title: RoE-FND: Synergizing LLMs with Experiential Learning for Effective and Generalizable Evidence-Based Fake News Detection
summary: The proliferation of deceptive content in social networks necessitates robust Fake News Detection (FND) systems. Existing pipelines either train detectors on labeled data or leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) for their reasoning ability. However, current approaches remain either limited in generalizability or prone to over-commitment to persuasive yet flawed rationales, lacking systematic experience and mechanisms to expose subtle reasoning errors. We propose \textbf{RoE-FND} (\textbf{\underline{R}}eason \textbf{\underline{o}}n \textbf{\underline{E}}xperiences FND), an LLM-based framework that combines self-reflective experience building with deliberation through retrieved experiences for FND. RoE-FND builds an experience bank via reflective learning that compares an unconstrained analysis with a label-conditioned analysis using the ground-truth label as posterior supervision, then summarizes their critical divergence into reusable reasoning guidelines. During inference, RoE-FND generates two opposing deductions via a flipped pseudo-label provided as posterior, retrieves the most relevant experiences for resolving their key disagreement, and adjudicates the better-supported rationale as the final prediction. Experiments across five popular benchmarks, including text-only datasets, i.e., CHEF, Snopes, PolitiFact, and multimedia datasets, i.e., FakeTT, FakeSV, demonstrate that RoE-FND outperforms strong baselines without optimizing LLM parameters on dataset distributions, while exhibiting strong cross-dataset generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出RoE-FND框架，通过自反思经验构建和基于检索经验的深思熟虑进行假新闻检测，在五个基准数据集上超越强基线并展现跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有假新闻检测方法要么依赖标注数据训练（泛化性受限），要么依赖LLM推理（易被看似合理但有缺陷的推理误导），缺乏系统化经验和暴露微妙推理错误的机制。
AI.method: RoE-FND包含两个阶段：(1) 经验构建阶段，通过对比无条件分析与标签条件分析（以真实标签作为后验监督）的差异，将关键分歧总结为可复用的推理准则存入经验库；(2) 推理阶段，通过翻转伪标签生成两个对立推理，检索最相关的经验来解决关键分歧，并裁定支持性更强的推理作为最终预测。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集（文本型：CHEF、Snopes、PolitiFact；多媒体型：FakeTT、FakeSV）上，RoE-FND无需针对数据集分布优化LLM参数即可超越强基线，并表现出强跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RoE-FND通过将反思性经验积累与深思熟虑的检索推理相结合，有效提升了假新闻检测的准确性和泛化性，为解决LLM在FND中过度依赖片面推理的问题提供了新范式。

title: Deep Analog: Open-Set Film Emulation with Reference-Conditioned 3D LUTs
comment: Master's thesis, Rochester Institute of Technology, 2026. 24 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Code and demo: https://github.com/EtonMu/deep-analog
summary: Film emulation reproduces the look of an analog film stock on a new digital photograph. We target its open-set form -- matching any reference film frame from a single example -- with a 3D lookup table (LUT) predicted from that reference. Real-time image enhancement predicts per-image weights over a fixed bank of 3D LUTs and blends them. We show this is a gated mixture of experts and inherits its failure: trained end-to-end against reconstruction, the gate collapses onto a single expert, so a bank of K LUTs delivers the capacity of one. An entropy term, the enhancement-setting analogue of mixture-of-experts load balancing, restores utilization and recovers about 1 dB PSNR. The deeper constraint survives: a fixed LUT basis is closed-set, freezing the achievable looks at training time. We therefore discard the basis and predict a single 3D LUT as a residual from a reference image (StyleLUTNet), trained by self-supervision on procedurally generated color transforms. The conditional design removes the gate and generalizes open-set to unseen film stocks without paired data or retraining. Around this color backbone we build Deep Analog, a film-emulation pipeline that adds histogram-based tone matching and a physics-informed optical renderer -- multi-scale grain and per-channel halation driven by parameters an inverse network regresses from the reference. On 350 self-supervised pairs the color stage reaches 22.05 dB PSNR / 0.925 SSIM and the full pipeline 21.72 dB / 0.923; the color path runs in 5.2 ms at 1080p (192 FPS) and exports a portable .cube LUT for standard editing tools. A second degeneracy in conditional LUT training -- residual-scale collapse -- shares the root cause and yields a general principle: auxiliary regularization must stay subordinate to reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Deep Analog，一种针对开放集胶片模拟（film emulation）的流水线。核心贡献是StyleLUTNet，它从单张参考图像直接预测残差3D LUT，取代了传统基于固定LUT库的混合专家方法，从而突破训练时冻结的封闭集限制。作者发现传统方法的门控机制会坍缩到单一专家，通过熵正则化恢复利用率约1dB PSNR，但根本限制在于固定基座是封闭集的。StyleLUTNet通过自监督学习程序化生成的颜色变换，实现开放集泛化，无需配对数据。完整流水线还包含直方图色调匹配和基于物理的光学渲染器（多尺度颗粒与逐通道光晕）。在350个自监督对上，颜色阶段达到22.05dB PSNR/0.925 SSIM，全流水线21.72dB/0.923，1080p下5.2ms运行（192 FPS），并可导出标准.cube LUT。
AI.motivation: 胶片模拟旨在让数字照片呈现出特定模拟胶片的外观。开放集形式要求仅凭单个参考帧匹配任意胶片质感，这是现有方法难以解决的。作者首先诊断出当前实时图像增强方法（基于固定3D LUT库逐图像加权混合）本质上是一个门控混合专家系统，存在两个严重缺陷：1）门控在端到端训练中坍缩到单一专家，K个LUT只提供1个的容量；2）更根本的是，固定LUT基座是封闭集的，训练时冻结了可实现的观感范围，无法泛化到未见过的胶片类型。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：证明基于LUT库的加权混合是门控混合专家，引入熵正则化（混合专家负载均衡的类比）恢复利用率，获得约1dB PSNR提升。2) StyleLUTNet：抛弃固定LUT基座，改为从参考图像预测单个3D LUT作为残差，用程序化生成的颜色变换进行自监督训练，无需配对数据即可泛化到开放集。3) Deep Analog完整流水线：在颜色骨干上叠加直方图色调匹配和物理启发的光学渲染器（多尺度颗粒、逐通道光晕），由反向网络从参考图像回归参数。4) 揭示第二个退化问题——残差尺度坍缩，提出通则：辅助正则化必须从属于重构损失。
AI.result: 在350个自监督训练对上，颜色阶段达到22.05 dB PSNR / 0.925 SSIM；完整流水线达到21.72 dB / 0.923 SSIM。颜色路径在1080p分辨率下仅需5.2ms（192 FPS），并可导出便携式.cube LUT供标准编辑工具使用。熵正则化恢复了约1dB PSNR的性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过从门控混合专家范式转向条件式残差LUT预测，成功解决了胶片模拟中开放集泛化的根本难题。实验证明StyleLUTNet在无配对数据条件下即可泛化到未见胶片，并保持了实时性能。作者还提炼了通用设计原则：辅助正则化必须从属于主重构目标，这对条件LUT训练和更广的生成任务具有方法论启示。

title: MetaReason: Precise Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning via Editing Meta Information for Solving Geometry Problems
summary: Although visual reasoning is crucial for solving complex geometry tasks, existing vision-language models rely heavily on text-only reasoning. Some recent methods introduce intermediate visual states to facilitate reasoning, but they are often hindered by inaccurate geometric representations and low rendering fidelity, ultimately leading to unreliable outputs. To address these limitations, we propose MetaReason, a framework for multimodal reasoning in plane geometry that leverages structured meta-information to enable accurate auxiliary-line construction. The framework first parses geometric images into meta-information, performs controllable edits with predefined tools to synthesize high-fidelity visual states, and then conducts reasoning based on these augmented views. To support this framework, we construct TutorGeo, a comprehensive dataset containing 17k image-to-meta conversion samples, 60k text-only reasoning traces, and 60k interleaved multimodal reasoning traces. Using this dataset, we combine supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to develop robust multimodal reasoning capabilities. We also introduce ExamGeo, a benchmark derived from real-world examination problems that enables systematic evaluation across varying difficulty levels. Experimental results demonstrate that MetaReason significantly outperforms existing open-source models and achieves competitive performance against proprietary models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MetaReason框架，利用结构化元信息实现平面几何的多模态推理。框架将几何图像解析为元信息，通过可控编辑合成高保真视觉状态，再基于增强视图进行推理。配套构建了TutorGeo数据集（17k图像转元信息样本、60k文本推理轨迹、60k多模态推理轨迹）和ExamGeo基准测试集，实验表明MetaReason显著优于现有开源模型，性能接近专有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在几何任务中过度依赖纯文本推理；虽有方法引入中间视觉状态来辅助推理，但受限于几何表示不准确和渲染保真度低，导致输出不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 将几何图像解析为结构化元信息；2) 利用预定义工具进行可控编辑，合成高保真视觉状态（辅助线构造）；3) 基于增强视图进行多模态推理；4) 结合监督微调和强化学习训练模型；5) 构建TutorGeo数据集和ExamGeo基准用于训练与评估。
AI.result: MetaReason在平面几何推理任务上显著优于现有开源模型，且性能与专有模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 结构化元信息和可控视觉状态编辑是提升几何多模态推理能力的有效途径，但该框架目前主要聚焦于平面几何，未来可扩展至更复杂的几何场景。

title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models increasingly use visual chain-of-thought (Visual CoT) to reason about spatial, temporal, and embodied environments. By generating intermediate reasoning images, Visual CoT provides an intuitive mechanism for visual foresight but introduces substantial inference overhead, which is particularly problematic for proactive video reasoning. We ask whether models can learn to think visually during training while reasoning directly at inference. We introduce Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT), a post-training framework that jointly optimizes textual prediction and next-embedding prediction over unlabeled videos. Given a partially observed video, IVT predicts latent representations of future frames together with the target textual answer, encouraging the model to capture motion, object transitions, interactions, and latent intent. At inference, IVT generates the answer directly without synthesizing or re-encoding future frames. We conduct controlled studies across target representations, decoder designs, prediction horizons, data mixtures, training curricula, and predictive objectives. IVT improves over direct-answer fine-tuning on all six evaluation settings while retaining the same inference pathway. Compared with explicit Visual CoT, IVT achieves comparable or better performance and reduces average end-to-end latency by more than 5x. Together, our findings suggest that explicit pixel-space generation at inference time, as used in visual chain-of-thought, may not be necessary for effective proactive video reasoning. Predictive world modeling can be internalized during training to produce multimodal reasoners that are both more accurate and substantially more efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT)框架，通过后训练阶段联合优化文本预测和下一嵌入预测，让多模态大语言模型在训练时内化视觉思维，推理时直接生成答案，无需显式生成中间推理图像，在保持甚至提升性能的同时将推理延迟降低5倍以上。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型使用视觉链式思维（Visual CoT）进行空间、时间和具身环境推理时，通过生成中间推理图像提供了直观的视觉前瞻机制，但引入了巨大的推理开销，对主动视频推理尤其不利。作者质疑是否可以在训练时学习视觉思考，而在推理时直接推理，以消除显式像素空间生成的推理成本。
AI.method: IVT是一种后训练框架，在无标注视频上联合优化文本预测和下一嵌入预测。给定部分观测的视频，IVT同时预测未来帧的潜在表示和目标文本答案，促使模型捕捉运动、物体转换、交互和潜在意图。推理时直接生成答案，无需合成或重新编码未来帧。作者系统研究了目标表示、解码器设计、预测范围、数据混合、训练课程和预测目标等设计维度。
AI.result: IVT在所有六种评估设置上均优于直接答案微调，同时保持相同的推理路径。与显式Visual CoT相比，IVT达到相当或更优的性能，并将平均端到端延迟降低5倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 推理时的显式像素空间生成（如视觉链式思维所用）可能并非有效的主动视频推理所必需。预测性世界建模可以在训练期间被内化，从而产生更准确且更高效的多模态推理器。

title: CFR without Unbiasedness: Deterministic Guarantees for Persistent Public-Chance Schedules
summary: At a finite public-chance cut, counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) must choose how many outcomes to evaluate before each regret update. Exact evaluation processes the full cut at one strategy profile; persistent partial evaluation processes a fixed without-replacement order across evolving profiles. The latter covers every outcome once per epoch, yet its feedback is generally conditionally biased because earlier batches influence the profiles seen by later batches. We establish a deterministic target-transfer theorem for uniform, nonnested additive public cuts. The theorem bounds full-cut exploitability by regret on the delivered feedback and a public-debit term that couples prefix coverage discrepancy with motion along the realized strategy path. Consecutively balanced schedules consequently converge for additive signed regret matching (RM) and RM+ under predetermined averaging weights, while a fixed RM+ construction proves that the discrepancy--path product is necessary in general. A component-resolved form of the theorem converts an execution trace into a numerical exploitability certificate. On two released heads-up no-limit hold'em turn endgames, persistent order improves substantially over fresh reshuffling despite identical epochwise coverage, and partial coverage wins every registered shallow matched-budget comparison. A depth study locates a crossover between 32 and 64 full-cut outcome budgets, after which complete coverage dominates. These results characterize public-chance width and order as learning variables and provide a deterministic basis for designing and auditing persistent CFR schedules.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限公共机会节点处，反事实遗憾最小化（CFR）在每次遗憾更新前应评估多少结果的问题。作者建立了一个确定性目标转移定理，适用于均匀、非嵌套的加性公共切分，该定理通过反馈上的遗憾和公共借方项来约束完整切分的可利用性。研究发现连续平衡的调度在加性符号遗憾匹配（RM）和RM+下收敛，而持久部分评估的固定顺序调度在扑克终端游戏中显著优于重新洗牌。
AI.motivation: CFR在公共机会节点处面临评估结果数量的权衡：精确评估处理整个切分但成本高，持久部分评估虽有反馈偏差但更高效。需要理解部分评估对收敛性和最终可利用性的影响，以及如何设计最优的持久调度策略。
AI.method: 作者建立了一个确定性的目标转移定理，将完整切分的可利用性界定为已交付反馈上的遗憾加上公共借方项——该项将前缀覆盖差异与沿实现策略路径的运动耦合起来。他们还提出了组件化解形式的定理，可将执行轨迹转化为数值可利用性证书。
AI.result: 连续平衡调度在加性符号RM和RM+下收敛；固定的RM+构造证明了差异-路径乘积在一般情况下是必要的。在两人无限注德州扑克转牌终端游戏中，持久顺序比重新洗牌显著改进，部分覆盖在浅层匹配预算比较中全部获胜。深度研究表明完整切分覆盖在32到64个结果预算之间占据主导地位。
AI.conclusion: 公共机会宽度和顺序应被视为可学习变量，持久CFR调度的设计与审计具有确定性的理论基础，为更高效的部分评估策略提供了理论保证和实用指导。

title: When Deep Research Agents Stagnate: Enhancing Reasoning with Retrieval-Aware Agent Control
summary: In this paper, we analyze the reasoning trajectories of a variety of DRAs and show that existing agents often suffer from reasoning stagnation: the majority of iterations contribute little or no improvement to final performance, while agents lack awareness of their trajectories and are therefore ineffective at adapting their search strategies or determining when to terminate. To address this issue, we introduce a set of unsupervised signals and a Retrieval-Aware Agent Controller (RAAC), which assists the agent in selecting optimal actions at each stage of the research process. RAAC incorporates key information retrieval principles, namely search novelty and information coverage, resulting in more effective reasoning trajectories that improve overall performance while reducing unnecessary iterations, and consequently cost and latency. Specifically on BrowseComp-Plus and across a large set of DRAs, adding RAAC reduces the number of search calls by an average of 14, significantly improves the best-performing DRA on recall and accuracy, and achieves an accuracy gain of up to 10% (3% on average).

AI.tldr: 本文提出检索感知智能体控制器（RAAC），通过无监督信号（搜索新颖性与信息覆盖度）帮助深度推理智能体避免推理停滞，优化搜索策略并决定终止时机，在BrowseComp-Plus上平均减少14次搜索调用，准确率平均提升3%、最高达10%。
AI.motivation: 现有深度推理智能体在推理轨迹中普遍存在推理停滞现象——大部分迭代对最终性能几乎没有贡献，且智能体缺乏对自身轨迹的感知，无法有效调整搜索策略或决定何时终止，导致效率低下和成本浪费。
AI.method: 提出RAAC（Retrieval-Aware Agent Controller），引入一组无监督信号，并整合信息检索中的两个关键原则——搜索新颖性（search novelty）和信息覆盖度（information coverage），在每个研究阶段辅助智能体选择最优行动。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp-Plus数据集上跨多种深度推理智能体进行测试：平均减少14次搜索调用；显著提升最佳智能体的召回率和准确率；准确率增益最高达10%，平均提升3%。
AI.conclusion: RAAC通过让智能体感知并控制自身推理轨迹，能够有效缓解推理停滞问题，在提升性能的同时降低不必要的迭代成本与延迟，为深度推理智能体的搜索策略优化提供了一种有效的无监督解决方案。

title: Auxiliary uncertainty signals for LLM-assisted systematic review screening: a benchmark across eight Cohen drug-class reviews
comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Code, prompts, and cached LLM responses at https://github.com/rahgoar/LR-Spectral-BERTGCN-Topological-Undecidability-in-Clinical-AI
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for title-abstract screening in systematic reviews, but their decisions lack calibrated uncertainty. We show that an auxiliary BERT+GCN classifier supplies a structured uncertainty signal that improves LLM screening efficiency, and we identify the prompt-delivery strategy that maximises the benefit-to-cost ratio.
  We evaluate five LLM prompt-delivery conditions on eight drug-class datasets from the Cohen (2006) benchmark using 3 seeds x 5-fold stratified cross-validation (600 fold-level results). A BERT+GCN model trained per fold classifies each test paper as INCLUDE, EXCLUDE, or MAYBE via two spectral tests (algebraic radical and categorical paradox). Conditions vary information content (none / label / full scores), selectivity (all papers vs. MAYBE only), and timing (proactive vs. reactive two-pass). A cross-model pilot against gpt-4.1-mini on three datasets tests cross-generation transfer.
  Three findings: (i) Full-context delivery yields significant gains in F1 (+0.011, paired Wilcoxon p=0.008) and WSS@95 (+0.050, p=0.039) at a 1.28x token-cost premium, while preserving recall. (ii) MAYBE-only routing is Pareto-optimal: highest mean recall (0.92) and AUC-ROC (0.54) at only 1.05x baseline cost -- one sixth of full-context overhead. (iii) The two-pass design escalates 22.2% +/- 8.8% of records yet never revises its decision (0% flip rate across all datasets and folds), giving decisive evidence that current instruction-tuned LLMs cannot self-triage. The cross-model pilot shows an identical +0.8% recall uplift for both LLM generations. A per-paper ablation across 20,796 observations shows the dual paradox test reduces empirically to a one-line logit-gap criterion. We release the full pipeline; the 600-run experiment replays in under one hour from cached LLM responses.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用BERT+GCN辅助分类器为LLM在系统综述标题-摘要筛选中的决策提供结构化不确定性信号，并通过五种提示词交付策略的系统评估，发现full-context交付可显著提升F1和WSS@95，MAYBE-only路由在成本-效益上帕累托最优，且两遍设计证明当前指令微调LLM无法自我分诊。
AI.motivation: LLM日益广泛用于系统综述的标题-摘要筛选，但其决策缺乏校准的不确定性度量，这限制了筛选效率与可靠性，需要一种结构化的不确定性信号来改进LLM的筛选性能。
AI.method: 在Cohen (2006)基准的8个药物类数据集上，使用3种子×5折分层交叉验证（共600个折级结果），训练逐折BERT+GCN分类器，通过代数根与范畴悖论两个谱检验将每篇论文分类为INCLUDE/EXCLUDE/MAYBE。评估5种LLM提示词交付条件，差异在于信息含量（无/标签/全分数）、选择性（全部论文vs仅MAYBE）及时序（主动vs反应式两遍），并用gpt-4.1-mini进行跨模型试点测试。
AI.result: (i) Full-context交付在1.28倍token成本下显著提升F1(+0.011, p=0.008)和WSS@95(+0.050, p=0.039)且保持召回率；(ii) MAYBE-only路由帕累托最优，最高平均召回率0.92和AUC-ROC 0.54，仅1.05倍基线成本；(iii) 两遍设计升级22.2%±8.8%记录但0%翻转率，证明LLM无法自我分诊。跨模型试点两种LLM均获相同+0.8%召回提升。20,796次观察的逐论文消融显示双悖论检验可简化为单行logit-gap准则。
AI.conclusion: LLM与结构化辅助分类器的结合能提升系统综述筛选效率；full-context交付取舍最优，MAYBE-only路由在成本-效益比上最优；当前LLM不具备自我纠错/分诊能力，提示词交付策略设计比期待模型自我修正更有效；完整pipeline已开源，600次实验可在1小时内从缓存LLM响应重放。

title: Xemo-Talker: Unlock Emotions Explicitly for Audio-Driven Talking Portrait Synthesis
summary: Precise emotion control in audio-driven talking heads remains a challenge due to the reliance on implicit emotion regulation in existing systems, which often leads to indirect and insufficient control. Additionally, training with explicit emotion-related losses across the entire motion space poses significant difficulties due to the inherent trade-off between accurate lip synchronization and fine-grained emotion control. In this paper, we reveal a key finding: although emotional cues are distributed throughout the motion space, concentrating discriminative supervision on less-principal components achieves a better emotion-lip synchronization balance, as principal components mainly encode high-energy articulation and pose variations. Building on this insight, we propose Xemo-Talker, which first learns a neutral speech-to-motion mapping for stable articulation and lip synchronization, and then introduces a lightweight emotion branch guided by less-principal subspace supervision. To enhance emotion control, we design a Tri-Loss consisting of inter-class separation, intra-class compactness, and less-principal contrastive learning. Given an audio input, a reference image, and an emotion label, Xemo-Talker achieves state-of-the-art emotion classification accuracy while maintaining competitive lip synchronization and high inference efficiency, with performance approaching that measured on real videos.The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/chaolongy/Xemo-Talker.

AI.tldr: Xemo-Talker是一种音频驱动的说话人头生成方法，通过将判别性监督集中在运动空间的次要主成分上（而非主成分），实现了情感控制与唇部同步的更好平衡。该方法先学习中性语音到运动的映射以保证稳定的发音和唇部同步，再引入由次要子空间监督指导的轻量级情感分支，并设计了包含类间分离、类内紧凑和次要主成分对比学习的三重损失函数。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动的说话人头生成系统依赖隐式情感调控，导致情感控制间接且不充分；同时在整个运动空间上使用显式情感损失存在唇部同步精度与细粒度情感控制之间的固有冲突。
AI.method: 1) 揭示关键发现：虽然情感线索分布在整个运动空间，但将判别性监督集中在次要主成分上能更好地平衡情感与唇部同步，因为主成分主要编码高能量发音和姿态变化。2) 提出Xemo-Talker，先学习中性语音到运动的映射确保稳定发音和唇部同步，再引入由次要子空间监督指导的轻量级情感分支。3) 设计Tri-Loss三重损失：类间分离、类内紧凑和次要主成分对比学习。
AI.result: Xemo-Talker在情感分类准确率上达到最先进水平，同时保持具有竞争力的唇部同步精度和高推理效率，性能接近在真实视频上测得的结果。
AI.conclusion: 将情感监督集中在运动空间的次要主成分上可以有效解决情感控制与唇部同步之间的权衡问题，Xemo-Talker验证了这一思路的有效性，并公开了源代码。

title: Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc
summary: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data. Existing neural surrogates often mix these roles inside unconstrained message passing. We introduce Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP), which turns this separation into an architectural principle. RHMP fixes the cellular coboundaries ($d_k$) determined by oriented incidence and learns symmetric positive-definite cochain metrics ($H_k$) for geometry-dependent propagation. Treating $H_k$ as the learned metric motivates cochain-frame equivariance: physical propagation should be invariant to orthogonal changes of the hidden cochain feature basis. RHMP implements this principle with metric-weighted Hodge blocks ($d_k^\top H_{k+1}d_k$), yielding exact cochain-complex identities ($d_{k+1}d_k=0$), nonnegative Hodge energies, positive-semidefinite operators, and exact Abelian curvature invariance. Across seven physical benchmarks spanning fluids, electromagnetism, gauge fields, and variable-mesh CFD, RHMP achieves the best overall performance, with the largest gains when topology, learned geometry, and field structure interact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出黎曼霍奇消息传递（RHMP），将物理场建模中的拓扑与几何分离作为架构原则：固定细胞复形上同边界算子，仅学习对称正定上链度量。通过度量加权的霍奇块实现精确的复形恒等式、非负霍奇能量和正半定算子，在七个物理基准上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有神经替代模型常将物理场的拓扑守恒律与几何/材料响应混在无约束的消息传递中，导致物理约束无法精确满足。论文主张：守恒律是拓扑的应保持精确，而几何、材料响应和各向异性耦合应从数据中学习。
AI.method: RHMP将分离原则编码为架构：1) 固定由有向关联矩阵确定的胞腔上同边界算子d_k；2) 学习对称正定上链度量H_k用于几何相关传播；3) 将H_k视为学习度量，促使上链框架等变性（物理传播应关于隐藏上链特征基的正交变化不变）；4) 用度量加权霍奇块d_k^T H_{k+1} d_k实现传播。
AI.result: 在涵盖流体、电磁学、规范场和变网格CFD的七个物理基准上，RHMP取得总体最佳性能，尤其在拓扑、学习几何和场结构相互作用的场景中增益最大。
AI.conclusion: RHMP通过将拓扑精确性与学习几何分离作为架构原则，实现了精确复形恒等式(d_{k+1}d_k=0)、非负霍奇能量、正半定算子和精确阿贝尔曲率不变性，证明了分离原则能显著提升物理神经代理的性能。

title: Language models suffer from a curse of ambiguity
summary: Large language models increasingly rely on sampling as a driver of their own improvement, making the fidelity of their learned distributions more critical than ever. Yet, not all distributions are equally easy to learn. In this work, we identify a curse of ambiguity: in large language models, and more broadly in all neural networks that produce discrete probability distributions, the more ambiguous a next-token distribution is, the harder it is to learn accurately. Through an extensive theoretical analysis, we trace this curse to architectural and learning roots. More ambiguous distributions require more capacity to be stored, larger embeddings to be represented, more steps to be fitted, and amplify token-sampling noise. We validate these findings on synthetic tasks with controlled ground truth and observe the same signatures in language models trained on real data. Our results provide a new perspective on the statistical capabilities of large language models and a practical framework for when to trust their output distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了一个"模糊性诅咒"现象：在大语言模型及所有生成离散概率分布的神经网络中，下一个词元分布越模糊（ambiguous），该分布就越难以被准确学习。通过理论分析，作者将这一现象追溯到架构和学习层面的根源，并在合成任务和真实语言模型上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越依赖采样作为自身改进的驱动力，因此其学习到的分布保真度变得至关重要。然而并非所有分布都同样容易学习，本文旨在识别和解释这种学习难度的差异，特别是模糊性对分布学习准确度的影响。
AI.method: 1) 通过广泛的理论分析，从架构和学习两个层面追踪模糊性诅咒的根源：更模糊的分布需要更多容量存储、更大嵌入表示、更多训练步骤来拟合，并且会放大词元采样噪声。2) 在具有可控真实标签的合成任务上验证理论发现。3) 在真实数据训练的语言模型上观察同样的特征。
AI.result: 在合成任务和真实语言模型上都验证了"模糊性诅咒"的存在：越模糊的分布越难被准确学习。具体表现为学习此类分布需要更高的存储容量、更大的嵌入维度、更多的训练步数，且采样噪声被放大。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为理解大语言模型的统计能力提供了新视角，并提供了一个实用框架来判断何时应该信任模型的输出分布。

title: FLOPs vs Real Work: The Importance of Replication in AI Efficiency Assessment
summary:
AI efficiency has recently taken the spotlight in both academy and industry due to massive model scales, high energy demands, and environmental costs. While reporting Floating Point Operations (FLOPs) is a traditional approach for assessing computational costs, the relationship between FLOPs and execution time is not straightforward, as layers with the same number of FLOPs may not have the same execution time because some operations are more easily parallelized than others. This paper sets out to replicate the original experiments from a study that proposed the $α-FLOPs$ estimation formula to verify whether the results remain applicable on newer, more powerful hardware.
  During the replication process, we identify limitations in the replication materials provided by the original study, including a lack of specific dependency details and transparency regarding regression data. Our results validate the thesis that raw FLOPs alone are not an appropriate metric for execution time, as spatial dimensions remain more easily parallelized than kernel dimensions. However, fine-grained measurements reveal that the relationship is much less straightforward than previously shown, with newer hardware exhibiting instabilities and discontinuities in execution time, including jumps and oscillations, that the $α-FLOPs$ formula generally underestimates. Ultimately, this work validates the empirical findings from the original study but shows negative results when applying the $α-FLOPs$ estimation. We also highlight the critical need for complete and accurate replication packages for research on hardware-dependent efficiency assessment and provide a complete replication package for our implementation to facilitate further study.

AI.tldr: 本文复制了提出α-FLOPs估算公式的原始研究实验，以验证其在更新的、更强大的硬件上是否仍然适用。结果表明原始研究关于FLOPs不能单独作为执行时间指标的结论仍然成立，但α-FLOPs公式在新硬件上表现不佳，存在执行时间不稳定性、跳跃和振荡等未被公式捕捉的现象。
AI.motivation: 由于模型规模巨大、能耗高和环境成本，AI效率评估日益受到关注。传统上使用FLOPs来评估计算成本，但FLOPs与执行时间之间并非简单线性关系，因为不同操作的并行化程度不同。作者希望验证α-FLOPs估算公式在新硬件上的适用性，并检查原始研究的可复制性。
AI.method: 作者完整复制了提出α-FLOPs公式的原始实验，在更新更强的硬件上进行验证。复制过程中记录并指出原始研究复制材料的不足（缺乏具体依赖细节和回归数据透明度），并进行细粒度的执行时间测量以比较公式预测与实际结果。
AI.result: 验证了原始研究关于FLOPs不足以单独作为执行时间指标的论点，空间维度比内核维度更易并行化。但细粒度测量显示，新硬件上关系更为复杂，存在执行时间的不稳定性和不连续性（跳跃和振荡），α-FLOPs公式总体上低估了这些现象。
AI.conclusion: 原始研究的经验性发现得到验证，但α-FLOPs估算在新硬件上呈现负面结果。作者强调硬件依赖型效率评估研究需要完整准确的复制包，并为此提供了完整的复制包供进一步研究。

title: PandasCorpus: A Resource of Real-World Pandas Workflows and Usage Patterns
summary:
Pandas has emerged as the de facto library for data processing and machine learning, widely used for tasks, such as data loading, transformation, and analysis. Despite its ubiquity, there has been limited systematic investigation into how Pandas is used in real-world projects and how typical workflows are composed in practice. To address this gap, we introduce PandasCorpus, a dataset curated from GitHub repositories that captures real-world Pandas workflows at scale. In this work, a workflow refers to Pandas-based code contained in Jupyter notebooks, a prevalent medium for writing, executing, and sharing data analysis code.
  The dataset comprises 139k notebooks from approximately 100k repositories and captures more than 4M Pandas API calls spanning 136 distinct operations. Beyond dataset construction, we characterize workflows using structural and Pandas-specific features and analyze notebook evolution between 2015 and 2025. Our study examines code executability, notebook size, and recurring sequences of Pandas operations, providing empirical insights into how Pandas is used in practice. The resulting corpus offers a reusable resource for studying data analysis workflows, Pandas usage patterns, and library-aware code composition. Both the dataset and the extraction pipeline are publicly available via GitHub and Zenodo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PandasCorpus，一个从GitHub上约10万个仓库中收集的13.9万个Jupyter notebook数据集，涵盖超过400万次Pandas API调用（136种操作），用于系统性地研究真实世界中Pandas的使用模式和工作流组成。
AI.motivation: 尽管Pandas是数据处理和机器学习的标准库，但缺乏对真实项目中Pandas使用方式的系统性研究，尤其是典型工作流如何组成的实践经验。
AI.method: 从GitHub仓库中构建PandasCorpus数据集，使用结构特征和Pandas特定特征来刻画工作流，并分析2015至2025年间notebook的演变，研究代码可执行性、notebook大小和Pandas操作的重复序列。
AI.result: 构建了包含139k个notebook、约100k个仓库、超过400万次Pandas API调用（覆盖136种不同操作）的数据集，并提供了关于Pandas实际使用模式的实证洞察。
AI.conclusion: PandasCorpus提供了一个可复用的资源，用于研究数据分析工作流、Pandas使用模式和面向库的代码组成，数据集和提取管道均已公开。

title: CLARA: Clip-Level Multimodal Alignment with VLM-Derived Rationales for Hateful Video Detection
summary: Hateful video detection has become increasingly important with the rapid growth of video-centric social media platforms, given the serious risks that hate speech poses to both individual well-being and social cohesion. Compared with text or static multimodal content, hateful video detection remains underexplored and significantly more challenging, as hateful meaning often arises from complex interactions among multimodal cues, including speech, audio, and visual content. Moreover, such signals are often brief, implicit, and temporally dependent, making them difficult to capture using conventional video-level representations. In this work, we propose CLARA, a clip-level multimodal framework for hateful video detection. Instead of treating a video as a single instance, CLARA models it as a sequence of fine-grained clips, enabling more precise capture of temporally localized hateful signals. We introduce a Mixture-of-Experts clip encoder for adaptive multimodal alignment, a local-global segment contrastive objective to jointly model short-term cues and long-range temporal dependencies, and VLM-derived rationales integrated via a gated Transformer to provide high-level semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on three hateful video datasets demonstrate that CLARA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Further ablation studies and parameter analyses validate the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLARA，一个基于clip级别的多模态框架用于仇恨视频检测。CLARA将视频建模为细粒度clip序列，通过MoE clip编码器、局部-全局对比学习目标和VLM推理引导，在三组数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 仇恨视频检测比文本或静态多模态内容更具挑战性，因为仇恨含义往往来自语音、音频和视觉等多模态线索的复杂交互，且这些信号通常是短暂、隐含且时间依赖的，传统的视频级表示难以捕捉。
AI.method: CLARA框架：(1) 将视频建模为细粒度clip序列而非单一实例；(2) 采用Mixture-of-Experts clip编码器实现自适应多模态对齐；(3) 引入局部-全局分段对比学习目标，联合建模短期线索和长期时间依赖；(4) 通过门控Transformer整合VLM生成的推理，提供高层语义指导。
AI.result: 在三个仇恨视频数据集上的广泛实验表明，CLARA持续优于最先进方法；消融研究和参数分析验证了每个组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CLARA证明了clip级别的细粒度建模、多模态自适应对齐以及VLM高层语义指导相结合，能够有效提升仇恨视频检测的性能，为视频级多模态理解任务提供了新的思路。

title: BRAID: Learning Equilibrium Maps in Interdependent Security Games via Weight-Tied Iterative Graph Neural Networks
summary: Computing Nash equilibria in interdependent security (IDS) games on networks is computationally expensive: best-response dynamics may need hundreds of iterations per instance, and downstream tasks such as auditing, stress-testing, and incentive design often require repeatedly re-solving the game under parameter perturbations. We propose BRAID, a Best-Response Amortized Iterative Dynamics model that uses a weight-tied iterative graph neural network to learn a direct map from game parameters to Nash equilibrium effort profiles, replacing iterative best response computation with a single forward pass that is up to 43X faster per instance. BRAID is derived from the best-response fixed-point structure of IDS games: its SUM aggregation reflects additive neighbor coupling, and a weight-tied gated recurrent unit (GRU) mirrors a damped best-response update. The same architecture applies across IDS specifications that vary investment-cost curvature and neighborhood aggregation, including log-linear, quadratic-cost, and log constant-elasticity-of-substitution (CES) utilities. Beyond equilibrium prediction, BRAID also recovers how equilibrium efforts change under perturbations to game parameters, including costs and network edge weights. We make this sensitivity recovery an explicit evaluation target and introduce two training strategies, interior-equilibrium training and input-noise regularization, that improve the local behavior of the learned equilibrium map without using sensitivity labels. Experiments show that BRAID effectively predicts Nash equilibria and recovers equilibrium sensitivities across utility specifications and network sizes.

AI.tldr: BRAID是一种基于权重共享迭代图神经网络的模型，用于在互依安全(IDS)博弈中直接学习从博弈参数到纳什均衡投入分布的映射，将迭代最优反应计算替换为单次前向传播，每个实例速度提升高达43倍，并能恢复均衡对参数扰动的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 在网络上计算IDS博弈的纳什均衡计算开销大：最优反应动力学每个实例可能需要数百次迭代；且下游任务（如审计、压力测试、激励设计）通常需要在参数扰动下反复求解博弈，传统方法难以满足效率需求。
AI.method: BRAID利用权重共享的迭代图神经网络（含SUM聚合和权重共享GRU）来模拟阻尼最优反应更新，源自IDS博弈的最优反应不动点结构。该架构适用于多种IDS规范（对数线性、二次成本、对数CES效用），并引入两种训练策略（内部均衡训练和输入噪声正则化）来提升学习均衡映射的局部行为，无需敏感性标签。
AI.result: 实验表明BRAID能有效预测纳什均衡并在多种效用规范和网络规模下恢复均衡敏感性；单次前向传播比迭代最优反应计算快最多43倍。
AI.conclusion: BRAID通过将迭代最优反应计算摊销为单次前向传播，同时实现了高效的均衡预测和无需标签的敏感性恢复，为IDS博弈的下游反复求解任务提供了可行方案。

title: Can Retrievers Find the Same Paper from Different Aspects? A Multi-Aspect Full-Paper Scientific Retrieval Benchmark
summary: Scientific papers contain multiple searchable facets such as background, methods. However, many paper retrieval benchmarks merely evaluate individual query-paper relevance, while overlooking other facets of the same paper. To bridge this gap, we introduce MAPLE, an expert-validated benchmark for multi-aspect, full-paper retrieval that evaluates whether retrievers can consistently recover the same paper from queries targeting its motivation, method, and experimental findings. MAPLE contains 2,095 queries about recent ML and NLP papers, grounded in both textual and multimodal content. We further propose MAPLE-Synth, a retrieval-based in-context learning pipeline that leverages OpenReview discussions and human-written query exemplars to generate realistic queries reflecting researchers' interests in different aspects of a paper. Our expert validation shows that these queries are comparable in realism to human-written queries and highly relevant to the target papers. Experiments across lexical, scientific-domain, general-purpose text, and multimodal retrievers reveal a substantial gap between retrieving a paper from any one aspect and retrieving it from all aspects: the strongest model achieves 98.1% AnyAspect@20 but only 15.7% AllAspect@20. Experiment/result queries and table-referenced queries are particularly difficult across retrievers. Although multi-chunk aggregation improves multi-aspect paper retrieval, considerable failures persist. MAPLE provides a testbed for evaluating and developing retrievers that represent scientific papers more comprehensively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAPLE，一个专家验证的多方面全文检索基准，包含2,095个针对近期ML/NLP论文的查询，涵盖动机、方法和实验发现三个层面。实验显示最强模型单方面检索达98.1%但全方位检索仅15.7%，揭示现有检索器在全面表示科学论文方面的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有论文检索基准仅评估单查询与论文的相关性，忽视了论文包含背景、方法等多个可检索方面。需要弥合这一差距，评估检索器能否从论文的不同方面（动机、方法、实验结果）一致地检索到同一篇论文。
AI.method: 提出MAPLE基准（含2,095个针对近期ML/NLP论文的查询，基于文本和多模态内容），以及MAPLE-Synth——一种基于检索的上下文学习管道，利用OpenReview讨论和人工查询示例生成反映研究者对不同论文方面兴趣的真实查询。
AI.result: 专家验证表明生成的查询与人工查询具有相当的逼真度且与目标论文高度相关。最强模型在AnyAspect@20达到98.1%，但AllAspect@20仅15.7%。实验/结果查询和表格引用查询尤其困难，多分块聚合虽有改善但仍存在显著失败。
AI.conclusion: MAPLE为评估和开发更全面表示科学论文的检索器提供了测试平台，揭示了当前检索器在多方面论文检索上的重大不足，强调了需要开发能更全面理解论文内容的检索系统。

title: HarmProfile: Characterizing Harmful Distributions in Frontier LLMs
summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) safety evaluation has largely treated harmful generation as an attack outcome rather than as an object of analysis. Consequently, little is known about the harmful outputs produced during model misbehavior, partly because large-scale, high-quality collections of frontier-LLM misbehavior are difficult to obtain. To address this gap, we introduce HarmProfile, a content-centric benchmark dataset that collects model misbehavior across diverse harm categories and model families, and defines the resulting harmful-output distribution as a model-level risk profile. The premise is that, just as linguistic behavior can be characterized from an utterance corpus, model risk can be characterized from the content, severity, and variation of its safety failures. HarmProfile contains over 80,000 validated artifacts from 23 frontier LLMs across 13 model families, organized into 15 harm categories and 57 subcategories. Using this corpus, we find that frontier LLMs reliably produce harmful content at scale, yet exhibit distinct risk profiles; both harmfulness and diversity grow with model capability, suggesting that frontier LLMs may appear safe yet harbor increasingly dangerous knowledge beneath the alignment surface. Our source code is available at https://github.com/fresh-ma/HarmProfile .

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarmProfile，一个以内容为中心的前沿大语言模型（LLM）安全评估基准数据集。该数据集收集了23个前沿LLM（跨越13个模型家族）在15个危害类别和57个子类别中的80000多个经验证的不当行为产物，将模型的不安全输出分布定义为模型层面的风险画像。研究发现前沿LLM能在规模上可靠地产生有害内容，但表现出不同的风险画像；有害性和多样性都随模型能力增长而增加，表明前沿LLM可能表面安全，但在对齐表面之下潜藏着日益危险的知識。
AI.motivation: 现有前沿LLM安全评估大多将有害生成视为攻击结果而非分析对象，导致对模型不当行为期间产生的有害输出知之甚少，主要原因是难以获得大规模、高质量的前沿LLM不当行为数据集。作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建HarmProfile基准数据集：从23个前沿LLM（13个模型家族）收集并验证超过80,000个不当行为产物，按15个危害类别和57个子类别组织，将有害输出分布定义为模型层面的风险画像。核心假设是：正如语言行为可从语料库表征，模型风险也可从安全失败的内容、严重性和变化性来表征。
AI.result: 前沿LLM能可靠地在规模上产生有害内容，但每个模型展现不同的风险画像；有害性和多样性随模型能力增强而增加，暗示能力更强的模型虽然表面安全，但内部潜藏着更危险的知識。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调了将有害生成作为分析对象进行系统性研究的重要性，并提出风险画像概念作为模型安全评估的新视角。代码已开源。

title: Periocular Soft Biometrics: A Survey and Applications to Multimedia Forensics and Disinformation Detection
comment: Accepted for publication at ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection (AI4MFDD2026)
summary: Soft-biometric attributes such as gender, age, and ethnicity provide valuable ancillary evidence when full identity recognition is not feasible, supporting applications in forensic investigation, identity verification, surveillance, or detection of synthetic and manipulated media. Among biometric modalities, the periocular region is a robust source of soft-biometric cues, as it often remains visible when other parts of the face are occluded, a frequent condition in forensic evidence and surveillance footage, and can be captured across a wide range of acquisition conditions. In this paper, we provide a survey of demographic attribute estimation from periocular images, covering publicly available datasets, methodological trends from handcrafted descriptors to deep learning architectures, and the state of the art in gender, age, and ethnicity prediction. We discuss use cases relevant to multimedia forensics and disinformation-detection applications, including demographic filtering in surveillance footage, age verification, and the detection of demographic inconsistencies in synthetic data. We also highlight open challenges, including dataset bias, cross-domain generalisation, fairness, ethical aspects, and the lack of forensic-oriented benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文是首篇针对"眼周区域人口统计学属性估计"的综述，系统梳理了公开数据集、从手工特征到深度学习的算法演进、以及性别/年龄/种族预测的最新进展，并重点讨论了其在多媒体取证与虚假信息检测中的应用及开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 软生物特征（性别、年龄、种族）在无法进行完整身份识别时提供重要的辅助证据。眼周区域作为生物特征模态中稳健的软生物特征来源，常在面部其他部位被遮挡时仍保持可见，适用于取证和监控场景。然而该领域缺乏系统性综述，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 本文采用综述研究的方法，涵盖:(1)梳理公开可用的眼周图像数据集;(2)总结从手工特征描述子到深度学习架构的方法学发展趋势;(3)综述性别、年龄、种族预测的现有技术水平;(4)讨论多媒体取证与虚假信息检测中的应用场景;(5)指出数据集偏差、跨域泛化、公平性、伦理等开放挑战。
AI.result: 文章呈现了眼周软生物特征估计的完整研究图景：汇总了现有数据集与主流方法框架，展示了性别/年龄/种族估计在监控人口过滤、年龄验证、合成数据人口不一致检测等取证场景中的可用性，同时揭示该领域存在数据集偏差、缺乏取证导向基准等关键短板。
AI.conclusion: 眼周人口统计学属性估计在多媒体取证领域具有重要应用价值，但目前仍面临数据集偏差、跨域泛化不足、公平性与伦理问题以及缺乏取证导向基准等挑战，这些是未来研究需要重点攻克的难题。

title: Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)
summary: Forward-Pass-Only MLP training (FPO) adapts large language models without a backward pass through the model body, achieving 2.7--3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning at ~40% less peak training memory, while leaving off-domain benchmarks within seed-noise of baseline, a property that full-network fine-tuning does not reliably reproduce. FPO rests on a single empirical observation: at late layers of a transformer, the output-layer prediction error approximates the true gradient with cosine similarity 0.47--0.59 across six public models we survey. We introduce a two-minute diagnostic that quantifies this approximation per layer for any model, identifying where late-layer adaptation is viable. Informed by the diagnostic, FPO computes a single error signal at the output and applies it to each target layer. No signal is propagated between layers, and no autograd graph is constructed at any point. We evaluate FPO on three model families (OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-8B, Falcon3-7B). Across all three, FPO produces in-domain perplexity improvement and leaves MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, and Winogrande within seed-noise of baseline. Localizing SFT to FPO's target layers to enter this regime is also feasible, but at 2.2x the wall-clock cost of FPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FPO（Forward-Pass-Only）方法，一种不需要通过模型主体反向传播的MLP训练技术，通过仅在输出层计算单一误差信号并应用于目标层，实现2.7-3.2倍的标准微调吞吐量，同时将峰值训练内存降低约40%，且保持离域基准性能在种子噪声范围内。
AI.motivation: 传统全网络微调计算开销大、内存需求高，且无法可靠地保持离域基准性能。研究者希望找到一种更高效的训练方法，能够在不进行反向传播的情况下实现有效的模型适应。
AI.method: FPO基于一个核心经验发现：在Transformer的深层，输出层的预测误差近似于真实梯度（余弦相似度0.47-0.59）。论文引入了两分钟诊断方法来量化每层的近似程度，识别深层适应的可行性。FPO在输出层计算单一误差信号，将其直接应用于每个目标层，层间不传播任何信号，也不构建autograd图。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族（OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-8B, Falcon3-7B）上评估，FPO在所有三个模型上产生域内困惑度改进，同时MMLU、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag和Winogrande基准保持在种子噪声范围内。
AI.conclusion: FPO提供了一种高效且有效的替代全网络微调的方法，通过利用输出层误差与梯度的近似关系，消除了反向传播的需求。虽然局部化SFT到目标层也能进入该训练模式，但其计算成本是FPO的2.2倍。

title: Mental Model Management: An Operator-Based Framework for LLM Memory
summary: Large language models process large amounts of information but usually lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining compact and evolving conceptual representations. We introduce Mental Model Management (3M), a framework in which knowledge is represented as mental models consisting of compact chunks. Rather than accumulating text passages, 3M continuously integrates new information into an existing conceptual representation. A set of operators extracts knowledge, retrieves relevant models, adds and updates chunks, reorganizes representations, detects inconsistencies, and derives new knowledge. We describe the main 3M operators and illustrate each operation using Evolution Strategies as a running example.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mental Model Management (3M)框架，用紧凑的概念块（chunks）来表示知识，而非累积文本段落。3M通过一组算子持续将新信息整合到已有的概念表示中，包括知识提取、模型检索、块添加与更新、表示重组、不一致检测和新知识推导。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型处理大量信息，但缺乏维护紧凑且不断演进的概念表示的显式机制。传统的文本累积方式无法实现高效、结构化的知识管理。
AI.method: 3M框架将知识表示为由紧凑块组成的心理模型，通过一组算子持续整合新信息：提取知识、检索相关模型、添加和更新块、重组表示、检测不一致、推导新知识。以Evolution Strategies作为运行示例说明每个算子的操作。
AI.result: 论文描述了3M的主要算子，并通过Evolution Strategies这一具体示例演示了每个算子的工作流程，验证了框架的可操作性。
AI.conclusion: 3M提供了一种替代文本累积的显式概念表示机制，使LLM能够维护紧凑且动态演进的知识结构。

title: Large Language Models Show Metacognitive Sensitivity in Medical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated and used in medicine, but clinical usefulness depends on answer accuracy and whether confidence tracks evidence quality and uncertainty. We developed a controlled, psychophysics-inspired clinical benchmark to test diagnostic choice and confidence behavior in a medical LLM. The benchmark focused on probable Alzheimer-type neurocognitive disorder (AT-NCD) versus depression-related cognitive impairment (DRCI). We generated 45 synthetic vignettes varying evidence strength, conflicting evidence, and missing information. Each vignette was presented under three prompt variants, yielding 135 trials. In a pilot run with gpt-4.1-nano, all trials produced valid structured outputs. Across forced-choice trials, diagnostic accuracy was 93.5%, mean confidence was 78.4%, and AUROC2 was 0.876. Confidence increased with evidence distance from the diagnostic boundary, decreased when information was missing, and remained higher on correct than incorrect trials after adjustment for evidence strength and prompt format. These findings indicate partial metacognitive sensitivity rather than globally uninformative confidence. However, errors clustered in moderate, conflicting AT-NCD cases, where the model shifted toward DRCI and retained more confidence than empirical accuracy justified. Model comparison suggested that confidence quality should be measured directly rather than inferred from benchmark accuracy or model capability alone. This study establishes a reproducible framework for evaluating evidence sensitivity, metacognitive sensitivity, and localized calibration failure in medical LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个受心理物理学启发的临床基准测试框架，用于评估医学大语言模型在诊断阿尔茨海默型神经认知障碍（AT-NCD）与抑郁相关认知障碍（DRCI）时的诊断准确性和置信度校准。通过45个合成临床情景（135个试验），在gpt-4.1-nano上测试发现：诊断准确率93.5%，平均置信度78.4%，AUROC2为0.876；置信度随证据距离增加而上升、随信息缺失而下降，对正确答案更有信心，表现出部分元认知敏感性。但错误集中在矛盾的中等AT-NCD病例，且模型置信度高于实证准确率，提示存在局部校准失败。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在医学中的应用日益广泛，但临床实用性不仅取决于答案准确性，还取决于置信度是否能准确反映证据质量和不确定性。现有评估方法缺乏对模型"知道何时不知道"能力的系统测试，因此需要建立可控的基准来同时评估诊断选择行为和置信度行为。
AI.method: 采用受心理物理学启发的实验设计：生成45个合成临床小故事，系统操纵证据强度、冲突证据和缺失信息三个维度；每个情景配以三种提示变体共135个试验；要求模型进行强制二选一诊断并报告置信度；分析诊断准确率、置信度水平、AUROC2、置信度与证据距离的关系，以及校准失败模式。
AI.result: gpt-4.1-nano在所有试验中产生有效结构化输出。诊断准确率93.5%，平均置信度78.4%，AUROC2为0.876。置信度随证据边界距离增加而上升，信息缺失时下降，在控制证据强度和提示格式后正确试验的置信度高于错误试验。然而，错误集中在中等证据强度且有冲突的AT-NCD病例，模型在这些病例中偏向DRCI诊断且置信度超出实证准确率所应支撑的水平。模型比较显示置信度质量应直接测量而非从基准准确率或模型能力推断。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了可复现的框架来评估医学LLM的证据敏感性、元认知敏感性和局部校准失败。部分元认知敏感性确实存在，但模型在特定的中等证据冲突病例中存在校准缺口，提示直接测量置信度质量的必要性。该框架可用于未来更广泛医学模型的系统性置信度评估。

title: The Recall Trap: A Recall-Maximizing Retriever Configuration Reduces Issue Resolution in Fixed-Budget Code Context
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures. Reproducibility artifact: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21879550
summary: Retrieval components for code assistants are tuned against retrieval metrics: a configuration that raises recall@k is adopted, and downstream task success is assumed to follow. We report a controlled case study in code repair, not a new phenomenon but a deployed-flag, execution-graded instance of the known relevance-diversity and objective-mismatch tradeoff (Levy et al., 2025). On SWE-bench Verified we inject a retriever's hits as a fixed 12-slot context pack with no search tools and toggle one flag (one-chunk-per-file deduplication) on an otherwise identical stack. The flag is the higher-recall configuration (gold file present in 0.878 of served packs against 0.806 disabled), yet disabling it, trading file breadth for within-file depth, raises the single-shot resolve rate: gpt-5.6-sol +7.6pp (39.2% to 46.8%, n=500, McNemar exact p=0.0003), and a pre-registered open-weights replication any reviewer can re-run (Qwen3.6-27B, +3.6pp, n=499, p=0.0133); both survive repository-clustered inference. The gain tracks within-file anchor dose, and a random-chunk control refutes an argmax-selection artifact. We map where it holds: it reverses on a lexical BM25 retriever (-3.2pp, significant cross-paradigm interaction), is not detected under unrestricted-Read agents (a powered null), and across four languages (SWE-PolyBench, N=617) is positive but not significant (+2.6pp, p=0.056), a mapped boundary rather than a confirmed extension. Operationally, at a tight fixed budget: do not hard-deduplicate by file, and A/B packing policies against the task, not the metric the flag was tuned to.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控案例研究，揭示了代码助手检索组件的一个关键陷阱：针对检索指标（如recall@k）调优的配置并不必然带来下游任务性能提升。作者在SWE-bench Verified上注入检索结果作为固定12槽上下文包，发现关闭按文件去重（虽然降低recall）反而提升单次修复率（gpt-5.6-sol +7.6pp，Qwen3.6-27B +3.6pp），并通过多组对照实验（随机块、BM25、多语言、Agent场景）映射了该效应的边界条件。
AI.motivation: 代码助手的检索组件传统上以检索指标（如recall@k）为优化目标，默认假设"更高的召回率=更好的下游任务表现"。然而这一假设缺乏严格验证，存在已知的相关性-多样性权衡（relevance-diversity tradeoff）和目标失配（objective mismatch）问题。作者希望用部署级、执行评分（execution-graded）的受控实验，严谨检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 在SWE-bench Verified基准上，将检索器的命中结果以固定12槽上下文包形式注入（无搜索工具），仅切换一个标志（单文件单块去重）进行对照。同时设计多组消融与对照实验：随机块控制（排除argmax选择伪影）、BM25词法检索器交叉对比、无限制Read Agent的零功效检验、以及跨四种语言的SWE-PolyBench边界映射。两个模型（gpt-5.6-sol与预注册的Qwen3.6-27B）均执行单次修复，采用McNemar精确检验并做仓库聚类推断。
AI.result: 关闭去重（牺牲文件广度换取文件内深度）在两个模型上都显著提升单次修复率：gpt-5.6-sol从39.2%升至46.8%（+7.6pp，p=0.0003），Qwen3.6-27B +3.6pp（p=0.0133）。但效应有明确边界：在BM25检索器下反转（-3.2pp），在无限制Read Agent场景下检测不到，在四语言SWE-PolyBench上仅+2.6pp且不显著（p=0.056）。
AI.conclusion: 检索指标与下游任务目标存在系统性失配：追求recall@k而采用按文件硬去重的策略，实际损害了代码修复的单次成功率。操作建议是：在固定预算下不要按文件硬去重，而应直接以任务指标对打包策略（packing policy）进行A/B测试，而非信任被调优的检索标志。

title: KeyID: Decoupled Drafting and Keyframe Editing for Identity-Preserving Video Generation
summary: Identity-preserving video generation (IPVG) requires synthesizing videos that are faithful to both reference subjects and text prompts. Existing methods are often hindered by high tuning costs or limited input-level enhancements, struggling to maintain rigid identity consistency during complex, long-sequence actions. To address these limitations, we propose KeyID, a training-free IPVG framework that decouples the synthesis of video dynamics from the injection of identity. Specifically, KeyID comprises two components: (1) Reference-Aware Video Generation, which produces an identity-agnostic video draft aligned with multiple references, and (2) Identity-Preserved Keyframe Editing, which integrates the target identity via sparse keyframe correction and subsequent motion interpolation. By shifting from dense frame-level supervision to sparse keyframe-level refinement, KeyID effectively resolves the capacity conflict between prompt adherence and identity fidelity. Crucially, our modular design allows seamless extension to multi-subject references and complex sequential action generation without additional training. KeyID outperforms prior works and is validated by automatic and human evaluations on the official challenge benchmark, ultimately securing the runner-up position in the Track 2 (Sequential Action) of the ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG Grand Challenge. Source code is available at https://github.com/WISLab-GDUT/KeyID.

AI.tldr: KeyID是一个无需训练的保身份视频生成框架，通过解耦视频动态合成与身份注入，将密集帧级监督转为稀疏关键帧级精炼，在ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG大挑战赛Track 2中获得亚军。
AI.motivation: 现有IPVG方法受限于高调优成本或有限的输入级增强，难以在复杂、长序列动作中保持刚性身份一致性。作者希望通过解耦策略解决提示遵循与身份保真之间的容量冲突。
AI.method: 提出KeyID框架，包含两个组件：(1) 参考感知视频生成，生成与多参考对齐的身份无关视频草稿；(2) 保身份关键帧编辑，通过稀疏关键帧修正和后续运动插值整合目标身份。该模块化设计可无缝扩展至多主体参考和复杂序列动作生成，且无需额外训练。
AI.result: KeyID在官方挑战基准上通过自动和人工评估优于先前工作，最终在ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG大挑战赛Track 2（序列动作）中夺得亚军。
AI.conclusion: 从密集帧级监督转向稀疏关键帧级精炼可有效解决提示遵循与身份保真之间的冲突，KeyID验证了训练无关框架在IPVG任务上的有效性，并开源代码。

title: The Open-Strategy Dictator Game: Cooperation Under Mutual Transparency
summary: We introduce the Open-Strategy Dictator Game (OSDG), a variant of the classic dictator game in which each player's strategy is a natural-language document visible to all participants. The dictator's decision, to SHARE or TAKE an endowment, may depend on the text of the recipient's strategy. A large language model adjudicates each interaction by interpreting the dictator's strategy in the context of the recipient's. We run round-robin tournaments among diverse strategies and analyze the resulting payoff matrix using softmax equilibrium frequencies, dominance analysis, and sensitivity to the relative value of cooperation. Conditionally cooperative strategies, those that share with cooperators and take from exploiters, consistently dominate, while unconditional strategies (always share or always take) are weakly dominated. The results suggest that in environments where agents can inspect each other's decision procedures, conditional cooperation is evolutionarily robust across a wide range of payoff parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了开放策略独裁者游戏（OSDG），一种变体，每个玩家的策略是一份所有参与者可见的自然语言文档。大语言模型作为裁判，根据独裁者策略与接受者策略的上下文来裁定每轮互动。通过循环赛和收益矩阵分析发现，条件合作策略（与合作者分享、与剥削者夺取）始终占优，而无条件策略（永远分享或永远夺取）被弱占优。
AI.motivation: 探索在代理可相互检查对方决策程序的环境中，条件合作策略的进化稳健性。经典独裁者游戏缺乏策略透明度，而现实互动中参与者常可观察对方的决策规则。
AI.method: 提出OSDG变体：策略为自然语言文档且对所有参与者可见；使用大语言模型裁判独裁者策略与接受者策略的互动；进行多样策略间的循环赛；用softmax均衡频率、优势分析和对合作相对价值的敏感性来解析收益矩阵。
AI.result: 条件合作策略（分享给合作者、夺取剥削者）持续占优；无条件策略（总是分享或总是夺取）被弱占优；在广泛的收益参数范围内，条件合作表现进化稳健。
AI.conclusion: 在代理可检视彼此决策过程的环境中，条件合作是跨广泛收益参数进化稳健的策略，突出了策略透明度对合作演化的重要性。

title: The EMN Country Factsheets Structured Dataset
summary: Each year, the European Migration Network (EMN) country factsheets deliver an overview of key migration and international protection developments within all EMN Member States and observer countries. The factsheets include both a textual component and a visual component. In this paper, we introduce a curated dataset of the textual component of these reports over 35 countries and 13 years (2012-2024.) The dataset was created to facilitate European-level research on migration policies and developments, and promote the use of reliable sources about migration in data science and media research, particularly at a time when the spread of online misinformation about migration constitutes a serious issue. The dataset transforms the original document texts into a tabular format, with columns corresponding to country, year, section, subsection, content, and harmonized title section. We illustrate the value of the dataset with concrete analyses and propose envisioned applications and uses of the dataset. The dataset is accessible through a DOI link.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个基于欧洲移民网络（EMN）国家概况报告文本部分构建的精选数据集，涵盖35个国家、13年（2012-2024年）的移民与保护政策发展信息，以表格化格式呈现，旨在促进欧洲层面的移民政策研究并应对移民相关的网络虚假信息问题。
AI.motivation: 当前关于移民的在线虚假信息传播严重，需要一个可靠的、权威的移民信息来源。EMN国家概况报告每年提供各成员国的移民和国际保护发展综述，但其文本形式不利于数据科学和媒体研究使用，因此需要将其转化为结构化数据。
AI.method: 从EMN各国事实清单中提取文本组件，将其从原始文档转换为表格格式，包含国家、年份、章节、子章节、内容和统一标题章节等字段，覆盖35个国家和2012-2024年共13年的时间范围。
AI.result: 成功构建了一个覆盖35国、13年的结构化数据集，并通过具体分析实例展示了数据集的实用价值，同时提出了预期的应用场景。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为欧洲层面的移民政策研究提供了可靠且结构化的数据资源，有助于在数据科学和媒体研究中推广权威移民信息来源，并通过DOI链接公开访问。

title: Multi-Modal Generative Fuzzy System: Fuzzy Inference Guided Large Model Interactive Question Answering Framework
summary: In Multimodal Question Answering (MQA), models are required to jointly encode and integrate heterogeneous information from multiple modalities, including text, images, and speech, to perform complex semantic reasoning and decision making. Despite recent advances, existing approaches, including traditional deep learning models and Large Models (LMs) or prompt-based frameworks, continue to face several critical challenges. First, modality bias arises from discrepancies in feature distributions across different modalities, which limits effective cross modal collaborative understanding. Second, many questions require knowledge drawn from multiple domains, introducing significant uncertainty. Third, current methods often rely on shallow semantic matching, resulting in limited reasoning depth an reduced interpretability. To address these issues, inspired by the traditional fuzzy system (FS) framework, we propose a fuzzy-inference-guided multimodal generative architecture termed the Multi-Modal Generative Fuzzy System (MMGFS). The main contributions of MMGFS are two folds. First, it alleviates modality bias through a multimodal collaborative rumination mechanism. Second, it introduces fuzzy rules and a multi-hop inference mechanism to support cross-domain knowledge fusion and hierarchical reasoning, thereby strengthening uncertainty modelling and deepening semantic understanding. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on open-domain question answering datasets, including MultimodalQA and WebQA, as well as domain-specific benchmarks, including BioMol-VQA and EHRxQA. Experimental results demonstrate that MMGFS consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple datasets. It effectively mitigates modality bias and question uncertainty while achieving superior performance in answer accuracy, consistency, and generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模糊推理引导的多模态生成架构MMGFS，通过多模态协同深思机制缓解模态偏差，并引入模糊规则和多跳推理机制支持跨域知识融合与分层推理，在多个多模态问答数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态问答方法面临三大挑战：1)模态偏差——不同模态特征分布差异限制了跨模态协同理解；2)跨域知识带来的不确定性；3)浅层语义匹配导致推理深度不足和可解释性差。传统深度学习和基于大模型的提示框架均未能充分解决这些问题。
AI.method: 受传统模糊系统框架启发，MMGFS包含两个核心贡献：1)多模态协同深思机制（multimodal collaborative rumination mechanism）用于缓解模态偏差；2)引入模糊规则和多跳推理机制，支持跨域知识融合与分层推理，强化不确定性建模并加深语义理解。
AI.result: 在MultimodalQA、WebQA等开放域问答数据集以及BioMol-VQA、EHRxQA等领域特定基准上进行了全面评估。实验结果表明MMGFS在多个数据集上持续优于现有方法，有效缓解了模态偏差和问题不确定性，在答案准确性、一致性和泛化性方面均取得 superior 性能。
AI.conclusion: MMGFS通过融合模糊推理范式与生成式多模态架构，为多模态问答中的模态偏差、不确定性和推理深度不足问题提供了一种有效解决方案，展现出良好的准确性和泛化能力。

title: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Resolution Diffusion Models for Trajectory Generation in Urban Systems
summary:
Understanding human mobility is critical for a wide range of urban applications, including traffic management, epidemic control, and urban planning. However, due to privacy concerns, the availability of large-scale public trajectory data remains limited, posing challenges for downstream mobility analysis. Existing methods for synthetic trajectory generation primarily focus on matching global distribution similarity, while often overlooking mobility patterns across different spatial and temporal resolutions that are essential for practical utility.
  To address these challenges, we propose a novel multi-resolution diffusion framework, MR-Traj, for large-scale trajectory generation. MR-Traj explicitly models trajectories as compositions of coarse-grained milestones and fine-grained segments, enabling the capture of complex spatial-temporal dependencies at multiple resolutions. Experimental results demonstrate that MR-Traj achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods in terms of global distribution similarity, while consistently outperforming them in modeling fine-resolution mobility patterns and supporting downstream urban mobility tasks. In addition, by introducing stochasticity at multiple resolution levels, MR-Traj generates more diverse trajectories, which empirically reduces trajectory linkage risk under a seed-guided data release setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ray0202/MR-Traj.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MR-Traj，一个多分辨率扩散框架，用于大规模轨迹生成。它通过将轨迹建模为粗粒度里程碑和细粒度片段的组合，同时捕捉多个时空分辨率下的移动模式，在保持全局分布相似性的同时，更好建模细粒度移动模式，并生成更多样化、隐私风险更低的轨迹。
AI.motivation: 由于隐私问题，大规模公共轨迹数据的可用性有限，阻碍了下游移动性分析。现有合成轨迹生成方法主要关注匹配全局分布相似性，往往忽略了不同空间和时间分辨率下的移动模式，而这些模式对实际应用至关重要。
AI.method: MR-Traj将轨迹显式建模为粗粒度里程碑与细粒度片段的组合，利用多分辨率扩散框架捕捉多个分辨率下的复杂时空依赖关系，并在多个分辨率层次引入随机性以增强轨迹多样性。
AI.result: MR-Traj在全局分布相似性方面达到与现有最优方法相当的性能，在细分辨率移动模式建模和下游城市移动任务支持方面持续优于现有方法。此外，多分辨率随机性的引入使生成的轨迹更多样化，在种子引导的数据发布设置下经验性地降低了轨迹关联风险。
AI.conclusion: MR-Traj通过多分辨率扩散建模有效解决了现有轨迹生成方法忽视多尺度移动模式的问题，在实用性和隐私保护方面均展现了优势。

title: ATLAS: Scaffold-Free Algorithm Synthesis by LLMs via Embedding-Guided Quality-Diversity Search
summary: Most LLM-based automated algorithm design methods optimize a designated component within a human-specified scaffold, fixing overall organization and component interactions. We present ATLAS, an embedding-guided quality-diversity framework for scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis in combinatorial optimization. The problem specification supplies objectives and constraints; a minimal I/O interface fixes only instance and solution formats; the LLM chooses and restructures components, interactions, and control flow. This freedom enlarges the search space, risking invalid candidates and premature convergence to one design region. ATLAS independently detects execution, interface, and feasibility failures, recomputes objectives, and applies error-conditioned repair; similarity-based archive management preserves algorithms across embedding-space regions to counter premature convergence. Its three-layer search refines the best design, gives other regions dedicated refinement opportunities, and performs cross-region synthesis to recombine components and their interactions. Across four NP-hard problems, ATLAS outperforms several state-of-the-art component-synthesis methods and a matched full-synthesis baseline while remaining competitive with strong human-designed algorithms. One ATLAS run retains several algorithms with comparable performance from distinct embedding-space regions rather than a single design. Code inspection finds that these multi-component designs differ in their primary construction or global-search backbone. Our results suggest that embedding-guided quality-diversity search can make the enlarged full-algorithm design space practically searchable. Source code and exact executable prompts are available at <https://github.com/Danial-Yazdani/ATLAS>.

AI.tldr: ATLAS是一个基于嵌入引导的质量多样性(QD)框架，用于组合优化中的无脚手架全算法合成。它让LLM自由选择和重组组件、交互及控制流，通过错误条件修复和相似性归档管理来解决搜索空间扩大带来的失效和早熟收敛问题，在四个NP难问题上优于多种SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的自动算法设计方法大多在人工指定的脚手架内优化特定组件，限制了整体组织和组件交互的自由度。作者希望突破这一限制，实现真正的全算法合成，但同时需要应对搜索空间急剧扩大带来的挑战。
AI.method: ATLAS包含三个关键机制：(1) 错误条件修复——独立检测执行、接口和可行性失败，重新计算目标函数并应用错误条件化的修复；(2) 基于相似性的归档管理——在嵌入空间区域间保留算法，防止过早收敛；(3) 三层搜索——第一层精炼最优设计，第二层为其他区域提供专门的精炼机会，第三层进行跨区域综合以重组组件及其交互。
AI.result: 在四个NP难问题上，ATLAS优于多种SOTA组件合成方法和匹配的全合成基线，同时与强人工设计算法保持竞争力。单次运行中能保留多个来自不同嵌入空间区域且性能相当的算法，这些多组件设计在主要构建或全局搜索骨干上存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入引导的质量多样性搜索可以使扩大后的全算法设计空间实际可搜索，克服了无脚手架全算法合成的主要障碍。这表明通过合理的多样性保持和错误管理策略，LLM能够自主探索更大范围的算法设计空间。

title: The Unwritten Benchmark: A New Challenge for Multimodal Machine Learning in Abstract Perceptual Reasoning
comment: To be published in CVPR Findings 2026
summary: Current multimodal models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in recognizing static visual and auditory content. However, their capacity for abstract perceptual reasoning, inferring unseen information from dynamic, generative processes, remains a critical and underexplored frontier. In this paper, we introduce The Unwritten Benchmark, a new challenge designed to probe this abstract perceptual and cognitive ability. We define the core task as acousto-kinematic word inference: models must decipher words, across 3 different writing styles, being written solely from the audio of pen scratches and the video of hand movements, without any visible ink trace. Our evaluation results reveal a profound gap between human and machine performance: while human participants achieve high ordered letter accuracy (over 80%), leading Multimodal Machine Learning Models, including GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5-Pro, struggle significantly, failing to surpass 10%. Furthermore, we identify a paradoxical fusion effect in the models, where providing both modalities often degrades performance rather than improving it. This finding indicates a fundamental breakdown in their ability to synthesize complementary perceptual cues for this cognitive task. These findings highlight significant limitations in both cross-modal causal reasoning and the understanding of the micro-kinematics essential for such cognitive and intuitive perceptual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"未写基准"(The Unwritten Benchmark)，测试多模态模型能否仅通过笔划声音和手部运动视频（无可见墨迹）推断被书写的单词。结果显示人类准确率超80%，而GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5-Pro等顶尖模型不足10%，且多模态融合反而降低性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型擅长识别静态视觉和听觉内容，但缺乏从动态生成过程中推断未见信息的抽象感知推理能力，这是一个关键且未被充分探索的领域。
AI.method: 设计"声动学-运动学单词推断"任务：模型需仅根据钢笔划痕音频和手部运动视频（无墨迹痕迹）来解读三种书写风格下的单词；构建新基准并对比人类与多模态模型表现。
AI.result: 人类参与者的有序字母准确率超80%，而GPT-4o和Gemini 2.5-Pro等领先模型未能超过10%；且发现悖论性融合效应——同时提供两种模态反而导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型在跨模态因果推理和对微运动学的理解上存在根本性缺陷，无法合成互补感知线索完成此类认知任务，揭示了人机之间的巨大性能鸿沟。

title: Evaluating Agentic Code Repair Capabilities in Distributed Systems
summary:
LLM-based coding agents have advanced rapidly on single-process SWE tasks, with frontier models now clustering in the high-70s on SWE-bench Verified. Distributed-system debugging, however, remains an under-explored regime: bugs span processes, nodes, and protocol interactions, with root causes rarely recoverable from source alone and brute-force exploration intractable across non-deterministic interleavings. This leaves two gaps in LLM and agent evaluation: no code-repair benchmark targets distributed-system bugs, and no controlled study isolates how much externally provided debugging context changes agent success on them. We introduce DDBench, a code-repair benchmark of 60 historical bugs mined from 13 open-source distributed systems, partitioned into three difficulty tiers.
  DDBench evaluates every case under two matched conditions: a symptom-only condition where the agent receives only the bug symptom and repository, and a context-augmented condition where it additionally receives a bounded debugging context (logs, traces, runtime state, and targeted code-investigation notes), isolating the effect of debugging context from model capability. The evaluation of ten LLMs on DDBench reveals several findings. First, distributed debugging exercises a reasoning dimension that single-process benchmarks do not surface: models' pass rates span 61 pp, and pairwise bootstrap separates 9 of 15 top-tier model pairs at p < 0.05 on DDBench's hardest case-set. Second, bounded debugging context lifts aggregate pass rate by +18.1 pp, and the lift is asymmetric: weaker models gain pass rate, while stronger models gain efficiency. Third, debugging context requires careful curation, as even faithful debugging context can sometimes mislead LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DDBench，一个包含60个分布式系统历史bug的代码修复基准测试，分为三个难度等级，并从10个LLM的评估中总结了三个发现：分布式调试与单进程基准测试不同、有界调试上下文对模型成功率有非对称提升、调试上下文需要精心策划。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM编码代理在单进程SWE任务上取得了显著进展，但分布式系统调试仍未被充分探索。存在两个缺口：没有针对分布式系统bug的代码修复基准测试，也没有对照研究隔离外部调试上下文对代理成功的影响。
AI.method: 从13个开源分布式系统中挖掘60个历史bug，分为三个难度等级。每个案例在两种匹配条件下评估：仅症状条件（只提供bug症状和仓库）和上下文增强条件（额外提供有界调试上下文，包括日志、追踪、运行时状态和代码调查笔记），以隔离调试上下文与模型能力的影响。
AI.result: 基于10个LLM的评估显示：1）模型通过率跨度达61个百分点，DDBench最难的案例集中9/15对顶级模型在p<0.05下可被区分；2）有界调试上下文使总体通过率提升+18.1个百分点，且提升不对称——较弱模型获得通过率提升，较强模型获得效率提升；3）调试上下文需要精心策划，即使忠实的调试上下文有时也会误导LLM。
AI.conclusion: 分布式调试激发了一个单进程基准测试无法呈现的推理维度，调试上下文对模型成功的促进作用显著但具有非对称性，且上下文的策划质量至关重要。

title: Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans
comment: Paper accepted at 3rd HCV workshop at ECCV 2026. 12 pages main text, 16 pages supp
summary: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated view and assessing it along three axes: the decision of target presence, the efficiency of reaching the target, and the gaze process itself. The axes dissociate. On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans, detecting present targets near ceiling and reaching them on the first saccade more often than people do. The gaze process is not human. Under the human-matched condition, all three share one signature: low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other. That is consistent with a single-pass, non-serial architecture rather than a limit of acuity. Matched retinal input reproduces where humans look but not how the looking unfolds in time, and no degradation regime recovers human-like search at human-like success. The gap sits on a process axis that answer-alignment and saliency metrics do not measure. Because they miss it, such metrics cannot certify human-like vision, and zero-shot models suit outcome and spatial questions but not temporal, process-level ones.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种通用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）与人类在目标导向视觉搜索（COCO-Search18）中的眼动扫描路径。在人类匹配的中心凹视觉输入条件下，模型在目标检测决策和目标获取效率上达到或超过人类水平，但注视过程与人类显著不同：模型产生低熵、大幅度、高度自一致的扫描路径，其自身一致性远超两个人类之间的一致性，表明其采用单遍、非串行架构而非人类式的串行搜索过程。
AI.motivation: 人类视觉搜索是串行的：中央凹必须依次落在候选目标上才能确认，这些落点形成扫描路径。作者希望探究多模态大语言模型在相同中心凹输入下是否以人类方式进行搜索，这关系到它们能否作为人类视觉模型使用，以及注意力对齐分数的有效性。
AI.method: 作者将三个通用MLLMs与人类眼动扫描路径在COCO-Search18目标导向搜索任务上进行比较。通过逐注视点驱动每个模型通过相同的人类匹配中心凹视图，并从三个维度评估：目标存在性决策、到达目标的效率、以及注视过程本身。
AI.result: 三个维度相互分离：在决策和目标获取上，模型匹配或超过人类（目标检测接近天花板，首次跳视到达目标的频率高于人类）；但注视过程不像人类——所有模型都表现出低熵、大幅度、自一致的扫描路径，自身一致性远高于两个人之间的一致性。匹配的视网膜输入能复现人类看哪里，但不能复现人类看的时序展开方式，且任何退化设置都无法恢复类人搜索成功率和类人搜索方式。
AI.conclusion: 差距存在于过程维度上，而答案对齐分数和显著性指标无法衡量该维度。因为这些指标忽略了这一差距，它们无法证明类人视觉能力。零样本模型适合回答结果和空间问题，但不适合时间层面的过程性问题。

title: Watermarked Game Solving via Perturbed Regret Minimization
summary: Many real-world interactions among self-interested parties can be modeled by game theory, and the rapid advancements in AI have raised concerns about the possible misuse---accidental or deliberate---of superhuman or human-level game-playing agents by bad actors. While AI watermarking has mainly been applied to LLM-generated texts, a recent line of work proposes developing watermarking techniques for agents in game-theoretic settings. However, existing watermarking techniques for game-theoretic agents are not readily applicable due to their limited scope or capabilities---they are tailored to perfect-information games and are thus inapplicable to richer game types. We propose a new approach to watermarking game-playing agents, which a) can be applied to imperfect-information settings; b) is directly integrated into the learning process itself; and c) incurs only a bounded cost in exploitability. For this purpose, we introduce perturbed regret minimization, which adds perturbations to the utilities prior to observation so as to encourage the learning algorithm to embed the watermark. Our experiments show that the watermark incurs only a small exploitability cost and can be detected within just a couple of hours of gameplay at human speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对博弈智能体的水印技术，可应用于不完全信息博弈场景，通过扰动遗憾最小化将水印直接嵌入学习过程，且仅产生有界的可利用性成本，实验表明水印成本小且能在数小时内被检测。
AI.motivation: 现实中许多自利主体间的交互可通过博弈论建模，而AI的快速发展引发了对超人或人类级博弈智能体被恶意滥用的担忧。现有的博弈智能体水印技术仅适用于完美信息博弈，无法应用于更丰富的博弈类型，因此需要一种适用于不完全信息场景的水印方法。
AI.method: 提出扰动遗憾最小化（perturbed regret minimization）方法，在观察前向效用函数中添加扰动，从而激励学习算法嵌入水印。该方法直接集成到学习过程中，适用于不完全信息博弈设置，并保证可利用性成本有界。
AI.result: 实验表明，该水印仅产生很小的可利用性成本，并且能够在人类速度下短短数小时的游戏过程中被检测出来。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的水印方法有效克服了现有技术在博弈类型上的局限，在不完全信息博弈中实现高效水印嵌入与检测，为博弈智能体的安全与溯源提供了可行途径。

title: Decomposing Staleness in Recommender Systems: A Dual-Filter Framework for Supersession and Decay
summary:
Stale recommendations are a pervasive challenge and a leading source of user complaints on large-scale content platforms. Items lose relevance through two primary mechanisms: supersession, where emerging updates render prior coverage stale, and relevance decay, where an item's informational value naturally diminishes over its lifecycle. Traditional countermeasures serve as crude proxies: age cutoffs poorly reflect actual relevance loss, while engagement heuristics rely on lagging signals, broadly exposing users to stale content before the system adapts.
  We present SDF (Supersession-Decay Filtering), a staleness filtering system fully deployed in Google Discover, a personalized recommendation feed with hundreds of millions of daily and billions of monthly active users. SDF targets both mechanisms with complementary filters, each powered by a learned model: a relational staleness model that detects supersession between item pairs, and a predicted traffic ratio (PTR) model that forecasts relevance decay from the item's content, trained on lifetime visit traffic. Applied via disjunction upstream of the ranking stage, SDF prunes stale candidates, measurably reducing downstream serving costs. Online experiments demonstrate that these filters significantly reduce the prevalence of stale content while improving user engagement. Over a two-year production deployment, user-filed staleness reports (in-product user feedback) declined by 54.9% relative to the pre-deployment baseline, establishing SDF as a robust and scalable paradigm for resolving content staleness at industrial scale.

AI.tldr: SDF是一个部署在Google Discover中的内容陈旧性过滤系统，通过两个互补的机器学习模型（关系性陈旧模型检测内容替代，预测流量比模型预测相关性衰减）在排序前剪枝陈旧候选，显著减少陈旧内容并提升用户参与度，两年部署期用户反馈下降54.9%。
AI.motivation: 大规模内容平台中陈旧推荐是普遍挑战且是用户投诉的主要来源。内容失效通过两种机制发生：替代（新内容使旧覆盖过时）和相关性衰减（信息价值随时间自然降低）。传统方法如年龄截断和参与度启发式是粗糙的近似，无法准确反映实际相关性损失，且依赖滞后信号，导致用户广泛暴露于陈旧内容。
AI.method: SDF系统包含两个互补过滤器，每个由学习模型驱动：（1）关系性陈旧模型——检测条目对之间的替代关系；（2）预测流量比（PTR）模型——基于条目内容预测相关性衰减，在生命周期访问流量上训练。两个过滤器采用析取方式应用于排序阶段上游，剪枝陈旧候选，同时降低下游服务成本。
AI.result: 在线实验证明过滤器显著减少陈旧内容出现的同时提升用户参与度。在Google Discover（数亿日活、数十亿月活用户）的两年生产部署中，用户提交的陈旧性报告相对部署前基线下降54.9%。
AI.conclusion: SDF建立了在工业规模上解决内容陈旧性的稳健且可扩展的范式，通过精准建模替代和衰减两种失效机制，相比传统启发式方法更有效，且能在大规模生产环境中长期稳定运行。

title: Wiola 13M, a Gated Spiral Attention Architecture for Parameter Efficient Small Language Models
summary: Small language models in the ten to one hundred million parameter range are attractive for on device inference, rapid experimentation, and controlled scientific study, yet most of them reuse the standard transformer block without adaptation to the small scale regime. We present Wiola, a decoder only language model whose novelty is concentrated in three drop in components of every layer. First, Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding perturbs the standard rotary frequencies by a slowly growing per dimension factor so that phase trajectories fan outward, improving long range discrimination while adding no parameters. Second, Gated Spiral Attention introduces a per head, content adaptive scalar gate derived from a causal cumulative statistic of the query stream, providing an implicit and differentiable form of soft head selection at negligible cost. Third, the Butterfly feed forward block replaces the conventional expansion layer with a multiplicative interaction and an intra block bypass path, matching the parameter count of a four times gated linear unit block while improving gradient flow in shallow stacks. We formalize each component, derive exact parameter and computation budgets, and prove that the gated attention admits an exact and numerically verified equivalence between full sequence training and cached autoregressive decoding, so that no approximation is introduced at inference time. We also describe a fully reproducible training and evaluation protocol on a standard tiny story corpus. The reference implementation is released as an open source package with weights ready publishing support.

AI.tldr: Wiola是一个10M到100M参数范围内的decoder-only语言模型，通过三个即插即用的组件改进标准Transformer块以适应小规模场景：Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding（螺旋旋转位置编码）、Gated Spiral Attention（门控螺旋注意力）和Butterfly前馈块，在保持参数预算的同时提升远距离辨别能力、提供隐式软头选择并改善梯度流动。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型（10M-100M参数）在端侧推理、快速实验和受控科学研究中很有吸引力，但大多数模型直接复用标准Transformer块，没有针对小规模场景进行适配优化。
AI.method: 提出Wiola模型，在每层中引入三个即插即用组件：1) Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding：通过每维度缓慢增长的因子扰动标准旋转频率，使相位轨迹向外扇形展开，增强长距离辨别能力且不增加参数；2) Gated Spiral Attention：引入基于查询流因果累积统计量的逐头内容自适应标量门控，提供可微的隐式软头选择；3) Butterfly前馈块：用乘法交互和块内旁路路径替代传统扩展层，匹配四倍门控线性单元块的参数数量同时改善浅层堆叠中的梯度流动。
AI.result: 论文形式化描述了每个组件，推导了精确的参数和计算预算，并证明了门控注意力在完整序列训练和缓存自回归解码之间存在精确且数值验证的等价性，推理阶段无近似引入。还提供了在标准小故事语料上的完全可复现训练与评估协议。
AI.conclusion: Wiola通过三个轻量级组件实现了小规模语言模型的针对性优化，同时保证了训练的完整性与推理的高效等价性，并开源了参考实现和权重。

title: On Cross-Validation for Hyperparameter Optimization of Deep Learning Image Classifiers
summary:
Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) can materially affect the performance of deep learning (DL) image classifiers, but there is little empirical guidance on how to derive the validation signal that drives it, especially for the small sample sizes common in fields such as medical imaging. We compared three HPO protocols in terms of {\em
  absolute performance-estimation error} (AEE; the absolute difference between the winning configuration's validation AUROC and its test AUROC): fixed holdout (F), reshuffled holdout (R), and 5-fold cross-validation (C). The search space, sampler, training procedure, architecture, and test set were held identical across protocols. We evaluated the protocols on three public datasets spanning two regimes: binary medical imaging (RSNA pneumonia radiographs and binarized HAM10000 skin lesions) and 200-class natural imaging (Tiny ImageNet), across a range of development set sizes $n$ and two backbones (ResNet-18 on all datasets, Vision Transformer (ViT-S/16) on RSNA). On the medical datasets, every point estimate favored cross-validation over both holdout protocols, with reductions in AEE largest at small sample sizes and diminishing as $n$ increased. This pattern remained robust under conservative family-wise adjustment. On Tiny ImageNet, AEE was negligible under all three protocols. Test AUROC was generally similar among protocols. Fixed holdout had lower mean AEE than reshuffled holdout in 11 of 12 medical conditions, although this secondary finding was less uniformly supported. For small-sample medical image classification, we recommend cross-validation-based HPO when computational resources permit because it trades additional computation for a more reliable development-time estimate of subsequent test performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统比较了三种超参数优化（HPO）验证协议——固定留出验证（F）、重洗留出验证（R）和5折交叉验证（C）——在深度学习图像分类器中的性能估计误差（AEE）。在三个公开数据集（RSNA肺炎X光片、二值化HAM10000皮肤病变和Tiny ImageNet）上，使用相同搜索空间、采样器、训练流程和架构进行对比。结果显示：在医学影像小样本场景下，交叉验证的AEE最低，且在小样本时优势最明显；在自然图像大规模数据集上三种协议差异可忽略不计。研究推荐在计算资源允许时，小样本医学图像分类应使用基于交叉验证的HPO。
AI.motivation: 超参数优化对深度学习图像分类器性能有显著影响，但缺乏关于如何设计驱动HPO的验证信号的实证指导，尤其是在医学影像等小样本场景下。此前没有系统性研究对比不同验证协议在估计测试性能方面的准确性。
AI.method: 比较三种HPO验证协议（固定留出、重洗留出、5折交叉验证），在三组数据集（两组医学影像、一组自然图像）上，保持搜索空间、采样器、训练流程、架构和测试集完全一致，评估各协议在绝对性能估计误差（AEE）上的表现，并跨不同开发集大小n和两种骨干网络（ResNet-18和ViT-S/16）进行系统评估。
AI.result: 医学数据集上，所有点估计均显示交叉验证优于两种留出协议，AEE降低在小样本时最为显著，且随n增大而递减；该模式在保守的族系校正下依然稳健。Tiny ImageNet上三种协议AEE均可忽略。固定留出在12种医学条件中的11种中平均AEE低于重洗留出。测试AUROC在三种协议间总体相似。
AI.conclusion: 对于小样本医学图像分类，推荐在计算资源允许时使用基于交叉验证的HPO，因为它以额外计算换取更可靠的开发期测试性能估计。这一发现为医学影像领域的HPO实践提供了首个系统的实证指导。

title: Geometry Is Not Robustness: A Trajectory-Level Study of PGD Evaluation
summary: Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) is widely used to evaluate adversarial robustness, typically via final adversarial accuracy, which does not capture model behaviour throughout the attack. Recent work proposes trajectory-level diagnostics, such as loss evolution, gradient alignment, and steps-to-failure, for deeper insight into adversarial optimisation dynamics. However, whether these diagnostics reliably indicate robustness strength remains unclear. We conduct a trajectory-level investigation of PGD attacks on convolutional neural networks trained on Fashion-MNIST. We compare clean-trained and adversarially-trained models across multiple robustness regimes, using rigorous 20-step PGD evaluations with random initialisation and multiple restarts for robustness measurement, and single-initialisation trajectory recording for diagnostics. We record full PGD trajectories across 3000 clean-correct samples per model and analyse loss evolution, gradient alignment, and failure timing across attack iterations. Our results reveal a clear robustness hierarchy across models; however, trajectory metrics do not contribute equally to its identification. Mean loss trajectories and gradient alignment patterns appear quantitatively similar across adversarially-trained models with substantially different robust accuracies. In contrast, steps-to-failure distributions provide a clearer separation of robustness regimes, directly reflecting functional resistance to adversarial perturbation. These findings indicate that trajectory-level diagnostics describe optimisation geometry but do not independently measure adversarial robustness. Their interpretability depends on robustness regime, attack strength, and multi-metric evaluation. Trajectory-level analysis should be a complementary diagnostic tool, interpreted in context, rather than a replacement for standard robustness measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文对PGD攻击在CNN模型（Fashion-MNIST）上的轨迹级诊断指标进行了系统性研究，发现损失轨迹和梯度对齐等指标在不同鲁棒性模型间表现相似，而步骤-失败（steps-to-failure）分布能更清晰地区分鲁棒性等级，表明轨迹级诊断应作为标准鲁棒性度量的补充工具而非替代品。
AI.motivation: 标准PGD评估通常只报告最终对抗准确率，无法捕捉攻击过程中的模型行为。虽然近期工作提出了轨迹级诊断（如损失演化、梯度对齐、steps-to-failure），但这些诊断指标是否可靠地反映鲁棒性强度仍不明确，需要系统验证。
AI.method: 在Fashion-MNIST上对卷积神经网络进行比较研究：使用20步PGD、随机初始化和多次重启进行鲁棒性测量；对每个模型3000个干净分类正确的样本记录完整PGD轨迹，分析损失演化、梯度对齐和失败时机三个诊断指标，对比干净训练和对抗训练模型。
AI.result: 模型间存在清晰的鲁棒性层级，但各轨迹指标贡献不均：平均损失轨迹和梯度对齐模式在鲁棒性差异显著的对抗训练模型间表现相似；而steps-to-failure分布在区分鲁棒性等级上更清晰，能直接反映对对抗扰动的功能性抵抗。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级诊断描述的是优化几何特性，但不能独立衡量对抗鲁棒性。其可解释性依赖于鲁棒性体制、攻击强度和多种指标的综合评估，应作为标准鲁棒性测量的补充诊断工具，需结合上下文解读。

title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models
summary: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator. To our knowledge, LACE is the first to formulate general tabular pipeline AutoML this way, evaluated on standardized OpenML tasks under a leakage-controlled protocol that withholds dataset identity from the generator. Because every candidate is ordinary Python, the returned pipeline and the search that produced it can be inspected and edited directly, rather than only through a framework's model objects.
