On 68 OpenML classification tasks, LACE with GPT-5.4-mini significantly outperforms auto-sklearn, H2O, and a fixed XGBoost baseline, with no detectable difference against AutoGluon, the strongest search-based system evaluated, while covering the full benchmark. Newer tabular foundation models are more accurate on the subset of tasks they support, but apply a fixed pretrained predictor rather than returning an editable task-specific program. LACE's contribution is therefore not raw accuracy but a search space defined by code: complete coverage, pipelines practitioners can reuse directly, and a component set extended by editing the prompt rather than the framework.

AI.tldr: LACE 是一种新型 AutoML 框架，通过让大语言模型作为变异算子，在完整的可执行 Python 程序（scikit-learn 兼容类）空间中进化搜索管道，而非局限于预设的组件空间。在 68 个 OpenML 分类任务上超越 auto-sklearn、H2O 和 XGBoost 基线，与 AutoGluon 相当，其核心贡献是"以代码定义搜索空间"：管道可直接检查编辑，组件可通过修改 prompt 扩展。
AI.motivation: 传统 AutoML 系统只能在预先指定的预处理算子、学习器和超参数空间中搜索，无法产生该空间之外的新结构，限制了搜索的表达能力和灵活性。
AI.method: LACE 采用进化循环维护一个 scikit-learn 兼容 Python 类的种群，以大语言模型（GPT-5.4-mini）作为变异算子生成新的管道程序，并在泄漏控制协议下隐藏数据集身份进行评估。
AI.result: 在 68 个 OpenML 分类任务上，LACE 显著优于 auto-sklearn、H2O 和固定 XGBoost 基线，与最强的 AutoGluon 无显著差异，且覆盖全部基准任务。新的表格基础模型在支持的任务子集上更准确，但不可编辑。
AI.conclusion: LACE 的贡献不在于原始精度，而在于以代码定义搜索空间：实现完整覆盖、产出可直接复用的管道、并通过编辑 prompt 而非框架来扩展组件集。

title: When to Communicate: Belief Distributions and KL Divergence for Principled Gating in Multi-Agent RL
summary: Effective communication in multi-agent reinforcement learning requires agents to decide not only \textit{what} to communicate, but when? Existing approaches either communicate at every timestep or learn a binary gate through REINFORCE policy gradients \cite{singh2019}, a high-variance signal that produces unstable and uninterpretable gating behavior. I propose a principled alternative: agents communicate only when the KL divergence between their learned belief distributions exceeds a fixed threshold. Each agent maintains a belief distribution over a latent world state computed as a softmax over its LSTM hidden state, and communicates only when belief disagreement is large enough to justify information exchange. I evaluate this approach on the Predator-Prey benchmark from IC3Net \cite{singh2019} across two environment sizes with 5 seeds each, and on MPE simple\_spread \cite{lowe2017}, comparing against IC3Net, CommNet, and an independent controller. On PP 10$\times$10, IC3Net outperforms KL-belief at all thresholds. On the harder PP 20$\times$20, a threshold ablation over $\varepsilon \in \{0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0\}$ reveals an inverted U-shape: $\varepsilon=0.5$ achieves 73.84 average steps and 42\% success rate versus IC3Net's 75.31 steps and 31\%, a gap of 1.47 steps and 11 percentage points with tighter seed variance. On MPE, the belief head improves mean reward by 12 points and reduces variance by 26$\times$ even when gating is inactive, suggesting two orthogonal contributions: principled gating when beliefs can converge, and improved latent representations that benefit coordination regardless.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于KL散度阈值判定的多智能体通信门控机制：智能体仅在信念分布分歧超过阈值时进行通信，替代传统REINFORCE二值门控的高方差问题。在Predator-Prey和MPE基准上验证，在困难环境上超越IC3Net，并发现信念头本身对表征学习的独立贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习中，通信门控要么每时刻全通信（浪费资源），要么用REINFORCE学习二值门控（高方差、不稳定、不可解释）。需要一个原则性、稳定的通信时机决策方法。
AI.method: 每个智能体维护一个关于潜在世界状态的信念分布（LSTM隐藏状态的softmax），仅在智能体间KL散度超过固定阈值ε时通信。在PP 10×10、PP 20×20和MPE simple_spread上评估，超参数消融ε∈{0.1,0.3,0.5,1.0}。
AI.result: PP 10×10上IC3Net全面优于KL-belief；PP 20×20上ε=0.5时KL-belief达到73.84步/42%成功率，优于IC3Net的75.31步/31%，方差更小；MPE上即使门控不激活，信念头也提升平均奖励12点并将方差降低26倍。
AI.conclusion: KL散度门控在信念分布能收敛的困难场景下优于REINFORCE门控，且信念表征头本身对协调有独立的正向贡献，即通信时机的选择与潜在表征质量是两个正交的改进维度。

title: Mobile App Rewrites via Dual Boot
summary: We term the mechanism dual boot: the ability to host two mobile application variants within a single binary with a boot-time variant selection. This mechanism, combined with build-generated symbol resolution maps and linker retain lists, also enables two additional capabilities not inherent to the mechanism alone: (1) in-binary A/B experimentation between full application variants, and (2) graceful deprecation of the legacy variant without user disruption: preserving app store listing, branding, and install base. We frame the complete lifecycle as the first application of the Strangler Fig pattern to native mobile platforms. We validate the architecture across three evaluation scenarios, with improvements in developer productivity, experimentation capability and flexibility. The system contributed to a complete iOS application rewrite, from initial embedding through multi-segment experimentation to full deprecation of the legacy variant, without losing users throughout the 10-month evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"双启动"（Dual Boot）的机制，允许在单个二进制文件中承载两个移动应用变体，并在启动时选择激活哪个变体。该机制结合构建生成的符号解析映射和链接器保留列表，还支持应用变体间的A/B实验，以及旧变体的优雅退役（不干扰用户）。论文将这一完整生命周期视为Strangler Fig模式在原生移动平台上的首次应用，并通过三个评估场景验证了该架构在开发者生产力、实验能力和灵活性方面的改进。
AI.motivation: 原生移动应用的重写过程往往面临用户流失、分发复杂性以及无法在真实用户中安全进行A/B实验等挑战。作者希望通过一种机制，使得旧版应用可以平滑地向新版本过渡，同时保持应用商店上架状态、品牌形象和现有安装用户群。
AI.method: 提出"双启动"机制，即在单一二进制文件中同时嵌入两个应用变体，通过启动时选择来决定运行哪个变体。该机制结合了构建生成的符号解析映射和链接器保留列表，进一步支持：（1）完整应用变体之间的A/B实验；（2）旧变体的优雅退役。整个生命周期被框架为Strangler Fig模式在原生移动平台上的应用。
AI.result: 在三个评估场景中验证了该架构，显示出在开发者生产力、实验能力和灵活性方面的改进。该系统支撑了一次完整的iOS应用重写过程——从初始嵌入、多阶段实验，到旧变体的完全退役，在10个月的评估周期内用户未流失。
AI.conclusion: 双启动机制是一种有效的策略，能够在原生移动平台上安全地进行应用大规模重写，既保留了用户基础和品牌，又提供了灵活的A/B实验能力，将Strangler Fig模式成功引入移动端开发实践。

title: UniTAC: Universal Task-Aware Compression via Weighted Distortion Measures
summary: Physical AI systems such as autonomous vehicles and robots rely on timely exchange of high-dimensional sensory signals under tight bandwidth, latency, and energy budgets. Because the task driving downstream decisions evolves over time, a task-specific codec is brittle and retraining one per task is infeasible in the field. We propose UniTAC, a single learned image codec spanning universal (task-agnostic) to task-specialized operation, re-targeted at runtime without retraining. The task is abstracted as a per-component importance vector, derived, e.g., from gradient attribution of any downstream model, and transmitted as low-overhead side information that conditions both encoder and decoder. Trained once over a broad, randomized family of such vectors against weighted-reconstruction distortion, UniTAC keeps a fixed backbone and a single human-viewable reconstruction whose fidelity is steered to the active task by swapping the injected vector. We analyze the underlying weighted rate-distortion problem, characterizing when a diagonal weighted distortion is task-consistent and how weights relate to task sensitivity. Guided by this, we design a Vision Transformer (ViT) codec whose token-level conditioning natively realizes this weight-driven code. On a localized task at 0.034 bpp, a single UniTAC model reaches 91.4% accuracy, only 1.9% below a task-based codec (93.3%) and above universal codecs (76.9%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniTAC，一种单一学习的图像编解码器，可在运行时无缝从通用（任务无关）切换到任务特化操作，无需重新训练。通过将任务抽象为逐组件重要性向量（如从下游模型的梯度归因中导出），UniTAC用低开销的侧信息同时调节编码器和解码器，并在加权重建失真的目标下对广泛的随机化向量族进行一次性训练。
AI.motivation: 物理AI系统（如自动驾驶和机器人）需要在严格的带宽、延迟和能量预算下及时交换高维感知信号。由于下游任务随时间演变，任务特定的编解码器不够灵活，且为每个任务重新训练在实战场上不可行。
AI.method: UniTAC将任务抽象为逐组件重要性向量，通过梯度归因从任何下游模型导出，以低开销侧信息形式同时调节编码器和解码器。训练一次，覆盖广泛的随机化重要性向量族，针对加权重建失真优化。论文分析了加权率失真问题，刻画了对角加权失真何时与任务一致，以及权重与任务敏感性的关系，并基于此设计了采用ViT编解码器的token级条件化机制。
AI.result: 在0.034 bpp的局部化任务上，单个UniTAC模型达到91.4%的准确率，仅比基于任务的编解码器（93.3%）低1.9%，显著高于通用编解码器（76.9%）。
AI.conclusion: UniTAC证明了单一训练模型通过运行时注入任务重要性向量即可在通用与任务特化性能之间灵活切换，弥合了通用编解码器的灵活性优势与任务专用编解码器的性能优势之间的差距。

title: Improved Metric Distortion Bounds for Deterministic Weighted-Tournament Voting Rules
summary: In metric social choice, voters and candidates lie in a common but unknown metric space, voters rank candidates by distance, and a voting rule seeks to minimize total distance to the voters. Its distortion is the worst-case approximation ratio relative to the minimum possible total distance. We study weighted-tournament rules (also known as C2 rules), which observe only the fraction of voters who prefer $a$ to $b$ for each pair of candidates $a,b$. These frequencies form a weighted tournament on candidates, a compressed representation that omits voter identities and the association of comparisons with individual voters. Prior work placed the optimal distortion of deterministic C2 rules between $3.1128$ and $3.9312$ [Charikar et al., EC 2025]. We introduce the Path-Unblanketed Set rule, a polynomial-time deterministic C2 rule with distortion at most $1+2\sqrt{2}\approx3.8284$ for every finite number of candidates. For elections with no more than six candidates, we prove with computer assistance that the distortion is at most $3.3346$. Furthermore, using an exact computer-assisted certificate, we provide a lower bound of $3.1828$ for deterministic C2 rules as a byproduct.

AI.tldr: 本文研究度量社会选择中的加权锦标赛规则（C2规则）的失真度问题。作者提出了Path-Unblanketed Set规则，这是一个多项式时间的确定性C2规则，对于任意有限数量的候选人都能保证失真度不超过1+2√2≈3.8284。对于不超过6个候选人的选举，通过计算机辅助证明失真度至多为3.3346。此外，通过精确的计算机辅助证书，还给出了确定性C2规则失真度的下界3.1828。
AI.motivation: 在度量社会选择中，投票规则的目标是最小化与选民的总距离，失真度衡量的是规则在最坏情况下相比最优方案的近似比率。已有的确定性C2规则的失真度上界和下界之间存在间隙（3.1128到3.9312），作者希望缩小这一间隙并构造更优的C2规则。
AI.method: 作者引入了Path-Unblanketed Set规则，这是一种新的确定性C2规则，仅依赖候选人之间的两两比较频率（加权锦标赛的压缩表示）。该规则在多项式时间内可计算。对于有限候选人数量，通过理论分析证明其失真度上界为1+2√2。对于候选人数量不超过6的情况，使用计算机辅助证明进一步收紧上界至3.3346。同时使用精确的计算机辅助证书推导出下界3.1828。
AI.result: Path-Unblanketed Set规则在任意有限候选人数下失真度至多为1+2√2≈3.8284；对于不超过6个候选人的选举，失真度至多为3.3346；确定性C2规则的失真度下界提升至3.1828。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入新的Path-Unblanketed Set规则，显著缩小了确定性C2规则失真度的已知间隙（上界从3.9312降至3.8284，且在小候选人场景下可进一步降至3.3346），同时将下界从3.1128提升至3.1828。这表明C2规则的失真度仍有进一步优化的空间。

title: Dense Expands, Sparse Anchors: Channel-Asymmetric Query Expansion for Hybrid Retrieval
summary: LLM-based query expansion improves retrieval by generating document-like passages. In hybrid retrieval, however, most evaluations fuse fixed top-$L$ dense and sparse rankings. Because the cutoff controls both which cross-channel contributions enter fusion and how much of each ranking is accessed, gains measured at one $L$ can change or reverse at another. We separate these effects by evaluating retrieval effectiveness under complete-list fusion and recording the policy-specific per-channel replay stopping depths at which its ordered top-$K$ is certified. We then introduce DESA (Dense Expansion and Sparse Anchoring), a channel-asymmetric query expansion method. An LLM generates complementary reference passages; orthogonal residual expansion adds their new semantic directions to the dense query, while score-product anchoring incorporates their lexical cues into sparse retrieval without broadening the original query's lexical support. Across seven BEIR datasets, DESA improves nDCG@10 and Recall@20 over the unexpanded query by 3.82% and 2.38%, while reducing dense and sparse access depths by 36.90% and 36.56%. With equal dataset weighting, 63.31% of queries become shallower in both channels. However, both depths increase with Contriever on Touché-2020. These results support channel-specific integration of generated passages and joint evaluation of retrieval effectiveness and access depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DESA（Dense Expansion and Sparse Anchoring）方法，一种通道不对称的查询扩展方法，通过LLM生成互补参考段落，利用正交残差扩展和分数乘积锚定同时提升稠密和稀疏检索性能，在减少访问深度的同时提高检索效果。
AI.motivation: 混合检索中，大多数评估在固定的顶层L下融合稠密和稀疏排序，但截断值既控制跨通道贡献的融合，也控制各排名的访问深度，导致在某一个L下测得的收益在另一个L下可能改变甚至逆转。现有研究忽视了这一混淆效应。
AI.method: 1）在完整列表融合下评估检索有效性，记录各通道策略特定的重放停止深度；2）提出DESA方法：LLM生成互补参考段落，正交残差扩展将新增语义方向加入稠密查询，分数乘积锚定将词汇线索纳入稀疏检索而不扩大原始查询的词汇支持范围。
AI.result: 在7个BEIR数据集上，DESA相比未扩展查询在nDCG@10提升3.82%、Recall@20提升2.38%，同时减少稠密访问深度36.90%和稀疏访问深度36.56%。等数据集加权下63.31%的查询在两个通道中变得更浅。但在Touché-2020上与Contriever结合时两种深度均增加。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明应将生成段落进行通道特定的整合，并联合评估检索有效性和访问深度，而非在固定截断值下单纯评估检索质量。

title: AutoMem: A Text-Gradient Recursive Self-Improvement Framework for Automated Memory Architectures Search
summary: Long-term memory is increasingly central to LLM agents, yet memory design remains a highly coupled architecture problem: what to encode, how to store it, how to retrieve it, and how to manage it can vary substantially across tasks and backbone models. We construct a discrete search space with 5 encoders, 5 stores, 6 retrievers, and 4 managers, and show that no single memory architecture consistently dominates: different tasks favor different module combinations, leading to substantial performance gaps. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{AutoMem}, a text-gradient recursive self-improvement framework for task-adaptive memory architecture search. \textsc{AutoMem} optimizes over the factored space through two components: Experience-Guided Architecture Search, which proposes candidate architectures from historical search trajectories and accumulated reflections, and Failure-Guided Module Diagnosis, which localizes memory-related failures to specific modules and converts them into targeted textual feedback. Experiments on GAIA, WebWalkerQA, and xBench-DeepSearch across two LLM backbones show that \textsc{AutoMem} consistently discovers task-adaptive memory architectures that outperform the strongest human-designed memory baselines, improving accuracy by $2.8$ points on average across six benchmark-backbone settings. Further analysis shows that \textsc{AutoMem} achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, reducing token cost by $14.3\%$ over the strongest accuracy baselines under Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, while also finding stronger architectures than substantially larger random searches within only a few guided iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoMem，一个基于文本梯度的递归自改进框架，用于任务自适应记忆架构搜索。它通过经验引导的架构搜索和失败引导的模块诊断，在由编码器、存储、检索器和管理器组成的高耦合记忆架构搜索空间中，自动发现最优模块组合，在多个基准和骨干模型上超越最强人工设计基线。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆对LLM智能体越来越重要，但记忆架构设计是一个高度耦合的问题（编码、存储、检索、管理各模块高度耦合），不同任务和骨干模型偏好不同的模块组合，不存在单一的最优记忆架构。
AI.method: 构建包含5个编码器、5个存储、6个检索器和4个管理器的离散搜索空间。提出AutoMem框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Experience-Guided Architecture Search（经验引导的架构搜索），从历史搜索轨迹和累积反思中提出候选架构；(2) Failure-Guided Module Diagnosis（失败引导的模块诊断），定位记忆相关失败到具体模块并转化为针对性的文本反馈。整体采用文本梯度递归自改进机制进行优化。
AI.result: 在GAIA、WebWalkerQA和xBench-DeepSearch三个基准上，跨两个LLM骨干模型，AutoMem在六个基准-骨干设置中平均比最强人工设计记忆基线提升2.8个准确率点。在Qwen3.5-122B-A10B下比最强准确率基线降低14.3%的token成本，并且仅用几次引导迭代就找到比大规模随机搜索更强的架构。
AI.conclusion: AutoMem证明了任务自适应记忆架构搜索的有效性，实现了准确率与效率的良好权衡，说明通过文本梯度驱动的递归自改进可以在高耦合的记忆架构设计空间中高效地找到优于人工设计的组合。

title: Equilibrium Forcing: Adaptive Video Generation Without Noise Conditioning
summary: Standard autoregressive video generation algorithms based on Diffusion and Flow Matching rely on rigid training objectives and static sampling schedules, limiting inference procedures from adapting to the data. We introduce Equilibrium Forcing (EqF), a simplified framework for video denoising generative models without noise level conditioning. EqF pioneers modular training- and inference-time designs for noise-unconditional generation that decouple learning the denoising field from sampling. This flexibility allows for inference-time algorithms that operate in a closed loop by adapting to feedback from the sample, improving video quality and consistency on challenging autoregressive video generation benchmarks. Extensive analysis elucidates exactly how removing the noise level conditioning enables EqF's data-dependent inference properties to surpass the performance of standard noise level-conditional denoising video methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Equilibrium Forcing (EqF)，一种无需噪声水平条件化的视频去噪生成框架，通过解耦去噪场学习与采样过程，实现可适应数据的闭环推理，在自回归视频生成基准上超越传统条件化方法。
AI.motivation: 标准的基于扩散和流匹配的自回归视频生成算法依赖于固定的训练目标和静态采样调度，限制了推理过程对数据的自适应能力。
AI.method: EqF简化了视频去噪生成模型，去除噪声水平条件化，将去噪场学习与采样过程解耦，允许推理阶段以闭环方式根据采样反馈自适应调整，从而提升视频质量和一致性。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的自回归视频生成基准上，EqF的数据依赖性推理特性超越了标准噪声水平条件化去噪视频方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 广泛分析表明，去除噪声水平条件化正是EqF实现数据依赖推理性能并超越传统条件化方法的关键机制。

title: DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs
summary: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets. This paper investigates whether these retired GPUs can find a productive afterlife to form a DumpsterCluster that can serve modern LLM inference, and under what conditions such repurposing is economically viable and environmentally sustainable. We physically built a 128-GPU DumpsterCluster from scratch using only second-hand components and ran it for one year. At current market prices (\$22K for the DumpsterCluster vs. \$600K for an 8-GPU B200 system), the economic advantages are substantial. Through pipeline-parallel optimizations, our V100 based DumpsterCluster achieves competitive LLaMA-70B throughput, validating production viability. However, our deployment reveals critical context dependencies. Older GPUs consume significantly more energy per token, making total cost of ownership favorable only in regions with inexpensive electricity. Under grid-average carbon intensity, second-hand systems can produce approximately 4x higher total carbon emissions per token for 8B models, and over 40x for 70B models, compared to current-generation hardware. These findings show that GPU afterlife is not universally sustainable - hardware repurposing must be strategically coupled with low carbon energy sources. When deployed in regions with favourable energy economics and clean electricity, second-hand GPUs offer a viable pathway for expanding AI capacity while advancing affordability, energy security, and environmental responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了退役GPU组建"垃圾场集群"(DumpsterCluster)用于现代LLM推理的可行性与可持续性。作者用二手组件实际搭建了一个128-GPU集群并运行一年，发现其成本远低于新系统(B200)，通过流水线并行优化可在V100上实现有竞争力的LLaMA-70B吞吐量。但部署揭示关键依赖：旧GPU每token能耗更高，仅在低电价地区总拥有成本才有利；在电网平均碳强度下，二手系统每token碳排放可比新硬件高4倍(8B模型)至40倍(70B模型)。结论是GPU"来世"并非普遍可持续，必须与低碳能源战略结合。
AI.motivation: 随着AI数据中心淘汰仍具备计算能力的GPU，大量二手加速器进入市场。作者希望探究这些退役GPU是否能通过重组形成有生产力、经济上可行且环境可持续的"垃圾场集群"来服务现代LLM推理，填补二手硬件再利用的可行性研究空白。
AI.method: 作者从零开始用纯二手组件物理搭建了一个128-GPU的DumpsterCluster，并持续运行一年。通过流水线并行优化在V100集群上运行LLaMA-70B推理，对比当前B200系统，从成本、吞吐量、能耗和碳排放等多维度进行评估。
AI.result: DumpsterCluster成本仅$22K，远低于B200系统的$600K。经流水线并行优化后，V100集群在LLaMA-70B推理上达到有竞争力的吞吐量。但旧GPU每token能耗显著更高，仅在低电价地区总拥有成本才占优。在电网平均碳强度下，二手系统每token碳排放较新硬件高约4倍(8B模型)和40倍(70B模型)。
AI.conclusion: GPU硬件再利用并非普遍可持续，其经济与环境效益高度依赖部署地区的能源条件。只有在电价低廉且电力清洁的地区，退役GPU集群才能成为扩大AI算力、兼顾可负担性、能源安全与环境责任的有效路径。

title: Drive, Pack, Fly: The Travelling Thief Problem with Drone
summary: In collection operations, accumulating payload progressively slows the vehicle, imposing a cumulative penalty on routing efficiency. An onboard drone can offset this penalty by retrieving outlying items, thereby shortening the makespan and increasing operational profit. However, travel time remains load-dependent, and each item collected by the ground vehicle shifts the arrival times that govern the drone's launch and rendezvous points. This paper introduces the Travelling Thief Problem with Drone (TTP-D), which maximises the collected profit, net of a time-based rental cost, by jointly optimising item selection, vehicle routing, and flight synchronisation. We formulate a mixed-integer linear program that solves small instances to optimality, and develop both metaheuristics and an attention-based Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) policy for larger instances. We further propose a learner-initialised hybrid solver, in which the DRL policy constructs an initial solution that a short annealing run subsequently refines. On two benchmark sets, this hybrid recovers most of the metaheuristic baseline's quality at a fraction of its computational budget, although the largest instances still require the baseline at its full budget. Finally, a sensitivity analysis reveals that the rental ratio is the primary driver of profitability, whereas the fleet parameters affect profit only at the margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出携带无人机的旅行小偷问题（TTP-D），联合优化物品选择、车辆路径与飞行同步，以最大化扣除时间租金成本后的收集利润。提出混合整数线性规划（最优解小规模）、元启发式与基于注意力机制的深度强化学习（DRL）策略（大规模），并设计学习器初始化混合求解器（DRL构造初始解+短退火精炼），在基准集上以少量计算预算恢复元启发式大部分质量。
AI.motivation: 传统收集作业中，货物积累会使车辆载荷增加、速度减慢，对路线效率产生累积惩罚。车载无人机可通过取回外围物品来抵消该惩罚，缩短完工时间并提高运营利润。但行驶时间仍依赖载荷，且地面车辆收集的每件物品都会改变无人机发射与汇合点的时间窗口，这带来了联合优化物品选择、车辆路径与飞行同步的复合挑战，现有模型未能同时处理这些耦合因素。
AI.method: (1) 提出TTP-D问题模型，目标函数为收集利润减去基于时间的租赁成本；(2) 构建混合整数线性规划（MILP）求解小规模实例至最优；(3) 开发元启发式算法与基于注意力机制的深度强化学习（DRL）策略处理大规模实例；(4) 提出学习器初始化的混合求解器，DRL策略先生成初始解，再由短时退火（annealing）过程进行精炼。
AI.result: 在两个基准集上，混合求解器能以元启发式基线的一小部分计算预算恢复其大部分解质量；但最大规模实例仍需基线以完整预算运行。敏感性分析显示，租金比率是盈利能力的首要驱动因素，而车队参数对利润的影响仅在边际层面。
AI.conclusion: 无人机协同的旅行小偷问题可有效提升收集利润，学习器初始化的混合求解器在解质量与计算效率间提供了良好平衡；租金比率主导盈利性，表明租赁成本策略是系统设计的核心杠杆，而车队规模等参数仅产生次要影响。

title: Global AI Regulations for FAIR and Ethics in High-Risk Use Cases: A Comparative Review
comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the 50th IEEE Computers, Software, and Applications Conference (COMPSAC 2026), Madrid, Spain, July 7-10, 2026
summary: AI governance is shifting from voluntary ethics to enforceable, risk-based regulation, yet cross-jurisdictional divergence creates compliance uncertainty for operators of high-stakes AI. We present a comparative matrix for the EU, US, and China that maps (i) risk classification triggers, (ii) binding obligations, (iii) enforcement and accountability mechanisms, and (iv) the degree to which FAIR principles are operationalised in practice. We stress-test the matrix on three high-impact domains: Electroencephalography (EEG)-guided rehabilitation robotics, AI-enabled debt collection in prospective Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) ecosystems, and AI-driven allocation of scarce Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) resources in emerging AI Factory infrastructures. Using primary legal texts and implementation evidence, we identify three recurring gaps: weak interoperability mandates, difficult operationalisation of cross-regime obligations (AI + sector regulation + data protection), and under-specified governance for critical digital infrastructure use cases. To bridge the implementation gap, we outline Knowledge Blocks, a machine-checkable compliance artefact pattern based on Resource Description Framework/Web Ontology Language (RDF/OWL), Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL), and Provenance Ontology (PROV-O), enabling audit-ready compliance-by-design across multiple regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对欧盟、美国和中国三个司法管辖区，构建了AI治理比较矩阵，涵盖风险分类触发条件、强制性义务、执法问责机制及FAIR原则实践程度四个维度，并在三个高影响领域（EEG康复机器人、CBDC生态中的AI债务催收、AI工厂中的GPU资源分配）进行压力测试，识别出三大实施缺口，并提出基于RDF/OWL、SHACL和PROV-O的机器可检查合规构件模式"Knowledge Blocks"以弥合实施差距。
AI.motivation: AI治理正从自愿性伦理转向强制性、基于风险的监管，但跨司法管辖区的监管差异给高风险AI运营者带来合规不确定性，亟需系统性的比较框架来理解和弥合不同监管体制之间的差距。
AI.method: 构建跨欧盟、美国、中国三地的AI治理比较矩阵（四大维度），在三个高影响应用领域进行压力测试，基于原始法律文本和实施证据识别共性缺口，并提出基于语义网技术栈（RDF/OWL、SHACL、PROV-O）的机器可检查合规构件模式"Knowledge Blocks"。
AI.result: 识别出三大反复出现的缺口：(1)互操作性强制要求薄弱；(2)跨体制义务（AI+行业法规+数据保护）难以落地操作；(3)关键数字基础设施用例的治理规范不充分。提出了Knowledge Blocks作为支持审计就绪的合规即设计方案的解决路径。
AI.conclusion: 跨司法管辖区的AI合规需要超越静态文本对照，转向机器可检查、可互操作、支持合规即设计的系统化方案，Knowledge Blocks为此提供了可行的技术原型。

title: The Quality of Claude AI-authored Python Tests Is Not Weaker Than Human-authored Tests
summary: We evaluate the quality of Claude AI-written Python tests against human-written Python tests from two established open-source projects Django and Pandas. Hundreds of tests per corpus are scored under one identical protocol. Using one-sided non-inferiority bounds, we find that the tests written by recent Claude models (Sonnet/Opus 4.6 and later) are no weaker than the two human-written corpora. In this study: (i) the AI-written corpus is tests from real tools, not synthetic tests generated in isolation against a fixed target, the setup used by every other AI-test-generation study we are aware of; (ii) every test is individually scored under three independent fault-injection protocols plus a seven-axis qualitative design rubric, allowing methods to cross-validate each other; (iii) tests are scored individually, rather than suite-level, identifying exactly which specific tests need attention.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了Claude AI生成的Python测试与两个开源项目（Django和Pandas）人工编写测试的质量对比。通过数百个测试在相同协议下的评分，发现近期Claude模型（Sonnet/Opus 4.6及以后）编写的测试质量不低于人工编写的测试语料。
AI.motivation: 现有AI测试生成研究大多使用合成测试，在隔离环境中针对固定目标生成，缺乏对真实场景中AI编写测试质量的系统性评估。作者希望基于真实工具生成的测试，全面评估AI测试与人类测试的质量差异。
AI.method: 从Django和Pandas两个开源项目中收集人工编写的Python测试作为基准，同时使用Claude模型生成AI测试。所有测试在统一的评分协议下进行评估，包括三种独立的故障注入协议和七轴定性设计评估标准，并对每个测试进行单独评分而非套件级评分。
AI.result: 通过单侧非劣效性检验，发现Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.6及更新版本模型编写的测试在质量上不弱于两个人工编写的测试语料。该方法能够在个体测试级别上精确识别出哪些具体测试需要关注。
AI.conclusion: 近期Claude模型生成的Python测试质量已达到或超过人工编写水平，且该研究框架提供了一种可交叉验证的多协议评估方法，能够精确到单个测试的质量诊断。

title: Steering the Flow: Inverting Face Recognition Models via Gradient-Guided Flow Matching
summary: Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) aim to reconstruct representative training samples of target identities from face recognition models, exposing critical security vulnerabilities. Existing methods typically rely on indirect guidance or highly stochastic guidance, making it difficult to stably optimize generation trajectories toward target facial images. In this paper, we propose Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI), a novel two-stage white-box model inversion method that reformulates inversion as a trajectory-steering task. Specifically, Step I, Learning a Generic Flow Matching Prior, pre-trains a generic unconditional Flow Matching model to encode the manifold of human faces as a robust prior. Step II, Attacking with Progressive Guidance Scheduler (PGS), injects time-dependent target-specific gradients during sampling. By backpropagating through the target model to obtain gradients from intermediate generated states, PGS progressively injects adaptive guidance signals into the vector field. This process effectively steers the current generative flow from random noise toward the high-density regions of the target class. Under an identity-disjoint cross-evaluation setting using the CelebA dataset, SFMI achieves an ACC of 0.9248, an FID of 22.61, and an LPIPS of 0.3874 on the ArcFace target. Extensive experiments on multiple target models demonstrate that SFMI achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance in attack success and visual fidelity under the evaluated white-box protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFMI（Steering Flow Model Inversion），一种两阶段白盒模型反演攻击方法，将模型反演重新表述为轨迹引导任务。第一阶段预训练通用Flow Matching模型学习人脸流形先验，第二阶段通过渐进式引导调度器（PGS）在采样过程中注入时间相关的目标特定梯度，将生成流从随机噪声稳定引导至目标类别高密度区域。在CelebA数据集上，SFMI在ArcFace目标上达到ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874，实现SOTA级攻击成功率与视觉保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有模型反演攻击（MIA）方法依赖间接引导或高度随机的引导，难以稳定地将生成轨迹优化至目标面部图像。需要一种更可控、更稳定的引导机制来提升攻击效果。
AI.method: SFMI采用两阶段框架：Step I预训练通用无条件Flow Matching模型，编码人脸流形作为鲁棒先验；Step II采用渐进式引导调度器（PGS），在采样过程中通过目标模型反向传播获得中间生成状态的梯度，随时间自适应注入目标特定引导信号，逐步引导生成流向目标类别高密度区域。
AI.result: 在CelebA数据集的身份不相交交叉评估设置下，SFMI在ArcFace目标上达到ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874。在多个目标模型上的广泛实验表明，在白盒协议下攻击成功率和视觉保真度均达到competitive SOTA水平。
AI.conclusion: SFMI通过将模型反演重构为轨迹引导任务，利用Flow Matching先验和渐进式引导调度，有效解决了现有方法中引导不稳定、优化路径不可控的问题，实现了更优的攻击成功率与视觉质量。

title: Multi-Winner Elections: Justified Representation, Strategyproofness, and Risk-Avoiding Truthfulness
summary:
We study approval-based multi-winner elections with justified representation (JR) when voters strategically report their ballots. We prove that there does not exist a strategy-proof mechanism that outputs JR committees, even when the mechanism can be randomized and only ex-ante strategy-proofness is required. The impossibility result holds for any fixed voter's monotone utility function. In addition, our impossibility result continues to hold for even more restrictive settings, such as the setting where we are allowed to select fewer than $k$ candidates, with only 4 candidates and 3 voters.
  Motivated by our negative results, we then ask for weaker strategy-proof guarantees under voters' partial information. We use the notion of RAT-degree proposed by Hartman, Segal-Halevi, and Tao (EC'25), the number of other voters whose information a manipulator must know before a safe and profitable deviation is possible. Standard proportional rules, such as greedy approval voting, proportional approval voting (PAV), and the method of equal shares (MES), have poor performances under the RAT-degree metric (with low RAT-degrees).

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于批准投票的多赢家选举中，选民策略性报告选票时"应有代表权（JR）"的机制设计问题。作者证明了不存在满足JR且策略-proof的机制（即使是随机化且仅要求事前策略-proof），该不可能性结果在更严格设置下（少于k个候选人、仅4个候选人和3个选民）依然成立。随后，作者在选民部分信息假设下寻求更弱的策略-proof保证，使用RAT-degree度量，发现标准比例规则（贪心批准投票、PAV、等份额法）在RAT-degree指标下表现较差。
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注满足JR的投票机制的存在性，但很少考虑选民可能策略性操纵选票的问题。作者希望探究在选民策略行为下，是否存在能同时满足JR和策略-proof的机制，并在不可能性成立后，寻找在弱化条件下的可行替代方案。
AI.method: 首先，证明一个不可能性定理：不存在任何（即使随机化的、仅要求事前策略-proof的）机制能够输出JR委员会，结果适用于任意固定的选民单调效用函数，并进一步推广到更严格设置（少于k个候选人、4候选3选民）。其次，利用RAT-degree（由Hartman等人提出）这一度量，评估标准比例规则（贪心批准投票、PAV、MES）在部分信息下的策略操纵脆弱性。
AI.result: 证明了一个强不可能性结果：在策略性投票下，没有任何事前策略-proof的（随机化）机制能保证JR，且该结果在极简设置（4候选、3选民）下也成立。进一步分析显示，贪心批准投票、PAV和MES等标准比例规则的RAT-degree都很低，意味着操纵者只需知道少数其他选民的信息即可实现安全且有利的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 在完全信息下的策略-proof与JR不可兼得，因此需要转向部分信息假设下的更弱保证。然而，现有的标准比例规则在RAT-degree度量下表现不佳，表明需要设计具有更高RAT-degrees的新机制，以在部分信息环境下提供更好的策略鲁棒性。

title: Large language model-assisted discovery of cohorts from scientific literature
summary: Background: Planning multi-study analyses requires identifying cohorts with the relevant participants, phenotypes, and data modalities. This process commonly relies on prior knowledge, cohort catalogues, and manual literature searches. We developed a complementary question-driven framework that searches relevant scientific literature and extracts explicit cohort names. Methods: The framework first generates multiple PubMed queries from configurable vocabularies and templates and retrieves the resulting scientific literature automatically through the PubMed API. A large language model then screens the retrieved titles and abstracts and extracts explicit cohort names using a prompt tailored to the research question. The extracted names are deduplicated with human review. Configurable code, prompts, and example outputs are available at https://gitlab.rz.uni-frankfurt.de/cap_molgenlab/literature-cohort-discovery. Evaluation: As a use case, we applied the framework to youth aggression genetics. From 5,400 generated PubMed queries, the framework retrieved 5,254 unique records and identified 188 candidate cohorts. Manual screening using predefined criteria, including participant age and genetic-data availability, retained 44 eligible cohorts. Automated LLM-based name extraction was within the agreement range of human annotators. We also searched four established cohort catalogues using the same research question. Their combined results contained 27 of the 44 eligible cohorts, while 17 were not returned by any cohort catalogue search. Conclusion: The framework converts research-question-specific vocabulary into screenable cohort inventories via a large, automated literature search. It can be adapted across populations, phenotypes, data modalities, and study designs, and provides a literature-based complement to curated cohort catalogues.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于问题的文献驱动的队列发现框架，通过自动生成PubMed查询并使用大语言模型（LLM）筛选文献并提取队列名称，作为传统队列目录的补充工具。以青少年攻击性遗传学为用例，从5,254条文献记录中识别出188个候选队列，其中44个符合条件的队列中有17个未被任何现有队列目录覆盖。
AI.motivation: 规划多研究分析需要识别具有相关参与者、表型和数据模式的队列，但当前方法依赖先验知识、队列目录和人工文献检索，效率低且容易遗漏。作者希望开发一种互补的、由研究问题驱动的自动框架，以更全面地发现相关队列。
AI.method: 框架首先从可配置词汇表和模板生成多个PubMed查询，通过PubMed API自动检索文献；然后使用针对研究问题定制提示的大语言模型筛选检索到的标题和摘要，提取明确的队列名称；最后通过人工审查对提取的队列名进行去重。代码、提示语和示例输出均开源。
AI.result: 在青少年攻击性遗传学用例中，框架从5,400个生成的查询中检索到5,254篇唯一文献，识别出188个候选队列。经预定义标准（包括参与者年龄和遗传数据可用性）人工筛选后保留44个符合条件的队列。LLM自动提取的队列名称与人工标注者的一致性相当。对比四个已建立的队列目录，其合计仅涵盖44个队列中的27个，有17个队列未被任何目录检索到。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能将研究问题特定的词汇转化为可筛选的队列清单，通过大规模自动化文献搜索实现。它可适应不同人群、表型、数据模式和研究设计，为策展的队列目录提供了基于文献的补充方案。

title: LLM Safety Alignment in Low-Resource Languages: A Systematic Literature Review
comment: The paper was accepted at LM4UC workshop organize by IJCAI. I added a screenshot of the decision (Open Review)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved substantial progress in safety alignment, yet their safety guarantees remain significantly weaker in low-resource and multilingual settings than in high-resource languages. In this paper, we conduct a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of LLM safety alignment in low-resource languages by adopting the PRISMA 2020 methodology. Out of roughly 1,500 papers identified from Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and OpenAlex, 50 relevant studies have been selected and analyzed. Our review is organized around four themes: safety alignment methods, multilingual safety risks, evaluation benchmarks, and cross-lingual transferability. We further propose a taxonomy of safety alignment approaches based on three adaptation mechanisms: data adaptation, objective optimization, and mechanistic alignment. Across literature, translated English benchmarks fail to sufficiently represent culturally rooted harms, and multilingual models are more vulnerable to cross-lingual jailbreaks, code-switching attacks, and safety degradation in underrepresented languages. These failures are driven by several key factors, including uneven multilingual pre-training coverage, insufficient native-language preference data, poor transfer of safety representations, and a lack of culturally aware evaluation frameworks. The review also notes that many low-resource languages, especially African languages, have fewer safety benchmarks available than other multilingual regions. Overall, the results reveal a persistent multilingual safety gap, and suggest that future progress will require culturally grounded benchmarks, participatory data collection, balanced multilingual pre-training, and scalable multilingual alignment methods.

AI.tldr: 本文采用PRISMA 2020方法对低资源语言下的大语言模型安全对齐进行了系统性文献综述，从约1500篇论文中筛选出50篇进行分析，围绕安全对齐方法、多语言安全风险、评估基准和跨语言迁移性四大主题展开，并提出基于数据适应、目标优化和机制对齐三种适应机制的分类体系。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在安全对齐方面已取得显著进展，但在低资源和多语言环境下的安全保障仍远弱于高资源语言。需要对低资源语言的安全对齐研究现状进行系统性梳理，以理解这一安全差距的本质和成因。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020方法论进行系统性文献综述，从Semantic Scholar、arXiv和OpenAlex三个数据源检索约1500篇论文，最终筛选并分析50篇相关研究，围绕四个主题组织综述，并提出基于数据适应、目标优化和机制对齐三种适应机制的安全对齐方法分类体系。
AI.result: 研究发现：翻译后的英语基准无法充分代表文化根源性危害；多语言模型更容易受到跨语言越狱、代码切换攻击和在代表性不足语言中安全性能下降的影响。失败原因包括多语言预训练覆盖不均、原生语言偏好数据不足、安全表征迁移差以及缺乏文化感知的评估框架。非洲语言的安全基准尤其稀缺。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了持续存在的多语言安全差距，未来进展需要文化根基的基准、参与式数据收集、均衡的多语言预训练以及可扩展的多语言对齐方法。

title: PE-CSNet: An equivariant network architecture with learnable patch-based sparse representation
summary: Compressive sensing (CS) enables accurate signal reconstruction from sparse measurements and is widely applied in medical imaging, remote sensing, and image compression. However, designing an effective, task-specific sparse transform and the corresponding optimization procedure for high-quality CS remains challenging. This process typically requires expert domain knowledge and laborious parameter tuning. To address this issue, we present a Patch-based Equivariant deep unrolling architecture, termed PE-CSNet, for accurate CS recovery. While traditional CS methods generally use predefined patch-based transform sparsity, we generalize this idea by incorporating learnable transform sparsity that adapts to the specific CS task through an optimization-driven process. Specifically, we first establish a generalized patch-based CS model, which we solve via a block coordinate descent (BCD) algorithm. The BCD solver is then unrolled into a deep neural network, where all parameters of both the CS model and solver are learned through end-to-end training. To improve data efficiency, we introduce a stochastic equivariant training strategy that exploits the patch-wise structure of the network, enabling PE-CSNet to learn effectively even from limited data. We further provide a simpler, parameter-shared version of PE-CSNet and briefly discuss its convergence as an iterative solver. For practical applications, the network uses stage-specific (non-shared) parameters to enhance its expressive power and thereby improve its performance. On the tasks of CS magnetic resonance imaging (CS-MRI) and CS coded diffraction patterns (CS-CDP), PE-CSNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fast computational speed, outperforming traditional methods and existing deep unrolling methods.

AI.tldr: 提出PE-CSNet，一种基于补丁的等变深度展开网络，用于压缩感知重建。通过将广义补丁CS模型用块坐标下降算法求解并展开为深度网络，引入可学习的变换稀疏性，结合随机等变训练策略提升数据效率，在CS-MRI和CS-CDP任务上达到最先进精度。
AI.motivation: 传统压缩感知方法需要专家领域知识和繁琐的参数调优来设计任务特定的稀疏变换和优化过程，这限制了高质量CS重建的效率和通用性。作者旨在通过可学习的变换稀疏性和优化驱动的深度学习过程来克服这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 建立广义补丁CS模型；2) 用块坐标下降算法求解；3) 将BCD求解器展开为深度神经网络，模型和解算器参数通过端到端训练学习；4) 引入随机等变训练策略利用网络的补丁结构提升数据效率；5) 提供参数共享的简化版本并讨论其收敛性，实际应用中使用阶段特定参数增强表达能力。
AI.result: 在CS-MRI和CS-CDP两项任务上，PE-CSNet达到最先进的重建精度，计算速度快，优于传统方法和现有的深度展开方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过网络展开和可学习稀疏变换，PE-CSNet有效解决了传统CS中需要人工设计稀疏变换和调参的问题，实现了高精度且高效率的CS重建，并展示了从有限数据中有效学习的能力。

title: Calibrated Trust, Not Sharper Prediction: An Empirical Test of Uncertainty Fusion
summary: A recurring proposal in legal AI is to improve case-outcome prediction by fusing uncertainty tools (evidence graphs with belief propagation, sequential Bayesian odds updating, Dempster-Shafer combination, and conformal prediction) into one pipeline. We test this on 1,000 real European Court of Human Rights cases from LexGLUE and FairLex, predicting whether the Court found a Convention violation from the case's fact paragraphs. We compare three families across two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5) as per-fact evidence estimators: (A) the raw LLM, (B) the LLM routed through the fusion pipeline, and (C) a term-frequency baseline through the same pipeline. Across roughly 4,750 tests we find: (1) on discrimination (AUROC around 0.83) the pipeline yields no improvement over either the raw LLM or the baseline; a frontier LLM used directly is the strongest single discriminator. (2) Naively composing an LLM with Bayesian-odds and Dempster-Shafer fusion more than doubles calibration error (ECE from about 0.16 to 0.46) via a prior-mismatch mechanism that replicates across both models. (3) Dempster-Shafer fusion is actively unsafe on long chains, committing confidently to wrong labels at below-chance accuracy; we recommend removing it. (4) The pipeline's genuine value is operational: routed through a conformal selective-prediction layer, the system decides which cases to automate and which to escalate. After removing Dempster-Shafer, recalibrating, and applying class-conditional risk control on the full 1,000-case set, the tuned engine auto-clears at 96.8 percent accuracy with 0.5 percent errors escaping and 96.3 percent caught for review, versus 85.9 / 3.8 / 72.1 for an untuned baseline. The contribution of such pipelines in law is calibrated trust, not sharper prediction.

AI.tldr: 本研究测试了将证据图、贝叶斯赔率、Dempster-Shafer融合和保形预测等不确定性工具融合成一个流水线来改进案件结果预测。在1,000个真实的欧洲人权法院案例上，使用两个前沿LLM作为证据估计器，发现融合流水线在判别力上并无提升，反而导致校准错误翻倍和Dempster-Shafer融合不安全。流水线的真正价值在于通过保形选择性预测层实现操作层面的自动化决策，经调优后能达到96.8%的自动放行准确率。
AI.motivation: 法律AI领域一直有反复出现的提议，主张将多种不确定性工具（证据图与信念传播、序贯贝叶斯赔率更新、Dempster-Shafer组合和保形预测）融合到单一流水线中以改进案件结果预测。作者希望通过严格的实证测试来验证这一提议是否真的有效。
AI.method: 使用1,000个来自LexGLUE和FairLex的真实欧洲人权法院案例，根据事实段落预测法院是否认定公约违规。对比三种方法：原始LLM、经融合流水线路由的LLM、以及通过同一流水线的词频基线。使用两个前沿LLM（Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5）作为逐事实证据估计器，共进行约4,750次测试，评估判别性能（AUROC）、校准误差（ECE）和操作安全性。
AI.result: (1)在歧视案件上（AUROC约0.83），流水线相比原始LLM和基线均无改进，直接使用前沿LLM是最强判别器。(2)天真地将LLM与贝叶斯赔率和Dempster-Shafer融合组合，通过先验不匹配机制使校准误差翻倍以上（ECE从0.16升到0.46）。(3)Dempster-Shafer融合在长链上不安全，会以低于偶然水平的准确率自信地提交错误标签。(4)去除Dempster-Shafer、重新校准并应用类别条件风险控制后，调优引擎以96.8%准确率自动放行，0.5%错误逃脱，96.3%被捕获送审，优于未调优基线的85.9/3.8/72.1。
AI.conclusion: 法律领域中此类流水线的真正贡献在于提供校准后的信任（calibrated trust），而非更尖锐的预测。Dempster-Shafer融合应被移除，直接使用前沿LLM进行预测，并通过保形选择性预测层实现安全的人机协作自动化决策。

title: Position: AI Lock-In Is in Progress, and We Must Be Prepared
summary: AI safety research has mainly focused on two areas: technical alignment (ensuring AI systems produce human-aligned outputs) and the regulation of generative AI's societal impacts (including unemployment risk and labor market disruption). However, an equally important dimension remains underexplored: the risk inherent in dependence on AI systems themselves. In this position paper, we argue that AI safety research should address AI Lock-In, the phenomenon whereby excessive reliance on AI systems leads to human deskilling, diminishes human capacity for independent functioning, and creates systemic vulnerabilities when AI systems become unavailable or compromised. We highlight that AI Lock-In is a systemic threat that is already emerging at individual, societal, and national levels, one that could be dramatically amplified by AI service disruptions or geopolitical conflicts. Drawing on detailed scenarios, we investigate how AI Lock-In emerges and escalates across multiple levels, ranging from individual skill atrophy to national-scale infrastructure failures. To address this, we provide guidance on how such risks can be mitigated and prepared for at each level. We contend that proactively addressing AI Lock-In before such dependencies become entrenched, or even irreversible, is essential for preserving individual autonomy and national security.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI锁定"（AI Lock-In）概念，指出过度依赖AI系统会导致人类技能退化、独立功能能力下降，并在系统不可用或被攻击时产生系统性脆弱性。文章主张AI安全研究应扩展至这一维度，并提供多层面的缓解与准备指导。
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全研究过度聚焦于技术对齐和生成式AI的社会影响监管，忽视了人类对AI系统过度依赖本身所蕴含的风险。这种依赖在个体、社会和国家层面均已显现，且可能因服务中断或地缘冲突而被急剧放大，因此亟需关注。
AI.method: 作者采用立场论文（position paper）方式，通过构建详细场景，从个体技能萎缩到国家基础设施故障等多个层面，系统分析AI Lock-In的产生与升级机制，并提出各层面的风险缓解与准备指导。
AI.result: 论文揭示AI Lock-In是一种已经在个体、社会和国家层面浮现的系统性威胁，展示了其多层面升级路径，并提供了针对性的缓解策略。作者认为在依赖变得根深蒂固甚至不可逆转之前主动应对，对保持个体自主性和国家安全至关重要。
AI.conclusion: AI安全研究必须扩展范围，将AI Lock-In纳入核心议题。在依赖关系固化前采取预防性措施，是保护人类自主能力和国家安全的必要条件。

title: Comparing Domain-Model Similarity Metrics Against Human Expert Ratings
summary: Domain models are a primary artefact in model-driven software engineering, where they capture the shared understanding between stakeholders and serve as the contractual basis for downstream software development. Automatic comparison of these semantic models has diverse application areas such as requirements engineering, education, automatic generation of domain models and model reuse and repository mining. The literature offers a variety of presented metrics, but for practitioners there is no defensible way to choose between them. The contribution of this paper is the implementation of five such metrics, their execution on a fixed set of 39 domain-model comparisons and the comparison of each metric's output against the human expert ratings produced for the same comparisons. Two research questions are addressed. RQ1 asks how close, on average, each metric is to the human expert rating across the 39 comparisons. RQ2 asks how consistent each metric's per-comparison distance from the human expert rating is. The findings reveal that no single metric achieves dominance across all criteria; rather, different metrics each yield competitive results on individual criteria - some closest on average, others best preserving the per-pair ordering - which suggests that an ensemble approach combining multiple metrics may serve as a viable substitute for human expert grading. The metric implementations are an artefact of this work and are published in accordance with the FAIR4RS recommendations (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20942596).

AI.tldr: 本文实现了五种领域模型语义比较度量，并在39个领域模型比较任务上将其输出与人类专家评分进行对比，通过两个研究问题（平均接近度和一致性）评估各度量表现，发现没有单一度量能全面胜出，提出集成方法可作为人类专家评分的可行替代方案。
AI.motivation: 领域模型是模型驱动软件工程中的核心工件，自动比较语义模型在需求工程、教育、模型生成和模型重用等领域有广泛应用。尽管文献中存在多种度量方法，但实践者缺乏选择依据，且这些度量尚未与人类专家评分进行系统性对比验证。
AI.method: 实现了五种领域模型比较度量，在固定集合的39个领域模型比较任务上执行这些度量，并将每种度量的输出与针对相同比较任务产生的人类专家评分进行对比。通过RQ1（各度量与专家评分的平均接近度）和RQ2（各度量逐比较距离专家评分的一致性）两个研究问题进行分析。
AI.result: 研究发现没有单一度量在所有标准上占据主导地位；不同度量在个别标准上均表现出竞争力——有些在平均接近度上最优，有些在保持逐对排序上最佳，这表明结合多个度量的集成方法可能成为人类专家评分的可行替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 不同度量在各自维度各有优势，单纯依赖单一度量无法全面替代人类专家评分，建议采用集成方法融合多种度量以获得更可靠的结果。度量实现已按FAIR4RS推荐发布（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20942596），作为本工作的可复用工件。

title: Non-obvious Manipulability with Groups in Shapley-Scarf Housing Markets
summary: In Shapley-Scarf housing markets, Ma (1994) shows that top trading cycles (TTC) is the unique mechanism satisfying individual rationality (IR), Pareto efficiency (PE), and strategy-proofness. We ask what other mechanisms become possible when strategy-proofness is replaced by a weaker condition called non-obvious manipulability (NOM), introduced by Troyan and Morrill (2020). We first show that this weaker condition does not help on its own: every IR and PE mechanism is already NOM. We therefore introduce a new condition: NOM with groups, under which each agent knows the preferences of the other members of her group, but not those of agents outside the group. This condition reduces to strategy-proofness when all agents belong to one group, and to standard NOM when every group is a singleton. Also, we introduce a participation condition called group rationality (GR), which requires that no group do worse than it would by trading only among its own members. We then define a class of mechanisms called TTC with super-groups, whose members satisfy GR, PE, and NOM with groups. The class includes mechanisms that differ from standard TTC, including mechanisms that are not strategy-proof. Furthermore, we show that every mechanism that satisfies GR, PE, and NOM with groups has the same best- and worst-case outcomes as every TTC with super-groups mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Shapley-Scarf住房市场中，当策略性（strategy-proofness）被弱化为非明显可操纵性（NOM）时可能存在的其他机制。作者发现单独使用NOM不会产生新的机制（每个IR和PE机制本身已满足NOM），因此引入两个新条件：群体NOM（NOM with groups）和群体理性（GR），并定义了一类称为"超级组TTC"的机制，满足GR、PE和群体NOM，且与标准TTC不同，甚至不满足策略性。
AI.motivation: Ma (1994)证明在Shapley-Scarf住房市场中，TTC是唯一满足个体理性(IR)、帕累托效率(PE)和策略性(strategy-proofness)的机制。作者想要探索当策略性这一严格条件被弱化为NOM时，是否会出现其他有趣的机制。
AI.method: 首先证明单独的NOM条件没有帮助（所有IR和PE机制都满足NOM）。然后引入两个新概念：(1) NOM with groups——组内成员知道彼此的偏好但不知道组外成员的偏好，当所有人为一组时退化为策略性，当每组为单例时退化为标准NOM；(2) 群体理性(GR)——要求任何群体通过仅在其内部交易所获结果不劣于其他方案。基于此定义"TTC with super-groups"机制类。
AI.result: 定义了TTC with super-groups机制类，其成员满足GR、PE和群体NOM。该机制类包含与标准TTC不同的机制，包括不满足策略性的机制。并且证明所有满足GR、PE和群体NOM的机制与每个TTC with super-groups机制具有相同的最佳和最差情况结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入群体层面的NOM和群体理性概念，作者成功扩展了TTC机制的设计空间，在保留IR和PE的同时，允许比策略性更弱但仍有意义的防操纵保证，从而发现了新的可行机制。

title: Noesis: Bidirectional Graph-RAG with Adaptive Parallelism and Cross-Knowledge-Base Semantic Discovery
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over knowledge graphs (Graph-RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for grounding large language models in domain-specific corpora. However, existing systems face persistent limitations: (1) static chunking fragments long documents, losing cross-section semantic connections; (2) ingestion pipelines do not scale adaptively; and (3) multi-domain deployments require either a monolithic knowledge base that dilutes retrieval precision or manual user routing. We present Noesis, a decoupled Graph-RAG architecture addressing these limitations through four algorithms: (a) Bidirectional Graph Traversal with a Graph-Feedback Context Resolver simulating human reading with degrading memory; (b) an AIMD Concurrency Controller adapted from TCP congestion control, achieving 23x speedup with zero OOM events; (c) Moesis, domain-aware selective quantization for MoE models achieving 6.3x speedup on 12 GB consumer GPUs; and (d) Mesh, cross-KB semantic routing with runtime structural discovery enabling small on-premises models to perform multi-hop cross-domain reasoning. On HotpotQA (1,000 questions), Noesis achieves 59.5 EM / 74.7 F1, surpassing GraphRAG by +27.8 EM while using a 35B on-premises model for graph construction rather than GPT-4o. Source text verification on a 193-page document confirms 90% precision on long-range causal edges inaccessible to chunk-independent extraction.

AI.tldr: Noesis是一种解耦的Graph-RAG架构，通过四个算法（双向图遍历、AIMD并发控制、Moesis领域感知量化、Mesh跨库语义路由）解决现有Graph-RAG系统在静态分块、缩放性和多域部署方面的三大局限性，在HotpotQA上超越GraphRAG达+27.8 EM，同时使用35B本地模型而非GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 现有Graph-RAG系统面临三个持续性问题：(1)静态分块破坏长文档的跨段落语义连接；(2)摄取流水线缺乏自适应扩展能力；(3)多域部署要么使用稀释检索精度的单一知识库，要么需要手动用户路由。这些限制阻碍了系统在真实复杂场景中的应用。
AI.method: Noesis提出解耦的Graph-RAG架构，包含四个核心算法：(a)双向图遍历+图反馈上下文解析器，模拟人类阅读的衰退记忆过程；(b)AIMD并发控制器，借鉴TCP拥塞控制实现自适应扩展；(c)Moesis，面向MoE模型的领域感知选择性量化；(d)Mesh，跨知识库语义路由，支持运行时结构发现，使小型本地模型能进行多跳跨域推理。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA上（1000个问题），Noesis达到59.5 EM/74.7 F1，相较于GraphRAG提升+27.8 EM。使用35B本地模型进行图构建而非GPT-4o。在193页文档的源文本验证中，长距离因果边的提取精度达到90%。AIMD并发控制器实现23倍加速且零OOM事件，Moesis在12GB消费级GPU上实现6.3倍加速。
AI.conclusion: Noesis通过解耦架构和四个专用算法系统性解决了Graph-RAG的三个核心局限，证明了小型本地模型也能超越依赖大型专有模型的现有方法，在性能、效率和可扩展性之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Inference-Time Mitigation of Adversarial Political Bias in Large Language Models
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become the mainstay for information retrieval and summarization tasks, ensuring that they are always non-partisan and invulnerable to political bias is a critical step towards safer and more trustworthy Artificial Intelligence (AI). Current model alignment paradigms, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), make LLMs follow overarching safety instructions. However, this instruction tuning can be exploited via adversarial prompt injection and be used to generate unsafe content. In particular, political bias has not been specifically targeted by modern alignment techniques as harmful and biased content. To address this vulnerability of LLMs, we propose mitigation strategies using Chain of Thought (CoT) prompting and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Using a public dataset of legislative videos, we generate summaries using LLMs, inject bias via adversarial prompting and evaluate their performance on a four axis scale designed for political summarization. In this paper, we present different methods to shield LLMs against the injection of political bias. Our results demonstrate that the proposed Recursive Self-Correction approach raises model performance from a Political Neutrality Likert scale baseline of 2.14 to 4.56, averaged across all models, demonstrating effective inference-time mitigation of political bias in LLM-generated summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型在政治摘要任务中易受对抗性提示注入而产生政治偏见的问题，提出了基于CoT提示和直接偏好优化（DPO）的缓解策略。实验表明，递归自校正方法将政治中立性Likert评分从基线2.14提升至4.56，有效在推理阶段缓解了LLM生成摘要中的政治偏见。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM成为信息检索和摘要任务的主流工具，确保其无党派且不受政治偏见影响是实现更安全、更可信AI的关键。然而，现有的RLHF等对齐方法仅使模型遵循总体安全指令，可通过对抗性提示注入被利用产生不安全内容，且政治偏见未被现代对齐技术作为有害内容进行专门针对性处理。
AI.method: 提出多种缓解策略：(1) 使用Chain of Thought（CoT）提示引导模型思考；(2) 采用Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）进行对齐优化；(3) 核心方法为Recursive Self-Correction递归自校正，在推理阶段迭代修正模型输出。使用公开立法视频数据集生成摘要，通过对抗性提示注入偏见，并在为政治摘要设计的四轴量表上评估性能。
AI.result: 提出的Recursive Self-Correction方法将政治中立性Likert量表基线评分从2.14提升至4.56（跨所有模型平均），有效实现了LLM生成摘要中政治偏见的推理时缓解。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，递归自校正等推理阶段缓解方法能够有效防御LLM在政治摘要任务中受到的政治偏见注入，保障模型输出的政治中立性，为构建更安全可信的AI系统提供了可行方案。

title: Path2ST: Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Grounded Cross-Modal Translation for Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E)-stained images offers a cost-effective alternative to spatial transcriptomics (ST). However, existing methods treat H\&E images as generic visual inputs and ignore their intrinsic biological hierarchy, where spatially organized cell types collectively form functional tissue microenvironments that govern local gene expression programs. To bridge this gap, we formulate H\&E-to-ST prediction as a cross-modal semantic translation task and propose Path2ST, a hierarchically grounded autoregressive framework featuring three key components: (i) a Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Conditioning mechanism that fuses explicit and implicit cellular features with tissue-level semantic representations to construct hierarchical conditioning signals; (ii) a Scale-Adaptive Autoregressive Generation process over a hierarchical semantic vocabulary, enabling coarse-to-fine, biologically consistent expression synthesis; and (iii) SpectraLoss, a full-spectrum objective that jointly enforces ordinal fidelity, models transcriptional bursts, and aligns semantic structures with cell types. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, validating that Path2ST generates highly accurate and spatially coherent transcriptomic profiles. The related code is released at https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/Path2ST.

AI.tldr: Path2ST提出了一种层次化自回归框架，将H&E染色图像到空间转录组的预测建模为跨模态语义翻译任务，通过层次细胞-组织条件机制、尺度自适应自回归生成和全谱损失函数，在三个数据集上取得了最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有H&E-to-ST预测方法将H&E图像视为通用视觉输入，忽略了其内在的生物学层次结构——空间组织的细胞类型共同构成功能组织微环境，进而调控局部基因表达程序。
AI.method: 提出Path2ST框架，包含三个核心组件：(i)层次细胞-组织条件机制，融合显式和隐式细胞特征与组织级语义表示；(ii)尺度自适应自回归生成过程，基于层次语义词汇实现从粗到细的生物学一致表达合成；(iii)SpectraLoss全谱目标函数，同时约束序数保真度、建模转录爆发并对齐语义结构与细胞类型。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的广泛实验表明，Path2ST达到了最先进的性能，能够生成高精度且空间连贯的转录组图谱。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用生物学层次结构，Path2ST验证了层次化自回归方法在跨模态H&E到空间转录组预测中的有效性，代码已开源发布。

title: PIKFNO: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Physics Informed Kernel Function
summary: This work proposes a new interpretable neural operator framework, termed the Physics Informed Kernel Function Neural Operator (PIKFNO), which explicitly incorporates physics informed kernel functions derived from governing equations into the neural operator architecture. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which rely on deep networks to implicitly learn basis functions, PIKFNO constrains the trunk network through physics informed kernel functions, thereby aligning its operator structure with the kernel expansions used in meshless collocation methods. Two construction strategies are introduced: one learns kernel functions directly from data, where the learned kernel can be regarded as a nonsingular fundamental solution, while the other builds them through transformations of analytical fundamental solutions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that PIKFNO achieves high predictive accuracy with substantially improved interpretability and superior generalization under limited training data. The proposed framework offers a new pathway for developing efficient, physically consistent, and interpretable neural operators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的可解释神经算子框架——物理信息核函数神经算子（PIKFNO），通过将控制方程推导出的物理信息核函数显式地融入神经算子架构中，约束trunk网络，使其算子结构与无网格配点法中的核展开对齐，从而在有限训练数据下实现高精度、高可解释性和强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子（如DeepONet）依赖深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性，且在小样本数据下泛化能力有限。作者希望将物理知识显式嵌入神经算子架构，使其兼具深度学习的拟合能力与传统数值方法（无网格配点法）的物理可解释性。
AI.method: PIKFNO框架包含两种核函数构建策略：(1) 直接从数据中学习核函数（学到的核可视为非奇异基本解）；(2) 通过解析基本解的变换来构建核函数。该方法通过物理信息核函数约束trunk网络，使神经算子的结构与无网格配点法中的核展开保持对齐。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，PIKFNO在有限训练数据条件下实现了高预测精度，同时显著提升了模型的可解释性，并在小样本场景下展现出优异的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: PIKFNO为开发高效、物理一致且可解释的神经算子提供了新路径，弥合了深度学习方法与传统数值方法之间的鸿沟。

title: Position: Evaluations of AI Moral Reasoning Still Miss Half of the Picture
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for archival publication at the ACL 2026 Workshop on Evaluating Evaluations (EvalEval)
summary: Recent work on evaluating the moral competence of large language models (LLMs) has focused primarily on what we call the moral value problem, i.e., whether model outputs align with human moral values. In contrast, the moral norm problem, i.e., whether models can identify and correctly apply context-sensitive moral norms, remains underexplored. We posit that this imbalance stems from the field's reliance on descriptive ethics frameworks, such as Moral Foundations Theory and Kohlberg's stages of moral development, which emphasize value representation over normative application. We review existing benchmarks and evaluation methods, and show that they cluster heavily around the value problem, while discussion regarding normative ethics remains underrepresented. We identify three crucial gaps: (i) the absence of high-quality ground-truth data for moral norms and their applications, (ii) insufficient evaluation of intermediate reasoning processes, and (iii) limited attention to the identification of morally relevant features in context. Subsequently, we propose a research agenda that includes the development of standardized formal representations for normative theories, the construction of expert-annotated datasets capturing norm application, and evaluation protocols that explicitly distinguish between values-level and norms-level competence. Our goal is to encourage a more systematic study of normative reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大语言模型道德能力评估领域过度聚焦于"道德价值问题"（输出是否符合人类道德价值），而忽视了"道德规范问题"（能否识别并正确应用情境敏感的规范）。作者回顾现有基准，识别三个关键缺口，并提出以规范伦理学为导向的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM道德评估主要依赖描述性伦理学框架（如道德基础理论、科尔伯格发展阶段理论），这些框架强调价值表征而非规范应用，导致规范层面的能力评估严重不足。
AI.method: 作者通过系统回顾现有基准与评估方法，进行聚类分析以展示其集中于价值问题；在此基础上识别三个关键缺口，并提出包含三大方向的研究议程。
AI.result: 发现现有工作严重偏向价值问题，规范问题代表性不足；识别出三个关键缺口：规范高质量真值数据缺失、中间推理过程评估不足、情境中道德相关特征识别关注有限。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁建立标准化的规范理论形式化表征、专家标注的规范应用数据集，以及能区分价值层面与规范层面能力的评估协议，以推动LLM规范性推理的系统研究。

title: AgentR A Stateful and Recovery-Aware Software Architecture for LLM-based Auditable Workflows
summary: Modern LLM-based applications increasingly require multi- stage execution, persistent intermediate state, retry seman- tics, and auditable usage accounting. However, many LLM applications are still implemented as stateless prompt- response wrappers or session-bounded conversational sys- tems, which makes them difficult to recover, audit, and re- produce after interruption or failure. We propose AgentR, a stateful architecture for LLM workflow systems that en- ables persistence and recovery, instantiated through scien- tific literature review as a representative use case. AgentR represents research intent, generated queries, candidate- paper assessments and gap analyses as durable workflow artifacts, and executes the pipeline through asynchronous BullMQ workers backed by Redis, with PostgreSQL as the persistence store. The design includes explicit processing state transitions, retries with exponential backoff, orphan job detection, credit-aware pre-checks, ACID token-cost logging, and Type-2 slowly changing pricing records. We evaluate AgentR on telemetry collected from a prototype deployment. At the LLM stage, the system achieves 99.2% job completion, and mean latencies of 9.0 s, 18.9 s, and 25.4 s for intent decomposition, query generation, and paper scoring, respectively. Parallel scoring allows for analytical latency modeling from observed calls, leading to as much as 4.3 wall-clock speedup over sequential execution. The results provide preliminary proof-of-concept that persistent state machine design, asynchronous orchestration, and cost-aware usage logging can enable improved observability, recoverability, and operational accountability in LLM workflow systems. The prototype implementation of AgentR is publicly available at: https://github.com/ RiyaSamanta/AgentR-public.

AI.tldr: AgentR 是一种面向 LLM 工作流系统的有状态架构，通过异步 BullMQ 工作线程、Redis 和 PostgreSQL 持久化存储，实现了 LLM 工作流的状态持久性、恢复能力、审计追踪和成本记录，并在科学文献综述场景中验证了其可行性，取得了 99.2% 的任务完成率和最高 4.3 倍的并行加速比。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 应用大多实现为无状态提示-响应封装或会话受限的对话系统，在多阶段执行、持久中间状态、重试语义和可审计计费等方面存在不足，导致工作流在中断或失败后难以恢复、审计和重现。
AI.method: AgentR 将有状态架构引入 LLM 工作流系统，具体包括：将研究意图、生成的查询、候选论文评估和差距分析表示为持久化工作流工件；通过基于 Redis 的异步 BullMQ 工作线程执行流水线；以 PostgreSQL 作为持久化存储；设计显式处理状态转换、指数退避重试、孤儿任务检测、信用感知预检查、ACID 令牌成本日志和 Type-2 缓慢变化定价记录。
AI.result: 在原型部署的遥测数据上，LLM 阶段任务完成率达 99.2%；意图分解、查询生成和论文评分的平均延迟分别为 9.0 秒、18.9 秒和 25.4 秒；并行评分相比顺序执行实现了高达 4.3 倍的墙钟加速。
AI.conclusion: 初步概念验证表明，持久状态机设计、异步编排和成本感知使用日志能够提升 LLM 工作流系统的可观测性、可恢复性和运营问责性，为构建更健壮的 LLM 工作流系统提供了可行参考。

title: Exact MMS Allocations under Personalized Bivalued Valuations: Goods and Chores
summary: The maximin share (MMS) is a central fairness benchmark for allocating indivisible goods and chores. We study additive valuations in the personalized bivalued setting, where each agent assigns one of two agent-specific values to every item. Whether exact MMS allocations always exist in this setting has remained a major open question, as highlighted by Ebadian, Peters, and Shah and by Garg, Huang, and Segal-Halevi. We answer this question affirmatively: we prove that exact MMS allocations always exist for both goods and chores and can be computed in polynomial time. Our proof combines a quota-based reformulation with an envelope relaxation, a sparse extreme-point construction, and flow-based rounding that controls the total rounding loss.

AI.tldr: 本文肯定地回答了一个重要的公开问题：在个性化双值设置下（每个智能体对每个物品赋予两个特定值之一），对于可分割商品和家务的可加估值，精确的最大最小份额（MMS）分配总是存在，且可以在多项式时间内计算。
AI.motivation: MMS是分配不可分割商品和家务的核心公平基准。虽然已有大量研究，但在个性化双值设置下精确MMS分配是否总是存在一直是一个重大公开问题，被多位学者（Ebadian、Peters和Shah，以及Garg、Huang和Segal-Halevi）明确指出。
AI.method: 论文的证明方法结合了四种关键技术：1）基于配额（quota）的重构表述；2）包络松弛（envelope relaxation）；3）稀疏极端点构造；4）基于流的舍入方法，用于控制总舍入损失。
AI.result: 作者肯定地回答了该公开问题：证明了在个性化双值设置下，商品和家务的精确MMS分配总是存在，并且可以在多项式时间内计算得出。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为个性化双值设置下的MMS分配问题画上了圆满的句号，解决了长期悬而未决的开放问题，同时提供了多项式时间的构造性算法，为公平分配理论做出了重要贡献。

title: Ask to Be Sure: Informative Interactions for Confident Multi-Turn LLM Recommendation
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled their use as conversational recommender systems (CRS), demonstrating strong recommendation accuracy and natural dialogue. However, guiding multi-turn interactions to elicit user preferences effectively remains challenging. Existing approaches either use separate reinforcement learning agents with templated interactions or optimize for interactivity judged by another LLM, without measuring how much useful information is actually gained. We propose a new approach that quantifies the effectiveness of each interaction by the reduction in the assistant's uncertainty, measured via entropy over recommendations. We apply this entropy reduction as a reward---without relying on ground-truth recommendations, which are often unavailable in real-world scenarios---to fine-tune the LLM, enabling strategic interaction generation. Empirical results with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO) on the INSPIRED and ReDial datasets show that our method improves both recommendation quality and conversational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于熵减奖励的对话推荐系统方法，通过量化每次交互带来的推荐不确定性降低程度来指导LLM生成策略性对话，无需依赖ground-truth推荐标签。
AI.motivation: 现有的对话推荐系统在引导多轮交互以有效获取用户偏好方面存在挑战：基于强化学习的模板化交互缺乏灵活性，而由LLM评判交互性的方法未测量实际获得的有用信息量。
AI.method: 通过推荐上的熵来衡量助手的不确定性，将每次交互引起的熵减作为奖励信号（无需ground-truth推荐），用于微调LLM，使其生成更具策略性的交互。
AI.result: 在INSPIRED和ReDial数据集上，结合SFT和DPO进行微调，方法在推荐质量和对话效率两方面均取得改进。
AI.conclusion: 熵减奖励可以作为无需ground-truth标签的有效训练信号，提升对话推荐系统的推荐准确性和交互效率。

title: Characterizing Rhetorical Misalignment in Decision-Making with Language Models
summary: Human decision-making is often shaped by a range of well-documented cognitive biases. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into high-stakes human-AI decision-making, it is important to understand whether their outputs can amplify potential biases, how this influences human decisions, and crucially, whether it can lead to harmful consequences. In this work, we develop a decision-theoretic framework to study rhetorical misalignment, a failure mode where an LLM uses rhetorically inappropriate forms of presentation for a given decision context, thereby inducing suboptimal human decisions. We empirically investigate this phenomenon through a human-subject experiment in realistic clinical decision-making using a dataset curated from the United States Medical Licensing Examination. By measuring how LLM-generated information affects decisions, we observe that LLMs induce an average 2.81% rate of harmful decision flips across different models, where clinician participants change from a correct to an incorrect answer. Rationales reported by participants provide evidence that these revisions are closely related to the language used by LLMs that may induce different types of cognitive biases, including anchoring, authority bias, and loss aversion. To enable scalable evaluation, we instantiate our theoretical framework using decision-makers simulated by LLMs to computationally measure rhetorical misalignment. Our findings reveal a safety concern previously unrecognized in high-stakes domains: a model can be factually aligned yet still induce harm through its rhetorical presentation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型(LLM)在临床决策等高危场景中的"修辞错位"(rhetorical misalignment)问题——即LLM输出内容在事实上正确，但其修辞呈现方式不适配决策情境，导致人类决策者发生有害决策翻转。通过基于美国执业医师考试数据的临床决策实验，发现LLM平均诱导2.81%的有害决策翻转率，这些翻转与锚定效应、权威偏见和损失厌恶等认知偏见密切相关。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地融入高风险的"人机协同决策"场景，现有研究主要关注LLM输出的事实准确性，却忽视了其修辞呈现方式对人类决策行为的潜在负面影响。作者希望揭示一个此前未被识别的安全问题：即使模型在事实上对齐，其修辞表达仍可能诱导次优甚至有害的人类决策。
AI.method: 作者首先构建了一个决策理论框架来形式化定义"修辞错位"这一失败模式；然后通过人类受试者实验，在基于美国执业医师考试(UMSLE)数据的临床决策场景中测量LLM生成信息对人类决策的影响；最后用LLM模拟决策者来实例化理论框架，实现修辞错位的可扩展计算测量。
AI.result: 实验发现LLM平均诱导2.81%的有害决策翻转率（参与者从正确答案变为错误答案），且参与者报告的理由表明这些决策修订与LLM语言触发的不同类型认知偏见密切相关，包括锚定效应、权威偏见和损失厌恶。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了一个在高风险领域此前未被识别的安全隐患：模型可能在事实上对齐，但仍通过其修辞呈现方式诱导人类做出有害决策。这要求AI安全评估不仅要关注事实正确性，还要关注LLM表达的修辞方式对人类决策行为的影响。

title: Local Gains and Fixed-Assignment Set Losses in Shared Set Decoders
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. An ancillary analysis-ready package supports exact aggregate reproduction without model inference. Code and reproduction package: https://github.com/yqjyzzz/query-interaction-reproduction
summary:
A query-relation deletion can improve the edited slot while reducing the utility of the prediction set that contains it. We study this tension in two related ResNet-50 DETR-family checkpoints using recorded, selection-conditional evidence from 710 paired image-relation units per checkpoint. The primary comparison subtracts a matched active control, which deletes the same leader source at a different recorded recipient, from the selected target deletion. It is therefore a composite contrast rather than a same-recipient placebo.
  The target-minus-control contrast is locally positive and fixed-assignment negative in both checkpoints. The opposite-sign pattern occurs within 302/710 DETR units and 460/710 DINO units. After rematching, the corresponding counts are 285/710 and 433/710. Rematching and native selection absorb enough of the mean loss for DETR intervals to cross zero, whereas DINO intervals remain negative, so persistence across readouts differs by checkpoint. A fixed-map comparison between hard deletion and a mass-preserving edit also differs before rematching. That comparison is conditional on the outcome-blind map and does not establish same-dose transport.
  Local intervention success therefore does not determine the consequence for a jointly decoded set. The supported conclusion is selection-conditional deletion sensitivity whose persistence depends on the readout and intervention operator. We do not identify an intervention-invariant edge mechanism, detector-level degradation, population prevalence, or the value of a training-time regularizer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了查询-关系删除操作在编辑槽位与预测集效用之间的张力，通过两个ResNet-50 DETR家族检查点的710对图像-关系单元数据，采用目标减控制组的对比设计，发现局部干预成功并不能决定联合解码集的后果，删除敏感性是否持续取决于读数方式和干预算子。
AI.motivation: 查询-关系删除可以改善被编辑的槽位，但同时会降低包含该槽位的预测集的效用。作者希望理解这种局部编辑成功与整体集合效用之间的张力关系，并探究是否存在干预不变的边缘机制或检测器层面的退化。
AI.method: 使用两个ResNet-50 DETR家族检查点，每检查点收集710对图像-关系单元的记录，采用选择条件证据。主要对比是目标删除减去匹配的活动对照（在相同领导来源但在不同记录接收者处删除），构成复合对比而非同接收者安慰剂。还进行了重匹配分析和固定映射下的硬删除与质量保持编辑的对比。
AI.result: 目标减对照的对比在两个检查点中局部为正、固定分配为负。反号模式出现在DETR的302/710单元和DINO的460/710单元中，重匹配后分别为285/710和433/710。重匹配和原生选择吸收了足够的平均损失使DETR区间跨越零，而DINO区间保持负值，因此持久性因检查点而异。固定映射对比在重匹配前有差异，但该对比以结果盲地图为条件，不能确立同剂量迁移。
AI.conclusion: 局部干预成功不能决定联合解码集的后果。支持的结论是选择条件删除敏感性，其持久性取决于读数和干预算子。未发现干预不变的边缘机制、检测器级退化、群体流行性或训练时正则化器的价值。

title: Explaining Reinforcement Learning Decisions in Self-adaptive Systems
comment: Accepted in the 20th Colombian Computing Congress. 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been extensively used in autonomous and self-* systems, but RL policies, especially deep RL ones relying on neural networks, lack transparency and are difficult to understand. This can lead to diminished user trust, and makes for a more challenging verification of systems. To address this challenge, this paper introduces Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning (EARL), a Python library to produce counterfactual explanations in RL settings. This library allows the user to produce explanations by exploring What-if scenarios to clarify agent behavior by comparing possible outcomes. Counterfactual explanations have been shown to be intuitive and user-friendly in psychology research, but have only recently been explored in RL, with existing implementations usually limited to toy examples and benchmarks. EARL supports counterfactual explanation generation in realistic RL-based self-adaptive systems. To demonstrate its applicability, we demonstrate its use in a simulation of CitiBikes, a self-adaptive bike-sharing system, and we provide evaluations showing how it performs in real applications.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了EARL，一个用于在强化学习（RL）系统中生成反事实解释的Python库。该库通过探索"What-if"场景来帮助用户理解代理行为，并在模拟的CitiBikes共享单车系统等真实自适应系统中展示了实用性。
AI.motivation: 深度RL策略依赖神经网络，缺乏透明度和可解释性，导致用户信任度下降，并使系统验证变得困难。现有的RL反事实解释实现通常局限于玩具示例和基准测试，缺乏对真实自适应系统的支持。
AI.method: EARL通过对比可能的结果来生成反事实解释，支持在真实的基于RL的自适应系统中进行反事实解释生成。具体通过在CitiBikes共享单车系统模拟上进行演示验证。
AI.result: 在CitiBikes（自适应共享单车系统）模拟中成功展示了EARL的适用性，并提供了在真实应用中的性能评估。
AI.conclusion: EARL填补了RL反事实解释在真实自适应系统应用中的空白，提供了一种直观且用户友好的解释机制，有助于提升用户信任和系统验证能力。

title: From Doyle to AGM: A Survey and an Implementation Roadmap for Belief Change
comment: Author's accepted manuscript of an article published in The European Journal on Artificial Intelligence 2026 (SAGE). 65 pages, 2 figures. Final published version available at https://doi.org/10.1177/30504554261426170
summary: This paper presents a targeted narrative review establishing the historical and theoretical foundations for computational belief change implementation. Seeded by Doyle and London's foundational 1980 taxonomy, we trace the evolution of belief revision from computational origins through the theoretical transformation of the AGM framework to contemporary approaches. Our analysis demonstrates how pre-AGM computational pragmatism relates to AGM theoretical constructs, revealing both continuities and transformations across this evolution. We analyze how each taxonomical category evolved in the post-AGM era, identifying the theoretical foundations and historical precedents that inform contemporary implementation challenges. This foundation enables subsequent research into robust computational blueprints that synthesize historical insights with formal guarantees, providing the baseline for systematic implementation analysis and engineering-focused belief change research.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇针对性的叙述性综述，以Doyle和London 1980年的基础分类法为起点，系统地追溯了信念修正从计算起源、经过AGM框架理论转型到当代方法的演变历程，并为后续计算蓝图和工程化实现研究奠定历史与理论基础。
AI.motivation: 计算信念修正在实现层面缺乏系统性的历史与理论梳理，需要在pre-AGM计算实用主义与AGM理论框架之间建立联系，揭示演化的连续性与变革，为当代实现挑战提供历史先例和理论根基。
AI.method: 采用定向叙述性综述方法，以Doyle和London的1980年分类法为种子，逐类分析信念修正的发展脉络；对每个分类学类别在后AGM时代的演变进行考察，并将历史见解与形式化保证相结合。
AI.result: 展示了pre-AGM计算实用主义与AGM理论构造之间的关联，识别了信念修正演化中的连续性与变革，并为每个分类学类别的后AGM演变提供了理论根基和历史先导。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为后续研究提供了基础，支持构建综合历史见解与形式化保证的、稳健的计算蓝图，为系统性实现分析和工程导向的信念修正研究确立了基线。

title: On the Influence of Refactoring Types on Merge Effort
comment: This paper is currently undergoing a major revision as part of the review process at IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering (TSE)
summary: Modern software development involves parallel work and concurrent changes, requiring code merging. Prior studies report that 10% to 20% of merge attempts result in conflicts, often requiring manual intervention. The literature explores factors that generate conflicts, including refactorings, but does not analyze how individual refactoring types influence the manual effort required to resolve them. We analyzed 64 open-source Java projects and applied association rule mining to measure the strength of associations between specific refactoring types and merge effort. Our results show that refactoring types relate to merge effort with varying strength. In particular, Rename Attribute, Move Class, Extract Variable, Change Return Type, and Split Parameter exhibit some of the strongest associations, especially when a higher number of such refactorings is present in the merge branches. We also find that both the number of refactorings and their diversity independently increase merge effort, both in terms of occurrence and intensity. Additionally, the co-occurrence of refactorings across parallel branches is associated with higher merge effort, particularly when combining structural transformations with changes to method signatures and data-structure representations, whereas more localized changes are less frequent in the most impactful combinations.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了64个开源Java项目，运用关联规则挖掘方法研究了具体重构类型与代码合并工作量之间的关联强度。研究发现Rename Attribute、Move Class、Extract Variable、Change Return Type和Split Parameter等重构类型与合并努力关联最强，且重构的数量和多样性都会独立增加合并工作量，跨并行分支的重构共现也与更高的合并努力相关。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已发现重构是导致合并冲突的因素之一，但尚未深入分析具体重构类型对解决冲突所需人工努力的影响程度。理解不同重构类型与合并工作量之间的关系，可以帮助开发者评估合并风险并制定更有效的合并策略。
AI.method: 分析了64个开源Java项目，应用关联规则挖掘（association rule mining）技术，衡量特定重构类型与合并努力（merge effort）之间关联的强度。研究还考察了重构数量、多样性以及跨分支重构共现对合并努力的影响。
AI.result: 不同重构类型与合并努力的关联强度各异。Rename Attribute、Move Class、Extract Variable、Change Return Type和Split Parameter表现出最强的关联，尤其在合并分支中存在较多此类重构时更为显著。重构的数量和多样性均独立增加合并努力；跨并行分支的重构共现，尤其是结构变换与方法签名、数据结构表示的改变组合时，与更高的合并努力相关。
AI.conclusion: 具体重构类型与合并工作量之间存在不同程度的关联，某些结构性重构类型对合并难度的影响尤为突出。重构的数量、多样性以及跨分支共现都是合并工作量增加的重要因素，这为开发者预测和缓解合并冲突提供了有价值的参考。

title: When Search Eats the Web: A Model of Corpus Erosion under Generative Extraction
summary: Generative search engines (GSEs) answer user queries directly from crawled web content. The capture of value from the corpus without a visit returned to the source (we call this capture extraction) diverts the traffic that finances content production. In response, publishers may restrict crawler access to their websites. In this paper, we model the crawlable corpus as a common-pool resource: the crawlable commons. It is described by three quantities: volume, average quality, and lifetime. Under two types of responses of publishers we prove that extraction degrades all three at once: publishers opt out, renewal loses its funding, and content becomes more perishable. After a given erosion threshold, the corpus goes extinct. A myopic GSE can cross this threshold, a long-run oriented GSE stays below it. We extend our model to several competing engines and prove, under a concavity condition on the steady-state value of the commons, that the symmetric equilibrium extraction rate is nondecreasing in their number and converges to the threshold. Adding users who strictly prefer direct answers, the assumption most favorable to extraction, we prove that the socially optimal extraction rate lies strictly below the erosion threshold, and no higher than the single engine's sustainable optimum. Finally, we discuss seven survival mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了生成式搜索引擎（GSE）从 crawled web 内容中直接回答用户查询的"捕获提取"行为对内容生产生态的影响。作者将可爬取语料库建模为公共池资源，证明提取行为会同时降低语料库的规模、平均质量和寿命，超过侵蚀阈值后语料库将灭绝。论文还分析了多引擎竞争、社会最优提取率及七种生存机制。
AI.motivation: 生成式搜索引擎直接从爬取内容回答用户问题，用户不再访问原始网站，导致内容生产者失去流量和收入来源。这种"捕获提取"行为使出版商可能限制爬虫访问，最终威胁整个内容生态的可持续性。作者希望从理论上理解这一动态失衡过程并提出解决方案。
AI.method: 将可爬取语料库建模为公共池资源（common-pool resource），用三个量描述：规模（volume）、平均质量（quality）和寿命（lifetime）。考虑出版商的两类响应行为，证明提取会同时恶化三个维度。进一步将模型扩展到多个竞争引擎，在稳态价值的凹性条件下证明对称均衡提取率随引擎数量非递减并收敛于阈值。最后考虑偏好直接回答的用户，证明社会最优提取率严格低于侵蚀阈值。
AI.result: 证明提取行为同时降解语料库的规模、质量和寿命三个维度；存在侵蚀阈值，超过则语料库灭绝；短视的GSE会跨越阈值而长期导向的GSE不会；多引擎竞争下均衡提取率随引擎数量增加而上升并收敛到阈值；即使在最有利于提取的假设下，社会最优提取率也严格低于侵蚀阈值且不高于单个引擎的可持续最优值。
AI.conclusion: 生成式搜索引擎的提取行为对内容生态系统构成系统性威胁，需要主动的治理机制来避免"公共池悲剧"。论文提出并讨论了七种生存机制来维持内容生产的可持续性。

title: LineageRAG: Harnessing GraphRAG by Constructing Evidence Lineages with Source Grounding
summary: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) retrieves evidence for multi-hop questions over structured cor- pus graphs. Existing GraphRAG methods leave the connection between evidence discovery and source grounding implicit. We propose LineageRAG, which constructs one evidence lin- eage for each query-derived evidence demand and completes it with a verbatim source span when the selected evidence supports that demand. LineageRAG first initializes the evi- dence demands. It then expands each lineage through demand- conditioned retrieval over the corpus graph while retaining the demand associated with every candidate. Lineage completion uses this provenance to select complementary passages and grounds supported demands in verbatim source text. Experi- ments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue show that LineageRAG improves R@5, EM, and F1 by 3.51, 5.96, and 5.22 points on average over leading GraphRAG baselines.

AI.tldr: LineageRAG是一种新型图检索增强生成方法，它为每个查询派生的证据需求构建证据谱系，并用逐字源文本来完成证据来源的实体化，在多跳问答数据集上显著优于现有GraphRAG基线。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG方法在证据发现与来源实体化（source grounding）之间的联系是隐式的，缺乏对证据来源的明确追踪，导致检索到的证据难以在答案生成中得到可靠支撑。
AI.method: LineageRAG首先初始化证据需求（evidence demands），然后通过需求条件化检索（demand-conditioned retrieval）在语料图谱上扩展每个谱系，同时为每个候选保留其关联的需求。谱系完成阶段利用这些溯源信息选择互补的段落，并将受支持的需求实体化到逐字源文本中。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue数据集上，LineageRAG相较于领先的GraphRAG基线，在R@5、EM和F1指标上平均分别提升了3.51、5.96和5.22个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式构建证据谱系并将需求与逐字源文本关联，LineageRAG有效弥合了证据发现与来源实体化之间的鸿沟，显著提升了多跳问答的检索与生成性能。

title: DeMTS: Denoising Trajectories as Multivariate Time Series for Hallucination Detection in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for text generation. However, similar to autoregressive LLMs, D-LLMs remain vulnerable to hallucinations, where fluent outputs may contain factually incorrect or unsupported content. Although existing hallucination detection methods for D-LLMs attempt to leverage uncertainty trajectories of the denoising process to better identify hallucination signals, they typically compress the trajectories along either the temporal or token dimension, overlooking the useful information encoded in the complete two-dimensional token-step structure. Consequently, they may fail to capture hallucination-relevant patterns, such as inconsistent convergence and cross-token fault propagation, leading to suboptimal detection performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a D-LLM hallucination detection framework that formulates the Denoising trajectories as Multivariate Time Series over learnable latent variables (DeMTS for short). DeMTS employs a trajectory-preserving token-to-variable assignment module to convert token signals into stable latent variables. Based on these variables, we propose dynamic multivariate temporal modeling to progressively integrate inter-variable dependency modeling with temporal encoding for hallucination prediction. Extensive experiments on two D-LLMs backbones and three benchmarks demonstrate that DeMTS outperforms existing hallucination detection methods while maintaining strong robustness, efficiency, and cross-task transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeMTS框架，将扩散大语言模型（D-LLM）的去噪轨迹建模为基于可学习潜变量的多元时间序列，通过轨迹保持的token到变量分配模块和动态多元时序建模，有效捕获幻觉相关模式（如不一致收敛和跨token故障传播），在幻觉检测任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: D-LLM虽是一种有前景的文本生成范式，但和自回归LLM一样容易产生幻觉。现有D-LLM幻觉检测方法虽利用去噪过程中的不确定性轨迹，但通常沿时间或token维度压缩轨迹，忽略了完整的二维token-step结构中的有用信息，从而无法捕获如不一致收敛和跨token故障传播等幻觉相关模式，导致检测性能欠佳。
AI.method: DeMTS框架包含两个核心模块：(1) 轨迹保持的token到变量分配模块，将token信号转换为稳定的潜变量；(2) 动态多元时序建模模块，渐进式整合变量间依赖建模与时间编码，用于幻觉预测。
AI.result: 在两个D-LLM骨干网络和三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，DeMTS在幻觉检测性能上优于现有方法，同时保持较强的鲁棒性、效率和跨任务可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 将去噪轨迹的完整二维结构保留并建模为多元时间序列，能够更有效地捕获D-LLM幻觉信号，为D-LLM幻觉检测提供了新的方法论视角。

title: VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding is a fundamental task for evaluating the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing leading models have already achieved approximately 90% accuracy on the Video-MME leaderboard, suggesting that conventional single-turn video understanding tasks are becoming increasingly saturated and insufficient for assessing the intelligence of advanced MLLMs. Towards this end, we introduce VideoGAIA, an agentic video understanding benchmark for general artificial intelligence (AI) assistants. Moving beyond one-shot video question answering, VideoGAIA formulates video understanding as a multi-turn, tool-augmented interaction process, where models must iteratively perceive videos, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate multimodal evidence across turns. VideoGAIA contains 271 model-human co-designed tasks covering diverse and complex real-world scenarios.
