The framework employs a MatterSim-D3-based structural optimization workflow to generate DFT-quality bilayer structures from monolayer building blocks and stacking configurations at substantially reduced computational cost. For property prediction, we introduce BDIP-Net (Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network), a graph neural network that explicitly models intra-layer and inter-layer interactions through interaction-specific potential representations and adaptive message fusion. We evaluate the proposed framework on BiDB, HetDB, and SAMBA, encompassing homobilayers, heterobilayers, and twisted bilayer systems. Results show that the MatterSim-D3-based workflow closely reproduces DFT-PBE-D3 optimized structures, while BDIP-Net consistently outperforms existing graph neural network and potential-based approaches for bilayer property prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个机器学习框架，用于高效构建和预测堆叠双层材料的结构与性质。框架包含两个核心组件：基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化工作流（以低成本生成DFT质量的双层结构）和BDIP-Net图神经网络（显式建模层内与层间两种相互作用）。在BiDB、HetDB和SAMBA三个数据集上的实验表明，该框架能紧密复现DFT-PBE-D3优化结构，并在性质预测上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 堆叠双层材料具有丰富的依赖于堆叠方式的性质，但其计算发现面临两大挑战：(1) 精确的结构生成依赖昂贵的DFT优化；(2) 现有机器学习模型在性质预测时未能显式区分层内强共价键与层间弱范德华力这两种截然不同的相互作用类型，导致预测精度受限。
AI.method: 提出了一个两阶段的机器学习框架：(1) 结构生成阶段：采用基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化工作流，从单层构建块和堆叠构型出发，以显著降低的计算成本生成DFT质量的双层结构；(2) 性质预测阶段：设计BDIP-Net（双层双相互作用势网络），一种图神经网络，通过交互特定势表示和自适应消息融合，显式建模层内与层间两种相互作用。
AI.result: 在包含同质双层、异质双层和扭转双层的BiDB、HetDB和SAMBA三个数据集上，MatterSim-D3工作流生成的结构与DFT-PBE-D3优化结构高度一致；BDIP-Net在双层性质预测任务上一致性地优于现有的图神经网络和基于势函数的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了在双层材料研究中，显式区分层内与层间相互作用可以显著提升性质预测精度，同时MatterSim-D3工作流能在低成本下实现DFT级结构生成，为堆叠双层材料的计算发现提供了高效且准确的解决方案。

title: OGX: An Open-Source, Vendor-Neutral Generative AI Application Server
summary: OGX (Open GenAI Stack) is an open-source AI application server and Python library that implements the APIs of major frontier labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) with pluggable backend providers. Developers building agentic AI applications--such as retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, multi-turn agents, and tool-calling workflows--can develop against a single API surface and deploy with any combination of inference engine, vector database, and safety backend, without changing application code. OGX's primary focus is the Responses API for server-side agentic orchestration, conforming to the Open Responses specification. The server also supports the Anthropic Messages API and Google GenAI Interactions API, decoupling SDK choice from model and deployment decisions. With over 20 inference providers, 13 vector store backends, and a companion Kubernetes Operator for production deployment, OGX serves as the self-hosted, model-agnostic backend for AI-powered developer tools including Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and OpenHands. The project has over 8,400 GitHub stars, 242 contributors, and 4,000 commits across nearly two years of public development.

AI.tldr: OGX是一个开源的AI应用服务器和Python库，实现了OpenAI、Anthropic、Google等主流前沿实验室的API，并支持可插拔的后端提供商。开发者可以基于单一API接口开发代理式AI应用（如RAG流水线、多轮代理、工具调用工作流），无需修改代码即可搭配任意推理引擎、向量数据库和安全后端进行部署。OGX重点支持Responses API（服务端代理编排），符合Open Responses规范，同时支持Anthropic Messages API和Google GenAI Interactions API。项目拥有20多个推理提供商、13个向量存储后端、配套的Kubernetes Operator，并服务于Claude Code、Codex CLI等AI开发工具，已获得超过8,400个GitHub星标。
AI.motivation: 随着代理式AI应用的兴起，开发者面临碎片化的API生态——不同前沿实验室（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google）提供不兼容的API，且部署时需要绑定特定的推理引擎、向量数据库和安全后端。OGX旨在解决这一痛点，通过统一的API表面解耦应用开发与底层基础设施选择，使开发者无需更改应用代码即可灵活切换和组合不同的后端服务。
AI.method: OGX作为开源AI应用服务器和Python库，核心方法包括：1) 实现主流前沿实验室API（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google）并提供可插拔后端提供商架构；2) 重点实现Responses API用于服务端代理编排，符合Open Responses规范；3) 同时支持Anthropic Messages API和Google GenAI Interactions API，将SDK选择与模型/部署决策解耦；4) 提供20多个推理提供商和13个向量存储后端的集成；5) 配套Kubernetes Operator支持生产环境部署。
AI.result: OGX成功构建了一个模型无关的自托管后端，支持多种AI开发工具（Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode、OpenHands），并获得了显著的社区认可：超过8,400个GitHub星标、242名贡献者、近两年约4,000次提交。
AI.conclusion: OGX通过统一的API抽象层和可插拔架构，有效解决了代理式AI应用开发中的API碎片化和部署绑定问题，为开发者提供灵活、模型无关的自托管AI后端解决方案，并在社区中获得了广泛的采用和认可。

title: An Empirical Study on the Impact of Normalized Use-Case Specifications on Traceability
summary: Traceability link recovery between requirements and source code is vital for software quality assurance and evolution analysis. Although automated traceability techniques have advanced greatly, the large semantic gap between vague natural-language requirements and precise source code still hinders accurate link recovery. Most existing approaches optimize traceability algorithms yet ignore the inherent quality of requirement descriptions, which prevents fundamental reduction of the semantic gap. This work proposes a requirement-oriented normalization method. Using controlled natural language and large-language-model-based prompt engineering, raw requirements are decomposed and converted into standardized use-case specifications to strengthen semantic representation and mitigate semantic divergence. Evaluated on four public datasets under two typical traceability frameworks, the normalized specifications improve tracing performance for semantically ambiguous raw requirements. However, over-normalization may degrade results for already high-quality requirements closely aligned with code semantics. The results validate source-side requirement normalization as a promising strategy for traceability improvement and reveal its applicable boundaries for practical usage.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向需求侧的归一化方法，利用受控自然语言和大语言模型提示工程，将原始需求分解并转换为标准化的用例规格说明，以缩小需求与源代码之间的语义鸿沟，从而提升追踪链接恢复的准确率。在四个公开数据集上的实验验证了该方法对语义模糊需求的提升效果，但也发现过度归一化会损害本身与代码语义高度对齐的高质量需求。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化追踪技术主要优化追踪算法本身，却忽视了需求描述的内在质量问题。由于自然语言需求的模糊性与源代码的精确性之间存在巨大语义鸿沟，仅靠算法优化无法从根本上缓解追踪不准确的问题。
AI.method: 提出需求侧归一化方法，通过受控自然语言（Controlled Natural Language）结合大语言模型提示工程，将原始需求进行分解并转换为标准化的用例规格说明（use-case specifications），以强化需求的语义表示、减少语义分歧，从而缩小与源代码之间的语义差距。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集和两种典型追踪框架下进行评测，归一化后的规格说明显著提升了语义模糊的原始需求的追踪性能；但对于本身质量较高且与代码语义紧密对齐的需求，过度归一化可能导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了需求侧归一化是提升追踪链接恢复的有前景策略，同时揭示了其适用边界——该方法更适合语义模糊的需求，而对高质量需求应谨慎使用，避免过度归一化带来的负面影响。

title: Solving Streett and Emerson-Lei Games with Universal Trees
summary:
Nearly a decade ago, Calude et al. showed that parity games can be solved in quasi-polynomial time. This result is now understood in terms of universal trees. By reduction to parity games, the quasi-polymonial result can benefit all omega-regular games. However, beyond such reductions, and with the exception of Rabin games, our understanding of the role of universal trees in direct solutions is still quite limited. In this work, we refute the common view that universal trees are relevant only for games that admit memoryless winning strategies. We contribute a full understanding of how universal trees interact with Zielonka trees for the solution of Streett and Emerson-Lei games.
  As a consequence, we show that winning regions and strategies in Streett games with $n$ vertices, $m$ edges, and $k$ pairs can be computed in time $O(mk\log(k)k!|U(n,k)|)$, where $U(n,k)$ is a universal tree for $n$ leaves and depth $k$. This improves upon the best previously known complexity result for Streett games, which relied on reduction to parity games and their quasi-polynomial solution.
  Furthermore, we show that winning regions and strategies for Emerson-Lei games with $n$ vertices, $m$ edges, and $c$ colors can be computed in time $O(mc\log(c)c!|U(n,c/2)|)$, again improving over reductions to parity games. Notably, our approach yields memory-optimal strategies, in contrast to those obtained via reductions to parity games. Finally, we show how universal trees can be used to bound the recursion tree of the Zielonka-McNaughton algorithm for Emerson-Lei games. This leads to a symbolic algorithm that replaces the factor $n^c$ in the time complexity of existing symbolic approaches with $|U(n,c)|$.

AI.tldr: 本文深入研究了通用树（universal trees）在Streett博弈和Emerson-Lei博弈中的作用，推翻了"通用树仅适用于具有无记忆获胜策略的博弈"的普遍观点。作者证明了通用树与Zielonka树的交互如何用于解决这两类博弈，并给出了改进的复杂度上界，同时获得了内存最优的策略以及一种改进的符号化算法。
AI.motivation: 此前，Calude等人的研究表明parity博弈可以在拟多项式时间内求解，这一结果被用通用树来理解。虽然通过归约可以让所有omega-正则博弈受益于这一结果，但除了Rabin博弈外，通用树在直接求解其他博弈中的作用仍不清楚。本文旨在打破"通用树仅适用于可记忆无策略的博弈"这一常见认知，探索通用树在Streett和Emerson-Lei博弈直接求解中的作用。
AI.method: 作者通过深入研究通用树与Zielonka树之间的交互关系，建立了一套全新的框架用于直接求解Streett和Emerson-Lei博弈。他们利用通用树的结构特性来界定和约束Zielonka算法中的递归树，从而在不需要通过归约到parity博弈的情况下，直接获得高效的求解算法。此外，他们还引入了一种符号化算法，利用通用树来限制递归深度。
AI.result: 1) Streett博弈：在n个顶点、m条边、k对条件下，可在O(mk log(k) · k! · |U(n,k)|)时间内计算获胜区域和策略，优于此前依赖归约到parity博弈的最优复杂度。2) Emerson-Lei博弈：在n个顶点、m条边、c种颜色下，可在O(mc log(c) · c! · |U(n,c/2)|)时间内求解，同样优于归约方法，且能获得内存最优策略。3) 符号化算法：利用通用树将现有符号化方法中的n^c因子替换为|U(n,c)|。
AI.conclusion: 本文彻底改变了人们对通用树适用范围的认知，证明通用树不仅适用于允许无记忆策略的博弈，在Streett和Emerson-Lei博弈的直接求解中同样发挥着核心作用。作者的方法不仅在时间复杂度上优于现有的归约方法，而且在策略的内存使用上也达到了最优，同时符号化算法的改进进一步扩大了这些结果的应用范围。

title: Decoupled Temporal Encoding for Generative Recommendation
summary: Positional encoding is a fundamental component of Transformer-based generative recommendation models, where user histories are modeled as autoregressive item sequences. Most positional encoding methods are inherited from natural language processing and mainly represent discrete item order. However, recommendation sequences go beyond ordered lists, as timestamps and temporal effects also shape item relations. Our work is motivated by a real-world food delivery and instant retail recommendation system, where user behavior exhibits multi-level temporal regularities, including recency effects, meal-time peaks, weekday-weekend shifts, and promotion-driven traffic bursts. Existing methods partially address this issue through timestamp features, interval embeddings, decay functions, or attention biases, but they usually inject heterogeneous temporal signals through a unified representation or a single modeling pathway, making it difficult to distinguish broad temporal dynamics from local order cues. To address this limitation, we propose Decoupled Temporal Encoding, a lightweight framework for generative recommendation. DTE separates temporal dynamics from order information through two complementary modules: a personalized macro-temporal module that injects compact temporal primitives into item embeddings, and a time-gated micro-sequential module that introduces relative-order bias only when interactions are temporally dense. DTE is also parameter-efficient and deployment-friendly, allowing easy integration into existing systems.

AI.tldr: 提出解耦时序编码（DTE），将宏观时序动态与微观序列顺序信息分离处理，用于基于Transformer的生成式推荐系统，以更好地建模用户行为中的多层级时间规律。
AI.motivation: 现有位置编码方法多继承自NLP，主要建模离散的item顺序，忽略了推荐序列中时间戳和时序效应（如近期效应、用餐高峰、工作日/周末差异、促销流量爆发）对item关系的影响。已有方法通过时间戳特征、间隔嵌入等方法部分解决问题，但将异构时间信号通过统一表示或单一路径注入，难以区分宏观时序动态与局部顺序线索。
AI.method: 提出DTE框架，包含两个互补模块：1）个性化宏观时序模块，将紧凑的时序原语注入item嵌入；2）时间门控微观序列模块，仅在交互时间密集时引入相对顺序偏置。该框架参数高效、易于部署。
AI.result: DTE将时序动态与顺序信息解耦，在真实的外卖和即时零售推荐场景中得到动机验证，具有参数高效和部署友好的特点，可轻松集成到现有系统。
AI.conclusion: 解耦时序与顺序信息是提升生成式推荐中时间建模能力的有效方向，DTE提供轻量级且可落地的解决方案。

title: Beyond Tokens: A Survey on Decoding Methods for Large Language and Vision-Language Models
comment: ACM SIGKDD Explorations Newsletter, Volume 28, Issue 1
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive generative capabilities, yet ensuring their outputs align with user intent is still challenging. While most existing approaches address this issue at the training stage, inference-time approaches like decoding methods offer a more efficient and scalable solution. Decoding methods control model generation by guiding token-level selection, performing sequence-level generation, or generating tokens in parallel to accelerate the process. In this survey, we identify three emerging paradigms from recent works on decoding methods for LLMs and LVLMs, provide a systematic review of these methods, highlight ongoing challenges, and discuss potential future research directions. Our goal is to underscore the efficiency and effectiveness of decoding methods and offer a practical view of their applications. Paper lists and more resources on decoding methods for LLMs and LVLMs can be found at https://github.com/wang2226/Awesome-LLM-Decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型（LLMs）和大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）解码方法的综述论文。论文识别出三种新兴的解码方法范式，系统回顾了这些方法，突出当前挑战，并讨论未来研究方向，强调解码方法在推理阶段的高效性和实用性。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs和LVLMs展现了强大的生成能力，但确保输出与用户意图对齐仍然具有挑战性。现有方法大多在训练阶段解决对齐问题，而推理阶段的解码方法提供更高效、可扩展的解决方案，因此有必要对这类方法进行系统性综述。
AI.method: 本文通过识别三种新兴解码范式进行系统综述：（1）引导token级选择的解码方法（2）执行序列级生成的解码方法（3）并行生成token以加速过程的解码方法。作者对近期相关工作进行分类整理和回顾。
AI.result: 论文总结了当前解码方法在LLMs和LVLMs中的三种主要范式，提供了对这些方法的系统梳理，并指出了该领域仍然存在的挑战和未来可能的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 解码方法是一种高效且可扩展的模型推理阶段对齐解决方案，本文旨在强调解码方法的效率与有效性，并为从业者提供实际应用视角，同时为未来研究指明方向。

title: Spatial Attention Noise Masking for Causally Sufficient Interpretability
summary: We present a novel causal approach to interpretability for computer vision models that dynamically masks the input image prior to classification. The interpretability of deep learning predictions is critical in high-stakes fields such as medical imaging, security, and autonomous driving. Most interpretability methods are applied passively to already trained models, which typically result in correlational rather than causal explanations. Existing causal interpretability methods are limited to post hoc analysis, weakening the causal claims. Additionally, existing active methods generally lack explanations that explicitly assign responsibility to input features. This work proposes a spatial attention noise masking framework that provides causal explanations about the features sufficient for the prediction. The proposed framework consists of: 1) a UNet-style mask generator, and 2) a Resnet18 encoder and linear classifier that classifies both masked and unmasked versions of an input image. The generated masks are regularized to be sparse and spatially smooth, while masked image embeddings are constrained to remain consistent with embeddings from the corresponding unmasked images. The resulting masks can be interpreted as feature attribution maps that are competitive with related interpretability methods while additionally providing strong causal explanations of model predictions. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate mask faithfulness, near-baseline classification performance across five classification tasks despite substantial masking of image information, and robustness to distribution shifts such as background swapping and natural adversarial examples. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate mask behavior and competitive interpretability relative to state-of-the-art feature attribution methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的因果可解释性方法，通过空间注意力噪声掩码框架对输入图像进行动态掩码，为计算机视觉模型的预测提供因果解释。框架包括UNet风格的掩码生成器和ResNet18编码器及线性分类器，生成的掩码稀疏且空间平滑，同时保持掩码与未掩码图像嵌入的一致性。实验证明该方法在掩码忠实度、分类性能和分布偏移鲁棒性方面均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法大多是事后（post hoc）应用于已训练模型，产生的是相关性解释而非因果解释；已有的因果可解释性方法局限于事后分析，因果声明薄弱；且现有主动方法缺乏明确将责任分配给输入特征的解释。
AI.method: 提出一个空间注意力噪声掩码框架，包含两个核心组件：1) UNet风格的掩码生成器，用于动态生成稀疏且空间平滑的掩码；2) ResNet18编码器和线性分类器，对掩码和未掩码版本的输入图像同时进行分类。掩码通过正则化保证稀疏性和空间平滑性，且掩码图像的嵌入与未掩码图像的嵌入保持一致。
AI.result: 定量评估表明掩码忠实度高，在五个分类任务上尽管大幅掩码图像信息仍保持接近基线的分类性能，并且对背景交换和自然对抗样本等分布偏移具有鲁棒性。定性比较进一步展示了掩码行为及与最先进特征归因方法相当的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 生成的掩码可解释为特征归因图，与相关可解释性方法性能相当，同时提供了模型预测的强因果解释，为因果可解释性领域提供了新的框架思路。

title: Training and Evaluating Ethical Reinforcement Learning Agents on Per-Episode Distributions
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents trained on a single reward signal exploit the gap between the designed reward and the intended behavior. This is particularly a problem when we are trying to imbue ethical behavior into RL agents. An agent can look ethical on average while concentrating its violations in a few bad episodes, and a creature in the environment harmed in one episode is not restored by good conduct in another. We compare four ways of training ethical behavior in Craftax, an open-ended survival benchmark. The four are: scalar penalties with termination, a linear multi-objective weight sweep, an adaptive Lagrangian constraint, and a non-compensatory utility optimized per episode under the Expected Scalarized Returns (ESR) criterion. All are evaluated under a single detector-based protocol that counts every violation in every episode without censoring. On the frontier of mean return against mean violation rate, the four methods are indistinguishable; per episode they separate sharply. At matched mean return, the ESR agent holds its stated budget of one violation in effectively every episode (worst-decile 1.04 +/- 0.07 violations), the Lagrangian leaks past the same budget (1.14 +/- 0.03), and the weight sweep's worst episodes double it (2.20 +/- 0.20). An observation-augmentation control attributes the separation to the training objective rather than to what the agent observes, and the per-episode guarantee costs nothing on the mean frontier. When ethical violations do not average away across episodes, we argue both training and evaluation must target the per-episode distribution rather than the mean.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了四种在Craftax基准中训练智能体伦理行为的方法（标量惩罚+终止、线性多目标权重扫描、自适应拉格朗日约束、基于ESR准则的每回合非补偿效用），发现它们在均值和平均违规率边界的表现不可区分，但在每回合级别表现差异显著。ESR方法能在几乎每一回合维持其声明的违规预算，而其他方法在恶劣回合中会超出预算。
AI.motivation: 强化学习智能体在单一奖励信号下会利用设计奖励与预期行为之间的差距，这尤其体现在伦理行为的灌输上。智能体可能表面上在平均意义上显得合乎伦理，但其违规行为集中在少数恶劣回合中——环境中一个生物在一次回合中受到的伤害不会被其他回合的良好行为所补偿。因此需要研究如何确保每回合而非仅平均意义上的伦理行为。
AI.method: 在Craftax开放生存基准中比较四种训练方法：(1) 带终止的标量惩罚；(2) 线性多目标权重扫描；(3) 自适应拉格朗日约束；(4) 基于期望标量化回报（ESR）准则的每回合非补偿效用优化。所有方法在统一的基于检测器的协议下评估，计算每一回合的每一次违规而不进行删减。此外通过观测增强对照实验来分离训练目标与观测内容的影响。
AI.result: 在均值回报对平均违规模率的边界上前四种方法不可区分，但每回合表现差异显著。在匹配均值回报时，ESR智能体几乎在每一回合都维持声明的每次一回合一违规预算（最差十分位1.04±0.07），拉格朗日方法超出该预算（1.14±0.03），权重扫描的最差回合则翻倍（2.20±0.20）。观测增强对照表明这种差异来自训练目标而非观测内容，且每回合保证在均值边界上无代价。
AI.conclusion: 当伦理违规无法在回合间平均抵消时，训练和评估都必须针对每回合的分布而非均值。该工作强调了伦理强化学习中每回合级别的约束保证的重要性。

title: Euclid-Omni : A Unified Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Plane Geometry
summary: Euclidean geometry is a compelling testbed for AI reasoning, as it demands the combination of intuitive diagram understanding, axiomatic deduction, and algebraic computation. Yet, existing approaches typically address only a subset of these abilities or struggle with competition-level problems. We introduce \textit{Euclid-Omni}, a unified neuro-symbolic framework that couples a formal geometry system with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to tackle both calculation- and proving-style problems, in formal and natural languages, up to Olympiad-level difficulty. At its core, we develop \textit{Euclidea}, a versatile symbolic geometry solver that automatically generates reasoning steps through deductive inference and algebraic computation. Building on this, we develop a data-generation pipeline that synthesizes symbolic problems and solutions, renders diagrams, and translates them into natural language, producing large-scale, diverse datasets for training LLMs and VLMs across a wide range of reasoning settings. Experiments show that VLMs trained on our synthetic data achieve superior performance on calculation tasks, and that LLMs combined with \textit{Euclidea} are competitive with state-of-the-art systems on Olympiad-level proving problems, despite using orders of magnitude less compute and training data. Code and scripts are publicly available at https://github.com/20171130/Euclid-Omni

AI.tldr: 本文提出Euclid-Omni，一个统一的神经符号框架，结合形式几何系统（Euclidea符号求解器）与LLM/VLM，解决从计算到证明（含自然语言和形式语言）的竞赛级欧几里得几何问题。通过数据生成管线合成大规模训练数据，实验证明VLM在计算任务上表现出色，LLM结合Euclidea在奥林匹克级证明问题上达到最先进水平，且计算量和训练数据少几个数量级。
AI.motivation: 欧几里得几何是AI推理的理想测试平台，涉及直觉图示理解、公理演绎和代数计算三者的结合。然而现有方法通常只覆盖其中部分能力，或在竞赛级问题上表现不佳，缺乏一个统一的框架来同时处理计算型和证明型问题。
AI.method: 1) 开发Euclidea，一个多功能的符号几何求解器，通过演绎推理和代数计算自动生成推理步骤；2) 构建数据生成管线，自动合成符号问题与解答、渲染图形并翻译为自然语言，生成大规模多样化数据集；3) 利用合成数据训练LLM和VLM，覆盖多种推理场景。
AI.result: 在合成数据上训练的VLM在计算任务上取得优异性能；LLM结合Euclidea在奥林匹克级证明问题上与最先进系统相当，但使用的计算量和训练数据少了几个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Euclid-Omni证明了神经符号框架能够有效统一几何推理中的多种能力（计算、证明、形式/自然语言），且通过符号求解器驱动的高质量数据生成，可以以极低的资源成本达到竞赛级水平，为AI几何推理提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Mind the Gap: An Empirical Study of Synchronization Gaps, Delays, and Missed Opportunities in Software Forks
summary:
Fork-based development enables parallel evolution of software, but unsynchronized contributions create persistent divergence: security patches, bug fixes, and quality improvements often fail to propagate across fork families, leaving downstream users exposed to known vulnerabilities or bugs and missing massive opportunities to improve the other repositories in the family. We present the first large-scale empirical study of fork synchronization, analyzing popular GitHub fork families with 3,820 actively maintained forks, and developed a monitoring platform to mine the valuable commits and promote their swift merging.
  Our findings reveal a synchronization paradox: while 90% of submitted pull requests are merged, only 6.92% of fork commits ever appear in PRs, leaving massive fork development permanently unsynchronized across the families. Synchronization delay is pervasive and structurally uneven where fork propagation accounts for 72.9% of end-to-end commit lifecycle delay. Contrary to common assumptions, PR rejection is rarely caused by technical incorrectness; instead, 65% of rejections stem from superseded contributions, process violations, or maintainer policy decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对GitHub fork同步进行大规模实证研究，分析了3,820个活跃维护的fork家族，发现虽然90%的PR会被合并，但仅6.92%的fork提交最终进入PR，造成大量fork开发永久性不同步。研究还发现同步延迟普遍存在且结构性不均衡，72.9%的端到端提交生命周期延迟来自fork传播，且PR被拒主要（65%）源于提交被取代、流程违规或维护者政策决定，而非技术错误。
AI.motivation: Fork-based开发使软件并行演进成为可能，但不同步的贡献会导致安全补丁、bug修复和质量改进无法在fork家族间传播，使下游用户暴露于已知漏洞，并错失改进其他仓库的机会。此前缺乏对fork同步的大规模实证理解。
AI.method: 对GitHub上3,820个活跃维护的fork家族进行大规模实证分析，并开发了一个监控平台来挖掘有价值的提交并促进其快速合并。
AI.result: 发现90%的已提交PR会被合并，但仅6.92%的fork提交会出现在PR中，形成同步悖论。fork传播占端到端提交生命周期延迟的72.9%。65%的PR拒绝源于提交被取代、流程违规或维护者政策决策，而非技术不正确。
AI.conclusion: fork同步存在严重的结构性低效问题，大量有价值的fork开发成果永远无法传播回主分支，需要改进提交挖掘和合并促进机制以提升fork生态的同步效率。

title: Anchoring for Truthfulness: The Random-Anchor Volume Mechanism for Multi-Facility Location
summary:
We study the strategyproof placement of \(k\) facilities on the real line for \(n\) agents who privately report their locations, without monetary transfers. For two facilities, the Proportional Mechanism of Lu, Sun, Wang, and Zhu (2010) is strategyproof in expectation and achieves a constant-factor approximation to the optimal social cost. Whether such a guarantee is possible for three facilities in the standard model, where each agent is served by her nearest open facility, has remained open.
  We resolve this question affirmatively by introducing the \emph{Random-Anchor Volume} mechanism. The mechanism first opens a facility at the report of a uniformly random agent, called the \emph{anchor}, and then jointly selects two additional reports, assigning each pair probability proportional to the product of the two consecutive gaps formed by the pair and the anchor. We prove that the mechanism is strategyproof in expectation and has expected social cost at most \(8 OPT_3\), where \(OPT_k\) denotes the minimum social cost achievable using at most \(k\) facilities.
  The mechanism naturally extends to every \(k\geq 2\) by selecting \(k-1\) additional reports with probability proportional to the product of the consecutive gaps among them and the anchor. Under truthful reporting, this generalization has expected social cost at most \(4(k-1)OPT_k\). Its incentive guarantee, however, has a sharp boundary: the mechanism is strategyproof in expectation for \(k\in\{1,2,3\}\), but is manipulable for every \(k\geq 4\).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Random-Anchor Volume机制，解决了在线上无货币转移设施放置问题中，三设施是否能在策略证明（期望意义上）的同时实现常数近似比的开放问题。该机制通过随机选择一个锚定代理，并以与锚点间的连续间隙乘积成比例的概率选择额外报告位置，证明期望社会成本至多为8×OPT₃。机制可推广到任意k≥2设施，但激励保证存在清晰边界：k∈{1,2,3}时是期望策略证明的，k≥4时可被操纵。
AI.motivation: 在线上的k设施位置选择问题中，Lu等人（2010）提出的比例机制对两设施实现了期望策略证明和常数近似比，但三设施在标准模型（每个代理由最近设施服务）下是否能同时保证这两个性质一直是开放问题。作者希望填补这一空白，并探索该机制对任意k设施的适用性和理论边界。
AI.method: 提出Random-Anchor Volume机制：(1) 随机均匀选择一个代理作为"锚点"，在其报告位置开设第一个设施；(2) 对于两个额外设施，以与形成锚点间的两个连续间隙乘积成比例的概率联合选择两个报告位置；(3) 推广到k≥2时，选择k-1个额外报告，概率与它们及锚点间的连续间隙乘积成比例。通过严格的期望社会成本分析和策略证明性证明来验证机制性质。
AI.result: 三设施情况下，机制是期望策略证明的，且期望社会成本至多为8×OPT₃，肯定地回答了此前开放的问题。在一般k下，真实报告时期望社会成本至多为4(k-1)×OPT_k；但激励性质存在尖锐边界：k∈{1,2,3}时是期望策略证明的，而k≥4时机制可被操纵。
AI.conclusion: Random-Anchor Volume机制通过引入随机锚点和基于间隙乘积的选择概率，成功为三设施问题构建了期望策略证明且具有常数近似比的机制，同时明确了该设计思路在一般k下的理论极限——仅适用于k≤3的激励保证，为后续研究指明了需要新思路的方向。

title: Static Pruning Across Sparse Retrieval Regimes: What Transfers, What Breaks, and What Still Helps
summary: Static pruning is widely used to accelerate sparse neural retrieval, yet existing studies each validate their conclusions within a single custom pipeline, leaving it unclear which findings transfer to modern engines with different index organizations and dynamic pruning mechanisms. We present the first cross-engine pruning portability study, evaluating static pruning strategies across three engines - a controlled C++ pipeline (exhaustive inverted index), BMP (block-max pruning), and SEISMIC (clustered inverted indexes) - on two benchmarks (MS MARCO, Natural Questions) with two encoders spanning opposite query-density regimes (SPLADE: 44 avg. query terms; V3-GTE: 7 avg. query terms), totaling 1,140 experimental configurations, with an additional deep-judgment validation on TREC DL 2019/2020. We find that index-side pruning (document and posting-list) is portable: it consistently reduces latency (1.2-6.6$\times$) and index size (18-82%) across all engines because sparse retrieval is memory-bound - a conclusion we support with cache-miss, TLB, and IPC profiling. In contrast, query pruning is already internalized by modern engines: it yields 4-11$\times$ speedup on the exhaustive pipeline but is subsumed by BMP's $β$ and SEISMIC's query_cut. Static pruning complements dynamic pruning: on BMP, combining document and query reduction yields 2.5$\times$ speedup with NDCG@10 within 0.003 of the exact baseline. Finally, NDCG@10 saturates while Recall@10 is still in the ${\sim}$85-95% range across all three engines, providing a portable stopping criterion: practitioners can push pruning to this knee without visible ranking degradation. Together, these findings answer what transfers (index-side pruning), what breaks (query pruning), and what still helps (static atop dynamic pruning).

AI.tldr: 本文首次对静态剪枝策略进行跨引擎可移植性研究，在三个不同索引组织的检索引擎（穷举索引、BMP块级剪枝、SEISMIC聚类索引）上评估了静态剪枝策略，发现索引侧剪枝（文档与 posting-list 剪枝）在所有引擎中均有效（延迟降低1.2-6.6倍、索引体积减少18-82%），而查询侧剪枝已被现代引擎内化，静态剪枝可作为动态剪枝的补充。
AI.motivation: 现有静态剪枝研究各自在单一自定义管道中验证结论，缺乏跨引擎的可移植性验证，导致哪些发现能迁移到具有不同索引组织和动态剪枝机制的现代引擎中尚不明确。
AI.method: 在三个引擎（C++穷举倒排索引、BMP块级最大剪枝、SEISMIC聚类倒排索引）上，使用MS MARCO和Natural Questions两个基准，结合SPLADE（平均44个查询词）和V3-GTE（平均7个查询词）两种编码器，共进行1,140种实验配置，并在TREC DL 2019/2020上进行深度判断验证。通过cache-miss、TLB和IPC性能剖析来支持内存受限的结论。
AI.result: 索引侧剪枝（文档和posting-list）在所有引擎中均可移植且持续有效（延迟1.2-6.6×、体积18-82%），因为稀疏检索是内存受限的。查询侧剪枝在穷举管道上可带来4-11×加速，但已被BMP的β和SEISMIC的query_cut机制内化。静态剪枝与动态剪枝互补：在BMP上结合文档和查询剪枝可获得2.5×加速且NDCG@10仅损失0.003。NDCG@10饱和时Recall@10仍在85-95%区间，可提供可移植的停止准则。
AI.conclusion: 回答了哪些发现可迁移（索引侧剪枝）、哪些会失效（查询侧剪枝）、哪些仍具价值（动态剪枝之上的静态剪枝）。为实践者提供了可移植的性能准则和停止准则。

title: Beyond the pale: Assessing prevalence and contents of extremist speech in LLM training data
comment: Accepted to the CPSS workshop @ KONVENS 2026
summary: Despite a strong interest on the part of the research community in the topic of trustworthy and safe AI, the composition of the text corpora that large language models (LLMs) encounter in pre- and post-training has not yet drawn much attention. In this work, we address the question of whether LLMs are exposed to unfiltered, uncontextualised extremist speech. Using several definitions of extremist speech, stemming from official documents and research literature, and an extraction pipeline combining automated text processing with expert verification, we provide a lower bound on the prevalence of extremist documents in Dolma, an open training corpus underpinning the OLMo series of models. We show that Dolma is likely to include hundreds of thousands of documents containing extremist content and hate speech of several types, including direct calls for violence, and discuss the implications of this for data curation and model pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性调查了大型语言模型（LLM）预训练语料库Dolma中极端主义言论的存在情况，通过结合自动化文本处理与专家验证的提取流程，估算出Dolma中包含数十万份极端主义内容文档，包括直接暴力呼吁，并讨论了这一发现对数据筛选和模型预训练的启示。
AI.motivation: 研究社区对可信赖和安全的AI兴趣浓厚，但LLM在预训练和后训练阶段接触的文本语料库的构成尚未引起足够关注。作者旨在回答一个关键问题：LLM是否暴露于未经过滤、未情境化的极端主义言论中。
AI.method: 采用多种来自官方文件和研究文献的极端主义言论定义，构建了一个结合自动化文本处理与专家验证的提取流水线，对Dolma开放训练语料库（OLMo系列模型的基础语料）进行系统性扫描，估算其中极端主义文档的流行度下限。
AI.result: Dolma语料库很可能包含数十万份含极端主义内容和多种仇恨言论的文档，包括直接的暴力呼吁。
AI.conclusion: 指出了当前LLM预训练语料中存在的极端主义内容问题，强调这对数据筛选和模型预训练实践具有重要影响，需要引起研究社区对语料库构成的更多关注。

title: Low Cost Two-Stage Fabric Defect Detection at the Edge
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures, 8 tables. Deployment study on NVIDIA Jetson Nano with TensorRT FP16. Includes a decomposition showing the measured 1.36x end-to-end speedup is dominated by data-path overlap rather than by the cascade. Dataset available on Roboflow Universe
summary: Fabric inspection in the garment industries of low-income economies remains largely manual, and commercial vision systems are priced beyond most small and medium mills. Because defects are sparse under controlled production, a natural response is a cascade: screen every frame with a cheap anomaly detector and invoke a full detector only on suspicious frames. We build such a cascade for four knit-fabric defect classes and deploy it end-to-end on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano with TensorRT FP16. Stage 1 is a compact convolutional autoencoder with decoder attention gates, an edge-weighted reconstruction loss, and feature-level distillation from a frozen YOLOv5n teacher; Stage 2 is YOLOv5n, invoked only on flagged frames. On a 249-image benchmark disjoint from detector training (20 defective, 229 non-defective), Stage 1 at a recall-prioritised threshold flags all 20 defective images (95% CI 0.83-1.00) at a false-positive rate of 49.3% (113/229), reducing false positives by 19.3% relative to a plain autoencoder (p=0.011). The parallel pipeline reaches 13.45 FPS against 9.86 FPS for a sequential YOLO-only loop. Our central finding comes from decomposing that 1.36x: 91% of it is attributable to overlapping JPEG decode with inference rather than to the cascade, which contributes only a 5.1% inference reduction at the measured forwarding rate p = 0.534. We further show that forwarding here is false-positive-limited rather than prevalence-limited - 85% of forwarded frames are false alarms - and quantify the 29-45% inference reduction attainable under tighter calibration. We report this as a caution for cascade speedups measured without controlling the data path, and position the system as AI-assisted triage rather than autonomous acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低收入经济体服装厂中面料缺陷检测成本高的问题，构建了一个两阶段级联检测系统：Stage 1用轻量卷积自编码器（带注意力门、边缘加权重建损失和YOLOv5n教师蒸馏）筛选可疑帧，Stage 2仅对可疑帧调用YOLOv5n。在Jetson Nano上部署后发现，整体1.36倍加速中91%来自JPEG解码与推理的重叠，而非级联本身（仅贡献5.1%推理减少）。转发帧中85%是误报而非真缺陷，说明系统是误报受限而非缺陷稀缺受限。作者将此作为对未控制数据路径时测量级联加速的警示，并将系统定位为AI辅助分诊而非自主验收。
AI.motivation: 低收入经济体的服装厂中面料检测仍以人工为主，商用视觉系统价格超出中小型工厂承受能力。由于受控生产下缺陷稀疏，自然想到用级联方案：用廉价异常检测器筛选每一帧，仅对可疑帧调用全量检测器，以降低计算成本。作者希望验证这种级联在实际端到端部署中的真实加速效果。
AI.method: 构建一个面向四种针织面料缺陷类别的两阶段级联系统：Stage 1是紧凑卷积自编码器，包含解码器注意力门、边缘加权重建损失，并从冻结的YOLOv5n教师网络进行特征级蒸馏；Stage 2是YOLOv5n，仅在Stage 1标记为可疑的帧上调用。整个管线在NVIDIA Jetson Nano上用TensorRT FP16端到端部署。在249张图像基准上（20张缺陷、229张无缺陷）评估，并通过分解加速来源来分析级联的真实贡献。
AI.result: Stage 1在召回优先阈值下能捕获全部20张缺陷图像（95% CI 0.83-1.00），误报率49.3%（113/229），相比普通自编码器误报降低19.3%（p=0.011）。平行管线达到13.45 FPS，高于顺序YOLO-only的9.86 FPS。但分解1.36倍加速后发现：91%来自JPEG解码与推理重叠，级联本身仅贡献5.1%的推理减少（p=0.534，不显著）。转发帧中85%是误报，在更严格校准下可达到29-45%的推理减少。
AI.conclusion: 级联检测的加速收益在端到端部署中可能被数据路径（如JPEG解码）主导，而非级联逻辑本身。当前系统是误报受限而非缺陷稀缺受限，其效用在更严格校准下才能体现。作者将此作为对未控制数据路径时测得的级联加速的警示，并将系统定位为"AI辅助分诊"而非自主验收工具。

title: DUET: Dual-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Same-Weight Disagreement for Prohibition Compliance
summary: Real-world LLM deployments increasingly rely on runtime-injected prohibitions--enterprise policies, PII redlines, tool boundaries--that vary per request and per tenant. Conventional post-training is structurally ill-suited: SFT hides the violation signal in compliant labels, and DPO's sequence-level preferences mismatch token-localized violations. We propose DUET, a token-selective on-policy distillation method for prohibition compliance. DUET pairs a teacher that sees the prohibition (positive) with an identical-weight teacher that does not (negative). Because the two teachers differ only in prohibition visibility, their per-token disagreement isolates the prohibition's causal effect--yielding a clean supervision signal uncontaminated by model capacity or mismatch. This disagreement drives two complementary mechanisms: signal cleaning, which discards agreement tokens as redundant or prefix-corrupted, and preference-directed learning, which pushes the student away from the negative teacher and toward the positive one at token granularity, embedding DPO-style optimization directly into OPD without offline preference data. We construct an industrial Prohibition-Compliance benchmark spanning five task families covering explicit-refusal, paraphrase robustness, and over-refusal. Across 1.5B-8B Qwen variants, DUET achieves 72.3-85.2% violation compliance while preserving 88-93% normal utility, dramatically outperforming teacher model and other distillation baselines. External evaluation on SysBench confirms improved safety alignment with minimal degradation on GSM8K and MATH-500.

AI.tldr: DUET是一种面向LLM禁令合规的token选择性在线策略蒸馏方法，通过配对两个仅禁言可见性不同的教师模型，利用其token级分歧作为监督信号，实现信号清洗和偏好导向学习，在1.5B-8B模型上达到72.3-85.2%的合规率同时保持88-93%的常规能力。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中LLM部署依赖运行时注入的禁令（企业策略、PII红线、工具边界），这些禁令因请求和租户而异。传统后训练方法结构上不适合此任务：SFT将违规信号隐藏在合规标签中，DPO的序列级偏好与token局部化违规不匹配，因此需要新的方法。
AI.method: DUET的核心是token选择性在线策略蒸馏：1) 配对两个权重相同但只有禁令可见性不同的教师（正/负），其token级分歧隔离了禁令的因果效应；2) 信号清洗机制丢弃冗余或前缀污染的同意token；3) 偏好导向学习在token粒度推动学生远离负教师、靠近正教师，将DPO风格优化直接嵌入在线策略蒸馏，无需离线偏好数据。
AI.result: 在涵盖五类任务（显式拒绝、释义鲁棒性、过度拒绝等）的工业禁令合规基准上，1.5B-8B Qwen系列模型达到72.3-85.2%的违规合规率和88-93%的常规功能保持；在SysBench外部评估中改善了安全对齐，且GSM8K和MATH-500上退化极小。
AI.conclusion: DUET通过配对教师分歧实现token级别的禁令合规学习，有效解决了运行时禁令注入场景下传统后训练方法的不足，在合规性和实用性之间取得了良好平衡，为动态策略合规提供了一种高效且可扩展的蒸馏方案。

title: An Agentic Framework Using Rules and LLMs for Embedding and Annotating Descriptive Document Layouts: A Plant Science Use Case
summary: Background: Recent advances in information retrieval (IR) leverage both dense and sparse representations, large language models (LLMs), and specialized retrieval models to improve ranking accuracy, relevance, and cross-lingual performance. Complementary techniques such as passage indexing, document layout analysis, and semantic knowledge representation further enhance retrieval effectiveness by capturing fine-grained contextual and structural information. Emerging agentic LLM frameworks extend these capabilities by enabling planning, iterative reasoning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration, thereby broadening applications across diverse domains. These frameworks also emphasize rigorous evaluation, ethical considerations, and trustworthiness, ensuring responsible deployment in real-world settings. We propose a modular, agent-based pipeline for botanical trait extraction. Optical character recognition (OCR) converts PDFs into machine-readable text, while segmentation and indexing organize content by genus and species. Rule-based parsers extract structured botanical traits, and ensembles of large language models (LLMs) expand trait vocabularies and resolve ambiguities. This approach ensures accurate species recognition, scalable annotation, and explainable integration of textual botanical descriptions, enabling robust and interpretable data extraction across large botanical corpora. Results: Using three regional botanical datasets, our system extracted 55,737 trait annotations across 4,961 species, averaging 9.1 traits per species. Integration of LLM-based enrichment improved coverage for 75% of traits, increasing total annotations by 59%. While the choice of OCR engine had a minor effect on species recognition, overall annotation counts remained stable, demonstrating the robustness, scalability, and reliability of the pipeline for large-scale botanical trait extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个模块化的基于智能体（agent）的流水线，用于从植物学文献中提取性状数据。系统结合OCR、分段索引、规则解析器和多LLM集成，从三个区域植物学数据集中成功提取了55,737条性状注解（覆盖4,961个物种），LLM增强使75%的性状覆盖率提升、总注解量增加59%，并验证了流水线在不同OCR引擎下的鲁棒性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 传统信息检索和文本提取方法难以高效、准确地从大规模植物学语料中提取结构化的性状数据。需要一种结合模块化架构、语义解析和LLM能力的方法，以实现大规模、可解释且鲁棒的植物性状自动化提取。
AI.method: 构建模块化智能体流水线：(1) OCR将PDF转换为机器可读文本；(2) 分段和索引按属种组织内容；(3) 基于规则的解析器提取结构化植物性状；(4) 多种LLM集成用于扩展性状词汇并解决歧义，确保物种识别准确、标注可扩展且文本解释可融合。
AI.result: 在三个区域植物学数据集上提取了55,737条性状注解、覆盖4,961个物种（平均每物种9.1个性状）。LLM集成增强使75%的性状覆盖率提高，总注解数增加59%。OCR引擎选择对物种识别影响较小，总体注解数量保持稳定，展示了流水线的鲁棒性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该模块化智能体流水线在大规模植物性状提取任务中展现出高鲁棒性、可扩展性和可靠性，为跨大规模植物学语料库的自动化、可解释数据提取提供了有效方案。

title: SMTpip: Interpreter-Aware SMT-Based Dependency Conflict Resolution for Restoring Python Source-Code Executability
summary: Software developers rely on packages to reuse existing functionality instead of implementing everything from scratch. Python developers commonly provide package and interpreter dependencies using configuration files, such as requirements.txt or setup.py. Package managers in Python, such as pip, can install packages according to dependency and interpreter version constraints specified in configuration files. However, Python dependency resolution remains challenging: (1) different packages may require incompatible versions of the same dependency; (2) dependencies may require a Python interpreter version that is incompatible with the interpreter used for the project, making a valid environment impossible; and (3) pip, the most popular Python package manager, resolves conflicts via backtracking, repeatedly trying candidate versions without knowing whether a valid execution environment exists or not. To address these challenges, we present SMTpip, an interpreter-aware environment inference technique for improving the executability of Python source-code artifacts. SMTpip constructs a dependency knowledge graph using metadata stored in the Python Package Index (PyPI) that hosts millions of package releases, encodes both package version constraints and interpreter compatibility constraints specified in configuration files into Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) formulas. Solving these formulas identifies a set of package versions and an interpreter version that jointly satisfy all declared constraints. Empirical evaluation on multiple datasets from open-source Python projects shows that SMTpip achieves substantial speedups -- $6.9\times$ over pip, $9.6\times$ over Conda, $3.2\times$ over smartPip, and $4\times$ over PyEGo -- while consistently producing constraint-consistent environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMTpip，一种基于可满足性模理论（SMT）的解释器感知环境推断技术，通过构建PyPI依赖知识图谱并将包版本约束与解释器兼容性约束编码为SMT公式，为Python项目快速求解出有效且一致的执行环境，相比pip、Conda、smartPip和PyEGo分别获得6.9×、9.6×、3.2×和4×的速度提升。
AI.motivation: Python依赖解析面临三大挑战：(1)不同包可能要求同一依赖的不兼容版本；(2)依赖所需的Python解释器版本与项目不匹配，导致无法构建有效环境；(3)主流包管理器pip通过回溯方式反复尝试候选版本，效率低下且无法预先判断是否存在有效环境。
AI.method: SMTpip首先利用PyPI上数百万包发布的元数据构建依赖知识图谱，然后将配置文件（如requirements.txt或setup.py）中的包版本约束和解释器兼容性约束编码为SMT公式，最后通过求解这些公式来同时确定满足所有声明的包版本集合与解释器版本。
AI.result: 在多个开源Python项目数据集上的实证评估表明，SMTpip相比pip加速6.9倍、相比Conda加速9.6倍、相比smartPip加速3.2倍、相比PyEGo加速4倍，同时始终生成约束一致的环境。
AI.conclusion: SMTpip通过将依赖解析问题转化为SMT求解问题，既保证了解析结果满足所有声明约束，又大幅提升了解析效率，为Python依赖管理提供了一种高效且可靠的解决方案。

title: Tight Inapproximability of Pacing and Throttling Equilibria in Second-Price Auctions
summary: Budget-constrained advertisers commonly rely on two control mechanisms: pacing scales bids, whereas throttling randomizes participation. We prove that, in second-price auctions, these two different mechanisms share the same sharp approximation-hardness threshold. For pacing, computing a $γ$-approximate equilibrium is $\mathsf{PPAD}$-hard for every constant $γ\in[0,1)$. For throttling, computing a $δ$-approximate equilibrium is $\mathsf{PPAD}$-hard for every constant $δ\in(0,1)$. At parameter $1$, the complementarity requirement becomes vacuous and the all-zero solution is feasible. That is, approximation does not eliminate the fixed-point barrier at any nontrivial parameter value.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了预算受限广告商在二价拍卖中常用的两种控制机制——pacing（缩放出价）和throttling（随机参与）——并证明两者在近似均衡计算上具有相同的尖锐近似困难阈值：对于任意常数参数，计算近似均衡都是PPAD-hard的，近似并不能消除不动点障碍。
AI.motivation: 预算受限广告商在在线广告拍卖中需要控制支出，pacing和throttling是两种核心机制。虽然实际中广泛使用，但它们的近似均衡计算复杂度尚不明确。研究者希望揭示这两种看似不同机制之间在计算复杂性上的根本联系。
AI.method: 通过理论归约分析，分别证明：(1) 对于pacing机制，计算γ-近似均衡在任意常数γ∈[0,1)下是PPAD-hard；(2) 对于throttling机制，计算δ-近似均衡在任意常数δ∈(0,1)下是PPAD-hard。两者在参数1处互补性要求变得空洞，全零解可行。
AI.result: 证明pacing和throttling两种机制在二价拍卖中具有相同的尖锐近似困难阈值——任意非平凡参数值下近似均衡计算均为PPAD-hard，且参数1处问题退化为平凡情况。
AI.conclusion: 近似计算并不能消除均衡计算中的不动点障碍，即使在任意非平凡近似精度下，两种预算控制机制的均衡求解仍然是计算上困难的。这从理论上说明了为什么实际中需要启发式或近似算法。

title: POI Recommendation with LLM-Augmented Multi-Graph Learning and Contrastive Alignment
summary: Point-of-interest (POI) recommendation models based on graph neural networks achieve strong performance by propagating collaborative signals over user-item interactions, yet they struggle with the cold-start problem, where items with few or no interactions are not represented. In this paper, we propose LLM-augmented Multi-Graph Contrastive Learning (LLM-MGCL), a multi-graph neural network that uses semantic and spatial information about items to extend the LightGCN backbone with two auxiliary item-item graphs: a semantic graph constructed from sentence embeddings of LLM-generated photo summaries and keywords, and a geographic graph derived from Haversine distances between business locations. Item embeddings are propagated over all three graphs in parallel, fused additively, and aligned across views through a bidirectional InfoNCE contrastive objective that connects behavioral, semantic, and spatial representations of the same items. Experiments on the Yelp Multimodal Recommendation Dataset show that LLM-MGCL outperforms classical collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, and interaction-only graph neural network baselines. It improves Recall@20 by 52.0% and NDCG@20 by 64.8% over LightGCN while performing on par with the strongest contrastive baseline, Self-supervised Graph Learning (SGL), which is also affected by the cold-start problem. An ablation study reveals that the cross-view contrastive alignment (CA) is the primary driver of these gains, with the best performance achieved when all three graphs are combined. Our results suggest that externally grounded, LLM-derived item knowledge can effectively compensate for missing collaborative signal and mitigate the item cold-start problem in POI recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-MGCL，一种利用LLM生成的语义信息和地理位置信息构建辅助物品-物品图，结合多图对比学习来缓解POI推荐中冷启动问题的图神经网络方法。
AI.motivation: 基于图神经网络的POI推荐模型在传播协作信号上表现优异，但面临冷启动问题——交互稀少或缺失的物品无法被有效表示。现有方法缺乏利用外部知识来弥补缺失协作信号的手段。
AI.method: 在LightGCN骨干基础上扩展两个辅助物品-物品图：(1) 语义图——由LLM生成的照片摘要和关键词的句子嵌入构建；(2) 地理图——基于商业位置间的Haversine距离构建。物品嵌入在三个图上并行传播、加性融合，并通过双向InfoNCE对比目标对齐行为、语义和空间表征。
AI.result: 在Yelp多模态推荐数据集上，LLM-MGCL相较于LightGCN在Recall@20提升52.0%，NDCG@20提升64.8%，与最强的对比基线SGL性能相当。消融实验表明跨视图对比对齐（CA）是增益的主要来源，三个图组合时性能最佳。
AI.conclusion: 外部基于LLM的物品知识可以有效弥补缺失的协作信号，缓解POI推荐中的物品冷启动问题。

title: Writing Style Similarity Reflects Academic Genealogy
summary: As authorship attribution systems are increasingly deployed to detect ghostwritten and AI-generated papers, their errors can support accusations against legitimate authors. These systems assume each author's style is their own. Researchers, however, study under advisors, and inherit their stylistic quirks. We build a corpus of arXiv authors with $\geq 2$ solo papers from the Mathematics Genealogy Project graph, giving $5{,}803$ total authors and $2{,}501$ ground-truth advisor-student pairings. Using embeddings from a fine-tuned model, advisors sit $39.9\%$ closer in cosine distance to their students than a random same-field author does. Two open encoders reproduce the effect at $12.6\%$ and $14.5\%$. \emph{Academic siblings}, two students of one advisor who may never have met, sit $30.4\%$ closer across $8{,}360$ pairs, even when they studied at different institutions. Pairs who share only an institution and a field show negligible similarity. Given a closed-set attribution task over the same corpus, the system's errors occur on the true author's advisors and academic siblings $11$ times more often than chance.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了作者归属系统的一个系统性缺陷：研究者的写作风格会继承其导师及学术同门的风格特征，导致归属系统难以区分真正的作者与其导师或学术同门，错误率比随机水平高出11倍。
AI.motivation: 作者归属系统被用于检测代笔和AI生成论文，其错误可能错误指控合法作者。这些系统假设每位作者的风格是独立的，但实际上研究者在导师指导下学习，会继承导师的风格特征。这种风格传承可能导致归属系统的系统性误判。
AI.method: 从数学谱系项目图中构建arXiv作者语料库，筛选出至少2篇独著论文的作者，共5,803位作者和2,501对导师-学生配对。使用微调模型提取嵌入，比较导师与学生之间、学术同门之间、以及仅共享机构与领域的配对之间的余弦距离，并在封闭集归属任务中分析系统错误模式。
AI.result: 导师与学生之间余弦距离比随机同领域作者近39.9%；两个开源编码器也分别重现了12.6%和14.5%的效果。学术同门在8,360对配对中距离近30.4%，即使在不同机构学习也如此。仅共享机构和领域的配对相似性可忽略。在封闭集归属任务中，错误出现在真正作者的导师和学术同门上的频率是随机水平的11倍。
AI.conclusion: 作者归属系统存在系统性偏差：导师和学生以及学术同门之间的风格相似性远高于随机同领域作者。这提示基于风格的归属系统可能无法可靠地区分具有学术传承关系的作者，部署此类系统时需要警惕其误判风险。

title: Do CNNs Internally Represent Real and Fake Images Differently? A Hidden-Layer Analysis
summary: Fake/synthetic images are increasingly prevalent, but it remains unclear whether Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) process real and fake images in the same internal manner. This work examines the hypothesis that CNNs represent real and fake images differently, such that fake images induce different hidden-layer activation patterns even when semantic content is preserved. The hypothesis is evaluated in scene recognition settings using trained CNN models. Dense-layer activations are extracted, and neurosymbolic methods assign semantic labels to selected neurons. For each real test image, corresponding fake images are generated with similar semantic content using object-label-guided text-to-image and image-to-image generation based on Stable Diffusion variants. Paired real-fake activation patterns are then compared statistically. Additional experiments with another dataset, CNN architecture, generative model, and JPEG/blur degradation analysis assess robustness. Results suggest that fake images evoke different hidden-neuron activations, and these differences are not explained only by simple image degradation. Overall, the findings indicate that real and fake images differ in CNN hidden-layer activation behavior at least in some settings, which opens the door for follow-up work on making use of this different behavior to improve fake image detection.

AI.tldr: 该研究探究了CNN是否以不同方式内部处理真实图像与伪造图像。通过场景识别任务中提取密集层激活，结合神经符号方法为神经元赋予语义标签，并使用Stable Diffusion生成语义匹配的伪造图像进行配对比较，发现伪造图像会引发不同的隐藏层神经元激活模式，且这种差异不能仅用简单图像退化来解释。
AI.motivation: 随着AI生成图像的日益普及，需要对CNN如何处理真实与伪造图像有更深入的理解。此前未知CNN是否在内部机制上以相同方式处理两类图像，这一问题的答案对伪造图像检测具有重要意义。
AI.method: 使用预训练CNN模型在场景识别设置下提取密集层激活；采用神经符号方法为选定神经元分配语义标签；通过目标标签引导的文本到图像及图像到图像生成（基于Stable Diffusion变体）为每张真实测试图像生成语义内容相似的伪造图像；对配对真实-伪造激活模式进行统计分析；另用不同数据集、CNN架构、生成模型及JPEG/模糊退化分析来评估鲁棒性。
AI.result: 结果表明伪造图像能引发不同的隐藏神经元激活，且这些差异不能仅由简单的图像退化解释。该发现至少在部分设置下成立。
AI.conclusion: 真实与伪造图像在CNN隐藏层激活行为上存在差异，这为未来利用这种差异行为改进伪造图像检测开辟了道路。

title: Efficient Neural-Network-Based High-Resolution Radiative Transfer for CO___ Retrieval, and Application to Interferometric Sensing
summary: Studying climate change requires reducing uncertainties in CO2 and CH4 emission estimates to better distinguish anthropogenic from natural sources, which motivates spaceborne measurements with improved revisit frequency and spatial coverage. In this context, the Horizon Europe SCARBOn project assesses a low-cost satellite constellation featuring the NanoCarb imaging interferometer as its core sensor for monitoring CO2 and CH4 emissions in the atmosphere. However, estimating CO2 and CH4 concentrations with high revisit and spatial coverage poses significant challenges: full-physics retrieval algorithms commonly used rely on repeated high-resolution radiative transfer (RT) simulations, which are computationally expensive when using line-by-line RT models. As an alternative, we propose in this study a feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP) surrogate designed to accurately and efficiently predict top-of-atmosphere radiances in the CO2 weak band, using a combined mean absolute error (MAE) loss on radiances and RT Jacobians to preserve both spectral accuracy and sensitivity to geophysical parameters. Coupling the MLP-based RT surrogate with the NanoCarb instrumental response yields an efficient and precise forward model for NanoCarb measurements, which shows promising results for CO2 concentration retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对SCARBOn项目中NanoCarb成像干涉仪监测CO2和CH4排放的需求，提出用多层感知机（MLP）替代昂贵的逐线辐射传输（RT）模型，精确高效地预测CO2弱波段的星顶辐射，并结合仪器响应实现快速、精确的CO2浓度反演。
AI.motivation: 气候变化研究需要降低CO2和CH4排放估算的不确定性，以区分人为与自然源，这推动了具有更高重访频率和空间覆盖的星载测量。然而全物理反演算法依赖逐线RT模型的重复高分辨率辐射传输模拟，计算代价极其高昂，成为实现高重访和高空间覆盖浓度估算的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出一种前馈多层感知机（MLP）替代模型作为RT代理，用于预测CO2弱波段的星顶辐射。采用辐射值和RT雅可比矩阵的组合平均绝对误差（MAE）作为损失函数，以同时保持光谱精度和对地球物理参数的敏感性。随后将MLP-based RT代理与NanoCarb仪器响应耦合，构建高效且精确的NanoCarb测量前向模型。
AI.result: MLP代理模型与NanoCarb仪器响应的耦合形成了高效精确的前向模型，在CO2浓度反演方面显示出有前景的结果。
AI.conclusion: 基于MLP的辐射传输代理能够在不牺牲精度的情况下大幅提高计算效率，有望支持低成本卫星星座实现高重访和高空间覆盖的CO2排放监测目标。

title: The Hallucination Snowball: Modeling Error Propagation as State Transitions in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures; accepted at the FAGEN Workshop (Failure Modes in Agentic AI), ICML 2026
summary: Sequential multi-agent LLM pipelines chain specialized agents without verification at handoffs, creating a structural flaw with measurable and severe consequences. We show that hallucinations injected at Stage 1 do not merely persist; they transform: raw numerical facts become derived computations, then narrative prose, then editorially approved conclusions. At each transformation, detectability degrades near-irreversibly. We formalize this as the hallucination snowball effect, a first-order Markov process over four states (Raw Fact $\to$ Derived $\to$ Narrative $\to$ Invisible) with empirically measured per-boundary escape probabilities of 24.6%, 48.3%, and 89.3%. Across 346 automatically injected hallucinations in a 4-agent financial analysis pipeline on FinanceBench, gpt-4o detection drops from 72.0% at Stage 1 to 50.9% at Stage 4, and 23.7% of hallucinations survive completely undetected in the final output. Even the strongest model tested (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, 87.0% at Stage 1) faces a structural ceiling; projected Stage 4 detection is only ${\sim}$60--65%. Critically, boundary gates using identical RAG verification tools reduce hallucination survival from 58.4% to 16.2% versus end-of-pipeline checking (Cohen's $h = -0.911$, $p < 0.000001$), while end-checking alone achieves merely 2.3 pp improvement over no verification. When you verify matters more than whether you verify. Our model predicts survival for $n$-agent linear pipelines and prescribes optimal verification resource allocation: invest at $S_1{\to}S_2$ first, where 75.4% of hallucinations are still catchable, not at $S_3{\to}S_4$ where 89.3% have already escaped.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示顺序多智能体LLM流水线在手稿交接处缺乏验证的结构性缺陷，提出了"幻觉雪球效应"（hallucination snowball effect）概念：幻觉在流水线各阶段从原始事实→派生计算→叙事性文本→不可见结论逐步转化，检测难度随传播呈近不可逆的递增趋势。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM流水线在各阶段交接时缺乏验证机制，导致幻觉不仅持续存在，还会发生形态转化使检测变得越来越困难，这是一个结构性缺陷，需要系统化的形式化描述和实证分析。
AI.method: 将幻觉传播形式化为四状态的马尔可夫过程（Raw Fact→Derived→Narrative→Invisible），在FinanceBench上构建346个注入幻觉的4智能体财务分析流水线实验，测量各阶段边界逃逸概率，并对比边界验证与端到端检测的效果。
AI.result: 逃逸概率分别为24.6%、48.3%、89.3%；gpt-4o检测率从阶段1的72.0%降至阶段4的50.9%，23.7%幻觉完全逃过检测；边界RAG验证将幻觉存活率从58.4%降至16.2%，而端到端检测仅提升2.3个百分点。最优验证资源应分配在S1→S2阶段。
AI.conclusion: 在幻觉检测中，"何时验证"比"是否验证"更重要；应优先在流水线早期阶段投入验证资源，因为那里75.4%的幻觉仍可被捕获，而不是在后期阶段（89.3%幻觉已逃逸）浪费资源。

title: OpenHarmony Bench: Evaluating LLMs and Coding Agents on OpenHarmony App Development
summary: We present OPENHARMONY BENCH, an app-level coding benchmark for evaluating LLM-based coding agents on OpenHarmony ArkTS applications. Unlike function-level benchmarks, it evaluates complete app-level changes: each task requires an agent to modify a buildable ArkTS project so that a requested behavior works end to end, involving UI state, data persistence, build configuration, and platform APIs. The benchmark installs and drives the delivered application on a device to check whether the behavior is observable. It covers three input sources: natural-language feature requests (new-feature), structured scenario specifications (spec-driven), and bug descriptions (bug-fix). The benchmark contains 153 top-level tasks and 242 Feature points (F-points), where an F-point is one executable behavior check. The snapshot includes 32 new-feature tasks, 50 spec-driven tasks with 139 F-points, and 71 bug-fix tasks. The main leaderboard is scored over top-level tasks rather than independently weighted F-points. We describe the benchmark construction, statistics, and build-and-test evaluation pipeline, and evaluate DevEco Code with eight LLMs across three independent full-suite runs per configuration. Three findings emerge. First, newer generations complete more tasks than their predecessors within evaluated model-family pairs. Second, buildability is close to saturated while behavioral correctness is not: mean Final Build Success Rate is 94.77% to 100.00%, whereas mean Task Completion is 48.36% to 58.39%. Third, spec-driven tasks have the lowest Task Completion under all-checks task scoring, with no configuration exceeding 35%. The code, data, tasks, reference solutions, tests, evaluation scripts, and leaderboard are released through the official OPENHARMONY BENCH website at https://bench.matrix.openharmony.cn/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了OPENHARMONY BENCH，一个面向OpenHarmony ArkTS应用的应用级编码基准，用于评估基于LLM的编码智能体。与函数级基准不同，该基准要求智能体修改可构建的ArkTS项目以端到端实现完整行为，涉及UI状态、数据持久化、构建配置和平台API，并在真实设备上安装和运行应用来验证行为是否可观察。基准涵盖三种输入源（自然语言新功能、结构化场景规范、bug描述），包含153个顶层任务和242个F-points，并发布了完整代码、数据、评估脚本和排行榜。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM编码基准大多是函数级或代码片段级，无法评估智能体在真实应用开发中处理端到端、跨模块完整功能变更的能力。作者希望通过一个应用级基准来填补这一空白，特别是针对OpenHarmony这一新兴开源操作系统平台，评估编码智能体从零到一完成完整应用功能修改的能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含153个顶层任务、242个可执行行为检查点（F-points）的基准，覆盖三种输入来源：自然语言功能请求（new-feature）、结构化场景规范（spec-driven）和bug描述（bug-fix）。每个任务要求智能体修改可构建的ArkTS项目，并通过构建-安装-运行管道在真实设备上验证行为可观察性。主排行榜按顶层任务评分而非独立加权F-points，并使用DevEco Code配合8个LLM进行三轮独立全套运行来评估。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：(1) 同一模型家族中新一代模型完成任务多于前代；(2) 可构建性接近饱和而行为正确性远未饱和（平均构建成功率94.77%-100.00%，而任务完成率仅48.36%-58.39%）；(3) spec-driven任务在all-checks任务评分下任务完成率最低，所有配置均不超过35%。
AI.conclusion: OPENHARMONY BENCH揭示了当前LLM编码智能体在真实应用级开发中的关键短板：虽然能构建出可运行的代码，但在端到端行为级正确性上仍有很大提升空间，尤其在结构化规范驱动的任务上表现最差，说明从规范到可验证行为实现的转换仍是巨大挑战。该基准为未来的应用级编码智能体研究提供了标准化的评估平台。

title: Learning to Price with Persuasion
summary: Motivated by modern marketplaces, where the platform or the seller routinely gathers detailed user profiles, we study a novel learning theoretic model that simultaneously involves information and mechanism design. Specifically, we consider the economic setting recently introduced by Bergemann et al. (2022), where in addition to the menu of quality-price pairs, the seller offers information on the value of the match between product quality and buyer's taste via a signaling scheme. We relax the assumption that the seller knows the buyers' belief about the distribution of tastes and study the sample requirements of designing a revenue maximizing scheme. We consider both the batch setting where we have access to data from a set of i.i.d. buyers and an online demand query model where we observe the buyers' behaviors to seller's schemes. Despite the apparent non-convexity of the problem, we also give the first FPTAS to compute a scheme that maximizes the revenue within an arbitrarily small additive loss, which was left open by Bergemann et al. (2022). Overall, this brings a new learning perspective in asymmetric economic settings where buyers and sellers know different types of information.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个结合信息设计与机制设计的全新学习理论模型，其中卖方通过信号方案向买方提供关于产品质量与买家品味匹配价值的信息，同时放宽了卖方已知买方信念的假设，研究了设计收入最大化方案的样本需求，并在批处理与在线查询两种设置下给出了首个FPTAS。
AI.motivation: 在Bergemann等人(2022)的设定中，卖方不仅提供质量-价格菜单，还通过信号方案提供匹配价值信息，但该工作假设卖方完全知道买方的信念分布。本文放松这一假设，从学习理论视角研究在不知道买方信念的情况下如何设计收入最大化的方案，填补了这一空白。
AI.method: 本文考虑了两种数据获取设置：(1)批处理设置，即从一组i.i.d.买方中获取数据；(2)在线需求查询模型，即观察买方对卖方方案的响应行为。尽管问题表面上是非凸的，作者给出了首个FPTAS（全多项式时间近似方案），能够在任意小的加性损失内计算最大化收入的方案。
AI.result: (1) 分别推导了批处理设置下设计收入最大化方案的样本需求；(2) 在在线需求查询模型中研究了相应问题；(3) 在非凸问题背景下，给出了首个计算收入最大化方案的FPTAS，解决了Bergemann等人(2022)留下的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文为不对称经济环境（买卖双方掌握不同类型信息）引入了新的学习视角，弥合了信息设计理论与机器学习样本复杂度分析之间的鸿沟，并为相关经济场景提供了可计算且可学习的解决方案。

title: Graph-Based Discovery of Mathematical Software Communities and Publication-to-Community Prediction
summary: Research software forms distinct co-usage communities that span traditional disciplinary boundaries, yet the structure of these communities remains largely unexplored. We present a graph-based framework for discovering mathematical software communities and predicting their association with research publications. We construct a software co-usage network from publication-software relationships using a curated swMATH dataset and subsequently apply community detection method, revealing a heterogeneous landscape of mathematical software communities. We formulate publication-to-community mapping as a multi-label classification task and further investigate whether community membership can be predicted from lightweight scholarly metadata. Specifically, we compare two feature representations of scientific publications: Mathematics Subject Classification (MSC) and title-based embeddings. Across a range of models, structured MSC representation consistently provides a stronger precision-recall trade-off, demonstrating that structured domain metadata captures software-community structure more effectively than compressed title-only semantics in this setting. This work highlights the continuing value of structured scholarly metadata for large-scale research software discovery, classification and recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于图的框架，用于发现数学软件社区并预测其与科研出版物的关联。通过从swMATH数据集构建软件共使用网络并应用社区检测，揭示了数学软件社区的异质景观。将出版物到社区的映射建模为多标签分类任务，比较了MSC结构化表示和标题嵌入两种特征，发现MSC表示在精度-召回权衡上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 研究软件形成的共使用社区跨越传统学科界限，但这些社区的结构尚未被充分探索。理解这些社区有助于大规模研究软件的发现、分类和推荐。
AI.method: 1) 从swMATH数据集构建软件共使用网络（基于出版物-软件关系）；2) 应用社区检测方法发现数学软件社区；3) 将出版物到社区映射建模为多标签分类任务；4) 比较两种特征表示：MSC结构化元数据 vs. 标题嵌入，并在多种模型下评估。
AI.result: MSC结构化表示在多种模型中始终提供更强的精度-召回权衡，表明结构化领域元数据比压缩的标题语义更能捕捉软件社区结构。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调了结构化学术元数据在大规模研究软件发现、分类和推荐中的持续价值。

title: What to Forget in Unlearning? Forget Set Curation for Language Models
comment: Presented at MemFM @ ICML 2026 and FoGen @ ICML 2026
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted data or behaviors from a trained model without retraining from scratch. Yet most evaluations assume that the examples to forget are already known. In realistic language-model deployments, a requester may ask a model to stop reproducing a song or book without knowing which spans, documents, quotations, or near-duplicates in a trillion-token corpus support that behavior. We study this missing upstream problem, forget set curation: mapping a suppression request to the data passed to an unlearning algorithm. We introduce CleanSlate, a benchmark for verbatim output suppression over songs and books, with model-specific extraction profiles, content-grounded QA, and capability-retention evaluations. CleanSlate exposes two failure modes. Natural lexical and exact-substring curators often yield forget sets that lead to weak suppression. An evaluation-aware curator suppresses requested continuations almost completely, but causes collateral regression on non-requested content and model-dependent capability loss. These results show that practical unlearning is not only an optimization problem once a forget set is given: the data chosen for forgetting determines both what can be unlearnt and what else is damaged.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CleanSlate基准，研究"遗忘集策展"问题——即将用户对模型输出的抑制请求映射到具体训练数据的过程。该基准针对歌曲和书籍的逐字输出抑制，揭示了自然词法和精确子串策展器导致弱抑制，而评估感知的策展器虽几乎完全抑制请求内容，却导致非请求内容回退和模型相关的能力损失。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘评估大多假设需要忘记的样本已知，但在现实的语言模型部署中，请求者可能要求模型停止复制某首歌或书籍，却不知道支撑该行为的具体语料片段。这种"忘记集策展"的上游问题此前未被系统研究。
AI.method: 引入CleanSlate基准，包含歌曲和书籍的逐字输出抑制任务，提供模型特定的提取档案、基于内容的QA评估和能力保持评估，以系统比较不同遗忘集策展策略的效果。
AI.result: 自然词法和精确子串策展器产生的遗忘集往往导致弱抑制；评估感知的策展器能几乎完全抑制请求的延续内容，但会造成非请求内容的附带回归和模型依赖性能力损失。
AI.conclusion: 实际机器遗忘不仅是给定遗忘集后的优化问题：所选择的遗忘数据同时决定了哪些内容可以被遗忘，以及哪些其他内容会受到损害。遗忘集策展是决定遗忘成败的关键上游环节。

title: IP Protection in the Era of Visual Generative AI: A Survey
summary: The rapid evolution of visual generative AI has introduced a wide range of intellectual property risks, spanning the unauthorized learning, reproduction, extraction, misuse, and redistribution of protected data and model assets. To address these risks, a growing body of technical defenses has been proposed. However, existing surveys typically organize this literature by lifecycle stage or technical mechanism, which can obscure the protective intent of different methods. This survey presents a two-dimensional taxonomy for IP protection in visual generative models. The primary axis is a Control Logic View, which classifies methods into Information Exposure Control, Generative Behavior Constraint, and Attribution & Accountability according to the risk variable they regulate. The secondary axis distinguishes Data IP from Model IP as cross-cutting asset dimensions. Under this framework, we systematically review protection methods, align evaluation protocols with protection objectives, and discuss open challenges including proactive model-level safeguards, standardized evaluation, robustness against adaptive attacks, and explainable evidence. This survey aims to offer a principled, systematic, and easy-to-follow overview for both new and experienced researchers in visual generative AI IP protection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于视觉生成模型知识产权保护的二维分类体系，从"控制逻辑视角"（信息暴露控制、生成行为约束、归属与问责）和"资产维度"（数据IP与模型IP）两个轴对现有防御方法进行系统梳理，并探讨了评估协议和开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成AI的快速发展带来了多层面的知识产权风险（包括未经授权的学习、复制、提取、滥用和再分发），虽然已有大量技术防御方法被提出，但现有综述通常按生命周期阶段或技术机制来组织文献，这可能会模糊不同方法背后的保护意图，缺乏一个以保护目的为导向的系统性框架。
AI.method: 本文提出一个二维分类法：主轴为"控制逻辑视角"，根据方法所调节的风险变量将方法分为三类——信息暴露控制、生成行为约束、归属与问责；次轴为跨领域的资产维度，区分数据IP和模型IP。在此框架下系统性地综述保护方法，并将评估协议与保护目标对齐。
AI.result: 该框架对现有视觉生成模型IP保护方法进行了系统梳理，将评估协议与保护目标相对应，并识别出开放挑战，包括主动模型级防护、标准化评估、针对自适应攻击的鲁棒性以及可解释的证据。
AI.conclusion: 本文旨在为视觉生成AI知识产权保护领域的新手和经验丰富的研究者提供一个有原则、系统且易于理解的综述框架。

title: iFuzz-Meta: An Interpretable Fuzzy Learning Framework Bridging Top-Down and Bottom-Up Knowledge Integration
summary: Interpretable representation learning remains a key challenge in modern neural computation, particularly when models are expected not only to perform but also to explain their reasoning. This paper introduces iFuzz-Meta, an interpretable fuzzy rule-based learning framework that preserves human-understandable reasoning structures within modern neural architectures. Each fuzzy rule corresponds to a semantic and spatial prototype defined in the original feature space, enabling transparent inference and direct interpretability. Meta-learning is employed as an analytical paradigm to examine how these interpretable rules reorganize across tasks and domains, providing a principled means to link algorithmic adaptation with cognitive representation. A knowledge-guided regularization mechanism further enables a top-down-bottom-up integration, in which theoretical priors act as soft inductive biases while data-driven learning refines and extends them. This dual process ensures that adaptation proceeds along semantically and physiologically meaningful trajectories, rather than arbitrary parameter shifts. Evaluations demonstrate that iFuzz-Meta achieves interpretable reasoning and stable cross-domain generalization, establishing a potential general pathway toward explainable and knowledge-aware fuzzy systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出iFuzz-Meta框架，将可解释的模糊规则学习嵌入现代神经网络架构中。每条模糊规则对应原始特征空间中的语义和空间原型，同时利用元学习范式分析规则跨任务和领域的重组，并引入知识引导的正则化机制实现自上而下与自下而上的整合，兼顾可解释性与跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现代神经计算中，模型不仅要能执行任务，还要能解释其推理过程。然而当前可解释表示学习仍面临挑战，需要一种既能保持人类可理解的推理结构，又能在现代神经架构中运作的框架。
AI.method: iFuzz-Meta包含三个核心组件：(1)模糊规则学习框架，每条规则对应原始特征空间中的语义-空间原型，实现透明推理；(2)元学习范式，用于分析可解释规则如何跨任务和领域重组；(3)知识引导的正则化机制，实现理论先验（自上而下）与数据驱动学习（自下而上）的双向整合，使适应过程沿语义和生理上有意义的轨迹进行。
AI.result: 实验评估表明iFuzz-Meta实现了可解释的推理和稳定的跨域泛化，验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: iFuzz-Meta为构建可解释且知识感知的模糊系统提供了一条潜在的通用路径，将算法适应与认知表征联系起来，推动了可解释人工智能的发展。

title: Toward Safe LLM Agents: A Survey of Specification, Verification, and Enforcement
summary: LLM agents increasingly perform irreversible real-world actions, including database updates, API calls, file operations, and autonomous use of tools. However, no existing system provides formally grounded, task-level safety guarantees for the plans these agents generate. Research remains fragmented across specification, verification, and enforcement, limiting understanding of the strengths and limitations of existing approaches. To address this gap, we conducted a PRISMA 2020 systematic review of 38 studies published between 2022 and 2026 and retrieved from six academic databases. Our analysis reveals four key findings. First, the specification bottleneck remains the primary challenge: natural-language-to-formal translation achieves only 24% to 35% semantic correctness, undermining downstream verification. Second, runtime monitoring is the most mature enforcement strategy, reducing unsafe actions by 40% to 65% in controlled settings, but it does not provide complete safety guarantees. Third, the verifier tax shows that blocking 94% of unsafe actions can still result in less than 5% safe task completion because agents exploit alternative unsafe paths. Finally, no existing approach simultaneously achieves soundness, scalability, semantic correctness, and task-level safety preservation. We contribute a three-level taxonomy, a comparative analysis of existing techniques, a synthesis of evidence on the verifier tax, and a ten-problem research agenda for trustworthy agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文对2022至2026年间38篇关于LLM代理安全性的研究进行了PRISMA 2020系统综述，揭示了规范瓶颈（自然语言转形式语言语义正确率仅24%-35%）、运行时监控是最成熟的执行策略（减少40%-65%不安全行为，但不提供完整保证）、验证者税现象（阻塞94%不安全行为仍可能导致任务完成率不足5%）等关键发现，并提出三层分类法、比较分析、验证者税证据综合及十项研究议程。
AI.motivation: LLM代理越来越多地执行不可逆的真实世界操作（数据库更新、API调用、文件操作和工具自主使用），但现有系统缺乏形式上严格、任务级别的安全保证。该领域在规范、验证和执行方面的研究碎片化，限制了人们对现有方法优劣的理解，因此需要进行系统综述来整合和梳理现有工作。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020系统综述方法，从六个学术数据库中检索2022至2026年间发表的38篇研究，通过规范（specification）、验证（verification）、执行（enforcement）三个维度进行分析，形成三层分类法并对现有技术进行对比分析。
AI.result: 四项关键发现：(1)规范瓶颈是最主要挑战，自然语言到形式语言翻译的语义正确率仅24%-35%；(2)运行时监控是最成熟的执行策略，在受控环境中可减少40%-65%的不安全行为，但无法提供完全安全保障；(3)验证者税表明即使阻塞94%的不安全行为，任务完成率仍可能低于5%，因为代理会利用替代的不安全路径；(4)现有方法无法同时实现可靠性、可扩展性、语义正确性和任务级安全保持。
AI.conclusion: 研究贡献包括三层分类法、现有技术比较分析、验证者税的证据综合，以及面向可信代理式AI的十项研究议程，呼吁领域内建立更系统化、形式化的安全保证框架。

title: Strategic Technical Debt: A Real Options Approach to Early-Stage Software Experimentation
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures. Pre-registered empirical program: OSF bs3cr (EP3'), rvx5t (EP-Pi)
summary: Technical debt is treated almost universally as an engineering pathology. This paper argues that under the conditions defining early-stage software work (high hypothesis uncertainty, cheap experiments, and the freedom to abandon), deliberately incurred technical debt is a rationally priced financial instrument: a call option on the validated product, purchased at a discount that is largest exactly when uncertainty is highest. We make three contributions. First, a demarcation: debt is strategic when its expected cost loads on the success branch of the venture (repaid only if the hypothesis validates) and toxic when it imposes unconditional cost while held (security exposure, data loss, corrupted experimental signal), a boundary stated formally that renders the popular "prudent vs. reckless" intuition testable. Second, a sequential model: a finite-horizon dynamic program over belief and debt stock yielding four results: a shadow price of debt equal to the risk-discounted probability of repayment; a technical-debt overhang (the belief threshold for scaling rises with the debt stock, proved via an envelope Lipschitz bound); a refactoring-pivot theorem (optimal repayment concentrates at the commitment boundary, predicting the practitioner-reported refactoring burst at product-market fit, registered here as a falsifiable prediction); and a volatility result under risk-neutral valuation. A pivot-salvage correction shows the folk rule "maximum debt at maximum uncertainty" fails whenever failure redirects rather than terminates the venture and the salvage differential clears the discounted cost premium. Third, a two-test primary empirical program (validation-event refactoring timing; the first repository measurement of pivot salvage), pre-registered with frozen analyzers before any data contact. Calibrations are illustrative, not estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战"技术债务必为病理"的共识，主张在早期创业条件下，刻意累积的技术债务可视为一种理性定价的金融工具——即对已验证产品的看涨期权，且不确定性最高时折扣最大。作者提出战略性与毒性债务的正式边界、基于动态规划的序贯模型（得出债务影子价格、技术债务悬置、重构-转向定理、波动率结果等），并设计了预注册的两项实证检验。
AI.motivation: 技术债务普遍被视为工程病理，但作者认为在早期软件开发中（高假设不确定性、低成本实验、可自由放弃），这一共识忽视了债务的策略性价值，缺乏可检验的理论框架来区分"审慎"与"鲁莽"的债务行为。
AI.method: 1) 形式化界定：战略债务（仅在验证成功时偿还）与毒性债务（持有时即产生无条件成本）；2) 有限时域动态规划模型，以信念和债务存量为状态变量，推导四大结论（债务影子价格、债务悬置、重构-转向定理、风险中性波动率结果）；3) 引入转向-挽救校正，修正"最大不确定性取最大债务"的民间规则；4) 预注册两项实证检验（验证事件重构时机、首次仓库级转向挽救度量）。
AI.result: 模型得出四方面理论结果：债务影子价格等于风险折现后的偿还概率；技术债务悬置（扩张信念阈值随债务存量上升）；最优偿还集中于承诺边界（预测产品-市场匹配时的重构爆发）；以及风险中性估值下的波动率结果。转向-挽救校正表明民间规则在转向场景下失效。校准仅为示意而非估计。
AI.conclusion: 技术债务在早期创业场景下可被视为理性的期权定价问题，其战略价值取决于债务成本是否仅挂在成功分支上。该理论将"审慎vs鲁莽"的直觉转化为可检验的形式化命题，并通过预注册的两项实证程序进行验证。

title: Liquid democracy under vote correlation: On the fallacies of averaging and the excluded middle
summary:
Liquid democracy permits voters to vote directly or delegate their votes to others. Existing algorithmic analyses assign each voter a single scalar parameter, interpreted as an independent probability of voting for the ground truth. This representation is inadequate when delegation is fixed before public information changes different voters' reliability in different ways.
  In this work, we study a minimal common-signal model of this phenomenon. Delegation occurs before a public binary signal is realised, while voting occurs afterwards. Conditional on the signal, sink votes are independent, and each voter has a signal-specific competence; marginally, correctness events are correlated through the common signal. We show that delegation based on average competence is not a safe scalarisation: it can violate do-no-harm, and a beneficial delegation rule may send votes to voters with lower average competence.
  We present and analyse three novel delegation mechanisms for this setting. The first is a conservative intersection mechanism that delegates only to neighbours whose competence exceeds the delegator's by a prescribed margin in every signal state; the conservative intersection mechanism inherits all the guarantees of delegation in the scalar competence setting. The next mechanism is a confounded-set mechanism that enable the delegation to neighbours who are favoured in one state and worse by at most a prescribed tolerance in the other. For this mechanism, we prove expected-margin bounds, and identify the weight-dispersion and mechanism-concentration conditions needed to obtain majority-correctness guarantees. Finally, on bounded-in-degree graphs, a multi-round certified-path mechanism propagates nonnegative two-dimensional path certificates; it is acyclic, yields statewise terminal competence improvement, and gives uniform bounds on path length and terminal voting weight.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了液态民主在公共信号模型下的委托机制。在信号实现前完成委托、信号实现后进行投票的设定下，信号会以不同方式影响不同投票者的可靠性。作者证明了基于平均能力的标量化委托不安全（可能违反"无害原则"，且有益的委托可能流向平均能力更低的投票者），并提出了三种新型委托机制：保守交集机制、混淆集机制和多轮认证路径机制。
AI.motivation: 现有液态民主的算法分析将每个投票者简化为一个标量参数（独立正确概率），但当委托在公共信息变化之前固定，而不同投票者的可靠性会以不同方式随信号变化时，这种标量表示是不够充分的。作者试图解决这一缺陷。
AI.method: 1) 建立最小公共信号模型：委托在二元公共信号实现前完成，投票在信号后发生，给定信号时投票独立且具有信号特定能力。2) 提出三种委托机制：保守交集机制（仅在所有信号状态下能力都超出委托者一定裕度时才委托，继承标量设定的所有保证）；混淆集机制（允许在一种状态有利而在另一种状态最多差一定容差时委托，给出期望边际界和多数正确性条件）；多轮认证路径机制（在有界度图上传播非负二维路径证书，保证无环、状态级终端能力改善、路径长度和终端权重有界）。
AI.result: 证明了基于平均能力的委托不安全的两个结论：可能违反无害原则；有益委托可能流向平均能力更低的投票者。对三种机制分别给出了理论保证：保守交集机制保留标量设定的全部保证；混淆集机制有期望边际界及多数正确性条件（需要权重分散和机制集中条件）；多轮认证路径机制具有无环性、状态级能力改善及均匀界。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了液态民主在公共信号（共同信息）环境下，标量能力表示的非充分性，并提供了三种具有不同权衡的委托机制，为更真实的信息相关投票场景提供了理论保障。

title: When Is Complex Chunking Worth It? A Multi-Objective Evaluation of Chunking Methods at Scale
summary: Dense retrieval is commonly evaluated on benchmarks that represent each document with a single embedding, even though real-world retrieval systems often index long documents that require chunking. In these settings, the chosen chunking method not only affects retrieval quality, but also indexing throughput, query latency, and memory usage. Prior comparisons of chunking strategies have mainly focused on retrieval performance, leaving operational trade-offs underexplored. To address these issues, we evaluate eight representative chunking strategies across two scalable corpora, three embedding models, and multiple corpus sizes, measuring both retrieval effectiveness and system-level costs. Our results show that computationally expensive methods rarely provide consistent gains over simpler chunking. Instead, the best performing strategy depends on the embedding model, dataset, corpus size, and target retrieval metric. Methods with similar performance can also differ substantially in operational cost, showing that chunking should be seen as a multi-objective design decision.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了八种分块策略在稠密检索中的表现，同时衡量检索效果和系统级成本（索引吞吐量、查询延迟、内存使用），发现计算昂贵的方法并不总能带来一致优势，最佳策略取决于嵌入模型、数据集、语料库规模和检索指标，分块应被视为多目标设计决策。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密检索基准通常以单嵌入表示文档，但真实系统中长文档需要分块。以往分块策略比较主要关注检索性能，忽略了分块对索引吞吐量、查询延迟和内存使用的系统级影响，使操作层面的权衡未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在两个可扩展语料库、三种嵌入模型和多种语料库大小下，对八种代表性分块策略进行全面评估，同时测量检索有效性和系统级成本。
AI.result: 计算成本高的分块方法很少比简单分块提供一致的优势；最佳策略取决于嵌入模型、数据集、语料库大小及目标检索指标；性能相近的方法在运营成本上可能有显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 分块不应仅被视为影响检索质量的技术手段，而是一个多目标设计决策，需要在检索效果与系统运营成本之间进行权衡。

title: Where Does Retrieval Fail? Evaluating RAG Architectures for Agricultural Advisory
summary:
Retrieval quality in RAG systems is commonly reported as a single aggregate score, which can hide large differences across query types and language conditions. We study this problem in Bengali agricultural advisory, where farmer queries are often colloquial while official advisory documents use formal scientific terminology. We construct a test collection of 1,000 queries and 2,882 knowledge nodes extracted from 284 official Bangladeshi agricultural publications, and use it to evaluate five retrieval architectures and six embedding models under three controlled language conditions.
  The results show that no single retrieval method is consistently best. For native Bengali queries, BM25 is the strongest single retriever (R@10 = 0.506) while Hybrid RRF reaches the highest overall R@10 of 0.539. However, dense retrieval performance varies sharply by query type: R@10 is 0.093 on colloquial farmer queries and 0.970 on formal safety queries. Across language conditions, BM25 R@10 drops from 0.506 on Bengali queries to 0.004 when English queries are matched against the Bengali corpus, while dense retrieval falls only from 0.464 to 0.425. We also find that embedding task configuration and passage length can each change reported R@10 by a factor of seven, independent of architecture. These results show why low-resource RAG evaluation should report performance by language condition and query type rather than relying on aggregate scores alone. The dataset and evaluation scripts are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RaiyanKhaan/AgriTrust-RAG.

AI.tldr: 本文针对RAG系统检索质量评估中单一聚合分数掩盖查询类型和语言条件差异的问题，在孟加拉语农业咨询场景下构建了包含1,000个查询和2,882个知识节点的测试集，评估了五种检索架构和六种嵌入模型。结果显示没有单一检索方法全面最优：BM25在孟加拉语查询上表现最强（R@10=0.506），Hybrid RRF达到最高整体R@10（0.539），但稠密检索在不同查询类型间差异巨大（口语查询0.093 vs 正式安全查询0.970），且跨语言条件下BM25性能急剧下降（从0.506降至0.004）。研究还发现嵌入任务配置和段落长度可独立使R@10变化七倍，强调了低资源RAG评估应按语言条件和查询类型分别报告性能。
AI.motivation: RAG系统的检索质量通常以单一聚合分数报告，但这种方法掩盖了不同查询类型和语言条件下的性能差异。在孟加拉语农业咨询场景中，农民使用口语化表达而官方文档采用正式科学术语，这种语言鸿沟使聚合评估尤其具有误导性。
AI.method: 构建一个包含1,000个查询和从284份孟加拉国官方农业出版物中提取的2,882个知识节点的测试集，在三种受控语言条件下评估五种检索架构（包括BM25、稠密检索、混合RRF等）和六种嵌入模型。
AI.result: 无单一检索方法全面最优。BM25在原生孟加拉语查询上最强（R@10=0.506），Hybrid RRF整体最高（R@10=0.539）。稠密检索在口语农民查询上仅R@10=0.093，而正式安全查询达0.970。跨语言条件下，BM25从0.506骤降至0.004，稠密检索仅从0.464降至0.425。嵌入任务配置和段落长度可各自使R@10变化七倍。
AI.conclusion: 低资源RAG评估不应依赖聚合分数，而应按语言条件和查询类型分别报告性能，以揭示不同检索方法在不同场景下的真实优劣。

title: Emergence of Transfer Learning towards Specific Identification of Alzheimer's Disease A Prospective Approach
summary: Worldwide, millions of senior citizens are suffering from Alzheimer disease abbreviated as AD, a well- versed form of dementia. AD is featured by amnesia, intellectual disability, and difficulty with consciousness. DL and ML models are undoubtedly explored to identify AD related patterns on large dimensional neuroimaging data but they need global optimization and are suffering from overfitting issue that might yield dissatisfactory result in testing data set. DL overcomes the issue by convolution of input image with kernel but any sudden change in the MRI image or human manipulation, limited pre- processing of the images can mislead CNN in achieving highly accurate detection. Transfer Learning (TL) has proved itself in AD diagnosis by utilizing pre-trained models on large data sets to guide novice model in a new neuroimaging dataset. This review provides an inclusive glimpse of TL implication in classification, identification including the conversion of AD. Keeping in view, we have assessed the strengths and limitations of TL in improvising diagnostic accuracy even with limited data. The uniqueness of the present review is the incorporation of explainable AI in TL based AD diagnosis system. Finally, it can be claimed that the review will guide the new re-searchers in the area of TL induced neurodegenerative disease detection.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，探讨迁移学习（TL）在阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断中的应用，重点评估了TL在分类、识别及AD转化预测中的优势与局限，并创新性地引入了可解释人工智能（XAI）以提升诊断系统的透明度和可信度。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习和机器学习模型在AD检测中面临过拟合和全局优化困难，CNN模型对MRI图像预处理和人为扰动敏感，导致检测精度受限。需要一种更稳健的方法来提升AD诊断的准确性，尤其是在有限数据条件下。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，系统评估迁移学习（TL）在AD诊断中的应用，包括利用在大规模数据集上预训练的模型来指导新神经影像数据集上的任务，同时整合可解释人工智能（XAI）技术来分析TL模型的决策过程。
AI.result: TL即使在有限数据条件下也能有效提升AD诊断的准确性，但存在一定的局限性。将可解释AI整合到TL-based AD诊断系统中是本文的独特贡献，为诊断结果提供可解释性支持。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为神经退行性疾病检测领域的新研究者提供了TL应用的全面指导，并强调了可解释AI在增强TL诊断系统可信度方面的重要价值。

title: SMOPD: Selective Token-Entropy Masking for Dirty-History Multi-Turn On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Dirty-history rollouts make multi-turn on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) brittle: once a student emits an erroneous intermediate reply, later turns are conditioned on that reply, and uniform distillation can spend loss on tokens that carry little corrective signal. We introduce SMOPD (Selective Masking for On-Policy Distillation), a loss-only stabilization method for multi-turn OPSD. For each generated middle-turn reply, SMOPD ranks token positions by student entropy and removes the lowest-entropy 20% from the clipped generalized Jensen-Shannon distillation loss; final-answer and FULL-preservation losses are unchanged. This design targets token-level uncertainty rather than coarse trajectory outcomes, adds no parameters, and has zero inference-time overhead. We compare SMOPD with a correctness-scaling variant that multiplies a common detached reliability proxy using final-answer correctness. On LiC with Qwen3 models, SMOPD improves SHARDED-view accuracy by 1.0-2.5 percentage points in single-seed 1.7B, 4B, and 8B comparisons, and a small 4B multi-seed check shows a +1.7pp mean SHARDED gain over baseline (two-tailed p = 0.022). Adding the outcome scalar is harmful without masking at 1.7B (-4.0pp) and remains scale-dependent when combined with masking (+1.3pp at 4B, neutral at 1.7B, and -0.5pp at 8B). These archived aggregate results suggest that token-level uncertainty is a more reliable stabilization signal than scalar final-answer correctness in this evaluated dirty-history OPSD setting, while leaving causal mechanism tests and broader benchmark validation to future work.
