AI.result: 模拟中预测与实测稳定性一致度在8%以内；竞争做市商数量为2和3时，不稳定性分别放大1.74倍和3.16倍，与预测一致。普通重训在模量1.21处失稳，而结构锚定修正能够在盲目重训崩溃时收敛。基于36年公开市场数据标定，从平静期到危机期，投资级和高收益债券的稳定余量分别下降约4.4倍和4.3倍。
AI.conclusion: REFLEX将一个抽象的收敛定理转化为市场层面的安全边际，为做市商提供部署前可测算的稳定性度量工具。

title: Harness the Memory: A Holistic Evaluation of Memory Substrates in Memory Agents
summary: Memory is becoming core infrastructure for long-horizon LLM agents, yet existing evaluations offer limited guidance on which memory substrate, namely the underlying medium in which memory is represented and stored, should be used under different operating regimes. We present a controlled harness evaluation of memory substrates for memory-augmented agents, covering dense and sparse indices, text records, structural stores, hierarchical stores, refinement-based memories, parametric updates, and activation-compatible context mechanisms. Across three backbone models and four benchmark suites spanning user-centric question answering and agent-centric decision-making, we instrument 26 performance and efficiency metrics under a unified harness. Our results show that no single substrate consistently dominates: broad retrieval benefits long-context factual QA, while excessive retrieval can harm sequential decision-making by shifting attention away from action-critical context. Scalability introduces a further routing axis, as substrates that perform well at moderate history lengths can become costly or brittle at longer horizons. These findings motivate substrate routing as a necessary component of adaptive agent memory systems and provide empirical guidance for designing efficient, reliable, and regime-aware long-term memory for LLM agents. Code will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过统一测试框架对LLM智能体的多种记忆基底（memory substrates）进行了受控评估，涵盖密集/稀疏索引、文本记录、结构化存储、层级存储、精炼记忆、参数更新及激活兼容上下文机制等。跨3个骨干模型和4个基准套件，测量了26项性能与效率指标，发现没有任何单一记忆基底在所有场景中持续占优，并据此提出"记忆基底路由"（substrate routing）作为自适应智能体记忆系统的必要组件。
AI.motivation: 记忆正成为长周期LLM智能体的核心基础设施，但现有评估无法为不同运行场景下应选择何种记忆基底（即记忆表示与存储的底层介质）提供明确指导。
AI.method: 构建受控测试框架（controlled harness evaluation），覆盖多种记忆基底类型（密集/稀疏索引、文本记录、结构化存储、层级存储、精炼记忆、参数更新、激活兼容上下文机制），在3个骨干模型和4个基准套件（涵盖用户中心问答和智能体中心决策）上统一测量26项性能与效率指标。
AI.result: 没有任何单一记忆基底在所有场景中一致占优。广度检索有利于长上下文事实问答，但过度检索会损害序列决策（因其将注意力从动作关键上下文转移）。可扩展性是另一条路由维度——在中等历史长度下表现良好的基底在更长视界下可能变得昂贵或脆弱。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明记忆基底路由（substrate routing）是自适应智能体记忆系统的必要组成部分，并为设计高效、可靠且感知运行模式的长期记忆提供了实证指导。

title: Artificial Intelligence as a Tool for Combating Child Labour: A Real-Time Edge Vision Pipeline for Child Detection and Age Estimation
summary: An estimated 138 million children remain in child labour worldwide, and the monitoring systems used by affected sectors, built on periodic household visits and interviews, systematically under-detect them. We present a real-time computer-vision pipeline, built and operated solely as a research prototype, that studies the feasibility of giving Child Labour Monitoring and Remediation Systems (CLMRS) a continuous, presence-based evidence channel. The pipeline combines a multi-task person and face detector (YOLO26x backbone in the CerberusDet framework), cascaded age estimation pairing MiVOLO v2 with a child-specialist model for ages 0-12, ByteTrack tracking, ArcFace and DINOv2 re-identification, and track-level fusion producing reviewable per-person records. The detector raises person mAP@0.5 from 0.390 to 0.683 over the previous-generation baseline; the child specialist reaches 1.944 years MAE on children-only validation, where widely used open-source stacks err by 18-23 years. FP8 TensorRT compilation yields a 1.77x speedup at +0.002 years MAE, bringing the pipeline above twice real-time on embedded hardware. On 26.8 hours of proxy video the system finds 634 unique child candidates versus 285 for its predecessor. We further report a seventeen-day unattended field pilot on a farm in Zimbabwe (38.7 million frames, six cameras) evaluated against a daily attendance register: software tuning improved detection yield 36-fold, and identity consolidation under a simultaneity veto cut over-reporting from 9.1x to 1.8-3.9x with zero proven-false merges. We document training and quantisation failures alongside successes, and the data-protection and human-in-the-loop safeguards such a system requires.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个实时计算机视觉流水线，作为纯研究原型，用于研究给童工监测与补救系统（CLMRS）提供持续、基于在场证据通道的可行性。系统结合多任务检测器、级联年龄估计、目标跟踪与重识别，在津巴布韦农场17天无人值守试点中显著提升检测产量并降低过度报告率。
AI.motivation: 全球约1.38亿儿童仍处于童工状态，而现有基于定期入户访问和访谈的监测系统系统性漏检。需要探索一种连续、基于在场证据的监测通道来补充现有CLMRS。
AI.method: 采用流水线组合：CerberusDet框架中YOLO26x骨干的多任务人物与脸部检测器、MiVOLO v2与0-12岁儿童专家模型级联的年龄估计、ByteTrack跟踪、ArcFace与DINOv2重识别、轨迹级融合生成可审查的逐人记录。还采用FP8 TensorRT编译优化，并在现场试点中引入同时性否决（simultaneity veto）进行身份整合。
AI.result: 检测器人物mAP@0.5从0.390提升至0.683；儿童专家模型在纯儿童验证集上MAE为1.944年，而主流开源方案误差达18-23年；FP8编译带来1.77倍加速且MAE仅增加0.002年，在嵌入式硬件上达到两倍实时。26.8小时代理视频中找到634个独特儿童候选（前代285个）。津巴布韦17天试点中软件调优使检测产量提升36倍，同时性否决将过度报告从9.1倍降至1.8-3.9倍且无误合并。
AI.conclusion: 该系统证明了基于CV的连续在场监测在技术上可行且能大幅改善童工检测效率，但作者强调了训练与量化失败，以及系统所需的数据保护与人在回路安全保障措施的重要性。

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Perception-Decision Misalignment in Omni-LLMs via Modality Subspace Activation
summary: Omni-Large Language Models (Omni-LLMs) power complex multi-modal reasoning in applications like World Action Models and autonomous agents. However, their strong performance often masks a profound Perceptual-Decision Misalignment (PDM), where decisions remain unfaithful to multi-modal perceptions. To diagnose this, we formalize Causal Modality Sensitivity (CMS), operationalized via a dual-lens framework: Answer Retention Rate (ARR) at the macro behavioral level, and Logit Angular Discrepancy (LAD) to track microscopic distribution shifts. We also curate CausalMSBench, a diagnostic dataset isolating language priors. Benchmarking reveals that popular Omni-LLMs exhibit critically low CMS, showing negligible distribution shifts even when key modalities are removed. To rectify this, we propose Modality Subspace Activation (MSA), a training-free inference-time framework that uses Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to estimate modal activation strengths. MSA dynamically balances modal projections in the last hidden state, effectively restoring CMS across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Omni-LLM中存在的感知-决策错位（PDM）问题，通过因果模态敏感性（CMS）双视角框架（ARR和LAD）进行诊断，构建CausalMSBench基准数据集，并提出无需训练即可恢复模态敏感性的MSA推理框架。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLM虽在多模态推理任务中表现优异，但其决策往往不可靠地依赖多模态感知，过度依赖语言先验而忽视关键模态输入。现有评估框架无法揭示这一问题。
AI.method: 1) 形式化因果模态敏感性（CMS），通过宏观看答保留率（ARR）和微观Logit角距离（LAD）双重视角诊断；2) 构建CausalMSBench数据集隔离语言先验；3) 提出模态子空间激活（MSA），利用SVD估计模态激活强度，在最后隐状态动态平衡模态投影。
AI.result: 基准测试显示主流Omni-LLM的CMS极低，即使移除关键模态也几乎无分布偏移；MSA框架能有效恢复CMS。
AI.conclusion: Omni-LLM存在严重感知-决策错位问题，但通过推理时的模态子空间激活可以在无需训练的情况下修复这一问题，为提升多模态模型的忠实度提供了新方向。

title: Accuracy and Reliability of Large Language Models in Cosmetic Chemistry and Skin Health: A Benchmarking Study
summary: As consumers increasingly turn to AI chatbots for skincare advice, the technical accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) in cosmetic chemistry remains largely under-evaluated. We benchmarked 14 LLMs on a structured set of topics related to cosmetic chemistry, including the chemical properties of specific cosmetic ingredients and common cosmetic scenarios that may be of interest to consumers. Web search was disabled throughout to assess each model's internalized knowledge rather than its internet retrieval capacity. Overall performance was poor, with the most pronounced deficits in quantitative reasoning and structural identification tasks. While models handled general skincare questions with reasonability, responses consistently lacked the technical depth required for informed consumer decision-making. Notably, conversation with AI can pose a risk: outputs that sound authoritative but contain technical errors are less likely to generate skepticism compared to responses that explicitly acknowledge uncertainty. These findings suggest that general-purpose LLMs, trained predominantly on unverified public data, are currently not reliable sources of cosmetic chemistry information. Progress on two fronts, fine-tuning verified chemical and dermatological datasets, and substantial improvements to algorithmic reasoning, will likely be needed before these tools can be considered as resources for public use.

AI.tldr: 本文对14个LLM在化妆品化学领域的知识进行了基准测试，发现整体表现不佳，尤其在定量推理和结构识别方面存在明显缺陷。尽管模型能合理回答一般护肤问题，但缺乏做出明智消费者决策所需的技术深度，且权威口吻的错误回答比承认不确定性的回答更不易引发怀疑，构成潜在风险。
AI.motivation: 随着消费者越来越多地向AI聊天机器人寻求护肤建议，LLM在化妆品化学方面的技术准确性尚未得到充分评估。本文旨在填补这一评估空白，为公众使用AI获取化妆品化学信息提供可靠性依据。
AI.method: 作者对14个LLM进行了结构化基准测试，测试主题涵盖化妆品成分的化学特性及消费者感兴趣的常见化妆品场景。测试期间禁用网络搜索，以评估各模型的内化知识而非联网检索能力。
AI.result: 整体性能较差，最突出的缺陷集中在定量推理和结构识别任务上。模型对一般性护肤问题回复合理，但回复普遍缺乏支持消费者明智决策所需的技术深度。此外，听起来权威但包含技术错误的回答比明确承认不确定性的回答更不易引起怀疑，构成安全隐患。
AI.conclusion: 通用LLM主要基于未经验证的公开数据训练，目前尚不能作为可靠的化妆品化学信息来源。需要两方面改进：在验证过的化学和皮肤病学数据集上进行微调，以及大幅提升算法推理能力，这些工具才可能被考虑用于公共用途。

title: DCI: Dependency Confidence Index for Assessing Open-Source Dependency Trustworthiness
summary: Selecting trustworthy open source software dependencies remains a major challenge in software supply chain security. We present the Dependency Confidence Index (DCI), a composite formative index that combines nine empirically weighted trust factors into a single normalized composite score for dependency selection. DCI's trust factors combine insights from a systematic literature review and an exploratory Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) survey of ten software developers, highlighting security, source code quality, and project health as the most influential dimensions. Following Goal-Question-Metric methodology, we implemented 12 automated measurements using SonarQube, GitHub APIs, and OpenSSF Scorecard data, deployed in a containerized evaluation platform. We conducted a pilot evaluation of the normalized DCI on 92 popular PyPI packages, observing moderate agreement with OpenSSF Scorecard scores and perfect test--retest reliability. Analysis reveals process-based factors (dependency management, CI) dominate scores on high-quality packages, while security metrics saturate---suggesting DCI's complementary role to existing tools. Our publicly available implementation provides a foundation for open source software trustworthiness research and practical dependency auditing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出依赖置信指数(DCI)，一个结合九个经验加权信任因素的综合形成性指数，用于开源软件依赖选择。DCI通过系统文献综述和AHP调查确定关键因素，实现12项自动化测量，并在92个PyPI包上进行了试点评估。
AI.motivation: 软件供应链安全中，选择可信的开源软件依赖仍然是一个重大挑战，缺乏综合性的、可量化的信任评估框架来指导依赖选择决策。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：首先通过系统文献综述和十名开发者的AHP调查确定九个信任因素；然后按照GQM方法论，利用SonarQube、GitHub API和OpenSSF Scorecard数据实现12项自动化测量；最后在容器化平台中对92个PyPI包进行试点评估。
AI.result: DCI与OpenSSF Scorecard评分呈现中等一致性，测试-重测可靠性完美。分析显示过程性因素（依赖管理、CI）主导高分包的得分，而安全指标趋于饱和，表明DCI对现有工具有补充作用。
AI.conclusion: DCI为开源软件可信度研究提供了可公开获取的实现基础，可用于实际依赖审计，并与现有工具形成互补而非替代关系。

title: pico-type: A 1.5M-Parameter Byte-Level Multi-Head Content Classifier
summary: We introduce pico-type, a byte-level multi-head content classifier with approximately 1.5 million parameters that simultaneously predicts seven content properties from raw UTF-8 bytes in a single forward pass. Operating directly at the byte level -- no tokenizer, no subword vocabulary, no pretrained embeddings -- pico-type classifies coarse type (12 classes), modality (8), subtype (24), code language (62), text language (30), file MIME type (90), and risk flags (6-label multi-label: API keys, JWTs, passwords, emails, phone numbers, SSH keys). The architecture combines a learned byte embedding, three convolutional blocks with growing receptive fields, two bidirectional attention layers with rotary position encodings, and a statistical pooling layer feeding seven Matryoshka-style classification heads. Four tiered variants (tiny/small/base/pro) share the same trunk with sliced representations from 16 to 576 dimensions, yielding ONNX exports under 210 KB and CPU inference under 10 ms. Trained on a mixture of synthetic templates and real-world data (8709 GitHub code samples, 5000 Wikipedia articles), pico-type achieves 60.3 percent code language accuracy on The Heap benchmark (24 languages) and 98.2 percent text language accuracy on Wikipedia (30 languages) -- improvements of +57 and +79 percentage points respectively over the synthetic-only baseline. Format-based heads (coarse, modality, subtype, file_mime, risk) maintain 100 percent accuracy on synthetic benchmarks. The model, code, and pretrained weights are released under Apache 2.0.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍pico-type，一个仅约150万参数的字节级多内容分类器，无需分词器或预训练嵌入，在单次前向传播中同时预测七种内容属性（粗类型、模态、子类型、代码语言、文本语言、文件MIME类型和风险标志）。模型采用学习字节嵌入、三个卷积块、双向注意力层和统计池化层，配合七个Matryoshka风格分类头，提供四种规格变体（tiny/small/base/pro），ONNX导出小于210KB，CPU推理小于10ms。在混合合成模板和真实数据上训练，代码语言准确率60.3%，文本语言准确率98.2%，分别比仅合成基线提升57和79个百分点。
AI.motivation: 传统内容分类器依赖分词器、子词词汇表和预训练嵌入，模型体积大、推理慢，难以在资源受限场景中部署。作者希望通过直接在原始UTF-8字节上操作，构建一个极轻量、多任务、可同时预测多种内容属性的分类器，实现高效且通用的内容理解。
AI.method: 架构包含学习字节嵌入、三个卷积块（感受野逐渐增大）、两个带旋转位置编码的双向注意力层，以及统计池化层，池化结果馈送给七个Matryoshka风格分类头。提供四种规格变体（tiny/small/base/pro）共用相同主干，切片维度从16到576不等。训练数据为合成模板与真实数据（8709个GitHub代码样本、5000篇维基百科文章）的混合。
AI.result: 在The Heap基准上（24种语言）代码语言准确率达60.3%，维基百科上（30种语言）文本语言准确率达98.2%，分别比仅合成基线提升57和79个百分点。基于格式的头（粗类型、模态、子类型、file_mime、风险）在合成基准上保持100%准确率。模型体积极小（ONNX导出<210KB），推理速度快（CPU<10ms）。
AI.conclusion: pico-type证明了一个紧凑的字节级模型能够同时有效地完成多种内容分类任务，在保持极小的模型尺寸和高推理效率的同时，通过结合真实世界数据训练显著提升了在开放领域的泛化能力。模型、代码和预训练权重已在Apache 2.0许可下开源。

title: Handoff-H1: An Orchestrated Vision-Agent System for Material Quantity Takeoff from Construction Blueprints
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures. Evaluation harness available on https://github.com/handoffai/residential-takeoff-benchmark/. Request data via e-mail to research@handoff.ai
summary: Converting a set of architectural blueprints into a complete material quantity takeoff requires visual perception across drawing sheets, dimensional and multi-hop reasoning, and grounding in construction conventions that the drawings never state. We present Handoff-H1, a takeoff system built from three layers: purpose-built computer-vision models that extract primitives; tool-using agents equipped with image operations and in-house visual-task tools, including CV-model-backed counting, detection and plan decomposition; and a persistent, hierarchically structured project foundation, grounded in a curated construction knowledge base. We evaluate on the Construction Blueprint Takeoff Benchmark: 10 real residential blueprint sets paired with consensus-validated expert takeoffs - 2,009 verified line items, restricted for scoring to the 1,348 primary-tier materials that drive an estimate - scored per trade by an LLM judge on material coverage and quantity Precision@25% (P@.25) and combined into a weighted composite. Under identical scoring from the raw PDF, seven frontier and open-weight models span composites of 35-61, and independent professional estimators - scored against the same reconciled gold standard - post 77.6% (65.5% coverage, 87.9% P@.25). Handoff-H1, working end-to-end from the raw PDF, reaches 81.6% (86.1% coverage, 78.8% P@.25): roughly 20 points above the strongest frontier agent, and above the independent estimators by pairing near-human quantity precision with coverage they do not reach. The evaluation harness is public for the open harbor framework; the blueprint sets and ground truth are available upon request for research use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Handoff-H1，一个从建筑蓝图自动生成材料工程量清单（takeoff）的系统。它由三层组成：专用计算机视觉模型提取图元、配备图像操作和视觉任务工具（计数、检测、平面图分解）的智能体、以及基于建筑知识库的分层项目基础。在 Construction Blueprint Takeoff Benchmark 上，Handoff-H1 端到端从原始 PDF 达到 81.6% 的综合得分（86.1% 覆盖率，78.8% P@.25），比最强的前沿智能体高约 20 分，甚至超过独立专业估算师（77.6%）。
AI.motivation: 将建筑蓝图转换为完整的材料工程量清单需要跨图纸的视觉感知、多跳推理以及对图纸中隐含的施工惯例的理解，这是一项极具挑战性的任务。现有的前沿模型在此任务上表现不佳（综合得分仅 35-61），甚至低于人类专业估算师，说明该任务需要专门设计的系统架构。
AI.method: Handoff-H1 采用三层架构：1) 目的性构建的计算机视觉模型来提取基本图元；2) 工具使用型智能体，配备图像操作工具和内部视觉任务工具（包括基于 CV 模型的计数、检测和平面图分解）；3) 持久的分层项目基础，以精心策划的建筑知识库为基础。
AI.result: 在包含 10 套真实住宅蓝图和 2,009 个已核验清单项（评分限定在 1,348 个主要层材料）的基准上，Handoff-H1 达到 81.6% 综合得分（86.1% 覆盖率，78.8% P@.25），超过最强的前沿智能体约 20 分，也超过独立专业估算师的 77.6%（65.5% 覆盖率，87.9% P@.25）。
AI.conclusion: Handoff-H1 通过将视觉感知、工具使用智能体和领域知识库相结合的专门设计，实现了超越人类专业估算师的端到端自动工程量清单生成，证明了针对特定领域任务进行系统化架构设计比通用模型更具优势。评估框架已公开，蓝图数据和标注可申请用于研究。

title: AMPLIFAI: A Multiphase CT Dataset for Benchmarking Clinical Reasoning in LI-RADS Assessment of Liver Lesions
summary: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the third leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with early detection improving survival from <20\% to >70\%. The standardized LI-RADS criteria establish a biopsy-free, fully imaging-based framework that can serve as a foundation for automating HCC diagnosis with artificial intelligence (AI). However, the lack of large, publicly available datasets with high-quality labels has limited the development of AI models for LI-RADS characterization. We introduce the \textbf{AMPLIFAI} dataset, the first public dataset of multiphase abdominal CT scans annotated with LI-RADS categories and segmented for three major LI-RADS features: arterial phase hyperenhancement, washout, and enhancing capsule. Following the \emph{Datasheets for Datasets} format, this paper details the dataset's composition, curation process, and annotation pipeline to facilitate transparent, reproducible research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AMPLIFAI数据集，这是首个公开的、按LI-RADS标准注释的多期腹部CT扫描数据集，包含三个主要LI-RADS特征的标注与分割，旨在推动基于AI的肝细胞癌自动化诊断研究。
AI.motivation: 肝细胞癌是全球第三大癌症致死原因，早期检测可将生存率从低于20%提升至超过70%。LI-RADS标准为无活检的全影像学诊断提供了框架，可作为AI自动化诊断的基础。然而，缺乏大规模、高质量标注的公开数据集严重限制了AI模型在LI-RADS特征描述方面的发展。
AI.method: 构建AMPLIFAI数据集：首个公开的多期腹部CT扫描数据集，按照LI-RADS分类进行标注，并对三个主要LI-RADS特征（动脉期高增强、廓清、强化包膜）进行分割。论文遵循Datasheets for Datasets格式，详细记录数据集的组成、筛选流程和标注流程。
AI.result: 成功创建并公开了AMPLIFAI数据集，这是首个带LI-RADS类别标注及三个主要特征分割的公开多期腹部CT数据集，并提供了完整的数据集文档。
AI.conclusion: 通过发布该数据集并记录详尽的标注流程，旨在促进透明、可复现的基于AI的HCC诊断研究，解决该领域缺乏高质量公开数据集的瓶颈。

title: P2E-VQ: ECG-linked representation augmentation for PPG via discrete patch retrieval
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely used in consumer wearables because of its low cost and ease of acquisition. However, unlike electrocardiography (ECG), PPG measures peripheral pulse dynamics rather than cardiac electrical activity, limiting its ability to predict cardiac conditions that rely on ECG-specific morphological cues. Existing methods attempt to bridge this gap by reconstructing ECG signals from PPG signals. However, this inverse mapping is inherently ill-posed, and faithful waveform reconstruction does not necessarily translate into improved downstream performance. To address this challenge, we propose P2E-VQ, a retrieval-augmented framework that replaces ECG waveform reconstruction with ECG-linked representation retrieval. Specifically, P2E-VQ converts PPG patches into discrete tokens and retrieves ECG-linked information from a memory bank constructed exclusively from the training data. This process augments PPG representations while requiring only PPG signals during inference. Extensive experiments on five public datasets covering six downstream tasks, including clinical endpoint prediction and affective state recognition, demonstrate that P2E-VQ consistently outperforms pretrained baselines under a unified frozen-feature linear-probing protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出P2E-VQ框架，通过检索增强而非波形重建的方式，将PPG信号与ECG相关信息关联，在不依赖ECG输入的情况下提升下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: PPG信号虽广泛用于可穿戴设备，但缺乏ECG的形态学线索，难以直接预测依赖ECG特征的心脏状况。现有PPG到ECG的重建方法本质上是病态逆问题，且波形重建质量与下游任务性能并不直接相关。
AI.method: P2E-VQ将PPG信号切分为patch并转化为离散token，通过从仅由训练数据构建的记忆库中检索ECG关联信息来增强PPG表征。推理阶段仅需PPG信号输入。
AI.result: 在五个公开数据集、六项下游任务（包括临床终点预测和情感状态识别）上，P2E-VQ在统一的冻结特征线性探测协议下持续优于预训练基线。
AI.conclusion: P2E-VQ验证了"检索增强替代波形重建"这一思路的有效性，为PPG在心脏健康监测等领域的应用提供了新范式。

title: Task- and Session-Level Model Routing: A Common-Interface Hybrid Evaluation of Four Open-Source Routers Across Four Benchmarks
summary: Agentic systems increasingly delegate model selection to a router, yet open-source routers are usually evaluated with different tasks, candidate pools, and execution protocols, limiting direct comparison. We present a common measurement protocol and hybrid evaluation of four router implementations across RouterBench, BFCL v4, tau2-bench, and WebArena. We evaluate 290 frozen tasks against a locked matrix of 2,610 candidate outcomes. Three routers emit constant or near-constant tier assignments; only vLLM Semantic Router varies materially with prompt content, and it has the highest observed success rate on none of the four benchmarks. Always-Mid matches Aurelio exactly on three benchmarks and within 0.003 on the fourth. For vLLM, task-level superiority tests detect no task-specific advantage over a share-matched content-blind allocation; equivalence is established only on WebArena at the protocol-declared five-percentage-point margin. The results show that, under these configurations and controls, observed gains track selected-tier composition more closely than demonstrated task-specific targeting. Fixed-tier baselines and selected-tier distributions are therefore necessary controls in router evaluation; the findings are scoped to these configurations, candidate pool, and frozen benchmark samples, not to routing paradigms in general.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的测量协议和混合评估框架，对四种开源路由器实现进行了公平对比。结果显示大多数路由器输出恒定或接近恒定的层级分配，只有vLLM Semantic Router会随提示内容变化，但其在四个基准上均未取得最高成功率。固定层级基线与所选层级分布是路由器评估中必要的对照组。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统越来越多地将模型选择委托给路由器，但开源路由器通常在不同的任务、候选池和执行协议下进行评估，导致无法直接对比，缺乏统一的度量标准。
AI.method: 提出统一的测量协议，在RouterBench、BFCL v4、tau2-bench和WebArena四个基准上，对290个冻结任务、锁定2610个候选结果的矩阵，对四种路由器实现进行混合评估。采用任务级优越性检验和共享匹配的内容无关分配对比方法。
AI.result: 三种路由器输出恒定或近恒定层级分配；只有vLLM Semantic Router随提示内容变化，但它在四个基准上均未获得最高成功率。Always-Mid与Aurelio在三个基准上完全匹配。vLLM在WebArena上仅在协议声明的五个百分点容忍度内建立等价性。
AI.conclusion: 在既定配置下，观察到的收益更多与所选层级组成相关，而非被证明的任务特定定位能力。路由器评估中必须包含固定层级基线和所选层级分布作为对照组，但研究结论仅限于特定配置、候选池和冻结基准样本。

title: Operationalizing the EU AI Act in Agile Software Development: A Guideline-Based Approach
summary: Context: The EU AI Act requires providers and deployers of Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems to implement documentation, risk management, and human oversight. Agile teams that ship AI features in short iterations lack specific artifacts to discharge these duties, since the regulation's abstract provisions do not map onto the Definition of Done, Sprint Reviews, or working agreements. Objective: We provide agile teams with an actionable compliance instrument: an evaluated guideline that operationalizes EU AI Act obligations as activities integrable into existing agile practice. We further document the translation method behind it so that the approach can be reused for adjacent regulations. Method: Following Design Science Research, we assessed each EU AI Act article along three dimensions. We subsequently classified the articles using a traffic-light scheme and mapped those deemed highly relevant to previously documented pain points of agile teams working with AI. We validated the resulting catalog with practitioners through a survey and 11 additional semi-structured expert interviews, analyzed via qualitative content analysis. Results: The guideline comprises 12 items covering roles and responsibilities, risk and quality management, transparency and traceability, monitoring, and regulatory sandboxes. Practitioners rated the catalog as understandable and relevant; feasibility varied with organizational maturity. Effective adoption towards EU AI Act compliance requires collective ownership across roles and integration into existing agile events rather than parallel compliance processes. Conclusions: The catalog gives agile teams a starting point to transform their delivery practices towards an EU AI Act compliance without dismantling agile practices.

AI.tldr: 本文基于设计科学研究方法，将欧盟AI法案的合规要求转化为12项可集成到现有敏捷实践中的具体活动清单，并通过实践者调查和专家访谈验证其可理解性与相关性，为敏捷团队提供可操作的合规工具。
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案要求AI系统的提供者和部署者实施文档管理、风险管理和人工监督，但该法规的抽象条款无法直接映射到敏捷团队的"完成定义"、Sprint评审或工作协议等具体实践中。敏捷团队在短迭代中交付AI功能，缺乏可用的具体工具来履行这些合规义务。
AI.method: 遵循设计科学研究方法：首先沿三个维度评估欧盟AI法案的每个条款，使用交通灯方案对条款进行分类，将高度相关的条款映射到此前记录的敏捷AI团队痛点；随后通过问卷调查和11次半结构化专家访谈（采用定性内容分析）验证生成的目录。
AI.result: 生成了包含12个条目的合规指南，涵盖角色与责任、风险与质量管理、透明度与可追溯性、监控和监管沙盒等方面。实践者认为该目录易于理解且相关，但可行性因组织成熟度而异。有效采用需要跨角色的集体责任以及将合规整合到现有敏捷活动中。
AI.conclusion: 该目录为敏捷团队提供了在不拆解敏捷实践的前提下向欧盟AI法案合规转型的起点，同时文档化的翻译方法也可复用于相邻法规。

title: NRCD: An Open Database of Collegiate Running with Unified Performance Standardization
comment: Accepted to CIKM'26 Resources Paper - Main Conference
summary: Collegiate running in the United States generates thousands of race results annually in cross country and track and field, yet no large-scale dataset has been publicly available for research. Existing websites such as Athletic.net, MileSplit, and TFRRS host results but do not support bulk download, restricting prior analyses to ~500 performances, often skewing studies toward male athletes. We introduce the National Running Club Database (NRCD), the first openly available collegiate running dataset at scale: 128,963 approved performances from 28,913 athletes across 1,336 meets in four sports (cross country (XC), indoor and outdoor track, and road races), 36.3% women, spanning 2004 through 2026. Within that single export, meets from August 2023 onward carry comprehensive course distance, elevation gain and loss, weather at race time, and track venue metadata (97.7% of XC rows with weather fields); earlier seasons back to 2004 are included with sparser metadata. NRCD is community-governed through open submission and expert approval and is maintained as a live database whose meet volume has grown yearly. We release a unified performance standardization framework that operationalizes established distance, elevation, and heat adjustments in one pipeline. Furthermore, we recommend gender-stratified modeling. On XC, full standardization lowers median within-athlete cross-meet variability by 51.0% (women) and 34.4% (men) versus raw times. We release the dataset and pipeline with a python package `nrcd' under FAIR principles, supporting longitudinal athlete modeling, environmental-confounder studies, and gender-equity research in collegiate sport.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了国家跑步俱乐部数据库（NRCD），这是首个公开的大规模美国大学跑步数据集，包含128,963条成绩记录、28,913名运动员、1,336场比赛，覆盖越野跑、室内外田径和路跑四个项目，时间跨度2004至2026年，其中女性占36.3%。数据集社区治理、持续更新，并配套统一性能标准化框架。标准化处理后，越野跑运动员内跨场比赛变异性显著降低（女性降51.0%、男性降34.4%），并以Python包`nrcd`按FAIR原则开源发布。
AI.motivation: 美国大学跑步每年产生数千场比赛结果，但缺乏大规模公开数据集。现有网站（Athletic.net等）不支持批量下载，以往研究仅能分析约500条成绩记录，且常偏向男性运动员，阻碍了性别平等和相关领域研究。
AI.method: 构建NRCD数据库：通过开放提交和专家审核的社区治理模式获取数据，涵盖四个运动项目并附带比赛距离、海拔升降、天气和场地元数据。同时开发统一性能标准化框架，整合距离、海拔和高温调整，并推荐按性别分层建模。
AI.result: NRCD包含128,963条经批准的成绩，来自28,913名运动员、1,336场比赛，36.3%为女性。标准化框架使越野跑运动员内跨场比赛变异中位数降低51.0%（女性）和34.4%（男性）。数据集以Python包形式按FAIR原则发布。
AI.conclusion: NRCD填补了大学跑步领域大规模公开数据集的空白，支持纵向运动员建模、环境混杂因素研究和性别平等研究，为体育科学研究提供开放基础设施。

title: RecurrentGPT: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation in Transformers
summary: Scaling transformer language models creates an inherent tension between expressivity and memory efficiency. While unique weights across layers preserve functional specialization---from input-grounding to abstract refinement---they incur a substantial memory footprint. Conversely, standard depth-sharing enforces uniform transformations that collapse representational diversity and degrade modeling quality. We introduce RecurrentGPT, a recurrent depth transformer where fixed-depth prelude and coda blocks bracket a single shared core iterated R times. Inspired by gated recurrent neural networks, we employ a lightweight projection and an elementwise update gate---conditioned on the hidden state, the fixed prelude output, and noise resampled at every step---to modulate the recurrent update. This allows the model to specialize the input to the same few layers across recurrences, rather than requiring many unique layers to achieve functional diversity. Under an isoFLOPS constraint, a 3-layer RecurrentGPT matches the accuracy of a 12-layer GPT-2 Small baseline with similar training and inference FLOPs, and leads MoR and heavy-tail depth sampling in all nine scale-by-budget cells; at medium and large scale it approaches dense quality at the standard token budget and overtakes it at medium scale once that budget is doubled. Under an isoPARAMS constraint, deeper recurrence achieves a 2.76 validation loss versus 2.84 for a non-recurrent counterpart at matched parameter and data budget. Our results demonstrate that adaptive depth reuse is a principled strategy for trading parameters for quality: at large scale, 63% fewer parameters and 59% less peak decoding memory for a 10% increase in compiled generation latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RecurrentGPT，一种循环深度Transformer架构，通过固定深度前奏和尾声块包裹单个共享核心层并迭代R次，利用轻量投影和元素级更新门（基于隐藏状态、前奏输出和每步重采样的噪声）来调制循环更新。在isoFLOPS约束下，3层RecurrentGPT匹配12层GPT-2 Small的精度；在isoPARAMS约束下，更深循环实现2.76验证损失对比非循环对应模型的2.84。大规模下可用63%更少的参数和59%更低的峰值解码内存，换取仅10%的编译生成延迟增加。
AI.motivation: 扩展Transformer语言模型在表达力与内存效率之间存在固有张力：各层独有权重虽保留功能特化（从输入接地到抽象精炼），但占用大量内存；而标准深度共享强制统一变换，导致表征多样性坍缩并降低建模质量。作者旨在解决这一矛盾，在不牺牲表达力的前提下提高参数和内存效率。
AI.method: 受门控循环神经网络启发，RecurrentGPT采用固定深度的前奏(prelude)和尾声(coda)块，中间包裹一个共享核心层并迭代R次。每个循环步使用轻量投影和元素级更新门来调制循环更新，该更新门条件依赖于隐藏状态、固定前奏输出以及每步重采样的噪声，使模型能够将输入特化到相同的少数层中跨循环运行，而非需要大量独立层来实现功能多样性。
AI.result: 在isoFLOPS约束下，3层RecurrentGPT匹配12层GPT-2 Small基线的精度，并在全部9个规模-预算单元格中优于MoR和重尾深度采样方法；在中大规模接近标准token预算下的密集质量，并在中等规模下当预算加倍时超越密集模型。在isoPARAMS约束下，更深循环实现2.76验证损失（对比非循环的2.84）。大规模下实现63%更少的参数和59%更低的峰值解码内存，仅增加10%编译生成延迟。
AI.conclusion: 自适应深度复用是将参数换取质量的合理策略：通过循环共享核心层并利用门控机制保持表征多样性，RecurrentGPT能在显著减少参数和内存的同时维持甚至超越密集模型的建模质量，证明了循环深度复用是平衡表达力与内存效率的有效方法。

title: MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling
comment: 12 pages, 6 pages appendix, 13 figures, technical report
summary: Part-aware 3D object generation is essential for graphics applications such as controllable modeling, editing, and articulation, where objects are represented as coherent assemblies of semantic parts. However, existing part-aware generation methods, do not scale well to highly complex objects. As the number of parts increases, generating detailed geometry becomes prohibitively expensive in token length and memory. We introduce MegaParts, a scalable autoregressive 3D generation framework to address this challenge by combining structured sequence modeling with a token-efficient vector-quantized shape tokenizer. Our tokenizer learns discrete latent representations for part-level geometry by minimizing token usage subject to high-fidelity reconstruction, enabling adaptive-length tokenization based on geometric complexity. On top of this compact representation, we train a large language model to generate object bounding boxes, part bounding boxes, and part shape tokens within a unified structured sequence. Combined with efficient long-context training strategy, our token-efficient formulation scales to objects with up to 300 parts and sequence lengths up to 256k tokens. This substantially extends the scale of part-aware 3D generation while preserving compositional structure and enabling fine-grained part-level control. Our method achieves higher mesh quality than baseline autoregressive and diffusion models, showing that compressed discrete part tokens improve not only scalability but also the achievable fidelity of generated geometry. These results suggest that LLM native token-efficient autoregressive modeling is a compelling alternative to diffusion for large-scale part-aware 3D generation. The project page is available at https://expmaster.github.io/megaparts_webpage.

AI.tldr: MegaParts是一种可扩展的自回归3D生成框架，通过结合结构化序列建模与token高效的矢量量化形状分词器，解决了部件级3D对象生成在高复杂度对象上难以扩展的问题。该方法支持多达300个部件、256k token序列长度，在网格质量和可扩展性上优于基线自回归模型和扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 部件感知的3D对象生成对图形应用（如可控建模、编辑和关节绑定）至关重要，但现有方法在部件数量增加时，生成详细几何所需的token长度和内存开销会变得极为昂贵，难以扩展到高复杂度对象。
AI.method: 1) 设计token高效的矢量量化形状分词器，学习部件级几何的离散潜在表示，在保证高质量重建的前提下最小化token使用量，实现基于几何复杂度的自适应长度token化。2) 基于紧凑表示训练大语言模型，在统一的结构化序列中生成对象边界框、部件边界框和部件形状token。3) 结合高效的长上下文训练策略。
AI.result: 方法支持多达300个部件和最长256k token的序列，显著扩展了部件感知3D生成的规模；在网格质量上优于基线自回归模型和扩散模型，证明压缩的离散部件token不仅提升可扩展性，还提升生成几何的保真度。
AI.conclusion: LLM原生token高效的自回归建模是面向大规模部件感知3D生成的、比扩散模型更具竞争力的替代方案，能够在保持组合结构的同时实现细粒度的部件级控制。

title: LUNG-KGMM: Knowledge-Guided Multimodal Learning for Lung Cancer Incidence Prediction
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, accepted by PRCV Oral
summary: Early identification of lung cancer risk is critical for timely intervention, yet existing prediction models are limited by their reliance on single data modalities and their inability to leverage structured clinical knowledge. We propose LUNG-KGMM, a knowledge-guided multimodal framework that integrates longitudinal electronic health records, radiology reports, chest radiograph representations, and guideline-derived knowledge for 1-to-6-year incident lung cancer prediction. To address modality heterogeneity and potential data leakage, we develop a leakage-sanitized report processing pipeline and a horizon-masked cumulative training objective that handles incomplete follow-up. We further introduce a knowledge-graph representation of clinical guidance that encodes report-triggered finding-attribute-action relations as an auditable knowledge stream. We build a multimodal development cohort from the publicly available MIMIC databases and construct a real-world validation cohort from the Xiamen Medical Big Data Platform. Extensive experiments on the MIMIC cohort demonstrate that LUNG-KGMM achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods, and validation on the Xiamen cohort further characterizes its cross-cohort portability and the need for local adaptation. The MIMIC development cohort is publicly accessible; the Xiamen cohort is governed by local data privacy regulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LUNG-KGMM，一个知识引导的多模态框架，整合纵向电子健康记录、放射学报告、胸片表征和指南推导知识，用于1-6年肺癌发病风险预测。该框架包含防泄漏的报告处理流水线、处理不完全随访的水平掩蔽累计训练目标，以及编码临床指南的知识图谱表示。在MIMIC公开数据和厦门医疗大数据平台真实世界数据上进行验证。
AI.motivation: 早期识别肺癌风险对及时干预至关重要，但现有预测模型受限于依赖单一数据模态，且无法利用结构化的临床知识。多模态信息的异质性问题和潜在的数据泄漏问题也未被充分解决。
AI.method: 1) 提出知识引导的多模态框架LUNG-KGMM，融合纵向EHR、放射学报告、胸片表征和指南推导知识；2) 开发防泄漏的报告处理流水线（leakage-sanitized report processing pipeline）；3) 提出水平掩蔽累计训练目标（horizon-masked cumulative training objective）处理不完全随访；4) 引入临床指南的知识图谱表示，编码报告触发的发现-属性-动作关系作为可审计的知识流。
AI.result: 在MIMIC队列上，LUNG-KGMM优于现有最先进方法；在厦门队列上的验证进一步刻画了其跨队列可移植性以及局部适配的需求。MIMIC开发队列公开发布，厦门队列受当地数据隐私法规约束。
AI.conclusion: 知识引导的多模态框架能有效提升肺癌风险预测性能，但跨机构部署仍需局部适配。该工作提供了可公开访问的开发队列和可复现的方法路线。

title: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs across Text and Audio Modalities for Accessible Disaster Assistance
summary: Effective disaster risk communication is a foundational humanitarian challenge, yet current emergency infrastructure fails to meet the needs of individuals with access and functional needs, including hard-of-hearing individuals, pregnant women, mothers with toddlers, and elderly individuals with dementia. Recent advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI), especially Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs), demonstrate powerful capabilities to serve diverse users across text, audio, image, and video modalities within a single unified system, such as a chatbot. However, their suitability for deployment rests on a property that receives limited scrutiny, i.e., whether these systems produce consistent, actionable outputs regardless of the modality through which a user communicates. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive analysis to understand the status of open-weight MM-LLMs using real emergency alert scenarios across four different vulnerable personas. These state-of-the-art (SOTA) models are evaluated on consistency of responses across text and audio modalities when the same task scenario is given. Findings indicate that no model achieves reliable consistency across modalities, and that performance gaps are heightened for personas with access needs, introducing modality-dependent inequity that undermines the humanitarian value of these systems. These results inform concrete design recommendations for building equitable, trustworthy, and inclusive AI tools for disaster risk communication.

AI.tldr: 本文针对灾害风险沟通中弱势群体（听障人士、孕妇、带幼儿母亲、失智老人）的需求，系统评估了开源多模态大语言模型（MM-LLMs）在文本和音频两种模态下对同一紧急告警场景响应的一致性。研究发现所有SOTA模型均无法实现跨模态的可靠一致性，且对具有特殊需求的群体表现更差，导致模态相关的不公平性，并据此提出构建公平、可信、包容性AI灾害沟通工具的设计建议。
AI.motivation: 有效的灾害风险沟通是人道主义领域的基础挑战，但现有应急基础设施无法满足有访问和功能需求人群的需要。尽管多模态大语言模型展现出服务多样化用户的潜力，但其是否能在不同模态下产生一致、可操作的输出这一问题鲜受关注，这直接关系到系统部署的适用性与公平性。
AI.method: 作者使用真实紧急告警场景，针对四种不同弱势用户画像（听障人士、孕妇、带幼儿母亲、失智老人），对开源MM-LLMs在文本和音频两种模态下的响应一致性进行综合分析和评估。
AI.result: 没有任何模型能在跨模态响应上实现可靠一致性；对有访问需求的群体，性能差距更为显著，引入了模态依赖的不公平性，削弱了这些系统的人道主义价值。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为构建公平、可信、包容的灾害风险沟通AI工具提供了具体的设计建议，强调了跨模态一致性作为评估和部署的关键维度。

title: ADEMM: A Longitudinal Method for Monitoring Developer Efficiency in Industry
summary: Context: Developer efficiency is influenced by technical, organizational, cognitive, and communication-related factors. However, most studies rely on one-time assessments or fixed instruments, limiting the ability to monitor how barriers emerge and change over time, especially in consulting and professional education contexts. Objective: This study proposes and evaluates the Adaptive Developer Efficiency Monitoring Method (ADEMM), an adaptive longitudinal method for monitoring developer efficiency when the monitoring organization does not directly employ the developers. Method: Following Design Science Research and Action Design Research, we conducted a mixed-method longitudinal study with 27 software developers over twelve survey cycles. ADEMM was designed and refined through five iterative cycles, combining recurring surveys, 18 semi-structured interviews, and joint evaluation with a problem owner. Results: The study resulted in ADEMM, a method that supports continuous data collection, mixed-methods integration, and iterative redesign of monitoring instruments. The evaluation produced three design principles: prioritization with the problem owner based on actionability, combination of closed and open data collection, and adaptation of items based on low variance and emerging qualitative signals. Conclusions: ADEMM provides a transferable approach for adaptive longitudinal monitoring of developer efficiency. It helps balance comparability, contextual sensitivity, and practical utility in environments where organizations need to support developers without directly controlling their work contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种自适应纵向监测方法ADEMM，用于在监测组织不直接雇佣开发人员的情况下监控开发人员效率。通过设计科学研究，对27名开发者进行了12轮调查循环和18次半结构化访谈，最终形成三种设计原则，为自适应纵向监测提供可迁移的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有开发人员效率研究多依赖一次性评估或固定工具，无法监测障碍随时间的变化，尤其在咨询和专业教育环境中，组织需要支持非直接雇佣的开发人员效率。
AI.method: 遵循设计科学研究（DSR）和行动设计研究（ADR），对27名软件开发者进行了12轮调查循环的混合纵向研究。ADEMM经过5个迭代循环设计和完善，结合重复调查、18次半结构化访谈以及与问题所有者（problem owner）的联合评估。
AI.result: 研究产出了ADEMM方法，支持持续数据收集、混合方法集成和监测工具的迭代再设计。评估得出三项设计原则：基于可行动性与问题所有者进行优先级排序、结合封闭式与开放式数据收集、基于低方差和新兴定性信号调整项目。
AI.conclusion: ADEMM提供了一种可迁移的自适应纵向监测方法，能在可比性、情境敏感性和实用效用之间取得平衡，适用于组织需要支持但不直接控制开发人员工作环境的场景。

title: A Pilot Study of Autocompleting Tokenizers
summary: Modern input methods routinely rely on autocomplete to omit information that can be recovered from local context. Inspired by these autocomplete-assisted writing systems, we investigate whether Transformer inputs can be compressed in a similar manner. Byte-level tokenization offers a simple and language-independent alternative to subword tokenization, but its longer input sequences typically result in increased computational cost and reduced model quality. We propose a compression scheme that employs a lightweight autoregressive byte language model to identify and remove bytes that are easily predictable from their surrounding context before Transformer processing. The resulting compressed representation is then provided as input to a standard encoder--decoder Transformer. Experiments on machine translation show that a substantial fraction of source-language bytes can be omitted without degrading translation quality. On English--French, our best method preserves translation performance while reducing source sequence length by nearly one-third. Additional experiments on Finnish--English, Russian--English, and Chinese--English demonstrate that the approach generalizes across diverse writing systems and morphological typologies, yielding comparable or improved translation quality at compression ratios between 0.47 and 0.67. These findings suggest that many input bytes are predictable enough to be represented implicitly rather than explicitly, providing a simple mechanism for reducing the sequence-length overhead associated with byte-level models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于字节级压缩的Transformer输入方案，通过轻量级自回归字节语言模型识别并移除上下文可预测的字节，在不损失翻译质量的前提下将源语言序列长度压缩近三分之一，并在多种语言对上验证了其泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 字节级分词虽简单且语言无关，但产生更长的输入序列，导致计算成本增加和模型质量下降。受自动补全系统启发，作者希望利用上下文可预测性来压缩输入，减少与字节级模型相关的序列长度开销。
AI.method: 使用一个轻量级自回归字节语言模型，在Transformer处理之前识别并移除那些易于从周围上下文预测的字节；压缩后的表示作为标准编码器-解码器Transformer的输入。
AI.result: 在英法翻译中，该方法在保持翻译性能的同时将源序列长度减少近三分之一；在芬兰语-英语、俄语-英语和中文-英语上，压缩比在0.47到0.67之间，翻译质量相当或更好，证明方法在不同书写系统和形态类型中均有效。
AI.conclusion: 许多输入字节足够可预测，可以隐式表示而非显式表示，这为降低字节级模型的序列长度开销提供了一种简单机制。

title: Qwen-Video-Edit: Instruction-Based Video Editing by Repurposing an Image Editing Model
summary: Instruction-based video editing is commonly built on video-pretrained generative backbones: a video diffusion transformer is adapted, at considerable cost, to condition on a source video and an editing instruction. In this report we explore a different route and show that a strong instruction-based image editing model can edit videos by operating directly on video-VAE latents. Starting from Qwen-Image-Edit, we arrange the latent frames of a Wan~2.1 video VAE as tiles of one large virtual image, reuse the editor's image positional encoding for every tile, and bridge the two latent spaces with a pair of lightweight input/output projections warm-started from the editor's own patchify and unpatchify layers, so that at initialization a (static) video is embedded exactly as an image the model already understands. The whole system is then fine-tuned on the public Ditto-1M editing triplets, and a few denoising steps of Wan~2.2 serve as an optional temporal enhancer. We motivate the design with a chain of zero-training observations: the stock image editor already edits a video presented as a contact sheet; it is indifferent to whether the sheet's tokens come from one joint encode or from per-frame encodes stitched in latent space; and it even edits genuine video latents zero-shot to a clearly recognizable degree, leaving fine-tuning only a fidelity gap to close. Our results suggest that, despite the large investment in training video latent spaces, per-frame video latents remain close enough to the image domain that mature image editing priors transfer with minimal adaptation. Project Page: https://yunpeng1998.github.io/Qwen-Video-Edit-Page; Code: https://github.com/yunpeng1998/Qwen-Video-Edit; Model: https://huggingface.co/yunpeng1998/Qwen-Video-Edit.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了一种不同于传统视频编辑的方法：直接使用强大的基于指令的图像编辑模型（Qwen-Image-Edit）作用于视频VAE潜在表示，通过将视频潜在帧排列为大型虚拟图像的拼接块，并利用轻量级的输入/输出投影层桥接两种潜在空间，实现了无需大规模训练的视频编辑。该方法在Ditto-1M数据集上微调，并使用Wan 2.2进行可选的时序增强，结果表明成熟的图像编辑先验可以以最小化适配迁移到视频领域。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于指令的视频编辑通常需要构建在视频预训练生成骨干上，即需要对视频扩散Transformer进行昂贵的适配才能处理源视频和编辑指令。作者希望探索一种更经济有效的替代路径，验证是否可以利用成熟的图像编辑模型直接处理视频潜在表示，从而避免大规模的视频特定训练成本。作者通过一系列零训练观察（如图像编辑器能编辑以联系表形式呈现的视频）来支撑这一设计动机。
AI.method: 该方法从Qwen-Image-Edit出发，将Wan 2.1视频VAE的潜在帧排列为一张大型虚拟图像的瓦片（tiles），复用编辑器的图像位置编码，并通过一对轻量级输入/输出投影层桥接两个潜在空间（从编辑器的patchify和unpatchify层热启动）。在初始化时，静态视频被精确嵌入为模型已理解的图像。整个系统在公开的Ditto-1M编辑三元组上进行微调，并可选地使用Wan 2.2的少量去噪步骤作为时序增强器。设计动机基于一系列零训练观察：原版图像编辑器已能编辑以联系表形式呈现的视频；对信号来自联合编码或逐帧编码拼接不敏感；甚至能以零样本方式编辑真实的视频潜在表示。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，尽管在视频潜在空间训练上有大量投入，逐帧视频潜在表示仍然与图像域足够接近，使得成熟的图像编辑先验能够以最小化适配成功迁移。该方法通过零训练观察验证了设计可行性，并通过微调弥补了保真度差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论表明，视频逐帧潜在表示与图像域保持接近，成熟图像编辑先验可以作为视频编辑的基础，无需昂贵的视频特定训练。该方法提供了一种高效替代方案，并开源了项目页面、代码和模型。

title: When Uncertainty Isn't Enough: An Empirical Study of Self-Correction in Code Generation
summary: Large language models for code generation often produce incorrect solutions without reliable indicators of failure. We study whether uncertainty estimation methods developed for natural language transfer to code generation, and whether such signals can improve code generation via selective self-correction. We evaluate five uncertainty methods: mean token entropy, verbalized confidence, $P(\text{True})$, entropy ensembles, and semantic entropy probes, across three small code LLMs on HumanEval and BigCodeBench. We find that multi-sample $P(\text{True})$ achieves the strongest correlation with correctness, while all the other methods, including semantic entropy probes, yield only weak correlation. We then use these uncertainty signals to drive three self-correction policies: adaptive decoding, uncertainty-based regeneration, and verification-based regeneration. Our results reveal a stronger negative finding than anticipated: uncertainty-based self-correction fails to reliably improve Pass@1, degrading accuracy in 5 of 6 configurations across both benchmarks ($-3$pp to $-10$pp), and adaptive decoding degrades accuracy in 4 of 6 configurations. Only verification-based self-correction reliably improves Pass@1, with gains of $+6$ to $+26$ percentage points on HumanEval and $+8$ to $+20$ percentage points on BigCodeBench, scaling inversely with baseline strength. These findings replicate consistently across both benchmarks and suggest that cheap uncertainty estimators are insufficient on their own to improve code correctness, and that their practical value lies in serving as gating signals for costlier execution-based correction loops rather than as standalone substitutes for verification.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了不确定性估计方法在代码生成任务中的表现，发现多采样P(True)与正确性相关性最强，但基于不确定性的自纠错方法大多无法可靠提升Pass@1，仅有基于验证的自纠错能稳定带来显著改进，表明不确定性信号应作为验证循环的门控信号而非独立替代方案。
AI.motivation: 代码生成的大语言模型常常产生错误答案且缺乏可靠的失败指标，作者希望探究自然语言领域的不确定性估计方法能否迁移到代码生成领域，并检验这些信号是否能通过选择性自纠错来提升代码正确性。
AI.method: 评估五种不确定性方法（均值token熵、口头化置信度、P(True)、熵集成、语义熵探针）在三个小型代码LLM上于HumanEval和BigCodeBench基准的表现；随后利用这些不确定性信号驱动三种自纠错策略：自适应解码、基于不确定性的重新生成、基于验证的重新生成。
AI.result: 多采样P(True)与正确性相关性最强，其余方法（包括语义熵探针）相关性较弱。基于不确定性的自纠错在6个配置中有5个降低准确率（-3pp至-10pp），自适应解码在6个配置中有4个降低准确率。仅有基于验证的自纠错稳定提升Pass@1，HumanEval上+6至+26个百分点，BigCodeBench上+8至+20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 廉价的不确定性估计器本身不足以提升代码正确性，其实践价值在于作为更昂贵的基于执行的纠错循环的门控信号，而非作为验证的独立替代方案。

title: Factors Impacting Developer Efficiency: Results from an Adaptive Longitudinal Study
summary: Context: Developer efficiency is driven by technical, organizational, and personal factors, yet few longitudinal studies explore how these factors evolve over time. Objective: This study investigates the primary factors hindering the perceived efficiency of developers in a consulting and professional development context, analyzing how these factors vary across recurring data collection cycles and how they are described qualitatively. Method: We conducted a mixed-methods longitudinal case study applying the Adaptive Developer Efficiency Monitoring Method (ADEMM) to 27 external software developers, combining twelve waves of periodic surveys with eighteen semi-structured interviews, analyzed through statistical and thematic analysis. Results: The most frequent bottlenecks were organizational dependencies and waiting for external validation, which stayed structurally stable, followed by technical knowledge gaps, which declined as developers adapted. A generative AI usage barrier emerged qualitatively nine waves into the study, was incorporated into the survey instrument, and became the most frequently coded interview theme. Interviews corroborated the quantitative findings, with insufficient requirements documentation and organizational dependencies as the most recurrent themes alongside AI-related challenges. Conclusions: Perceived developer efficiency is highly dynamic and cannot be accurately captured through a single cross-sectional measurement. Adaptive monitoring via ADEMM identified an emerging factor, generative AI usage barriers, that a fixed instrument would have missed, and informed a concrete organizational intervention during the study. For organizations managing external developers, actions should target external dependencies, communication channels, and developers' evolving use of AI tools.

AI.tldr: 本文通过混合方法的纵向案例研究，运用ADEMM方法对27名外部软件开发者进行了12轮周期性调查和18次半结构化访谈，发现感知开发者效率的主要障碍是组织依赖和等待外部验证，这些因素在结构上保持稳定，而技术知识缺口随时间下降。研究还发现生成式AI使用障碍这一新兴因素，固定工具无法捕获。
AI.motivation: 开发者效率受到技术、组织和个人因素的驱动，但很少有纵向研究探索这些因素如何随时间演化。现有研究多采用横截面测量，无法准确捕捉开发者效率的动态变化特征。
AI.method: 采用混合方法的纵向案例研究，应用自适应开发者效率监测方法（ADEMM），对27名外部软件开发者实施12轮周期性调查（定量）和18次半结构化访谈（定性），结合统计分析和主题分析进行数据处理。
AI.result: 最频繁的瓶颈是组织依赖和等待外部验证，结构上保持稳定；技术知识缺口随开发者适应而下降。生成式AI使用障碍在第九轮定性出现后纳入调查工具，成为访谈中最常编码的主题。定性访谈证实了定量发现，需求文档不充分和组织依赖是最反复出现的主题。
AI.conclusion: 感知开发者效率高度动态，无法通过单次横截面测量准确捕获。ADEMM自适应监测能识别固定工具无法发现的新兴因素（如生成式AI使用障碍），并在研究期间指导了具体的组织干预。对于管理外部开发者的组织，应针对外部依赖、沟通渠道和开发者不断演化的AI工具使用进行干预。

title: DCA-MoE: Spatially Adaptive Cross-Layer Fusion and Density-Routed Experts for Crowd Counting
summary: Crowd counting must recover reliable local density under severe variations in perspective, head scale, occlusion, and background clutter. Although modern counting objectives provide strong spatial supervision, many multi-level decoders still use spatially invariant feature fusion and apply one receptive-field pattern to every location. We propose DCA-MoE, a framework that makes both decisions content dependent while retaining a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Spatially Adaptive Layer Fusion (SALF) predicts position-wise weights over four aligned backbone features, and Density-Routed Multi-Receptive-Field Experts (DR-MoE) assigns each location a soft mixture of local, mid-range, and large-context residual experts. An EBC-style head reconstructs block density, while DMCount supervision and an auxiliary routing-balance term train the decoder without updating the backbone. On the NWPU-Crowd validation split, the strongest paired configuration, based on DINOv3 ViT-L/16, obtains 31.7 MAE and 72.2 RMSE; the matched ViT-B/16 full model obtains a paired 32.2/75.9. Cross-dataset results remain mixed, and several component baselines currently report independently selected minima from a single seed. The evidence therefore supports the feasibility of spatially adaptive fusion and routing, while broader paired and multi-seed evaluation remains necessary for causal attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DCA-MoE框架，通过空间自适应层融合（SALF）和密度路由多感受野专家（DR-MoE）实现内容相关的特征融合与感受野选择，结合冻结的DINOv3编码器进行人群计数。在NWPU-Crowd验证集上取得较好效果（ViT-L/16配置MAE 31.7，RMSE 72.2），但跨数据集结果不稳定，需配对评估和多种子实验以验证因果归因。
AI.motivation: 现有多层级人群计数解码器使用空间不变的特征融合方式，对所有位置应用单一感受野模式，无法应对透视、头部尺度、遮挡和背景杂波等严重变化，需要使融合决策和感受野选择都依赖于内容。
AI.method: 1) SALF（空间自适应层融合）：预测四个对齐骨干特征上逐位置的权重；2) DR-MoE（密度路由多感受野专家）：为每个位置分配局部、中距离和大范围残差专家的软混合；3) EBC风格头部重建块密度；4) DMCount监督和辅助路由平衡项训练解码器，骨干网络保持冻结。
AI.result: 在NWPU-Crowd验证集上，基于DINOv3 ViT-L/16的最强配对配置取得MAE 31.7和RMSE 72.2；匹配的ViT-B/16完整模型取得MAE 32.2和RMSE 75.9。跨数据集结果不稳定，部分组件基线报告的是单种子下的独立最小选择。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持空间自适应融合和路由的可行性，但需要更广泛的配对评估和多种子实验来验证因果关系。

title: Why Vision Fails as a Universal Bridge: Rectifying Modality Asynchrony in Multilingual MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit substantial performance degradation in non-English visual reasoning, despite the strong multilingual competence of their text-only backbones. While mechanistic evidence from text-only models suggests that non-English inputs are routed through an English-centric latent space, the multimodal implications of this phenomenon remain unexplored. Through rigorous mechanistic analysis, we identify the \textbf{Ghost Anchor} phenomenon: a temporal modality asynchrony where linguistic translation to the English semantic manifold completes in early layers, while visual semanticization remains immature. Consequently, visual signals are physically present yet functionally invisible during the early alignment window. To rectify this, we propose \textbf{ANCHOR}, a training framework employing Proactive Visual Anchoring (PVA) to accelerate early visual semantic emergence, ensuring visual representations proactively guide linguistic translation. Mechanistic interventions confirm that ANCHOR successfully restores the causal influence of visual signals during early translation. Furthermore, extensive experiments on XMMMU, MaXM, and CVQA demonstrate that ANCHOR consistently outperforms standard baselines, achieving robust visual reasoning across both fine-tuned and zero-shot languages.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在非英语视觉推理中存在显著的性能下降，并通过机制分析识别出"Ghost Anchor"现象：语言翻译在早期层即完成到英语语义空间的映射，而视觉语义化尚未成熟，导致视觉信号在早期对齐窗口中"物理存在但功能不可见"。为此提出ANCHOR训练框架，通过主动视觉锚定（PVA）加速早期视觉语义涌现，使视觉表征主动引导语言翻译。实验证明该方法在XMMMU、MaXM和CVQA上均优于标准基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在非英语视觉推理中性能严重下降，尽管其纯文本骨干具备强大的多语言能力。虽然已有研究从文本模型角度揭示非英语输入通过英语中心潜在空间进行路由，但这一现象在多模态场景中的影响尚未被探索。
AI.method: 通过严格的机制分析识别"Ghost Anchor"现象（时间维度上的模态异步：语言翻译提前完成、视觉语义化滞后），并提出ANCHOR训练框架，采用主动视觉锚定（PVA）加速早期视觉语义涌现，让视觉表征在语言翻译过程中发挥主动引导作用。
AI.result: 机制干预证实ANCHOR成功恢复了视觉信号在早期翻译阶段的因果影响；在XMMMU、MaXM和CVQA基准上的大量实验表明，ANCHOR在微调语言和零样本语言上均一致优于标准基线，实现了鲁棒的视觉推理。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次从机制层面阐明了MLLMs中多语言视觉推理性能下降的根源（Ghost Anchor现象），并提出了有效的训练框架ANCHOR来解决这一问题，验证了加速视觉语义早期涌现对于多语言视觉推理的关键作用。

title: Zero-Shot Adaptation of Medical Vision Foundation Models for High-Frequency Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation
summary:
Prostate cancer claims a life every 80 seconds. Early detection is needed to prevent disease progression, and both PSA density calculation and biopsy decisions rely on knowing the exact boundary of the gland. Conventional ultrasound at 6-12 MHz blurs this boundary, missing one in three high-risk cancers. Micro-ultrasound (29 MHz) improves resolution threefold but introduces dense acoustic speckle that obscures the outer wall; given the same image, two clinicians draw outlines differing by over 10% in area. Supervised methods are costly and generalise poorly across scanners. Can a foundation model segment the prostate with no training data?
  We present the first zero-shot pipeline for this modality: MedSAM, pre-trained on over 1.5 million medical images, localises the prostate; we then apply CLAHE to sharpen the outer wall, binary dilation to recover missed pixels, and Fourier smoothing (4 modes, s=1.05) to refine the boundary. MedSAM requires a spatial prompt, so we evaluate bounding-box and point-click strategies across 75 patients of the Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation dataset (2,621 slices).
  On the 20-patient held-out test set, the pipeline reduces mean boundary-distance error by 45% (Dice 0.749+/-0.043 to 0.865+/-0.029; HD95 217.2+/-36.9 to 120.1+/-26.1 px), reaching Dice 0.859 across the cohort. Its mean overlap shows no significant difference from the three non-expert rater groups (p>0.19), while segmenting 38-52% more consistently (lower inter-patient standard deviation). Point-click prompts fail regardless of placement (best Dice=0.350), because speckle gives no stable local contrast. Only an approximate bounding box is required, so any clinic can deploy it without data collection, annotation, or retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出基于MedSAM的零样本（zero-shot）微超声前列腺分割流程。通过CLAHE锐化、二值膨胀和傅里叶平滑等后处理步骤，在2,621张切片（75名患者）的微超声数据集上，将平均边界距离误差降低45%（Dice从0.749提升至0.865，HD95从217.2降至120.1像素），分割表现与非专家影像科医生无显著差异，且一致性更高（变异系数低38-52%）。仅需粗略边界框提示即可部署，无需任何数据收集、标注或重新训练。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌早期检测依赖精确的腺体边界，但传统超声（6-12 MHz）分辨率不足会漏掉三分之一的高危癌症；微超声（29 MHz）虽分辨率提升三倍，却引入密集声学散斑噪声使外壁模糊，导致医生间勾画面积差异超10%。监督学习方法成本高且跨扫描仪泛化差，因此需要探索无需训练数据的零样本分割方案。
AI.method: 采用MedSAM（基于超过150万医学图像预训练的基础模型）作为分割核心，通过边界框（bounding-box）或点点击（point-click）提示定位前列腺；随后应用CLAHE锐化外壁、二值膨胀恢复漏检像素、傅里叶平滑（4个模式，s=1.05）细化边界。在75名患者的微超声前列腺分割数据集（2,621切片）上评估两种提示策略，20名患者留作测试集。
AI.result: 在20名患者测试集上，平均边界距离误差降低45%（Dice达0.865±0.029，HD95达120.1±26.1像素），全队列Dice为0.859。与三组非专家评分者相比无显著差异（p>0.19），且患者间一致性更高。点提示无论放置位置均失败（最佳Dice仅0.350），因散斑缺乏稳定局部对比度；仅边界框提示有效。
AI.conclusion: 仅需一个粗略的边界框提示，任何诊所无需数据收集、标注或重训练即可部署该零样本微超声前列腺分割方案，展现了基础模型在低资源临床场景中的应用潜力。边界框提示优于点提示的关键在于散斑噪声下局部对比度不稳定，而全局定位信息更具鲁棒性。

title: Ring-based Spatial Transformer: Learning Non-linear Spatial Interactions between Building Distribution and Pedestrian Flow
summary: This study proposes a ring-based SpatialTransformer to learn how building uses at different distances from a railway station interact to generate pedestrian flow. Concentric ring buffers at 100-meter intervals up to 800 meters were defined around 100 randomly selected stations in Tokyo, treating each ring as a spatial token. Self-Attention was applied to learn inter-zone interactions directly from data, without prior structural assumptions. GPS-derived walking trip counts served as the target variable and Geographically Weighted Regression as the baseline. Across 30 independent trials, the SpatialTransformer consistently outperformed GWR in predictive accuracy. SHAP analysis revealed that mid-to-outer distance zone features dominate pedestrian flow prediction, while features from the 0-100m zone contributed little. The attention matrix showed that each distance zone attends most strongly to spatially distant zones, demonstrating that pedestrian flow is regulated by structural interactions across the entire catchment area rather than by any single zone in isolation. These findings challenge the compact city assumption that station-proximate development maximizes pedestrian flow, and suggest that land use distribution across the full walkable catchment area deserves greater consideration in urban planning practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于环形缓冲区(ring-based)的SpatialTransformer模型,以东京100个车站周边800米范围内的同心圆环作为空间token,通过自注意力机制学习不同距离圈层土地用途之间的相互作用来预测行人流量。模型在30次独立试验中一致优于地理加权回归(GWR)基线。SHAP分析发现中远距离圈层的特征对预测贡献最大,而0-100米圈层贡献最小;注意力矩阵显示各距离圈层更关注空间上较远的圈层,表明行人流量由整个步行影响区的结构性互动决定,而非单一圈层。这一发现挑战了紧凑城市理论中"车站邻近开发最大化行人流量"的假设,提示城市规划应更重视完整步行影响区的土地利用分布。
AI.motivation: 传统上,城市规划多基于"紧凑城市"假设,认为车站邻近区域的开发能最大化行人流量。然而,行人流量可能受到车站周边整个步行影响区内土地用途之间复杂交互作用的影响,而非仅由近站区域单方面决定。现有方法(如GWR)无法有效捕捉这种跨空间圈层的非线性交互关系,因此需要一种不依赖先验结构假设、能从数据中直接学习区间交互的模型来验证这一假设。
AI.method: 围绕东京100个随机选择的车站,以100米为间隔定义至800米的同心环形缓冲区,每个环形作为空间token。采用自注意力机制(Self-Attention)直接学习各距离圈层之间的交互作用,无需先验结构假设。以GPS衍生的步行出行次数作为目标变量,地理加权回归(GWR)作为基线模型进行对比。通过30次独立试验评估预测精度,并使用SHAP分析和注意力矩阵进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: SpatialTransformer在30次独立试验中一致优于GWR的预测精度。SHAP分析表明中远距离圈层特征主导行人流量预测,0-100米圈层贡献最小。注意力矩阵显示每个距离圈层最强关注空间上较远的圈层,验证了行人流量受整个影响区结构性交互调控。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了紧凑城市假设——车站邻近密集开发未必是最大化行人流量的唯一或最佳路径。整个可步行影响区的土地利用分布对行人流量有更重要的调控作用,城市规划实践中应给予更全面的考虑。

title: Cross-Domain Industrial Fault Detection by Causal Mechanism Monitoring
summary: Unsupervised fault detection in industrial systems is dominated by reconstruction based methods that monitor individual sensor marginal distributions. This misses coupling faults, where the physical relationship between sensor groups breaks while marginal statistics remain normal. Such faults evade marginal monitoring and persist as latent failures, with direct consequences for system reliability and safety. We propose CMR-Mamba (Causal Mechanism Representation Mamba), which trains per domain Mamba state-space encoders on healthy data. A causal cross-modal predictor regularises these encoders so that the effect-channel manifold reflects the normal cause-to-effect coupling. Anomalies are scored by k-nearest-neighbour (kNN) distance on this manifold or by the mechanism residual between the observed and the causally predicted effect embedding. We evaluate CMR-Mamba on electromechanical (Paderborn bearings), hydraulic (ZeMA) and cyber-physical (SWaT) coupling-fault domains. Ablations establish two findings. First, k-NN manifold scoring, rather than the encoder family, is the dominant source of gain over reconstruction-error scoring, improving baselines by up to 0.42 AUROC and exceeding the gain from causal regularisation. Second, aggregate AUROC is saturated by easy faults that any strong method solves, so the methods separate only on the low-separability subset. There CMR-Mamba leads the evaluated baselines on Paderborn artificial defects and on SWaT stealthy attacks, which keep every sensor inside its normal range and which marginal methods detect only at chance. CMR-Mamba therefore offers an interpretable and consistently competitive approach to coupling-fault detection across mechanical, hydraulic and cyber-physical systems. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/status/CMR_Mamba_MFD_1177.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CMR-Mamba（因果机制表示Mamba），一种无监督耦合故障检测方法。它利用Mamba状态空间编码器对健康数据进行训练，并通过因果跨模态预测器正则化编码器，使效应通道流形反映正常的因果关系耦合。通过kNN距离或机制残差进行异常评分，在机电、液压和网络物理系统上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于重构的无监督故障检测方法仅监控各传感器边际分布，无法检测耦合故障——即传感器组间物理关系被破坏而边际统计仍正常的故障。这类故障会逃避边际监控并持续存在，直接影响系统可靠性与安全性，因此需要建模传感器间因果耦合关系的方法。
AI.method: 1) 为每个域训练Mamba状态空间编码器处理健康数据；2) 使用因果跨模态预测器正则化编码器，使效应通道流形反映正常因果耦合；3) 通过两种评分方式检测异常：kNN距离（基于流形）或机制残差（观测效应嵌入与因果预测效应嵌入之差）。
AI.result: 在Paderborn轴承（机电）、ZeMA（液压）和SWaT（网络物理）三个耦合故障域上验证。消融实验发现：1) kNN流形评分是主要增益来源（AUROC提升最多0.42），超过因果正则化的贡献；2) 聚合AUROC被简单故障饱和，方法主要在低可分性子集上区分。CMR-Mamba在Paderborn人工缺陷和SWaT隐蔽攻击上领先基线，后者使每个传感器保持正常范围，边际方法仅在随机水平。
AI.conclusion: CMR-Mamba提供了一种可解释且持续有竞争力的耦合故障检测方法，适用于机械、液压和网络物理系统，特别擅长检测那些使所有传感器保持在正常范围内的隐蔽攻击。

title: The Specification Paradox: Rethinking Requirements Engineering in the Age of AI
summary: The growing adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Software Engineering has reinforced the expectation that coding activities can be largely automated. However, this perception may represent yet another historical search for a solution capable of eliminating the inherent challenges of software development. This article discusses the transition from a code-centered paradigm to Specification-Driven Development. We argue that artificial intelligence reduces some of the effort associated with writing source code, but it does not eliminate the complexity of developing professional software systems. Instead, it shifts this complexity toward domain understanding, requirements elicitation, specification development, validation, maintenance, and software evolution. Building on this perspective, we discuss the renewed centrality of Requirements Engineering, considering its implications for productivity and software quality, as well as risks associated with automation bias, ambiguity propagation, Specification Overfitting, and the accumulation of Specification Debt. Finally, we propose the Specification Paradox: the more capable artificial intelligence systems become at automatically generating software, the greater the dependence on correct, complete, verifiable, and explainable human-produced specifications. We conclude that the future of Software Engineering will depend not only on machines' ability to generate code, but also on humans' ability to correctly specify, evaluate, and evolve what is intended to be built.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了从以代码为中心的范式向规范驱动开发（Specification-Driven Development）的转变。作者认为AI虽然减少了编写源代码的工作量，但并未消除软件开发的专业复杂度，而是将复杂度转移到领域理解、需求获取、规范开发、验证、维护和软件演化等方面。文章提出了"规范悖论"（Specification Paradox）：AI生成软件的能力越强，对正确、完整、可验证且可解释的人类规范的需求就越强。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在软件工程中的广泛应用，人们普遍期望编码活动可以大幅自动化。但这种观念可能只是历史上又一次寻找消除软件开发固有挑战的万能解决方案。作者旨在纠正这种误解，揭示AI并未消除软件开发的复杂度，而是改变了复杂度的分布位置。
AI.method: 本文是一篇观点/立场文章（position paper），通过论证和推理探讨从代码中心范式到规范驱动开发的转变。文章分析了需求工程在AI时代的重新中心化地位，并提出了多个概念框架：规范悖论、自动化偏差、歧义传播、规范过拟合（Specification Overfitting）和规范债务（Specification Debt）。
AI.result: 文章提出了"规范悖论"这一核心论点：AI系统自动生成软件的能力越强，对高质量人类规范的依赖就越大。同时识别了四个关键风险：自动化偏差、歧义传播、规范过拟合和规范债务的累积，这些风险在AI驱动的开发范式中尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 软件工程的未来不仅取决于机器生成代码的能力，更取决于人类正确规范、评估和演化所构建系统意图的能力。需求工程将在AI时代重新获得核心地位，成为决定软件质量和生产力的关键因素。

title: Grounding Healthcare LLMs in a Causal Knowledge Graph: Framework, Metrics, and a Cardiovascular Pilot
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed for healthcare decision support, but their evaluations still reward single-answer accuracy rather than reasoning about interventions, mechanisms, harms, evidence, and uncertainty. We propose a reproducible, graph-centered evaluation framework for intervention-oriented LLM behavior in healthcare and stress-test it in a cardiovascular pilot. The framework has four components: (i) a domain causal knowledge graph in which assertions are first-class, provenance-preserving nodes with stable identifiers; (ii) a scenario-conditioned subgraph extraction step that, given any clinical scenario, retrieves the relevant reified-assertion subgraph; (iii) four controlled grounding conditions that vary how the retrieved subgraph is composed into the model's context (ungrounded C1, knowledge-graph C2, causal-graph C3, integrated C4); and (iv) an automated scoring pipeline, anchored on assertion identifiers, that computes intervention accuracy, and other evaluation measures on a single pass. To test the framework, we built a category-balanced scenario generator across eight reasoning failure modes and instantiated it on a cardiovascular graph. The metric panel discriminates conditions along interpretable, non-redundant axes: C4 obtains the strongest causal edge F1 (0.838), adverse-effect F1 (0.833), evidence accuracy (0.738), and unsupported claim rate (0.114), while C1 obtains the highest raw intervention accuracy (0.948) with no measurable causal or evidential grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可复现的、以图为中心的评估框架，用于评估大语言模型在医疗干预决策中的推理能力，超越了传统的单一答案准确率评估。框架包含领域因果知识图谱、场景条件子图提取、四种接地条件、自动化评分管线四个组件，并在心血管领域进行压力测试。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在医疗决策支持中的评估仍只关注单一答案的准确性，未能充分评估模型对干预措施、机制、危害、证据和不确定性的推理能力，缺乏可复现的评估框架。
AI.method: 框架包含四部分：(i) 以断言为第一公民的领域因果知识图谱，保留来源和稳定标识符；(ii) 场景条件下提取相关子图；(iii) 四种受控接地条件（未接地C1、知识图谱C2、因果图C3、集成C4）；(iv) 基于断言标识符的自动化评分管线，计算干预准确性等指标。通过八种推理失败模式的场景生成器在心血管图上进行测试。
AI.result: 指标面板能沿可解释、非冗余的轴区分条件：C4获得最强因果边F1（0.838）、不良效应F1（0.833）、证据准确性（0.738）和最低无依据声明率（0.114），而C1获得最高原始干预准确率（0.948）但缺乏可测量的因果或证据接地。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效区分模型在不同接地条件下的表现差异，揭示"表面准确性"与"实质性推理质量"之间的分离——未接地的模型虽有高分但缺乏因果和证据基础，而集成接地（C4）提供了最全面的推理质量。

title: A Declarative-Procedural Perspective on Expert Routing in Bilingual Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
summary: We investigate whether Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models develop linguistically structured expert routing during bilingual language acquisition. Inspired by the Declarative-Procedural framework, we analyze lexical, grammatical, and syntactic processing in a decoder-only English-German MoE Transformer trained under sequential language exposure. We construct a probe-based validation set and extract token-level routing distributions to quantify category-dependent specialisation using mutual information, routing entropy, and Jensen-Shannon distance. The curriculum-trained model exhibits a peak mutual information of 0.1148 at layer 5, indicating category-dependent differences in routing distributions across linguistic categories. Surprisingly, a no-curriculum baseline trained on mixed English-German data shows stronger aggregate specialisation, reaching a peak mutual information of 0.2599 at the same layer. These results suggest that interpretable linguistic organization emerges within MoE routing patterns even without sequential language exposure. A replication at a second training seed shows that the no-curriculum condition's specialisation concentrates on a single language whose identity is seed-dependent, whereas the curriculum consistently yields a stable, language-balanced routing profile; rather than uniformly increasing specialisation, staged bilingual exposure reduces single-language dominance. The official Github repository: https://github.com/Amrit828/DP-Theory-MOE-Interpretability-Research

AI.tldr: 本文研究Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 语言模型在双语习得过程中是否发展出语言学结构化的专家路由。受陈述性-程序性框架启发，作者分析了在连续语言暴露下训练的英德MoE Transformer中词汇、语法和句法处理的专家路由分布。使用互信息、路由熵和Jensen-Shannon距离量化类别依赖的特化程度。课程训练模型在第5层达到峰值互信息0.1148，而混合数据训练的基线模型表现出更强的聚合特化（0.2599）。复制实验表明，无课程条件的特化集中在单一语言上且依赖种子，而课程条件产生稳定、语言平衡的路由特征。
AI.motivation: 探索MoE语言模型在双语习得中是否自然涌现语言结构化的专家路由，以及连续/分阶段语言暴露如何影响这种结构化特化，检验陈述性-程序性框架在神经网络中的适用性。
AI.method: 使用解码器-only英德MoE Transformer，在连续语言暴露（课程学习）和混合数据（无课程）两种条件下训练；构建基于探针的验证集，提取token级路由分布，通过互信息、路由熵和Jensen-Shannon距离量化不同语言类别（词汇、语法、句法）的路由特化程度。
AI.result: 连续语言暴露的课程模型在第5层峰值互信息0.1148；无课程基线模型在第5层峰值互信息0.2599，表现出更强的聚合特化。复制实验（第二种子）发现无课程条件的特化集中在单一语言且身份依赖种子，而课程条件产生稳定、语言平衡的路由特征。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的语言学组织在MoE路由模式中无需连续语言暴露即可涌现；分阶段双语暴露并非均匀增加特化，而是减少单一语言主导性，促进语言平衡的路由特征。

title: Where the Cost Falls: A Deployment-Aware Adoption Order for Stability Enhancements to Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks
summary: Teams that adopt cycle-consistent adversarial networks for unpaired image-to-image translation meet the same obstacles: adversarial training oscillates or collapses, cycle consistency preserves coarse layout while finer texture drifts, and a single discriminator judging global realism misses local artifacts. Four enhancements address these failures, and they are usually compared on output quality alone. We show that they also divide sharply by where their cost falls, and that this division, which follows from the architecture and not from any particular run, yields an adoption order for teams under a compute or latency budget. A Wasserstein objective with gradient penalty, a VGG19 perceptual loss on the cycle reconstruction, and multi-scale discriminators change training only, so a team can adopt or drop them without altering what ships. Self-attention alone persists into the deployed generator, with memory growing as the square of the feature-map size, which makes it the one component a resource-constrained team should defer. We integrate all four onto a lightly tuned baseline for horse-to-zebra translation, introduced one at a time on a fixed control and then combined, and for each we give the failure mode it targets and how it integrates. We document the collapse and reconstruction-artifact modes the baseline produced, report what visual inspection of saved samples showed for each variant, and report Fréchet Inception Distance and Kernel Inception Distance for the combined model. We specify the protocol still needed, covering the individual variants, perceptual similarity, and downstream segmentation, to rank these enhancements on measured evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了CycleGAN类非配对图像翻译中四种常见增强（Wasserstein+梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失、多尺度判别器、自注意力）在计算/延迟成本上的分布差异，指出前三者只影响训练、而自注意力会进入部署生成器且内存随特征图尺寸平方增长。作者以马到斑马任务为基准，逐一引入并组合测试，记录失败模式，但最终只给出组合模型的FID/KID指标，并呼吁补充更完整的评估协议。
AI.motivation: CycleGAN类方法的对抗训练常震荡或崩溃、循环一致性保留粗略布局但细节纹理漂移、单一判别器漏检局部伪影。已有增强手段通常只在输出质量上被比较，忽略了它们对部署资源（计算/延迟）的不同影响，本文希望揭示这种成本分布差异，为资源受限团队提供采纳顺序的指导。
AI.method: 作者选定马到斑马翻译的轻调基线，逐一独立加入四项增强（Wasserstein目标+梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失、多尺度判别器、自注意力），并在固定对照组上一次一个地引入，最后组合全部四项。对每个变体记录其针对的失败模式与集成方式，并观测基线产生的崩溃与重建伪影，报告组合模型的FID与KID。
AI.result: 四项增强在成本落点上明显二分：Wasserstein、感知损失和多尺度判别器仅改变训练过程、不影响部署；唯有自注意力驻留在生成器中，内存随特征图尺寸平方增长，是资源受限团队应延后采用的一项。作者报告了组合模型在两套指标上的数值，并给出了视觉检查各变体样本的观测。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为成本位置这一维度与架构强相关、与特定运行无关，因而能给出资源预算下的采纳优先序。但当前证据仍不足以对各项增强做严格排名，作者列出仍需补充的协议（逐变体评测、感知相似度、下游分割），以基于实测证据对这些增强进行排序。

title: An automatic-differentiation framework for time-lapse electrical resistivity tomography inversion of hydrologic dynamics
comment: Main text: 10 figures. Supplementary Information: 2 figures and 2 tables
summary: Time-lapse electrical resistivity tomography (TL-ERT) provides spatially distributed information on subsurface hydrologic changes. However, inversion of long monitoring sequences is computationally demanding. Modifying the data misfit, regularization, model parameterization, or petrophysical transformation may also require new gradient derivations and separate implementations. Here, we present AD-TLERT, a unified, GPU-accelerated framework for time-lapse ERT inversion based on automatic differentiation. The framework integrates model parameterization, differentiable petrophysical transformations, forward modeling, data misfit, regularization and auxiliary constraints into a single computational chain. Alternative inversion formulations can therefore reuse the same PDE derivative implementation without re-deriving the complete ERT sensitivity for each case. Comparisons with pyGIMLi showed close agreement in the forward responses, gradients, and recovered resistivity models. Under the tested configuration, AD-TLERT achieved an approximately 51-fold speedup. Synthetic experiments showed that inversion choices affect the amplitude, geometry, and temporal behavior of recovered anomalies. By propagating gradients through the embedded petrophysical relationship, AD-TLERT enabled direct water-content inversion and yielded more accurate estimates than post-inversion conversion for the tested model. A field application further demonstrated how ERT, temperature, and soil-moisture observations can be combined to image snowmelt-driven hillslope wetting. AD-TLERT provides an efficient and flexible framework for time-lapse ERT inversion and hydrologic interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AD-TLERT，一个基于自动微分的GPU加速时间推移电阻率层析成像（TL-ERT）反演框架，统一了模型参数化、岩石物理变换、正演模拟、数据拟合、正则化及辅助约束，实现了无需重新推导灵敏度的高效灵活反演，相较pyGIMLi获得约51倍加速，并支持直接水含量反演。
AI.motivation: TL-ERT能提供地下水文变化的时空信息，但长监测序列的反演计算成本高昂。此外，修改数据拟合项、正则化、模型参数化或岩石物理变换时，通常需要重新推导梯度并单独实现，缺乏统一高效的计算框架。
AI.method: AD-TLERT基于自动微分构建统一计算链，整合模型参数化、可微岩石物理变换、正演建模、数据拟合、正则化与辅助约束。通过自动微分复用同一PDE导数实现，支持多种反演公式而无需重新推导完整ERT灵敏度，并利用GPU加速计算。
AI.result: 与pyGIMLi对比，正演响应、梯度和恢复电阻率模型高度一致；在测试配置下实现约51倍加速。合成实验表明反演选择影响恢复异常体的振幅、几何和时变特征。通过内嵌岩石物理关系传播梯度，AD-TLERT实现直接水含量反演，其精度优于反演后转换方法。野外应用成功结合ERT、温度和土壤湿度观测以成像融雪驱动的山坡湿润过程。
AI.conclusion: AD-TLERT为时间推移ERT反演和水文解释提供了一个高效且灵活的框架，兼具计算加速和公式可扩展性，有望推动TL-ERT在水文领域的更广泛应用。

title: Position: AI Agents in Scientific Teams Should Be Studied as Human-Agent Systems
comment: 15 pages. Accepted at the COLM 2nd Workshop on Language Models for Scientific Discovery
summary: Large language model-based agents are increasingly deployed as collaborators in scientific discovery yet most current work focuses on the autonomous capabilities of "AI Scientists". We argue that this overlooks the social aspects of scientific teamwork, and that studying AI Scientists as human-agent systems (HAS)--where the unit of analysis is the human-agent pair--is both underexplored and undervalued. We establish these points through literature and empirical analysis, and highlight recent incidences and studies which show that deploying agents in science without accounting for human-agent dynamics introduces near-term risks, including reduced diversity of scientific inquiry. Through analysis of real-world case studies, we show that scientists and agents can augment each other's capabilities. We call for new research that adopts the HAS lens to develop mathematical frameworks for understanding and fostering human-AI synergy in scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前"AI科学家"研究过度关注智能体自主能力，忽视了科学团队合作的社会性。作者主张应以"人-智能体系统"（HAS）为分析单元进行研究，通过文献和实证分析揭示忽视人机动态带来的风险（如科研多样性降低），并呼吁建立数学框架来理解和促进人机协同。
AI.motivation: 现有研究集中于AI智能体的自主科研能力，忽略了人类与智能体协同工作的社会维度，这一盲区可能导致实际部署中的风险（如科研多样性下降），因此需要重新审视分析单元并呼吁新研究方向。
AI.method: 通过文献综述、实证分析以及真实世界案例研究，论证以人类-智能体对（human-agent pair）作为分析单元的必要性和价值，并展示科学家与智能体间能力互补的证据。
AI.result: 发现忽略人机动态会带来短期风险，包括科研探究多样性降低；同时通过案例分析证明科学家与智能体能够相互增强彼此能力。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁采用HAS视角开展新研究，建立用于理解和促进科学发现中人机协同的数学框架。

title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks
summary: Repository-scale coding requires an agent to keep tests, imports, configuration, and migration rules consistent within a bounded context window. We model this as reconstructing a coupled-fact graph: at each edit, a required fact comes from recent context or parametric memory, and the facts covered by neither form coherence debt. We supply and withhold each channel and inject faults across seven models and five harnesses. As expected, no model completes a task on an unseen API with both channels empty, and putting the facts in the prompt restores success. When a rename defeats what models memorized about a real library, all seven fail in the same place, passing and missing the same tests. Availability decides the outcome and distance does not: withholding a fact costs exactly the work it supports, and a supplied fact works as well far from the edit as next to it. Harnesses pay unequal prices for it: configurations that all pass every test differ more than tenfold in tokens consumed because they rebuild the same content at different rates, and spending more recovers nothing when facts are withheld. A missing fact produces wrong work rather than absent work: an agent asked to act acts, fabricating the file or guessing the value, so instruments built on reads look for a hole already filled. How often it says it is blocked instead is a property of the model, from every trial to none. Availability does not settle every edit: where standard and code disagree, agents follow the standard even when it prescribes the worse code, so a stale convention file costs more than no file. Because parametric memory substitutes for reading, on SWE-bench, where models likely know the repositories, reads no longer predict success. Harnesses should keep the facts an edit depends on available when the agent writes, and check that availability against what the agent produces rather than what it reads.

AI.tldr: 本文研究仓库级代码编辑中"事实可用性"（fact availability）对智能体的影响。作者将编辑任务建模为重构耦合事实图，并系统性地在七个模型和五个工具链上操控"上下文提示"与"参数记忆"两个通道的供给/剥夺，并注入故障。核心发现：当模型记忆被重命名击败时，所有模型在同一处失败；事实可用性而非距离决定成败；缺失事实导致错误工作而非缺席工作；工具链之间由于重建内容的速率不同，token消耗可相差十倍以上；在标准与代码冲突时，智能体遵循标准即使它导致更差的代码。
AI.motivation: 仓库级编码需要智能体在有限的上下文窗口内保持测试、导入、配置和迁移规则的一致性。以往研究未系统性地区分"上下文事实"与"参数记忆"这两个信息通道的贡献，也未量化事实缺失对最终产出的影响，因此需要一种耦合事实图的建模方式并实验验证。
AI.method: 将编辑任务建模为重构耦合事实图。实验设计：(1) 分别供给/剥夺上下文通道和参数记忆通道；(2) 在七个模型和五个harness上注入故障；(3) 对真实库进行重命名以击败模型的参数记忆；(4) 对比事实与编辑的距离对成功的影响；(5) 测量harness的token消耗差异及标准/代码冲突时的行为。
AI.result: (1) 无模型能在两通道皆空时完成未见API任务；事实放入提示可恢复成功。(2) 重命名击败记忆后七个模型在同一处失败。(3) 事实可用性而非距离决定成败。(4) 通过所有测试的harness间token消耗差异超过十倍。(5) 缺失事实产生错误工作（捏造文件/猜测值），读取工具看到的是一已填补的洞。(6) 模型报告阻塞的频率是模型属性，从每次到从不。(7) 标准与代码冲突时智能体遵循标准。(8) SWE-bench上参数记忆可替代读取，读取不再预测成功。
AI.conclusion: Harness应确保编辑所依赖的事实（facts）在智能体写入时可用，并应依据智能体产生的内容而非读取的内容来校验可用性。事实缺失会造成不易察觉的错误工作，而非明显的阻塞，这要求工具设计从根本上重新审视可用性检查的方式。

title: SAGA: Structure-Attended Generative Action Embedding Model that encodes Multi-Surface User Action Sequences
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to ACM RecSys 2026 Context-Aware Recommender Systems (CARS) workshop
summary: Prior embedding models for sequential recommendation typically operate within a homogeneous action space, limiting their ability to capture cross-surface behavioral signals spanning distinct behavioral domains. We present SAGA, a generative action embedding model that encodes multi-surface user interaction sequences across a Financial Service organization's ecosystems, from checkout, peer-to-peer (P2P) transactions, in-app engagement, email to account actions, into a unified user representation for downstream recommendation tasks. Central to SAGA is a per-field tokenization schema that decomposes each action event into multiple field-level tokens (e.g. product, interaction, surface), enabling field-level attention and per-field training objectives that fused single-token approaches cannot support. Through an offline ablation study on loss formulation, tokenization granularity and training data scope, we isolate the contribution of each design choice. A downstream model integrated with SAGA-generated user embeddings delivers the strongest overall click and conversion lift across diverse downstream touchpoints, compared to all ablated and alternative architectures.

AI.tldr: SAGA是一个生成式行动嵌入模型，将金融服务生态系统中跨多个表面（结账、P2P交易、应用内互动、邮件、账户操作）的用户交互序列编码为统一用户表示，用于下游推荐任务。核心创新在于按字段的token化方案，将每个行动事件分解为多个字段级token，支持字段级注意力和训练目标。
AI.motivation: 现有顺序推荐的嵌入模型通常在同质行动空间中运作，无法捕捉跨不同行为领域的跨表面行为信号。作者旨在通过统一的多表面用户表示来解决这一局限。
AI.method: SAGA采用按字段token化方案，将每个行动事件分解为多个字段级token（如产品、互动、表面），实现字段级注意力和每字段训练目标，这超越了单一token方法的表达能力。通过离线消融研究（损失公式、token化粒度、训练数据范围）隔离各设计选择的贡献。
AI.result: 集成SAGA生成用户嵌入的下游模型，在多样化的下游触点中相比所有消融和替代架构取得了最强的整体点击和转化提升。
AI.conclusion: SAGA证明了跨多表面行为信号编码为统一用户表示的有效性，其字段级token化方案是提升推荐性能的关键设计。

title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models
summary: We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages. On artificial languages, models exhibit a left-branching preference that aligns with neither natural language universals nor human word order learning biases.
