On natural languages, monolingual models show no clear base word order bias at small scales, but as data grows, a preference for right-branching subject-verb-object (SVO) languages emerges while SOV falls behind despite being the most frequent order cross-linguistically. This SVO advantage extends to multilingual models and correlates with language resource level and data quality rather than word order. Thus, the same architecture exhibits opposite preferences on artificial and natural languages, establishing that word order biases observed in practice are data-driven. Since highly-resourced languages are overwhelmingly SVO, these biases risk gradually reducing word order diversity, particularly in languages that productively use multiple word orders, with the widespread adoption of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了decoder-only语言模型在192种人工语言和类型多样的自然语言中的词序偏好。模型在人工语言上表现出与人类学习偏差不符的左分支偏好，而在自然语言上，随着数据量增长，模型更偏好右分支的SVO语序，SOV语序虽在跨语言中最常见却表现落后。这种SVO优势与语言资源水平和数据质量相关，而非词序本身，表明词序偏好是数据驱动的，并可能随着LLM的普及逐渐减少词序多样性。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型是否具有内在的词序偏好，以及这些偏好是来自架构本质还是训练数据，这对评估LLM对语言多样性的潜在影响至关重要。
AI.method: 在192种人工语言和类型多样的自然语言上系统比较decoder-only语言模型的词序偏好，分别分析单语模型和多语模型，并关联语言资源水平与数据质量因素。
AI.result: 人工语言上模型表现出左分支偏好；自然语言上，单语模型在小规模时无明显偏好，数据增长后SVO优势显现而SOV落后。SVO优势在multilingual模型中同样存在，且与资源水平和数据质量相关。
AI.conclusion: 同一架构在人工和自然语言上表现出相反的词序偏好，证明实际观察到的词序偏好是数据驱动的。由于高资源语言绝大多数是SVO，LLM的广泛采用可能导致词序多样性逐渐减少，尤其是对灵活使用多种词序的语言构成风险。

title: OvDSGG: End-to-End Open-Vocabulary Dynamic Scene Graph Generation
summary: Dynamic scene graphs (DSGs) capture spatio-temporal interactions across videos as $\langle$subject, predicate, object$\rangle$ triplets, and underpin downstream tasks such as video captioning, video question answering, and action analysis. However, end-to-end dynamic scene graph generation (DSGG) methods are closed-set: they recognize only objects and predicates from a fixed training vocabulary and struggle with the long-tailed distribution of rare concepts, severely limiting their real-world applicability. Existing open-vocabulary models typically inherit pretrained large language models, resulting in multi-stage training and inference with substantial cost. We introduce OvDSGG, the first end-to-end framework for open-vocabulary DSGG. OvDSGG builds on top of an open-vocabulary Spatial Backbone and a Temporal Backbone; we further propose a Triplet Feature Extraction Module that bridges them, and a Visual-Language Alignment Module that preserves open-vocabulary recognition by learning an adaptive decision boundary in the joint visual-language feature space, without expensive knowledge distillation in existing methods. We further introduce a rigorous open-vocabulary DSGG benchmark adapted from Action Genome, with disjoint Base/Novel splits for both objects and predicates. OvDSGG significantly outperforms open-vocabulary baselines across all metrics, with zero-shot Recall@$K$ scores 10.0--20.4 percentage point higher than the next-best baseline, while on closed-set DSGG remaining competitive with state-of-the-art models. Code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/jhelsby/OvDSGG/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OvDSGG，首个端到端开放词汇动态场景图生成框架。它基于开放词汇的空间骨干和时间骨干，提出三元组特征提取模块桥接两者，并通过视觉-语言对齐模块在联合特征空间中学习自适应决策边界，无需昂贵知识蒸馏。在Action Genome构建的开放词汇基准上，零样本Recall@K比次优基线高10-20.4个百分点，闭集设置下与SOTA保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端动态场景图生成(DSGG)方法是闭集范式，仅能识别固定训练词汇中的物体和谓词，难以应对长尾分布中的稀有概念，严重限制实际应用。现有开放词汇模型通常继承预训练大语言模型，导致多阶段训练和推理成本高昂。
AI.method: OvDSGG包含：(1) 开放词汇空间骨干和时间骨干；(2) 三元组特征提取模块桥接两种骨干；(3) 视觉-语言对齐模块通过学习联合视觉-语言特征空间中的自适应决策边界来保持开放词汇识别能力，避免现有方法中昂贵的知识蒸馏。同时构建了基于Action Genome的开放词汇DSGG基准，对物体和谓词分别划分不相交的Base/Novel子集。
AI.result: OvDSGG在所有指标上显著优于开放词汇基线，零样本Recall@K比次优基线高10.0-20.4个百分点；在闭集DSGG上仍与最先进模型保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: OvDSGG是首个端到端开放词汇动态场景图生成框架，在保持闭集性能的同时大幅提升开放词汇场景下的识别能力，代码和基准已公开。

title: In-Context Learning to Assess Built Environment Impacts on Perceived Neighborhood Walkability Among Mobility-impaired Older Adults
summary: As global populations age, enhancing neighborhood walkability through inclusive urban design is important for mitigating built environment (BE) barriers that discourage physical activity and social participation among older adults. This study investigates the utility of in-context learning (ICL), using the transformer-based foundation model TabPFN, to determine how BE features influence perceived walkability, as measured by the Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale (NEWS-A) survey. Using a small-scale dataset (N = 257) comprising a unique demographic of older adults with knee osteoarthritis or a history of falls, TabPFN achieved a macro F1 score of 54.89% for walkability perceptions categorized as Low, Neutral, and High using equal-width binning. This result outperformed optimized, grid-searched baseline models, including Random Forest (45.85%) and XGBoost (50.56%). To interpret these results, we employed Shapley Interaction Quantification (SHAP-IQ) to identify the hierarchical importance of feature interactions. Preliminary results revealed that the model's predictive logic was primarily driven by higher-order interactions. For example, the interaction between average street circuity and the ratio of drivable roads emerged as the primary discriminator of perceived walkability. Neighborhood greenery was found to have substantial predictive importance only when combined with an individual's fear of falling or perception of age-friendliness. Overall, ICL using TabPFN demonstrates superior performance on small-scale datasets, enhancing the fidelity of the resulting interpretive insights. Furthermore, SHAP-IQ provides a synergistic perspective on how higher-order feature interactions drive the model's predictions.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用基于Transformer的基础模型TabPFN和上下文学习（ICL），在仅有257名老年膝骨关节炎或跌倒史患者的小规模数据集上预测步行适宜性感知（NEWS-A）。TabPFN取得了54.89%的宏观F1分数，优于网格搜索优化的随机森林（45.85%）和XGBoost（50.56%）。通过SHAP-IQ解释分析发现，高阶特征交互主导预测逻辑，如街道迂回度与可驾驶道路比率的交互是关键判别因素，邻里绿化需与跌倒恐惧或年龄友好感知结合才具有显著预测重要性。
AI.motivation: 随着全球人口老龄化，需要通过包容性城市设计提升社区步行适宜性，以减少阻碍老年人身体活动和社会参与的环境障碍。然而小规模、特殊人群数据集上的步行适宜性预测面临挑战，需要寻找更适合小数据场景的机器学习方法。
AI.method: 采用基于Transformer的基础模型TabPFN进行上下文学习（ICL），在N=257的小规模数据集上预测老年人步行适宜性感知（分为低、中、高三类，等宽分箱）。使用SHAP-IQ（Shapley Interaction Quantification）解释高阶特征交互的重要性，并与网格搜索优化的随机森林和XGBoost基线模型进行对比。
AI.result: TabPFN实现54.89%的宏观F1分数，显著优于随机森林（45.85%）和XGBoost（50.56%）。SHAP-IQ分析显示模型预测主要由高阶交互驱动，其中街道迂回度与可驾驶道路比率的交互是最主要判别因素；邻里绿化仅在结合跌倒恐惧或年龄友好感知时才具有显著的预测重要性。
AI.conclusion: 上下文学习结合TabPFN在小规模数据集上表现优于传统基线模型，能提升解释性洞察的保真度。SHAP-IQ提供了一种协同视角，揭示高阶特征交互如何驱动模型预测，为老年友好型社区步行环境设计提供了数据驱动的决策支持。

title: Beyond Correctness: Toward Automated Novelty Verification with Lean 4
comment: 20 pages. Preliminary version; a large-scale quantitative evaluation (N theorems x M models) is left to future work. Comments welcome. Code: https://github.com/ayrtonporto/avid-journal
summary:
Artificial intelligence systems applied to mathematics verify correctness but not novelty: an automatically generated theorem can compile in Lean without errors and yet be an already known result. This article presents AViD Journal, a pipeline that receives a LaTeX article, formalizes its statements in Lean 4, and issues a novelty verdict through a decision tree over three dimensions: prior existence in a formal corpus (Mathlib) and an informal one (TheoremSearch and Matlas, with temporal filter and LLM judge), non-triviality via automatic tactics, and structural distance between proofs measured as Jaccard distance over premise sets.
  Evaluation on papers withdrawn from arXiv due to declared duplication produced a result more informative than any performance measure: the identification of three obstacles that limit the approach regardless of this implementation. First, successful compilation of a Lean file does not guarantee semantic fidelity. Second, the recall ceiling is imposed by the coverage of theorem indices, not by the similarity metric. Third, arXiv removes the source code of articles upon withdrawal, compromising the reproducibility of any benchmark built upon them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AViD Journal流水线，用于自动检测数学论文中定理的新颖性。该系统接收LaTeX论文，用Lean 4形式化其陈述，并通过决策树（基于形式语料库Mathlib和非形式语料库TheoremSearch/Matlas的先前存在性、非平凡性自动策略、证明结构距离）给出新颖性判定。在arXiv撤回论文上的评估揭示了三个限制：Lean编译成功不保证语义保真、语料库覆盖决定召回上限、arXiv撤回删源码影响基准可复现性。
AI.motivation: 人工智能数学系统只能验证正确性（如Lean编译通过），但无法判断新颖性——即使编译无误的定理可能早已是已知结果。现有系统缺乏自动化评估数学定理新颖性的工具，因此需要构建一个能自动判定定理是否已被前人证明的流水线。
AI.method: AViD Journal是一个端到端流水线，包含三个主要步骤：1）接收LaTeX文章并提取其中的数学陈述；2）使用Lean 4形式化这些陈述；3）通过决策树从三个维度判定新颖性：先前存在性（检查Mathlib形式语料库以及TheoremSearch和Matlas非形式语料库，并加入时间过滤和LLM评判）、非平凡性（通过自动策略检测）、以及证明之间的结构距离（基于前提集合的Jaccard距离度量）。
AI.result: 在因声明重复而从arXiv撤回的论文上进行评估，得到的核心结果不是性能指标，而是发现了三个限制该方法（无论具体实现）的根本障碍：1）Lean文件编译成功不等于语义保真；2）召回率上限由定理索引的覆盖范围决定，而非相似度度量；3）arXiv在撤回文章时会删除源代码，破坏基于这些文章构建的基准的可复现性。
AI.conclusion: AViD Journal展示了形式化验证与自动检索相结合来判定数学定理新颖性的可行性，但研究揭示的核心障碍表明：定理新颖性检测的根本瓶颈在于语料库覆盖率和形式化语义保真度，而非算法指标本身。这些发现对构建可复现的数学新颖性基准提出了重要挑战。

title: ModBench: A Pipeline for Building Modelica Benchmark Datasets Mined from Library Repositories
comment: Extended abstract accepted at SAM 2026, co-located with MODELS 2026. To appear in the ACM/IEEE MODELS 2026 Companion Proceedings
summary: Research on equation-based cyber-physical systems modeling languages, such as Modelica, is constrained by the lack of curated benchmark datasets. This limits empirical insight into the evolution and development of models. We address this gap with ModBench, a pipeline that mines Git repositories of Modelica libraries to produce benchmark datasets of model snapshots. The pipeline (1) filters repository commits to retain human-authored, Modelica-relevant revisions; (2) extracts simulation-eligible classes; and (3) builds canonical representations of Modelica classes. For empirical validation, we applied ModBench to the Modelica Standard Library (MSL) and report the resulting dataset, spanning the full commit history (since Modelica language v3), with 85,562 distinct class snapshots, and links enabling traceability to original models and Git metadata. The dataset, its API, and the data generation pipeline are publicly available to support future research on model evolution analysis, compiler testing, and automated model repair or generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ModBench，一个从Modelica库的Git仓库中挖掘并生成基准数据集的流水线，将其应用于Modelica标准库，构建了包含85,562个不同类快照的数据集，并公开数据、API和生成流水线以支持后续研究。
AI.motivation: 基于方程的cyber-physical系统建模语言（如Modelica）研究因缺乏精选基准数据集而受限，阻碍了对模型演变与发展的实证洞察。
AI.method: ModBench流水线包含三个步骤：(1)过滤仓库提交，保留人类编写且与Modelica相关的修订；(2)提取可仿真类；(3)构建Modelica类的规范化表示。并将其应用于Modelica标准库（MSL）进行实证验证。
AI.result: 生成的基准数据集涵盖Modelica标准库完整提交历史（自Modelica语言v3起），包含85,562个不同的类快照，并提供与原始模型和Git元数据的追溯链接。
AI.conclusion: ModBench数据集、API及生成流水线已公开，可用于模型演化分析、编译器测试以及自动化模型修复或生成等未来研究。

title: ConceptFormer: Learning Adaptive Latent Concepts for Query-Document Alignment in Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Visual document retrieval is a critical component of multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, aiming to identify query-relevant pages from document collections where evidence is distributed across text, layout, charts, and visual structures. Recent efforts toward finer-grained supervision primarily rely on textual descriptions or localized visual regions as evidence proxies. However, such supervision signals may either overlook complex visual structures or provide incomplete and inaccurate representations of the underlying evidence. To address these limitations, we propose ConceptFormer, a latent concept representation learning framework for visual document retrieval. ConceptFormer models query-relevant evidence as continuous, query-conditioned latent concepts that explicitly bridge localized visual evidence and semantic relevance, without requiring either textual intermediate representations or direct reliance on raw visual annotations. During training, ConceptFormer employs a strong vision-language model to dynamically determine the number of latent concept tokens and uses these concepts as an intermediate representation to bridge the semantic gap between queries and documents, thereby guiding the learning of the embedding space. Experiments on diverse visual document retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that ConceptFormer achieves 16.7\% and 22.1\% relative improvements in average NDCG@10 over the strongest visual retrieval baseline and the strongest OCR-based text retrieval baseline, respectively. Further analysis reveals that latent concepts effectively connect localized visual evidence with semantic relevance, enabling the retriever to capture both fine-grained textual cues and complex document-level visual structures while preserving strong retrieval alignment. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/Neuir/ConceptFormer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConceptFormer，一种用于视觉文档检索的潜在概念表示学习框架。它通过query条件化的连续潜在概念token来桥接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，无需文本中间表示或直接依赖原始视觉标注，在多个基准上显著超越现有最强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉文档检索的细粒度监督信号主要依赖文本描述或局部视觉区域作为证据代理，但这些方式要么忽略复杂的视觉结构，要么提供不完整和不准确的证据表示，限制了检索性能。
AI.method: ConceptFormer将查询相关证据建模为连续的、查询条件化的潜在概念。训练时使用强视觉语言模型动态确定潜在概念token的数量，并将这些概念作为中间表示来桥接查询与文档之间的语义鸿沟，从而指导嵌入空间的学习。
AI.result: 在多个视觉文档检索基准上，ConceptFormer相较最强的视觉检索基线和最强的OCR文本检索基线，平均NDCG@10分别提升16.7%和22.1%。
AI.conclusion: 潜在概念能有效连接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，使检索器既能捕捉细粒度文本线索，又能理解复杂的文档级视觉结构，同时保持强大的检索对齐能力。

title: TRACE-BN: Transferring Bangla-English Tutoring Behavior to a Sub-1B Offline Language Model
summary: Bangla-English tutoring requires more than producing a correct translation: learners also need explanations of grammar differences, awareness of their likely errors, and targeted practice. We present TRACE-BN, a curriculum-guided dataset of structured tutoring traces for Bangla-speaking learners of English at the CEFR A1-A2 level. Each trace combines word-level glosses, literal and natural translations, Bangla grammar explanations, a plausible learner error, and a targeted practice question with its answer. The traces are generated by Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite as the teacher model from NCTB Classes 9-10 English curriculum units, then filtered for structural validity, script integrity, and semantic duplication. We transfer the resulting structured tutoring behavior to Qwen3-0.6B using LoRA with 4-bit quantization for resource-constrained offline deployment. On held-out inputs, schema validity increases from 85.4% to 95.8%, while, against teacher-model references, chrF++ improves from 15.28 to 34.77 and BLEU from 4.52 to 21.03. Field-level evaluation by two independent judges shows improvements across translation, grammar explanation, learner-error diagnosis, and practice alignment, while a human audit supports the quality of the supervision data. The results show that curriculum-guided structured supervision can transfer multi-component tutoring behavior to a sub-1B model under these resource constraints. The dataset, model checkpoints, and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RaiyanKhaan/Trace-BN

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TRACE-BN，一个面向孟加拉语英语学习者的课程引导式结构化辅导轨迹数据集。该数据集通过Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite生成，包含词级注释、字面与自然翻译、孟加拉语语法解释、学习者常见错误及针对性练习，并通过LoRA 4-bit量化将辅导行为迁移到Qwen3-0.6B小模型上，在资源受限场景下实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语-英语辅导不仅需要正确的翻译，还需要语法差异解释、学习者常见错误预警和针对性练习。然而现有系统缺乏包含这些多组分辅导行为的结构化训练数据，特别是在资源受限环境下的小规模模型部署需求尚未得到满足。
AI.method: 1) 从NCTB 9-10年级英语课程单元提取内容，使用Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite作为教师模型生成结构化辅导轨迹数据集TRACE-BN；2) 对生成数据进行结构有效性、脚本完整性和语义去重过滤；3) 使用LoRA配合4-bit量化将结构化辅导行为迁移到Qwen3-0.6B模型上，实现资源受限的离线部署。
AI.result: 在保留测试集上，schema有效性从85.4%提升到95.8%；相对于教师模型参考，chrF++从15.28提升至34.77，BLEU从4.52提升至21.03。两位独立评审员的字段级评估显示翻译、语法解释、学习者错误诊断和练习对齐方面均有改善，人工审计也支持监督数据的质量。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，课程引导式结构化监督可以在资源约束条件下将多组分辅导行为有效迁移到低于10亿参数的小规模模型，为孟加拉语英语学习者的离线辅导应用提供了可行的解决方案，且公开了数据集、模型检查点和代码以支持进一步研究。

title: Zero-MELO: Test-Time Evidence Calibration with Multimodal LLMs for Zero-Shot Micro-Gesture Recognition
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general video understanding, their capability in fine-grained and motion-centric tasks remains limited. This limitation is particularly critical in micro-gesture recognition (MGR), where micro-gestures (MGs) - subtle, short-duration, and spatially localized human movements - serve as key discriminative signals for implicit affective analysis, yet are easily neglected following common prompting practices. Although MGR has been intensively studied by many discriminative approaches, the use of MLLMs for MGR is underexplored, with notably poor performance. We hypothesize that the motion-sensitive representation ability of MLLMs is constrained by their inherent single-pass forward inference, which can be substantially enhanced through carefully designed test-time guidance. Motivated by this, building on our prior findings regarding temporal insensitivity in Video LLMs, we diagnose zero-shot MGR errors in the Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) space. We observe that MLLMs suffer from two bottlenecks: 1) insufficient localized evidence and 2) severe score biases driven by language and motion-agnostic appearances. Thus, we propose a novel test-time evidence calibration framework that improves both reasoning details and prediction reliability. Specifically, we introduce a tree search mechanism to progressively acquire localized, fine-grained visual evidence, coupled with a test-time calibration module to mitigate score biases. The multi-cue fusion module then integrates evidence from multiple cues without relying on a single cue for final prediction. Our framework achieves mean-class accuracies of 26.84\% on iMiGUE and 22.10\% on MA-52, significantly outperforming the Qwen2.5-VL baseline, which produces 16.15\% and 10.20\%, respectively. The code will be available at https://zero-melo.github.io/Zero-MELO.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在细微手势识别（MGR）任务上表现不佳的问题，提出了一种测试时证据校准框架（Zero-MELO）。该框架通过树搜索机制逐步获取局部细粒度视觉证据，并结合测试时校准模块缓解分数偏差，最后通过多线索融合模块进行综合预测。在iMiGUE和MA-52基准上分别达到26.84%和22.10%的平均类别准确率，显著超越Qwen2.5-VL基线。
AI.motivation: MLLMs在通用视频理解上表现出色，但在微手势识别这类细粒度、运动中心的任务上能力受限。微手势是细微、短时长且空间局部化的人体运动，是隐式情感分析的关键判别信号，但常见的提示方式容易忽略这些信号。尽管判别式方法已深入研究了MGR，但MLLMs在该任务上探索不足且性能较差。作者假设MLLMs的运动敏感表示能力受限于其固有的单次前向推理，可通过精心设计的测试时引导来显著增强。
AI.method: 作者在负对数似然（NLL）空间诊断零样本MGR错误，识别出两个瓶颈：(1)局部证据不足；(2)由语言和运动无关外观导致的严重分数偏差。据此提出测试时证据校准框架，包含三个关键模块：(1)树搜索机制——逐步获取局部、细粒度的视觉证据；(2)测试时校准模块——缓解分数偏差；(3)多线索融合模块——整合多个线索的证据而不依赖单一线索进行最终预测。
AI.result: 在iMiGUE上取得26.84%的平均类别准确率，在MA-52上取得22.10%，显著优于Qwen2.5-VL基线的16.15%和10.20%。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的测试时证据校准，可以有效增强MLLMs在细微手势识别任务上的运动敏感表示能力，从而大幅提升微手势识别的准确率。

title: Quantifying Depth Sufficiency in Residual Neural Networks: A First-Order Criterion
summary: How can we determine whether a trained neural network is already deep enough? We study this under a fixed function-preserving residual-growth protocol specifying insertion locations, residual families, zero-output initializations, and zero-state first-order updates. We define first-order residual depth saturation as the absence of a strict local decrease from every admissible insertion. We prove residual non-degeneracy is necessary and sufficient: additional depth has first-order value exactly when conditional activation gradients have a nonzero projection onto at least one admissible residual tangent space. This boundary is shared by descent-compatible zero-state updates and invariant under regular local reparameterizations preserving that tangent space. Under residual-signal realizability, raw activation-gradient vanishing exactly certifies saturation. Across ResNets, GPT-2-style models, and continued-pretrained Pythia checkpoints, the maximum activation-gradient norm decreases toward a low-signal regime with depth. Function-preserving growth also achieves converged performance competitive with training from scratch. These results support activation-gradient magnitude as a conservative diagnostic of the remaining empirical first-order value of residual depth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了如何判断已训练神经网络是否已经"足够深"，提出了"一阶残差深度饱和"的概念，并证明残差非退化性是判断增加深度是否具有一阶价值的充要条件。通过实证验证，激活梯度范数可作为判断残差深度剩余价值的保守诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 在实际训练深度网络时，一个关键问题是：当前网络是否已经足够深，继续加深是否还有意义？缺乏严格的理论框架来判断残差深度增长是否还能带来优化收益。
AI.method: 在固定函数保持的残差增长协议下（指定插入位置、残差族、零输出初始化和零状态一阶更新），定义一阶残差深度饱和。通过理论分析证明残差非退化性是充分必要条件，并利用条件激活梯度在有许可残差切空间上的投影来判断。在ResNet、GPT-2及Pythia检查点上进行实证验证。
AI.result: 理论上证明：残差非退化性⇔增加深度具有一阶价值；该边界对下降兼容的零状态更新共享，且在保持切空间的再参数化下不变。在残差信号可实现性条件下，激活梯度消失可精确证明饱和。实证上，各模型的最大激活梯度范数随深度向低信号区域递减，且函数保持增长能达到与从头训练相当的收敛性能。
AI.conclusion: 激活梯度幅值可以作为判断残差深度剩余一阶价值的保守诊断指标，为实践中判断是否需要继续加深网络提供了理论依据和实用工具。

title: Auditing an AI-Generated Mathematical Proof: A Correction to a Greedy Conditioning Lemma in Quantum Parallel Repetition
comment: 8 pages, 5 references, Auditing an OpenAI's Generated Mathematical Proof
summary:
Chapter 6 of OpenAI's *Ten Advances in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science* claims an exponential parallel-repetition theorem for all finite two-player, one-round entangled games. Early in the proof, the chapter uses a quantitative greedy conditioning lemma. The lemma is meant to select a small set of coordinates (D) such that, after conditioning on winning every coordinate in (D), a randomly chosen remaining coordinate is won with average probability at least (1-δ). The statement is correct, but the proof as printed contains a polarity error. Its continuation test is written in terms of average success, while the next step requires a coordinate with a large conditional failure probability. That implication is false, and even simple examples can leave the printed procedure without a valid next move.
  This note gives an explicit counterexample, identifies the intended continuation condition, and supplies a complete corrected proof. The repair is local: it leaves the statement of the lemma and the parameters used later in the chapter unchanged. It should not, however, be read as an independent verification of the main parallel-repetition theorem. More broadly, the example shows how a mathematically plausible AI-generated argument can hide a small but decisive reversal between complementary events.

AI.tldr: 本文指出OpenAI《数学与理论计算机科学十大进展》第六章中一个贪心条件化引理的证明存在极性错误（将成功与失败事件颠倒），并给出反例、识别正确的延续条件，以及完整的修正证明。
AI.motivation: 该引理是并行重复定理证明的关键步骤，但原文证明中的延续测试使用平均成功率，而下一步需要高条件失败概率的坐标，这一隐含关系实际上不成立。需要指出错误并修复，同时警示AI生成论证中互补事件颠倒的风险。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个显式反例展示原文程序的失效，识别出应使用的正确延续条件（选择具有大条件失败概率的坐标），并在不改变引理陈述和后续参数的前提下提供完整的纠正证明。修复是局部性的。
AI.result: 给出了使原始证明无法继续的显式反例，确定了正确的延续条件，并提供了完整的修正证明。修正保持引理陈述及后续章节使用参数不变。
AI.conclusion: 原文引理陈述正确但证明存在极性错误；修复是局部的，但不应视为对主定理的独立验证。该案例更广泛地展示了AI生成数学论证中互补事件（成功/失败）颠倒的风险。

title: TDD-Agent: Test-Driven Reasoning for Code Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in code generation, yet ensuring correctness in complex, repository-level tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches often use generated tests as static post-hoc validators, which limits their ability to guide implementation and may introduce misleading feedback when the tests themselves are incomplete or incorrect. In this paper, we introduce TDD-Agent, which operationalizes the test-driven development paradigm for code generation. TDD-Agent first prompts the model to generate executable tests, encouraging it to clarify expected behaviors before implementation, and then performs iterative dual-track refinement over both the generated code and tests using execution feedback. We first isolate the effect of test-first reasoning through a prompt variant TDD-prompt on LiveCodeBench, where it consistently improves upon reasoning-based prompting baselines. Building on this finding, we evaluate the full TDD-Agent framework on RepoEval, a repository-level benchmark, and show that it consistently outperforms retrieval-based and agent-based baselines. Additional analyses show that iterative refinement improves not only code correctness but also the effectiveness of the generated tests, yielding higher pass rates, coverage, and mutation scores, suggesting that tests can serve as evolving reasoning artifacts rather than fixed validators. Our source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TDD-Agent-Framework-6370/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TDD-Agent框架，将测试驱动开发范式应用于代码生成。该框架先让模型生成可执行测试以明确预期行为，再通过执行反馈对代码和测试进行迭代双轨优化，在LiveCodeBench和RepoEval基准上均优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成方法通常将生成的测试仅作为静态的事后验证器，这限制了测试对实现过程的引导作用，且当测试本身不完整或错误时可能引入误导性反馈。作者希望让测试在代码生成过程中扮演更主动的角色。
AI.method: 提出TDD-Agent框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) TDD-prompt提示变体，让模型先编写可执行测试来明确预期行为；(2) 迭代双轨优化机制，利用执行反馈同时改进生成的代码和测试。作者先在LiveCodeBench上隔离验证测试优先推理的效果，再在RepoEval上进行完整框架评估。
AI.result: TDD-prompt在LiveCodeBench上持续优于基于推理的提示基线；TDD-Agent在RepoEval上一致优于基于检索和基于智能体的基线。迭代优化不仅提升代码正确性，还提高了测试的通过率、覆盖率和变异分数。
AI.conclusion: 测试不应被视为固定的验证器，而应作为可演化的推理工件，在代码生成过程中持续引导和改进实现，从而有效提升仓库级代码生成任务的正确性。

title: PLeDO: Pain Level Detection for Osteoarthritis from EMR Data
summary: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a progressive chronic joint disease resulting in a breakdown of articular cartilage and bone when damaged joint tissues are not able to normally repair themselves. The aim of this pilot research study is to understand the pain severity for OA from patients' primary care Electronic Medical Records (EMR), both from the structured medical data and the unstructured chart note data using information extraction, natural language processing and machine learning techniques. We propose SPaDe, a Synonym-based Pain level Detection tool to categorize patients into having mild or moderate-to-severe pain to understand diagnosis and treatment methods based on only the pain related expressions in the unstructured chart note. Expressions are subjective, objective, and influenced by cultural background and demography which poses a difficult challenge. Therefore, we improve the model by incorporating the medication information from the structured EMR data and pain scale related information from the chart note to propose an integrated pain level detection tool for OA called PLeDO. With the help of human labeled gold standard data, we demonstrate that both SPaDe and PLeDO can detect mild and moderate-to-severe pain from the EMR data to analyze and potentially improve the quality of care in primary care setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于电子病历（EMR）的骨关节炎（OA）疼痛程度检测工具：SPaDe（基于同义词的疼痛检测）和PLeDO（整合结构化药物信息与非结构化疼痛量表信息的集成检测工具），用于将患者分为轻度或中度至重度疼痛类别，以辅助初级医疗中的诊断和治疗。
AI.motivation: 骨关节炎是一种进行性慢性关节疾病，疼痛评估对诊断和治疗至关重要。然而，病历中的疼痛表达具有主观性、受文化背景和人口统计学因素影响，仅依靠非结构化图表笔记难以准确判断疼痛程度，需要整合结构化与非结构化数据来提升检测准确性。
AI.method: 采用信息抽取、自然语言处理和机器学习技术。首先提出SPaDe，仅基于非结构化图表笔记中的疼痛相关表达进行同义词层面的疼痛检测；随后提出改进版PLeDO，在SPaDe基础上整合结构化EMR中的药物信息和图表笔记中的疼痛量表相关信息，构建集成疼痛检测模型。
AI.result: 借助人工标注的金标准数据，验证了SPaDe和PLeDO均能有效从EMR数据中检测轻度与中度至重度疼痛，其中PLeDO通过整合多种数据源提升了检测能力。
AI.conclusion: SPaDe和PLeDO能够从初级医疗EMR数据中准确检测OA患者的疼痛程度，有助于分析和潜在改善初级医疗环境中的护理质量。

title: Time as Structure: Temporal Dependency Graphs for Verifiable Deadline Computation over Legal Documents
summary: Miss a filing deadline by one day and the claim is barred, however strong the case. Computing that deadline is rarely simple: the period runs from a triggering event, is counted by a statutory convention, and may be suspended by a mandatory conciliation window. We ask whether a language model should answer such questions directly, or read the document and leave the arithmetic to code. We extract dated facts and their dependencies into a temporal dependency graph and compute deadlines from it with a calendar-correct engine. On UK Employment Appeal Tribunal judgments the engine reproduces six of seven timeliness rulings, and matches the judges' own dates to the day. The strongest of four language models, asked the same cases, gets the arithmetic right and the answer wrong: in six of twenty-one responses its stated verdict contradicts its own thinking, and every contradiction runs the same way, calling a late claim timely. To test the systems at scale we move the dismissal date across the statutory boundary, generating 427 cases whose answers are computed rather than annotated. On the cases both systems answer, the pipeline is right 90.2% of the time against 61.2% for direct answering. The limit is extraction: on contracts the errors are almost never in the arithmetic, but in choosing which event the period starts from.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了法律期限计算问题：语言模型是否应直接回答，还是应读取文档后将算术交给代码处理。作者将日期事实及其依赖关系提取为时间依赖图，并用日历正确的引擎计算截止日期。在英国就业上诉法庭判决上，该引擎再现了七分之六的时效裁定，与法官日期精确到天。最强的语言模型在六个回答中犯下自相矛盾的错误，且错误方向一致（将逾期申诉判定为及时）。在427个生成案例中，pipeline准确率90.2%，对比直接回答的61.2%。限制在于提取环节：错误几乎不在算术，而在选择期限起算事件。
AI.motivation: 法律期限计算对案件结果至关重要（错过一天即丧失权利），但计算过程复杂：期限从触发事件起算、按法定惯例计算、可能被强制调解窗口暂停。作者质疑语言模型是否应直接回答此类问题，还是应分离出算术部分交给确定性代码处理。
AI.method: 将文档中的日期事实及其依赖关系提取为时间依赖图（temporal dependency graph），并使用日历正确的引擎（calendar-correct engine）从图中计算截止日期。通过移动解雇日期跨越法定边界，生成427个测试案例，避免人工标注的局限。
AI.result: 在UK EAT判决上，引擎复现了七分之六的时效裁定，日期与法官完全一致。最强的四个语言模型之一在21个回答中有6个自相矛盾（其陈述的裁决与自身推理冲突），且所有矛盾均将逾期认定为及时。在427个生成案例中，pipeline准确率90.2%，直接回答仅61.2%。
AI.conclusion: 将法律期限计算任务分离为文档提取与代码计算两部分是更可靠的方案。算术不是瓶颈，瓶颈在于从文本中正确选择期限的起算事件。语言模型存在系统性偏差（倾向于将逾期判为及时），而确定性的计算引擎能有效避免这类错误。

title: Beam-Wise Statistical Background Subtraction for Static Roadside LiDAR: A Cross-Sensor Benchmark Study
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), Naples, Italy, September 15-18, 2026
summary: Background subtraction is a key preprocessing step for infrastructure-based LiDAR perception, enabling efficient isolation of dynamic traffic participants without semantic annotations. However, systematic cross-sensor evaluations and reproducible studies for static roadside LiDAR are missing. This paper presents a comparative benchmark of beam-wise statistical background subtraction for statically mounted LiDAR sensors. We formulate background estimation as a per-beam temporal modeling problem and investigate complementary statistical strategies that capture dominant as well as multi-modal background structures, combined with spatial filtering in the angular and 3D domain. To enable reproducible evaluation, we introduce HighwayScene, a new multi-LiDAR dataset recorded in a static roadside setup, and extend the public CoopScenes dataset with static/dynamic point-wise annotations. Across multiple scenes and heterogeneous sensing technologies, we demonstrate that beam-wise statistical modeling provides a robust and transferable solution. Combining lightweight per-beam models with spatial consistency filtering substantially improves precision while maintaining high recall and real-time capability. All datasets, annotations, and implementations are publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对静态路侧LiDAR传感器的波束级统计背景减除方法的比较基准。作者将背景估计建模为逐波束的时间序列问题，结合角度域和3D域的空间滤波，并引入了新的多LiDAR数据集HighwayScene以及扩展的CoopScenes数据集。实验表明波束级统计建模具有鲁棒性和可迁移性，结合空间一致性滤波可显著提升精确率，同时保持高召回率和实时性能。
AI.motivation: 路侧基础设施LiDAR感知中的背景减除是关键的预处理步骤，可以在无需语义标注的情况下高效分离动态交通参与者。然而，目前缺乏针对静态路侧LiDAR的系统性跨传感器评估和可复现研究，这阻碍了该技术的实际部署与比较。
AI.method: 将背景估计公式化为逐波束的时间建模问题，研究两种互补的统计策略（捕捉主导背景结构及多模态背景结构），并结合角度域和3D域的空间滤波。同时构建了新的多LiDAR数据集HighwayScene，并为CoopScenes数据集添加了静态/动态点级标注。
AI.result: 在多种场景和异构传感技术下，波束级统计建模提供了鲁棒且可迁移的解决方案。轻量级逐波束模型结合空间一致性滤波显著提高了精确率，同时保持高召回率和实时处理能力。所有数据集、标注和实现均已公开。
AI.conclusion: 波束级统计背景减除是静态路侧LiDAR感知中一种有效且可迁移的方法，空间一致性滤波能够在不牺牲召回率和实时性的前提下大幅提升精确率，且通过公开数据集和实现推动了该领域研究的可复现性。

title: When Does the Best Sampling Temperature Rise with the Budget? Sufficient Conditions for Pass@k
comment: Theory paper, 13 pages, 1 analytical figure. Deterministic verification code is included as ancillary material. No new language-model experiment
summary: The temperature that maximizes pass@$k$ is often low for a small sampling budget and higher for a large budget. This pattern has been reported from Codex through recent multi-sample inference studies. It is not an algebraic property of pass@$k$: as Slocum et al. (ICLR 2025) observe, for one fixed task the maximizing temperature is independent of $k$. Building on that fixed-task observation and the hard/easy-task explanation, we give a formal population-level sufficient condition for the aggregate pattern. For task $X$, let $p_t(X)$ be one-sample success probability at temperature $t$, and define the conditional log-success response $m_t(u)=\mathbb{E}[\dot p_t(X)\mid p_t(X)=u]/u$. If $m_t(u)$ is nonincreasing in current success probability, then the normalized temperature derivative of aggregate pass@$k$ is nondecreasing in $k$. Consequently, derivative signs are nested across budgets; if each temperature-performance curve is strictly single-peaked, its unique maximizer is nondecreasing in $k$. The proof identifies the mechanism as a monotone-likelihood-ratio power tilt toward lower-success tasks. We derive a closed-form two-stratum phase diagram, including upward and downward regimes, and show that the marginal temperature derivative admits an exact $\mathrm{Beta}(2,k)$ kernel representation whose kernel concentrates at one-sample success of order $1/k$. Interpreting that scale as task-level localization additionally requires a regular, nonvanishing density-response factor near zero. A signed-moment representation yields diagnostic shape restrictions, while a short appendix records exact discrete refinements of the existing multi-configuration allocation formulation. No language model is trained, and no model query is used as an experimental measurement: the contribution is a conditional theory of an established empirical phenomenon, with assumptions that can be tested in future work.

AI.tldr: 本文为"温度参数最大化pass@k时随采样预算k增大而升高"这一经验现象提供了形式化的总体层面充分条件。基于固定任务上最优温度独立于k的观察，作者证明若条件对数成功响应函数m_t(u)随时间样本成功概率非增，则聚合pass@k的归一化温度导数随k非减，从而最优温度随k单调非降。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明，从Codex到近期多采样推理研究，最大化pass@k的最优温度在小采样预算时往往较低，在大预算时较高。但这一经验模式并非pass@k的代数性质（固定任务上最优温度与k无关），作者希望对这一聚合层面的经验现象给出严格的理论解释。
AI.method: 作者构建了形式化的总体层面模型：对任务X定义单样本成功概率p_t(X)，并定义条件对数成功响应函数m_t(u)=E[ṗ_t(X)|p_t(X)=u]/u。若m_t(u)随u非增，则证明聚合pass@k的归一化温度导数随k非增，且导数符号在预算间嵌套。证明机制为单调似然比向低成功任务倾斜。作者还推导了两层相位图的闭式解、边际温度导数的Beta(2,k)核表示、以及有符号矩的表示。
AI.result: 给出了一个可检验的充分条件：m_t(u)非增时聚合模式成立。提供了两stratum相位图（包含向上和向下机制）、Beta(2,k)核表示的精确边际温度导数、核在1/k尺度集中现象（任务级局部化需额外规则性条件）、以及有符号矩的诊断形状限制。此外附录记录了现有多配置分配的精确离散改进。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献是建立在一个已被广泛观察的经验现象之上的条件性理论，不做任何实验测量，所有假设可在未来工作中验证。

title: When Agentic Executions Fail: Detecting and Localizing Runtime Faults from Telemetry
summary: Reliability in LLM-based agentic systems is a property of the whole execution (its tool calls, model calls, guardrails, and inter-agent messages), not of the final answer alone, yet evaluating only task outcomes reveals little about how or why a run fails. We present AGENTCHAOSBENCH, a benchmark for detecting and localizing runtime faults in agentic systems from their execution telemetry. We run five heterogeneous applications that coordinate agents over the Agent-to-Agent protocol and call tools through the Model Context Protocol, and inject ten types of operational fault (unavailable or slow tools, corrupted or oversized responses, and delayed, looped, or misrouted delegations and bypassed guardrails) at their tool, model, guardrail, and inter-agent boundaries, alongside a no-fault control. The resulting dataset contains 275 sanitized traces: 250 faulty executions spanning ten fault types and 25 no-fault controls. Each faulty trace is aligned with the no-fault execution of the same input; fault-type labels and, where applicable, location labels are held out from diagnosis. On structured single-trace inputs, a first set of zero-shot LLM baselines shows the task is far from solved: local detectors up to 14B parameters reach only 13.6-19.2% top-1 fault-type accuracy and the frontier DeepSeek-v4-pro only 24.8%, while jointly identifying the fault type and its location tops out at 22%; reference-dependent faults (above all a bypassed guardrail) stay near-unsolved from a single trace. An aligned reference improves selected relative faults but does not resolve guardrail bypass. The held-out labels and compact prediction format support reproducible comparison of LLM-based and non-LLM diagnosis methods.

AI.tldr: AGENTCHAOSBENCH是一个用于检测和定位智能体系统中运行时故障的基准测试。它基于Agent-to-Agent协议和Model Context Protocol构建了5个异构应用，注入了10种操作故障（工具不可用/慢、响应损坏/过大、委托延迟/循环/错路由、护栏绕过等），生成了275条清洗过的执行轨迹（250条故障+25条无故障对照）。基准测试表明该任务远未解决：零样本LLM基线在故障类型识别上仅达13.6-24.8%的top-1准确率，联合定位故障类型和位置最高仅22%。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体系统的可靠性是整个执行过程（工具调用、模型调用、护栏、代理间消息）的属性，而不仅仅是最终答案的属性。仅评估任务结果无法揭示运行失败的方式和原因，因此需要一个新的基准来检测和定位智能体系统中的运行时故障。
AI.method: 作者运行了5个通过Agent-to-Agent协议协调代理、通过Model Context Protocol调用工具的异构应用，在工具、模型、护栏和代理间边界注入10种操作故障，并设置无故障对照组。每个故障轨迹与相同输入的无故障执行对齐，故障类型标签和位置标签被保留用于诊断。构建了275条清洗后的轨迹数据集。
AI.result: 在结构化单轨迹输入上，零样本LLM基线表现不佳：高达14B参数的局部检测器仅达到13.6-19.2%的top-1故障类型准确率，前沿的DeepSeek-v4-pro仅达24.8%；联合识别故障类型和位置最高为22%；参考依赖型故障（尤其是护栏绕过）在单轨迹上几乎无法解决。对齐参考提高了部分相对故障，但未能解决护栏绕过。
AI.conclusion: 通过保留标签和紧凑的预测格式，该基准支持LLM和非LLM诊断方法的可复现比较，揭示智能体系统运行时故障诊断这一关键任务还远未解决，特别是护栏绕过等参考依赖型故障极具挑战性。

title: When Do Concepts Become Functionally Sufficient During Language-Model Training?
summary: Understanding a model and its learning mechanisms in depth requires identifying when its internal structures become useful, rather than simply looking at the final state. We study this through concept dynamics: at each layer and checkpoint, we decompose activations, select sparse soft masks, and inject masked reconstructions into the model. Concept analysis is therefore tested functionally: a mask is useful only insofar as it preserves a target under intervention. We compare sufficiency for activation reconstruction, linear decodability, true downstream preservation, and checkpoint transfer under learned alignment. The framework treats decomposition assumptions as hypotheses rather than interpretability guarantees, monitoring functional sufficiency across checkpoints and source-to-final reconstructability under learned alignment. At the shared fixed-penalty operating point across seven models, downstream masks retain substantially less soft mass than reconstruction masks; predictive-distribution shifts remain small.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于概念动力学的功能化可解释性框架，通过在每层和检查点分解激活、选择稀疏软掩码并注入掩码重建，以干预测试方式检验概念是否真正有用。研究发现：在七个模型的共享固定惩罚操作点下，下游任务掩码保留的软质量远少于重建掩码，但预测分布偏移较小。
AI.motivation: 深入理解模型及其学习机制需要识别内部结构在何时变得有用，而非仅观察最终状态。现有可解释性方法往往将分解假设视为可解释性保证，缺乏功能性的检验。作者希望通过干预测试来衡量概念掩码的真实效用。
AI.method: 在每一层和检查点对激活进行分解，选择稀疏软掩码，并将掩码重建注入模型中。对概念分析进行功能性测试：衡量掩码在干预下保留目标的程度。比较了激活重建充分性、线性可解码性、真实下游任务保留性，以及在学到的对齐下检查点转移能力。将分解假设视为假设而非保证，并在检查点间和源到最终的可重建性上进行功能充分性的监控。
AI.result: 在七个模型的共享固定惩罚操作点下，下游任务掩码保留的软质量显著少于重建掩码；预测分布偏移在干预下保持较小。
AI.conclusion: 概念分析应通过功能干预来检验而非仅依赖最终状态；下游保留与重建充分性之间存在显著差异，表明不同用途需要不同的概念表征，且分解假设需持续监控其功能性充分性。

title: SpIn-ViT: Designing a Sparsity-Induced Vision Transformer That Is Mechanistically Interpretable
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has recently expanded to Vision Transformers (ViTs), with Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) increasingly used as post-hoc tools to decompose internal representations into sparse and more interpretable features. However, because post-hoc SAEs are trained on frozen representations after the ViT has already been optimized, their latent features are not directly aligned with the downstream classification objective. We introduce SpIn-ViT, a framework that jointly trains a pretrained ViT and a modified SAE end-to-end, directly aligning sparse patch-level representations with image classification. SpIn-ViT learns semantically coherent neuron activations that localize meaningful image regions while maintaining competitive predictive performance. We evaluate SpIn-ViT across nine image-classification benchmarks using classification accuracy, quantitative interpretability metrics, AI-based and Human evaluations. Compared with the previous state-of-the-art post-hoc SAE method, SpIn-ViT achieves 8.84% higher average classification accuracy, an AI-based interpretability score nearly four times as high, and a human-evaluation score more than twice as high. We further extract interpretable rule-sets using the SAE neurons to create neurosymbolic models which achieve 5.97% higher average classification accuracy while requiring a 58.8\% smaller rule-set than the neurosymbolic models created from the SOTA post-hoc SAE method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpIn-ViT框架，将预训练的Vision Transformer与改进的稀疏自编码器（SAE）进行端到端联合训练，使稀疏的patch级表示直接对齐图像分类任务，相比事后SAE方法在分类准确率、可解释性评分和神经符号规则提取方面均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 事后训练的SAE基于冻结的ViT表示进行训练，其潜在特征与下游分类目标不对齐，导致特征解释性与模型预测目标之间缺乏直接关联。
AI.method: SpIn-ViT将预训练的ViT与修改后的SAE进行端到端联合训练，使稀疏patch级表示直接对齐图像分类目标，从而学习语义连贯的神经元激活并定位有意义的图像区域。
AI.result: 在九个图像分类基准上，相比现有最优的事后SAE方法：分类准确率平均提高8.84%，AI可解释性评分提升近4倍，人工评估评分提升2倍以上；提取的神经符号模型准确率提高5.97%，且规则集缩小58.8%。
AI.conclusion: SpIn-ViT通过端到端联合训练证明了将可解释性组件与分类目标对齐的有效性，不仅提升了可解释性，还同时增强了分类性能和神经符号模型的效率。

title: ARGUS: Attention-Guided Transformers for Scalable Person Identification Using Wi-Fi Telemetry
summary: Passive, device-free person identification offers an alternative to camera- and wearable-based biometrics, yet existing wireless approaches rely largely on gait or activity cues and are rarely evaluated at scale. In this paper, we present \emph{Argus}, a passive Wi-Fi sensing system that identifies people from commodity Channel State Information (CSI) without requiring an attached device or a prescribed motion. Argus converts short CSI spans into compact \emph{statgrams}: statistical maps built from the channel views available on a given device. A lightweight decoder-only Transformer then reads coarse statgram patches as tokens, and segment-level logit aggregation combines evidence over time. On a 154-subject CSI dataset evaluated with a strict physical-segment split, Argus reaches $78.88\% \pm 1.62\%$ Top-1 accuracy on 6-second windows and $84.85\% \pm 1.31\%$ after aggregating 19 overlapping windows over a 60-second segment; Top-3 and Top-5 reach $98.61\%$ and $99.26\%$. For a 60-second statgram, Argus improves over a raw-CSI Transformer baseline by 7.75 points while using $4.4\times$ fewer FLOPs per window. Attention-guided compression preserves full single-window accuracy with only half of the EHealth patches. On WiMANS, a multi-user benchmark across three rooms and two Wi-Fi bands, Argus remains within 1.23 percentage points of the strongest per-configuration baselines on average while using $27\times$ fewer inference FLOPs. These results show that compact CSI statistics can scale passive identification while also exposing deployment limits in open-set rejection and cross-room transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Argus，一个被动Wi-Fi感知系统，利用商用设备的信道状态信息（CSI）进行无设备、免穿戴的人员识别。Argus将短CSI片段转换为紧凑的统计图谱（statgrams），并使用轻量级decoder-only Transformer处理，通过分段级别的logit聚合来提升识别精度。在154名受试者的数据集上，Argus在60秒分段上达到84.85%的Top-1准确率，同时比基线少用4.4倍FLOPs，并在多用户基准WiMANS上验证了其跨场景泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有无线人员识别方法主要依赖步态或活动线索，缺乏大规模评估，且通常不够紧凑高效。作者希望提供一种无需附加设备、无需规定动作的被动Wi-Fi识别方案，能够在更大规模数据上验证其有效性，并探索其部署极限。
AI.method: Argus将短CSI片段转化为紧凑的统计图谱（statgrams），即从设备可用的信道视图中构建的统计图。随后使用轻量级decoder-only Transformer将粗粒度的statgram补丁作为token进行处理，并通过分段级别的logit聚合跨时间整合证据。此外引入注意力引导的压缩策略，仅用一半的EHealth补丁即可保持完整精度。
AI.result: 在154名受试者的数据集上，Argus在6秒窗口上达到78.88%±1.62%的Top-1准确率，60秒分段上达到84.85%±1.31%；Top-3和Top-5分别达到98.61%和99.26%。相比raw-CSI Transformer基线提升7.75个点，同时FLOPs减少4.4倍。在WiMANS多用户基准上，与最强基线平均差距仅为1.23个百分点，推理FLOPs减少27倍。
AI.conclusion: Argus证明紧凑的CSI统计特征能够规模化支持被动人员识别，同时指出了在开放集拒绝和跨房间迁移方面的部署局限性，为后续研究提供了方向。

title: A Comprehensive Survey of Wireless Foundation Models for AI-Native 6G Networks
comment: 28 Pages, submitted to IEEE Communications Surveys and Tutorials
summary: Foundation models are emerging as a transformative paradigm for AI-native sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks by enabling scalable, transferable, and data-efficient intelligence across diverse communication tasks. Unlike conventional deep learning models that are trained for individual applications, wireless foundation models (WFMs) learn generalized representations from large-scale heterogeneous wireless data and can be efficiently adapted to communication, sensing, localization, and network optimization tasks with minimal task-specific supervision. Despite rapid progress, current research remains fragmented across architectures, training paradigms, and application domains, with no unified survey dedicated to the design, learning, and deployment of WFMs. This survey presents a comprehensive and unified review of wireless foundation models. We first establish the fundamental concepts of WFMs and introduce a taxonomy that organizes the field according to model architectures, pre-training paradigms, and applications. We then review representative architectures, self-supervised pre-training strategies, parameter-efficient adaptation methods, datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies, highlighting their roles in enabling transferable wireless intelligence. Furthermore, we examine emerging applications spanning physical-layer signal processing, network intelligence, and cross-layer optimization, and discuss the key challenges of data availability, generalization, interpretability, efficient edge deployment, and standardization. Finally, we outline future research directions toward scalable, trustworthy, and general-purpose wireless intelligence for AI-native 6G networks. This survey provides a comprehensive reference for researchers and practitioners developing next-generation intelligent wireless systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于无线基础模型（WFMs）的全面综述，系统性地回顾了无线基础模型在AI原生6G网络中的设计、学习与部署。文章建立了WFM的基本概念和分类体系，涵盖模型架构、预训练范式、参数高效适配方法、数据集、基准和评估方法，并探讨了在物理层信号处理、网络智能和跨层优化中的应用，最后讨论了数据可用性、泛化能力、可解释性、边缘部署和标准化等关键挑战及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 无线基础模型（WFMs）正在成为AI原生6G网络的关键使能技术，但当前研究在架构、训练范式和应用领域上呈现碎片化状态，缺乏一篇统一的综述来系统梳理WFMs的设计、学习与部署，这阻碍了该领域的整合发展。
AI.method: 本文采用综述研究方法，首先建立WFM的基本概念并引入分类体系（按模型架构、预训练范式和应用三个维度组织），随后系统回顾代表性架构、自监督预训练策略、参数高效适配方法、数据集、基准和评估方法论，并进一步考察跨物理层和多层领域的应用场景。
AI.result: 本文全面梳理了无线基础模型的研究现状，揭示了该领域在架构选择、预训练策略和应用场景方面的最新进展，同时识别出数据可用性、泛化能力、可解释性、边缘高效部署和标准化五大核心挑战，并提出了面向可扩展、可信赖和通用无线智能的未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 无线基础模型代表了6G网络中实现可扩展、可迁移、数据高效的无线智能的关键范式转变，未来需要朝着构建规模化、可信赖、通用化的无线智能系统方向努力，以支撑AI原生6G网络的落地。

title: Skill2Query: Exploiting Skill Structure to Generate Pseudo-Queries for Agent Skill Retrieval
summary: Pseudo-query generation can alleviate the supervision bottleneck for agent skill retrieval, but existing document-level approaches typically leave the rich internal relations among capabilities, parameters, and usage examples implicit. As a result, generated queries may be topically relevant to a skill while lacking capability grounding and parameter consistency, raising the question of whether explicitly exploiting a skill document's internal structure can produce more effective retrieval signals. We therefore propose Skill2Query, a framework that first parses a skill document into a Skill Knowledge Graph and then generates pseudo-queries through a three-stage process including style mimicking, query template generation, and parameter filling. The generated queries can be used for offline index augmentation, online query expansion, and retriever training. Four benchmarks (TheoremQA, LogicBench, ToolQA, and CHAMP) are used to evaluate Skill2Query with large-scale skill candidate pools across multiple downstream applications, including skill retrieval, retriever training, and end-to-end agent execution. Using nearly 30K skills across diverse domains, we generate 700K category-diverse pseudo-queries. Skill2Query consistently improves sparse, dense, and skill-routing retrieval, with an average Recall@1 gain of 6.70 percentage points across retrieval settings. Skill2Query-generated training data also achieves the best Recall@1 and nDCG@1 among the evaluated generation baselines. Further evaluations with multiple LLM backends demonstrate that improved skill retrieval translates into higher agent task success rates. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/MatZaharia/Skill2Query.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Skill2Query框架，通过将技能文档解析为技能知识图谱，再经过风格模仿、查询模板生成和参数填充三阶段生成伪查询，从而缓解智能体技能检索的监督瓶颈。在近3万技能、70万伪查询的规模下，Skill2Query在稀疏、稠密和技能路由检索上平均Recall@1提升6.70个百分点，并提升端到端智能体任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的文档级伪查询生成方法通常忽略了能力、参数和使用示例之间丰富的内部关系，导致生成的查询虽然在主题上与技能相关，但缺乏能力依据和参数一致性。作者质疑：是否显式利用技能文档的内部结构能产生更有效的检索信号？
AI.method: Skill2Query框架包含两个核心步骤：1）将技能文档解析为技能知识图谱（Skill Knowledge Graph），显式建模能力、参数和示例间的内部关系；2）通过三阶段流程生成伪查询：风格模仿（style mimicking）、查询模板生成（query template generation）和参数填充（parameter filling）。生成的查询可用于离线索引增强、在线查询扩展和检索器训练。
AI.result: 在TheoremQA、LogicBench、ToolQA和CHAMP四个基准上评估，使用近3万个跨域技能生成70万条类别多样的伪查询。Skill2Query在稀疏、稠密和技能路由检索上均取得一致提升，平均Recall@1提升6.70个百分点；生成的训练数据在Recall@1和nDCG@1上优于其他生成基线；多个LLM后端评估表明改进的技能检索能转化为更高的智能体任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用技能文档的内部结构（知识图谱）来指导伪查询生成，相比于文档级方法能产生更具能力依据和参数一致性的检索信号，从而在多类检索任务和下游智能体执行中带来一致且显著的性能提升。

title: Logical Embeddings for Argument Analysis
summary: We propose a new framework for machine-learning-oriented argument analysis tasks. Our proposal involves replacing traditional contextualized word embeddings used in most NLP tasks with logical embeddings, an alternative encoding that directly exploits argumentation structures. In essence, logical embeddings encapsulate the logical semantics of an argument, allowing for a better representation of its meaning. Supporting these embeddings is a mathematical logic-based similarity measure that offers a transparent notion of proximity and is guaranteed to satisfy several desirable theoretical properties that current cosine similarity-based contextualized word embeddings cannot assure. This similarity measure induces a positive semi-definite kernel on the set of arguments, enabling us to uniquely define logical embeddings using the theory of Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHS). Moreover, we prove that this encoding is optimal, in the sense that no logical information is lost in the process. As with other RKHS applications, logical embeddings can be used in numerous supervised and unsupervised tasks. We provide an implementation of the method and aim to test it against literature benchmarks. Additionally, we demonstrate that logical embeddings outperform most standard embedding methods on a classification task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"逻辑嵌入"（logical embeddings）的新框架，用于机器学习导向的论证分析任务。该框架用基于论证结构的逻辑嵌入替代传统的上下文词嵌入，并配套一种基于数学逻辑的相似度度量，该度量满足余弦相似度无法保证的理论性质，并通过RKHS理论实现最优编码（不丢失逻辑信息）。实验表明逻辑嵌入在分类任务上优于大多数标准嵌入方法。
AI.motivation: 传统上下文词嵌入（如BERT等）虽然在大多数NLP任务中表现优异，但在论证分析任务中存在两个关键缺陷：一是基于余弦相似度的表征缺乏透明、可解释的邻近性概念；二是无法保证某些理想的理论性质。作者希望利用论证结构本身，设计一种更能捕捉逻辑语义的嵌入表示，从而提升论证分析任务的效果。
AI.method: 1) 提出逻辑嵌入概念，直接利用论证结构而非词上下文来编码论点的逻辑语义。2) 设计一种基于数学逻辑的相似度度量，保证满足若干理想理论性质。3) 证明该相似度度量诱导一个正半定核，从而可借助Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHS)理论唯一定义逻辑嵌入。4) 通过理论证明该编码在逻辑信息保留意义上是最优的。
AI.result: 提供了方法实现，并在文献基准上进行了测试。实验表明，逻辑嵌入在分类任务上的表现优于大多数标准嵌入方法。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑嵌入为论证分析提供了一种更具理论保证的替代方案，在保持逻辑信息完整性的同时提升了下游任务性能，有望在众多监督与无监督的论证分析场景中广泛应用。

title: PaSTel: Anchoring Histology in Spatial Transcriptomics via Multi-Scale Hierarchical Bio-Prior Contrastive Pretraining
comment: This paper was accepted to the 3rd ICML 2026 Workshop on Multi-modal Foundation Models and Large Language Models for Life Sciences
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) links tissue morphology with molecular programs, motivating multimodal pretraining methods that align histology images with gene expression. However, existing approaches suffer from two key limitations: spatially informative gene selection is often dominated by ubiquitous housekeeping genes, leading to weakly discriminative representations, and independent spot-patch alignment fails to capture spatial dependencies that are critical for tissue organization. To address these challenges, we introduce PaSTel, a hierarchical multimodal pretraining framework that integrates biological priors at three levels. At the spot level, TF-IDF reweighting is used to identify spatially informative genes; at the functional level, curated KEGG pathways serve as anchors for encoding global biological semantics; and at the regional level, spatial clustering aggregates neighboring spots to model meso-scale tissue structure. Across multiple downstream tasks, PaSTel consistently outperforms existing vision and vision-omics encoders, demonstrating that incorporating multiscale biological priors yields more informative and transferable representations for spatial transcriptomics.

AI.tldr: PaSTel是一个分层多模态预训练框架，通过整合三个层面的生物学先验（点水平的TF-IDF基因重加权、功能水平的KEGG通路锚点、区域水平的空间聚类）来改进空间转录组学中组织图像与基因表达的联合表征学习，在多个下游任务中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有空间转录组学多模态预训练方法存在两个关键局限：1）空间信息基因选择常被管家基因主导，导致判别性表征弱；2）独立的点-图像块对齐无法捕捉对组织结构至关重要的空间依赖关系。
AI.method: PaSTel提出分层多模态预训练框架，在三个层面整合生物学先验：1）点水平：使用TF-IDF重加权来识别空间信息基因；2）功能水平：以精选的KEGG通路作为锚点编码全局生物学语义；3）区域水平：通过空间聚类聚合邻近点以建模中尺度组织结构。
AI.result: 在多个下游任务中，PaSTel一致优于现有的视觉编码器和视觉-组学编码器，表明整合多尺度生物学先验能够产生更具信息量和可转移性的空间转录组学表征。
AI.conclusion: 将多尺度生物学先验整合到多模态预训练中，可以有效提升空间转录组学表征的信息量和可迁移性，为组织形态与分子程序的联合建模提供了更优方案。

title: Take it Personally: The Limits of General SSL Representations for Real-Life PPG Emotion Detection
comment: 9 pages, 4 Figures, 2 Tables, Accepted as the 14th International Conference on Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII 2026)
summary: While Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) effectively extracts general representations from noisy, unconstrained physiological signals such as photoplethysmography (PPG), its suitability for highly subjective tasks remains unproven. In this work, we evaluate the efficacy of PPG-based SSL for real-life intense emotion detection. First, we pretrain a Real-Life PPG encoder (RL-PPG) on unconstrained, real-life data. As a rigorous sanity check, we demonstrate that these representations transfer exceptionally well to an objective physical activity recognition task, yielding almost 5-fold increase in performance over baselines in a leave-one-subject-out evaluation (LOSO). However, when applied to a~subjective real-life emotion detection task, these same general representations fail to surpass naive baselines under the LOSO protocol. Using an Across-Time validation strategy, we establish that incorporating an individual's personal data during fine-tuning is the main driver of predictive performance, outweighing the benefits of population-level pretraining. Ultimately, our findings indicate that in the evaluated scenario, general SSL representations may be insufficient for subjective affective inference, suggesting that personalization is likely a key component for real-world emotion recognition. To support future research, we share the code and pretrained RL-PPG~encoder~weights.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了基于PPG（光电容积脉搏波）的自监督学习（SSL）在现实生活强烈情绪检测中的有效性。研究发现，SSL表征在客观的身体活动识别任务中表现出色（LOSO评估下性能提升近5倍），但在主观的情绪检测任务中却无法超越朴素基线。通过跨时间验证策略，作者发现个性化微调是预测性能的主要驱动力，而群体级预训练收益有限，表明通用SSL表征对主观情感推断可能不足，个性化是现实情绪识别的关键。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习虽然能从PPG等无约束生理信号中有效提取通用表征，但其在高度主观任务（如情绪检测）中的适用性尚未得到验证。作者希望系统性地检验SSL表征在客观任务与主观任务上的迁移表现差异，以明确其局限性和适用边界。
AI.method: 作者首先在无约束现实生活数据上预训练了一个RL-PPG编码器。作为严谨的合理性检验，将其迁移到客观的身体活动识别任务（LOSO评估）；随后应用于主观的现实生活情绪检测任务，采用LOSO和Across-Time两种验证策略，对比个体微调数据与群体预训练对预测性能的贡献。
AI.result: RL-PPG表征在身体活动识别任务上表现优异，相比基线提升了近5倍；但在情绪检测任务的LOSO协议下未能超越朴素基线。Across-Time验证表明，个体数据微调是性能的主要驱动因素，其贡献超过了群体级预训练带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 通用SSL表征在主观情感推断场景中可能不足，个性化（引入个体数据）是现实世界情绪识别的关键组成部分。作者公开了代码和预训练权重以支持后续研究。

title: Synchronized Logit Steering: Real-world Steganography
summary: Steganography in large language models offers a way to embed hidden messages within natural-sounding text. Existing token and logit-level methods typically require the sender and receiver to share an identical prompt context, which is rarely guaranteed in production pipelines that use retrieval-augmented generation or proprietary system instructions. We introduce Synchronized Logit Steering (SLS), a deterministic steganographic scheme that eliminates this dependency by deriving a proxy prompt from the generated output itself, allowing both parties to reconstruct the same logit distribution without access to the original prompt. SLS encodes payload values as token ranks within high-entropy regions of the proxy prompt distribution, and we extend the scheme with periodic recurrence and payload bursts to scale information density. Across ShareGPT, GSM8K, and SWE-bench Verified, we show that the KL divergence between the true and proxy prompt distributions falls below 0.5 nats once the synchronization window reaches 40 tokens, and SLS encoding does not meaningfully disrupt this convergence relative to greedy generation. We also find that the periodic-burst variant achieves 0.20 bits per token, or roughly 10x the capacity of single-payload encoding. Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests further confirm that SLS outputs are statistically difficult to distinguish from greedy generations, demonstrating that covert, prompt-agnostic communication through LLMs is both practical and stealthy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为同步逻辑指引（SLS）的确定性隐写方案，通过从生成输出本身推导代理提示（proxy prompt），消除了发送方和接收方需共享相同提示上下文的依赖，使得双方无需访问原始提示即可重建相同的逻辑分布。SLS在高熵区域的代理提示分布中按token排名编码有效载荷，并通过周期性重复和载荷突发来扩展信息密度。实验表明，在40个token的同步窗口后，真实与代理提示分布的KL散度低于0.5 nats，周期性突发变体实现0.20比特/token的容量（约为单次载荷编码的10倍），且KS检验证明SLS输出在统计上难以与贪婪生成区分。
AI.motivation: 现有token级和logit级的隐写方法要求发送方与接收方共享完全相同的提示上下文，但在实际生产管线（如检索增强生成RAG或专有系统指令）中这一前提往往无法满足，限制了隐写通信的实用性和隐蔽性。
AI.method: SLS提出从生成输出自身推导代理提示（proxy prompt），使双方无需共享原始提示即可重建相同的logit分布；在高熵区域按token排名编码载荷值；并扩展了周期性重复和载荷突发两种变体以提升信息密度。
AI.result: 在ShareGPT、GSM8K和SWE-bench Verified上，同步窗口达到40个token后，真实与代理提示分布的KL散度降至0.5 nats以下，且SLS编码相对贪婪生成不会显著破坏收敛；周期性突发变体达到0.20比特/每token的容量（约为单次编码的10倍）；KS检验表明SLS输出在统计上难以与贪婪生成区分。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明通过LLM实现隐蔽、不依赖提示的通信既实用又隐蔽，为无共享上下文的隐写通信提供了可行方案。

title: LongRCA Bench: Diagnosing Responsible Roles and Root Causes in Long-Horizon Agent Failures
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Yunfei Zhang and Boyu Feng contributed equally. Changhua Pei is the corresponding author
summary: When a long-horizon agent execution fails, outcome-level evaluation reveals the unsuccessful result but not where the decisive error entered the trajectory. Developers must then inspect the full execution to identify the responsible role and localize the earliest decisive root-cause step. Existing failure-attribution benchmarks largely focus on shorter traces, leaving diagnosis across hundreds of recorded steps underexplored. We introduce LongRCA Bench, comprising 1,140 failed trajectories across five domains without injected errors. It provides independently scored human labels for the responsible role and earliest decisive root-cause step. The median trajectory contains 145 steps, and the strongest baseline reaches only 13.2% exact root-step accuracy. We further present Root-Cause Trajectory Attribution (RCTA), a training-free method that retrieves candidate error steps from segment summaries and traces them to available earlier handoff instructions. Using the same backbone, benchmark instances, and scoring protocol, RCTA reaches 51.1% responsible-role accuracy and 24.1% exact root-step accuracy. These results highlight the need to evaluate responsible-role attribution and exact root-step localization as separate targets in long-trajectory failure diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LongRCA Bench，一个包含1,140条跨五个领域的长轨迹失败诊断基准（中位数145步），并引入RCTA方法，一种无需训练的技术，通过段摘要检索候选错误步骤并回溯至早期指令，在责任角色和根因步骤定位上显著超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有失败归因基准多关注较短轨迹，缺乏对数百步长轨迹中错误诊断的研究。当长时程智能体执行失败时，仅凭结果级评估无法定位决定性错误进入轨迹的位置，开发者需要检查完整执行过程来识别责任角色和根因步骤，这一需求尚未被充分满足。
AI.method: 构建LongRCA Bench（1,140条无注入错误的失败轨迹，包含独立评分的责任角色和最早决定性根因步骤标签）；提出Root-Cause Trajectory Attribution (RCTA)，一种训练免费的方法，从段摘要中检索候选错误步骤并将其追溯至可用的早期交接指令。
AI.result: 最强基线仅达到13.2%的精确根因步骤准确率；RCTA方法达到51.1%的责任角色准确率和24.1%的精确根因步骤准确率，使用相同骨干模型、基准实例和评分协议。
AI.conclusion: 长轨迹失败诊断中，责任角色归因与精确根因步骤定位应作为两个独立目标进行评估。当前基线在长轨迹诊断上表现不足，RCTA展示了无需训练的潜力，但仍需进一步改进。

title: Think Inside the Chunk: RegulaRAG for Regulation-Compliant Scenario Generation using LLMs: A Case Study of UN Regulation No. 152
summary: Generating regulation-compliant test scenarios is essential for validating safety-critical automotive systems, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to ground outputs in long, hierarchical standards. We present RegulaRAG, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline that couples SmartChunking, reference-aware enrichment of paragraphs and tables via graph traversal, with Smart Retrieve & Rerank over these enriched units. To test our system, we evaluate on a manually curated dataset covering all scenarios in UN Regulation No. 152 (AEBS). Our study comprises: (i) a three-step progressive search that identifies near-optimal retrieval parameters without exhaustive grid search; (ii) head-to-head comparisons against five baseline RAG systems; and (iii) a robustness stress test that scales the source corpus with distractor content. Outputs are evaluated using a customized penalized scoring metric. Across all experiments, RegulaRAG achieves the highest average Meta-Score (82.99), outperforming the next-best system by 43% (NoRAG: 57.94), while operating at 14k-25k tokens per query versus up to 500k for graphcentric baselines. It maintains strong performance, remaining stable even as the number of regulatory sources grows, whereas competing RAG systems degrade sharply in both quality and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RegulaRAG，一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的流水线，用于从长层次化法规标准（如UN R152）中生成合规的自动驾驶测试场景。该系统结合智能分块（SmartChunking）、参考感知的段落与表格增强（通过图遍历）以及智能检索重排序，在手动标注的AEBS全场景数据集上，以82.99的Meta-Score远超五个基线系统，且推理成本远低于基于图的方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在从长而层次化的法规标准中生成合规测试场景时存在困难，难以将输出锚定到具体的法规条款。现有RAG系统在处理这类结构化法规文本时表现不足，需要更精细的文本分块与检索策略。
AI.method: 构建RegulaRAG流水线，包括：(1) SmartChunking智能分块，对段落和表格进行参考感知的图遍历增强；(2) Smart Retrieve & Rank在增强单元上进行检索与重排序；(3) 三步渐进式搜索确定近似最优检索参数；(4) 使用定制化惩罚评分指标评估输出质量。
AI.result: RegulaRAG取得最高平均Meta-Score（82.99），比次优系统（NoRAG：57.94）高出43%，每次查询仅消耗14k-25k tokens（相比之下基于图的基线系统消耗高达500k tokens）。在干扰语料扩展的压力测试中性能保持稳定，而竞争对手系统质量与鲁棒性均显著下降。
AI.conclusion: RegulaRAG在法规合规测试场景生成任务中证明了RAG流水线的有效性，通过智能分块与参考感知增强显著提升LLM对长法规标准的理解与检索能力，同时保持高效的计算成本和良好的可扩展性。

title: When AI Rewrites, Classifiers Relax: Uncertainty-Aware Sentiment Analysis on Sarcastic and AI-Paraphrased Social Text
summary: Sentiment classifiers are increasingly applied to social media content that is either sarcastic or AI-generated --- two distributional regimes where standard evaluations offer little guidance. We present a three-part empirical study of sentiment classifier behaviour under these conditions. First, we find that confidence scores on sarcastic text are significantly lower than on non-sarcastic text (Mann--Whitney $p = 2 \times 10^{-6}$), confirming that classifiers sense their own uncertainty on ironic content even without explicit uncertainty modelling. Second, and counterintuitively, we show that sentiment classifiers achieve higher accuracy on AI-paraphrased reviews than on the original human-authored text (RoBERTa: $+5.8$ pp for Qwen3.5-4B paraphrases, $+3.7$ pp for Gemma4-E4B), revealing a cross-domain stylistic alignment effect: AI paraphrases remove distributional noise that confounds Twitter-trained classifiers, producing cleaner, more prototypical sentiment text. Third, we demonstrate that a lightweight abstention wrapper --- flagging the $14\%$ of inputs with confidence below $0.6$ --- improves accuracy from 82.2\% to 88.9\% ($+6.7$ pp) on the retained set. We further compare Semantic Entropy and MC-Dropout-style disagreement as uncertainty signals and find near-identical AUROC ($0.650$ vs.\ $0.646$) on sarcastic text, suggesting that for short social media inputs, both methods are interchangeable. Our results motivate a shift from confident single-label prediction to uncertainty-aware abstention in high-stakes sentiment applications such as mental health flagging and content moderation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三部分实证研究，考察了情感分类器在讽刺文本和AI生成文本这两种分布外场景下的表现。研究发现：分类器在讽刺文本上置信度显著降低；对AI改写文本的准确率反而高于原始人类文本（跨域风格对齐效应）；一个轻量级弃权机制（标记14%低置信度输入）可将准确率从82.2%提升至88.9%。语义熵和MC-Dropout两种不确定性信号在讽刺文本上表现几乎相同（AUROC 0.650 vs 0.646）。
AI.motivation: 情感分类器广泛应用于社交媒体内容，而讽刺文本和AI生成文本是两种标准评估难以覆盖的分布外场景。现有研究对分类器在这些条件下的行为缺乏系统性理解，需要实证研究来指导高影响应用（如心理健康标记、内容审核）中的模型部署。
AI.method: 采用三部分实证研究设计：(1) 使用Mann-Whitney检验比较讽刺与非讽刺文本上的置信度分布；(2) 对比AI改写与人类原始文本上的分类准确率，使用RoBERTa作为分类器，Qwen3.5-4B和Gemma4-E4B作为改写模型；(3) 实现轻量级弃权包装器，将置信度低于0.6的输入标记为不确定，并对比语义熵与MC-Dropout两种不确定性信号。
AI.result: 讽刺文本上的置信度显著低于非讽刺文本（p=2×10⁻⁶）；AI改写文本上的准确率高于原始文本（RoBERTa在Qwen3.5-4B改写上+5.8pp，Gemma4-E4B上+3.7pp）；弃权机制将准确率从82.2%提升至88.9%（+6.7pp）；语义熵和MC-Dropout在讽刺文本上的AUROC近乎相同（0.650 vs 0.646）。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为不确定性感知的弃权策略提供了有力支持，建议在高风险情感分析场景中从自信的单标签预测转向不确定性感知的弃权决策。AI改写能去除混淆分类器的分布噪声，产生更干净、更典型的情感文本。两种不确定性方法可互换使用。

title: Looks Can be Deceiving: Annotator and Reviewer Performance Across Imagery Sources in Crowd-Sourced Aerial Damage Assessment
summary: This paper presents the first known empirical investigation of annotator and reviewer performance across multi-source remotely sensed imagery, evaluating human labeling across drone, crewed aviation, and satellite views. Because existing aerial imagery datasets rely predominantly on single-source imagery, there is no currently established state of practice for efficiently allocating human labor to curate large-scale, multi-source aerial datasets. This work addresses this limitation by analyzing annotator and reviewer performance within a post-disaster building damage assessment dataset of 9 disasters, where 20041 buildings in drone, 20695 buildings in crewed aviation, and 33392 buildings in satellite imagery were labeled. These labels, provided by 187 annotators, were then refined through two successive quality-control stages: a single-reviewer pass followed by a consensus-committee review. Our analysis reveals two findings that raise questions for standard crowd-sourcing practices. First, initial annotations were revised by the final committee at rates that rise steeply from higher- to lower-resolution sources (25.27% for crewed aviation and 36.95% for satellite), with the same ordering at every observed workflow stage. Second, a single individual review reduced but did not resolve this disagreement: after review, the committee still revised 6.85% of drone, 14.05% of crewed, and 20.86% of satellite labels. These observations suggest that, in workflows like this one, uniform review allocation leaves the most residual disagreement in lower-resolution imagery. Based on this evidence, and consistent with prior work on adaptive task assignment and budget-aware quality control, this paper offers three recommendations for multi-source dataset curation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证研究了多源遥感影像（无人机、载人航空、卫星）中标注者与审核者的表现差异，基于9场灾害的建筑物损毁评估数据集（覆盖7万余栋建筑、187名标注者、两级质控流程），发现分辨率越低，标注修订率越高（卫星高达36.95%），且单轮审核无法消除分歧。据此提出多源数据集标注的三项建议。
AI.motivation: 现有航拍影像数据集主要依赖单一影像源，缺乏对多源遥感影像中人力标注分配效率的实证研究，无法为大规模多源航拍数据集的构建提供人力分配的实践指导。
AI.method: 利用包含9场灾害、20041栋无人机影像建筑、20695栋载人航空影像建筑和33392栋卫星影像建筑标注数据的数据集，由187名标注者完成初始标注，再经过单人审核和共识委员会两轮质控，统计各影像源在各阶段标注修订率。
AI.result: 1) 初始标注修订率从高分辨率到低分辨率呈陡峭上升趋势（载人航空25.27%，卫星36.95%）；2) 单人审核后委员会仍修订了6.85%无人机、14.05%载人航空和20.86%卫星标签，说明单人审核无法消除分歧。
AI.conclusion: 统一均匀的人力审核分配会导致低分辨率影像残留最多分歧，建议根据影像源分辨率实施差异化的自适应任务分配与预算感知的质量控制策略来策展多源数据集。

title: RouteTS: Frequency-Time Routing for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Real-world time series inherently intertwine global periodic structures with localized non-stationary variations. Existing approaches process these heterogeneous dynamics within a single computational domain, incurring fundamental limitations: time-domain models suffer from periodic misalignment over long horizons, while frequency-domain models over-smooth transient spikes. We argue that the optimal computational domain is not a property of the model, but of the data itself. Based on this principle, we propose RouteTS, a unified forecasting framework that partitions the frequency spectrum via amplitude routing and delegates components to their mathematically optimal domains. Dominant frequencies are processed by a complex-valued linear predictor in the frequency domain to preserve periodic structure, while residual spectral energy is reverted to the time domain and modeled by a lightweight MLP for local variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RouteTS achieves competitive prediction accuracy across diverse real-world datasets, with routing decisions guided by the underlying spectral signature. Furthermore, the lightweight design of RouteTS provides significant computational efficiency advantages, offering a principled solution to the longstanding dilemma between global periodicity and local transience.

AI.tldr: RouteTS提出了一种统一的时间序列预测框架，通过振幅路由将频谱划分为主导频率（在频域用复值线性预测器处理）和残差能量（在时域用轻量MLP处理），使每个成分在其数学最优域中被建模，在保持预测精度的同时显著提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: 真实世界时间序列同时包含全局周期性结构和局部非平稳变化，现有方法在单一计算域中处理这些异构动态存在根本缺陷：时域模型在长预测范围内会出现周期性错位，而频域模型会过度平滑瞬态尖峰。作者认为最优计算域不应由模型决定，而应由数据本身决定。
AI.method: RouteTS框架通过振幅路由对频率谱进行分区：主导频率被送入复值线性预测器在频域中处理以保留周期结构，剩余频谱能量则转换回时域并由轻量级MLP建模局部变化。路由决策由底层的频谱特征引导。
AI.result: 实验表明RouteTS在多个真实世界数据集上取得了具有竞争力的预测精度，同时得益于轻量级设计，在计算效率方面具有显著优势。
AI.conclusion: RouteTS为全局周期性与局部瞬变性之间的长期困境提供了原则性解决方案，证明数据自适应域选择是处理异构时间序列动态的有效途径。

title: Semantic Uncertainty-Guided Orchestration in Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems
summary: As large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems become increasingly capable, coordinating agents under uncertainty becomes a fundamental challenge. Existing orchestration strategies typically rely on fixed interaction patterns and often lack mechanisms for assessing the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, allowing errors and hallucinations to propagate through the system. This paper introduces a semantic-uncertainty-guided orchestration approach, HASSUM as a general framework for uncertainty-aware coordination in multi-agent systems. The method estimates uncertainty using semantic entropy and semantic density, which measure trust at the level of answer semantics rather than output probabilities. These signals enable adaptive orchestration decisions, including output verification, selective reprompting, additional deliberation, and confidence-aware response selection. Because the approach operates independently of any particular agent architecture, it can be integrated into a broad range of hierarchical and collaborative multi-agent systems. The evaluations demonstrate an implementation within a hierarchical agent framework and evaluate it on StrategyQA, JailbreakBench, and TruthfulQA benchmarks. Across tasks that require complex reasoning and are prone to ambiguity or hallucinations, uncertainty-guided orchestration yields more reliable outcomes than uncertainty-unaware coordination. Semantic entropy and semantic density in tandem outperformed either metric alone. Ablations testing different thresholds and model sizes demonstrated that both influence the effectiveness of semantic metrics. The results suggest that semantic uncertainty is a practical and general-purpose signal for improving robustness and trustworthiness in agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HASSUM，一个基于语义不确定性的多智能体系统协调框架，通过语义熵和语义密度评估智能体中间推理步骤的可信度，实现自适应协调决策（如输出验证、选择性重新提示、额外审议和置信度感知响应选择），从而提高复杂推理和易产生幻觉任务中的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的多智能体系统协调策略依赖固定交互模式，缺乏对中间推理步骤可靠性的评估机制，导致错误和幻觉在系统中传播。需要一种通用的不确定性感知协调机制来提升系统鲁棒性。
AI.method: 引入语义熵（semantic entropy）和语义密度（semantic density）作为语义层面的不确定性度量，替代基于输出概率的信任评估。这些信号驱动自适应的编排决策，包括输出验证、选择性重新提示、额外审议和置信度感知的响应选择。方法独立于具体智能体架构，可集成到层级式和协作式多智能体系统中。
AI.result: 在StrategyQA、JailbreakBench和TruthfulQA基准上的评估显示，不确定性引导的编排比不考虑不确定性的协调产生更可靠的结果。语义熵和语义密度联合使用优于单独使用任一度量。消融实验表明阈值和模型规模都影响语义度量的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 语义不确定性是一种实用且通用的信号，能够显著提升智能体AI系统的鲁棒性和可信度，为多智能体协调提供了一种可推广的不确定性感知框架。

title: Invariant Pretraining for Robust Code Representations
summary: Encoder-based code representation models remain widely deployed for discriminative tasks such as clone detection and code classification, where their small size and low inference cost are decisive. Their robustness, however, is fragile: under invariant programs, semantically equivalent code written in different syntactic forms, learned representations degrade substantially even though program behavior is unchanged. We present an empirical study of this robustness gap across four encoder baselines, two downstream tasks, and four datasets, together with a minimal code-only continued pretraining recipe that closes much of it. Our method, invariant pretraining (InvPT), applies semantic-preserving transformations to the corpus and combines masked language modeling with multi-positive supervised contrastive learning that treats all augmentations of the same source function as positives, mixing self-contrast pairs (same code, different masks) with invariant-contrast pairs (transformed code) for positives of varying difficulty. Unlike prior contrastive code encoders, InvPT does not require paired natural-language data. Across our evaluation, InvPT improves robustness on transformed test sets by up to 11 percentage points on clone detection and 19 on code classification while matching or improving standard accuracy, and our ablations isolate multi-positive invariant contrast as the main source of the gains. Our aim is not a new objective but a careful measurement of where encoder robustness breaks and how far a simple, code-only recipe can recover it.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于编码器的代码表示模型在语法变换下鲁棒性退化的问题，提出了一种仅使用代码的持续预训练方法InvPT。该方法通过语义保持变换生成增强样本，并结合掩码语言建模与多正样本监督对比学习（同一函数的所有增广作为正样本），在不依赖自然语言配对数据的情况下，将克隆检测鲁棒性提升最多11个百分点，代码分类最多提升19个百分点。
AI.motivation: 编码器类代码表示模型因其小规模和低推理成本被广泛用于判别性任务（如克隆检测、代码分类），但其鲁棒性脆弱：面对语法形式不同但语义等价的程序时，学习到的表示会显著退化。现有对比学习的代码编码器通常依赖自然语言配对数据，缺乏仅代码的鲁棒性改善方案。
AI.method: 提出不变性预训练（InvPT）方法：(1) 对语料库施加语义保持的代码变换；(2) 结合掩码语言建模与多正样本监督对比学习；(3) 将同一源函数的所有增广视为正样本，混合自对比对（相同代码、不同掩码）与不变对比对（变换代码）以构造不同难度的正样本；(4) 不需要配对的自然语言数据，仅使用代码。
AI.result: 在四个编码器基线、两个下游任务和四个数据集上，InvPT在变换测试集上使克隆检测鲁棒性提升最多11个百分点，代码分类提升19个百分点，同时匹配或提升了标准精度。消融实验表明多正样本不变对比学习是增益的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 作者强调本文目的不是提出全新目标函数，而是对编码器鲁棒性失效点进行细致测量，并展示一个简单的、仅代码的配方能在多大程度上恢复鲁棒性。结果表明，通过多正样本不变对比学习的持续预训练能有效弥合大部分鲁棒性差距。

title: When Tool-Backed Skill Retrieval Fails: Source-Style Collapse in Executable Capability Retrieval
summary: Large-scale agents increasingly rely on retrieval to access external capabilities. We study this retrieval gate in structured tools and APIs, a measurable class of tool-backed executable skills that must be surfaced before an agent can plan, incorporate, or act. In this setting the retrieval layer can silently fail even when the capability corpus is fixed: on ToolRet, a retriever fine-tuned on one source-specific slice collapses on another source-specific slice of the same benchmark, with FT-1100 despite its higher lexical overlap with the gold tools. We call this failure mode source-style collapse. Query-side TF-IDF fingerprints flag source styles on which the fine-tuned retriever is likely to fail better than semantic or length-based proxies, giving a cheap signal for mismatch over a fixed tool corpus. We propose ToolScout, a source-aware routing method that uses this signal as a routing guard: on the mixed 4,996-query stream, TF-IDF-based routing raises coverage from 22.3% to 86.1%, and across five collapsed sources 20 matched examples raise the coverage-weighted global top-1 proxy from 1.3% to 53.9%. The same failure and routing behaviors persist when tools are rerendered as executable skill cards, which rules out raw API-schema format as the sole cause.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大规模智能体在结构化工具和API检索中的"来源风格崩塌"（source-style collapse）问题：在固定工具语料库上，针对某一来源特定切片微调的检索器会在同基准的另一来源切片上性能骤降。作者提出基于TF-IDF查询指纹的来源感知路由方法ToolScout，能低成本检测不匹配并大幅提升检索覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 大规模智能体依赖检索访问外部能力，但检索层在结构化工具和API场景中可能静默失败。即使能力语料库固定不变，微调过的检索器在跨来源切片上仍会崩溃（例如FT-1100在同基准不同来源切片上表现骤降），这种失败模式此前未被系统研究，需要识别其成因并设计缓解方案。
AI.method: 1) 识别"来源风格崩塌"现象，通过词法重叠等指标排除简单归因；2) 提出查询侧TF-IDF指纹作为检测来源不匹配的廉价信号，优于语义或长度代理指标；3) 设计ToolScout来源感知路由方法，利用TF-IDF指纹作为路由守卫；4) 通过将工具重渲染为可执行技能卡片，排除原始API schema格式作为唯一原因。
AI.result: 在混合4,996条查询流上，TF-IDF路由将覆盖率从22.3%提升至86.1%；在五个崩塌来源上，20个匹配示例将覆盖率加权的全局top-1代理指标从1.3%提升至53.9%。工具重渲染为技能卡片后，失败和路由行为依然存在，说明根源并非单纯的API schema格式。
AI.conclusion: 来源风格崩塌是结构化工具检索中的一个真实且可诊断的失败模式，TF-IDF查询指纹提供了简单有效的检测信号，ToolScout路由方案能显著缓解该问题。该现象在工具重渲染为技能卡片后仍存在，表明其根源更深层，值得进一步研究。

title: The Machine's Internal Clock: Do LLMs Share Human Temporal Illusions?
summary: Human perception of time is subjective. Well-documented temporal illusions show that the brain relies on context and relational cues for judging duration instead of tracking elapsed time directly. Prior studies established these effects with visual and auditory stimuli. Existing LLM evaluations of temporal perception focus on estimating event durations or multi-step temporal reasoning. In this work, we investigate whether written narratives alone can evoke human temporal illusions, using a new benchmark of 6,684 narrative pairs spanning five illusions. We find that human readers (60 participants) prefer expected scenarios in only two of the five illusions, those where the manipulation is directly visible in text rather than requiring readers to internally simulate duration. We evaluate 14 LLMs on the same benchmark. Surprisingly, we find that models pick the literature-predicted scenario across four of the five illusions, diverging from human behavior. Reasoning traces show that ~70% of responses explicitly evoke psychology research, suggesting that this alignment is consistent with retrieval of published findings rather than human-like temporal biases.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个包含6,684对叙事文本的基准数据集，涵盖五种时间错觉，探究纯文本叙事能否引发人类的时间错觉。实验发现人类读者只在两种错觉中表现出预期偏好（当操纵直接可见于文本时），而14个LLM在四种错觉中选择了文献预测的场景，与人类行为产生分歧。推理轨迹显示约70%的响应明确引用了心理学研究，表明LLM的"对齐"更可能源于检索已发表结论而非人类式的时间偏差。
AI.motivation: 先前的时间错觉研究主要基于视觉和听觉刺激，已有的大语言模型（LLM）时间感知评估聚焦于事件时延估计或多步时间推理。作者希望探究纯文字叙述本身是否足以诱发人类时间错觉，从而填补LLM时间感知评估中关于主观时间感知的空白。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含6,684对叙事文本的新基准数据集，覆盖五种时间错觉。招募60名人类读者进行偏好测试，同时评估14个LLM在相同基准上的表现，并分析模型的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 人类读者仅在两种错觉中偏好预期场景（操纵直接可见于文本的错觉），LLM则在四种错觉中选择文献预测场景，与人类行为不一致。约70%的LLM推理响应明确提及心理学研究证据。
AI.conclusion: LLM在时间错觉任务上的"拟合"行为实际上反映了对已发表心理学文献的检索式对齐，而非真正模拟了人类的主观时间感知偏差，提示需谨慎解读LLM在感知类任务上的表现。

title: Benchmarking Frontier Text-to-Image Models on Image-Description Prompts
summary: Text-to-image models are typically reported on average-case prompts, which understates the gap between systems on compositionally demanding requests involving precise object counts, multi-object attribute binding, legible embedded text, and explicit spatial constraints. We evaluate four production text-to-image systems: Hunyuan 3.0, Gemini 3 Pro Image ("Nano Banana Pro"), Black Forest Labs FLUX.2, and Ideogram 3.0. The evaluation uses the 48 hardest prompts drawn from the DataSeeds.AI Sample Dataset (DSD), selected through an automated complexity-scoring pass over the full corpus. Every generated image is graded using an independent-judge rubric. GPT-5.4-Pro authors an atomic, weighted, mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive (MECE) evaluation rubric, while Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview independently determines whether each criterion is satisfied. Gemini 3 Pro Image ranks first with a score of 84.8/100, narrowly ahead of FLUX.2 at 82.3/100. Ideogram 3.0 and Hunyuan 3.0 score 65.7/100 and 63.3/100, respectively. Failure analysis shows that the leading systems primarily lose points through object miscounting and geometric artifacts, whereas the trailing systems more frequently produce garbled text. Ideogram 3.0 also frequently omits requested elements. Full per-sample rubrics, scores, and failure annotations are available from the authors upon request.

AI.tldr: 本文针对文本到图像模型在组合性复杂提示（精确对象计数、多对象属性绑定、嵌入文本、空间约束）上的表现进行评估，测试了四个生产系统（Hunyuan 3.0、Gemini 3 Pro Image、FLUX.2、Ideogram 3.0），使用48个最难提示和独立评判标准。结果显示Gemini 3 Pro Image以84.8分居首，略胜FLUX.2的82.3分，而Ideogram和Hunyuan分别只有65.7和63.3分。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型评估通常基于平均难度提示，低估了系统在组合性复杂请求上的性能差距。作者旨在通过高难度提示集和独立评判来揭示生产级系统的真实能力差异。
AI.method: 从DataSeeds.AI样本数据集中通过自动化复杂度评分选出48个最难的提示；使用GPT-5.4-Pro生成原子化、加权、互斥且穷尽的(MECE)评估规则；由Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview独立判断每条标准是否满足；对四个生产系统进行系统化评估和失败模式分析。
AI.result: Gemini 3 Pro Image以84.8/100排名第一，FLUX.2以82.3/100紧随其后，Ideogram 3.0和Hunyuan 3.0分别得分65.7/100和63.3/100。领先系统主要因对象计数错误和几何伪影失分，落后系统更多产生乱码文本，Ideogram还经常遗漏要求元素。
AI.conclusion: 在高难度组合性提示下，顶级系统间的差距虽然存在但并不悬殊，而领先与落后系统之间的差距显著。不同系统的失败模式有本质区别，这为针对性的模型改进提供了方向。

title: One Score, Two Decisions: Selective Prediction on the Rare-Disease Tail
summary: Given a patient's clinical findings, a diagnostic system ranks possible diseases and must decide when to endorse its first prediction or defer it for review. This decision is usually made by thresholding the top score. Selective prediction over ranked outputs begins with two checks. First, the ranker must produce enough correct top-ranked predictions to make the target feasible. Across 2,000 patient records stratified by disease prevalence, eight small open-weight LLMs achieve at most 4.6% Recall@1 on ultra-rare diseases. At 10% coverage, even a perfect confidence ranking of their existing predictions therefore cannot reach 50% selective accuracy. More accurate models pass the same check, showing that the limit is regime-specific. Second, the confidence signal must match the decision being made.
