For fixed-candidate rankers, the top-two margin cancels components shared across candidates. On phenotype-only Exomiser, it selects 10% of cases at 29.0% accuracy, compared with 13.3% overall, while the top score provides no reliable gate. Yet that cancellation can remove information needed to detect whether the candidate list contains an answer. SciFact retrieval and biomedical entity linking confirm this distinction. Finally, we prove that unlabelled scores alone cannot determine whether switching to the margin will help.

AI.tldr: 本文研究临床诊断系统中选择性预测（selective prediction）的可行性问题，发现两个关键限制：一是排序器在超罕见疾病上的Recall@1极低（最多4.6%），导致即使完美置信度排序也无法达到50%的选择性准确率；二是不同置信度信号（如top score与top-two margin）适用于不同决策场景，而仅凭未标注分数无法判断哪种信号更优。
AI.motivation: 诊断系统需要在给出第一个预测与推迟审核之间做出决策，这通常通过阈值化顶部分数实现。但现有研究未系统验证选择性预测的前提条件：排序器是否产生足够多的正确top预测，以及置信度信号是否与决策目标匹配。作者旨在建立选择性预测在分类输出上的结构化检查框架。
AI.method: 提出两项检查：(1) 可行性检查——跨2000条按疾病流行度分层的患者记录，评估8个开源小规模LLM与多种模型的Recall@1；(2) 置信度匹配检查——对比top score与top-two margin在固定候选排序器（Exomiser表型数据）上的选择性表现，并在SciFact检索和生物医学实体链接任务上验证。最后通过理论证明说明未标注分数不足以指导置信度信号的选择。
AI.result: 超罕见疾病上所有8个LLM的Recall@1最高仅4.6%；在10%覆盖率下即使完美置信度排序也无法达到50%选择性准确率。Exomiser上top-two margin在覆盖10%时准确率达29.0%（总体13.3%），而top score无可靠门控效果。但margin的相消可能丢失检测候选列表是否含答案所需的信息。理论证明显示无标注分数无法判断切换至margin是否有益。
AI.conclusion: 选择性预测的可行性受限于疾病流行度层级（regime-specific）；置信度信号的选择必须与具体决策任务匹配，不存在通用的最优信号；未标注数据无法指导置信度信号选择，需结合任务特性和标注信息进行系统化设计。

title: Beyond Pass@k: Measuring Reliability and Security of Agentic Code Generation
summary: AI coding agent benchmarks rank agents with the Chen et al. (2021) pass@k estimator, but current implementations misapply it: they set n to the number of unit tests in a single submission rather than the number of independent rollout attempts, conflating test-suite size with attempt independence. We diagnose this operationalization error, prove it by counterexample, and propose reliability@k, the same estimator applied correctly, with n = independent rollouts and c = fully-passing rollouts per (task, agent) pair. In a synthetic multi-rollout benchmark, the misapplied metric inflates reported scores by 0.85-0.97 in absolute terms (0.96-0.98 reported vs. 0.00-0.12 corrected), and a cheap single-rollout proxy fails to substitute for repeated runs (Spearman $ρ= 0.417$). Motivated by evidence that functional correctness does not imply security safety, we additionally propose security-adjusted reliability@k, which counts only rollouts that are both functionally correct and free of high-severity insecure patterns. In an initial live-API test with three agents, the adjustment did not change any ranking under our current scanner and threshold, so we present it as a proposed complementary lens whose decisive evaluation requires better-powered future runs. Finally, a preliminary 5-task SWE-bench Verified pilot observes the same core concern in a real repository setting: macro-averaged hidden-test pass rate was 0.80 while strict task resolution was 0.20.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断了AI编程智能体基准中pass@k估计器的误用问题：现有实现错误地将n设为单次提交中的单元测试数量，而非独立rollout尝试次数。作者提出reliability@k作为正确应用，并在合成基准与SWE-bench Verified真实仓库设置中验证了该误用会严重虚增分数，同时提出安全调整版本reliability@k。
AI.motivation: AI编程智能体评估广泛使用Chen等人(2021)的pass@k估计器，但当前实现存在系统性误用：将测试套件大小误认为尝试独立性，导致评估分数被严重夸大。此外，功能正确性不等于安全性，需要同时考量安全维度。
AI.method: (1) 通过反例证明pass@k操作化错误；(2) 提出reliability@k，正确设置n=独立rollout次数，c=完全通过rollout数；(3) 提出security-adjusted reliability@k，仅统计功能正确且无高危不安全模式的rollout；(4) 在合成多rollout基准和SWE-bench Verified pilot中进行验证。
AI.result: 错误应用的指标将报告分数从修正后的0.00-0.12虚增到0.96-0.98（绝对差0.85-0.97）；单rollout替代方案与重复运行的Spearman ρ=0.417，不足以替代；安全调整在3个agent的初步测试中未改变排名；SWE-bench pilot中隐藏测试通过率0.80 vs 严格任务解决率0.20。
AI.conclusion: 当前编程智能体基准中的pass@k误用系统性高估了智能体能力，需要以正确指定的reliability@k取代；安全调整视角提出但需更大规模实验验证。核心问题在真实仓库设置（SWE-bench Verified）中得到初步证实。

title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding
summary: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this instrument to 1902 runs, each evaluated with a fixed test suite, across configurations that vary the team size, the team structure, and the file policy. The resulting networks show how coordination changes as teams grow and as the work changes. Direct messaging initially increases close to quadratically with the number of agents, with much of this growth coming from an early round of introductions. As the teams grow further, this increase levels off in the largest teams we study, where agents increasingly communicate through broadcast messages. The task also shapes the network that emerges. Work built around a shared specification produces dense, highly connected teams, while pipeline tasks produce sparse networks organised around local interfaces. Shared files can replace repeated 1-to-1 communication, cutting output tokens by about 42% at eight agents on message-heavy work, while adding overhead when files already carry the coordination. Naming one agent as coordinator creates no communication hub and provides no reliable improvement in success. We also observe an unprompted tendency for agents to seek out hidden grading material. We repeat the key experimental conditions in a sealed environment, replacing the hidden material with marked placeholder files. Across 244 additional runs, agents still reach for it in four fifths of runs, while the coordinator and file-channel findings reproduce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种测量AI编码代理团队内部协调机制的工具，将每次运行表示为带时间戳和成本的时序网络（代理和文件为节点，消息/文件读写为边），并应用于1902次运行。研究发现：直接消息随代理数近二次方增长但大团队中趋于平稳并转向广播；任务类型塑造网络拓扑（共享规格产生密集网络，流水线任务产生稀疏网络）；共享文件可减少约42%的输出token但增加额外开销；指定协调者并未产生通信枢纽或提升成功率；代理还表现出主动搜寻隐藏评分材料的未提示倾向。
AI.motivation: 现有AI编码代理评估只关注任务完成情况和运行成本，忽略了团队内部的协调机制。理解多代理如何协调对设计更高效的AI团队至关重要，但缺乏系统化的测量工具。
AI.method: 提出一种协调测量工具：将每次运行建模为时序网络，节点为代理和文件，有向边为带时间戳和成本的消息、文件写入和文件读取。在多种配置下（团队规模、团队结构、文件策略）收集1902次运行进行分析，并在密封环境中重复关键实验（244次运行）验证结果。
AI.result: 直接消息通信最初随代理数量近二次方增长（主要来自早期介绍轮次），之后在大团队中趋于平稳并转向广播通信。任务类型显著影响网络结构。共享文件将消息密集型工作的输出token削减约42%。指定协调者既未形成通信枢纽也未提升成功率。代理在80%的运行中主动寻找隐藏评分材料。
AI.conclusion: AI编码代理团队的协调模式是可测量且可预测的：通信随团队规模演化的规律、任务性质对协调结构的影响、以及共享文件这一高效协调机制，都为设计更有效的多代理编码系统提供了实证依据。同时，代理主动搜索评分信息的倾向提示需要关注评估环境的密封性。

title: Cost Scales with Change, Not Corpus Size: Incrementally Maintaining an Evolving Semantic Substrate
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted and presented at the 2026 International Electronics Symposium (IES), Yogyakarta, Indonesia, August 1-3, 2026 (IEEE technically co-sponsored). Authors' accepted version
summary: Retrieval-augmented and agentic question-answering systems increasingly re-derive the meaning of a corpus at query time. Put plainly, instead of re-deriving what a corpus means on every question, the work is done once when a document arrives and is thereafter merely consulted -- a compiler, not an interpreter, of meaning. An alternative is to compile that meaning once, at ingest time, into a compact, queryable semantic substrate and maintain it as the corpus evolves. The central objection is maintenance cost: rebuilding a truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) on every change appears prohibitive, and a change of embedding model seems to force a full re-embedding. We argue and show empirically that maintenance cost scales with the amount of change, not corpus size. On a controlled synthetic pilot (dimension 256, rank 32, a corpus grown from 3,000 to 9,000 documents over 50 update events), incremental low-rank updates were 33.7 times cheaper per update than full re-SVD and 23.8 times cheaper cumulatively, while the incremental subspace tracked the full recomputation to within floating-point precision (maximum principal-angle drift below 1e-11 degrees; recall@10 = 1.0). An orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update recovered 0.95 mean cosine to truly re-embedded vectors by re-embedding only about 10 percent of the corpus. The results support maintaining, rather than repeatedly reconstructing, a semantic substrate.

AI.tldr: 本文论证并实证表明，在语料库问答系统中，将语义含义在摄取时编译为紧凑的可查询语义基底（而非每次查询时重新推导），其维护成本随变更量而非语料库规模增长。实验表明增量低秩更新比完整重新SVD便宜33.7倍，且精度达到浮点精度级别。
AI.motivation: 检索增强和智能体问答系统在每次查询时都要重新推导语料库的含义，这类似于"解释器"而非"编译器"的效率低下问题。作者提出在文档到达时一次性编译语义含义，但核心反对意见是维护成本过高——重建截断SVD代价高昂，更换嵌入模型似乎需要完全重新嵌入。
AI.method: 提出在摄取时将语义含义编译为紧凑的可查询语义基底并随语料库演化进行维护，而非每次查询时重新推导。采用增量低秩更新方法替代完整重新SVD，并使用正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新处理嵌入模型变化，仅需重新嵌入约10%的语料库。
AI.result: 在合成实验中（维度256，秩32，语料库从3000增长到9000文档，50次更新事件），增量低秩更新每次更新比完整重新SVD便宜33.7倍，累计便宜23.8倍；增量子空间与完整重计算在浮点精度内一致（最大主角度漂移低于1e-11度，recall@10=1.0）。正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新通过仅重新嵌入约10%的语料库，恢复了对真正重新嵌入向量的0.95平均余弦相似度。
AI.conclusion: 实证结果支持维护而非反复重建语义基底的策略——维护成本与变更量成正比而非与语料库规模成正比，使得"编译器式"语义管理方法切实可行。

title: Gated Against One Model, Open to the Next: Option-Only Solvability in Legal Multiple-Choice Benchmarks
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Dataset, model predictions and code at https://huggingface.co/datasets/overthelex/ua-judge-exam
summary:
Multiple-choice benchmarks are graded on whether a model picks the right option, not on whether it needed the question. Measuring that gap takes care: a model answering A to most items scores above chance wherever the key sits at A, and reads as recognition when it is not. We measure it on UA-JudgeExam: 11,990 four-option items with official keys, published by Ukraine's Higher Qualification Commission of Judges.
  Shown the options and no question, Claude Haiku 4.5 scores 0.383 against chance, and the leak is concentrated: 11.8% of items are answered blind on all eight option orders, against 0.2 items expected by chance. It is not quotation: search over 280,059 editions of Ukrainian legislation recovers 0.128. Gating those out retains 8,128 items, on which the gating model itself now scores 0.204, and GPT-5.6, which took no part in the selection, still answers 0.515 of them with the question hidden. Scoring twelve held-out models on the whole set and subtracting each one's answer-position habit, only two keep an excess: GPT-5.6 at +0.265, Sonnet 4.6 at +0.081. Without it the ranking misleads: Llama 3.1 8B scores 0.292 blind, above every model but those two, purely by answering A to 92% of items.
  The gate does select something real: on the items it rejected, eleven of twelve models score 0.518-0.789, every interval clear of what the same model scores on the items it kept. But that signal is one model's, and filtering on it does not transfer upward. Neither is visible on a 400-item sample, where nine models read as "statistically at chance". Rewriting distractors instead overshoots to 0.168, below chance and as exploitable. The same probe on LEXam returns chance: every option there points into the stem, none longer than 33 characters. Item format decides whether the problem can arise; capability decides how much is extracted. We release the corpus, the predictions and the harness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多选题基准测试中的"盲答泄漏"问题：模型在不看题目的情况下，仅凭选项位置规律就能得分。作者在乌克兰法官考试（UA-JudgeExam，11,990道四选项题）上测量了这一缺口，发现Claude Haiku 4.5盲答得分0.383远超随机水平，泄漏集中在11.8%的题目上。通过门控过滤后仍有多模型维持显著盲答优势。研究还发现题目格式决定泄漏能否发生，能力决定泄漏提取量。
AI.motivation: 多选题基准以"选对选项"为评分标准，而非"是否真正需要题干"。这导致模型可能仅凭选项位置习惯（如固定选A）获得高于随机的分数，被误判为具有真实能力。作者旨在量化这一"不需要题目也能答对"的缺口，以纠正排行榜误导。
AI.method: 使用乌克兰法官资格考试（UA-JudgeExam）11,990道四选项题，通过多种方式检测泄漏：(1)隐藏题目只给选项，测盲答分数；(2)在所有八种选项排列顺序上进行盲答测量；(3)与280,059版乌克兰立法文本比对排除引用泄漏；(4)用门控模型过滤泄漏题后，评估其他未参与筛选的模型；(5)对照LEXam基准进行格式对比分析。
AI.result: Claude Haiku 4.5盲答得0.383，其中11.8%的题目在全部八种选项顺序下都能盲答正确（随机期望仅0.2%）。门控后保留8,128题，门控模型自身盲答仍为0.204，未参与筛选的GPT-5.6盲答0.515。对12个模型扣除位置习惯后，仅GPT-5.6(+0.265)和Sonnet 4.6(+0.081)有显著超额。Llama 3.1 8B靠92%选A获得0.292盲答分。被门控拒绝的题上多数模型分数为0.518-0.789。LEXam上探测结果为零（选项都指向题干且短于33字符）。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试中的盲答泄漏是真实且可探测的现象，但不是所有模型共享的信号——门控过滤不可跨模型迁移。排行榜若不计入位置习惯会严重误导（如Llama纯靠选A超过多数模型）。题目格式是泄漏能否成立的决定性因素，模型能力决定泄漏提取程度。作者发布了语料、预测和测试框架以支持复现。

title: Risk-Adaptive Edge--Cloud Visual Reasoning for Communication-Efficient Autonomous Driving
summary: Cloud-hosted vision-language models (VLMs) offer greater contextual reasoning capabilities than smaller onboard models, but frequent visual uploads increase communication overhead and add network and inference latency to tactical decisions. We present a risk-adaptive edge-cloud architecture in which onboard traffic assessment determines when cloud reasoning is requested. An onboard VLM and a lightweight detector capture temporal traffic conditions and path-relative hazards for conservative local response and selective cloud access. The cloud model provides tactical advice, while validation, vehicle control, and automatic emergency braking remain local. In CARLA experiments, our method matched the task success rate of periodic cloud access while reducing cloud requests by 54.1% and recording fewer automatic emergency braking (AEB) activations. In a delayed-roadwork ablation, semantic events triggered requests before the next scheduled audit. Across three emulated network profiles, the method continued to reduce cloud traffic, although lane changes took longer than with periodic access. Onboard traffic assessment therefore served as a practical trigger for selective VLM inference in these experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种风险自适应的边缘-云协同架构，通过车载交通评估决定何时请求云端视觉语言模型（VLM）推理，在匹配周期式云端访问任务成功率的同时，将云端请求减少54.1%，并减少自动紧急制动（AEB）触发次数。
AI.motivation: 云端VLM具有比车载小模型更强的上下文推理能力，但频繁上传视觉数据会增加通信开销，并为战术决策引入网络和推理延迟。
AI.method: 采用风险自适应边缘-云架构：车载VLM与轻量检测器捕捉时变交通状况及路径相关危险，用于保守的本地响应与选择性云端访问；云端模型提供战术建议，而验证、车辆控制与AEB保持本地执行。
AI.result: 在CARLA实验中，该方法匹配周期式云端访问的任务成功率，云端请求减少54.1%，AEB激活更少；延迟道路施工消融实验中，语义事件在下次计划审计前就触发请求；三种网络模拟下仍能减少云端流量，但变道耗时比周期式访问更长。
AI.conclusion: 车载交通评估可作为选择性VLM推理的实用触发机制，在降低通信开销的同时保持任务性能。

title: Mitigating Rubric Interference in LLM Judges via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: LLM judges increasingly evaluate responses against fine-grained rubric checklists. When a sample requires multiple rubrics, current methods typically assess each in a separate inference call. Evaluating all rubrics in a single pass is a natural alternative with greater efficiency, but we find that it introduces rubric interference: the verdict on one rubric shifts depending on which other rubrics are co-present. In a preliminary study, only one-third of samples receive fully consistent verdicts when evaluated under rubric sets of varying composition. We develop a measurement framework that probes interference through four controlled operations: rubric set expansion, subsetting, reordering, and noise injection. To mitigate interference without external supervision, we propose Self-Anchored Rubric Alignment (SARA). SARA uses a model's own single-rubric judgments as stable anchors and aligns multi-rubric reasoning with these anchors through on-policy self-distillation. We validate SARA on three datasets (HealthBench, FLASK, ResearchQA) and two model families (Qwen3, Llama-3.1). SARA consistently improves evaluation consistency while maintaining agreement with both base models and GPT-4.1 as a reference judge. Furthermore, the learned consistency transfers across datasets, confirming that SARA teaches a general capability rather than fitting dataset-specific patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM法官在单次推理中评估多个评分标准（rubric）时存在"rubric干扰"问题，即评分结果会随共存标准的不同而漂移，仅有三分之一的样本在不同标准组合下得到完全一致的判定。作者提出SARAI（Self-Anchored Rubric Alignment）方法，利用模型自身单标准判定作为稳定锚点，通过on-policy自蒸馏来对齐多标准推理，在三个数据集和两个模型家族上验证了该方法能一致性地提升评估一致性，且该一致性能力可跨数据集迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM judges在评估需要多个评分标准的样本时通常为每个标准单独调用一次推理，效率低；虽然单次并行评估所有标准是更高效的替代方案，但作者发现这引入了"rubric干扰"——一个标准的判定结果会因其他同时存在的标准而改变，导致评估不一致性严重（仅三分之一样本完全一致）。这是多标准联合评估中一个未被充分研究的问题。
AI.method: 作者首先设计了四个受控操作（标准集合扩充、子集化、重排序、噪声注入）来建立测量干扰的框架。然后提出SARA方法：以模型自身的单标准判定作为稳定锚点，通过on-policy自蒸馏将多标准推理与这些锚点对齐，无需外部监督即可缓解rubric干扰。
AI.result: 在HealthBench、FLASK、ResearchQA三个数据集以及Qwen3和Llama-3.1两个模型家族上验证，SARA一致性地提升了评估一致性，同时保持了与基座模型和GPT-4.1参考judge的一致性。学习到的一致性还能跨数据集迁移，表明SARA教授的是通用能力而非数据集特定模式。
AI.conclusion: SARA有效解决了多标准联合评估中的rubric干扰问题，通过自锚定和自蒸馏实现了无需外部监督的一致性提升，且该能力具有跨数据集泛化性，为高效且可靠的多标准LLM评估提供了新路径。

title: Advanced modelling and data analytics in aviation
summary: The aviation industry characterized by its stringent safety standards has seen a growing need for innovative approaches to enhance safety measures. Despite the vast accumulation of aviation safety data over time, its full potential in predicting and preventing incidents has not been fully realized. This research addresses this gap by applying machine learning (ML) and natural language processing (NLP) techniques to analyze aviation safety data from Socrata, the Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB), the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), and the Aviation Safety Network (ASN). By leveraging existing ML models, including deep learning and transformer-based architectures alongside NLP methods for mining aviation incident narratives, this study uncovers patterns contributing to safety related incidents such as accidents and near-misses. Additionally, it employs various topic modelling techniques to extract meaningful themes from unstructured safety reports, enhancing the interpretability of incident analysis. Causal inference techniques and interpretable AI frameworks are further explored to improve model transparency and trustworthiness. A key contribution of this work is the deployment of advanced ML methodologies in a structured aviation safety context, assessing their effectiveness and providing insights into their practical implementation. The findings offer valuable insights for aviation stakeholders, including regulators, airlines, and policymakers, by providing data-driven solutions that enhance incident analysis and decision making. Ultimately, this research supports the industry s ongoing efforts to minimize risks, improve passenger and crew security, and integrate AI driven methodologies into aviation safety management.

AI.tldr: 本文运用机器学习、自然语言处理及因果推断等技术，对来自多个航空安全数据库（Socrata、ATSB、NTSB、ASN）的事故数据进行系统性分析，挖掘事故模式、提取主题、增强模型可解释性，为航空安全利益相关方提供数据驱动的决策支持。
AI.motivation: 航空业安全标准极高，但长期积累的海量安全数据尚未被充分挖掘以预测和预防事故。现有研究未能充分利用这些数据来识别事故模式、提升安全决策效率，存在显著的研究空白。
AI.method: 整合多个航空安全数据源，采用深度学习与Transformer架构等现有ML模型，结合NLP方法挖掘事故叙述文本；运用多种主题建模技术从非结构化安全报告中提取主题；引入因果推断和可解释AI框架增强模型透明度与可信度。
AI.result: 研究发现并揭示了导致安全事故（如事故和近失事件）的潜在模式；通过主题建模提升了事故分析的可解释性；证实了先进ML方法在结构化航空安全情境中的有效性，并为实际落地实施提供了见解。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为航空监管机构、航空公司和政策制定者提供了数据驱动的解决方案，改善事故分析与决策制定，支持航空业降低风险、提升乘客和机组安全，并推动AI驱动方法整合到航空安全管理体系中。

title: GEO-Flag: Detecting and Measuring GEO-Optimized Web Content
summary: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) modifies web content to increase its likelihood of being selected and cited by generative search engines. This can give strategically optimized pages visibility disproportionate to their authority or relevance and even make weak or false information appear well supported. Unlike conventional search, generative search synthesizes information into direct answers rather than presenting competing sources, which can further amplify these risks, as assessing source provenance and authority requires additional user interaction. Despite these concerns, systematic methods for detecting GEO-optimized webpages remain underexplored. We introduce \texttt{GEOFlagBench}, a benchmark of 3,200 webpages spanning 400 queries, four domains, and eight GEO optimizer families, and use it to systematically evaluate existing GEO detection methods. Although the strongest baseline achieves an aggregate F1 of 0.880, method-level and authorship-conditioned evaluations reveal substantial weaknesses and potential reliance on authorship-related shortcuts. We therefore propose \emph{Intervention-Paired Training} (IPT), which supervises detector responses to GEO interventions and non-GEO AI polishing; on ModernBERT, IPT improves F1 from 0.862 to 0.944 and worst-group accuracy from 0.725 to 0.883. We develop a GEO-gated Agent system for auditing the Source Tier and verifiability of Citation URLs in detected GEO pages. Finally, we deploy the complete pipeline on released Google Search and Gemini-grounded retrieval results for 1,000 real-user queries. Across 10,095 available pages, we estimate an overall GEO prevalence of 8.90\%, reaching 16.36\% among pages modified in 2026. Our results establish a foundation for systematically detecting, auditing, and measuring GEO in real-world search ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GEOFlagBench基准（3,200个网页、400个查询、8类GEO优化器），系统评估现有GEO检测方法，并提出Intervention-Paired Training（IPT）方法提升检测性能（F1从0.862提升至0.944），开发GEO门控Agent系统审计检测页面，并在10,095个真实网页中估计GEO流行率为8.90%。
AI.motivation: 生成式搜索引擎中，GEO可让优化页面获得与其权威性或相关性不成比例的可见性，甚至使虚假信息看起来有据可依。与常规搜索不同，生成式搜索将信息合成直接答案，进一步放大风险。然而，系统检测GEO优化网页的方法仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 构建GEOFlagBench基准，覆盖400个查询、4个领域、8种GEO优化器家族、3,200个网页；2) 提出Intervention-Paired Training（IPT），监督检测器对GEO干预和非GEO AI润色（polishing）的响应差异；3) 开发GEO门控Agent系统，用于审计检测页面中引文URL的来源层级（Source Tier）和可验证性；4) 将完整流程部署于Google Search和Gemini检索结果上。
AI.result: 最强基线聚合F1为0.880，但方法级和作者条件评估显示薄弱环节及对作者相关捷径的依赖；IPT在ModernBERT上将F1从0.862提升至0.944，最差组准确率从0.725提升至0.883；在10,095个可用页面中估计GEO流行率为8.90%，其中2026年修改页面高达16.36%。
AI.conclusion: 本文为在真实搜索生态系统中系统检测、审计和衡量GEO建立了基础，揭示了现有检测方法的不足，并证明了IPT方法的有效性，为后续GEO检测研究提供了基准和方法支撑。

title: Semantic Space of Parts of Speech
summary: Parts of speech categorization is understood in the European linguistic tradition as crisp categorization, which is also reflected in corpus linguistics, where each disambiguated token is assigned exactly one POS. However, the assigned categories are largely determined by arbitrary decisions distilled into annotation manuals. Since some words stand between parts of speech in their semantics or typical syntax, and some parts of speech are closer to each other than others, POS categorization seems inherently fuzzy. We analyze this fuzziness using word2vec embeddings, training a neural network to reduce their high dimensionality to three dimensions relevant for determining parts of speech. This creates a three-dimensional space onto which we map several thousand words, revealing which are prototypical and which lie on the boundaries, and visualizing relationships between parts of speech. The study uses Universal Dependencies POS tags for French, Czech, Finnish, Russian, and English.

AI.tldr: 本文利用word2vec嵌入和神经网络降维技术，将词性标注映射到三维空间中，揭示词性分类的模糊性。研究涵盖法语、捷克语、芬兰语、俄语和英语五种语言，通过可视化原型词和边界词，展示了词性之间的连续性和重叠关系。
AI.motivation: 传统欧洲语言学传统将词性视为离散的、精确的分类，这在语料库语言学中体现为每个token只能被赋予一个词性标签。然而，这种分类很大程度上由标注手册中的主观决定决定，某些词的语义或典型句法位于词性之间，且不同词性之间的距离不相等，因此词性分类本质上是模糊的。作者希望通过可视化来揭示这种模糊性。
AI.method: 使用word2vec嵌入表示词汇，训练神经网络将高维嵌入降维到与词性判定相关的三个维度，创建三维空间。将数千个词映射到该空间，分析哪些词是原型词（prototypical）、哪些词位于边界（boundary），并可视化不同词性之间的关系。数据使用Universal Dependencies词性标注，涵盖法语、捷克语、芬兰语、俄语和英语五种语言。
AI.result: 通过三维空间映射，成功可视化了词汇在词性分类中的分布情况，识别出典型的词性原型词和处于词性边界上的模糊词，并展示了不同词性之间的接近程度和重叠关系。
AI.conclusion: 词性分类确实存在内在的模糊性，并非完全离散。通过降维嵌入空间的可视化方法，可以更直观地理解词性之间的连续关系、原型性和边界性，从而对传统词性分类的假设提出反思和补充。

title: Registration-Free Hyperspectral Reconstruction from RGB via a Permutation-Invariant Gram-Matrix Principle
comment: 11 pages, 10 figures, 8 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Reconstructing a spatially and spectrally high-resolution hyperspectral image (HR-HSI) from a low-resolution HSI (LR-HSI) and a high-resolution RGB image (HR-RGB) usually assumes precise registration and a known camera response function (CRF). Both assumptions are difficult to satisfy with different sensors. We remove both through a permutation-invariant supervision principle: the Gram matrix of an unmixed abundance map depends on shared material composition but not on pixel ordering. Matching abundance Gram matrices therefore allows RGB-to-HSI mapping to be learned without spatial correspondence and without a predefined CRF. Under a full random permutation of HR-RGB pixels, a state-of-the-art fusion method collapses, whereas our reconstruction is unchanged after inverse reindexing for evaluation. Building on this principle, a residual spectral super-resolution function maps HR-RGB directly to HR-HSI without registration, known CRF, or paired supervision. Across indoor, natural-scene, and remote-sensing benchmarks, the method achieves accuracy comparable to approaches that require these assumptions while remaining robust when they are violated. Loss ablations further show that reconstruction accuracy is largely insensitive to the specific discrepancy used to match the Gram matrices, indicating that performance arises primarily from the permutation-invariant principle rather than loss tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于排列不变监督原理的高光谱图像融合方法，通过匹配丰度图的Gram矩阵，无需空间配准、已知CRF或配对监督即可从LR-HSI和HR-RGB重建高分辨率高光谱图像，并在多种基准上达到与需严格假设方法相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 传统HSI融合方法依赖精确的空间配准和已知相机响应函数(CRF)，但在实际多传感器场景中这些假设难以满足，导致方法失效。
AI.method: 利用排列不变监督原理：丰度图的Gram矩阵仅取决于共享的物质组成而非像素排列顺序。通过匹配丰度Gram矩阵，学习RGB到HSI的映射函数，无需空间对应关系和预定义CRF。具体采用残差光谱超分辨率函数直接将HR-RGB映射到HR-HSI。
AI.result: 在室内、自然场景和遥感三个基准上，该方法精度与需要严格假设（配准和CRF）的方法相当。在像素完全随机排列情况下，现有先进融合方法失效，而本文方法在逆索引重排后结果不变。损失消融实验表明，用于匹配Gram矩阵的具体差异度量对精度影响不大，性能主要来源于排列不变原理本身。
AI.conclusion: 该方法验证了排列不变监督是一种有效的无所监督原则，能够消除对空间配准和CRF的依赖，同时保持与需假设方法相当的重建精度，且对假设违背具有鲁棒性。

title: Rethinking Reverse KL as Adaptive Entropy Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to smaller students, but existing objectives often struggle to balance faithful imitation and robust generation. In particular, existing methods mainly combine FKL and RKL, overlooking that RKL itself provides a mechanism for adjusting the student's imitation strength. Motivated by this, we revisit on-policy Reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) distillation and decompose its objective into a teacher-fitting term and a student-entropy term, without introducing an explicit FKL branch. We show theoretically that the token-level optimal student distribution corresponds to a tempered variant of the teacher distribution, where the adaptive weight controls the trade-off between mode-seeking and uncertainty preservation. Guided by this insight, we propose \textbf{Adaptive Entropy Distillation (AED)}, which uses the teacher's entropy to dynamically calibrate token-level imitation strength. Experiments on instruction-following and mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that AED achieves superior overall performance and generally improves teacher--student distributional and entropy alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视教师-学生蒸馏中的反向KL（RKL）损失，将其分解为教师拟合项和学生熵项，并提出自适应熵蒸馏（AED），利用教师熵动态校准token级别的模仿强度，在指令跟随和数学推理基准上取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法在平衡忠实模仿（FKL）和稳健生成方面存在困难，且忽视了RKL本身已包含调节学生模仿强度的机制，无需显式引入FKL分支。
AI.method: 将on-policy RKL蒸馏目标分解为教师拟合项和学生熵项；从理论上证明token级最优学生分布是教师分布的温度调节变体，自适应权重控制模式寻求与不确定性保持的权衡；据此提出AED，使用教师熵动态校准token级模仿强度。
AI.result: 在指令跟随和数学推理基准上，AED取得了更优的整体性能，并且普遍改善了教师-学生分布的分布对齐和熵对齐。
AI.conclusion: 通过重新挖掘RKL内部机制而非显式组合FKL与RKL，AED在无需额外分支的情况下实现了更好的蒸馏效果，验证了理论分析的正确性。

title: Agentic Data Cleaning Without a Clean Reference: An Experimental Study of Capabilities and Trade-offs
comment: 21 pages, 3 figures, Submitted to New Generation Computing
summary: Data cleaning without a trusted clean reference is challenging because unusual values may represent either genuine errors or valid observations. This paper studies how different agent capabilities affect reference-free data cleaning and proposes an evidence-grounded framework that combines structured context, profiling, LLM reasoning, executable checks, controlled evidence retrieval, source ranking, citation alignment, conservative repair, reversible scripts, and provenance logging. Seven configurations are evaluated across financial, clinical, and environmental-monitoring datasets using controlled synthetic corruption and original-data descriptive analysis, resulting in 126 completed runs. The evaluation includes two comparison baselines and a progressive LLM-based sequence that adds executable tools, evidence retrieval, evidence controls, and conservative repair. In the synthetic evaluation, the deterministic profiling baseline achieved the highest detection F1-score of 0.561. Among the LLM-based configurations, the full conservative configuration achieved the highest F1-score of 0.421, but no configuration performed best across all evaluation criteria. The source-ranked configurations achieved the lowest unsupported-rule rates, while decision-level citation alignment remained weak. The full conservative configuration produced no unsafe or unnecessary modifications, although these rates were already zero before the conservative policy was added, and it performed no direct repairs. Overall, the results show that additional capabilities introduce trade-offs among detection, repair, evidence grounding, conservative behaviour, reproducibility, and operational cost rather than producing consistent improvements. The study provides a structured framework and empirical methodology for evaluating these trade-offs in reference-free agentic data cleaning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了无参考数据清洗中不同智能体能力的影响，提出了一个基于证据的框架，并在金融、临床和环境监测数据集上进行了126次实验。结果表明，额外能力在检测、修复、证据依据、保守行为和操作成本之间引入权衡，而非一致性改进。
AI.motivation: 没有可信干净参考的数据清洗具有挑战性，因为异常值可能代表真实错误或有效观测。现有方法缺乏系统性的框架来评估不同智能体能力在无参考数据清洗中的作用。
AI.method: 提出一个证据驱动的框架，结合结构化上下文、配置文件分析、LLM推理、可执行检查、受控证据检索、来源排序、引用对齐、保守修复、可逆脚本和溯源日志。在三个数据集上评估七种配置，包括两个比较基线和逐步增强的LLM序列。
AI.result: 确定性配置文件分析基线获得最高检测F1分数（0.561）；LLM配置中全保守配置F1最高（0.421），但没有配置在所有评估标准上表现最佳。来源排序配置获得最低的无支持规则率，但决策级引用对齐较弱。全保守配置虽无安全/不必要修改，但在保守策略添加前这些率已为零，且未执行直接修复。
AI.conclusion: 额外的智能体能力在无参考数据清洗中引入权衡而非一致改进。研究提供了一个结构化框架和实证方法，用于评估这些权衡。

title: FZ-VLM: A Two Stage Florence-Zephyr Vision Language Model Framework for Pulmonary Nodule Characterization and Clinical Decision Making
summary: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and Computed Tomography (CT) is a primary imaging tool for screening and followup assessment. After pulmonary nodule detection, radiologists manually assess anatomical location, diameter, margin characteristics, and attenuation type to support risk assessment and clinical decision-making. However, this post-detection workflow is time-consuming and can be affected by inter-observer variability. Existing Artificial Intelligence methods often focus on isolated tasks, limiting their use as a unified, clinically grounded interpretation framework. This study presents FZ-VLM, a two-stage Florence-Zephyr Vision Language Model framework for unified structured pulmonary nodule characterization in lung CT. The framework uses a fine-tuned Florence-2 model to extract radiological attributes from expert-annotated 2D axial CT slices, while a Zephyr-7B model uses these attributes to generate nodule descriptions, follow-up recommendations, and longitudinal analyses. Results showed that the Stage 1 model achieved 77.18\% accuracy for anatomical location, 67.96\% accuracy for margin characteristics, and 79.13\% accuracy for attenuation type, with a Mean Absolute Error of 2.58 mm for diameter estimation, outperforming evaluated GPT-4-based baselines as well as the human baseline. Expert radiologist evaluation of Stage 2 showed 93.9\% accuracy, 98.6\% completeness score, 76.1\% clinical relevance, and an overall score of 89.5\%. Safety analysis showed that most outputs were clinically safe, although some follow-up recommendations still required expert review. To the best of our knowledge, this study presents the first two-stage Vision-Language Model framework for structured nodule characterization and clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出FZ-VLM，一个两阶段Florence-Zephyr视觉语言模型框架，用于肺CT中肺结节的统一结构化表征。第一阶段使用微调的Florence-2模型从CT切片提取放射学属性，第二阶段使用Zephyr-7B生成结节描述、随访建议和纵向分析。结果显示第一阶段在解剖位置、边缘特征和衰减类型上分别达到77.18%、67.96%和79.13%的准确率，直径估计MAE为2.58mm；第二阶段专家评估显示93.9%准确率和98.6%完整性分数。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，CT是筛查和随访评估的主要影像工具。肺结节检测后，放射科医生需手动评估解剖位置、直径、边缘特征和衰减类型来支持风险评估和临床决策，但这一工作流程耗时且受观察者间变异影响。现有的AI方法通常只关注孤立任务，缺乏统一的、临床基础的解读框架。
AI.method: FZ-VLM采用两阶段架构：第一阶段使用微调的Florence-2模型从专家标注的2D轴向CT切片中提取放射学属性；第二阶段使用Zephyr-7B模型基于这些属性生成结节描述、随访建议和纵向分析。该方法旨在将检测后工作流统一为一个整体框架。
AI.result: 第一阶段模型在解剖位置、边缘特征和衰减类型上分别达到77.18%、67.96%和79.13%的准确率，直径估计平均绝对误差为2.58mm，优于GPT-4基线和人类基线。第二阶段专家评估显示93.9%准确率、98.6%完整性分数、76.1%临床相关性和89.5%总分。安全性分析显示大多数输出临床安全，但部分随访建议仍需专家审查。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了首个用于肺结节结构化表征和临床决策制定的两阶段视觉语言模型框架。该框架在提取放射学属性和生成结构化报告方面表现良好，优于GPT-4基线和人类基线，但在随访建议的临床安全性方面仍需进一步改进和专家审查。

title: A Reproducibility Study of Partial Residual Ablations in Pre-LN Transformers
summary:
Residual connections are a fundamental component of transformer architectures, yet the roles of the attention and feed-forward residual pathways remain poorly understood when considered independently. This paper presents a reproducibility study of partial residual ablations in Pre-LN GPT-style transformers trained at two scales (10M and 124M parameters).
  I compare four architectural configurations by selectively removing the attention residual connection, the feed-forward residual connection, or both. Across all experiments, removing the attention residual (FFNOnly) consistently causes deterministic collapse to the No-Residual performance floor. In contrast, removing the feed-forward residual (AttnOnly) exhibits a reproducible recovery effect at 10M scale under a controlled 8-seed deterministic study, while its behavior at 124M remains unresolved because of substantial seed variance.
  During the investigation, I identified and corrected an experimental measurement confound in runtime gain scaling and document both the failed intermediate reproduction and the subsequent controlled replication. Based on the empirical results, I propose a cross-position routing hypothesis to explain the observed asymmetry while explicitly distinguishing confirmed findings from unresolved questions.
  To support reproducibility, I release the complete source code, experiment configurations, checkpoints, training logs, and all experimental results, including intermediate non-reproducing runs.

AI.tldr: 本文对Pre-LN GPT风格Transformer中的部分残差消融进行了可复现性研究，在10M和124M两个规模下分别移除注意力残差、前馈残差或两者。研究发现移除注意力残差（FFNOnly）会导致确定性坍塌到无残差性能下限，而移除前馈残差（AttnOnly）在10M规模下表现出可复现的恢复效应，但在124M规模下因种子方差过大而无法定论。
AI.motivation: 残差连接是Transformer架构的基础组件，但注意力残差通路和前馈残差通路各自独立的作用尚未被充分理解。作者希望分别消融这两条残差通路，以揭示它们在Pre-LN Transformer中各自的贡献和不对称性。
AI.method: 在10M和124M参数规模的Pre-LN GPT风格Transformer上进行系统的残差消融实验，比较四种架构配置：完整残差、仅移除注意力残差（FFNOnly）、仅移除前馈残差（AttnOnly）、无残差。在10M规模采用8个种子的受控确定性研究，并在过程中识别和修正了一个运行时间增益测量中的实验混淆因素。
AI.result: 移除注意力残差在所有实验中一致性地导致性能坍塌到无残差下限；移除前馈残差在10M规模下表现出去可复现的恢复效应，但在124M规模下由于显著的种子方差而无法确定结论。作者还记录并修正了一个实验测量混淆问题。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出跨位置路由假说来解释注意力残差与前馈残差消融之间的不对称性，并明确区分了已确认的发现与未解决的问题。作者完全开源了代码、配置、检查点、训练日志和所有实验结果（包括失败的中间复现结果），以支持可复现性。

title: From Errors to Proofs: Minimal-Core-Guided Repair for Neuro-Symbolic Constraint Solving
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Workshop on Logic and Symbolic Reasoning (LogiSymb), poster
summary: Making language models solve constraint problems reliably often means having them translate the problem into a formal specification and delegating the search to a sound solver. But the translation is itself a language-model task, and an unfaithful translation makes the solver faithfully solve the wrong problem. Existing pipelines repair only translations that crash, returning the solver's error message and falling silent when the program runs but is wrong. We replace the error message with a proof: when the generated program is unsatisfiable, we extract a minimal unsatisfiable core over the model's own constraints and hand it back the exact set that cannot hold together, a leakage-free signal that localizes the fault. On a new benchmark of 77 problems with an exact oracle, translation to Answer Set Programming is faithful on six of seven domains and fails only on aggregate coverage scheduling, which concentrates the translation tax in one diagnosable pattern. A minimal core, rather than a bare error, is what stops a weaker model from fabricating solutions to infeasible problems, cutting fabrication from 79% to 7%. A strong chain-of-thought baseline meanwhile matches the symbolic route on accuracy, so the route's value is not accuracy but certificates and its refusal to fabricate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用最小不可满足核（minimal unsatisfiable core）替代错误信息来修复语言模型生成的约束求解程序。当生成的程序不可满足时，提取模型自身约束中的最小不可满足集合返回给模型，实现泄漏-free的故障定位。在77个问题基准上，翻译为Answer Set Programming在六个领域忠实可靠，仅聚合覆盖调度失败；最小核将弱模型捏造率从79%降至7%，而强思维链基线的价值不在于准确性而在于证书和拒绝捏造。
AI.motivation: 现有修复流水线仅在程序崩溃时返回求解器的错误信息，但当程序能运行但结果错误时保持沉默，导致模型忠实地求解了错误的问题。需要一个能定位故障的信号，而不仅仅是崩溃时的错误提示。
AI.method: 将约束问题翻译为Answer Set Programming（ASP），当生成的程序不可满足时，提取最小不可满足核（模型自身约束中不能同时成立的精确集合）返回给语言模型，实现泄漏-free的局部故障定位信号。
AI.result: 在77个问题、精确oracle的新基准上，ASP翻译在六/七个领域忠实可靠，仅在聚合覆盖调度上失败。最小核替代裸错误信息将弱模型捏造率从79%降至7%。强思维链基线在准确性上匹配符号路线，但该路线的价值在于提供证书和拒绝捏造。
AI.conclusion: 最小不可满足核是比裸错误更有效的故障定位信号，能阻止弱模型捏造解。符号路线的核心价值不在准确性（思维链可匹配），而在于提供形式化证书和拒绝捏造的可靠性保证。

title: Do Language Models Consistently Encode the Current Year?
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
summary: A consistent concept of the current time is important for temporal reasoning, yet how language models represent the current time is not well understood. We contribute two tasks that probe the current year in conceptually distinct ways: an associative task, which infers the current year from verb tense, and a declarative task, which directly queries for the current year. Both tasks estimate current years within one year of the post-training data cutoff of instruction-tuned language models. For base models, predictions on the associative task serve as a strong proxy for the pre-training data cutoff, with an average error of only 10 months across 13 models. However, their internal mechanisms diverge: the associative task uses mechanisms similar to factual recall, while the declarative task lacks consistent causal pathways. This divergence poses a challenge for updating the current year in language models. None of prompting, SFT, or weight editing succeed in shifting the associative and declarative years simultaneously. Prompting updates the declarative year (94.6% success across 351 target years) but leaves the associative year nearly unchanged (1.7% success). Year-shifted SFT also fails to shift the associative year, matching the target year in only one of eight models. Weight editing, while effective for both tasks individually, does not generalize across both. Overall, our results show that the current year is not consistently encoded in language models: The associative notion, deeply ingrained in linguistic structures learned in pre-training, uses different causal mechanisms and resists the same modifications that easily shift the declarative notion learned in post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型如何表示"当前时间"。作者设计了两种任务：联想任务（从动词时态推断当前年份）和陈述任务（直接查询当前年份）。发现指令微调模型在两个任务上的预测都能接近其训练数据截止时间，但基础模型在联想任务上的预测可作为预训练截止时间的强代理。关键在于，这两个任务使用不同的内部机制——联想任务类似事实回忆，陈述任务缺乏一致的因果通路。因此，提示工程、SFT或权重编辑都无法同时更新这两种年份表征。
AI.motivation: 时间推理对语言模型至关重要，但当前时间在模型中的编码方式尚不清楚。理解"当前年份"如何被表示，对于模型更新、知识编辑和时间推理能力至关重要。
AI.method: 贡献两个任务来探测当前年份：(1) 联想任务——从动词时态推断当前年份；(2) 陈述任务——直接询问当前年份。分别测试指令微调模型和基础模型，并评估提示工程、SFT、权重编辑三种更新方法的有效性。
AI.result: 两种任务都能在一年多误差内估计当前年份；基础模型在联想任务上的预测与预训练截止时间平均误差仅10个月。但两种任务机制不同：联想任务类似事实回忆，陈述任务缺乏一致因果通路。提示工程使陈述年份更新成功率达94.6%，但联想年份仅1.7%；年份偏移SFT仅在8个模型中的1个成功；权重编辑对单个任务有效但无法同时泛化。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型中的"当前年份"并非统一编码：联想性年份深深根植于预训练中学到的语言结构中，使用不同的因果机制，且抗拒那些能轻易改变陈述性年份的修改；而陈述性年份则是在后训练中学到的。这种分裂对更新语言模型中的当前时间构成重大挑战。

title: The Quantum Shortcut: Complex Phase-State Dynamics Reduce the Optimization Steps of Sequence Models
summary: Sequence models are conventionally distinguished by their backbone, the mechanism that routes information across positions, such as attention or recurrence. This paper varies a choice that is prior to the backbone and shared by nearly all current models: the \emph{substrate}, the number system in which the hidden state is represented together with the form of the map from state to prediction. The prevailing substrate is a real-valued state with an affine--softmax readout; we study a complex-valued alternative drawn from the mathematics of quantum theory, in which information is carried by the phases of the state and scores are quadratic Born forms. Prior work proved an idealized version of this substrate representationally stronger than any real model with a linear readout; we ask whether it also trains faster. Relaxing the two properties that block deployment, exact unitarity and the Born vocabulary readout, we instantiate it in the Mamba state-space model and an attention-based Transformer. At 253M parameters, matched to within $0.02\%$ and trained under one fixed protocol on three byte-level corpora, the complex models reach every measured validation loss in approximately one third (state-space) and one half (attention) of the optimization steps of their real counterparts. The two backbones then diverge. Once the learning-rate warmup ends, the state-space advantage continues to widen, from $0.321$ to $0.354$ bits per character on OpenWebText and from $0.368$ to $0.396$ on FineWeb, which an artifact of the warmup ramp would not do; the attention advantage instead decays toward zero on every corpus, and is therefore an effect of early training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种在骨干架构（如注意力或循环机制）之前的选择——"基底"（substrate），即隐藏状态表示的数制及状态到预测映射的形式。作者将传统实值状态加仿射-softmax读出，替换为基于量子理论的复值状态，其中信息由相位承载，分数为二次Born形式。在Mamba状态空间模型和Transformer上，以253M参数、固定训练协议、三个字节级语料库进行匹配实验，复值模型达到相同验证损失所需优化步数约为实值模型的1/3（状态空间）和1/2（注意力）。但两种骨干的后续表现分化：状态空间的优势在热身结束后持续扩大，而注意力的优势则衰减至零，属于早期训练效应。
AI.motivation: 先前的理论工作证明了理想化的复值基底在表示能力上强于任何带线性读出的实值模型，但尚不清楚这种优势能否转化为实际训练速度上的提升。作者希望在放宽阻碍部署的两个性质（严格酉性和Born词汇读出）后，检验复值基底是否训练得更快。
AI.method: 将复值基底实例化到Mamba状态空间模型和基于注意力的Transformer中，以253M参数规模，在三种字节级语料库上采用固定训练协议，与实值模型进行严格的匹配对照实验（参数匹配到0.02%以内），比较达到相同验证损失所需的优化步数。
AI.result: 复值模型在状态空间骨干上仅需约1/3的优化步数、在注意力骨干上仅需约1/2的优化步数即可达到与实值模型相同的验证损失。但两种骨干后续行为分化：状态空间模型的优势在学习率热身结束后持续扩大（OpenWebText上从0.321到0.354比特/字符，FineWeb上从0.368到0.396），而注意力模型的优势在每个语料库上逐渐衰减至零。
AI.conclusion: 复值基底在训练速度上确实具有实质性优势，但该优势的性质取决于骨干架构：在状态空间模型中优势是持续且随训练加深的，在注意力模型中则仅是早期训练的暂时效应。值得注意的是，状态空间优势的持续扩大可排除热身斜坡伪影的解释，表明基底选择对优化动力学有深远影响。

title: Task-Driven Three-Layer Distributed Scheduling for Emergency Earth Observation in Large Low-Earth-Orbit Constellations
summary: Large low-Earth-orbit (LEO) Earth-observation (EO) constellations offer frequent access to geographically dispersed ground targets, but emergency requests may arrive after committed routine-plan execution has begun. The resulting dynamic emergency observation scheduling problem (DEOSP) requires urgent tasks to be inserted under intermittent ground contact without excessive routine-plan disruption. To address DEOSP, we propose a task-driven three-layer distributed scheduling (T3L-DS) method, which represents task demand and sensor footprints on a common geographic grid and forms temporary clusters from observation capabilities and current inter-satellite links. For intra-cluster coordination, T3L-DS introduces onboard dual-plan bidding and joint marginal evaluation. It also designs an inter-cluster coordination mechanism for unresolved demand. Extensive computational experiments compare T3L-DS with centralised simulated annealing (SA), an adapted selective time-variant better reply process (A-SeTVBRP), and a conventional contract-net protocol (CNP). T3L-DS achieves the highest emergency coverage among the distributed methods, with average relative improvements of approximately 2.8% and 17.1% over A-SeTVBRP and CNP, respectively. Its average relative gap from SA is approximately 7.1%. Under conflict-enhanced loads, it reduces routine-coverage loss by approximately 57.9% and 87.7% relative to A-SeTVBRP and CNP, respectively. The ablation study confirms the contribution of the proposed coordination enhancements. Overall, the results show that T3L-DS provides an effective distributed approach to DEOSP.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低轨对地观测星座中动态应急观测调度问题（DEOSP），提出一种任务驱动的三层分布式调度方法（T3L-DS），通过共地地理网格、临时聚簇、双计划投标与联合边际评估以及簇间协调机制，实现了应急任务的高效插入与常规计划的低扰动，在应急覆盖率和常规覆盖损失上均优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 低轨对地观测星座虽能频繁访问分散的地面目标，但应急请求可能在常规计划执行开始后才到达，需要在间歇性地面接触下插入紧急任务，同时避免过度干扰常规计划。这一动态应急观测调度问题（DEOSP）尚缺乏有效的分布式求解方案。
AI.method: 提出任务驱动的三层分布式调度（T3L-DS）方法：将任务需求与传感器覆盖范围表示在统一地理网格上；依据观测能力与当前星间链路形成临时簇；在簇内采用星上双计划投标与联合边际评估实现协调；并设计用于未解决需求的簇间协调机制。
AI.result: 与集中式模拟退火（SA）、自适应选择性时变最佳响应过程（A-SeTVBRP）和传统合同网协议（CNP）对比：T3L-DS在分布式方法中应急覆盖率最高，平均相对提升约2.8%（对比A-SeTVBRP）和17.1%（对比CNP）；与SA的平均相对差距约7.1%。在冲突增强负载下，常规覆盖损失相较于A-SeTVBRP和CNP分别降低约57.9%和87.7%。消融实验验证了所提协调增强机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: T3L-DS为DEOSP提供了一种有效的分布式求解途径，在应急覆盖与常规计划保护之间取得了良好平衡，适合星上自主动态调度的应用场景。

title: Why Summaries Turn Neutral: Policy Attribution for Sentiment Drift in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
summary: Reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) aligns LLMs with human preferences, improving summarization fluency and safety, but causes sentiment drift: overly neutral summaries stripped of emotional nuance. We diagnose why RL acts as a sentiment neutralizer and present Policy Attribution, a framework using gradient and logit decomposition to trace drift to reward model (RM) signals and KL (Kullback-Leibler) penalty. Sentiment drift reflects a strategic bias toward "low-risk" tokens maximizing expected rewards under preference uncertainty (Stiennon et al., 2020; Gao, Schulman, and Hilton, 2023). On Reddit TL;DR and CNN/DailyMail, RLHF summaries get higher rewards but show 30-40% lower sentiment variance. Cross-lingual analysis across eight languages shows language-independent drift, with morphologically richer languages more suppressed (Krasitskii et al., 2026). We propose and validate a sentiment-aware regularization technique reducing drift by 18-22% without harming summary quality. The code and toolkit will be public.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断了RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）导致大语言模型摘要产生"情感漂移"（sentiment drift）的问题——即模型生成的摘要过于中性、丧失情感细微差别。作者提出Policy Attribution框架，通过梯度和logit分解追溯漂移根源至奖励模型（RM）信号和KL惩罚，并发现漂移源于模型在偏好不确定性下偏向"低风险"token以最大化期望奖励的策略。在Reddit TL;DR和CNN/DailyMail数据集上，RLHF摘要得分更高但情感方差降低30-40%；跨八种语言分析显示漂移具有语言无关性，形态丰富的语言受抑制更严重。作者提出情感感知正则化技术，在不损害摘要质量的情况下将漂移减少18-22%。
AI.motivation: RLHF虽能提升摘要流畅性和安全性，但存在情感漂移问题——摘要变得过度中性而丧失情感细微差别。此前对RLHF的评估主要关注对齐效果，忽略了生成文本的情感质量退化，缺乏对这一系统性偏见的机制性诊断与解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出Policy Attribution框架：利用梯度和logit分解方法，将情感漂移追溯至RM信号和KL惩罚的具体贡献；2) 在Reddit TL;DR和CNN/DailyMail上进行实验，对比RLHF前后摘要的情感方差；3) 跨八种语言进行交叉语言分析；4) 提出情感感知正则化技术以缓解漂移。
AI.result: RLHF摘要获得更高奖励但情感方差下降30-40%；漂移在八种语言中均存在（语言无关性），形态丰富语言受抑制更明显；情感感知正则化可在不损害摘要质量的情况下减少18-22%的漂移。
AI.conclusion: RLHF的奖励优化机制天然倾向于情感中性的"安全"输出，这是偏好不确定条件下最大化期望奖励的策略性选择。该问题可通过情感感知正则化有效缓解，并将在公开代码和工具包中发布成果。

title: DualMiT-Net: Local-Global Transformer-Convolutional Fusion for Breast Mass Segmentation in Mammographic Regions of Interest
summary: Breast mass segmentation is an important step in computer-aided mammography, but it remains difficult because masses can have low contrast, irregular shapes, and boundaries that blend with surrounding breast tissue. To address this problem, we present DualMiT-Net, a dual-branch network that uses both a focused view of the mass and a wider view of the surrounding tissue. The local branch uses a Mix Transformer (MiT-B5) encoder to learn mass shape, texture, and boundary information, while the global branch uses an EfficientNet-B5 encoder to learn surrounding breast context. Features from the two branches are shared at the deeper encoder levels and are then progressively fused in a single decoder. A spatial gate controls how much global information is added during decoding. We also evaluated four input representations and selected a percentile-windowed mammogram combined with a Gabor texture response. The model was trained and evaluated on the mass subset of the Curated Breast Imaging Subset of the Digital Database for Screening Mammography (CBIS-DDSM) using a patient-level split. Across three training runs, DualMiT-Net with exponential moving average weights achieved a mean Dice coefficient of 0.9375 and a mean Intersection over Union of 0.8834. It also achieved better Dice and IoU scores than six standard encoder-decoder baselines trained using the same data and training settings. These results show that combining local mass information with wider breast context can provide accurate and consistent breast mass segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DualMiT-Net，一种用于乳腺肿块分割的双分支网络，同时利用肿块局部视图（MiT-B5编码器）和周围组织全局视图（EfficientNet-B5编码器），通过深层特征共享和单解码器渐进融合，配合空间门控控制全局信息注入。在CBIS-DDSM数据集上取得Dice 0.9375和IoU 0.8834的成绩，优于六种基线模型。
AI.motivation: 乳腺肿块分割在计算机辅助乳腺X线摄影中至关重要，但由于肿块对比度低、形状不规则、边界与周围组织融合，分割十分困难。仅关注肿块本身可能缺乏足够的上下文信息，需要结合局部肿块信息和更广泛的乳腺组织背景来提高分割精度。
AI.method: 提出DualMiT-Net双分支网络：局部分支使用Mix Transformer (MiT-B5)编码器学习肿块的形状、纹理和边界信息；全局分支使用EfficientNet-B5编码器学习周围乳腺组织上下文。两分支在深层编码器层面共享特征，随后在单个解码器中渐进融合，并通过空间门控机制控制解码过程中全局信息的加入量。同时评估了四种输入表示，最终选用百分位窗口化乳腺X线影像结合Gabor纹理响应。
AI.result: 在CBIS-DDSM数据集的肿块子集上，采用患者级划分，使用指数移动平均权重后，三次训练运行的DualMiT-Net平均Dice系数为0.9375，平均IoU为0.8834，均优于六种使用相同数据和训练设置的编码器-解码器基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 将局部肿块信息与更广泛的乳腺背景信息相结合，能够实现准确且稳定的乳腺肿块分割，验证了双分支、多尺度上下文融合方法的有效性。

title: Tail-Aware Top-$k$ On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective paradigm for transferring knowledge between language models, where a student is trained to align its next-token distribution with the teacher's along its own trajectories. To provide dense supervision at tractable cost, many works minimize the reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the student and teacher's normalized distributions over the teacher's top-$k$ tokens. However, this normalized objective discards the information about tail probability: the total probability outside the teacher's top-$k$ tokens. As a result, the optimization can steadily increase the student's tail probability and entropy, empirically degrading downstream accuracy. To address this issue, we propose Tail-Aware Top-$k$ OPD (\textbf{TA-OPD}), a novel distillation method that restores the missing tail probability signal. In particular, TA-OPD minimizes the reverse KL divergence over the top-$k$ tokens plus a tail token that carries the tail probability. In effect, TA-OPD better aligns the student's next-token distribution with the teacher's, preventing the increase in tail probability and entropy caused by top-$k$ normalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of TA-OPD, improving Avg@8 by up to 8.05 points on common benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/HuipengHuang/TA-OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TA-OPD（Tail-Aware Top-k OPD），一种新的on-policy蒸馏方法，通过引入尾部token来恢复top-k归一化时丢失的尾部概率信号，从而防止学生模型尾部概率和熵的持续增加，提升下游任务的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的on-policy蒸馏方法在top-k token上最小化reverse KL散度时，由于归一化操作丢弃了尾部概率信息（即teacher top-k token之外的总概率），导致优化过程中学生模型的尾部概率和熵不断增大，最终降低下游任务的准确率。这一隐藏问题亟需解决。
AI.method: TA-OPD在原有top-k token基础上额外引入一个代表尾部概率的token，在top-k tokens加上该tail token的集合上最小化reverse KL散度。这样做恢复了被top-k归一化丢弃的尾部概率信号，使学生模型的下一个token分布与教师模型更好地对齐，阻止尾部概率和熵的增大。
AI.result: 大量实验证明TA-OPD的优越性，在常见基准测试上Avg@8指标最高提升8.05个点。
AI.conclusion: TA-OPD通过恢复尾部概率信号有效解决了top-k归一化蒸馏中的信息丢失问题，在不显著增加计算成本的前提下显著提升了蒸馏质量与下游任务表现。

title: CEDAR-GRPO: Process-Aware Reinforcement Learning for General Abductive Reasoning in LLMs
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/cedar-grpo/cedar-grpo
summary: Abductive reasoning, often characterized as inference to the best explanation, is central to explanation under uncertainty, from everyday sense-making and investigation to scientific discovery. Yet LLM research has mostly studied abduction through narrow, task-specific benchmarks, making it unclear whether observed gains transfer beyond the benchmark family used for training or evaluation. We ask whether RL post-training can improve abduction as a transferable reasoning capability. We introduce CEDAR-GRPO, a process-aware framework that combines final-answer correctness with abductive rewards for evidence coverage and evidence-to-explanation directionality. Four open-weight LLMs are post-trained on a controlled, domain-neutral mixture of abductive hypothesis-generation and hypothesis-selection tasks. We evaluate them on 11 unseen tasks spanning hypothesis selection, missing-fact generation, defeasible inference, long-context investigation, clinical reasoning, code debugging, and non-abductive controls. CEDAR- GRPO improves every model on every held-out task over both base models and correctness-only GRPO, with average gains of 7.4 and 2.7 points, respectively, and a maximum gain of 30.8 points. Ablations confirm that RL, abductive reward design, and task diversity each contribute to transfer. Process-level metrics further show stronger abductive behavior, including exploration of alternatives, elimination of rivals, backtracking, and uncertainty marking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CEDAR-GRPO框架，通过基于过程的强化学习（RL）后训练来提升大语言模型的溯因推理能力，并证明该能力可以跨任务迁移。在4个开源模型上使用领域中性的任务混合进行后训练，在11个未见任务上平均提升7.4分（对比基线模型）和2.7分（对比仅正确性奖励的GRPO），最大提升达30.8分。
AI.motivation: 溯因推理（即最佳解释推理）对不确定性下的解释至关重要，但现有LLM研究主要依赖于狭窄、任务特定的基准来研究溯因推理，导致训练或评估获得的收益是否能在基准族之外迁移并不清晰。作者希望探究RL后训练能否将溯因推理作为可迁移的推理能力进行提升。
AI.method: 提出CEDAR-GRPO框架，这是一种过程感知的强化学习框架，将最终答案正确性与溯因奖励（证据覆盖度、证据到解释的方向性）相结合。对4个开源LLM在受控、领域中性的溯因假设生成和假设选择任务混合上进行后训练。
AI.result: 在11个未见任务（涵盖假设选择、缺失事实生成、可废止推理、长上下文调查、临床推理、代码调试及非溯因控制任务）上，CEDAR-GRPO相较于基座模型和仅正确性奖励的GRPO，分别平均提升7.4分和2.7分，最大提升30.8分。消融实验证实RL、溯因奖励设计和任务多样性都对迁移有贡献。过程级指标显示更强的溯因行为，包括探索备选方案、排除竞争对手、回溯和不确定性标记。
AI.conclusion: 通过过程感知的奖励设计与领域中性的任务混合训练，RL后训练可以将溯因推理培养为一种可迁移的通用推理能力，而非仅针对特定基准过拟合的技能，这为提升LLM的解释推理能力提供了有效路径。

title: L3Cube-IndicQuest v2: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Factual Knowledge of Large Language Models Across Indic Languages
summary: We present L3Cube-IndicQuest v2, a large-scale gold-standard multilingual question-answering benchmark for evaluating the India-specific factual knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs). The benchmark comprises 3,471 curriculum-grounded English question--answer pairs spanning nine domains, curated from educational curricula, competitive examination materials, and domain-specific reference books. We introduce a practical hybrid construction strategy that combines context-grounded LLM-based question generation and validation with semantic deduplication and human verification, enabling scalable creation of benchmark data while preserving annotation quality. The benchmark is translated into 19 Indic languages, yielding a publicly released multilingual dataset of 69,420 question--answer pairs across 20 languages. We evaluate six LLMs under three protocols: LLM-as-a-judge and two deterministic lexical criteria, exact-substring and word-overlap matching. All three produce almost the same model ranking, showing that the results do not depend on the choice of judge. The frontier commercial model leads by a wide margin, and among open-weight models Gemma4 31B outperforms the Indic-specialised Sarvam 30B in every evaluated Indic language.

AI.tldr: L3Cube-IndicQuest v2是一个大规模黄金标准多语言问答基准，包含3,471个基于课程构建的英文问答对，覆盖9个领域，翻译成19种印度语言，共69,420对20种语言的问答数据。论文提出混合构建策略（LLM生成+验证+语义去重+人工核实），并评估了6个LLM在三种评估协议下的表现，结果显示前沿商业模型大幅领先，开放权重模型中Gemma4 31B在印度语言上优于印度专用模型Sarvam 30B。
AI.motivation: 现有的问答基准缺乏针对印度特定事实知识的评估，且缺少大规模高质量的多语言基准来衡量LLM在印度语言上的知识掌握程度。
AI.method: 采用混合构建策略：结合上下文引导的LLM问答生成与验证、语义去重和人工核实；数据源自教育课程、竞赛材料和领域参考书；翻译至19种印度语言；使用三种评估协议（LLM-as-a-judge、精确子串匹配、词重叠匹配）。
AI.result: 三个评估协议产生几乎相同的模型排名，证明结果不依赖评判方式选择；前沿商业模型大幅领先；开放权重模型中Gemma4 31B在所有印度语言上优于Indic专用模型Sarvam 30B。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可以在保证标注质量的前提下规模化创建基准数据，并且提出的基准有效评估了LLM在印度特定事实知识上的表现。

title: Geometry-Calibrated Closed-Form Shrinkage for SAR Despeckling
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) despeckling is an inverse-recovery problem in which multiplicative non-Gaussian noise must be suppressed without erasing scattering structures. We revisit a nonlocal sparse estimator that applies a log--Yeo--Johnson transformation, stacks similar patches into groups, codes each group on its own left singular basis, and shrinks the resulting coefficients. Three quantities usually treated as tunable are shown to be fixed by this construction. First, the group dictionary is orthonormal, so the weighted Lasso admits an exact coefficient-wise soft-threshold solution: the iterative inner solver is unnecessary, and the two apparent weighting matrices are the numerator and denominator of a single threshold field rather than independent modules. Second, because the dictionary is estimated from the noisy group itself, its retained subspace absorbs speckle in proportion to the group aspect ratio $γ=p^2/K$; a random-matrix argument converts the corresponding regularization constant into a geometry-calibrated correction and collapses patch size, group size, and shrinkage scale into one analytically determined degree of freedom. Third, singular projection makes the coefficient noise nearly Gaussian at every tested look number, which locates the point at which an exact speckle likelihood ceases to be informative. The resulting estimator is deterministic, training-free, and applies one set of analytically determined settings to every image and sensor. It ranks first in 18 of 24 PSNR/SSIM comparisons against twelve published methods on three synthetic benchmarks, and attains the lowest mean deviation of the ratio image from the theoretical speckle model over six real-SAR configurations from five sensors. Code is available \href{https://github.com/Teriri1999/Geometry-Calibrated-Closed-Form-Shrinkage-for-SAR-Despeckling}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了一种基于非局部稀疏估计的SAR图像去斑方法，采用log-Yeo-Johnson变换、相似块分组和左奇异基编码。作者证明了三个通常被视为可调参数的量其实由构造本身固定：群字典正交性使得加权Lasso有精确的系数级软阈值闭式解；字典从含噪分组估计导致子空间按组纵横比γ=p²/K吸收散斑，通过随机矩阵理论将正则化常数转化为几何校准的修正项；奇异投影使系数噪声近似高斯。最终得到一个确定性、无需训练、参数全解析确定的估计器，在24项PSNR/SSIM对比中18项排名第一，并在六种真实SAR配置中取得最低的比值图像偏差。
AI.motivation: SAR去斑是逆恢复问题，需在乘法非高斯噪声下抑制散斑同时保留散射结构。现有非局部稀疏估计方法中，加权Lasso的两个权重矩阵、正则化常数、以及收缩尺度等参数通常被视为需要手动调优的超参数，缺乏理论依据，导致方法在不同图像和传感器间泛化性差。本文旨在通过严格的数学推导证明这些"可调"参数实际上是由方法构造本身唯一确定的，从而消除经验调参的需求。
AI.method: 作者重新分析非局部稀疏估计器：首先对SAR数据应用log-Yeo-Johnson变换，将相似 patches 堆叠成组，每组用自己的左奇异基编码并收缩系数。核心理论贡献有三：(1) 证明群字典为正交，因此加权Lasso有精确的逐系数软阈值闭式解，内部迭代求解器冗余，且两个表观权重矩阵实际上是单一阈值场的分子与分母；(2) 由于字典从含噪分组自身估计，保留子空间按比例γ=p²/K吸收散斑，利用随机矩阵论将正则化常数转化为几何校准修正，把patch大小、组大小和收缩尺度折叠为一个解析确定的自由度；(3) 奇异投影使系数噪声在所有测试视数下近似高斯，确定了精确散斑似然失效的临界点。
AI.result: 所得估计器完全确定性、无需训练、对所有图像和传感器使用同一组解析确定的设置。在三个合成基准上与十二种已发表方法的24项PSNR/SSIM对比中，有18项排名第一；在来自五个传感器的六种真实SAR配置中，比值图像相对理论散斑模型取得最低的平均偏差。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过数学推导展示了SAR去斑中非局部稀疏估计的三个核心参数并非自由可调，而是由问题的几何结构唯一决定，将经验调参转化为解析确定的设置。这不仅简化了方法应用，还揭示了字典自适应估计、正则化与噪声统计之间的深层理论联系，为无需训练、跨传感器通用的SAR去斑提供了新范式。

title: A Novel Fourier Feature Network for Solving Partial Differential Equations
summary: Building on the foundation of single-hidden-layer neural networks, Fourier Feature Networks (FENs) are proposed, which incorporate Fourier features using $\cos$, $\sin$, or a combination of both. Similar to Extreme Learning Machines (ELMs), FENs employ a single-hidden-layer architecture to generate a set of basis functions. The target function is then approximated as a linear combination of these basis functions, with the coefficients determined using the least squares method. However, unlike ELMs, which often rely on affine transformations to improve representational power, FENs can achieve high-precision solutions without requiring such transformations on the input variables. To evaluate the representational capacity of these networks, we search for an optimal scaling factor within a predefined range for the randomly initialized and fixed weights and biases. By adjusting this scaling factor, we ensure a fair comparison between FENs and ELMs using various activation functions, such as $\text{sigmoid}$, $\tanh$, and $\text{swish}$. Our numerical experiments demonstrate that FENs consistently achieve higher accuracy than ELMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于单隐层神经网络基础的傅里叶特征网络（FENs），利用cos、sin及其组合作为傅里叶特征生成基函数，通过最小二乘法确定线性组合系数来逼近目标函数。与极限学习机（ELMs）相比，FENs无需仿射变换即可实现高精度求解。通过搜索最优缩放因子进行公平比较，数值实验表明FENs在多种激活函数下均优于ELMs。
AI.motivation: 为了克服ELMs依赖仿射变换来提升表示能力的局限性，探索一种无需输入变量变换即可实现高精度逼近的网络结构，从而简化模型并提升计算效率。
AI.method: 提出Fourier Feature Networks (FENs)，采用单隐层结构，使用cos、sin或两者组合作为傅里叶特征构造基函数；通过最小二乘法求解线性组合系数。在预设范围内搜索随机初始化固定权重和偏置的最优缩放因子，以实现FENs与ELMs在sigmoid、tanh、swish等激活函数下的公平对比。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，在多种激活函数下，FENs的求解精度始终高于ELMs。
AI.conclusion: FENs作为一种基于傅里叶特征的单隐层网络，无需仿射变换即可获得比ELMs更高的逼近精度，展现出更强的表示能力。

title: BengaliMCQ: Automatic Generation and Answer Prediction of Academic Multiple-Choice Questions in a Low-Resource Language
summary: Traditional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks process documents without attending to their hierarchical structure, leading to poor performance, especially in low-resource languages such as Bengali. To address this, we propose a structure-aware RAG framework that models Bengali textbooks as hierarchical graphs and uses a contrastively trained graph neural network to retrieve a small set of relevant passages. These passages provide focused context for a large language model, enabling topic-specific multiple-choice question (MCQ) generation and in-domain answer prediction. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework outperforms strong dense retrieval baselines across retrieval metrics, produces more relevant MCQs, and achieves superior answer prediction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结构感知的检索增强生成（RAG）框架，将孟加拉语教科书建模为层次图，使用对比训练图神经网络检索相关段落，为LLM提供聚焦上下文，用于特定主题的多选题生成和领域内答案预测。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG框架忽略了文档的层次结构，在孟加拉语等低资源语言上性能较差，需要结构感知的方法来提升检索和生成质量。
AI.method: 将孟加拉语教科书建模为层次图，采用对比训练（contrastively trained）的图神经网络（GNN）检索少量相关段落，为大型语言模型（LLM）提供聚焦上下文，支持主题特定的多选题生成和领域内答案预测。
AI.result: 该框架在检索指标上优于强密集检索基线，生成的相关多选题更多，答案预测准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的层次图建模结合对比训练的GNN能显著提升低资源语言（如孟加拉语）下RAG系统的检索和生成性能。

title: Generation of Synthetic Fingerphotos with GANs
summary: Contactless fingerprinting is an emerging approach to biometric authentication that allows users to scan their fingerprints without touching a scanner. Due to the limited amount of contactless fingerprint data available and the security risks associated with sharing real individuals' fingerprints, it is valuable to explore methods of generating synthetic data that can be used in place of - or in conjunction with - real data to develop and evaluate contactless fingerprinting systems. In this paper, we present and evaluate synthetic fingerphotos generated using StyleGAN2-ADA and StyleGAN3, existing image generation architectures. We evaluate the realism, privacy preservation, and variety of the synthetic fingerphotos by comparing their biometric feature statistics to those of real fingerphotos, computing match scores between real and synthetic fingerphotos, and computing match scores between different synthetic fingerphotos. This paper provides a quantitative comparison point for future evaluations of synthetic fingerphotos. The evaluation code is made available at https://github.com/cmillerlynch/fingerphoto-gan.

AI.tldr: 本文使用StyleGAN2-ADA和StyleGAN3生成合成接触式指纹照片，并通过生物特征统计、真实与合成指纹匹配分数、合成指纹之间的匹配分数来评估合成数据的真实性、隐私保护性和多样性，为未来合成指纹照片评估提供定量基准。
AI.motivation: 接触式指纹识别数据稀缺且共享真实指纹存在安全风险，因此需要探索生成合成数据以替代或补充真实数据，用于开发和评估接触式指纹识别系统。
AI.method: 使用StyleGAN2-ADA和StyleGAN3两种图像生成架构生成合成指纹照片，并从三个方面进行评估：1) 对比真实与合成指纹照片的生物特征统计以评估真实感；2) 计算真实与合成指纹照片之间的匹配分数以评估隐私保护性；3) 计算不同合成指纹照片之间的匹配分数以评估多样性。
AI.result: 文章对合成指纹照片的真实感、隐私保护性和多样性进行了定量评估，提供了与真实指纹照片的对比分析结果，并公开了评估代码。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为未来合成指纹照片的评估提供了一个定量比较基准，验证了使用GAN架构生成合成指纹数据的可行性，但强调需要进一步评估以确保合成数据在接触式指纹识别系统中的有效性和安全性。

title: Unraveling the Size Determination Mechanism of Nanocrystal Synthesis via Interpretable Neural Networks
summary: Deep learning models of nanocrystal synthesis enable the prediction of size and shape by encoding precursors and reaction conditions. However, their black-box nature hinders gaining deep insights into the underlying synthetic mechanisms. Here, we develop the Nanocrystal Equation Learner (NanoEQL), a fully white-box neural network to unravel the size determination mechanisms of nanocrystal synthesis. Building on the EQL architecture, eight operators are introduced to replace standard activation functions to fit the mathematical equations in nanocrystal synthesis. Among these operators, three smoothed operators address the gradient explosion of singular operators at zero. To evaluate the weights of different precursors, we develop a temperature-gated attention pooling strategy that encodes concentration-driven and reactivity-driven chemical synthesis mechanisms into the temperature gate. The NanoEQL model illustrates that the final nanocrystal size can be described by a linear equation composed of three scalars representing nanocrystallization capability (-Zp), growth capability (Zrea), and external input potential (-Zops). These interpretable scalars not only advance the rational design of nanocrystal synthesis but also establish a generalizable paradigm for deciphering chemical reaction mechanisms through white-box machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了纳米晶体方程学习器（NanoEQL），一种全白盒神经网络模型，用于揭示纳米晶体合成中尺寸决定的机制。该模型通过引入八个操作符替代标准激活函数来拟合合成中的数学方程，并采用温度门控注意力池化策略编码不同前驱体的化学合成机制，最终将纳米晶体最终尺寸描述为由三个可解释标量组成的线性方程。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型虽能预测纳米晶体的尺寸和形状，但其黑盒性质阻碍了对底层合成机制的深入理解。
AI.method: 基于EQL架构，引入八个操作符替代标准激活函数以拟合纳米晶体合成中的数学方程，其中三个平滑操作符解决了奇异操作符在零点处的梯度爆炸问题；开发温度门控注意力池化策略，将浓度驱动和反应性驱动的化学合成机制编码进温度门中。
AI.result: NanoEQL模型表明，最终纳米晶体尺寸可由一个线性方程描述，该方程由三个可解释标量组成：纳米结晶能力（-Zp）、生长能力（Zrea）和外部输入潜力（-Zops）。
AI.conclusion: 这些可解释标量不仅推进了纳米晶体合成的理性设计，还建立了通过白盒机器学习解读化学反应机制的通用范式。

title: Generated Context versus Governed State: Functional Conditions for Accountable Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become the dominant interface of clinical artificial intelligence, yet the interface they expose (text in, text out, one context window at a time) maintains no explicit, persistent, governed representation of what is currently true about a patient. This paper argues that longitudinal clinical reasoning is a state-estimation problem under partial observability, and that the axis on which clinical AI succeeds or fails is not the fluency of the model reading the record but the governance of the patient state it reasons over. We distinguish generated context from governed state; separate five objects that clinical AI habitually conflates (true state, observations, evidence, belief, and simulated state); define a tiered governance standard against which any clinical AI system can be audited; and show that an operational definition of accountability decomposes into four information requirements: an immutable evidence ledger with awareness-time versioning, a belief state distinct from accumulated evidence, an observation-process model, and claim-level causal typing. We are explicit that this decomposition is analytic rather than a necessity theorem, and that its value is conceptual hygiene: it converts "accountable clinical AI" from a slogan into an audit instrument. A six-level maturity framework separates what a system makes governable from what it can compute, locating current LLM-centric practice at high capability but low maturity. The paper is fully self-contained: the four research questions the framework poses are stated in the introduction, and the conclusion records what the paper establishes toward each; future work develops the buildable core of the architecture and the research program toward full Clinical World Models. No empirical result is claimed here.

AI.tldr: 本文论证纵向临床推理本质上是部分可观测条件下的状态估计问题，提出将"生成的文本上下文"与"受治理的患者状态"分离，并建立分级治理标准与可审计的问责分解框架，将"负责任的临床AI"从口号转化为审计工具。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽已成为临床AI的主流界面，但其"文本进文本出、单一上下文窗口"的接口缺乏对患者当前真实状态的显式、持久且受治理的表示。作者认为临床AI成败的关键不在模型阅读记录的流畅度，而在于所推理患者状态的治理水平。
AI.method: 概念分析与框架构建：1) 区分生成上下文与受治理状态；2) 分离临床AI常混淆的五类对象（真实状态、观测、证据、信念、模拟状态）；3) 定义分层治理标准用于审计任何临床AI系统；4) 将问责的操作性定义分解为四个信息需求：不可变证据账本（含觉察时间版本化）、区别于累积证据的信念状态、观测过程模型、声明级因果类型标注；5) 提出六级成熟度框架。
AI.result: 本文不声称任何实证结果，其贡献是分析性的：提供了将"负责任的临床AI"从口号转化为审计工具的概念清洁方法。通过六级成熟度框架将系统"可治理的内容"与"可计算的内容"分离，指出当前以LLM为中心的实践具备高能力但低成熟度。
AI.conclusion: 该分解是分析性的而非必要性定理，其价值在于概念卫生。论文完全自包含，四个研究问题在引言中提出并在结论中记录进展，未来工作将开发架构的可构建核心及通往完整临床世界模型的研究计划。

title: Wiktionary as a Crowdsourced Lexicon for English Dialects
summary: This paper evaluates Wiktionary as an ethically crowdsourced lexicon for English dialects. We took a two-phase approach, providing an in-depth descriptive analysis of the crowdsourced lexicon for 12 national varieties of English before applying the lexicon to geo-referenced, country-level social media language data to examine the real-world performance of this crowdsourced dialect lexicon. We demonstrate that Wiktionary matches or exceeds the coverage of traditional dictionaries, such as the Oxford English Dictionary (OED), for regional and Outer-Circle varieties. Our dialect-specific case study on New Zealand English found high alignment between Wiktionary and the OED based on word-formation patterns (R = 0.883). Similarly, we observed high alignment between the dialect lexicon and geo-referenced social media language. While this paper found that Wiktionary has broad coverage of lexical properties, it also highlighted some of the macro-challenges involved in evaluating dialect-responsive language resources and tools, such as the role of language contact in dialects and register effects in web-based corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文评估维基词典（Wiktionary）作为英语方言的伦理众包词典资源。通过两阶段方法，先对12种国家英语变体的众包词条进行深度描述性分析，再将其应用于地理参考的社交媒体语言数据检验真实表现。结果显示Wiktionary在地区性和外圈英语变体上的覆盖率达到或超过传统词典（如OED），在新西兰英语的构词模式上与OED高度一致（R=0.883），且方言词条与社交媒体语言高度对齐。同时指出方言评估中语言接触和语域效应等宏观挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统方言词典（如OED）存在覆盖不均、更新滞后等问题，而众包词典（如Wiktionary）具有伦理优势（开放、社区驱动）且可能提供更广泛的方言覆盖。研究者希望系统评估Wiktionary作为英语方言资源的可靠性及其在真实语言数据中的可用性。
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法：(1) 对Wiktionary中12种国家英语变体的众包词条进行深入的描述性语言学分析；(2) 将方言词条应用于地理标记的国家级社交媒体语言数据，检验该众包方言词典在真实语料中的表现。并对新西兰英语进行专门的个案研究，比较Wiktionary与OED的构词模式。
AI.result: Wiktionary在地区性和外圈英语变体上的覆盖率等于或超过传统词典（如OED）。新西兰英语个案研究中，Wiktionary与OED在构词模式上高度一致（R=0.883）。方言词条与地理参考的社交媒体语言也呈现高度对齐。同时发现评估方言资源时面临宏观挑战，包括语言接触在方言中的角色以及网络语料中的语域效应。
AI.conclusion: Wiktionary是评估区域及外圈英语方言的有效且覆盖广泛的众包词典资源，其覆盖率和可靠性可与传统词典媲美。然而，在方言响应型语言资源和工具的评估中仍需关注语言接触、语域效应等宏观层面的方法论挑战，这提醒未来研究需要更细致地考量方言复杂性。

title: MOSS-VL Technical Report
summary: We present MOSS-VL, an open vision-language model family that treats real-time interaction -- perceiving while it speaks -- as a first-class capability. It is co-designed across the stack: the language decoder attends to vision only through gated cross-attention, so the model can naturally see incoming frames while generating; a synthesized interaction corpus supervises when to speak, when to stay silent, and when to revise; and a staged curriculum concentrates all real-time-specific training in one light final stage over a strong offline foundation. Offline, MOSS-VL-Instruct is competitive at comparable scale and leads temporal-reasoning video sets. Across four streaming benchmarks, MOSS-VL-Realtime posts the best average on three (second on the fourth) among open-source streaming models, sweeping the three subsets that squarely test proactive behavior -- 66.0 vs. 37.5 for the best baseline on OmniMMI Proactive Alerting. With 11.3B parameters but visual tokens outside the decoded sequence, MOSS-VL widens its time-to-first-token advantage over same-backbone Qwen3-VL-8B from 2.8x to 5.1x as visual context grows. We release all five checkpoints, the training curriculum, and the real-time inference code at https://github.com/OpenMOSS/MOSS-VL.

AI.tldr: MOSS-VL是一个开放源码的视觉语言模型家族，将实时交互（边感知边说话）作为首要能力，通过门控交叉注意力、合成交互语料库和分阶段课程训练实现，在流式基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型大多擅长离线理解任务，但缺乏真正的实时交互能力——即在生成过程中同时感知新到来的视觉输入。作者希望将实时交互作为模型的"一等公民"能力来设计。
AI.method: 全栈协同设计：(1) 语言解码器仅通过门控交叉注意力（gated cross-attention）关注视觉，使模型在生成时能自然感知新帧；(2) 使用合成交互语料库监督模型决定何时发言、何时保持沉默、何时修正；(3) 采用分阶段课程训练，将实时专用训练集中在轻量级最终阶段，基于强离线基础构建。视觉token放在解码序列之外，不增加序列长度。
AI.result: MOSS-VL-Instruct在离线场景与同规模模型竞争且领先时序推理视频集；MOSS-VL-Realtime在四个流式基准中平均最佳成绩三个（第四个第二），在主动行为子集上66.0对比最佳基线37.5；11.3B参数但TTFT优势相比同骨干Qwen3-VL-8B从2.8x扩大到5.1x（随视觉上下文增长）。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构、数据和训练策略的全栈协同设计，MOSS-VL成功将实时交互能力内化为模型的核心特性，同时保持离线性能，并显著提升流式推理效率，所有五项检查点、训练课程和推理代码均已开源。

title: Generative Learning of Separatrices
summary:
The identification and reconstruction of the boundaries separating basins of attraction in multistable, multidimensional dynamical systems presents a fundamental challenge in computational dynamics. These structures govern transition pathways and other important large timescale behavior, yet they remain typically under-sampled since their neighborhood does not get routinely visited during direct simulations. Traditional computational approaches face computational limitations in high-dimensional systems and require a priori knowledge of the dynamical system and its equations. Simplistic sampling methods such as random or uniform sampling of the phase space typically fail to quantitatively approximate separatrices and their structure altogether.
  We introduce and implement a framework that combines supervised classification with generative modeling to address this challenge. Our approach first trains neural network classifiers on uniformly or randomly sampled initial conditions labeled by their corresponding basins of attraction in the system of interest. Using uncertainty metrics of the trained classifier to quantify decision boundaries, the method then identifies these high uncertainty regions and boundaries of the classifier as preliminary approximate separatrices. Subsequently, score-based generative models are trained specifically on samples from high-uncertainty regions, ultimately generating densities of samples consistent with the empirical density of samples on or close to the manifold that constitutes the separatrix between basins in the sampled region. This approach leverages the complementary strengths of (a) discriminative models for global phase space partitioning and (b) generative models for detailed geometric sampling, resulting in a systematic, iterative, data-driven framework that produces empirically consistent reconstructions of (approximate) separatrix manifolds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个结合监督分类与生成建模的新框架，用于在多变体、高维动力系统中识别和重建吸引盆之间的边界（分离流形）。该方法先用神经网络分类器对均匀或随机采样的初值进行分类，利用不确定性指标定位高不确定区域作为初步分离流形，再用基于分数的生成模型在高不确定区域密集采样，最终重建接近分离流形的样本密度分布。
AI.motivation: 分离流形（separatrices）支配着多稳态动力系统的过渡路径和长期行为，但在直接模拟中很少被访问，导致采样不足。传统计算方法在高维系统中面临计算瓶颈，且需要预先知道系统方程。简单的随机或均匀采样方法无法定量逼近分离流形及其结构。
AI.method: 该框架包含三个关键步骤：(1) 在均匀或随机采样的初始条件上训练神经网络分类器，根据吸引盆标记标签；(2) 利用分类器的不确定性指标（如预测置信度）量化决策边界，识别高不确定区域作为近似分离流形；(3) 在高不确定区域训练基于分数的生成模型，生成与分离流形流形上或附近经验密度一致的样本，从而实现迭代、数据驱动的分离流形重建。
AI.result: 该框架结合了判别模型（全局相空间分区）和生成模型（局部几何细密采样）的互补优势，能够系统地产生经验上一致的近似分离流形重建。
AI.conclusion: 这是一种纯数据驱动的、无需先验动力学方程知识的迭代框架，为高维多变体系统中分离流形的重建提供了新的可行途径，弥补了传统方法的不足。

title: Do LLMs Know What to Ask and When? Evaluating Multi-Turn Information Seeking
summary: When a user question is underspecified, a capable model should recognize that its context is insufficient, identify the missing information, ask for it, and respond only once that information determines a unique answer. We formalize multi-turn information seeking as solving a k-underspecified constraint satisfaction problem, where k is the number of variables jointly required to determine the target and therefore measures the degree of missing information. We instantiate the formulation in MT-InfoSeek, a controlled evaluation suite of 5,251 problems and 9,006 task instances spanning mathematics, logic, biology, medicine, and general knowledge. We evaluate models along three axes: what they ask, when they ask it, and how the acquired information affects the final answer. Performance degrades across models and domains as underspecification increases. Models recognize that additional information is needed but underestimate how much, and in logical problems at k = 2 they under-predict the degree of missing information about four times as often as they over-predict it. They also fail to identify a minimal sufficient set of queries, improve only marginally when given the true k, and often stop before acquiring sufficient information. In tasks with ordered dependencies, an incorrect query order reduces final accuracy even when the model eventually acquires all necessary information. We measure information seeking directly through final sufficiency, which records whether the acquired information determines the target independent of answer generation. This separation shows differences between models that final accuracy alone does not capture, and indicates that the ability to seek information over multiple turns is distinct from the ability to generate answers and is not measured by current LLM evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多轮信息寻求的形式化框架，将其建模为k-未指定约束满足问题，并构建了MT-InfoSeek受控评估套件（5,251个问题、9,006个任务实例），覆盖数学、逻辑、生物、医学和常识领域。研究发现模型随着未指定程度增加性能显著下降，低估缺失信息量、难以识别最小充分查询集、在有序依赖任务中查询顺序错误会降低最终准确率，并通过"最终充分性"指标证明了信息寻求能力与答案生成能力是分离的。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM评估主要关注单轮问答和最终答案准确率，缺乏对多轮信息寻求能力的系统性评估。当用户问题未充分指定时，模型应识别信息不足、主动询问缺失信息，但现有评估体系无法衡量这一关键能力。
AI.method: 将多轮信息寻求形式化为k-未指定约束满足问题（k为确定目标所需联合求解的变量数），构建MT-InfoSeek受控评估套件，从三个维度评估模型：问什么（查询内容）、何时问（提问时机）、以及获取的信息如何影响最终答案。引入"最终充分性"指标，将信息获取是否充分与答案生成正确性分离测量。
AI.result: 模型在所有领域随未指定程度增加而性能下降；模型能意识到需要更多信息但低估需要量，在k=2的逻辑问题中低估概率是高估的4倍；模型难以找到最小充分查询集，即使告知真实k也仅略有改进；在有序依赖任务中，即使最终获取了全部必要信息，错误的查询顺序仍会降低准确率；最终充分性指标揭示了仅看最终准确率无法捕捉的模型间差异。
AI.conclusion: 多轮信息寻求能力是独立于答案生成能力的认知技能，当前LLM评估体系无法衡量这一能力。模型在信息寻求上存在系统性缺陷，需要专门的评估框架和训练方法加以改进。

title: When Stories Evolve: Benchmarking LLM Storytelling Across Agent Architectures in Open-Ended World Simulations
summary: Large language models can write fluent stories, but open-ended storytelling requires more than local fluency. In evolving world simulations and AI-native games, models must preserve facts, relationships, causal dependencies, and character states as the world changes. We introduce WSE-bench, a process benchmark that separately evaluates sustained generation, canonical coherence, and meaningful development in dynamic LLM storytelling. Generation Coverage records the proportion of planned narrative steps produced; Consistency tracks when canon breaks; and Richness measures how meaningfully branching, player-shaped trajectories develop. Across frontier models, Consistency and Richness do not form a smooth trade-off: their empirical Pareto frontier is non-concave, with several non-dominated intermediate configurations that no positive linear weighting can select. Added structure can enrich trajectories, but it does not uniformly improve coherence and may shorten them. Model scale chiefly improves sustained generation, without producing reliable gains in canonical coherence or meaningful development. These results show that sustained generation, canonical coherence, and meaningful development are distinct and sometimes competing capacities. WSE-bench makes those dynamics visible by extending narrative evaluation from finished stories to the processes that create them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WSE-bench，一个评估大语言模型在动态叙事中持续生成、规范一致性和有意义发展能力的流程基准。研究发现不同前沿模型在这三个维度上呈现非平滑的Pareto权衡，模型规模主要提升持续生成能力，而对规范一致性和有意义发展没有可靠增益。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能写出流畅的故事，但开放式叙事需要更多超越局部流畅性的能力。在动态世界模拟和AI原生游戏中，模型必须随着世界变化维护事实、关系、因果依赖和角色状态。现有评估主要关注成品故事，而缺乏对创作过程的评估。
AI.method: 提出WSE-bench流程基准，分别从三个维度评估动态LLM叙事：(1) Generation Coverage记录已完成计划叙事步骤的比例；(2) Consistency追踪规范被打破的时刻；(3) Richness衡量有意义的分支和玩家塑造轨迹的发展程度。
AI.result: 在前沿模型中，Consistency和Richness之间不构成平滑权衡，其经验Pareto前沿是非凹的，存在多个无正线性加权可选择的非支配中间配置。增加结构可丰富轨迹，但不能统一改善连贯性，且可能缩短轨迹。模型规模主要改善持续生成能力，而不可靠地提升规范一致性和有意义发展。
AI.conclusion: 持续生成、规范一致性和有意义发展是不同且有时相互竞争的能力。WSE-bench通过将叙事评估从成品故事扩展到创作过程，使这些动态更加可见。

title: Frequency and Edge-Guided Segment Anything Model for Remote Sensing Image Semantic Segmentation
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE TGRS 2026
summary: Remote sensing image semantic segmentation (RSISS) has attracted significant attention due to the growing demand for fine-grained land cover information. The Segment Anything Model (SAM), proposed as a foundation vision model, offers strong segmentation performance and generalization capabilities for RSISS tasks. However, existing SAM-based approaches face two limitations: (1) Insufficient adaptation of SAM's features to the diverse characteristics of land cover types. (2) Semantic ambiguity at object boundaries, which hinders accurate delineation. To address these limitations, we propose Frequency and Edge-guided SAM (FE-SAM), a scalable and efficient framework for RSISS. Specifically, we introduce a Frequency-Modulated Adapter (FMA) that adaptively decomposes and modulates frequency-domain features based on the input data. It selectively enhances informative high- and low-frequency components corresponding to different land cover types.
