Furthermore, to improve SAM's ability to capture fine-grained details, we design EGRefiner, which integrates multi-scale edge-enhanced information extracted from the input image. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that FE-SAM outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The source codes are available at: https://github.com/oucailab/FE-SAM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FE-SAM（Frequency and Edge-guided SAM），一个用于遥感图像语义分割的可扩展高效框架。通过频率调制适配器（FMA）自适应分解和调制频域特征，选择性增强不同地物类型对应的高频和低频成分；同时设计EGRefiner集成多尺度边缘增强信息以提升细节捕捉能力。在三个基准数据集上优于现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于SAM的遥感图像语义分割方法面临两个局限：(1) SAM的特征难以充分适应多样化的地物类型特征；(2) 目标边界存在语义模糊，阻碍了精确的地物边界描绘。
AI.method: 提出FE-SAM框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Frequency-Modulated Adapter (FMA)：基于输入数据自适应分解和调制频域特征，选择性增强不同地物类型对应的高频和低频信息成分；(2) EGRefiner：集成从输入图像提取的多尺度边缘增强信息，以提升SAM对细粒度细节的捕捉能力。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FE-SAM优于现有的最先进方法。源代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: FE-SAM通过频域调制和边缘引导的双重策略，有效解决了SAM在遥感图像语义分割中特征适应性不足和边界语义模糊的问题，验证了频域与边缘信息在遥感分割任务中的有效性。

title: Iterative Refinement Diffusion for Super-Resolved Data Assimilation of Multiscale Physical Systems
summary: Recovering high-resolution states from sparse, low-resolution observations is a central challenge in scientific machine learning and data assimilation. Classical data assimilation exploits temporal information through forecast-analysis cycles, but often requires repeated access to expensive high-resolution forecast models. Generative super-resolution can recover unresolved structure from coarse observations, but is commonly used as a one-shot mapping that does not fully exploit constraints from past states. We introduce Iterative Refinement (IR), a learned data assimilation framework that combines these perspectives. Instead of performing a single coarse-to-fine reconstruction, IR decomposes the task into resolution-wise forecast-analysis operations across a multiresolution hierarchy. At each stage, a shared neural operator with resolution-dependent spectral mode slicing provides a dynamical prior, while a shared conditional diffusion corrector uses the current coarser-resolution state to produce a refined posterior at the next finer resolution. We evaluate IR on one-dimensional stochastically forced Burgers dynamics and two-dimensional Kraichnan turbulence. On the challenging 256x256 Kraichnan benchmark, IR achieves an RMSE of 0.184 and an SSIM of 0.836, outperforming spectral upsampling, one-shot diffusion super-resolution, enhanced deep super-resolution, and an autoregressive forecaster. On the more constrained Burgers testbed, IR remains competitive with one-shot diffusion, which achieves the lowest RMSE. These results show that one-shot generative reconstruction can be effective for simpler settings, while hierarchical forecast-analysis refinement becomes advantageous in strongly multiscale and underdetermined regimes. Overall, IR combines temporal priors, generative correction, and multiresolution reconstruction for learned data assimilation in complex physical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出迭代细化（IR）框架，将经典数据同化与生成式超分辨率结合，通过多分辨率层级上的共享神经算子（提供动力学先验）和条件扩散校正器（提供生成式后验）实现分层预报-分析循环，在Kraichnan湍流基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏低分辨率观测恢复高分辨率状态是科学机器学习和数据同化的核心挑战。经典数据同化虽利用时间信息但依赖昂贵的高分辨率预报模型；生成式超分辨率虽能恢复未解析结构，但通常只是一次性映射，未充分利用过去状态的约束。作者希望结合两者优势。
AI.method: IR框架将粗到细重建分解为跨多分辨率层次的预报-分析操作。每阶段使用带分辨率相关谱模态切片的共享神经算子作为动力学先验，共享条件扩散校正器利用当前较粗分辨率状态生成下一精细分辨率的细化后验。
AI.result: 在256x256 Kraichnan湍流基准上，IR达到RMSE 0.184和SSIM 0.836，优于谱上采样、一次性扩散超分辨率、增强深度超分辨率和自回归预测器。在更受限的Burgers测试平台中IR与一次性扩散方法表现相当，后者取得最低RMSE。
AI.conclusion: 一次性生成式重建在简单场景中有效，而分层预报-分析细化在强多尺度和欠定问题中更具优势。IR综合了时间先验、生成式校正和多分辨率重建，为复杂物理系统的学习数据同化提供了新思路。

title: MINT: Min-Selection Preference Distillation for Balanced Multi-Objective Alignment
summary: Aligning a language agent to several objectives at once is a persistent failure mode of preference-based training: when objectives are combined additively, optimization collapses onto whichever is cheapest to improve and sacrifices the rest, so a support agent learns to sound warm while giving no real help. The root issue is that an additive reward has no notion of balance. We introduce Mint (MIN-selection preference disTillation), a one-line change to preference distillation: rather than ranking sampled candidates by a weighted sum of rewards, we rank them by their weakest objective, distilling the best-balanced candidate over the most lopsided one with an unchanged DPO objective. This is the p -> negative infinity limit of a generalized-mean family spanning additive to worst-case selection. Across cooperative emotional support and adversarial negotiation, min-selection lifts both objectives while sharply cutting their imbalance; on emotional support it raises the weaker axis from 0.37 to 0.64 (p < 10^-40), surpassing human experts and persisting across full multi-turn rollouts. A turn-by-turn analysis yields our central finding: min-selection corrects imbalance in proportion to how imbalanced the reference policy is, and its benefit endures over an interaction precisely as long as that imbalance does.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mint（MIN-selection preference disTillation）方法，通过最小目标选择替代加权和来对候选进行排序，解决偏好训练中多目标对齐时的目标失衡问题，在情感支持和对抗性谈判任务中显著提升弱势目标表现并削减目标间不平衡。
AI.motivation: 偏好训练中多目标对齐持续失败：当目标被加性组合时，优化会塌缩到最容易改进的目标上而牺牲其他目标。例如支持型智能体学会语气温暖但实际帮助不足。根本问题在于加性奖励缺乏平衡的概念，需要一种机制在优化中保持多目标之间的均衡。
AI.method: 引入Mint方法，作为偏好蒸馏的一行改动：不按奖励加权和对候选排序，而是按最弱目标对候选排序，用原始DPO目标蒸馏最平衡的候选而非最不平衡的候选。该方法是对包含加性到最坏情况选择在内的广义均值族的p→负无穷极限。
AI.result: 在合作情感支持和对抗性谈判任务中，最小选择同时提升两个目标并大幅削减不平衡。情感支持任务中弱势指标从0.37提升至0.64（p<10^-40），超过人类专家水平，并在完整多轮推演中持续有效。逐轮分析表明最小选择纠正不平衡的程度与参考策略的不平衡程度成正比。
AI.conclusion: Mint通过最弱目标排序实现多目标平衡优化，其效益持续性与参考策略的不平衡持续性成正比。该方法为多目标偏好强化学习提供了简单有效的解决方案。

title: BERTopic-Virality Prioritisation: A Scalable Framework for Thematic and Comparative Analysis of COVID-19 and Monkeypox Misinformation on Twitter
summary: Health misinformation circulating during pandemics can gain traction rapidly, creating harmful narratives that compete with public health guidance. Most topic-modelling pipelines treat engagement as an external outcome, limiting their ability to prioritise semantically coherent topics that are also rapidly diffusing. We introduce BERTopic-VP, a virality-prioritised topic-modelling framework that combines contextual embedding-based clustering (BERTopic) with a post hoc Virality Prioritisation (VP) layer. The pipeline is complemented by a two-stage hybrid misinformation detection module that fuses a supervised content-based classifier with an external verification signal derived from public-health knowledge bases. Applied to three benchmark datasets, COVID-19_FNIR, Monkeypox, and Constraint, the framework achieves strong classification performance, with F1 up to 0.950 and ROC-AUC up to 0.989, while identifying high-impact clusters under top 1%, 5%, and 10% VP thresholds. For datasets without native engagement metadata, prioritisation is based on a logistic propensity-to-spread score, used as an ordinal proxy for diffusion potential rather than a direct measure of engagement. The results show that integrating semantic structure, virality-aware ranking, and affective-linguistic profiling enables scalable and interpretable comparative analysis of misinformation across pandemics. The proposed framework supports monitoring-oriented early warning by surfacing low-volume but high-risk narratives for analyst review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BERTopic-VP框架，将BERTopic聚类与事后病毒式传播优先排序（VP）层结合，并辅以两阶段混合虚假信息检测模块，用于跨疫情场景下可扩展、可解释的虚假信息分析。在三个基准数据集上F1最高达0.950，ROC-AUC最高达0.989。
AI.motivation: 疫情中健康虚假信息传播迅速，与公共卫生指导竞争叙事。现有主题建模管道将参与度（engagement）视为外部结果，无法优先识别语义连贯且快速扩散的主题，缺乏将病毒式传播性与主题语义结构整合的方法。
AI.method: 提出BERTopic-VP框架：(1) 基于上下文嵌入聚类的BERTopic进行主题建模；(2) 事后病毒式优先排序层（VP）对主题进行扩散优先级排序；(3) 两阶段混合虚假信息检测模块，融合监督式内容分类器与基于公共卫生知识库的外部验证信号；(4) 对无原生参与度元数据的数据集，使用逻辑斯蒂传播倾向评分作为传播潜力的序数代理。
AI.result: 在COVID-19_FNIR、Monkeypox和Constraint三个基准数据集上，分类F1最高达0.950，ROC-AUC最高达0.989；在1%、5%、10%的VP阈值下成功识别高影响力聚类；结合语义结构、病毒式感知排序与情感语言画像可实现跨疫情的可扩展比较分析。
AI.conclusion: 整合语义结构、病毒式感知排名和情感语言画像，能够支持面向监控的早期预警系统，通过浮现低量但高风险的叙事供分析师审查，实现跨流行病的可解释比较分析。

title: MEDR: Query-Independent Frame Selection via Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring
summary: Frame selection is a fundamental component of multimodal large language models, enabling long videos to be processed under limited visual-token and computational budgets. Uniform sampling preserves temporal coverage but may miss informative content that appears only briefly. To alleviate this limitation, query-dependent methods can retrieve question-relevant frames. However, because the selected frames depend on the current question, the same visual input cannot be directly shared across different questions, and frame selection must be repeated in multi-turn video dialogue. This motivates us to seek a query-independent frame selection method that preserves the reusability of a fixed visual input while improving the coverage of informative events beyond uniform sampling. We propose Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring (MEDR), a training-free and query-independent frame selection method. Multi-Signal Event Modeling organizes complementary visual, motion, and text signals into signal-specific temporal events. Dynamic Rescoring then iteratively reevaluates each candidate relative to the current selected set, updating its score according to frame-level signal strength, additional event coverage, and temporal proximity. The resulting fixed frame set is constructed without observing the query and can be reused across different questions. On the standard benchmark evaluations, MEDR improves model accuracy by 0.63%-0.89% on Video-MME. On the long-video subset of LongVideoBench, it improves accuracy by up to 1.23% with Qwen3-VL-8B. MEDR further improves overall accuracy by 0.53%, while reusing exactly the same frame set for every question about a video.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MEDR（Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring），一种无需训练且查询无关的视频帧选择方法。它通过多信号事件建模（视觉、运动、文本信号）和动态重打分迭代选择关键帧，生成的固定帧集可复用，在不同查询间共享，在Video-MME上提升0.63%-0.89%，在LongVideoBench长视频子集上最高提升1.23%。
AI.motivation: 现有帧选择方法中，均匀采样可能错过短暂出现的重要信息；查询依赖方法虽能检索问题相关帧，但帧集依赖当前问题，无法在多轮视频对话中直接复用，导致重复选帧。研究者希望找到一种查询无关的帧选择方法，既保持固定视觉输入的可复用性，又能超越均匀采样的信息覆盖度。
AI.method: MEDR包含两个核心组件：1) 多信号事件建模（Multi-Signal Event Modeling）：将互补的视觉、运动、文本信号组织为信号特定的时间事件；2) 动态重打分（Dynamic Rescoring）：迭代地根据当前已选帧集重新评估每个候选帧，综合帧级信号强度、额外事件覆盖度和时间邻近性更新其分数。整个过程无需训练且不依赖查询，生成的固定帧集可跨问题复用。
AI.result: 在Video-MME标准基准上，MEDR将模型准确率提升0.63%-0.89%；在LongVideoBench长视频子集上，使用Qwen3-VL-8B时准确率最高提升1.23%；在整体实验中，MEDR提升总体准确率0.53%，且对所有问题复用完全相同的帧集。
AI.conclusion: MEDR证明了查询无关的帧选择方法能有效兼顾固定视觉输入的可复用性和信息覆盖度，在无需训练的情况下即显著提升多模态大语言模型在长视频理解上的性能，为多轮视频对话场景提供了一种高效且实用的解决方案。

title: WANDR: A Benchmark for Wide and Deep Research
summary: WANDR (Wide ANd Deep Research) is a benchmark of 500 realistic, challenging data-collection tasks for research agents. Each task requires a system to discover a large set of entities that satisfy specified criteria (breadth), investigate each entity through multiple coordinated web searches (depth), and return independently verifiable records with supporting sources and excerpts. Tasks are represented as qualification key hierarchies that specify the entities, relationships, evidence, and required count at each level; a hierarchy with n companies, m employees per company, and k sources per employee requires n x m x k records. This structure supports diverse workflows such as market mapping, due diligence, literature review, product comparison, and talent sourcing, with targets ranging from dozens to thousands of records. WANDR replaces static gold answer sets with task-specific judges that refetch cited pages and verify each record against its evidence, allowing evaluation of current and changing facts. Record verdicts are aggregated into soft and hard precision, recall, and F1 scores that distinguish factual quality, coverage, and hierarchical completeness. The tasks are derived from de-identified product-usage logs and produced through a semi-automated pipeline with automated checks, empirical audits, and human review where needed. We evaluate six production research systems and find that the benchmark is far from saturated: at high effort, the strongest system reaches only 0.363 soft F1 and 0.133 hard F1. Performance degrades as target volume and hierarchy depth increase, with incomplete discovery, missing enrichment, and incomplete evidence construction remaining major bottlenecks. The benchmark and evaluation harness are available at https://github.com/perplexityai/wandr.

AI.tldr: WANDR是一个包含500个现实且具有挑战性的数据收集任务的基准测试，用于评估研究型AI代理。每个任务要求系统发现大量符合条件的实体（广度）、通过多次协调的网页搜索深入调查每个实体（深度），并返回具有可验证来源和摘录的独立可验证记录。任务以资格键层次结构表示，支持市场映射、尽职调查、文献综述、产品对比和人才搜寻等工作流。该基准用任务特定评判器替代静态答案集，可评估当前和变化的事实，并采用软/硬精确率、召回率和F1分数来区分事实质量、覆盖率和层次完整性。评估六个生产研究系统发现基准远未饱和：最强系统在高努力下仅达到0.363软F1和0.133硬F1，性能随目标数量和层次深度增加而下降。
AI.motivation: 现有研究代理基准测试往往过于简单或依赖静态答案集，无法评估系统处理真实世界中复杂、动态数据收集任务的能力。需要一个能够衡量代理在广度（发现大量实体）和深度（深入调查每个实体）两方面表现的可扩展基准测试，同时应对不断变化的事实。
AI.method: WANDR通过资格键层次结构表示任务，规定每个级别的实体、关系、证据和所需数量（n个公司×m个员工×k个来源）。它用任务特定评判器替代静态答案集，评判器会重新获取引用页面并逐条验证记录。任务来自去标识化的产品使用日志，通过半自动化流水线生成，包含自动化检查、经验审计和人工审查。评估采用软/硬精确率、召回率和F1分数，区分事实质量、覆盖率和层次完整性。
AI.result: 评估了六个生产研究系统。最强系统在高努力条件下仅达到0.363软F1和0.133硬F1，表明基准远未饱和。性能随目标数量和层次深度增加而下降，主要瓶颈包括不完整的实体发现、缺失的充实信息以及不完整的证据构建。
AI.conclusion: WANDR提供了一个具有挑战性的研究代理基准测试，目前最强的生产系统也远未达到饱和水平，证明该基准能够有效区分不同系统的能力并推动该领域进步。基准和评估工具已开源。

title: What the Reranker Sees: Multi-Aspect Page Annotation for Long-Document Multimodal Question Answering
summary: Long-document visual question answering (VQA) over documents of tens to hundreds of pages mixing text, tables, charts, and figures typically follows retrieve-then-read pipelines. In our setting, the bottleneck shifts from retrieval recall to reranker-side evidence selection: on MMLongBench-Doc, BGE-M3 reaches Recall@20 = 0.86 but only F1@5 = 0.254, and even the visual retriever ColPali reaches only F1@5 = 0.332; a text-only rerank LLM seeing only raw snippets misses table, chart, and layout evidence even when the upstream retriever encoded images. We propose Trident, with two complementary components: Trident-R, a retriever-agnostic LLM reranker that converts each candidate into an LLM-readable semantic record, including a visual caption, section path, entity tags, multi-axis concept hits, and a text snippet, then performs a single adaptive-K rerank call; and Trident-S, a generation-side module that prompts the VLM under topical, entity, and structural lenses before synthesis. On two long-document datasets, the annotation+rerank protocol substantially improves retrieval F1 across five heterogeneous pools, with every reranked pool exceeding the strongest adaptive-K baseline PageIndex. An LLM rerank without the annotation barely changes first-hit ranking, indicating the lift comes from the structured annotation. Trident-S targets open-ended synthesis questions by design, adding up to 6.6 points in generation accuracy on these questions. The best Trident configuration is the strongest downstream QA pipeline in our evaluation, with rankings consistent across two LLM judges (kappa = 0.913).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Trident框架，针对长文档VQA中检索-重排-生成管线的瓶颈问题。Trident包含两个组件：Trident-R（检索器无关的LLM重排器，将候选文档转换为LLM可读的结构化语义记录）和Trident-S（生成侧模块，通过主题、实体和结构视角提示VLM）。实验表明该方法在长文档数据集上显著提升重排F1和生成准确率，成为评估中最强的下游QA管线。
AI.motivation: 长文档VQA的瓶颈已从检索召回转移到重排侧的证据选择。现有方法在MMLongBench-Doc上Recall@20较高（BGE-M3达0.86）但F1@5很低（仅0.254），即使视觉检索器ColPali也只有0.332。纯文本重排LLM无法捕捉表格、图表和布局信息，即使上游检索器已编码了图像。
AI.method: Trident包含两个互补组件：(1) Trident-R：检索器无关的LLM重排器，将每个候选项转换为LLM可读的语义记录（包含视觉标题、章节路径、实体标签、多轴概念命中、文本片段），进行单次自适应K重排调用；(2) Trident-S：生成侧模块，在合成前通过主题、实体和结构透镜提示VLM。
AI.result: 注释+重排协议在五个异构池上显著提升检索F1，每个重排池都超过最强自适应K基线PageIndex。LLM重排但无注释几乎不改变首命中排名，说明提升来自结构化注释。Trident-S在开放式合成问题上最多增加6.6个点的生成准确率。最佳Trident配置是评估中最强的下游QA管线，两位LLM评判者排名一致（kappa=0.913）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化注释是提升重排效果的关键因素，Trident通过将候选转换为语义记录解决了多模态证据选择问题，同时Trident-S通过三种视角提示增强了开放式问题的生成能力，整体形成了完整且鲁棒的长文档QA解决方案。

title: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness
summary: AI-powered digital-avatar streamers in live e-commerce must answer product questions, engage viewers, and execute changing business strategies in real time. This requires low latency, factual and effective replies, and rapid adaptation to updated campaign, compliance, and style requirements. We develop an evolvable Harness that decouples Skills, Hooks, system prompts, and tools from model weights, allowing runtime behavior to change without retraining. However, Harness evolution creates a moving execution environment: compact models fine-tuned on one configuration may memorize names, schemas, and prompt templates rather than follow the Harness currently provided, while stronger zero-shot models are too slow for real-time use. We address this tension with Harness-Aware Training (HAT), which makes Harness states part of the training distribution. HAT applies task-preserving Harness-State Augmentation (HSA) to Skills, tool schemas, prompt structures, and interaction constraints, and comprises three stages: HSA-based supervised fine-tuning, general on-policy distillation to recover general capabilities, and HSA-based agentic reinforcement learning in a production-informed live-room simulator. Across four evaluation sets with more than 4,500 cases, our compact 35B model scores 94.8 on real-world Live-Stream QA, versus 80.3 for the base model and 93.0 for the strongest evaluated general LLM, while scoring 94.6 on Harness-Variant QA and retaining 83.5 on IFEval. By contrast, fixed-Harness SFT reduces IFEval by 7.7 points. In a controlled complete-agent replay on one NVIDIA H20 GPU with MTP enabled, the system achieves 3.407 s P50 and 8.114 s P95 latency. These results show that HAT produces a latency-feasible compact agent that remains effective under evaluated Harness changes without sacrificing general instruction following.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可演化的Harness框架和Harness-Aware Training (HAT)方法，用于电商直播中AI数字人主播的实时问答。通过将Harness状态（技能、钩子、系统提示、工具）纳入训练分布，实现紧凑35B模型在低延迟下兼顾事实准确性、通用指令遵循能力和对不断变化的业务配置的高适应性，在真实场景QA得分达94.8。
AI.motivation: 直播电商中的AI数字人主播需要实时回答问题、吸引观众并适应不断变化的业务策略，要求低延迟、事实准确且能快速适应更新后的活动、合规和风格要求。然而，紧凑模型在单一配置下微调会记忆名称和模板而非遵循当前Harness，而更强的零样本模型又太慢无法满足实时要求。
AI.method: 提出可演化Harness解耦技能、钩子、系统提示和工具与模型权重，使运行时行为无需重训练即可改变。在此基础上提出HAT三阶段训练：(1)基于保留任务的Harness-State Augmentation (HSA)有监督微调；(2)通用on-policy蒸馏恢复通用能力；(3)在生产信息直播模拟器中的HSA智能体强化学习。
AI.result: 在超过4,500个案例的四个评估集上，紧凑35B模型在真实直播问答得94.8分（基线80.3，最强通用LLM 93.0），在Harness变体问答得94.6分，IFEval保持83.5分（固定Harness SFT降低了7.7分）。在单块NVIDIA H20 GPU上实现P50 3.407s和P95 8.114s的延迟。
AI.conclusion: HAT方法成功训练出一个延迟可行的紧凑智能体，在评估的Harness变化下保持有效性，且不牺牲通用指令遵循能力，有效解决了模型适应性与实时性之间的张力。

title: EgoTac: In-the-wild Tactile Prediction from Egocentric Vision
summary: Touch is fundamental to dexterous manipulation, yet most egocentric human data increasingly used for robot learning lacks tactile information. Directly collecting large-scale tactile data is challenging due to sensor limitations, while human video data is abundant, contact-rich, and easily scalable. This motivates a natural question: can tactile signals be inferred purely from vision? To address this, we introduce EgoTac, a generalizable model that predicts rich tactile information directly from egocentric human videos. EgoTac is trained on a unified corpus of over 5.7M image-tactile pairs, covering both continuous force measurements and binary contacts. By learning from this diverse dataset, EgoTac captures nuanced touch dynamics across varied interactions. Experiments demonstrate strong performance: in-domain prediction achieves an average force error below 0.06N. On out-of-domain contact prediction benchmarks, EgoTac consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art contact estimator. It also captures the rise and fall patterns of real tactile data and enables zero-shot predictions on unconstrained real-world videos. Scaling analyses further reveal that both data diversity and volume improve performance steadily. Overall, EgoTac provides a scalable pathway to extract tactile priors from egocentric human videos, enabling broadly applicable tactile-aware robot learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoTac，一个从第一人称（egocentric）人类视频中直接预测丰富触觉信息的通用模型。该模型在超过570万图像-触觉对（涵盖连续力测量和二元接触）的统一语料库上训练，能够捕捉多样的交互触觉动态。实验表明其在域内预测的平均力误差低于0.06N，在域外接触预测基准上优于最先进的接触估计器，并支持对无约束真实世界视频的零样本预测。
AI.motivation: 触觉对于灵巧操作至关重要，但机器人学习中常用的大规模第一人称人类数据缺乏触觉信息。由于传感器限制，直接收集大规模触觉数据很困难，而人类视频数据丰富、包含丰富接触信息且易于扩展。因此作者提出一个自然问题：能否仅从视觉推断触觉信号？
AI.method: EgoTac是一个从第一人称人类视频预测触觉信息的通用模型，在包含超过570万图像-触觉对的统一语料库上训练（涵盖连续力测量和二元接触两种数据类型），学习多样交互中细微的触觉动态。
AI.result: 域内预测平均力误差低于0.06N；域外接触预测基准上持续优于最先进的接触估计器；能捕捉真实触觉数据的升降模式；支持无约束真实世界视频的零样本预测；扩展性分析显示数据多样性和规模的增加均能持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: EgoTac提供了一条从第一人称人类视频提取触觉先验的可扩展路径，能够推动广泛适用的触觉感知机器人学习。

title: Real-Time State-of-Health Estimation and Online Degradation Prognosis from Partial Battery Discharge Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: With the increasing integration of renewable energy sources, energy storage systems have become essential, making the accurate estimation of their State of Health (SOH) and degradation behavior critical. In this work, we propose a physics-informed deep learning approach for lithium-ion battery SOH prediction using incomplete discharge curves extracted from arbitrary voltage ranges, thereby reflecting realistic and heterogeneous operating conditions. The proposed method combines data-driven learning with physically motivated degradation dynamics to ensure consistent and reliable SOH estimation from partial discharge information, achieving a MAPE below 4$\%$. In addition, a real-time degradation trend estimation strategy is introduced to detect key aging transitions without requiring prior knowledge or historical data, making it applicable to a wide range of batteries. Overall, our approach enables SOH estimation from arbitrary discharge segments and a real-time degradation forecast that continuously integrates all usage, overcoming previous methods that rely on fixed protocols or early, non-adaptive predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理信息深度学习方法，用于从任意电压范围的放电曲线片段中估计锂离子电池的健康状态（SOH），并引入实时退化趋势估计策略，检测关键老化转变，无需先验知识或历史数据。
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源的普及，储能系统不可或缺，准确估计电池SOH和退化行为至关重要。现有方法依赖固定协议或早期的非自适应预测，无法适应现实世界中异构和多样化的运行条件。
AI.method: 将数据驱动学习与物理启发的退化动力学相结合，利用从任意电压范围提取的不完整放电曲线进行SOH预测；同时引入实时退化趋势估计策略，无需先验知识即可检测关键老化转变。
AI.result: 在部分放电信息条件下实现MAPE低于4%的一致且可靠的SOH估计，并能实时检测关键老化转变。
AI.conclusion: 该方法克服了以往依赖固定协议或早期非自适应预测的局限，能够从任意放电段估计SOH并持续集成所有使用数据进行实时退化预测，适用于广泛类型的电池。

title: Discovering High-Quality Chess Puzzles with Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Learning and skill mastery require extensive and deliberate practice. In many learning settings, producing high-quality pedagogical materials can require a high level of domain expertise and be very time-consuming. Pedagogical materials often need to train students to engage in different thinking patterns. In some domains, such as chess, puzzles are used to help students practice their skills in calculating the next moves and recognizing known patterns on a board. Giving students a practice set of puzzles to help them learn different modes of thinking is challenging because the teacher needs to carefully balance between different motifs and how many look-ahead steps a student needs to perform. Popular online platforms like Chess.com and Lichess offer players millions of puzzles. Unlike chess tactics puzzles procured by human experts, where chess beginners can learn valuable insights, these puzzles are automatically generated and often regarded as having low pedagogical value. These platforms also rely on a heuristic to recommend puzzles to users for practice. Using the user history data over an entire year, a total of 1.5 billion puzzle-solving histories, we learn the pedagogical value of a puzzle and how to automatically choose a set of puzzles to better support chess learners using insights from offline reinforcement learning. We show that using offline policy evaluation, our trained policy has significant impact on beginners with puzzle-solving Elo range of 100--1000, particularly for the group of beginners whose learning growth was stagnant. We also performed a qualitative analysis of the puzzles discovered by our model by collecting annotation ratings from expert chess players. The success of our pipeline shows promise for a future where we can understand the pedagogical values of practice items given general user interaction data.

AI.tldr: 本文利用来自Chess.com和Lichess等平台长达一年、总计15亿次的谜题求解历史数据，通过离线强化学习自动学习和选择具有教学价值的象棋谜题，以更好地支持初学者学习。研究发现该策略对Elo评分100-1000的初学者（尤其是学习停滞的群体）有显著影响，并通过专家棋手的人工标注验证了模型发现的谜题质量。
AI.motivation: 高质量教学材料需要高水平的领域专业知识且非常耗时。在象棋领域，教师需要仔细平衡不同主题和所需前瞻步数来设计练习谜题。虽然在线平台提供了数百万个自动生成的谜题，但这些谜题被认为教学价值较低，且平台依赖启发式方法推荐谜题，缺乏系统性、数据驱动的方法来评估和选择具有教学价值的练习材料。
AI.method: 作者利用一年内15亿次谜题求解历史数据，采用离线强化学习（offline reinforcement learning）方法学习谜题的教学价值，并自动选择一组谜题以更好地支持象棋学习者。使用离线策略评估（offline policy evaluation）来评估训练策略的效果，并对模型发现的谜题进行专家棋手的人工定性分析。
AI.result: 训练的策略对Elo评分100-1000的初学者有显著影响，特别是对学习成长停滞的初学者群体效果明显。专家棋手对模型发现的谜题进行了注释评分，定性分析结果验证了模型发现谜题的质量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了利用通用用户交互数据理解练习项目教学价值的可行性，为未来在教育领域通过数据驱动方式自动生成和选择高质量教学材料提供了前景和方向。

title: Using the Mimi codec for metalinguistic representations
comment: 11 pages, accepted for the Proceedings of the Third Workshop on the Bridges and Gaps between Formal and Computational Linguistics (BriGap-3), Paris 2026
summary: In this paper, we focus on the dictionary of 2048 tokens used in Mimi semantic token codebook, the neural codec of the Moshi language model. We show that the ABX experiment carried out with Mimi fails to capture the mapping of the semantic tokens to phone realisations. By realigning Mimi representations to the TIMIT corpus transcriptions, we show that the 2048 tokens IDs of the semantic codebook map to quadphone, triphone, biphone, phone and subphone realisations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Moshi语言模型使用的Mimi语义token码本（2048个token），发现现有的ABX实验无法捕捉语义token到音素实现的映射关系。通过将Mimi表示与TIMIT语料库转写进行重新对齐，作者证明这2048个语义token ID可以映射到四音素、三音素、双音素、单音素和子音素等不同粒度的音素实现。
AI.motivation: 现有ABX实验无法准确反映Mimi语义token码本与音素实现之间的映射关系，需要更合适的方法来揭示语义token的实际语音学含义。
AI.method: 将Mimi的语义token表示与TIMIT语料库的转写进行重新对齐，分析2048个token ID与不同粒度音素（四音素、三音素、双音素、单音素、子音素）的对应关系。
AI.result: Mimi语义码本中的2048个token能够映射到多种粒度的音素实现，包括四音素、三音素、双音素、单音素和子音素。
AI.conclusion: ABX实验不足以捕捉Mimi语义token到音素实现的映射，而通过TIMIT重新对齐可以更有效地揭示语义码本的语音学结构。

title: Do Visual Grounding Decoders Need Feed-Forward Networks? A Controlled Study over Frozen Vision-Language Features
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Code and project page: https://github.com/TarunTomar122/attention-is-all-you-need-for-vlms
summary: Do feed-forward networks (FFNs) in visual grounding decoders add essential computation once a pretrained vision-language model has already encoded image and language context? We compare a four-block attention-only decoder (A4), a matched four-block attention-plus-FFN decoder (S4), and an eight-block attention-only parameter control (A8) over frozen VLM features. A4 matches or slightly exceeds S4 on RefCOCOg and Ref-Adv-s. FineCops-Ref reveals a small A4 deficit of 0.52 percentage points at IoU@0.5 (95% CI [0.12, 0.95] in favor of S4), but A8 recovers it and finishes 0.26 points above S4. Official FineCops levels do not show a monotonic increase in the gap. A4 reduces trainable decoder parameters by 44.4% and cached-decoder latency by 10.1%, although end-to-end latency remains backbone-dominated. These results concern the trainable grounding decoder, not a complete attention-only VLM.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉接地解码器中前馈网络（FFN）的必要性。通过对比四块纯注意力解码器（A4）、四块注意力加FFN解码器（S4）和八块纯注意力参数控制（A8），发现A4在RefCOCOg和Ref-Adv-s上与S4相当或略优，在FineCops-Ref上仅略低于S4（0.52个百分点），而A8可完全恢复并超越。A4将可训练解码器参数减少44.4%，缓存解码延迟降低10.1%。
AI.motivation: 探究在预训练视觉-语言模型已编码图像和语言上下文的前提下，视觉接地解码器中的前馈网络是否增加了必要的计算量，即FFN是否可以省略。
AI.method: 在冻结的VLM特征上，比较四种块结构的纯注意力解码器（A4）、四种块结构的注意力加FFN解码器（S4）以及八种块结构的纯注意力参数控制（A8）。在RefCOCOg、Ref-Adv-s和FineCops-Ref三个基准上进行评估。
AI.result: A4在RefCOCOg和Ref-Adv-s上匹配或略超过S4；在FineCops-Ref上A4比S4低0.52个百分点（IoU@0.5，95%CI显示有利于S4），但A8恢复差距并高出S4 0.26个百分点。A4减少44.4%的可训练解码器参数和10.1%的缓存解码延迟，端到端延迟仍由骨干网络主导。
AI.conclusion: 在视觉接地解码器场景中，FFN并非核心必需组件，纯注意力架构在保持性能的同时能显著降低参数和延迟。但结论仅适用于可训练接地解码器，而非完整的纯注意力VLM。

title: ER-KANs: Efficient and Robust Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Data-Scarce Scientific Machine Learning
comment: 22 pages, 20 figures, 8 tables; code and data at https://github.com/harshillodhiya/ER-KANs
summary:
The efficient-KAN literature---covering Chebyshev, wavelet, and radial-basis-function variants of the original Kolmogorov-Arnold Network---has been benchmarked almost entirely on clean data. We show that this choice conceals a large capability difference between architectures: ChebyKAN's test MSE (evaluated against clean ground truth) increases by a factor of 10.6x when training data is corrupted with sigma=0.1 noise, versus 7.9x for vanilla KAN, 1.7x for a standard MLP, and just 1.4x for our proposed ER-KAN.
  ER-KAN combines three design choices targeting the noisy, data-scarce setting: shared Gaussian RBF bases across all edges in a layer (providing locality and efficient parameterisation), curriculum noise injection during training (explicitly teaching noise robustness), and entropy-weighted adaptive regularisation (preventing overfitting at small N). The result is a 595-parameter network that matches MLP accuracy at moderate noise while degrading far more gracefully as noise grows.
  We evaluate on eight analytic functions (N in {50, 200, 500}, sigma in {0, 0.03, 0.1}), on a damped harmonic oscillator physics-informed neural network where ER-KAN achieves 4.2x lower solution MSE than MLP, and on a Burgers' equation PINN where all models fail to converge---a genuine limitation we report rather than suppress. We introduce the noise degradation ratio as a simple complementary metric and recommend it become a standard reporting requirement for efficient-KAN papers.

AI.tldr: 本文指出efficient-KAN文献（Chebyshev、wavelet、RBF等变体）几乎只在干净数据上评测，掩盖了不同架构之间的巨大能力差异。作者提出ER-KAN，结合共享高斯RBF基、课程噪声注入和熵加权自适应正则化，在噪声数据和小样本场景下表现远优于ChebyKAN和vanilla KAN，接近甚至超越MLP的鲁棒性。同时提出噪声退化比（noise degradation ratio）作为补充指标，建议成为efficient-KAN论文的标准报告要求。
AI.motivation: 现有efficient-KAN文献几乎全部在干净数据上评测，忽略了噪声场景下的能力差异。作者发现ChebyKAN在含噪训练数据下测试MSE恶化10.6倍（vs MLP仅1.7倍），说明仅用干净数据评测会严重高估KAN变体的实用价值，亟需针对噪声、小样本场景的改进方案和评测标准。
AI.method: ER-KAN包含三个设计：1) 层内所有边共享高斯RBF基函数（提供局部性和高效参数化）；2) 训练期间课程噪声注入（明确教学噪声鲁棒性）；3) 熵加权自适应正则化（防止小N过拟合）。整个网络仅595个参数。
AI.result: 在8个解析函数上（N∈{50,200,500}，σ∈{0,0.03,0.1}），ER-KAN噪声退化比仅1.4x，优于MLP的1.7x、vanilla KAN的7.9x和ChebyKAN的10.6x。在阻尼谐振子物理信息神经网络中，ER-KAN比MLP的解决方案MSE低4.2倍。在Burgers方程PINN中所有模型均无法收敛，作者如实报告了该局限性。
AI.conclusion: 干净数据评测会严重高估efficient-KAN的鲁棒性。ER-KAN通过共享RBF基、课程噪声注入和熵加权正则化，在小规模含噪场景下以少量参数达到MLP级精度且退化更平缓。作者提出噪声退化比作为标准补充指标，并呼吁efficient-KAN领域的论文将其作为常规报告要求。

title: JarvisBench: Always-on Intelligence Between Humans and Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents can execute continuously, but human attention remains intermittent and scarce. This creates a bidirectional coordination problem: users may need immediate access to an agent while work continues in the background, whereas agents may encounter consequential decisions that require user judgment after the user has stopped monitoring execution. We posit an always-on attention-coordination layer---\textit{Jarvis}\footnote{Named after the fictional AI assistant in \textit{Iron Man}.}---that mediates this interface and allocates human attention across one or more working agents. We introduce \textit{JarvisBench} to evaluate both directions of this coordination: whether an intermediary can accurately and promptly answer user-initiated questions about ongoing work, and whether it can recognize when an agent requires user judgment, solicit that judgment at the right moment, and route it back to improve task outcomes. JarvisBench contains 45 agentic task instances: 20 single-agent tasks and 25 workstreams organized into 10 multi-agent projects. The tasks span 19 domains and were selected and adapted from more than 2,000 public candidates. Crucially, the need for user attention arises naturally during execution rather than from an obvious omission in the initial prompt. JarvisBench is designed to integrate with arbitrary agent runtimes without modifying their underlying execution loops. Our reference implementation further provides a full-duplex speech interface, allowing users to reach Jarvis naturally while timely attention coordination supports agents working in the background. By separating agent execution from attention coordination, JarvisBench provides a stable evaluation target as agent capabilities continue to improve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Jarvis作为一个始终在线的注意力协调层，解决长期运行智能体与间歇性人类注意力之间的双向协调问题，并引入JarvisBench基准来评估该协调层的双向能力：一是准确及时地回答用户对正在进行的任务的提问，二是识别智能体何时需要用户判断并在适当时机征询和回传判断结果。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的智能体可以持续执行，但人类注意力是间歇且稀缺的。这导致双向协调难题：用户可能需要即时访问智能体（而智能体在后台继续工作），智能体也可能在用户停止监控后遇到需要用户判断的关键决策。现有系统缺乏一个专门的注意力协调层来管理这种双向交互。
AI.method: 提出Jarvis注意力协调层，作为人与智能体之间的中介接口，在多个工作智能体之间分配人类注意力。同时构建JarvisBench基准，包含45个智能体任务实例（20个单智能体任务和25个工作流组成10个多智能体项目），涵盖19个领域，从2000多个公开候选中筛选改编而来。基准可集成任意智能体运行时而无需修改其执行循环，参考实现提供全双工语音接口。
AI.result: JarvisBench的特点在于用户注意力的需求在执行过程中自然产生，而非来自初始提示中的明显遗漏。通过将智能体执行与注意力协调解耦，为评估两类协调能力提供了稳定目标：回答用户关于进行中工作的提问，以及在适当时机征询用户判断并回传以改善任务结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将智能体执行与注意力协调分离，JarvisBench在智能体能力持续提升的同时仍能提供稳定的评估基准，为长期运行智能体的人机协作提供了新的方向。

title: Hallucination Span Detection with Input-Side Evidence Alignment
summary: Hallucinations remain a major obstacle to the reliable use of large language models (LLMs) in conditional text generation. Existing methods primarily assess the factuality of an entire generated text, providing limited insight into which output spans are hallucinated or how they relate to the input. We introduce the task of hallucination span detection with input-side evidence alignment, which jointly identifies hallucinated spans and aligns output tokens with the corresponding input evidence. Our approach is based on the observation that faithful output tokens are predictable from the input, whereas hallucinated tokens are not. We therefore train an encoder-based model to predict masked output tokens from the input representation, using prediction confidence for hallucination detection while naturally producing alignments to the input. Experiments show that the proposed method effectively detects hallucinated spans and identifies meaningful input-side evidence. Human evaluation confirms the quality of the predicted alignments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出幻觉跨度检测与输入侧证据对齐任务，通过训练编码器模型从输入表示预测被掩码的输出token，利用预测置信度识别幻觉跨度并自然产生与输入的对应关系。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法主要评估整段生成文本的事实性，无法定位具体哪些输出跨度是幻觉的，也无法展示其与输入的关联。这限制了LLM在条件文本生成中的可靠使用。
AI.method: 基于"忠实输出token可从输入预测，而幻觉token不可预测"的观察，训练一个编码器模型，从输入表示预测被掩码的输出token，利用预测置信度进行幻觉检测，同时通过预测过程自然产生输出与输入证据的对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能有效检测幻觉跨度，并识别有意义的输入侧证据。人工评估确认了预测对齐的质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过预测置信度进行幻觉检测与输入证据对齐是可行且有效的，为条件文本生成中的幻觉定位提供了细粒度的解决方案。

title: SA-GEM: Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning for Efficient Remote Sensing Large Vision-Language Models
summary: RS-LVLMs have advanced multimodal understanding of Earth observation imagery, yet their performance is fundamentally constrained by high-resolution processing, as visual token counts grow quadratically with linear input resolution while important visual evidence is inherently sparse and increasingly diluted across the expanded sequence. Existing token pruning methods largely rely on scale-agnostic resolution policies and isolated importance cues, limiting task-aligned granularity adaptation and holistic evidence preservation. To address this, we present Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning (SA-GEM), a plug-and-play framework that unifies task-adaptive token granularity allocation with holistic geospatial token importance modulation. Specifically, a lightweight router selects the resolution based on query-dependent token granularity, while a token importance modulator jointly models task relevance, spatial structure, and local redundancy to preserve holistic geospatial evidence. We show that higher resolution is not universally beneficial and, once sufficient granularity is reached, token quality matters more than token quantity. Experiments across various benchmarks demonstrate that SA-GEM achieves consistent gains in both accuracy and efficiency over existing pruning methods. On XLRS-Bench, it surpasses GeoLLaVA-8K by 2.3% in accuracy with a 2.4 times total inference speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SA-GEM框架，通过尺度自适应路由和地理空间证据调制来解决遥感大型视觉语言模型（RS-LVLMs）在高分辨率处理中视觉token过多且重要证据被稀释的问题，实现了精度与效率的同步提升。
AI.motivation: RS-LVLMs的性能受限于高分辨率处理：视觉token数量随输入分辨率二次增长，而重要的视觉证据本身稀疏且被稀释。现有token剪枝方法依赖尺度无关的分辨率策略和孤立的显著性线索，缺乏任务对齐的粒度适应和整体证据保留能力。
AI.method: SA-GEM是一个即插即用框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 轻量级路由器根据查询依赖的token粒度选择合适分辨率；(2) token重要性调制器联合建模任务相关性、空间结构和局部冗余，以保留整体地理空间证据。
AI.result: 实验表明更高分辨率并非普遍有益，达到足够粒度后token质量比数量更重要。SA-GEM在多个基准上相较现有剪枝方法在精度和效率上均取得一致提升。在XLRS-Bench上，相比GeoLLaVA-8K准确率提升2.3%，总推理速度提升2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: SA-GEM验证了"粒度充足后质量优先"的核心观点，通过统一的尺度适应与证据调制机制，为RS-LVLMs提供了一种兼顾精度与效率的token剪枝新范式。

title: p-Spin Glass Network Efficient Single-Batch Continual Learning
summary: Modern sequence models heavily rely on massive memory footprints and large-batch stochastic optimization, barriers that restrict sample efficiency and continual learning. We introduce the $p$-Spin Glass Network, a novel architecture that overcomes these limitations, structurally manages optimization variance and yields four noticeable capabilities: 1. It enforces memory efficiency: native ternary quantization compresses internal parameters by $8\times$, while exact implicit gradients strictly bound activation memory to $\mathcal{O}(B \cdot T \cdot D)$. 2. it demonstrates sample efficiency, matching the asymptotic performance of a Transformer baseline while utilizing $8\times$ fewer training sequences. 3. Method enables single-batch stability and smooth, monotonic convergence at a stochastic micro-batch size of $1$. 4. Finally, this stability proves modality-agnostic, maintaining robust temporal credit assignment across both discrete subword and long horizon uncompressed raw byte streams. Ultimately, this work removes large batch requirement for stable deep learning, establishing a foundation for continuous learning and edge AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出p-Spin Glass Network架构，通过原生三值量化和精确隐式梯度，实现8倍内存压缩和8倍样本效率提升，支持单批次稳定训练及连续学习。
AI.motivation: 现有序列模型依赖巨大内存占用和大批量随机优化，这限制了样本效率和持续学习能力，本文旨在突破这些瓶颈。
AI.method: 引入p-Spin Glass Network架构：(1) 原生三值量化将内部参数压缩8倍；(2) 精确隐式梯度将激活内存严格限制在O(B·T·D)；(3) 结构化管理优化方差，支持单批次（微批大小1）下的稳定收敛。
AI.result: 该架构在三个维度验证了有效性：(1) 内存效率提升8倍；(2) 仅用1/8训练序列即可达到Transformer基线的渐近性能；(3) 在微批大小1下实现平滑单调收敛，且该稳定性跨模态保持，适用于离散子词和原始字节流。
AI.conclusion: 该工作消除了大规模深度学习对大批量的依赖，为持续学习和边缘AI奠定基础。

title: Personalized Auto-Research: Towards a True AI Co-Scientist
summary: AI co-scientists that generate hypotheses, retrieve related work, design experiments, execute code, and draft full papers are beginning to change how research is carried out. Despite this rapid progress, state-of-the-art systems remain researcher-agnostic: given a research goal, they optimize novelty, validity, or reviewer score while ignoring the individual scientist who will use the output. This overlooks a fundamental fact about research, namely, that what counts as novel, valuable, or feasible depends on the researcher, including their prior work, methodological repertoire, and the collaborators and communities in which they are embedded. In this work, we introduce the problem of personalized auto-research, which conditions every stage of the research process on a representation of the individual researcher. We argue that personalization is not a convenience layer, but rather the fundamental property that allows an AI system to serve as a genuine co-scientist rather than a generic instrument. To address this problem, we propose a general and flexible framework that threads a graph-grounded researcher context through retrieval, hypothesis search, experimentation, writing, and review. The framework consists of three fundamental components: (i) graph-grounded researcher representations, (ii) personalization across the full research pipeline, and (iii) evaluation grounded in the individual. Notably, we highlight a one-size-fits-all failure mode where distinct researchers issuing the same goal receive essentially the same research, erasing the tacit knowledge through which novel ideas arise. Finally, we discuss fundamental open problems and challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"个性化自动科研"（personalized auto-research）问题，主张AI科研系统必须基于个体研究者的表征（包括其过往工作、方法储备、合作者与学术社群）来个性化整个研究流程，而非对所有研究者一视同仁。作者提出一个图约束的研究者上下文框架，涵盖检索、假设生成、实验、写作与评审全流程，并指出"一刀切"模式会抹杀研究者隐性知识、导致新颖性丧失。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的AI科研系统是"研究者无关"的——给定研究目标后只优化新颖性、有效性或评审分数，却忽略了使用输出的个体科学家。然而"何为新颖、有价值、可行"本质上取决于研究者本人及其学术背景。作者认为个性化不是便利层，而是AI系统成为真正"合作科学家"而非通用工具的根本属性。
AI.method: 提出一个通用灵活的框架，将图约束的研究者上下文贯穿整个科研管线。框架包含三大核心组件：(i) 图约束的研究者表征（graph-grounded researcher representations）；(ii) 全科研管线的个性化（检索、假设搜索、实验、写作、评审）；(iii) 基于个体的评估（evaluation grounded in the individual）。
AI.result: 本文主要贡献是定义并形式化"个性化自动科研"问题，提出通用框架，并揭示了一个关键失败模式：当不同研究者提出相同目标时，系统会产出几乎相同的研究，从而抹除隐性知识、压制新颖想法的产生。文章还讨论了开放性难题与挑战。
AI.conclusion: 个性化是AI成为真正协作者科学家而非通用工具的核心前提。当前系统的"一刀切"模式存在根本缺陷，需要将研究者上下文（图表征）注入科研全流程，并发展基于个体的评估方式。该方向仍存在大量开放问题待解决。

title: QuantumPhaseNet: A Gauge-Covariant Geometric and Quantum-Spectral Theory of Semantic Concept Hierarchies with Prototype Validation of a Classical Quantum-Inspired Model
comment: [PAGES] pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Extends arXiv:2602.14419 (WavePhaseNet). Includes prototype validation with an offline Validation Studio; RQ5 reports a negative result for quantum advantage
summary: We present QuantumPhaseNet, a gauge-covariant geometric and quantum-spectral extension of Transformer representations. Context-dependent semantic states are modeled as complex amplitudes; a covariant phase rate induces a semantic wavelength used as a proxy for conceptual scale; and low-frequency graph modes define a document-level discourse direction. The theoretical part establishes local gauge invariance, unitarity of the quantum block, boundedness and conditional stability of WavePhase Attention, and a calibratable hallucination-risk formulation. We also implemented a fully offline Validation Studio for the classical quantum-inspired pipeline in Section 14.1 and evaluated the five research questions in Section 16.1 on its built-in synthetic setting (n=240, observation noise 0.22, circuit noise 0.08, five seeds). RQ1 yielded a wavelength-hierarchy Spearman correlation of 0.852 versus 0.707 for the baseline, 87.3% direction accuracy, and AUC 0.953. RQ2 achieved discourse alignment 0.933 versus 0.589 and 41.2 versus 16.2 paragraphs before drift. RQ3 achieved AUROC 0.881 versus cosine 0.765 and phase-shuffle 0.536. RQ4 achieved error-detection AUROC 0.854 versus entropy 0.634, with Brier 0.150 and ECE 0.098. RQ5 did not show quantum advantage: target probability and end-to-end cost efficiency were 25.5% and 0.107, compared with 70.7% and 0.707 for the Chebyshev classical approximation. These results provide initial synthetic evidence for the classical quantum-inspired components, but not external validity or unconditional quantum speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QuantumPhaseNet，一种规范协变的几何与量子谱Transformer扩展，将语义状态建模为复振幅，利用协变相位率产生语义波长作为概念尺度代理，并用低频图模式定义篇章级话语方向。理论部分建立了局部规范不变性、量子块幺正性、WavePhase注意力的有界性与条件稳定性，以及可校准的幻觉风险公式。实验在离线的经典量子启发流水线上进行（n=240），五个研究问题中前四个显示优于基线，但RQ5未显示量子优势。
AI.motivation: Transformer表示在捕捉上下文相关的语义状态时缺乏几何与量子谱层面的形式化架构，作者希望引入规范协变的几何结构和量子谱扩展来丰富语义建模，同时为幻觉风险提供可校准的数学框架。
AI.method: 将语义状态建模为复振幅；通过协变相位率定义语义波长作为概念尺度代理；利用低频图模式建立文档级话语方向；理论上证明局部规范不变性、量子块幺正性以及WavePhase注意力的稳定性；并实现离线验证工作室进行实验评估。
AI.result: RQ1波长层次Spearman相关0.852（基线0.707）、方向准确率87.3%、AUC 0.953；RQ2话语对齐0.933（基线0.589）、漂移前段落41.2（基线16.2）；RQ3 AUROC 0.881（优于cosine 0.765和phase-shuffle 0.536）；RQ4错误检测AUROC 0.854（基线0.634）；但RQ5未显示量子优势：目标概率25.5%和成本效率0.107，远低于Chebyshev经典近似的70.7%和0.707。
AI.conclusion: 经典量子启发组件在合成设置下显示初步积极证据，但缺乏外部效度，且RQ5明确表明无条件的量子加速不成立，经典Chebyshev近似仍占优。

title: Distribution-free false-alarm calibration and chance-corrected spatial evaluation for industrial anomaly detection
summary: Studies of industrial visual inspection commonly report the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and the overlap between anomaly maps and defect masks. Neither measure specifies the false-alarm rate at a selected threshold, while recurrent defect locations and mask geometry can inflate overlap. We combine a distribution-free upper tolerance threshold with a paired-minus-crossed spatial test. This test compares each detector's score-contributing locations with the matched defect mask and with masks from other images; the difference in rates defines spatial-evidence lift relative to the empirical chance-overlap rate. We evaluate three detectors on 120 point-defect images from three ISP-AD modalities and three fixed data splits. Of 378 alarms, 230 overlap the matched mask. Paired and crossed rates are nevertheless similar in eight of nine detector--modality cells; only DINOv2--ASM has a positive 95\% bootstrap lower bound (lift 0.259, 95\% interval 0.159--0.347). On the independent Magnetic Tile Defect dataset, the same analysis gives lifts of 0.203 (0.169--0.236) for Wide ResNet-50 (WRN50) patch memory and 0.231 (0.202--0.262) for Vision Transformer B/16 (ViT-B/16) patch memory, with one-sided permutation $p=10^{-5}$ for both. When crossed masks are restricted to the same defect class, the lifts remain 0.185 and 0.210. Exact sample planning shows that, with 150 calibration normals, a 95\%-confidence distribution-free claim is supported only for target false-positive rates of 1.98\% or higher; a 1\% target requires at least 299 normals. The results support reporting operating-point performance and chance-corrected spatial evidence alongside AUROC and raw mask overlap.

AI.tldr: 本文指出工业视觉检测常用指标（AUROC和异常图与缺陷掩码的重叠）的局限性——既不指定选定阈值下的误报率，且重复缺陷位置和掩码几何会夸大重叠。作者提出结合无分布上限容差阈值与配对-交叉空间检验的方法，在三个ISP-AD模态和120张点缺陷图像上评估三个检测器，发现大多数情况下配对与交叉率相似，仅DINOv2-ASM有显著正提升；在独立Magnetic Tile Defect数据集上验证了方法的有效性，并给出了精确的样本量规划建议。
AI.motivation: 现有工业视觉检测评估指标（AUROC和掩码重叠）无法准确反映在选定阈值下的误报率，且因缺陷位置重复和掩码几何因素，原始重叠率可能产生虚高，需要更可靠的评估方法。
AI.method: 结合无分布上限容差阈值与配对-减去-交叉空间检验：比较每个检测器得分贡献位置与匹配缺陷掩码及其他图像掩码的重叠率差异，定义空间证据提升（spatial-evidence lift）以修正经验机会重叠率。
AI.result: 在378个警报中230个与匹配掩码重叠，但9个检测器-模态组合中8个的配对与交叉率相似；仅DINOv2-ASM有正的95%提升下限（0.259）。在Magnetic Tile Defect数据集上WRN50提升0.203、ViT-B/16提升0.231（置换检验p=10^-5）；样本规划显示150个正常样本仅支持1.98%及以上的目标误报率，1%目标需至少299个正常样本。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明应在AUROC和原始掩码重叠之外，同时报告工作点性能和机会校正的空间证据；该方法能更准确地评估工业视觉检测器的实际空间定位能力。

title: Frontier AI Forecasting Has a Measurement Problem: An Audit of Progress Evidence
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Evidence cutoff: 12 August 2026. Ancillary code and data included. Preprint; comments welcome
summary: Quantitative forecasts of frontier artificial intelligence often connect dated targets to trends in benchmark scores, training compute, release time, or expert belief. This paper audits whether the public measurement record supports those connections before another trend is fitted. I construct a frozen, event-centric record through 12 August 2026 with 62 selected systems, 12 versioned benchmarks, seven capability or impact criteria, 144 graded events, 27 source records, and 408 typed relations. The record is an audit sample, not a census. Only seven systems jointly observe estimated training compute and a METR 50 percent task horizon. Training compute is absent for 19 of 27 closed systems, including every selected closed release from 2026, while none of the 35 open-weight systems has a METR horizon observation. Benchmark succession creates a second break: a seven-system link from METR Time Horizon 1.0 to 1.1 has a log-scale slope of 1.206 (95 percent CI 1.021 to 1.390), whereas a six-system MMLU to MMLU-Pro comparison appears shift-like under logit and probit links but not under linear or logarithmic links. The observed bridges have about 80 percent power only for slope departures near 25 percent. Provenance is concentrated: 52 of 71 substantive quantitative events, or 73.2 percent, come from one measurement programme, and 76.1 percent are laboratory releases. A review of 56 methodological and empirical sources identifies 16 complementary measurement directions spanning resources, inference budgets, reliability, agentic work, safety, human preference, field outcomes, and forecast backtesting. No direction supplies a replacement scalar. The result is not that frontier AI forecasting is impossible, but that a defensible dated forecast is a claim about a versioned measurement system with explicit joins, protocols, links, and source dependence, not merely a fitted curve or calendar date.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了前沿AI定量预测所依赖的公开测量记录，构建了一个截至2026年8月12日的冻结事件记录（62个系统、12个版本化基准、144个分级事件、408个类型化关系），发现训练算力数据缺失严重（27个封闭系统中19个缺失），基准衔接存在断裂，且来源高度集中（73.2%的实质性定量事件来自单一测量项目）。结论是可辩护的日期化预测应是对版本化测量系统的声明，而非简单的拟合曲线。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI的定量预测常常将日期目标与基准分数、训练算力、发布时间或专家信念的趋势联系起来，但公开测量记录是否真正支持这些联系尚未经过严格审计。本文旨在检验这些预测所依赖的测量基础是否可靠。
AI.method: 构建一个冻结的、以事件为中心的审计样本记录，包含62个精选系统、12个版本化基准、七项能力或影响标准、144个分级事件、27个来源记录和408个类型化关系。采用逻辑与概率链接函数分析基准衔接，并系统回顾56个方法学和经验来源以识别互补测量方向。
AI.result: 关键发现包括：(1) 只有7个系统同时观测到训练算力估计和METR 50%任务时间跨度；(2) 19/27的封闭系统缺乏训练算力数据，所有2026年封闭系统均缺失；(3) METR 1.0到1.1的对数斜率桥接为1.206，而MMLU到MMLU-Pro的桥接仅在特定链接下呈现移位特征；(4) 观测桥接对25%斜率偏差仅有约80%的统计功效；(5) 来源高度集中，73.2%来自单一测量项目，76.1%为实验室发布。
AI.conclusion: 结论不是前沿AI预测不可能，而是可辩护的日期化预测必须明确描述其所依赖的版本化测量系统，包括显式连接、协议、链接和来源依赖性。没有任何单一补充指标能替代当前标量指标，因此预测者需要更审慎地说明其测量基础。

title: A Cognitively Motivated Multidimensional Framework for Evaluating Metaphor Explanations
comment: Preprint of paper accepted at INLG 2026
summary: Current evaluation of metaphor explanations relies mainly on holistic quality ratings, revealing little about how explanation quality is structured or where human judgments agree and diverge. We introduce a cognitively motivated framework that decomposes metaphor explanation quality into six theoretically grounded dimensions. In a dense annotation study (11,200 ratings), we find that: {\bfseries(i)} explanation quality is genuinely multidimensional; {\bfseries(ii)} annotator disagreement is systematic rather than random; and {\bfseries(iii)} the six dimensions collapse into a shared cluster and two independent axes of judgment. An exploratory feasibility study further shows that a standard automatic evaluation pipeline can recover parts of this structure, predicting the most discriminative dimensions well while its errors correlate human (dis)agreement. Together, these results suggest that multidimensional evaluation offers richer diagnostic insight than holistic ratings, and that automatic evaluators for open-ended generation tasks should be judged on how well they preserve the structure of human judgment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个认知驱动的六维度隐喻解释质量评估框架，通过密集标注研究（11,200个评分）发现解释质量是多维的、标注者分歧是系统性的，且六维度可聚为一个共享簇和两个独立判断轴。可行性研究显示标准自动评估流水线能部分恢复该结构。结果表明多维评估比整体评分提供更丰富的诊断信息。
AI.motivation: 当前对隐喻解释的评估主要依赖整体质量评分，无法揭示解释质量的结构性特征，也无法理解人类判断的一致性与分歧所在。
AI.method: 提出六个理论驱动的隐喻解释质量维度框架，进行11,200条评分的密集标注研究，并开展探索性可行性研究以验证标准自动评估流水线能否恢复人工判断的结构。
AI.result: 研究发现：（i）解释质量本质上是多维的；（ii）标注者分歧是系统性的而非随机的；（iii）六个维度可归结为一个共享簇和两个独立判断轴。自动评估流水线能较好预测最具区分力的维度，其错误与人类（不）一致相关。
AI.conclusion: 多维评估比整体评分提供更丰富的诊断性洞察；开放生成任务的自动评估器应以保留人类判断结构的程度来评判其质量。

title: MODAL: Multi-Modal Object Re-ID via Model-Driven Sparse Decoupling and Text-Image Differential Filtering
summary: Multi-modal object re-identification (Re-ID) aims to facilitate cross-camera object retrieval in complex environments by leveraging complementary information from visual (e.g., RGB, NIR, TIR) and textual modalities. However, existing approaches often lack principled feature disentanglement and coherent multi-modal integration, leading to entangled representations that introduce cross-modal conflicts, obscure discriminative cues, and suffer distribution shift under modality-missing conditions. To tackle these challenges, we propose MODAL, a novel multi-modal object re-identification framework, grounded in coupled sparse coding theory and differential suppression principles. A core component of MODAL is a Multi-modal Feature Sparse Decoupling module, developed in a model-driven deep unrolling manner based on multi-modal coupled sparse coding. It explicitly decomposes multi-modal features into uni-modal specific, bi-modal and tri-modal shared representations, thereby achieving more transparent and effective feature disentanglement. Benefiting from the principled feature disentanglement, MODAL naturally mitigates performance degradation in incomplete-modality scenarios via a Modality-Aware Subspace Activation that selectively activates only the consistently shared subspaces. Moreover, we propose a Text-Image Differential Filtering module that leverages coarse-grained textual semantics to adaptively suppress task-irrelevant responses in the decoupled visual representations, thereby enhancing discriminative information. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that MODAL achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior transparency.

AI.tldr: 提出MODAL框架，基于耦合稀疏编码和差分抑制原理，实现多模态物体重识别的特征解耦与整合，在四个数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法缺乏原则性的特征解耦和连贯的多模态整合，导致表征纠缠、跨模态冲突、判别线索模糊，且在模态缺失情况下存在分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 1) 多模态特征稀疏解耦模块：基于多模态耦合稀疏编码，采用模型驱动的深度展开方式，将特征显式分解为单模态特定、双模态和三元模态共享表示；2) 模态感知子空间激活：在模态缺失时仅激活一致的共享子空间以缓解性能退化；3) 文本-图像差分过滤模块：利用粗粒度文本语义自适应抑制视觉表示中的任务无关响应。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的大量实验表明，MODAL取得了最先进的性能，并具有优越的透明性。
AI.conclusion: 基于原则性特征解耦的多模态整合方法能够有效缓解跨模态冲突和模态缺失问题，同时保持表征的透明性和可解释性。

title: Is Grokking a Loss of Normal Hyperbolicity of the Interpolation Manifold?
summary: A recent line of work recasts the post-memorization phase of grokking as constrained optimization: once a network interpolates the training set, weight decay drives a slow drift along the zero-loss manifold toward lower norm. In the language of dynamical systems, this is a fast-slow system in which the interpolation manifold plays the role of a slow manifold. We ask a question that this framing makes natural but the existing literature does not address: is the sharp generalization transition a loss of normal hyperbolicity of that manifold: a fold- or bifurcation-like event in which a normal restoring direction goes flat? Or does the manifold stay uniformly attracting while generalization happens by smooth drift? We propose a simple, optimizer-agnostic diagnostic: the smallest nonzero singular value $σ_{\min}^{+}(\mathbf J)$ of the residual Jacobian, which, for the squared loss, equals the slowest normal restoring rate of the manifold. On a two-layer ReLU network trained to grok modular addition under squared loss, $σ_{\min}^{+}(\mathbf J)$ does not collapse at the transition; it is near zero only before memorization and attains its largest values during the transition. The result holds across five seeds, and the six smallest singular values behave identically; there is no subspace-local collapse either. This is preliminary evidence against the bifurcation hypothesis and in favor of the smooth-contraction picture. We are explicit that a single-setting, gradual-transition experiment under Adam optimizer does not prove the absence of a bifurcation; it constrains where one could hide.

AI.tldr: 本文研究grokking现象中突发的泛化转变是否源于动力系统中的"法向双曲性丧失"（分岔/折叠事件），还是源于沿着零损失流形的平滑漂移。作者提出一个与优化器无关的诊断指标——残差Jacobian的最小非零奇异值σ_min⁺(J)，并在两层ReLU网络模加法的grokking实验中证明该值在转变期不塌缩，初步证据支持平滑收缩图景而非分岔假说。
AI.motivation: 先前工作将grokking的记忆后阶段建模为约束优化：网络插值训练集后，权重衰减驱动沿零损失流形向低范数缓慢漂移。这是一个快慢系统，插值流形扮演慢流形角色。自然的问题是：尖锐的泛化转变是否意味着该流形失去法向双曲性（法向恢复方向变平），还是流形保持均匀吸引而泛化通过平滑漂移发生？现有文献未回答此问题。
AI.method: 提出一个简单且优化器无关的诊断指标：残差Jacobian的最小非零奇异值σ_min⁺(J)，对平方损失而言它等于流形最慢的法向恢复速率。在两层层ReLU网络上用平方损失训练grok模块化加法任务，测量该指标在训练全程（尤其是记忆后到泛化转变阶段）的变化，并跨5个随机种子验证，同时检查前六个最小奇异值是否出现子空间局部塌缩。
AI.result: σ_min⁺(J)在泛化转变时并未塌缩；它仅在记忆化之前接近零，并在转变期间达到最大值。该结果在5个种子上一致成立，且六个最小奇异值行为完全相同，不存在子空间局部塌缩。
AI.conclusion: 初步证据反对分岔假说，支持平滑收缩图景。作者明确承认单一设定、Adam优化器下的渐变实验并不能证明分岔不存在，只是约束了分岔可能隐藏的位置。

title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures; includes appendices and ancillary aggregate-result CSV files
summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can improve reasoning by spending more computation, but deployment requires deciding when extra collaboration is worth its cost. We isolate this decision by running every problem under four protocols while holding the solver fixed within each setting: direct solving (Baseline), iterative self-correction (Single), planner-executor-reviewer collaboration (PER), and multi-agent deliberation (Broadcast). The primary benchmark comprises 4,181 competition-level math problems; paired robustness checks cover four benchmarks spanning competition math, biology, and broader science with two solver families. Across fixed policies, trained routers, and frozen LLM routers, conservative policies under-escalate, whereas higher-solve frozen routers often over-escalate. A post-answer, pre-collaboration gpt-oss-120b probe ranks Baseline failures with 0.8847 AUROC (4,151 parseable cases; 95% CI [0.8732, 0.8955]). The same score remains informative for predicting whether any collaboration helps (0.7683 AUPRC), but is much weaker for identifying PER- or Broadcast-specific value (0.1674 and 0.1041 AUPRC). Separately, the pre-answer self-confidence gate reaches 78.0% solve at 45K tokens, compared with 73.8% at 71.3K for a frozen gpt-oss-120b router and 92.4% for a retrospective fixed-order oracle. Across 10 paired model-condition settings, the oracle adds 23.2-58.3 points of retrospective coverage over Baseline, but protocol profiles vary by task. In the six settings with held-out router evaluations, oracle gaps remain 18.5-28.9 points. Confidence can therefore support initial escalation, while protocol-specific cost-aware routing remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多智能体LLM系统中"何时值得额外协作"的决策问题。通过固定求解器，在四个协议（直接求解、迭代自修正、规划者-执行者-评审者协作、多智能体审议）下对4,181道竞赛数学题及四个基准进行测试。发现保守策略升级不足，高求解率的冻结路由器则过度升级。一个基于gpt-oss-120b的事后打分器能以0.8847 AUROC预测基线失败，但对识别特定协议价值较弱。事前置信度门控在45K token时达到78.0%求解率，优于冻结路由器（73.8%@71.3K），但距回溯性全知Oracle（92.4%）仍有较大差距。结论是置信度可支持初步升级决策，但协议特定的成本感知路由仍有待解决。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统能通过增加计算量提升推理能力，但部署时需要判断何时额外协作值得付出成本。现有工作缺乏对该决策问题的系统隔离研究——即在求解器固定的前提下，究竟该在什么条件下启动协作过程。
AI.method: 在固定求解器的前提下，对每个问题在四种协议下运行：直接求解（基线）、迭代自修正（单智能体）、规划者-执行者-评审者协作（PER）、多智能体审议（Broadcast）。主基准为4,181道竞赛数学题，配以四个跨竞赛数学、生物学和更广泛科学的基准和两个求解器家族。评估涵盖固定策略、训练路由器、冻结LLM路由器，以及基于gpt-oss-120b的事后打分器（AUROC/AUPRC）和事前置信度门控。
AI.result: 事后gpt-oss-120b探针以0.8847 AUROC（95% CI [0.8732, 0.8955]）预测基线失败；对"任何协作是否有帮助"预测为0.7683 AUPRC，但对PER或Broadcast特定价值预测仅0.1674和0.1041 AUPRC。事前置信度门控在45K token时达到78.0%求解率，优于冻结路由器的73.8%（71.3K token），远低于Oracle的92.4%。在10个配对模型-条件设置中，Oracle比基线多出23.2-58.3个百分点覆盖；在6个有验证的设置中，Oracle差距仍为18.5-28.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 置信度信号可用于支持初始升级（从基线升级到协作）的决策，但协议特定的成本感知路由问题尚待解决——即无法有效预测哪种具体协作协议（PER还是Broadcast）能带来增量价值。事后探查能识别失败案例，但对协议选择的价值识别不足，说明需要更好的路由信号或更细粒度的价值估计方法。

title: MicroVerse: An Instrument for Measuring Self-Authored Identity Drift in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Language-Model Simulations
summary: Long-horizon, multi-agent language model (LM) simulations are widely proposed for studying social behavior, yet instruments to measure whether persona-conditioned agents maintain identity fidelity under sustained pressure are lacking. We present MicroVerse, a behavioral-science instrument that measures identity drift in generative agents. Agents carry an immutable "soul file" (core values, moral boundaries, personality, goals) and inhabit a resource-scarce 50 x 50 environment where water is a non-respawning survival constraint. Scarcity is operationalized via a per-tick existence-cost gradient. The eight-verb action space maps directly to moral boundaries (trade, talk, attack, scavenge). Using a three-layer memory architecture, agents periodically revise a mutable current identity against their immutable original soul via importance-triggered reflection. To mitigate survivor bias, MicroVerse decouples measurement from behavior using uniform longitudinal engine snapshots every N ticks alongside a forced-end snapshot of all living and dead agents. Identity drift is scored offline using a paraphrase-aware, value-anchored, multi-register diff rather than raw cosine similarity. We evaluate the instrument via a controlled seed run (n = 25) and a reflection-threshold sweep (thresholds {40, 80, 150}) to determine if drift dynamics are gate artifacts or threshold-robust properties. We report two primary findings: (1) Anti-self-deception emerges unprompted as the single largest semantic category of identity modification (27 of 111 added boundaries, 24%). (2) The system is threshold-robust; lower gates accelerate and increase revision frequency but preserve drift direction. All empirical results are strictly preliminary existence proofs and effect shapes (one model, one seed per arm, n = 25) rather than statistical significance claims.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MicroVerse，一个用于测量生成式智能体身份漂移的行为科学工具。智能体携带不可变的"灵魂文件"，在资源稀缺的50×50环境中生存。作者通过三层记忆架构和重要性触发的反思机制，结合离线语义差异评分，量化身份漂移。初步实验（n=25）发现反自我欺骗是最主要的身份修改类别（24%），且系统对反思阈值具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 长视野、多智能体LM模拟被广泛用于研究社会行为，但缺乏衡量人格条件化智能体在持续压力下保持身份保真度的工具。现有方法无法有效测量身份漂移现象。
AI.method: MicroVerse包含四个核心设计：(1)不可变的"灵魂文件"记录核心价值、道德边界、人格和目标；(2)资源稀缺环境（水为非再生约束，逐tick存在成本梯度）；(3)八动词动作空间映射到道德边界；(4)三层记忆架构中，智能体通过重要性触发的反思，周期性修订可变当前身份。身份漂移使用释义感知、价值锚定的多语域diff离线评分，而非原始余弦相似度。测量与行为解耦，通过统一的纵向引擎快照和强制结束快照缓解幸存者偏差。
AI.result: 两项主要发现：(1)反自我欺骗（anti-self-deception）自发涌现，成为身份修改的最大语义类别（111条新增边界中占27条，24%）；(2)系统对反思阈值具有鲁棒性——较低阈值会加速并增加修订频率，但保持漂移方向不变。所有结果为初步存在性证明和效应形状，而非统计显著性声明。
AI.conclusion: MicroVerse提供了首个专门用于测量生成式智能体身份漂移的行为科学仪器。初步结果表明身份漂移是阈值鲁棒的系统属性而非门控伪影，且反自我欺骗行为可能是一个值得深入研究的自发涌现现象。

title: ProjFormer: Point Cloud Completion via Geometric-Projective Transformer and Cross-Modal Semantic Constraints
comment: Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026. 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables
summary: Point cloud completion is inherently ill-posed due to severe sparsity and ambiguity in partial observations. Existing multi-view methods alleviate this by incorporating 2D semantics, but often rely on learned attention and fixed fusion, which lack geometric consistency and adaptability. We propose ProjFormer, a cross-modal framework that enforces geometry-consistent 2D-3D interaction through explicit projection and adaptive feature routing. A Projective Guided View Attention module aligns 3D points with multi-view features via deterministic projection, enabling efficient and geometrically consistent aggregation. Building on this, a geometry-aware routing network performs point-wise adaptive fusion of structural and observation-driven features for progressive refinement. Experiments show that, under a lightweight design, ProjFormer delivers competitive performance with improved structural completeness.

AI.tldr: 提出ProjFormer，一种通过显式投影和自适应特征路由实现几何一致的2D-3D交互的跨模态点云补全框架。
AI.motivation: 点云补全因部分观测的稀疏性和模糊性而具有不适定性；现有多视图方法虽引入2D语义，但依赖学习式注意力与固定融合，缺乏几何一致性和适应性。
AI.method: 提出ProjFormer框架：(1) 投影引导视图注意力模块通过确定性投影对齐3D点与多视图特征，实现高效且几何一致的聚合；(2) 几何感知路由网络执行逐点自适应融合，结合结构特征与观测驱动特征进行渐进式细化。
AI.result: 在轻量设计下，ProjFormer在结构完整性上取得改进，性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式投影与自适应路由，ProjFormer在不依赖复杂注意力机制的情况下，有效增强了点云补全的结构完整性与跨模态一致性。

title: Disentangling Homophily and Rarity: Explaining Failure in Graph Neural Networks
comment: 9 pages of main text, 33 pages total, 11 figures, 17 tables
summary: Are heterophilic nodes in a graph harder to classify because they are heterophilic or because they are rare? Some existing work frames classification of such nodes as a subgroup generalisation problem, where a model performs well on the majority group at the expense of the rare group. Others explain this as a problem of neighbourhood aggregation in graph neural networks (GNNs). We assess these two viewpoints through a detailed evaluation of six GNNs on five datasets of varying homophily, and find that homophilic nodes tend to be easier to classify, even when they are rare---challenging the subgroup framing. However, our findings also nuance existing beliefs about how GNNs misrepresent heterophilic nodes. We demonstrate that the information needed to classify heterophilic nodes correctly is often recoverable by retraining the classification head of a model, or even just the final linear classification layer.

AI.tldr: 本文通过评估六种GNN在五个不同同质性数据集上的表现，发现异嗜性节点难以分类的根本原因不是它们作为稀有子群（亚组泛化问题）导致的，而是同嗜性节点即使稀有也更容易分类。此外，研究发现GNN并未真正丢失异嗜性节点的分类信息——只需重新训练分类头或最后一层线性分类层即可恢复正确分类。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对异嗜性节点分类困难的原因存在两种竞争性解释：(1)亚组泛化视角——模型对多数群组表现好而牺牲稀有群组；(2)GNN邻域聚合视角——消息传递机制导致异嗜性节点表示失真。作者旨在通过系统性评估厘清这两种观点何者更符合实证。
AI.method: 对六种GNN模型在五个具有不同同质性水平的数据集上进行详细评估，通过比较同嗜性节点与异嗜性节点在不同稀有度条件下的分类表现，来检验亚组泛化框架；并通过重训练分类头或仅重训练最终线性分类层的方式，检验GNN表示中是否仍包含可用于正确分类异嗜性节点的信息。
AI.result: (1) 同嗜性节点即使在稀有情况下也更容易分类，挑战了亚组泛化框架对异嗜性节点困难的解释；(2) 通过重训练分类头或仅重训练最终线性层即可恢复异嗜性节点的正确分类，说明GNN深层表示中仍保留了必要的信息，与"GNN彻底错误表示异嗜性节点"的既有观点不一致。
AI.conclusion: 异嗜性节点分类困难既不能完全归因于稀有性（亚组泛化），也不意味着GNN的邻域聚合完全丢失了相关信息。问题可能更多出现在分类层而非表示学习阶段，这为改进异嗜性节点分类提供了更精确的干预方向。

title: Small Models Scout Bottleneck Order for Large-Model Data Control
summary: Small proxy models are commonly used to identify data mixtures for larger-scale training. We ask whether their training trajectories reveal another transferable structure: the order in which larger models should resolve skill bottlenecks. We formulate first-passage skill training, where each monitored skill has a target floor and the objective is to minimize the tokens required to reach all floors. We introduce LogFloor, a closed-loop controller that directs each round toward current bottlenecks, producing phase-ordered resolution trajectories. Across five bAbI skill slices on Qwen2.5-1.5B, LogFloor reduces token cost by 56.2% on average. In 70M-to-12B transfer, three-round replay of a 70M scout path reaches every floor in all eight target runs, saving 30.9% by pair mean, 39.4% in pooled training tokens, and 37.6% under source-cost accounting. On MMLU-control, a frozen scout path succeeds across all eight 12B runs. Collapsing a path to its static marginal mixture or reversing its phase order removes most benefits, while bottleneck labels alone remain partially useful. These results identify phase-ordered bottleneck resolution as a transferable curriculum structure for monitored skill-targeted training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首达技能训练(first-passage skill training)框架，并引入LogFloor闭环控制器，利用小型代理模型的训练轨迹预测大模型应解决技能瓶颈的顺序。实验表明该方法在bAbI任务上平均降低56.2%的token成本，在70M到12B的规模迁移中平均节省30.9%的训练token。
AI.motivation: 现有工作通常利用小模型识别数据混合比例，但忽略了训练轨迹中可能蕴含的另一种可迁移结构——大模型应按照何种顺序解决技能瓶颈。作者希望挖掘并利用这种阶段有序的瓶颈解决顺序。
AI.method: 1) 形式化首达技能训练问题：每个受监控技能有目标下限，目标是最小化达到所有下限所需的token数。2) 提出LogFloor闭环控制器，每轮将训练导向当前瓶颈技能，产生阶段有序的解决轨迹。3) 使用70M小型代理模型的学习路径，将三回合轨迹重放到12B模型上实现规模迁移。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B的五个bAbI技能切片上，LogFloor平均减少56.2%的token成本。在70M到12B迁移中，三回合重放70M侦察路径在所有八个目标运行中达到所有技能下限，平均节省30.9%训练token（池化节省39.4%）。将路径压缩为静态边际混合或反转阶段顺序会消除大部分收益，而仅使用瓶颈标签仍有部分效用。
AI.conclusion: 阶段有序的瓶颈解决顺序是一种可迁移的课程结构，可应用于受监控的目标技能训练。这揭示了大模型训练中技能瓶颈的时序特征，以及小模型轨迹迁移的价值。

title: When Less Is Enough: Context Selection and Prompting Strategies for Bengali News Headline Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in text generation tasks, yet their effectiveness on headline generation remains sensitive to how input context is selected and presented. In this work, we investigate Bengali news headline generation as a document-level generation task that requires effective selection and presentation of salient contextual information from long-form articles. Using Gemini-2.0-Flash, Llama-3.3-70B, and GPT-4o, we systematically study the effects of context selection, prompting strategies, and in-context learning (i.e., few-shot) on the quality of headline generation. Our experiments show that providing the full article does not necessarily improve performance; instead, using selected lead paragraphs of the article can maintain, and in some cases improve, headline generation quality. We further compare Bengali Native Prompting (BNaP) and Cross-Lingual Prompting (XLP), and examine how each interacts with context-enriched prompt templates incorporating auxiliary contextual cues. Results demonstrate that prompting strategies substantially influence generation quality: XLP often yields stronger performance, particularly when combined with contextual enrichment, but its benefits are model-dependent. Additionally, few-shot prompting substantially improves Gemini, with most of the gain obtained from a single demonstration, whereas Llama shows limited benefit from additional examples. Overall, our findings highlight that effective Bengali news headline generation depends more on context relevance and prompt design than on increasing input length, offering practical insights for multilingual and low-resource LLM applications.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了孟加拉语新闻标题生成任务，探讨了上下文选择、提示策略和少样本学习对生成质量的影响。研究发现完整文章并非最优输入，精选导语段落效果更好；跨语言提示（XLP）通常优于孟加拉语原生提示（BNaP）；少样本提示对Gemini提升显著但对Llama帮助有限，说明上下文相关性和提示设计比输入长度更重要。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在标题生成任务上的效果高度依赖于输入上下文的选择和呈现方式，但针对孟加拉语等低资源语言的系统研究尚不充分。本文旨在探索如何通过优化上下文选择和提示策略来提升孟加拉语新闻标题生成的效率和质量，为多语言和低资源场景下的LLM应用提供实践指导。
AI.method: 使用Gemini-2.0-Flash、Llama-3.3-70B和GPT-4o三种模型，系统性地研究三个维度：(1) 上下文选择（完整文章 vs. 选定导语段落）；(2) 提示策略（孟加拉语原生提示BNaP vs. 跨语言提示XLP，以及结合辅助上下文线索的提示模板）；(3) 少样本学习（few-shot）的影响。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：完整文章并不一定提升标题生成质量，精选导语段落可维持甚至提升性能；XLP通常优于BNaP，尤其在结合上下文增强时，但优势因模型而异；少样本提示大幅提升Gemini性能（单个示例即获得大部分收益），而Llama从额外示例中获益有限。
AI.conclusion: 孟加拉语新闻标题生成的有效性更多取决于上下文相关性和提示设计，而非输入长度。这为多语言和低资源场景下的LLM应用提供了重要的实践洞察。

title: CETalk: Continuous Valence-Arousal Control for Audio-Driven 3D Talking Head Generation
summary: Emotional 3D talking head generation aims to synthesize expressive facial animations with accurate lip synchronization. However, existing methods often rely on discrete emotion categories, which fail to capture the continuous evolution of affect. They also overlook the temporal frequency mismatch between audio articulation and emotional expression. In this paper, we propose CETalk, an audio-driven 3D facial animation framework conditioned on continuous Valence--Arousal (VA) representations for fine-grained emotion control. CETalk predicts a sequence of FLAME parameters through three key components: a Dynamic Emotion Modulation Module that adaptively scales emotional intensity using audio-derived cues; a Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling mechanism that employs parallel branches to decouple high-frequency articulatory movements from low-frequency emotional dynamics; and a Dynamic Fusion Mechanism that integrates these multi-scale features via an adaptive gating network. To support training and evaluation, we construct 3D-VA-MEAD, a large-scale dataset with automatically estimated VA annotations and reconstructed 3D facial motions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CETalk outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both lip-sync accuracy and emotional expressiveness, while enabling smooth and controllable emotion transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CETalk，一种基于连续Valence-Arousal（VA）表示的情感3D说话人头生成框架，通过动态情感调制模块、多尺度时间建模和动态融合机制，解耦高频发音运动与低频情感动态，并在自构建的3D-VA-MEAD数据集上超越现有方法，实现了更精细的情感控制和更自然的唇音同步。
AI.motivation: 现有情感3D说话头生成方法存在两大缺陷：一是依赖离散情感类别，无法捕捉情感的连续演化；二是忽略了音频发音与情感表达之间的时间频率不匹配问题（发音是高频的，而情感表达是低频的）。
AI.method: CETalk包含三个关键组件：1）动态情感调制模块，利用音频线索自适应调节情感强度；2）多尺度时间建模机制，通过并行分支解耦高频发音运动与低频情感动态；3）动态融合机制，通过自适应门控网络整合多尺度特征。同时构建了3D-VA-MEAD数据集，包含自动估计的VA标注和重建的3D面部运动。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CETalk在唇音同步准确性和情感表现力两方面均优于现有最先进方法，并能实现平滑可控的情感过渡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了连续VA表示相比离散情感类别在3D说话头生成中的优越性，同时证明了将音频发音与情感表达按时间频率解耦处理的有效性，为情感驱动的面部动画生成提供了新思路。

title: M-LINKX: Multiview Graph Learning for Brain Cognitive Disease Detection
comment: Accepted at the 25th IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026). 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Electroencephalogram (EEG) is a non-invasive and relatively low-cost procedure that measures brain electricity for the detection of cognitive diseases. EEG-based classification of dementia-related conditions, including Alzheimer's disease (AD), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and frontotemporal dementia (FTD), remains challenging because EEG signals are noisy, non-stationary, and vary across subjects. Segment-based learning provides a practical way to model long EEG recordings by converting them into fixed-length inputs. For each segment, discriminative information may be explored by using signals within each channel (i.e. electrode), as well as interactions between EEG channels. In this paper, we propose M-LINKX, a multi-view graph learning framework for EEG-based dementia classification. For each segment, we extract channel-level node features and construct multiple functional-connectivity (FC) graph views, where each view is defined by a specific combination of connectivity metric, frequency band, and topology filter, respectively. Instead of relying on message passing over the constructed graphs, M-LINKX follows a simple design in modeling node features and adjacency-based connectivity representations. The graph-view representations are fused using global trainable view weights, and subject-level prediction is obtained by averaging segment-level probabilities. Experiments on two three-class EEG datasets with different diagnostic groups, CAUEEG (HC/MCI/Dementia) and AHEAP (HC/AD/FTD), show that M-LINKX achieves the best subject-level performance under the main experimental settings. Our study suggests that multi-view functional connectivity can improve EEG-based dementia classification when integrated with an appropriate graph-learning architecture. Code and data are available at https://github.com/anphantt/MLINKX.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M-LINKX，一种基于多视图图学习的EEG痴呆症分类框架。它将长EEG信号分割为固定长度片段，为每个片段提取通道级节点特征并构建多种功能连接图视图，通过全局可训练权重融合图视图表示，最后对片段级概率取平均得到受试者级预测。在两个三分类EEG数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: EEG信号具有噪声大、非平稳、跨受试者差异大的特点，基于EEG的痴呆症分类（包括AD、MCI、FTD）仍具挑战性。现有的基于分段的学习方法虽能建模长EEG记录，但片段内的判别信息（包括通道内信号和通道间交互）尚未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: M-LINKX框架包含以下核心设计：(1) 对每个EEG片段提取通道级节点特征；(2) 构建多个功能连接图视图，每个视图由连接度量、频带和拓扑滤波器的特定组合定义；(3) 采用简单设计同时建模节点特征和邻接矩阵表示的连接信息，而非依赖图上的消息传递机制；(4) 使用全局可训练的视图权重融合多视图表示；(5) 通过对片段级概率取平均获得受试者级预测。
AI.result: 在两个三分类EEG数据集（CAUEEG: HC/MCI/Dementia 和 AHEAP: HC/AD/FTD）的实验中，M-LINKX在主要实验设置下取得了最优的受试者级分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，多视图功能连接与合适的图学习架构相结合，可以有效提升基于EEG的痴呆症分类性能。代码和数据已公开提供。

title: When Is an Agent Evaluation Over? Outcome Finality and Cross-Unit Separation
summary: Current agent evaluations score models on the state visible at the end of a stopped run which they count as one trial. However, interpreting the score as a final result would require two conditions that the endpoint does not itself necessarily establish: outcome finality and cross-unit separation. These conditions are independent, since reconciling a delayed outcome can settle the label while runs still share state and isolating runs can prevent carryover while the scored outcome remains unfinished. We develop a completion argument that specifies the evidence needed for each decision and argue that a final label is justified only when anything that could still change the claimed outcome is resolved, bounded, or retained as uncertainty. First, in a controlled replay to demonstrate the mechanism where an agent's actions were held fixed, we find that the endpoint and terminal labels differ for every delayed operation, while a delayed write changes the next run's score when service state persists between runs but not after isolation or verified reset. Second, in a review of ten public protocols, we find that all protocols identify when a run stops and what is scored, while unfinished operations and the evidence for treating runs as separate trials are documented less consistently. Finally, we propose an open-effects record that lists operations or resources that may remain relevant after the endpoint, their current status, and whether they could change the scored outcome or affect another run.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前智能体评估仅基于停止运行结束时的状态得分，但将其解释为最终结果需要满足结果最终性和跨单元隔离两个独立条件。作者提出"完成论证"框架，通过受控重放实验和十项公开协议的审查，发现终点标签与终止标签在延迟操作上存在差异，且协议对未完成操作和运行隔离证据的记录不一致。最后提出开放效应记录（open-effects record）来跟踪可能影响评分或其他运行的操作和资源。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体评估将运行结束时的状态得分视为单次试验的最终结果，但这一解释隐含了两个未必成立的条件：结果最终性（结果是否已完成）和跨单元隔离（运行之间是否相互独立）。这两个条件相互独立，延迟结果可能继续改变标签，而运行间共享状态可能导致结果串扰。作者希望明确何时可以为最终标签提供合理证据。
AI.method: 首先通过受控重放实验，固定智能体动作，比较终点标签和终止标签在延迟操作上的差异，并测试服务状态持久化对下一轮得分的影响（隔离或重置前后的对比）。其次，回顾十个公开协议，评估它们对运行停止时机、评分对象、未完成操作及运行隔离证据的记录情况。最后提出开放效应记录（open-effects record）作为改进方案。
AI.result: 受控重放实验发现：每一次延迟操作的终点标签与终止标签均不同；延迟写入在服务状态持久化时改变下一轮得分，但隔离或验证重置后不再影响。十项公开协议审查发现：所有协议都明确了运行停止时机和评分对象，但对未完成操作以及运行被视为独立试验的证据记录不一致。
AI.conclusion: 仅有当任何可能改变所声称结果的因素被解决、限定边界或保留为不确定性时，最终标签才应被合理赋予。作者提议采用开放效应记录来系统化此类证据，提高智能体评估的可靠性和可解释性。

title: PLSQLBench: Benchmarking LLM Systems for Executable Procedural Database Programming
summary: We present PLSQLBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can write executable PL/SQL programs, with correctness measured through execution-based tests. Existing LLM evaluations largely target general-purpose code generation or declarative text-to-SQL, leaving procedural database programming underexplored. PLSQLBench contains 2,865 instances: 2,594 single-turn tasks and 271 multi-turn conversations spanning 978 turns. The benchmark combines complex schema-grounded tasks over enterprise-style Spider 2 databases, simpler schema-grounded tasks derived from Spider, and MBPP-derived procedural problems, covering varying levels of database grounding and procedural complexity. Experiments with eight LLMs reveal recurring difficulties in schema grounding, PL/SQL dialect fidelity, procedural control flow, exception handling, and cross-turn consistency. Tool-augmented LLM agents improve performance on several schema-grounded evaluations, although substantial gaps remain. These results highlight procedural database programming capabilities not directly assessed by conventional code generation or text-to-SQL benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/oracle-samples/plsqlbench.

AI.tldr: PLSQLBench是首个用于评估LLM能否编写可执行PL/SQL程序的基准测试，包含2,865个实例（2,594个单轮任务和271个多轮对话共978轮），覆盖企业级Spider 2数据库、Spider衍生的简单任务以及MBPP衍生的过程性编程问题。实验发现LLM在模式接地、PL/SQL方言保真度、过程控制流、异常处理和跨轮一致性方面存在持续性困难。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM评估主要针对通用代码生成或声明式text-to-SQL，缺乏对过程性数据库编程（PL/SQL）的评估，需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建PLSQLBench基准，包含多层次的模式接地任务（企业级Spider 2、简化Spider、MBPP过程性问题），通过执行测试衡量正确性，并对8个LLM进行实验评估，同时测试工具增强的LLM代理。
AI.result: 8个LLM在基准上表现出系统性困难，包括模式接地、PL/SQL方言保真度、过程控制流、异常处理和跨轮一致性；工具增强的LLM代理在多个模式接地评估中有所提升，但仍有显著差距。
AI.conclusion: PL/SQL过程性数据库编程能力无法被传统代码生成或text-to-SQL基准直接评估，该领域仍需进一步研究和改进。

title: Fast Test-Time Refinement for Robust Learned Image Compression
summary: Learned image compression (LIC) has demonstrated remarkable rate-distortion (RD) performance in benign settings. However, the high representational capacity endowed by deep neural networks (DNNs) comes at the expense of increased adversarial vulnerability. This hinders their adoption as trusted standardized codecs. Recent work has sketched test-time refinement (TTR) as a defense in gray-box scenarios, despite its original purpose of improving benign RD performance. Unfortunately, extensive iterations of TTR incur prohibitive overhead, while the robustness mechanism lacks theoretical understanding. Moreover, TTR has not been evaluated in white-box settings or against attacks beyond $\ell_2$-bounded rate and untargeted distortion objectives. To bridge these gaps, we present a systematic study. Our study reveals an Asymmetric Adversarial Trajectory (AAT) property in LIC systems: transitioning from adversarial to benign regions is significantly easier than the reverse process, where adversarial examples can often be roughly recovered within only 1-2 steps. We provide a two-dimensional Tube Model to explain this phenomenon. Based on AAT, we propose a Fast Test-Time Refinement (FTTR) framework for practical and robust LIC systems. We establish that the robustness arises from the contraction of adversarial regions induced by the Input-as-Label property of LIC systems, rather than from obfuscated gradients. Extensive evaluations with diverse strong adaptive attacks across multiple LIC systems demonstrate the promise of the proposed FTTR framework. The code is available at https://github.com/chinaliangjiaming/FTTR.git.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了学习图像压缩（LIC）系统的对抗鲁棒性问题，发现非对称对抗轨迹（AAT）性质：从对抗区域到良性区域的迁移远比反向过程容易。基于此提出快速测试时精炼（FTTR）框架，用1-2步即可防御对抗攻击，并通过Tube Model解释其机理。
