AI.motivation: LIC虽然在正常场景下率失真性能优异，但深度神经网络的强表达能力带来更高的对抗脆弱性，阻碍其作为可信标准化编解码器的应用。现有测试时精炼（TTR）防御虽被提及但存在迭代开销大、缺乏理论理解、未评估白盒场景及其他攻击类型等问题。
AI.method: 揭示LIC系统中非对称对抗轨迹（AAT）性质；提出二维Tube Model解释该现象；基于AAT提出快速测试时精炼（FTTR）框架，利用Input-as-Label属性实现快速收敛的对抗防御。
AI.result: AT显示从对抗到良性区域约1-2步即可恢复；FTTR在多种强自适应攻击和多类LIC系统上取得鲁棒性能，且证明鲁棒性源于对抗区域的收缩而非梯度混淆。
AI.conclusion: FTTR为实际部署的稳健LIC系统提供了高效且可解释的防御方案，填补了TTR在理论理解与白盒评估方面的空白。

title: Can Neural Networks Learn by Experimenting on Themselves? Self-Interventional Learning from Functional Consequences to Predictive Self-Knowledge
comment: 37 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research (JMLR)
summary: Machine-learning systems usually model external data, while their internal functional organization is analyzed by external observers. This work introduces Self-Interventional Learning (SIL), in which a neural system perturbs its own functional structure, observes consequences, learns a predictive self-model, generalizes to unexecuted interventions, and uses predictions to guide later structural action. In a construction-known synthetic system, SIL recovered critical structure, redundancy, and replaceability, while synergy was not reliably recovered. Across 30 fresh confirmatory seeds, increasing the pairwise intervention budget from 4 to 56 reduced held-out prediction error from 0.0335 to 0.0148 and increased Spearman correlation from 0.629 to 0.883. In a matched ablation, preserving the correct intervention--consequence mapping reduced prospective prediction error by 81.3%, while using the same learned self-model for action reduced normalized regret by 31.7% relative to ignoring it. However, model-guided action did not significantly outperform a direct empirical-memory policy, and powered CIFAR-10/ResNet validation showed no robustness advantage over equal-budget direct repair search. These results support SIL as an intervention-driven framework for learning predictive knowledge about a network's own functional organization, while showing that the self-model remains incomplete and is not universally superior to simpler direct strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自干预学习（SIL）框架，让神经网络主动扰动自身功能结构、观察后果并学习预测性自模型，进而指导后续结构操作。实验表明SIL能恢复关键结构信息，但在综合效应恢复和对抗直接策略方面存在局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习系统只建模外部数据，其内部功能组织通常由外部观察者分析，缺乏系统自我理解自身功能结构的机制，因此需要引入一种让网络自身学习自模型的框架。
AI.method: SIL框架通过四个步骤运作：扰动自身功能结构、观察干预后果、学习预测性自模型（概括到未执行的干预）、利用预测指导后续结构性行动。在合成系统、消融实验和CIFAR-10/ResNet上进行了验证。
AI.result: 在已知构成的合成系统中，SIL成功恢复关键结构、冗余性和可替换性，但无法可靠恢复协同效应。30个确认种子的实验中，干预预算从4增至56时，预测误差从0.0335降至0.0148，Spearman相关从0.629升至0.883。正确映射保留使前瞻预测误差减少81.3%，模型引导行动使归一化遗憾减少31.7%。但模型引导行动未显著优于直接经验记忆策略，CIFAR-10/ResNet验证无鲁棒性优势。
AI.conclusion: SIL可作为基于干预驱动框架学习网络自身功能组织的预测性知识，但自模型仍不完整，并非在所有场景下都优于更简单的直接策略。

title: Skill Blocks: How Should an Agent Load Its Skill? A Caching-Correct Comparison of Pre-load, On-Demand Tool-Loading, Progressive Disclosure, and Hybrid
summary: Agent skills are often injected in full on every request, increasing token cost. We compare four content-preserving loading methods: Full, Skill Block, Reference, and Hybrid. Across SearchQA, SpreadsheetBench, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SynthProc, we measure token usage using raw input for single-turn tasks and cache-correct effective input for multi-turn tasks. Results show no universal winner. Hybrid reduces input by 27.4% on SearchQA and 39.8% on SpreadsheetBench. On large multi-turn skills, Skill Block and Hybrid achieve substantial reductions, reaching 62.5% and 52.8% on ScienceWorld and 73.0% and 66.6% on SynthProc. ALFWorld shows smaller gains because procedures are short and repeatedly needed. Paired outcome tests detect no quality differences, though they do not establish equivalence. Overall, conditional loading is most beneficial when large portions of a skill are not needed on every turn.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了四种内容保留的Agent技能加载方法（Full、Skill Block、Reference、Hybrid）在五个任务上的token使用效率。结果表明没有万能最优方法：Hybrid在SearchQA和SpreadsheetBench上分别减少27.4%和39.8%的输入量；在大型多轮技能任务中，Skill Block和Hybrid在ScienceWorld和SynthProc上分别实现62.5%/52.8%和73.0%/66.6%的减少；ALFWorld因流程短且频繁使用而收益较小。结果测试未发现质量差异，但未建立等价性。
AI.motivation: Agent技能通常在每次请求时全部注入，导致token成本高昂。本文旨在探索更高效的内容保留方案，在维持技能质量的同时降低token开销。
AI.method: 提出并比较四种内容保留的加载方法：Full（完整加载）、Skill Block（按技能块加载）、Reference（引用式加载）和Hybrid（混合方法）。针对单轮任务使用原始输入测量token用量，多轮任务则使用考虑缓存的校正有效输入测量。
AI.result: 五种基准任务（SearchQA、SpreadsheetBench、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、SynthProc）上无单一方法全面获胜。Hybrid在SearchQA和SpreadsheetBench分别减少27.4%和39.8%；大技能多轮任务中Skill Block和Hybrid分别最高减少73.0%和66.6%；ALFWorld因流程短、重复需求高而收益有限。配对结果测试未检出质量差异，但不足以证明等价性。
AI.conclusion: 条件加载（conditional loading）在技能中大部分内容并非每轮都需要时最为受益。该研究揭示了不同任务特性下各加载方法的适用性，为Agent技能部署的token效率优化提供了实践指导。

title: Token Distribution versus Data Volume: Domain Balancing in Multi-Domain Meeting Summarisation
comment: Accepted at 19th International Natural Language Generation Conference (INLG 2026), Utrecht, Netherlands
summary: Jointly fine-tuning an LLM on meeting-summarisation corpora of widely varying size raises a question that prior work leaves confounded: when a domain-balanced training mixture helps, is the gain due to the distribution of tokens across domains, or merely to the volume of data seen? We disentangle these factors by constructing balanced and natural (native-proportional) token mixtures at matched token budgets (2-32M) over five English meeting corpora, fine-tuning Mistral-7B with QLoRA, and evaluating per domain. Balancing redistributes quality, improving the data-scarce minority domains at a low cost to the data-rich ones. The trade favours balancing whenever the minority domains matter: their share under proportional allocation is fixed at 1-2% regardless of budget, so matching balanced quality on those domains requires far more total data. We further find that pruning low-value transcript lines removes ~15% of tokens from the conversational corpora at no measurable cost, and that balancing by tokens is not the same as balancing by examples. A two-annotator study of 741 judge-labelled facts validates our fact-level evaluation. Together these results give practitioners a basis for deciding when to balance an imbalanced multi-domain mixture, and on what unit.

AI.tldr: 该论文解耦了多领域LLM微调中"领域平衡数据混合"带来的增益究竟源于数据分布还是单纯的数据量，通过在匹配的token预算下构建平衡与自然比例混合数据集，证明了平衡混合主要惠及数据稀缺的少数领域，且当少数领域重要时平衡策略更优。此外还发现剔除低价值转录行可节省约15%token而不损失性能，并验证了按token平衡与按样本平衡是不同的。
AI.motivation: 先前关于领域平衡训练混合的工作混淆了两个因素：增益到底来自跨领域token的分布，还是仅仅来自总数据量？该问题没有得到明确解答，导致实践者无法判断何时应该平衡一个不平衡的多领域混合数据集。
AI.method: 在五个英语会议语料库上，于匹配的token预算（2-32M）下构建平衡混合与自然（原生比例）混合，使用QLoRA对Mistral-7B进行微调，并按领域评估。同时进行低价值转录行剪枝实验，以及两标注者的741个事实级标注研究来验证事实级评估。
AI.result: 平衡混合重新分配了质量：显著改善数据稀缺的少数领域，仅对数据丰富领域造成低成本损失。在按比例分配下，少数领域份额固定为1-2%，无论预算如何，要匹配平衡质量需要更多总数据。剪枝低价值转录行可移除约15%的token且无可测损失。按token平衡与按样本平衡并不等同。
AI.conclusion: 为实践者在决定是否平衡不平衡的多领域混合数据集、以及以何种单位平衡时提供了依据。当少数领域重要时，平衡是更优策略。

title: Perspective-Invariant Attack with Enhanced Transferability of Adversarial Examples
summary: Adversarial examples generated on a surrogate deep neural network (DNN) can often successfully fool other black-box DNN models. This cross-model transferability poses serious security threats to DNNs in practical applications. Input transformation techniques are widely used to enhance adversarial transferability by increasing the diversity of input images. However, existing methods primarily rely on local operations with limited degrees of freedom (DOF), such as block-wise shuffling and resizing, overlooking global perspective transformations that naturally arise from viewpoint changes. In this work, we propose a Perspective-Invariant Attack (PIA), which introduces a multi-DOF vertex sampling strategy that systematically covers the perspective transformation hierarchy from 2-DOF translation to 8-DOF projective mapping. By generating geometrically diverse input variations, PIA effectively reduces overfitting of adversarial perturbations to the surrogate model, thereby improving adversarial transferability. We further propose PIA-Mix, a generic extension that maintains a complementary transformation pool and efficiently combines our perspective transformation with auxiliary methods for improved transferability. Extensive experiments involving various DNN architectures, advanced defense mechanisms, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) demonstrate that PIA and PIA-Mix outperform state-of-the-art transfer-based attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于透视变换的对抗攻击方法PIA及其扩展PIA-Mix，通过多自由度顶点采样策略生成几何多样的输入变化，有效提升黑盒对抗样本的跨模型迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有输入变换方法主要依赖局部操作（如块级打乱和缩放），自由度有限，忽视了由视角变化自然产生的全局透视变换，限制了对抗迁移性的提升。
AI.method: 提出PIA（Perspective-Invariant Attack），采用多自由度顶点采样策略，系统覆盖从2-DOF平移到8-DOF投影映射的透视变换层次；并提出PIA-Mix，维护互补变换池，将透视变换与辅助方法高效结合。
AI.result: 在多种DNN架构、先进防御机制以及多模态大语言模型上的大量实验表明，PIA和PIA-Mix在性能上超越了现有的最先进迁移攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入全局透视变换来增加输入多样性，能够有效减少对抗扰动对替代模型的过拟合，从而显著提升黑盒场景下的对抗迁移性。

title: Degeneracy Counting Quantum Algorithm using Decoherence
summary: Counting the global optima of a classical optimization problem is a #P-hard task. We develop the canonical thermal pure quantum (CTPQ) state-based degeneracy counting (CTPQsd#) algorithm that determines the number of global optima of a classical optimization problem P by measuring only a small probe S, without finding individual minima. The method exploits a perturbative relation between the decoherence measure of S and the degeneracy of P when S and P are together in a CTPQ state. We provide the first numerical demonstration that this relation can be used to count the global minima, applying it to problems encoded by diagonal random-energy Hamiltonians as a maximally unstructured testbed for classical binary optimization problems. Classical simulations of up to 20 problem qubits quantify the algorithm's sensitivity to variations in the temperature of the CTPQ state, the Hamiltonian energy range, the problem size, and degeneracy. We establish the temperature threshold for determining the exact degeneracy and identify a second, lower threshold that provides a temperature window to count near-degenerate minima within a user-defined energy tolerance. By confining measurement to S, the protocol replaces tomography over the exponentially large problem Hilbert space with tomography over a small probe represented by only four qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CTPQsd#算法，利用规范热纯量子（CTPQ）态与探针系统，通过仅测量一个四比特小探针S的退相干量来计数经典优化问题的全局最优解数量（#P难问题），无需逐一寻找最小值。数值实验（最多20个问题比特）验证了该方法在随机能量哈密顿量编码下的有效性，并确定了温度阈值窗口。
AI.motivation: 经典优化问题的全局最优解计数是一个#P难任务，现有方法通常需要找到所有独立最小值，计算代价随问题规模指数增长。作者希望开发一种不依赖于寻找个体最小值、而是通过测量一个小探针就能直接确定全局最优解数量的算法，从而规避对指数大的问题希尔伯特空间进行完整层析的巨大开销。
AI.method: 该方法的核心是利用问题系统P与小探针S共同处于CTPQ态时，S的退相干度量与P的简并度之间存在微扰关系。通过将经典优化问题编码为对角随机能量哈密顿量，仅测量四比特探针S即可提取退相干信息，从而推算P的全局最优解数量。数值模拟覆盖最多20个问题比特，考察温度、能量范围、问题规模和简并度对算法灵敏度的影响。
AI.result: 经典模拟（最多20个问题比特）量化了算法对CTPQ态温度、哈密顿量能量范围、问题规模和简并度变化的敏感性。建立了确定精确简并度的温度阈值，并发现第二个更低的阈值，提供了在用户定义能量容差内计数近简并最小值的温度窗口。仅需四比特探针测量即可替代对指数大问题空间的完整层析。
AI.conclusion: CTPQsd#算法首次从数值上证明了通过微扰退相干关系计数全局最优解是可行的，该方法将指数规模的层析任务压缩为对小探针的四比特测量，为#, 难计数问题提供了一种新的量子计算路径，并明确了适用的温度参数范围。

title: Trust Is Not Enough: Influence Calibration for On-Policy Self-Distillation in Agentic RL
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) gives language agents dense token-level supervision from a privileged self-teacher on the policy's own trajectories. Existing methods allocate this supervision mainly by teacher trust, but trust does not reveal whether emphasizing a token supports the current policy objective. We call this the trust-utility mismatch and introduce Influence Calibration for Self-Distillation (ICSD). For each supervised token, ICSD measures the first-order response of its importance-weighted RL surrogate contribution to a teacher-directed output perturbation. Batch-adaptive calibration converts this non-stationary signal into a bounded allocation weight while preserving the original auxiliary-loss mass within each action turn. These detached weights affect only the distillation loss and require no additional model pass. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA, ICSD improves all matched aggregate metrics over trust-only allocation under Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), across two model families spanning 1.5B to 7B. At 7B, it reaches 96.1% ALFWorld success and a WebShop score of 93.1. Frozen-batch analyses show that ICSD reduces teacher-supported mass assigned to objective-opposed tokens from 60.1% to 37.8% and raises cosine compatibility with the RL gradient by 0.192. A companion repository is avail- able at https://github.com/lanqz7766/Influence-Calibration-for-On-Policy-Self-Distillation-in-Agentic-RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Influence Calibration for Self-Distillation (ICSD)方法，解决on-policy自蒸馏中"信任-效用不匹配"问题——即仅依据教师信任度分配监督权重无法反映token对当前策略目标的实际贡献。ICSD通过测量每个token的RL代理损失对教师方向扰动的首要响应，并结合批自适应校准来分配权重，在不增加模型前向计算的前提下提升蒸馏效果。在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA上均优于纯信任分配方案。
AI.motivation: 现有的on-policy自蒸馏方法主要依据教师信任度来分配token级监督，但信任度并不能揭示强调某个token是否真正支持当前策略目标（策略优化方向）。这种"信任-效用不匹配"会导致蒸馏损失与RL目标不一致，从而限制学习效果。
AI.method: ICSD对每个受监督token，测量其重要性加权RL代理贡献对教师方向输出扰动的首要响应（first-order response）；然后通过批自适应校准将该非平稳信号转化为有界分配权重，同时保持每个动作回合内的原始辅助损失总质量不变。这些解耦权重仅影响蒸馏损失，无需额外模型前向计算。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA上，ICSD在所有匹配的聚合指标上均优于纯信任分配，适用于GRPO和GiGPO两种策略优化方法，覆盖1.5B到7B两个模型家族的实验。7B规模下达到ALFWorld成功率96.1%、WebShop得分93.1。冻结批次分析显示，ICSD将目标相反token上的教师支持质量分配从60.1%降至37.8%，与RL梯度的余弦兼容性提升0.192。
AI.conclusion: ICSD通过将蒸馏监督分配从"信任导向"转向"效用导向"，有效缓解了信任-效用不匹配问题，显著提升了language agent在多种环境和规模下的RL表现，证明蒸馏权重应反映token对当前策略目标的实际贡献而非仅依赖教师信任。

title: Aborted but Not Forgotten: KV-Cache Retention Breaks Rollback Consistency in Language Agents
summary: Stateful language agents assume a rejected branch can be taken back by clearing it from the application transcript. We show this breaks when the serving session retains key/value (KV) state across the logical abort: the model can continue attending to content the application believes it discarded. We formalize the missing guarantee as rollback consistency: a complete abort must restore the state the model attends, not just the transcript. The key failure is cross-layer: a correct logical rollback need not compose with retained inference state, and the gap can remain invisible to the application. To isolate cache effects from text effects, we introduce a same-token/different-cache audit that holds decision-step tokens identical while varying only whether the cached prefix is stale or rebuilt from committed state. Across seven open-weight families (3.8B-36B), retained KV alone flips a typed protected effect in 25 of 63 audited cells, while attacker tokens are absent from the served request in all 63; rebuilding the cache closes every cell. The channel reproduces in an end-to-end session application, on the default Hugging Face Transformers cache-reuse path, and under LangGraph time-travel, where verified logical rollback can still leave attended KV stale. Susceptibility varies across models, but the underlying attended-state integrity violation is structural. We rule out position and length confounds, generalize across protected effects, policy structures, and a cache-isolated Mixture-of-Experts model, and show that transaction-local cache restoration closes the channel without requiring a global cache flush. All headline results are deterministic and reproducible from released artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了状态化语言代理中的一个安全漏洞：当应用层逻辑上回滚（abort）一个分支时，服务端会话仍保留key/value (KV) 缓存状态，导致模型可以继续"看到"应用认为已丢弃的内容。作者将其形式化为"回滚一致性"（rollback consistency）保证，并证明跨层问题：逻辑回滚正确不代表推理状态也正确。通过同token/不同缓存的审计方法，在7个开源模型家族中，63个被审计单元中有25个因保留的KV缓存导致受保护效果被翻转，而攻击者token在所有63个案例中都不在服务请求中；重建缓存则完全关闭该通道。
AI.motivation: 现有状态化语言代理框架（如LangGraph）允许逻辑回滚分支，但只清除应用层转录（transcript），未考虑服务端会话保留的KV推理状态。这导致模型实际注意力状态与应用层认知不一致，形成隐蔽的安全漏洞——恶意内容可能看似被移除，实则仍在影响模型输出。该问题跨层存在，应用层无法察觉，亟需形式化并量化该风险。
AI.method: 作者：(1) 形式化定义"回滚一致性"——完整的中止必须恢复模型注意力所依赖的状态；(2) 引入"同token/不同缓存"审计方法，保持决策步骤token完全一致，仅变化缓存前缀是过期的（stale）还是从已提交状态重建的（rebuilt），以隔离缓存效应与文本效应；(3) 在7个开源模型家族（3.8B-36B）上进行系统性审计，并扩展至端到端会话应用、Hugging Face Transformers默认缓存复用路径及LangGraph time-travel场景。
AI.result: 保留的KV缓存单独即可在63个被审计单元中的25个翻转受保护效果（typed protected effect），且所有63个案例中攻击者token均不在服务请求中；重建缓存可关闭所有案例的通道。该漏洞在端到端会话应用、默认HF缓存复用路径及LangGraph time-travel（已验证逻辑回滚正确的场景）中均可复现。不同模型易感性不同，但潜在的结构性问题是普遍的。作者排除了位置和长度混淆因素，并验证了事务局部缓存恢复（transaction-local cache restoration）即可关闭通道，无需全局缓存刷新。所有主要结果具有确定性且可复现。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑层面的回滚一致性不足以保证推理状态的安全性——这是一个结构性、跨层的完整性漏洞。安全的语言代理中止语义必须同时考虑KV缓存的物理状态恢复，而非仅关注转录清理。事务局部缓存重建提供了可行的修复路径，无需牺牲全局缓存性能。该工作为状态化代理的安全回滚语义建立了理论基础和实证基线。

title: HOIMask: Towards Generative Masked Modeling for Human Object Interaction Generation
summary: Diffusion-based methods have dominated the HOI generation, as they enable critical contact fusions or signals to guide the diffusion process. However, they often result in high artifacts and unstable interaction quality due to error accumulation during iterative denoising. In this work, we propose HOIMask, the first generative masked framework for modeling HOI motion in discrete space. HOIMask first encodes both motion sequences and contact-aware signals into discrete 2D human and object token maps via HOI Vector Quantization (VQ), preserving fine-grained spatial-temporal structure beyond conventional 1D representations. On this basis, a generative masked modeling framework is employed to jointly capture human-object interaction dynamics, leveraging a transformer architecture designed to model complex spatial-temporal and interaction dependencies. To generate more coherent and physically plausible motions, we further introduce a novel contact-aware reconstruction guidance in discrete space during inference, which fuses contact signals to optimize HOI tokens that forces the generated motion with higher spatio-temporal consistency. With craftily designed motion interaction tokens, dedicated architecture and guidance strategy, HOIMask outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods, generating more realistic and semantically aligned HOI motions. Please refer to https://jyhflash.github.io/HOIMask/ for more results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HOIMask，这是首个在离散空间中进行人体-物体交互（HOI）运动生成的生成式掩码建模框架。它通过HOI向量量化将运动序列和接触信号编码为离散的2D token图，并利用Transformer架构联合建模交互动力学，同时引入离散空间中的接触感知重建引导，以生成更连贯、物理上更合理的HOI运动，优于现有的扩散方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散式HOI生成方法虽然能引入关键接触融合信号来引导扩散过程，但在迭代去噪过程中存在误差累积，导致大量伪影和不稳定的交互质量。作者旨在克服扩散方法的这一根本缺陷，探索一种新的生成范式。
AI.method: 1) 提出HOI向量量化（Vector Quantization），将运动序列和接触感知信号编码为离散的2D人体和物体token图，保留细粒度的时空结构（优于传统1D表示）；2) 采用生成式掩码建模（Masked Modeling）框架联合捕获人体-物体交互动力学，配合Transformer架构建模复杂的时空与交互依赖关系；3) 在推理阶段引入新颖的接触感知重建引导（接触感知优化HOI token），在离散空间中融合接触信号，迫使生成运动具有更高的时空一致性。
AI.result: HOIMask在生成更真实、语义对齐的HOI运动方面优于最先进的基于扩散的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的运动交互token、专用架构和引导策略，HOIMask证明了离散空间中的生成式掩码建模是HOI运动生成的一种更鲁棒、更高质量的替代方案，有效克服了扩散方法的误差累积问题。

title: PathFinder: Joint Decompositions of Linked Multimodal Datasets
summary: Low-rank matrix decompositions can uncover patterns and structure in data and have a number of different applications across many disciplines. Extensions to "joint" low-rank decompositions have been proposed to link datasets from different modalities. While these methods enable the discovery of common patterns across modalities, they require that all the multimodal data share one or more dimensions. We propose a new analysis method, PathFinder, that enables co-analysis of datasets that do not necessarily all share a dimension. The key insight is that as long as pairs or subgroups of matrices do share some dimension, and that there are one or more paths that link across the data matrices, a global joint decomposition can be sought out. This enables the joint estimation of common patterns across different modalities, species, or scales, where a one-to-one mapping across all data along some dimension is not necessarily available. We show that PathFinder is a general umbrella under which many matrix decomposition methods fall as special cases. It can be used to discover common patterns across disparate datasets and to make predictions for missing data or modalities.

AI.tldr: PathFinder是一种新的联合低秩矩阵分解方法，通过路径链接的方式实现不完全共享维度数据的联合分析，能够发现跨模态、物种或尺度的共同模式，并可作为多种现有矩阵分解方法的统一框架。
AI.motivation: 现有的联合低秩分解方法要求所有多模态数据在至少一个维度上完全共享，这限制了其应用范围。实际中许多数据集（如不同物种、不同尺度的数据）并不完全共享维度，需要新的方法来实现这类数据的联合分析。
AI.method: PathFinder的核心思想是：只要数据矩阵的某个子集或某些对之间存在共享维度，并且通过一条或多条路径将这些矩阵链接起来，就可以寻求全局联合分解。这使得不需要所有数据都共享某一维度即可进行联合估计。
AI.result: PathFinder被证明是一个通用框架，许多现有的矩阵分解方法都可以视为其特例。它可以用于发现不同数据集之间的共同模式，并对缺失数据或模态进行预测。
AI.conclusion: PathFinder扩展了联合低秩分解的适用范围，允许在不完全共享维度的数据集之间进行联合分析，为多模态、多种类的数据整合提供了新的可能性。

title: RETRACE: Resilience-Guided Trait-Conditioned Craving Estimation from Wearable Physiology in Opioid Use Disorder
summary: Detecting opioid craving from wearable physiological signals is critical yet difficult, with the potential to support proactive interventions for individuals with opioid use disorder (OUD). This challenge is especially pronounced under subject-independent evaluation because craving is subjective, heterogeneous, and often physiologically entangled with stress. Our empirical analysis shows that stress elicits strong and reproducible autonomic responses, while craving-related signals are weaker, sparse, and largely embedded within stress-related physiology. We further show that psychological resilience, which shapes stress regulation and craving vulnerability, is not reliably observable from short-term wearable windows, but can be captured through reusable subject-level proxies, including post-stress heart-rate recovery and autobiographical memory recall.Motivated by these findings, we introduce RETRACE, a resilience-guided trait-conditioned framework for subject-independent craving estimation from wearable physiology. RETRACE reframes craving detection as trait-conditioned physiological interpretation: rather than assuming the same physiological pattern has the same meaning across individuals, it uses resilience-related subject context to guide inference. Technically, RETRACE introduces a novel dual-encoder design that separates generalizable stress physiology from subject-specific craving interpretation. It combines a frozen stress-pretrained encoder with a resilience-conditioned craving encoder, using feature-level gating and representation-level fusion to enable lightweight personalization without target-user craving labels or per-user retraining. We evaluate RETRACE on a novel multimodal OUD dataset containing wearable physiology, stress and craving annotations, and autobiographical narratives. Under LOSO setup, RETRACE achieves up to 7% absolute improvement over the strongest baseline

AI.tldr: 本文提出RETRACE框架，用于从可穿戴生理信号中检测阿片类药物渴求。核心发现是：渴求信号弱且与应激生理纠缠，而心理韧性可通过可复用的个体级代理（如应激后心率恢复、自传体记忆回忆）捕获。RETRACE采用双编码器设计，分离通用应激生理与个体特定渴求解释，实现无需目标用户渴求标签的轻量个性化。
AI.motivation: 从可穿戴生理信号检测阿片类药物渴求对主动干预至关重要，但在被试独立评估下极为困难，因为渴求具有主观性、异质性和与应激的生理纠缠。现有方法忽视了个体差异对生理信号解读的影响。
AI.method: RETRACE是一种韧性引导的特质条件化框架。采用双编码器架构：一个冻结的应激预训练编码器处理通用应激生理，一个韧性条件化渴求编码器处理个体特定解读。通过特征级门控和表示级融合实现轻量个性化，无需目标用户渴求标签或逐用户重训练。个体级代理包括应激后心率恢复和自传体记忆回忆。
AI.result: 在包含可穿戴生理、应激和渴求标注及自传体叙事的新型多模态OUD数据集上，在留一被试出（LOSO）设置下，RETRACE相比最强基线实现了最高7%的绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明渴求检测应被重构为特质条件化的生理解读任务，将可复用的个体级韧性代理融入模型设计，可以在被试独立场景下显著提升渴求检测性能。

title: The Null Token Knows: Reducing Message-Free Hallucination in ASR and NMT
comment: Submitted to the Thirty-Ninth AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-27)
summary: Modern encoder-decoder systems can produce fluent text even when their input contains no recoverable message. We study this failure in ASR and NMT through the models' reserved null tokens, asking whether the score for ending generation already carries a usable abstention signal. Across speech recognizers and translation models, we audit native null-token scores and scalar logit shifts. In Whisper, we additionally probe decoder states and compare supervised row edits with conventional external gates. The evaluated models often expose a useful abstention signal, but stock decoding does not reliably act on it. Raising the null-token score can sharply suppress fabrication, but aggressive intervention also deletes valid speech or shortens legitimate translations. These findings turn the null token into a diagnostic lens on hallucination and motivate evaluating abstention methods by both suppression and deletion costs, rather than by hallucination reduction alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究现代编码器-解码器系统在输入无可恢复信息时仍能生成流畅文本的失败模式（幻觉）。作者通过分析ASR和NMT模型中保留的null token得分，验证其是否可作为可用的弃权（abstention）信号。研究发现模型通常暴露有用的弃权信号，但标准解码并未可靠利用它；提高null token得分可抑制捏造，但过度干预会删除有效语音或缩短合法翻译。因此，作者提出将null token作为诊断幻觉的透镜，并建议评估弃权方法时应同时考虑抑制能力和删除代价。
AI.motivation: 现代编码器-解码器系统在输入无可恢复消息时仍能生成流畅但虚假的文本（幻觉现象），这在ASR和NMT中尤为严重。作者希望找到一种既有的、无需额外训练的弃权信号来检测和抑制这种失败，而非依赖外部门控等复杂方法。
AI.method: 作者利用模型中的保留null token，审计原生null token得分和标量logit位移作为弃权信号。在Whisper中进一步探测解码器状态，并将监督式行编辑与常规外部门控进行比较。通过操纵null token得分来观察对捏造抑制和合法内容保留的影响。
AI.result: 评测的模型通常展现出有用的弃权信号，但标准解码过程并未可靠地利用该信号。提高null token得分可以显著抑制幻觉/捏造，但激进的干预会误删有效语音或缩短合法翻译片段，存在抑制与删除之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: null token可作为诊断幻觉的重要透镜。评估弃权方法时应同时考量抑制（hallucination reduction）和删除（deletion）两类代价，而非仅以幻觉减少作为唯一指标。这一发现为未来弃权方法的设计与评估提供了新方向。

title: A Unified Backbone--Expert Framework with Relation-Token and Residual--Classifier Interfaces for Automatic Modulation Recognition
summary: Automatic modulation recognition (AMR) faces distinct representation bottlenecks under varying observation lengths, where a single model architecture often fails to excel. To address this, we propose a unified backbone-expert framework with a common convolutional state-space backbone and two specialized interfaces. For short sequences, we inject explicit lag-aware complex-plane descriptors as relation tokens before encoding to compensate for information loss. For long sequences, we design a gated multi-scale residual refinement module to correct the feature map, combined with a fixed-averaging classifier collaboration to harness complementary evidence. Our framework achieves overall average accuracies of 67.28 \pm 0.14% on RML2016.10b and 87.19 \pm 0.77% on HisarMod2019 (mean \pm sample standard deviation over three runs), respectively. The framework's efficacy is further validated through three-seed ablations, native-length cross-configuration tests, and controlled window studies, confirming the benefit of expert-interface decoupling over one-size-fits-all architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的骨干-专家（backbone-expert）框架，用于自动调制识别（AMR），以解决不同观测长度下单一模型架构难以同时表现出色的问题。框架使用共同的卷积状态空间骨干网络和两个专门接口：短序列通过注入显式的滞后感知复平面描述符作为关系标记来补偿信息损失；长序列则通过门控多尺度残差精炼模块修正特征图，并结合固定平均分类器协作利用互补证据。在RML2016.10b和HisarMod2019上分别达到67.28±0.14%和87.19±0.77%的平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 自动调制识别在不同观测长度下面临不同的表征瓶颈，单一模型架构往往无法在短序列和长序列场景下同时取得优异表现，因此需要一种能适应长度变化的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出统一的骨干-专家框架，包含一个普通的卷积状态空间骨干网络和两个专门接口：(1) 对短序列，在编码前注入显式的滞后感知复平面描述符作为关系标记以补偿信息损失；(2) 对长序列，设计门控多尺度残差精炼模块修正特征图，并结合固定平均分类器协作利用互补证据。
AI.result: 在RML2016.10b上达到67.28±0.14%的平均准确率，在HisarMod2019上达到87.19±0.77%（三次运行的均值±样本标准差）。通过三种子消融实验、原生长度交叉配置测试和受控窗口研究进一步验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果确认了专家接口解耦优于一刀切（one-size-fits-all）的单一架构方案，证明了针对不同观测长度设计专门接口的价值。

title: LLM-based Framework for Generating and Verifying Parallel DEVS Statecharts
summary: The development of models demands sound modeling and simulation knowledge as well as domain knowledge. Every model should accurately represent a system's dynamics and be verifiable. Toward this objective, this research introduces an agentic PDEVS-LLM framework to assist human modelers in generating and verifying PDEVS statecharts for behavior modeling of atomic Parallel Discrete Event System Specification (PDEVS) models. The framework supports (re)generating plausible facts from a system description prompt using the agentic LLM used for generating plausible facts. Inconsistencies in plausible facts lead to incorrect PDEVS statecharts having logical structure and behavioral inaccuracies. A controlled-correction mechanism is developed to verify the logical consistency of the plausible facts. The agentic LLM is used to generate key behavioral conditions from the system description prompt. The plausible facts are then verified against the behavioral conditions using propositional logic entailment for a finite number of times. The verification results enable the generation of modification prompts that can reduce errors in generated plausible facts, resulting in more accurate PDEVS statecharts. To verify a statechart's logical correctness, its Timed Automata counterpart is manually created and verified for deadlock and reachability properties. The human modeler may regenerate plausible facts and PDEVS statecharts iteratively and incrementally. A basic correctness metric is introduced to quantify the completeness and accuracy of the expected behavioral traits of the PDEVS statechart models. A collection of example systems with varying levels of complexity is developed to demonstrate the capabilities and limitations of LLMs. The evaluation of the proposed verification mechanism shows a substantial improvement in the logical consistency of generated statecharts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个agentic PDEVS-LLM框架，利用LLM辅助人类建模者生成和验证PDEVS状态图，通过受控校正机制验证事实的逻辑一致性，并引入正确性度量来量化模型行为特征的完整性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 模型开发需要扎实的建模与仿真知识以及领域知识，每个模型都应准确表示系统动态且可验证。然而，LLM生成的plausible facts中的不一致会导致PDEVS状态图出现逻辑结构和行为上的不准确，因此需要一种机制来验证和校正这些生成内容。
AI.method: 提出agentic PDEVS-LLM框架：(1)使用agentic LLM从系统描述提示中生成plausible facts；(2)开发受控校正机制验证plausible facts的逻辑一致性，通过LLM生成关键行为条件，并使用命题逻辑蕴含对plausible facts进行有限次验证；(3)基于验证结果生成修改提示以减少错误；(4)手动创建状态图的Timed Automata对应物并验证死锁和可达性属性；(5)引入基本正确性度量量化PDEVS状态图的行为特征完整性和准确性；(6)支持人类建模者迭代和增量式地重新生成plausible facts和PDEVS状态图。
AI.result: 通过一系列不同复杂度的示例系统验证了该框架的效能，评估表明所提出的验证机制显著提高了生成状态图的逻辑一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了LLM在辅助建模中的潜力，通过受控验证和修正机制有效提升了PDEVS状态图生成的准确性，但也揭示了LLM在不同复杂度系统中的能力和局限性。

title: T-LLM Compiler: Trusted LLM-based Code Optimization and Verification Framework
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have opened opportunities to apply high-level code transformations to the field of code optimization, and it has since emerged as one of the most fundamental tasks for LLMs to perform; however, at present, LLMs struggle to apply wide-ranging code optimization tasks due to both the complexity of the code and the inability to independently verify the correctness of the transformations. In this paper, we present the Trusted LLM (T-LLM) Compiler, which proposes an advancement in compiler technology through a collaborative effort involving high-level LLM code transformations, traditional compilers, and verification tools. Experimental results reveal that it can significantly improve code correctness when tested on a set of PolyBench/C benchmarks. Our approach facilitates iterative code optimization efforts with verification strategies that enable corrective actions. Through this approach, T-LLM Compiler achieves code optimization accuracy of up to 83.3% and a speedup of up to 16.1\% on the PolyBench/C benchmarks, with the transformed code reaching an average of 26.7% speedup wrt standard baselines. Additionally, we release the project's source code to the open-source community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了T-LLM编译器，通过结合大语言模型（LLM）的高层代码变换、传统编译器和验证工具，实现可信的代码优化。在PolyBench/C基准测试上，该方法实现了高达83.3%的代码优化正确率和16.1%的加速比，平均加速达26.7%。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在代码优化领域展现出潜力，但LLM难以执行广泛的代码优化任务，主要原因在于代码本身的复杂性以及无法独立验证代码变换的正确性。现有方法缺乏可靠的验证机制来确保LLM生成的变换是正确的。
AI.method: T-LLM编译器采用协作框架，整合三个关键组件：1）LLM负责高层代码变换；2）传统编译器执行底层优化；3）验证工具确保变换的正确性。该框架支持迭代优化，并通过验证策略实现纠正性措施，使优化过程能够不断自我修正。
AI.result: 在PolyBench/C基准测试上，T-LLM编译器实现了高达83.3%的代码优化正确率和16.1%的加速比，变换后的代码相对于标准基线平均达到26.7%的加速效果。同时，项目源代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: T-LLM编译器证明了将LLM高层变换与传统编译器及形式化验证工具相结合，可以有效提升代码优化的正确性和性能，为LLM在编译器技术中的可信应用提供了可行路径，并促进了开源社区的协作发展。

title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression
comment: COLM 2026, Third Conference on Language Modeling
summary: Long-context reasoning remains computationally expensive for large language models due to the quadratic complexity of attention over text tokens. Visual-text compression offers a promising alternative by rendering text into images and processing them with vision-language models, often reducing token usage. However, existing approaches apply uniform compression regardless of query relevance, potentially sacrificing precision where detailed extraction is required. We present SEER, a framework that learns to select query-relevant images through visual scanning and retrieve textual content only where needed, combining the efficiency of visual compression with the precision of text-based reasoning. Through supervised fine-tuning on tool-interaction trajectories, SEER learns adaptive tool invocation for selection and retrieval. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that SEER improves extraction precision through selective text retrieval while retaining average prompt-token savings relative to full-text baselines. On LongBench, SEER achieves 51.11% average accuracy, outperforming the visual-text baseline Glyph-9B by 2.33 points and Qwen3-8B by 3.49 points. Code can be accessed at https://github.com/jiaweixu98/SEER

AI.tldr: SEER是一个框架，通过学习选择与查询相关的图像并进行视觉扫描，仅在有需要的地方检索文本内容，结合视觉压缩的效率和基于文本推理的精确性，在长上下文基准上优于现有视觉文本基线。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理对大型语言模型计算成本高昂，注意力机制对文本token具有二次复杂度。现有的视觉-文本压缩方法采用统一压缩，不考虑查询相关性，在需要详细提取的场景下可能牺牲精度。
AI.method: SEER框架通过视觉扫描学习选择与查询相关的图像，并仅按需检索文本内容。使用工具交互轨迹进行监督微调，学习自适应工具调用以进行选择和检索。
AI.result: 在LongBench上，SEER达到51.11%的平均准确率，比视觉文本基线Glyph-9B高出2.33个百分点，比Qwen3-8B高出3.49个百分点，同时保留平均提示token节省。
AI.conclusion: SEER通过选择性文本检索提升了提取精度，同时保留了视觉压缩带来的token节省优势，验证了自适应查询相关压缩的有效性。

title: From "What-If" to "What-Is": Counterfactual Thinking-Inspired Semantic Alignment for Visual Brain Decoding
summary: Visual brain decoding reconstructs visual content perceived by a person from neural measurements such as fMRI, providing a computational approach to studying how visual information is represented in the brain. Recent multimodal representations and diffusion priors have improved reconstruction realism. However, visually plausible reconstructions may contain incorrect objects, attributes, or relations because a strong generative prior can complete content not sufficiently specified by the decoded representation. Conventional reconstruction metrics mainly assess the final image and may therefore obscure such semantic errors. We propose ConceptAlign, a counterfactual semantic alignment framework for visual brain decoding. ConceptAlign pools decoded visual tokens and projects them into a frozen text-embedding space, aligning the representation with the ground-truth caption while separating it from scene-preserving near-miss alternatives. Generated offline by an LLM, these alternatives modify one critical object, attribute, or relation while retaining the scene. A margin-based objective learns fine-grained semantic boundaries between the observed stimulus and plausible but incorrect interpretations without requiring LLM calls during inference. We introduce a systematic three-level semantic evaluation framework covering foundational discriminability, counterfactual description discrimination, and representational geometry. Experiments on the Natural Scenes Dataset show that ConceptAlign improves reconstruction measures, counterfactual semantic discrimination, and representational alignment over the MindEye2 backbone. Matched negative-source ablations, independent LLM and human-written alternatives, and human evaluation support the effectiveness and robustness of the supervision, with favorable patterns in fine-grained conflicts, limited-data decoding, and cross-subject structure.

AI.tldr: 提出ConceptAlign，一个用于视觉脑解码的反事实语义对齐框架。它将解码的视觉token池化并投影到冻结的文本嵌入空间，与真实字幕对齐同时与场景保留的近错反事实备选分离，学习细粒度语义边界，提升重建真实性和语义正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉脑解码方法虽然能产生视觉上合理的重建，但由于生成先验过强，可能包含错误的物体、属性或关系（语义错误）。传统重建指标主要评估最终图像，可能掩盖这类语义错误。因此需要一种能够对齐和区分细粒度语义的框架。
AI.method: 1) 将解码的视觉token池化并投影到冻结的文本嵌入空间；2) 与真实字幕对齐，同时与场景保持的近miss反事实备选（由LLM离线生成，修改一个关键物体/属性/关系）分离；3) 采用基于margin的目标函数学习刺激与合理解释之间的细粒度语义边界，推理时无需LLM调用；4) 引入三级语义评估框架：基础判别力、反事实描述判别力和表征几何。
AI.result: 在Natural Scenes Dataset上，ConceptAlign相比MindEye2骨干提升了重建指标、反事实语义判别力和表征对齐。匹配的负样本消融、独立LLM和人类书写的备选以及人类评估均支持监督的有效性和鲁棒性，在细粒度冲突、有限数据解码和跨被试结构上也表现良好。
AI.conclusion: ConceptAlign通过反事实语义对齐有效提升了视觉脑解码的语义精度，弥补了传统重建指标无法捕捉细粒度语义错误的不足，为脑解码提供了更可靠的语义监督方法。

title: Command-Space Counterfactual Explanations for Pareto-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Pareto Conditioned Networks learn multiple multi-objective reinforcement learning behaviours by conditioning a single policy on a desired return command. However, the local mapping from command and state to action remains opaque. We propose command-space counterfactual explanations for PCNs: given a fixed state, original command, and foil action, we search, in a black-box setting, for a minimally changed desired-return command under which the same trained policy would choose the foil. Our contributions are threefold. First, we formulate PCN explanations as return-command interventions, using a return-only PCN variant that avoids the added ambiguity of horizon-conditioning. Second, we adapt adversarial machine learning methods to reinforcement-learning explanations. Third, we introduce a boundary-seeded directional search that improves over purely local optimization in the command-action landscape, resulting in our proposed approach CF-ZOO. The resulting explanations are actionable and intuitively expressed in the user's own preferences: "If your trade-off had shifted slightly towards X, the agent would have chosen Y."

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CF-ZOO方法，用于为Pareto Conditioned Networks（PCN）生成基于命令空间的反事实解释。在固定状态下，通过黑盒搜索找到最小变化的期望回报命令，使同一策略选择foil动作，从而将解释表达为用户可理解的需求偏好。
AI.motivation: PCN通过在单一策略上条件化期望回报命令来学习多目标强化学习行为，但命令与状态到动作的局部映射是不透明的。现有工作缺乏对PCN决策过程的解释性，用户无法理解为什么智能体在特定状态下选择了某个动作。
AI.method: 1) 将PCN解释形式化为回报命令干预，使用仅回报的PCN变体以避免水平条件化的歧义；2) 将对抗机器学习方法适配到强化学习解释中；3) 提出边界种子化的方向搜索（boundary-seeded directional search），改进命令-动作景观中的局部优化，形成CF-ZOO方法。
AI.result: CF-ZOO能够生成可操作且直观的反事实解释，以用户偏好表达，如"如果你的权衡略微偏向X，智能体将选择Y"。边界种子化方向搜索优于纯局部优化方法。
AI.conclusion: CF-ZOO为PCN提供了黑盒环境下的反事实解释框架，使多目标强化学习决策更具可解释性和可操作性，解释以用户偏好语言呈现。

title: Demand-Driven Vertiport Siting and Discrete-Event Fleet Simulation for On-Demand Urban Air Mobility Network Design
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
summary: This paper presents a demand-driven framework for on-demand Urban Air Mobility (UAM) network design that links vertiport siting, fleet simulation, and door-to-door travel-time feasibility. Demand is estimated from commuter and passenger activity data, converted into spatial trip-end points, and clustered using K-means to generate candidate vertiport locations. Candidate networks are screened using range and minimum station-spacing constraints, then evaluated with a discrete-event simulation that models multi-vehicle dispatch, deadhead relocation, battery swaps, and service regularity. Flight time and energy consumption are computed using a point-mass eVTOL performance model. In a Greater Los Angeles case study, the preferred design expands from four stations and four eVTOLs at low demand to sixteen stations and twelve eVTOLs at the highest tested demand level. Results show that larger fleets improve completion time and vehicle-arrival regularity but do not eliminate deadhead flights, indicating that spatial demand imbalance remains an operational burden. The travel-time savings analysis further suggests that UAM is most defensible for longer or congestion-heavy trips where sufficient non-flight time remains after accounting for flight time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种需求驱动的城市空中交通（UAM）网络设计框架，将垂直起降场选址、机队仿真与门到门出行时间可行性相结合。在大洛杉矶案例中，最佳设计从低需求下的4个站点4架eVTOL扩展至高需求下的16个站点12架eVTOL。结果表明更大机队改善完成时间和到达规律性，但无法消除空载调机飞行，且UAM在长距离或拥堵行程中最具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 城市空中交通网络设计需要综合考虑需求分布、基础设施选址与运营可行性，而现有方法往往割裂这些要素，缺乏一个将需求估计、选址与运营仿真整合的需求驱动框架。
AI.method: 从通勤与旅客活动数据估计需求并转换为空间出行端点，使用K-means聚类生成候选垂直起降场位置；通过航程和最小站间距约束筛选候选网络；采用离散事件仿真建模多车调度、空载调机、电池更换和服务规律性；飞行时间与能耗由eVTOL点质量性能模型计算。
AI.result: 大洛杉矶案例中，最优设计从低需求（4站4机）扩展至高需求（16站12机）。更大机队改善完成时间和车辆到达规律性，但空载调机飞行无法消除，表明空间需求不平衡仍是运营负担。出行时间节省分析显示UAM对长途或拥堵严重、飞行后仍有充足非飞行时间的行程最有利。
AI.conclusion: 需求驱动的UAM网络设计框架能够系统性地确定垂直起降场规模与机队配置，但需正视空间需求不平衡带来的运营代价，且应聚焦于UAM最具时间优势的长途或拥堵场景进行部署。

title: LLMs Get Smarter from Targeted Synthetic Multilingual Data
summary: Language-specific competency (LSC) is the phenomenon of a language model performing better or worse depending on the language of the prompt. In other words, a language model outputs different (and potentially incorrect) responses to the same semantic query when prompted in different languages. Prior work attributes this to an internal misalignment of semantic representation across languages. Currently, there are two main approaches to address LSC in the literature: (1) routing all queries through English, improving performance, but limiting language expressivity to English; or (2) training on language-balanced data, equalizing model performance across languages, but reducing overall performance. In this work, we take a data centric perspective and introduce HOTFIXR: Hardness Optimized Training data For Improving X-Lingual Reasoning. It is a data generation framework that uses models to probe and learn a student model's multilingual weaknesses, and generates data to mitigate them. HOTFIXR can generate multilingual synthetic training data that can improve multilingual performance. We evaluate on three in-distribution tasks, three out-of-distribution tasks, and four out-of-distribution languages. On average, HOTFIXR (1) improves in-distribution performance by 6.2%, (2) reduces catastrophic forgetting (induced by fine-tuning) on OOD tasks by 3.7%, and (3) on OOD languages by 7.1%. Overall, as many real-world applications requires multilingual LLMs, our work contributes to the efforts of making LLMs multilingually proficient. We will release code upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HOTFIXR框架，通过数据生成方式解决语言模型的语言特定能力（LSC）问题，即模型在不同语言提示下表现不一致的现象。HOTFIXR利用模型探测并学习学生模型的多语言弱点，生成针对性合成训练数据来弥补这些弱点。实验表明该方法在分布内任务上提升6.2%，在分布外任务和语言上分别降低灾难性遗忘3.7%和7.1%。
AI.motivation: 语言模型存在语言特定能力（LSC）问题，即同一语义查询在不同语言下会产生不同甚至错误的回答。现有两种解决方案都有缺陷：(1)将所有查询路由到英语会限制语言表达性；(2)使用语言平衡数据训练虽能均衡性能但降低整体表现。因此需要一种既能提升多语言性能又不牺牲整体能力的方法。
AI.method: HOTFIXR是一个数据生成框架，核心思路是：首先使用模型来探测并学习学生模型在多语言场景下的弱点（即表现较差的语言-任务组合），然后针对这些弱点生成多语言合成训练数据，以弥补模型的语言能力差距。
AI.result: 在三个分布内任务、三个分布外任务和四种分布外语言上评估。平均而言，HOTFIXR：(1)分布内性能提升6.2%；(2)在分布外任务上减少微调导致的灾难性遗忘3.7%；(3)在分布外语言上减少7.1%的遗忘。
AI.conclusion: HOTFIXR提供了一种数据中心的解决方案来改善多语言LLM的语言特定能力问题，通过有针对性的合成数据生成来弥补模型的多语言弱点，在提升分布内性能的同时减少灾难性遗忘，为真实世界中需要多语言LLM的应用做出贡献。

title: Beyond Natural-Image Foundation Models: Benchmarking Satellite Pretraining for Ophthalmic Image Analysis
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Medical Foundation Models and Benchmarks (MEDFMB)
summary: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) have emerged as a promising approach in medical imaging, producing broadly applicable systems that can be efficiently adapted across diverse imaging modalities, anatomical regions, and clinical tasks. However, VFMs require extensive training data, and their progress in medical image analysis is constrained by limited data availability, privacy concerns, and high development costs. To alleviate these constraints, medical VFMs (MedVFMs) are often built upon weights from generalist models pretrained on vast amounts of publicly available natural images, introducing a substantial distribution shift for medical task adaptation. To address this, we propose satellite imagery as a novel pretraining domain for MedVFM development and benchmarking, motivated by its closer visual alignment with medical data and its freedom from the privacy constraints that limit medical datasets. Across multiple ophthalmic imaging modalities, we compare DINOv3-SAT493m pretrained on 493 million satellite images against DINOv3-LVD1689m pretrained on 1.7 billion natural images, together with two medical specialist baselines: DINOv3-RETFound and MAE-RETFound. Our experiments show that satellite imagery is a stronger pretraining source than natural images for ophthalmic tasks, particularly on en face vascular-rich modalities. On several tasks, satellite pretraining matches or exceeds the medical specialists on high-resolution en face inputs, despite using no medical data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将卫星图像作为医学视觉基础模型（MedVFM）的新预训练领域，相比自然图像更接近医学数据的视觉特征且无隐私限制。实验表明，在眼科多模态任务中，基于4.93亿卫星图像预训练的DINOv3-SAT493m在多个任务上优于基于17亿自然图像预训练的DINOv3-LVD1689m，甚至在部分高分辨率en face任务上可媲美或超越医学专家模型（RETFound系列）。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉基础模型面临数据量有限、隐私约束和高开发成本三大挑战。现有MedVFM通常基于大规模自然图像预训练权重，但自然图像与医学图像之间存在显著的分布偏移，限制了医学任务适配效果。需要寻找更接近医学数据视觉特征且不受隐私限制的预训练数据源。
AI.method: 提出将卫星图像作为MedVFM的预训练领域。使用DINOv3架构，对比三种预训练设置：1）DINOv3-SAT493m（4.93亿卫星图像）；2）DINOv3-LVD1689m（17亿自然图像）；3）两个医学专家基线（DINOv3-RETFound和MAE-RETFound，基于眼科数据预训练）。在多种眼科成像模态上进行系统评估。
AI.result: 卫星图像预训练在眼科任务上优于自然图像预训练，尤其在富含血管的en face模态上优势明显。在多个任务中，卫星预训练在无需任何医学数据的情况下，性能匹配或超越了使用医学数据的专家模型。
AI.conclusion: 卫星图像可作为医学视觉基础模型的有效预训练数据源，能够缓解医学数据稀缺和隐私限制问题，同时自然缩小视觉分布差距，为MedVFM开发提供了新的范式。

title: A Physiology-Informed Digital Twin Framework for Simulating Liver Health Progression
comment: This paper is under review at IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI)
summary: We present a physiology-informed digital twin of the human liver designed for longitudinal simulation of liver function and early-stage disease progression. The model, referred to as HEPATWIN, integrates key hepatic processes, including carbohydrate, lipid, and protein metabolism, bilirubin conjugation, bile production, and detoxification, within a unified systems-level framework to generate clinically observable biomarker trajectories. Unlike purely data-driven approaches, HEPATWIN incorporates mechanistic representations of liver physiology and patient-specific inputs such as diet, activity, and baseline biomarkers to simulate disease evolution over time. To ensure consistency with clinical progression patterns, we introduce a stage-transition-driven calibration mechanism that aligns simulated outputs with population-level biomarker distributions across disease stages, including NAFLD, fibrosis, and cirrhosis. Validation using the NIDDK NAFLD dataset demonstrates that HEPATWIN produces longitudinal biomarker estimates within clinically acceptable ranges and can forecast trajectories over multi-year horizons. Furthermore, simulated biomarkers retain sufficient clinical signal to support downstream NASH detection with competitive performance relative to models using ground-truth laboratory data. These results highlight the potential of physiology-informed digital twins for personalized, non-invasive diagnosis and prediction of organ health in general and liver health monitoring in particular.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HEPATWIN，一个基于生理学知识的肝脏数字孪生模型，用于纵向模拟肝功能及早期疾病进展。模型整合碳水化合物、脂质、蛋白质代谢、胆红素结合、胆汁生成和解毒等关键肝脏过程，生成临床可观察的生物标志物轨迹。通过阶段转换驱动的校准机制，使模拟输出与NAFLD、纤维化和肝硬化等疾病阶段的群体生物标志物分布一致。在NIDDK NAFLD数据集上验证表明，HEPATWIN能产生临床可接受的纵向生物标志物估计，并可预测多年时间跨度的疾病轨迹，且模拟数据足以支持NASH检测。
AI.motivation: 传统的纯数据驱动方法缺乏对肝脏生理机制的刻画，难以实现个性化的长期疾病预测。作者希望构建一个结合肝脏生理学机制的模型，以支持个性化、非侵入性的肝脏健康监测和疾病预测。
AI.method: HEPATWIN采用系统级框架整合多个肝脏关键生理过程（代谢、胆红素、胆汁、解毒），并引入患者特定输入（饮食、活动、基线生物标志物）。通过阶段转换驱动的校准机制，将模拟输出对齐到不同疾病阶段的群体生物标志物分布，实现纵向动态模拟。
AI.result: 在NIDDK NAFLD数据集上，HEPATWIN生成的纵向生物标志物估计在临床可接受范围内，可预测多年时间跨度的疾病轨迹；其模拟生物标志物用于下游NASH检测时，性能可与使用真实实验室数据的模型相竞争。
AI.conclusion: 生理学信息驱动的数字孪生方法在个性化、非侵入性肝脏诊断和健康预测方面具有显著潜力，为肝脏及其他器官的健康监测提供了一个有前景的建模框架。

title: Does a Tool Result Carry More Authority Than Plain Text? Three Prospective Studies of False-Claim Adoption in a Synthetic Assignment Task with Claude Opus 5
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures. Includes two document-preregistered studies, exact prompts, and complete program disclosure
summary: Language-model systems increasingly read from stores they also write to, so a claim that was merely written earlier can return looking retrieved. We tested whether the message package carrying an unsupported assignment changes which answer a model gives in a synthetic lookup task. Claude Opus 5 selected a color code for a named item or abstained. In an exploratory four-arm study, false-code adoption was 0/24 with no target claim, 0/22 scorable trials when a prior assistant assertion named the target, 14/24 when a tool-result record named it, and 15/24 when that result used a ten-field metadata wrapper that marked it unchecked. The tool-result arm selected the record's code in 11/12 supported trials and 14/24 unsupported trials, ruling out a fixed output-token bias while leaving substantial planted-token heterogeneity. A document-preregistered replication reproduced the tool-result versus assistant-assertion gap, 7/24 against 0/24, one-sided Fisher exact p = 0.0047. The tool-result rate nevertheless fell from 14/24 to 7/24 across runs made four days apart. A second preregistered study gave the earlier comparison a live text control: both records were announced in advance and placed in the same final user turn, then target binding was swapped between the linked tool result and later inline JSON. Inline text was sufficient for false-code adoption in 60/60 trials; the tool-result condition produced 57/60, so the registered result-first superiority criterion failed, p = 1. The result does not show that tool results have no effect. It shows that native tool-result placement was not necessary and that this experiment did not find greater behavioral weight for the result package than for announced inline text. The findings concern a single model on one synthetic task template, accessed through one API.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过合成查找任务测试了不同消息包装（工具结果、助手断言、内联文本）对语言模型采用虚假代码的影响。探索性研究发现工具结果记录比助手断言更易导致虚假代码采纳（14/24 vs 0/24），预注册复制实验验证了这一差异（7/24 vs 0/24），但随时间的稳定性存疑。第二个预注册研究加入内联文本对照组后，发现内联文本与工具结果同样有效（60/60 vs 57/60），表明工具结果的原生位置并非必要。
AI.motivation: 语言模型系统越来越多地从其自身写入的存储中读取信息，导致先前写入的声明在检索时可能被误认为已核实的外部信息。作者希望探究携带不支持断言的"消息包装"（message package）类型是否会影响模型采取虚假信息的决策。
AI.method: 使用合成查找任务：要求Claude Opus 5为命名项目选择颜色代码或弃权。设计了四个探索性实验臂：（1）无目标声明对照（2）助手先验断言（3）工具结果记录（4）带十字段元数据包装的未检查工具结果。随后进行了两个预注册复制研究，包括在第二研究中加入内联文本对照组，比较工具结果与提前公布并在同一用户回合出现的内联文本。
AI.result: 探索性研究：虚假代码采纳率为0/24（对照组）、0/22（助手断言）、14/24（工具结果）、15/24（带元数据包装的工具结果）。预注册复制验证了工具结果与助手断言之间的差距（7/24 vs 0/24，Fisher精确检验p=0.0047），但工具结果率从14/24降至7/24。第二项预注册研究：内联文本60/60，工具结果57/60，注册的结果优先标准失败（p=1）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明原生工具结果位置并非虚假代码采纳的必要条件——宣布的内联文本同样有效。实验未发现工具结果包装比已宣布的内联文本具有更大的行为权重。研究结果仅限于单一模型、单一合成任务模板和单一API访问方式，需谨慎推广。

title: Whose Gold? Annotator-Pool Disagreement Is Large at the Item Level, and Hidden by Small Leaderboards
comment: Submitted to the HAIC workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary:
Preference benchmarks are built by hiring annotators, and the identity of those annotators is treated as an implementation detail. We measure what that detail buys. On the 2,885 MultiPref items where both pools are internally unanimous, so no tie-breaking convention is consulted at all, expert and crowd annotators assign a different majority label to 23.6% and name the opposite winner on 9.2%; on the 246 comparably unanimous MT-Bench cells, benchmark authors and recruited experts differ on 30.5% and reverse on 8.5%. Yet on both corpora the resulting model leaderboards are bit-identical: Kendall tau = 1.00 with zero of six models displaced.
  That invariance is far weaker evidence than it looks, and we quantify how weak. Switching pools moves a model's win rate by 1.9pp (SD), one adjacent pair in our own leaderboard sits 0.8pp apart and had a 38% chance of swapping, and an item-level bootstrap displaces at least one model in 28% of resamples. The observed zero is the common outcome, not a property of aggregation: on the same measured perturbation, a ten-model leaderboard is displaced with probability 0.86 and a twenty-model leaderboard with probability 0.9997. Reporting a six-model leaderboard is safe; the safety does not generalise, and everything that consumes labels per item is not safe at any size. We make the distinction precise, show that a widely used dataset's stated assumption of no intra-group annotator variability is false, and show that an LLM judge tracks the crowd pool over the expert pool on all three models we test, including one from a different vendor. All code, per-call outputs, and pre-registered decision rules will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了偏好基准中标注者身份（专家vs众包）对标注结果和模型排行榜的影响，发现虽然后端排行榜看似不变，但这种不变性具有误导性，实际统计功效极弱，且模型数量增加时排行榜被推翻的概率急剧上升。
AI.motivation: 偏好基准通常被认为"谁来标注不重要"，但标注者身份被视为实现细节而被忽视。作者希望量化标注者身份差异实际带来的影响，并质疑现有排行榜不变性结论的可靠性。
AI.method: 在MultiPref和MT-Bench两个语料库上，对比专家与普通众包标注者的多数标签、获胜者选择及模型排行榜。通过逐项引导（item-level bootstrap）、扰动分析及概率计算，量化排行榜翻转风险，并测试LLM判断器对不同标注者池的追踪倾向。
AI.result: 专家与众包标注者在内部一致的样本上分歧高达23.6%（MultiPref）和30.5%（MT-Bench），但六模型排行榜Kendall tau=1.00完全不变。然而，切换标注池使模型胜率移动1.9pp，28%的引导重采样会至少替换一个模型，十模型排行榜有86%概率被推翻，二十模型达99.97%。此外，LLM判断器偏向众包池而非专家池。
AI.conclusion: 六模型排行榜的稳定性是个巧合而非通用规律；"排行榜不变"的结论在更大模型集合上不成立。标注者身份对逐项标签消费（如偏好数据训练）的影响不可忽略，且广泛使用的数据集声称"组内无标注者变异"的假设被证伪。

title: Anchor-Regularized Adaptation for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection with DINOv3
summary: Recent works in AI-generated image detection have shown that careful training data alignment can improve generalization by removing spurious correlations. However, linear probes on frozen DINOv3 representations achieve remarkably strong performance even when trained on misaligned datasets. Motivated by this result, we analyze the underlying rationale and the limits of this generalization. We find that frozen DINOv3 performs well because its decisions rely on features that faithfully represent the space of authentic images. At the same time, its final layer is less effective at capturing the subtle pixel-artifact cues that can be emphasized by aligned training data. We further observe that naively mixing aligned and misaligned data during adaptation improves sensitivity to such cues but at the cost of distorting the pre-trained representation, limiting generalization. To address this issue, we propose Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA). We apply Low-Rank Adaptation to capture pixel-level artifacts while leveraging a frozen anchor classifier to avoid deviations from the original representation structure. This allows the model to exploit pixel-artifact cues without sacrificing generalization. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on nine diverse and challenging benchmarks, indicating that ARA enables complementary supervision from misaligned and aligned data for more effective detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA)方法，通过低秩适配(LoRA)捕获像素级伪影线索，同时利用冻结的锚点分类器保持预训练表示结构不偏移，从而在AI生成图像检测中同时利用对齐和未对齐数据的互补监督信号，在九个基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究表明训练数据对齐可以提升AI生成图像检测的泛化能力，但冻结的DINOv3表示在线性探针上即使使用未对齐数据也表现优异。作者分析发现：DINOv3依靠忠实反映真实图像空间的特征，但其最后一层对像素级伪影线索捕捉不足；而简单混合对齐和未对齐数据虽能提升对伪影的敏感性，却会扭曲预训练表示，损害泛化能力。这激发了如何同时利用两类数据互补优势的研究。
AI.method: 提出Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA)框架：使用Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)适配层来捕捉像素级伪影线索，同时引入一个冻结的锚点分类器作为正则化约束，防止适配过程中偏离原始预训练表示的结构。通过这种方式，模型既能从对齐数据中学习敏感的伪影特征，又不会牺牲由未对齐数据获得的对真实图像的忠实表示。
AI.result: ARA方法在九个多样且具有挑战性的基准上均达到最先进性能，证明了该方法能有效融合对齐和未对齐数据的互补监督信息，在保持泛化能力的同时提升对像素伪影的检测敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了DINOv3表示泛化能力的来源及其局限性，并通过ARA方法证明了对齐与未对齐数据可以互补使用：LoRA负责学习像素级伪影线索，冻结锚点分类器维护表示结构稳定，两者结合实现了更有效的AI生成图像检测。

title: Do Geometry-Aware Positional Encodings Help Transformers in Spatial Imperfect-Information Games?
summary: Transformers applied to spatial imperfect-information games must represent map geometry while tracking hidden entities through time. We ask whether geometry-aware positional encodings improve these capabilities, without claiming a new positional encoding. We construct a four-level benchmark on a hexagonal naval pursuit game: controlled geometry and topology probes, an exact-Bayes hidden-target tracking task, offline policy imitation at 1k and 10k games, and 7,200 fixed-seed games against three legacy opponents. Across matched Transformer backbones, HexRoPE reduces exact-belief posterior cross-entropy relative to no positional encoding by 0.278 on D6-transformed test orbits and 0.329 on a larger map; both hierarchical-bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero, and both Holm-adjusted p-values are below 0.001. At 1k games, HexRoPE improves policy action accuracy by 4.63 percentage points over no encoding and 2.05 points over rectangular relative bias; the gains shrink to 1.55 and 0.41 points at 10k games. However, HexRoPE does not improve aggregate gameplay win rate: its paired effect over no encoding is -1.56 percentage points (95% CI [-4.50, 1.17]). Rectangular relative bias is strongest on D6 belief consistency but fails sharply when extrapolating from radius 3 to radius 4, while graph bias provides only a small blocked-edge gain. The results show that geometric inductive bias improves belief estimation and data-efficient imitation, but those representation gains do not automatically produce stronger closed-loop play.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了几何感知位置编码（HexRoPE）在空间不完美信息博弈（六边形海战游戏）中的作用。实验表明HexRoPE在信念估计（降低后验交叉熵0.278-0.329）和数据高效模仿学习（1k局提升4.63个百分点）上显著优于无位置编码，但在10k局时优势缩小，且并未提升闭环博弈的胜率（效果为-1.56个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 空间不完美信息博弈中，Transformer需要同时表示地图几何结构并随时间追踪隐藏实体。作者想探究几何感知的位置编码是否能提升这些能力，而不声称提出新编码方法。
AI.method: 构建四级基准测试：(1)受控几何与拓扑探针；(2)精确贝叶斯隐藏目标追踪任务；(3)1k和10k局离线策略模仿；(4)对三个传统对手进行7200局固定种子博弈。在匹配的Transformer骨干网上比较HexRoPE、无位置编码、矩形相对偏置和图形偏置。
AI.result: HexRoPE在精确信念后验交叉熵上显著优于无编码（D6变换测试轨道降0.278，更大地图降0.329，置信区间排除零，p<0.001）。1k局时策略动作准确率提升4.63个百分点（较无编码）和2.05个百分点（较矩形相对偏置）；10k局时缩减至1.55和0.41。但胜率未提升，配对效应为-1.56个百分点（95% CI [-4.50, 1.17]）。矩形相对偏置在D6信念一致性上最强但外推失败，图形偏置仅提供小的阻塞边增益。
AI.conclusion: 几何归纳偏置能提升信念估计和数据效率模仿学习，但表征层面的提升并不能自动转化为更强的闭环博弈表现，提示表征与闭环策略之间存在不可忽略的差距。

title: S2-MoE: Enabling Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts on Edge Devices
summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for inference on edge devices is challenging due to severe memory and bandwidth constraints. While speculative decoding and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) have been proposed to improve inference efficiency, naively combining them often incurs excessive verification overhead and poor expert reuse, limiting their effectiveness in memory-bound edge settings. In this work, we propose S2-MoE, an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for MoE inference on edge devices. S2-MoE reduces redundant verification through routing-aware adaptive speculative expansion, improves verification efficiency with reuse-aware expert gating, and aligns draft and target execution via shared context. Implemented in llama.cpp, S2-MoE achieves up to 5.3x speedup (about 2.0x on average) over standard autoregressive de?coding across diverse MoE models and datasets on edge devices.Code is available at https://github.com/angerybob/S2-MoE.

AI.tldr: S2-MoE 是一个针对边缘设备上 MoE 推理的自推测解码框架，通过路由感知的自适应推测扩展、重用感知的专家门控和共享上下文对齐草稿与目标执行，在 llama.cpp 中实现最高 5.3 倍（平均约 2.0 倍）的加速。
AI.motivation: 在边缘设备上部署 LLM 推理面临严重的内存和带宽限制。虽然推测解码和 MoE 分别被提出以提升推理效率，但简单地将它们结合往往会导致过多的验证开销和较差的专家复用，限制了在内存受限的边缘场景中的有效性。
AI.method: 提出 S2-MoE 框架，包含三个关键机制：(1) 路由感知的自适应推测扩展，减少冗余验证；(2) 重用感知的专家门控，提升验证效率；(3) 通过共享上下文对齐草稿与目标执行。
AI.result: 在 llama.cpp 中实现，在多种 MoE 模型和数据集上，相对于标准自回归解码在边缘设备上达到最高 5.3 倍加速，平均约 2.0 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: S2-MoE 有效地解决了推测解码与 MoE 结合时的验证开销和专家复用问题，显著提升了边缘设备上 MoE 推理的效率，并已开源。

title: From Sequence to Structure: Relational Uncertainty Propagation for LLM Agents
summary: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying large language model (LLM) agents in complex interactive environments. Existing UQ methods largely rely on local signals, such as token probabilities, predictive entropy, or per-step confidence, and therefore overlook the long-range dependencies through which errors accumulate across an execution trajectory. As a result, they may fail to identify agent failures whose causes originate several reasoning or interaction steps before the final answer. We propose RUPA (Relational Uncertainty Propagation for Agents), a trajectory-level UQ framework for LLM agents. RUPA represents an execution history as a directed trajectory graph in which reasoning states, tool interactions, and environment feedback are nodes connected by temporal and semantic dependency edges. It then propagates uncertainty over this graph to capture how execution risk accumulates and transfers across interaction steps. The propagated signal is combined with trajectory-level behavioral features and goal-alignment information to produce a confidence estimate for the full agent trajectory. We evaluate RUPA on representative agent benchmarks, including $τ$-2, Terminal-Bench-2, and GAIA, using 6 open-source LLMs spanning multiple model families. Experimental results show that RUPA consistently outperforms existing UQ methods by providing more accurate uncertainty estimates, enabling earlier failure detection, and improving uncertainty-guided agent execution across diverse agent tasks. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling relational dependency is crucial to reliable UQ for long-horizon LLM agents, providing a practical foundation for trustworthy agent execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RUPA框架，通过将LLM智能体的执行轨迹建模为有向图并传播不确定性，实现轨迹级别的可靠不确定性量化（UQ），在多个基准和6个开源LLM上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有UQ方法依赖局部信号（如token概率、预测熵、单步置信度），忽略了错误在长执行轨迹中跨步骤累积和传播的长程依赖关系，因而无法识别源于早期推理或交互步骤的智能体失败。
AI.method: RUPA将执行历史表示为有向轨迹图，其中推理状态、工具交互和环境反馈作为节点，通过时间依赖边和语义依赖边连接；随后在该图上传播不确定性以捕获执行风险随交互步骤累积和转移的过程；将传播信号与轨迹级行为特征及目标对齐信息结合，生成完整智能体轨迹的置信度估计。
AI.result: 在τ-2、Terminal-Bench-2和GAIA基准上，使用6个开源LLM（覆盖多个模型家族）进行实验，RUPA在不确定性估计准确性、早期失败检测以及不确定性引导的智能体执行方面均一致优于现有UQ方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模关系依赖对长horizon LLM智能体的可靠UQ至关重要，RUPA为可信赖的智能体执行提供了实用基础。

title: TERRA: A Hierarchical Parallel Training and Memory Orchestration Framework for High-Resolution AI-based Earth Modeling
comment: 15 pages, 16 figures, 6 tables, and 2 algorithms. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems (TPDS). Code is available at https://github.com/ruohan12345/TERRA
summary: Training high-resolution AI-based Earth forecasting models is memory-intensive. Window-based Swin Transformers reduce the quadratic cost of global attention, but existing distributed systems such as AERIS primarily target pixel-level models and do not jointly support convolutional sampling modules and shifted-window execution. Long-lead rollout finetuning further increases activation memory. To address these challenges, we present TERRA, a hierarchical parallel training framework for high-resolution Earth forecasting. TERRA introduces Sampling-Aware Window, Sequence, and Tensor Parallelism (SAWSTP), which preserves spatially contiguous layouts for sampling modules and routes tokens into topology-aware ragged window layouts for Transformer execution. For long-lead finetuning, Memory Orchestration (MO) provides rollout-aware checkpoint planning and combines input buffering with budget-constrained activation offloading. Experiments on the $1/12^\circ$ GLORYS-based Wenhai workload show that TERRA supports models with up to 11.4B parameters on 96 H200 GPUs and sustains up to $39.76$ PFLOPS, achieving $65.0\%$ strong-scaling and $94.1\%$ weak-scaling efficiency. Compared with checkpoint-only policies, MO further reduces peak allocated GPU memory by $32.2\%$--$51.8\%$ with at most $20.0\%$ step-time overhead, which makes finetuning with smaller patch sizes and longer rollouts feasible for improved forecasting accuracy.

AI.tldr: TERRA是一个面向高分辨率地球预测模型的分层并行训练框架。它提出了采样感知的窗口、序列和张量并行（SAWSTP），在保持采样模块空间连续布局的同时，将token路由到拓扑感知的不规则窗口布局中进行Transformer执行。同时引入内存编排（MO）机制用于长前置期微调，结合输入缓冲和预算约束的激活卸载。在GLORYS-based Wenhai工作负载上，TERRA支持在96块H200 GPU上训练高达114亿参数的模型，强扩展效率65.0%，弱扩展效率94.1%，相比仅检查点策略将峰值GPU内存降低32.2%–51.8%。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率AI地球预测模型的训练内存开销巨大。现有的分布式系统（如AERIS）主要针对像素级模型，无法同时支持卷积采样模块和移动窗口执行。此外，长前置期滚动微调进一步增加了激活内存压力，需要专门的解决方案。
AI.method: TERRA包含两大核心组件：1) SAWSTP（采样感知窗口、序列和张量并行）：为采样模块保留空间连续布局，并将token路由到拓扑感知的不规则窗口布局中以适配Swim Transformer的移动窗口执行；2) 内存编排（MO）：提供滚动感知的检查点规划，结合输入缓冲与预算约束的激活卸载策略，用于长前置期微调。
AI.result: 在1/12° GLORYS-based Wenhai工作负载上，TERRA支持高达114亿参数的模型（96块H200 GPU），持续算力达39.76 PFLOPS，强扩展效率65.0%，弱扩展效率94.1%。相比仅检查点策略，MO将峰值GPU内存分配降低32.2%–51.8%，步进时间开销最多20.0%。
AI.conclusion: TERRA通过联合支持卷积采样模块与移动窗口Transformer执行，有效解决了高分辨率地球预测模型分布式训练中的扩展性和内存瓶颈。其内存编排机制使得更小patch尺寸和更长前置期的微调变得可行，从而提升预测精度。

title: Lipschitz Bandits with Arbitrary Feedback Delays
comment: 10 pages of main contents, 26 pages in total
summary: The Lipschitz bandit problem extends the traditional multi-armed bandit framework to continuous action spaces by assuming that the reward functions satisfy a Lipschitz condition. This work investigates Lipschitz bandits under arbitrary feedback delays, where reward signals are not received immediately upon taking an action but after an arbitrarily chosen delay. We consider both stochastic and adversarial reward settings, proposing an elimination-based algorithm and an EXP3-based algorithm, respectively. For both settings, our algorithms achieve a regret bound of $\tilde{O}\left(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D}\right)$ over a time horizon $T$ with total delay $D$, where the main difference between settings lies in the definition of the zooming dimension $d_z$. Our bounds match existing delay-free regret guarantees for Lipschitz bandits and characterize the additional $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$ impact introduced by feedback delays.

AI.tldr: 本文研究任意反馈延迟下的Lipschitz赌博机问题，分别针对随机和对抗性奖励设置提出了基于消除的算法和基于EXP3的算法，实现了$\tilde{O}(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D})$的遗憾界，其中$d_z$为缩放维度，$D$为总延迟。
AI.motivation: Lipschitz赌博机将传统多臂赌博机扩展到连续动作空间，但现有工作未充分考虑实际系统中普遍存在的反馈延迟问题。本文旨在填补这一空白，研究在任意延迟条件下Lipschitz赌博机的遗憾界。
AI.method: 针对随机奖励设置提出基于消除的算法；针对对抗性奖励设置提出基于EXP3的算法。两者分别利用缩放维度$d_z$刻画问题复杂度，并将延迟影响通过$\sqrt{D}$项来表征。
AI.result: 两种设置下的算法均获得$\tilde{O}(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D})$的遗憾界，与无延迟情形下的最优遗憾界相匹配，额外代价仅为$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$，其中$D$为总延迟。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统刻画了Lipschitz赌博机在任意反馈延迟下的遗憾界，证明延迟仅带来$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$的额外代价，且该结果在随机和对抗两种设置下均成立。

title: Gathered, Not Admitted: How Attention Brings a Latent Variable into Verbalizable Form
comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/parsa-mz/innerj
summary: Language models hold latent quantities in a form they can report on, and more of a quantity is present in that form when the task requires reusing it flexibly. What causes a representation to enter that form is open, and the word workspace invites an admission story: a gate that decides what gets in. Testing it on open-weight models with Jacobian lenses, over a benchmark whose five arms share an identical context, we find no gate where it predicts one. Demand raises a concept's lens visibility beyond what applying an operator to a supplied value produces: +0.050 [+0.045, +0.057] in percentile rank on our primary checkpoint, positive on all four we measure, though that arm answers at ceiling and the accuracymatched contrast is stronger under that readout. At the same time one shared linear map decodes the variable from every arm, the control included, at 6.4-9.0x its selection-corrected floor. What produces the later readable form at the queried position is attention-mediated gathering inside a mid-depth window: separating patch depth from readout depth puts transport there at least 17x above anywhere shallower under non-saturating readouts, with no tested MLP output contributing positively inside it. Under the saturating percentile rank the same grid does not localise the window, which is a fact about that measure. An arm that needs the variable for nothing concentrates sevenfold less, so the window is demand-specific. That window has two measured edges, a survival failure below and destruction above, and it falls at the same fractional depth in a 64-layer hybrid and a 62-layer dense model from another family. We localise where the variable is installed and read, not the route from the passage, which transports nothing. But the readout is not a calibrated measure of use: three components move it to within 12% of one another and differ 7.4x in what they do to the answer.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Jacobian透镜和五臂基准测试，探究语言模型内部工作记忆中"变量表示"的生成机制。研究发现：需求会提高概念在透镜下的可见度，但不存在预测中的"门控"机制；一个共享线性映射可从各臂解码变量；信息通过注意机制在中等深度窗口内聚集形成可读表示，该窗口在跨模型家族中保持稳定的分数深度位置；但读出度量并非使用量的校准指标。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型如何在内部工作记忆中形成和应用变量表示，检验"工作区"（workspace）隐喻中"门控准入"机制的假设，并探究需求如何影响表示的可读形式。
AI.method: 使用Jacobian透镜分析开放权重模型，设计五个共享相同上下文但任务需求不同的基准臂；分离补丁深度与读出深度以定位信息传输窗口；通过对照臂和选择校正基线进行消融验证；跨两家不同模型家族（64层混合模型和62层稠密模型）验证发现。
AI.result: 未发现预测的门控机制；需求将概念的透镜可见百分位排名提高+0.050，在主要检查点上四种架构均为正效应；共享线性映射以6.4-9.0倍于选择校正基线的水平解码变量；信息传输集中在中等深度窗口内，该窗口至少比更浅层高17倍；不需要变量的臂聚集量少七倍；窗口在两种不同模型家族中位于相同分数深度。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型中的变量可读表示产生于注意力介导的、需求特异性的中等深度窗口内的信息聚集，而非门控准入机制。但读出度量不能校准实际使用：不同组件可使读出移动至彼此12%以内，却对答案产生7.4倍差异的影响。

title: ReRef-3D: A Benchmark for Spatial Referring Expression-Guided 3D Scene Rearrangement
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR)
summary: We introduce ReRef-3D, a benchmark for language-guided placement in 3D scenes. It contains 33,826 instructions across 998 CLEVR-derived scenes, spanning 16 placement families and direct, one-hop, and two-hop references. Each instruction must be resolved into a valid new placement position. Given that an instruction defines a region of acceptable placements rather than one coordinate, our evaluation inserts a prediction into the scene, recomputes relations, and tests relation satisfaction and physical validity. Each instruction also includes a verified naturalized rewrite. After fine-tuning, LLaVA-3D, 3D-LLM, and PlaceIt3D produce valid placements for 68.3%, 31.6%, and 22.4% of instructions, respectively. Across models, relation satisfaction surpasses physical validity, relations such as nearest and between are the most difficult, and phrasing has minimal effect on performance.

AI.tldr: ReRef-3D是一个用于3D场景中语言引导放置任务的基准测试，包含998个场景、33,826条指令，涵盖16种放置类别和直接、一跳、两跳引用。评估采用场景插入+关系重算方式，测试关系满足度和物理有效性。微调后LLaVA-3D、3D-LLM和PlaceIt3D的有效放置率分别为68.3%、31.6%和22.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D视觉语言模型在语言引导的物体放置任务上缺乏系统性的评测基准，特别是缺乏对复杂引用（一跳、两跳）和放置关系多样性的覆盖，且需要更合理的评估方式（即基于区域而非单一坐标判断有效性）。
AI.method: 构建了基于CLEVR的998个3D场景和33,826条指令，覆盖16种放置关系和三种引用复杂度；每条指令定义的是可接受放置区域而非单一坐标。评估时先将预测位置插入场景，再重新计算物体间关系，检测关系满足度与物理有效性；同时提供自然化改写版指令用于消融实验。
AI.result: 三种模型微调后有效放置率分别为LLaVA-3D 68.3%、3D-LLM 31.6%、PlaceIt3D 22.4%。所有模型在关系满足度上均优于物理有效性；nearest和between两类关系最难；指令的表述方式（原始vs自然化改写）对性能影响很小。
AI.conclusion: ReRef-3D揭示了现有3D模型在语言引导放置任务上的明显短板，特别是物理有效性和复杂空间关系（如nearest、between）的处理能力不足，为未来3D放置任务研究提供了标准化评估基准和改进方向。

title: Certifying Compressed Language Models: An Audit and a Statistical Toolkit
comment: 109 pages, 3 figures, 20 tables. Artifacts and per-item outputs: doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21939143
summary: A fraction of a point of benchmark accuracy is the usual evidence that a compressed model is equivalent to its original. That quantity is least informative when two models are most alike: a net delta is what survives cancellation between opposing per-item changes, and cancellation is most complete in the regime equivalence claims occupy. Across an atlas of 1,707 paired model-by-task cells mined from public per-item evaluation dumps (1.3B-405B), churn runs roughly five times the net accuracy delta, and cells scoring identically to their baseline still disagree on individual items. In a preregistered audit of 17 equivalence claims from three registered frames (method papers, model cards, vendor documentation), 16 are eligible. None states a prospective numerical equivalence margin, and none releases task-matched per-item outputs, though 3 release outputs for other tasks only; 5 report too little to assess numerically, so a reader cannot check them at any sample size. We audit evidential sufficiency, not truth: no claim is called false. We supply the missing instrument: paired equivalence testing at a declared margin, with certification tables giving the items an evaluation needs, computed from disagreement observed under compression, not from independent-binomial variance. A controlled experiment pairs GPTQ and AWQ on byte-identical calibration samples across five seeds. Under the frozen eight-cell decision rule H3 is supported: changing the calibration draw was sufficient to reverse the observed method ordering in 5 of 8 confirmatory cells. The reporting standard we propose is five lines: declare a margin, run the paired test, report churn beside net delta, cite the sample size you met, release per-item outputs. It applies to any comparison between two models alike enough to be worth comparing. All per-item outputs, protocols and code are released.

AI.tldr: 本文指出用基准准确率的净差值来证明压缩模型与原模型等价是极不可靠的，因为净差会掩盖逐项样本的变化（churn）。作者在1,707个配对模型-任务单元中发现在净准确率差异约五倍大的逐项分歧，并审计了17个等价性声明，全部缺乏前瞻性数值边界和任务匹配的逐项输出。作者提出配对等价性检验工具、证明所需样本量的认证表，并建议五行的报告标准。对照实验表明（GPTQ vs AWQ）在5/8的确认单元中仅改变校准抽样顺序即可逆转方法排序。
AI.motivation: 目前压缩模型等价性多用基准准确率的一小部分差值作为证据，但净差值度量在模型最相似时最不具信息量，因为符号相反的逐项变化会相互抵消。需要更严谨的统计工具和报告标准来核实等价性声明。
AI.method: 1) 挖掘1,707个配对模型-任务单元的公共逐项评测数据（1.3B-405B），测量churn与净差值的关系；2) 预注册审计17个等价性声明（来自方法论文、模型卡、供应商文档）；3) 提出配对等价性检验（在声明边界下）及认证表；4) 用GPTQ vs AWQ在字节相同校准样本上、五个随机种子的对照实验验证。
AI.result: churn约为净准确率差异的五倍；16/17个等价性声明可审计但无一声明前瞻性数值边界；3个仅发布其他任务输出，5个报告信息不足以致无法在任何样本量下核验。对照实验中，冻结节决策规则下H3得到支持：5/8的确认单元中仅改变校准抽样即足以反转方法排序。
AI.conclusion: 等价性声明需要规范化的报告框架：声明边界、运行配对检验、报告churn与净差值、引用满足的样本量、发布逐项输出。该标准适用于任何足够相似值得比较的两个模型之间，且所有数据、协议和代码均已发布。

title: LLM-Based Hierarchical Coordinated Control with Continuation-Aware Policy Learning
summary: Coordinating multiple interacting units in complex engineering systems is challenging when system interactions are difficult to model, operational information is heterogeneous, and low-level actions must satisfy strict constraints. We propose an LLM-based hierarchical framework in which the LLM coordinates interacting units based on heterogeneous operational context, while task-specific controllers or optimizers generate executable and constraint-aware actions. We further introduce Continuation-Aware GRPO to capture the consequences of coordination decisions over subsequent control intervals. Rather than judging a decision only by its immediate outcome, the method also evaluates how the system evolves afterward under the current policy. We validate the framework on multi-ramp traffic control and virtual power plant (VPP) energy management, using simplified system models for training and more realistic simulators for evaluation. Across both tasks, the proposed method consistently outperforms direct task-specific control and optimization, end-to-end reinforcement learning, rule-based and RL-based hierarchical coordination, and prompting-only LLM coordinators, demonstrating the value of heterogeneous-context reasoning, hierarchical execution, and continuation-aware policy learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的分层框架，用于协调复杂工程系统中的多个交互单元。LLM基于异构操作信息进行高层协调，而任务特定的控制器/优化器生成满足约束的可执行动作。此外，引入Continuation-Aware GRPO算法，通过评估协调决策对后续控制区间系统演化的影响来学习策略。在交通匝道控制和虚拟电厂能量管理两个任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 复杂工程系统中多个交互单元的协调面临三大挑战：系统交互难以建模、操作信息异构、底层动作需满足严格约束。传统方法（端到端强化学习、直接任务特定控制）难以同时处理这些挑战。
AI.method: 1) LLM分层框架：LLM负责基于异构上下文进行高层协调决策，任务特定控制器/优化器生成可执行且满足约束的低层动作。2) Continuation-Aware GRPO：一种新的策略学习方法，不仅评估协调决策的即时结果，还评估系统在当前策略下后续时段的演化后果。3) 训练与评估分离：用简化系统模型训练，用更真实的模拟器评估。
AI.result: 在多重匝道交通控制和虚拟电厂（VPP）能量管理两个任务上，所提方法一致优于直接任务特定控制和优化、端到端强化学习、基于规则和RL的分层协调、以及仅用提示的LLM协调器。
AI.conclusion: 异质上下文推理、分层执行和延续感知策略学习的有机结合，能够有效提升复杂系统中多单元协调的表现。

title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets
comment: Code is available at https://github.com/NineAbyss/R-3-Bench . The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/R-3-Bench/R-3-Bench
summary: In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value. Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce $R^3$-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic settings. Matched single-problem response curves define an offline empirical oracle over observed successes. Across 72 main-table cells for six models, the oracle mean matches or exceeds the contest mean in all cells and is strictly higher in 71. Under moderate tool-free pressure, equal-allocation replay also exceeds contest performance for four of six models. Trajectory diagnostics reveal limited strategy updating and pressure-dependent failure patterns. In a three-model diagnostic under strong agentic pressure, at least one fixed scheduler exceeds the contest mean in six of nine cells, but no policy dominates across domains. These results expose a persistent gap between demonstrated competence and shared-budget realization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R³-Bench基准，用于评估模型在共享计算预算下完成六问题套件（数学、竞赛编程、抽象推理）的表现。通过匹配单问题响应曲线构建离线经验oracle，在72个主表单元格中oracle均值全部达到或超过比赛均值（71个严格更高）。结果表明模型的单问题能力与共享预算下的实际表现之间存在持续差距。
AI.motivation: 现有推理和智能体基准大多使用独立的每任务预算，而共享预算研究未能将套件表现与同一模型在单问题上的已知能力进行校准，缺乏对资源理性分配的系统评估。
AI.method: 引入R³-Bench框架：1) 在数学、竞赛编程和抽象推理领域构建六问题套件；2) 在无工具和智能体两种设置下评估共享预算分配；3) 利用匹配的单问题响应曲线构建离线经验oracle（基于观察到的成功）；4) 采用轨迹诊断分析策略更新和压力相关的失败模式。
AI.result: 72个主表单元格中，oracle均值在所有单元格达到或超过比赛均值，其中71个严格更高。在中等无工具压力下，等量分配重现对四个模型的比赛表现超过基线。强智能体压力诊断中，至少一个固定调度器在九格中的六格超过比赛均值，但无策略在所有领域占优。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了模型展示的单问题能力与共享预算下实际资源分配实现之间存在持续且显著的差距，表明现有模型在资源理性分配方面仍有明显不足。

title: Self-Supervised Topologically Invariant Manifold Learning for Railway Image Quality Assessment
summary: Existing blind image quality assessment (BIQA) methods typically rely on synthetic distortions and subjective annotations, limiting generalization in real-world domains. To address this, we propose a fully self-supervised BIQA framework based on topologically invariant manifold learning under boundary constraints, which constructs a stable quality reference without manual labels. The framework generates progressive background dilution scales via repeated random cropping around each target; exploiting the monotonic degradation of target information density across these scales, it establishes a self-constrained quality manifold. A linearized spatial moment projection eliminates geometric distortions from random cropping; then a monotonicity divergence filter prunes background-sensitive evaluators, isolating an elite pool \(\mathcal{M}_{\text{elite}}\). A robust M-estimator with a principal component stabilizer fuses the metrics into an asymptotically efficient pseudo-ground truth \(q_{\text{PGT}}\), contracting variance toward the Cramér-Rao lower bound. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the elite evaluator pool, distilled from 11 baseline metrics, secures superior zero-shot transferability across standard synthetic and wild benchmarks (CSIQ, LIVEC, LIVE-2). Concurrently, deployments on the CQU Railway Rolling Stock Surveillance Dataset (2,797 images) yield a manifold cosine similarity \(>0.999\) and a 100.0\% survival rate under industrial extreme stresses, robustly validating its cross-paradigm decoupling and topological resilience.

AI.tldr: 提出一种完全自监督的盲图像质量评估（BIQA）框架，基于边界约束下的拓扑不变流形学习，无需人工标注即可构建稳定的质量参考。通过随机裁剪生成渐进背景稀释尺度，利用线性化空间矩投影和单调性发散滤波筛选精英评估器池，并融合出逼近Cramér-Rao下界的伪地面真值。实验在合成与真实基准上展现出优异的零样本迁移能力，并在工业数据集上验证了拓扑鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有BIQA方法依赖合成失真和主观标注，导致在真实世界域中泛化能力有限。作者旨在摆脱对人工标签的依赖，构建无需先验标注的自监督质量评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 通过重复随机裁剪生成渐进背景稀释尺度，利用目标信息密度的单调递减特性建立自约束质量流形；2) 线性化空间矩投影消除随机裁剪带来的几何失真；3) 单调性发散滤波器剔除背景敏感评估器，筛出精英池；4) 采用带主成分稳定器的鲁棒M估计器融合指标，生成渐近有效的伪地面真值q_PGT，方差收敛至Cramér-Rao下界。
AI.result: 从11个基线指标中蒸馏出的精英评估器池，在CSIQ、LIVEC、LIVE-2等合成及野生基准上展现优异零样本迁移性；在CQU铁路滚动车辆监控数据集（2797张图像）上获得流形余弦相似度>0.999，极端工业应力下存活率100%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在无标注条件下实现了跨范式的质量评估解耦，验证了拓扑不变流形学习在真实世界BIQA中的有效性，同时具备出色的工业部署鲁棒性。

title: Online Convex Optimization with Dueling Feedback
summary: We study online convex optimization with dueling (pairwise comparison) feedback, where the learner observes only a binary preference between two queried points. While dueling feedback is well understood in discrete or stochastic settings, the adversarial convex setting has remained unexplored. We propose a simple reduction that converts dueling feedback into approximate gradients, enabling the use of standard first-order methods. We show that regret guarantees transfer under this reduction, yielding the first results for this setting, including $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ static, adaptive, and dynamic regret. Under additional structure, we obtain improved rates of $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ for smooth objectives and $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T \log T})$ for strongly convex functions.
