AI.conclusion: PDF语料库的统计报告必须同时使用文档和token两种单位，否则会严重误导对语料库内容构成和质量的理解。现有的截断恢复手段远不足以补救文本损失，需要重新审视语料库构建策略。

title: Feed-Forward Hierarchical Gaussian Diffusion for Extreme CT Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing three-dimensional computed tomography (CT) from severely constrained projections is highly ill-posed. Sparse angular sampling, restricted angular coverage, and low photon counts can occur individually or jointly, obscuring global anatomy and local tissue detail. Many learned CT reconstruction methods are tailored to a single dominant degradation. Existing diffusion and Gaussian approaches commonly recover global structure and local detail within a shared representation. We propose HiGDiff, a feed-forward hierarchical Gaussian diffusion framework that decomposes reconstruction both spatially and from structure to detail. Physics-conditioned anatomical anchors and a foreground capacity field allocate learnable Gaussian primitives to informative regions. A structure diffusion stage first recovers global attenuation geometry, and its learned representation conditions a detail diffusion stage for residual boundaries and tissue transitions. The resulting Gaussian banks are rendered as attenuation fields and further refined by a gradient-isolated residual module. Experiments on three distinct CT benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art reconstruction performance across isolated, paired, and joint degradation settings, including improvements of 5.81 dB in macro-average peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and 0.113 in structural similarity index measure (SSIM) on the Low Dose CT Image and Projection Data (LDCT-PD) collection. Code and experimental configurations are openly available at https://github.com/Bean-Young/HiGDiff.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiGDiff，一个前馈式分层高斯扩散框架，用于从严重受限投影中重建三维CT图像。该方法在空间维度和结构到细节维度上对重建进行分解：先通过结构扩散阶段恢复全局衰减几何，再利用其表示条件化细节扩散阶段恢复边界和组织过渡，最终通过梯度隔离残差模块细化。在三个CT基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 严重受限投影下的CT重建是高度病态问题。稀疏角度采样、受限角度覆盖和低光子数可能单独或联合出现，同时模糊全局解剖结构和局部组织细节。现有学习方法通常针对单一主要退化设计，而扩散和高斯方法在共享表示中恢复全局结构和局部细节，缺乏层次化的分解策略。
AI.method: HiGDiff采用前馈式分层高斯扩散框架：(1) 物理条件化的解剖锚点和前景容量场将可学习的伽马（Gaussian）基元分配到信息丰富区域；(2) 结构扩散阶段先恢复全局衰减几何；(3) 其学习表示条件化细节扩散阶段，用于恢复残差边界和组织过渡；(4) 生成的高斯库被渲染为衰减场，并通过梯度隔离残差模块进一步细化。
AI.result: 在三个不同的CT基准数据集上，HiGDiff在孤立、配对和联合退化设置下均达到最先进的性能。在LDCT-PD数据集上，宏平均PSNR提升5.81 dB，SSIM提升0.113。
AI.conclusion: 分层分解结构-细节的扩散方法能同时有效处理多种CT退化场景，优于针对单一退化的现有方法。代码已开源。

title: Does 1/2-Tsallis-INF Also Work Well for Best-Arm Identification?
summary: Regret minimization (RM) and best-arm identification (BAI) are two fundamental objectives in multi-armed bandits. Among regret-minimizing algorithms, $1/2$-Tsallis-INF is a canonical best-of-both-worlds FTRL algorithm: it achieves logarithmic pseudo-regret in stochastic bandits while retaining minimax-optimal regret in adversarial bandits, without knowing the environment in advance. This raises a natural question: can the same algorithm, without additional exploration, also identify the best arm reliably? We study this question in stochastic bandits by analyzing the failure probability $\operatorname{Err}_t$, defined as the probability that the empirical best arm determined by the cumulative importance-weighted loss estimates of 1/2-Tsallis-INF differs from the true optimal arm. The main difficulty is that, at the logarithmic-regret scale, suboptimal arms are sampled with probability heuristically of order $1/t$. Consequently, importance weighting causes the cumulative estimator to fluctuate on the same linear scale as its mean separation. To overcome this obstacle, guided by a diffusion toy model, we construct a Lyapunov function for the gap process between the estimated cumulative loss of the optimal arm and that of the best competing arm. This leads to polynomial upper bounds on $\operatorname{Err}_t$: for learning rate $η_t=α/\sqrt t$, $\operatorname{Err}_t$ decays at rate $t^{-2+α^2μ_{i_*}/4+ρ}$ for any $ρ>0$, where $μ_{i_*}$ denotes the mean loss of the true optimal arm. We also establish a lower bound $Ω(t^{-2-\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon>0$, showing that the exponent $2$ is essentially tight.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1/2-Tsallis-INF这一后悔最小化算法在随机赌博机中是否也能可靠地识别最优臂。作者通过构造Lyapunov函数分析最优臂与次优臂之间累积损失估计的间隙过程，证明了算法识别错误概率的多项式上界，并建立了本质上紧的下界。
AI.motivation: 1/2-Tsallis-INF是最优的"两全其美"FTRL算法，在随机和对抗性环境中都能达到最优后悔界。一个自然的问题是：这种仅以后悔最小化为目标的算法，不做额外探索，是否也能可靠地识别最优臂？这个问题对于理解后悔最小化与最优臂识别两种目标之间的内在关系至关重要。
AI.method: 作者定义了错误概率Err_t为基于累积重要性加权损失估计的经验最优臂与真实最优臂不一致的概率。关键在于次优臂被采样的概率约为1/t量级（在logarithmic后悔尺度下），导致重要性加权使累积估计在与其均值差相同的线性尺度上波动。为克服这一困难，作者以扩散玩具模型为指导，为最优臂与最佳竞争臂之间的估计累积损失差构造Lyapunov函数。
AI.result: 在学习率η_t=α/√t下，错误概率Err_t以速率t^{-2+α^2μ_{i_*}/4+ρ}衰减（任意ρ>0），其中μ_{i_*}为最优臂的均值损失。同时建立了下界Ω(t^{-2-ε})（任意ε>0），表明指数2本质上是紧的。
AI.conclusion: 1/2-Tsallis-INF算法在无需额外探索的情况下，确实能以多项式速度可靠地识别最优臂，其错误概率指数2是本质上最优的。这表明后悔最小化算法可能天然具备最优臂识别的能力，为理解两类目标之间的协同关系提供了理论依据。

title: SkillCommit: Evolving Agent Skills through Behaviorally Validated Scope Expansion
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can continually improve without parameter updates by converting historical experience into reusable procedural knowledge. However, existing methods often consolidate experience based on semantic similarity or LLM judgments, which may merge superficially related but behaviorally incompatible strategies and thereby degrade performance. To address the issue, we propose SkillCommit, an online skill evolution framework that continuously transforms experience into a hierarchical library of reusable skills. Each new experience is initially preserved as an instance-specific patch, retaining the behavior validated in its local context. As related skills accumulate, SkillCommit abstracts those sharing a common behavioral mechanism into higher-level skills. Specifically, for each incoming skill, embedding-based retrieval first identifies candidate related skills. Cross-instance replay and an LLM-based mechanism check determine whether these skills transfer across cases and share a common underlying mechanism. Candidates that pass both checks are abstracted into a higher-level skill and committed only if it preserves the validated behavior of all constituent skills. Experiments on RuleArena, OpenExempt and KOR-Bench demonstrate that SkillCommit consistently improves agent performance across diverse domains. Moreover, the learned skills transfer across model scales and families, enabling cross-model experience transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出了SkillCommit框架，一个在线技能演化系统，通过将经验转化为层级化可复用技能库来持续提升LLM智能体性能，不涉及参数更新。
AI.motivation: 现有的经验整合方法通常基于语义相似度或LLM判断来合并经验，这可能导致将表面相关但行为上不兼容的策略合并在一起，从而降低性能。需要一个更严格的机制来确保合并的技能真正共享共同的行为机制。
AI.method: SkillCommit提出层级化技能库框架：1) 新经验先作为实例特定补丁保留；2) 当相关技能积累时，通过嵌入检索识别候选相关技能；3) 通过跨实例回放和基于LLM的机制检查来判断技能是否可迁移且共享底层机制；4) 只有通过两项检查的候选才会被抽象为更高级技能，且仅当该技能保留所有组成技能的验证行为时才提交。
AI.result: 在RuleArena、OpenExempt和KOR-Bench上的实验表明，SkillCommit持续提升智能体在不同领域的性能，且学到的技能可以跨模型尺度和模型家族迁移，实现跨模型经验转移。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于行为机制而非仅语义相似度来抽象技能，SkillCommit能更可靠地将经验固化为可复用技能，并支持跨模型的经验复用。

title: D2-ScaleAgent: Dual-Dimensional Scaling for Long Document Understanding
summary: Multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a key technique for visually rich long document understanding. Existing multi-modal RAG methods are progressively advancing toward multi-agent systems: they first retrieve relevant pages based on a query, and then iteratively understand information within those pages. However, these methods typically rely on fixed workflows and lack the ability to dynamically scale computation at test time, often leading to insufficient evidence. To address this, we propose D2-ScaleAgent, an agentic framework that introduces a dual-dimensional scaling paradigm for retrieval and reasoning. The core of D2-ScaleAgent is a Verifier agent-driven dynamic routing loop based on the intrinsic difficulty of the query, centered around a continuously updated evidence bank that serves as the agent's dynamic working memory: when retrieval needs to be expanded, the agent routes outward (retrieval scaling), decomposing the query into attributes and performing parallel page retrieval, followed by adaptive pruning to ensure comprehensive evidence coverage. When fine-grained reasoning is required, the agent routes inward (reasoning scaling), dynamically selecting sub-agents with varying granularity and count to extract evidence from pages. Finally, D2-ScaleAgent achieves logical closure over the evidence chain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that D2-ScaleAgent is effective on long and visually rich document benchmarks like MMLongBench-Doc, LongDocURL, etc.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D2-ScaleAgent，一个基于双维度缩放范式的多模态RAG智能体框架，通过Verifier驱动的动态路由循环，在检索和推理两个维度上根据查询难度动态扩展计算，解决现有固定工作流多智能体RAG方法证据不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态RAG方法虽已向多智能体系统演进，但依赖固定工作流，缺乏在测试时动态扩展计算的能力，常导致证据覆盖不足，无法有效处理复杂查询。
AI.method: 提出D2-ScaleAgent框架，核心是Verifier智能体驱动的动态路由循环，基于查询内在难度，围绕持续更新的证据库（动态工作记忆）运作。检索扩展时向外路由，将查询分解为属性并并行检索页面后自适应剪枝；推理需求时向内路由，动态选择不同粒度和数量的子智能体从页面提取证据，最终实现证据链的逻辑闭合。
AI.result: 在MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL等长且视觉丰富文档基准上，D2-ScaleAgent展现了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 双维度（检索和推理）动态缩放范式能有效提升多模态RAG在复杂长文档理解任务上的表现，通过动态调整计算资源来确保证据的充分覆盖。

title: ENAF: A Multi-Exit Network with an Adaptive Patch Fusion for Large Image Super Resolution
summary: To accelerate single image super-resolution (SISR) networks on large images (2K-8K), many recent approaches decompose an image into small patches and dynamically determine an execution path according to its difficulty (referred to as a dynamic network). To quantify the hardness of a patch, they mainly rely on a handcrafted assessment score, e.g., edge, which weakly associates a patch's texture with the computational complexity of a SISR model. To address the problem, we introduce ENAF - a dynamic network for SISR with an adaptive patch fusion. Built on top of a backbone, ENAF incorporates multiple early exits (EEs) to tackle the over-parameterized SISR model. More importantly, ENAF plugs a tiny network that estimates PSNR to associate data texture with a computation cost at an EE. Based on the scores, ENAF effectively assigns image patches to an exit, enhancing the quality-complexity trade-off. Extensive experiments on common datasets with popular SISR backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of ENAF in various settings. The source code is provided in https://github.com/nmduonggg/ENAF

AI.tldr: ENAF是一种用于单图像超分辨率的动态网络，通过多个早期退出和自适应补丁融合机制，利用tiny网络估计PSNR来关联图像纹理与计算成本，从而在质量和复杂度之间取得更好的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的大图像SISR动态网络方法主要依赖手工设计的评估分数（如边缘检测）来衡量补丁的难度，但这种手工分数与SISR模型实际的计算复杂度关联较弱，无法准确反映补丁纹理与计算需求之间的关系。
AI.method: ENAF在骨干网络基础上集成多个早期退出（EEs），并嵌入一个tiny网络来估计PSNR，从而将数据纹理与EE处的计算成本相关联。根据这些分数，ENAF有效地将图像补丁分配到不同的退出点，实现自适应补丁融合。
AI.result: 在常见数据集和流行SISR骨干网络上的大量实验证明了ENAF在多种设置下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过用学习到的PSNR估计网络替代手工设计的难度评分，ENAF能够更精准地分配计算资源，显著改善质量-复杂度权衡，为大规模图像超分辨率提供了更优的动态推理方案。

title: Beyond Field Accuracy: Two-Axis Diagnosis of Inverse-PINN Parameter Error
comment: Preprint with supplementary appendix. 26 pages, 3 figures
summary: Inverse physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can reconstruct a field accurately while returning an incorrect physical parameter. We introduce a two-axis post-training diagnosis that separates finite-sample resolution under a specified observation-and-estimation protocol from the signed parameter preference encoded by the final learned field and residual metric. The first axis repeatedly fits noisy observations with a matched forward estimator. At known synthetic truth, the second freezes the field and residual view and computes a local score displacement toward a nearby residual-profile minimum. Endpoint consistency then tests whether joint training delivers that preference under the same final view. Across three synthetic one-dimensional, scalar-parameter PDEs, matched-forward mean absolute relative error ranges from 2.34 percent to 17.46 percent. The displacement tracks frozen-profile minima across locked seeds, architectures, and fresh-noise retraining (r from .945 to .982), and it tracks delivered signed log-error in 240 fresh-noise RBA runs (r = .994; 237/240 correct directions). A coupled two-parameter Darcy check validates the full matrix calculation. The axes are complementary diagnostic coordinates, not additive error components or a deployable oracle-free estimator. Together, they route follow-up work toward observations, residual evidence, or endpoint delivery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两轴训练后诊断方法，用于区分逆向物理信息神经网络（PINNs）中参数辨识失败的来源：一是有限样本分辨率（观测与估计协议下的匹配性），二是最终学习场与残差度量所编码的符号参数偏好。通过合成实验验证了诊断坐标的有效性。
AI.motivation: 逆向PINNs在重建场时可能准确，但返回的物理参数却是错误的。现有方法缺乏系统性的诊断工具来定位参数偏差的根源，因此需要一种能够将"有限样本分辨率不足"与"参数偏好方向错误"分离的诊断框架。
AI.method: 提出两轴诊断：(1) 第一轴——在指定观测与估计协议下，用匹配的前向估计器重复拟合带噪声观测，评估有限样本分辨率；(2) 第二轴——冻结场与残差视图，计算向邻近残差剖面最小值的方向位移，测试局部得分偏好。通过端点一致性检验联合训练是否在该视图下交付了这种偏好。
AI.result: 在三个一维标量参数PDE上，匹配前向估计器的平均绝对相对误差为2.34%至17.46%。位移与冻结剖面最小值在锁定种子、架构和重新训练下高度相关（r=0.945至0.982），且在240次新鲜噪声RBA运行中与交付的符号对数误差高度相关（r=0.994，237/240方向正确）。两参数Darcy耦合问题验证了完整矩阵计算。
AI.conclusion: 两轴是互补的诊断坐标，而非可加误差分量或可部署的无预言机估计器。它们共同将后续工作引导至观测质量、残差证据或端点交付三个方向。

title: When Context Misleads: Intent-Guided Decoding for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves large language models by grounding generation in external evidence, but it also introduces a source trust problem: retrieved context may be useful, irrelevant, or even misleading. Existing RAG systems often apply a fixed trust policy toward retrieved evidence, which can either over-trust incorrect context or underuse context when the user explicitly asks for context-following behavior. Therefore, we propose Intent-Guided Decoding (IGD), a framework that arbitrates between retrieved context and parametric memory according to user intent. IGD uses answer-level filtering and token-level correction to steer the final decoding trajectory between retrieved context and parametric memory. We evaluate IGD on three faithful QA benchmarks and three factual-conflict benchmarks across five LLMs, IGD substantially improves factual recovery, achieving gains of up to 65.4 percentage points on factual-conflict benchmarks over Direct RAG, while preserving or improving strict context-following behavior, this findings highlight the importance of balancing factuality and faithfulness in RAG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Intent-Guided Decoding (IGD)框架，根据用户意图在检索上下文与参数记忆之间进行仲裁，通过答案级过滤和token级校正来引导解码轨迹，在事实冲突基准上相比Direct RAG最高提升65.4个百分点的事实恢复率，同时保持或改善严格上下文跟随行为。
AI.motivation: RAG系统在引入外部证据提升大模型生成能力的同时带来了源信任问题：检索到的上下文可能有用、无关甚至误导。现有RAG系统对检索证据采用固定信任策略，要么过度信任错误上下文，要么在用户明确要求上下文跟随行为时未能充分利用上下文，缺乏根据用户意图动态调整信任度的能力。
AI.method: IGD框架通过两层机制在检索上下文和参数记忆之间进行仲裁：1) 答案级过滤（answer-level filtering）用于决策整体生成方向；2) token级校正（token-level correction）用于逐token引导最终的解码轨迹，从而在事实性与忠实性之间实现动态平衡。
AI.result: 在三个忠实QA基准和三个事实冲突基准上、跨越五个LLM的评估中，IGD在事实冲突基准上相比Direct RAG实现了高达65.4个百分点的事实恢复率提升，同时保持或改善了严格上下文跟随行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明在RAG中平衡事实性（factuality）和忠实性（faithfulness）至关重要，IGD框架证明了根据用户意图动态仲裁检索上下文与参数记忆的有效性。

title: Decomposing Whole Slide Image Report Generation with Graph-Constrained Multiple Instance Learning Workflows
comment: Accepted at the MICCAI 2026 REG Challenge
summary: Whole-slide image (WSI) report generation requires recognizing spatially distributed pathological features and organizing them into a coherent diagnostic narrative. Although direct vision-to-text models can yield fluent reports, they obscure the contributions and failure modes of visual recognition, structured reasoning, and language generation. We propose a decomposed framework in which frozen Virchow2 tile embeddings are aggregated by multiple-instance learning (MIL) classification heads that answer organ-specific diagnostic questions. An organ-conditioned graph constrains the assembly of these answers into a structured reasoning chain, which a language model realizes as a pathology report. On the REG2026 held-out set of 2,028 slides, the proposed workflow achieved a chain-Jaccard score of 0.702. Performance fell to 0.420 without graph-based chain construction, 0.398 when the organ-specific graphs were replaced by a single organ-agnostic graph, and 0.371 when the language model constructed the chain freely from MIL predictions. Using the same report generator, graph-structured chains improved the report score from 0.330 to 0.495. On 350 external TCGA WSIs spanning the seven REG organs without fine-tuning, the expected organ graph was selected in 64.0% of cases and ranked among the top three in 86.6%. Providing the correct organ graph increased agreement with coarse TCGA primary-diagnosis labels from 61.8% to 92.6%, identifying organ routing as a main bottleneck under domain shift. Overall, organ-conditioned, graph-constrained chain assembly improves structured reasoning and report generation while enabling stage-specific error localization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分解式的全玻片图像（WSI）报告生成框架，将流程拆分为视觉识别（MIL分类头）、结构化推理（器官条件图约束的推理链）和语言生成（语言模型生成报告）三个阶段。在REG2026测试集上链式Jaccard分数达0.702，报告分数从0.330提升至0.495，并能实现阶段级错误定位。
AI.motivation: 直接视觉到文本（vision-to-text）的WSI报告生成模型虽然能生成流畅报告，但无法清晰追踪各个组件的贡献和失败模式，即视觉识别、结构化推理和语言生成之间的边界模糊，导致错误难以定位和诊断。
AI.method: 框架由三部分组成：(1) 使用冻结的Virchow2 tile嵌入，通过多实例学习（MIL）分类头聚合特征并回答器官特异的诊断问题；(2) 器官条件的图结构约束这些答案的组装，形成结构化推理链；(3) 语言模型将推理链转化为病理报告。
AI.result: 在2028张REG2026测试集上链式Jaccard分数0.702；去除图约束降至0.420，器官无关图降至0.398，自由构建链降至0.371。使用相同报告生成器，图结构链将报告分数从0.330提升至0.495。外部350张TCGA WSI上，正确器官图选择率64.0%，前三名86.6%；提供正确器官图将粗粒度诊断标签一致性从61.8%提升至92.6%。
AI.conclusion: 器官条件、图约束的链式组装方法能显著提升结构化推理和报告生成质量，同时实现阶段特异性错误定位，并揭示跨域迁移下器官路由是主要瓶颈。

title: Every Expert Counts: ExactMoE for Memory-Efficient W4A16 Inference
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models reduce arithmetic by activating only a small subset of experts per token, yet deployment still requires storing and moving the full expert bank. We present ExactMoE, an inference design that applies symmetric group-128 four-bit weight quantization only to routed experts, stores those experts in kernel-native MARLIN form in pinned host memory, and executes all selected experts through a configurable GPU-resident slot cache and fused grouped MoE kernels. The router, attention, embeddings, normalization layers, and language-model head remain in BF16. "Exact" refers to complete expert availability and an unchanged top-k routing procedure: no expert is pruned, substituted, or forced to execute on the CPU. It does not imply numerical identity with the BF16 model. On OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct, evaluated on a single NVIDIA L4, a 16-slot configuration reduces peak reserved GPU memory from 14.168 to 1.836 GiB (87.04%) while retaining 81.85% of BF16 decode throughput. A fully resident 64-slot configuration reaches 31.923 tokens/s versus 21.662 tokens/s for BF16 while reserving 4.061 GiB. Across 12,450 zero-shot multiple-choice questions, ExactMoE obtains 70.3534% normalized accuracy versus 70.8996% for BF16, retaining 99.23% of the baseline accuracy. In a matched 16-token ablation, fused grouped execution is 1.97x as fast as a sequential W4 reference. These results identify a practical memory-transfer-throughput frontier for complete-expert MoE inference.

AI.tldr: ExactMoE是一种稀疏混合专家（MoE）语言模型的推理设计方案，通过对路由专家应用对称group-128四比特权重量化，并将其以MARLIN格式存储在主机端固定内存中，配合GPU驻留槽缓存和融合分组MoE内核来执行所有被选中的专家，从而在保持完整专家可用性和不变top-k路由的前提下，大幅降低GPU显存占用同时维持较高吞吐和准确率。
AI.motivation: 虽然稀疏MoE语言模型每次仅激活一小部分专家，降低了算术计算量，但其部署仍然需要存储和移动完整的专家库，导致GPU显存占用过高。作者旨在解决这一部署瓶颈，探索内存-传输-吞吐之间的权衡边界。
AI.method: 仅对路由专家应用对称group-128四比特权重量化，以内核原生MARLIN格式存储在固定主机内存中，通过可配置的GPU驻留槽缓存和融合分组MoE内核执行所有被选中的专家。路由器、注意力、嵌入、归一化层和语言模型头保持BF16精度。保持完整的专家可用性和不变的top-k路由过程。
AI.result: 在OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct和单个NVIDIA L4上：16槽配置将峰值GPU显存从14.168降至1.836 GiB（降低87.04%），同时保留81.85%的BF16解码吞吐；64槽全驻留配置达到31.923 tokens/s（BF16为21.662 tokens/s），保留4.061 GiB显存；在12,450道零样本多选题中达到70.3534%归一化准确率（BF16为70.8996%），保留99.23%基线准确率；融合分组执行比顺序W4参考快1.97倍。
AI.conclusion: ExactMoE识别了一条实用的内存-传输-吞吐前沿边界，证明通过四比特量化、主机端存储和融合内核的组合，可以在几乎不损失准确率的同时显著降低GPU显存占用，甚至在某些配置下超越BF16的解码吞吐。

title: Demographic Injection in Medical Language Models under Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Prompts
summary: Clinical-AI guidance increasingly recommends prompting language models to reason with attention to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). We measure a side effect that misrepresents patients: a one-sentence DEI prompt appended to a medical question leads models to add patient demographic attributes (race, socioeconomic status, sex) the question never stated, in effect rewriting who the patient is. We call this demographic injection. Across 47 models, four medical benchmarks, and 376,000 responses scored by a validated model-judge pipeline, a single DEI prompt raises the injection rate from 0.7% to 33.1% (47x) in all 47 of 47 models, attributable to the equity content rather than to added length (18x above a length-matched control; p=1.4x10^-14). Most added content is a general population statement that leaves the answer unchanged, but a smaller subset attaches an attribute to the specific patient or changes the selected option (0.25-2.4% of responses, 99.8% toward the incorrect option), where the invented demographic changes the answer the model recommends. Phrasing scales the effect from 14% to 56%. DEI prompts are just one example of a more general mechanism. Any instruction that nudges how a model reasons can make it add unrequested details, including details about the patient. Flagged outputs are treated as model errors under study, not clinical guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文发现一个副作用：在医疗问题后附加一句DEI（多样性、平等与包容）提示词，会导致语言模型注入患者从未提及的人口统计学属性（种族、社会经济地位、性别），即"人口统计注入"。该现象在47个模型、4个医疗基准、376,000个响应中普遍存在，注入率从0.7%飙升至33.1%（47倍）。虽然大多数注入内容不影响答案，但有一小部分（0.25-2.4%）会改变推荐选项，且99.8%朝错误方向变化。
AI.motivation: 随着临床AI指南日益推荐在提示词中加入DEI考量，研究者意识到这一做法可能带来未预期的副作用——模型会主动为患者"编造"人口统计学属性，从而改变对患者身份的认知，甚至影响医疗建议的正确性。
AI.method: 研究覆盖47个模型、4个医疗基准数据集，生成376,000个响应，使用经过验证的模型评判流水线进行评分。通过对比加入DEI提示词与长度匹配的对照提示词，分离出DEI内容的真实效应，并系统改变措辞以测试效果的规模可调性。
AI.result: 单一DEI提示词使注入率从0.7%升至33.1%（47倍），在全部47个模型中一致出现。相比长度匹配的对照仅为18倍（p=1.4×10^-14）。大多数注入是无关的一般性人群陈述，但0.25-2.4%的响应会将属性附加到具体患者或改变选项，其中99.8%导向错误答案。措辞变化可使效应在14%-56%间波动。
AI.conclusion: DEI提示词只是更普遍机制的一个例子：任何引导模型推理方式的指令都可能使其添加未请求的细节。研究强调这些问题属于模型错误而非临床指导问题，提示需要对AI提示词设计持谨慎态度。

title: STAGE: Controlled Objective Admission for Multi-Preference LLM Alignment
summary: Multi-preference alignment is often framed as scalarization: combine reward dimensions, then optimize. This leaves a temporal decision underspecified: when should each preference dimension enter policy optimization? We propose \methodname, a stability-guided active-set controller for controlled objective admission. \methodname starts from a small active set, retains admitted objectives, and expands when reward-deviation gates indicate low recent deviation or a patience budget is exhausted. A probing phase estimates a hard-to-easy order, and adaptive weighting emphasizes underperforming active dimensions. Automatic evaluations with 15 training preferences and 16 held-out benchmark columns show that \methodname obtains higher averages than simultaneous scalarization and shared-budget adapted baselines. Component ablations and expansion dynamics further support cumulative retention, gated admission, and probing-derived ordering as useful design choices in this setting. These results position objective-entry timing as a concrete control variable in reward-vector RLHF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出\methodname，一种基于稳定性引导的主动集控制器，用于奖励向量RLHF中的多偏好对齐。它通过控制目标进入策略优化的时机（而非同时标量化所有偏好维度），提升了训练偏好和留出基准上的平均性能。
AI.motivation: 多偏好对齐常被简化为标量化问题（合并奖励维度后优化），但这种方法在时间维度上存在缺失：每个偏好维度应该何时进入策略优化？作者认为目标进入时机是一个被忽略但关键的决策变量。
AI.method: \methodname从一个较小的主动偏好集合开始，逐步吸纳新目标：1) 通过奖励偏差门控判断近期偏差是否较低，或耐心预算耗尽时扩展主动集；2) 采用探测阶段估计各目标的难易顺序（从难到易）；3) 自适应权重机制强调表现不佳的主动维度。
AI.result: 在15个训练偏好和16个留出基准列上的自动评估中，\methodname比同时标量化和共享预算自适应基线获得更高平均值。组件消融和扩展动力学实验支持累积保留、门控准入和探测排序等设计选择的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 目标进入时机是多偏好RLHF中的一个具体可控变量，\methodname的稳定性引导主动集控制方法为此提供了有效的解决方案，优于同时标量化方法。

title: A Multi-Annotator Study of Segmentation Noise and Uncertainty in Turbid Underwater Images
comment: accepted at ECCVW'26 - 2nd Workshop on Marine Vision
summary: Label uncertainty and annotator disagreement are common challenges in the field of computer vision, yet their study has largely been confined to the medical domain or to generic image-recognition datasets. Underwater datasets are particularly susceptible to these issues due to the need for domain expertise, degraded visibility conditions, and the inherent difficulty of establishing reliable ground truth in inaccessible environments. Despite these challenges, annotation uncertainty in underwater imagery remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic multi-annotator study of segmentation in real underwater scenes, with over 100 participants, and across varying, controlled levels of turbidity. We show that underwater datasets face many of the same annotation challenges as other vision tasks, while turbidity introduces additional systematic errors. We further investigate the main factors driving label noise and explore ways to improve annotation quality in turbid underwater environments, including privileged information, individual effort and annotator ensembles. All (meta-) data collected in this study will be available on the project page: https://vap.aau.dk/tubcertainty

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地研究了真实水下场景中的多标注者分割标注不确定性，涉及100多名参与者以及不同受控浊度水平，发现水下数据集面临与其他视觉任务类似的标注挑战，且浊度会引入额外的系统性错误。
AI.motivation: 标注不确定性和标注者分歧是计算机视觉中的常见挑战，但此前研究主要集中在医学领域或通用图像识别数据集。水下数据集的标注不确定性尚未被探索，尽管水下环境因需要领域专业知识、能见度差、难以建立可靠地面真值而特别容易受到这些问题的影响。
AI.method: 开展了首个针对真实水下场景分割任务的多标注者系统研究，招募超过100名参与者，在受控的不同浊度水平下进行标注实验。收集元数据，通过对比水下与其他视觉任务的标注挑战，分析浊度带来的系统性误差，并探索驱动标注噪声的主要因素以及改善标注质量的策略（包括特权信息、个人努力和标注者集成）。
AI.result: 水下数据集与其他视觉任务面临相似的标注挑战，同时浊度会引入额外的系统性标注错误。研究识别了驱动标注噪声的主要因素，并验证了特权信息、个人努力和标注者集成为提升浊水环境中标注质量的有效手段。所有数据和元数据将公开在项目页面上。
AI.conclusion: 本研究填补了水下图像标注不确定性研究的空白，为理解和改善水下环境中的标注质量提供了系统性数据和方法论支撑，并为后续水下视觉任务的数据集构建和标注协议设计提供指导。

title: Look Before You Lift: Visual and Quantitative Diagnostics for Topological Deep Learning
summary: Topological deep learning (TDL) methods rely on lifting raw data into higher-order discrete domains such as simplicial complexes, cell complexes, and hypergraphs. In practice, this lifting step is often treated as a black box: practitioners select a lifting and then tune architectures, with limited visibility into whether the induced higher-order connectivity is meaningful for the downstream task. To address this missing diagnostic layer, we propose a visualization technique called TopoExplorer that leverages the strictly augmented Hasse graph form of topological datasets for exploratory data analysis. For the first time, practitioners can easily visualize the incidence- and adjacency-based neighborhoods that define the lifted dataset, as well as read off key graph metrics that describe its structural and feature landscape. Via an extensive set of experiments across many datasets and liftings, we show that several of these metrics correlate with downstream model performance, suggesting they can help inform TDL preprocessing design. Our perspective reframes the TDL workflow from lift-train to lift-look-design-train, enabling more principled, interpretable, and efficient model development. TopoExplorer is hosted at https://topoexplorer.pagekite.me, and its source code is available at github.com/geometric-intelligence/topoexplorer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TopoExplorer，一个基于严格增广Hasse图的拓扑数据集可视化诊断工具，帮助从业者在拓扑深度学习（TDL）工作流中理解lifting步骤产生的拓扑结构，并通过图指标与下游性能的相关性分析，将TDL流程从"lift-train"转变为"lift-look-design-train"。
AI.motivation: TDL方法通常将原始数据提升到高阶离散域（如单纯复形、胞腔复形、超图），但lifting步骤被视为黑箱，从业者缺乏对高阶连通性是否有意义于下游任务的诊断手段。
AI.method: 利用严格增广Hasse图（strictly augmented Hasse graph）作为拓扑数据集的统一表示，提供邻接与关联邻域的可视化，并计算结构性和特征性图指标；通过大量跨数据集和lifting方式的实验验证这些指标与模型性能的相关性。
AI.result: 实验表明多个图指标与下游模型性能存在相关性，证明这些指标可用于指导TDL预处理设计，提升模型开发的原理性、可解释性和效率。
AI.conclusion: 将TDL工作流从"lift-train"重塑为"lift-look-design-train"，为更科学、可解释的拓扑深度学习模型开发提供了新的诊断层和设计指导。

title: Towards Standardized Evaluation in Automated Domain Modeling: Introducing a Benchmark
summary: Domain modeling plays an essential role in domain-driven design, capturing essential entities and their relationships within a specific domain. Despite advancements in automated domain modeling, the absence of standardized benchmarks has hindered the comparative assessment of existing approaches. This paper introduces a benchmark designed to address this gap. The benchmark combines the 45-record Golden UML Modelset (Verbruggen et al., 2025) on Zenodo, as distributed by the Text2UML project of Calamo, Mecella, and Snoeck (Calamo et al., 2025), with the 8-record reference archive of Chen et al. (Chen et al., 2023a,b), enabling the evaluation of automated domain modeling approaches across different levels of complexity and scale. Given a natural language description, the task is to generate a corresponding domain model. For each description, a reference domain model is provided as ground truth. A metric is used to compare the generated domain model with the corresponding ground-truth model. To demonstrate the utility of the benchmark, we evaluate multiple automated domain modeling approaches, including heuristic rule-based methods and LLM-driven strategies. In accordance with the FAIR4RS recommendations (Chue Hong et al., 2022), the benchmark is provided as a research artifact to encourage reuse and support future research on automated domain modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于自动化领域建模评估的标准化基准（Benchmark），结合了45条记录的Golden UML Modelset和8条记录的Chen等人参考档案，共53个自然语言描述及其对应的参考领域模型，并提供了评估指标。作者在该基准上评估了多种自动化领域建模方法（包括启发式规则方法和LLM驱动策略），并遵循FAIR4RS建议将基准作为研究工件公开，以促进该领域的比较研究和可复现性。
AI.motivation: 尽管自动化领域建模（Automated Domain Modeling）已有诸多进展，但缺乏标准化基准（standardized benchmarks），导致现有方法之间的比较评估（comparative assessment）困难，阻碍了该领域的系统化进展。
AI.method: 1) 构建基准：整合45条记录的Golden UML Modelset（来自Text2UML项目）与8条记录的Chen等人参考档案，共53个任务。2) 任务设定：给定自然语言描述，生成对应的领域模型，以参考模型作为ground truth。3) 评估方案：使用指标将生成的领域模型与ground-truth模型进行比较。4) 实验验证：评估多种自动化领域建模方法，包括启发式规则方法和LLM驱动策略。5) 遵循FAIR4RS建议将基准作为开放研究工件发布。
AI.result: 该基准成功展示了其在评估不同自动化领域建模方法（从启发式规则方法到LLM驱动策略）方面的实用性，为领域建模方法的系统比较提供了标准化工具和评估框架。
AI.conclusion: 该基准填补了自动化领域建模领域缺乏标准化评估基准的空白，通过提供可复用的研究工件（遵循FAIR4RS原则），支持未来研究并对不同自动化领域建模方法进行公平比较与持续改进。

title: Ask, Condition or Abstain: Reinforcement Learning for Missing-Premise Reasoning
summary: Answer-only reinforcement learning (RL) trains reasoning models to solve fully specified problems, but many realistic queries omit a premise needed for a unique answer. In this setting, the useful response is not always refusal: the model should ask for the missing premise, condition its answer on the unknown quantity, or abstain when no informative conditional response is available. We present \emph{Ask-Condition-Abstain Reinforcement Learning} (ACA-RL), a data-augmented RL framework for this setting. Its reasoning-graph-guided pipeline converts well-posed problems into missing-premise training instances with localized gap annotations; ACA-RL then trains on these instances with a structured reward over five observable response behaviors. We also introduce the \emph{Missing-Premise Benchmark} (MPB), a 274-instance human-verified benchmark spanning mathematical, logical, and real-world word problems. Across Qwen3 and Llama models, ACA-RL consistently improves on MPB while preserving competitive performance on well-posed reasoning tasks. Together with the released code, MPB, and training data, this work supports a new mission for NLP evaluation: measuring whether models can recognize when a task is underdetermined and handle uncertainty, not only whether they can answer fully specified questions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACA-RL（Ask-Condition-Abstain强化学习框架），用于训练推理模型处理缺少前提条件的问题。通过推理图引导的数据增强管线将完整问题转化为缺失前提的训练实例，并使用五种可观察响应行为的结构化奖励进行训练。同时引入274个人工验证的缺失前提基准MPB，涵盖数学、逻辑和真实世界应用题。实验表明ACA-RL在Qwen3和Llama模型上持续提升MPB性能，同时保持完整问题推理任务的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习主要训练模型解决完全指定的问题，但现实中有许多查询缺少推理所需的前提条件。在这种设定下，最有效的响应不总是拒绝回答——模型应该询问缺失的前提、基于未知量给出条件性回答，或在无法提供信息性回答时选择放弃。需要新的训练框架和评估基准来应对这一问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出ACA-RL框架，采用推理图引导的数据增强管线，将良定义问题转换为缺失前提的训练实例，并带有局部化的间隙标注。2) 对转换后的实例使用五种可观察响应行为（询问、条件回答、放弃等）的结构化奖励进行强化学习训练。3) 提出Missing-Premise Benchmark (MPB)，包含274个人工验证的实例，涵盖数学、逻辑和真实世界词问题。
AI.result: 在Qwen3和Llama系列模型上，ACA-RL在MPB基准上持续取得改进，同时保持良定义推理任务上的竞争性表现。代码、MPB基准和训练数据均已发布。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为NLP评估提出了新使命：不仅要衡量模型能否回答完全指定的问题，还要衡量模型能否识别任务是否欠定并妥善处理不确定性。

title: JoLT: Joint Latent Trajectories for Context-Guided High-Resolution Tiled Generation
comment: 25 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the AI4VA Workshop at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://obvious-research.github.io/jolt/
summary: Although text-to-image generative models produce impressive results, they struggle to generate densely detailed, high-resolution (HR) images. Current literature addresses this issue with a low-to-high-resolution approach. First, a low-resolution (LR) image is generated. Then, an upsampled version is generated using the LR image as an additional cue. In this paper, we present Joint Latent Trajectories (JoLT). To generate an image, JoLT uses two streams that jointly denoise LR and HR latent images at each sampling step. The LR latent controls the overall layout, while the HR latent controls the details. We interconnect both branches to jointly integrate their information. We extensively validate our method, demonstrating its advantages over competing baselines. The resulting images are not only richly detailed but also visually pleasing, opening new avenues for artistic creation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Joint Latent Trajectories (JoLT)，一种双流联合去噪框架，用于文本到图像的高分辨率生成。该方法通过同时去噪低分辨率（LR）和高分辨率（HR）潜变量，LR控制整体布局，HR控制细节，两个分支相互连接以集成信息，显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像生成模型在生成高分辨率、密集细节的图像时表现不佳。当前主流方案采用低到高分辨率的级联方法（先生成LR图像，再以LR为条件生成上采样HR图像），这种方案存在信息传递不充分、生成质量受限的问题。
AI.method: JoLT采用两个并行流，在每个采样步骤中联合去噪LR和HR潜变量。LR潜变量用于控制整体布局，HR潜变量用于控制细节。两个分支相互连接（interconnected），在去噪过程中共同整合信息，实现LR和HR特征的协同生成。
AI.result: 通过大量实验验证，JoLT在生成质量上优于竞争基线方法，生成的图像不仅细节丰富，而且视觉上令人愉悦，为艺术创作开辟了新途径。
AI.conclusion: JoLT通过双流联合去噪的范式，克服了传统低到高分辨率级联方法的局限，实现高质量高分辨率图像生成，展示了在艺术创作等应用方向的广阔前景。

title: Towards a theory of inference-time alignment with unknown rewards
summary: Generative model alignment has received broad interest, and significant progress has been made in supervised fine-tuning and inference-time computation. Yet, alignment has remained poorly understood from a statistical learning perspective. We formulate inference-time alignment as a weak-to-strong learning problem, where a reference policy (weak learner) is assumed to be fairly good and the goal is to produce a strong learner that predicts a good response at test time with arbitrarily high probability. Our problem is formulated as learning from scratch --- everything is learned from data rather than assuming access to a good reward estimate, and thus differs from the existing inference-time alignment theory. Our model shares similarity to the recent work of arXiv:2510.15464, where for each prompt, there could be multiple good responses. Our definition of the alignment learnability follows the PAC learning principle. We introduce a novel combinatorial dimension of the reward class which we call the alignment dimension, and show that it completely characterizes the alignment learnability --- a reward class is alignment learnable if and only if its alignment dimension is finite. The core of our learning procedure works by invoking the ordinary one-inclusion graph algorithm to run a tournament over all pairs of label sets satisfying that neither is a subset of the other. We believe our results might shed light on establishing a complete theoretical understanding towards alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文从统计学习理论的角度研究生成式模型的推理时对齐问题，将其形式化为弱到强学习问题，并引入"对齐维度"这一组合维度，证明其有限性完全刻画了对齐可学习性。
AI.motivation: 生成式模型对齐（alignment）虽在实践上取得显著进展（如监督微调和推理时计算），但从统计学习理论视角仍缺乏深入理解。现有推理时对齐理论假设可获取好的奖励估计，而本文的目标是从数据中直接学习，无需奖励估计。
AI.method: 将推理时对齐形式化为弱到强学习问题，其中参考策略为弱学习器，目标是产生在测试时以任意高概率预测好响应的强学习器。提出奖励类的对齐维度（alignment dimension）这一新的组合维度，并借鉴经典的一包含图（one-inclusion graph）算法，对既不互为子集的标签对集合进行锦标赛式（tournament）对偶比较。
AI.result: 证明对齐维度完全刻画了对齐可学习性：奖励类是可对齐学习的当且仅当其对齐维度有限。每个提示可能有多个好的响应，与arXiv:2510.15464相关工作共享相似性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为建立对齐问题的完整理论理解提供了基础，从PAC学习原则出发给出了对齐可学习性的精确刻画，可能启发后续更深入的理论研究。

title: Decentralized Federated Learning for Heterogeneous Multi-Task Semantic Communication
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Communications
summary: Collaborative training in distributed semantic communication (DSC) networks typically relies on decentralized federated learning (DFL). However, pushing topology-agnostic aggregation into heterogeneous, multi-task environments creates a fundamental bottleneck: it drives negative transfer and overconsensus bias (OCB). This paper introduces a personalized DSC framework that cuts off this cross-task interference. At the node level, a policy-driven multi-path routing mechanism separates task-specific features from shared representations to preserve local fidelity. Across the network, we deploy a "communicationwhile- aggregation" protocol. It calibrates a column-stochastic consensus matrix using task affinities. This limits the system to absorbing complementary knowledge while actively blocking mismatched parameter updates. To bound the convergence, we derive a unified Lyapunov drift analysis. We reveal a strict Ushaped trade-off: deeper topological mixing reduces variance but amplifies structural OCB. Resolving this tension yields a closed-form expression for the optimal aggregation depth. We evaluate the proposed framework on NYU-v2, where the results reveal a clear trade-off between insufficient aggregation and excessive topological mixing. At the analytically derived optimal aggregation depth, our method achieves a 4.77% global relative improvement over the no-aggregation baseline and outperforms decentralized FedAvg, FedAMP, and heuristic max aggregation. We further evaluate the framework on Taskonomy and imperfect wireless links to examine the effects of network-size variation and wireless-link reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种个性化分布式语义通信（DSC）框架，通过策略驱动的多路径路由机制和"通信-聚合"协同协议来切割跨任务干扰，并推导出最优聚合深度的闭式表达式，在NYU-v2等数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 分布式语义通信网络中的协作训练通常依赖去中心化联邦学习（DFL），但将拓扑无关的聚合应用于异构多任务环境会产生负迁移和过度共识偏差（OCB）这一根本瓶颈，亟需解决跨任务干扰问题。
AI.method: 在节点层面，采用策略驱动的多路径路由机制，将任务特定特征与共享表示分离以保持局部保真度；在网络层面，部署"通信-聚合"协议，利用任务亲和度校准列随机共识矩阵，仅吸收互补知识并阻止不匹配的参数更新；通过统一的Lyapunov漂移分析推导收敛界，并得出最优聚合深度的闭式解。
AI.result: 在NYU-v2数据集上，在解析推导出的最优聚合深度下，方法相比无聚合基线实现4.77%的全局相对提升，并优于decentralized FedAvg、FedAMP和启发式最大聚合；同时在Taskonomy和存在无线链路缺陷的场景中验证了网络规模变化和链路可靠性的影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了严格U形的权衡关系：更深层次的拓扑混合可降低方差但会放大结构性过度共识偏差；通过解决这一张力，可得出最优聚合深度的闭式表达式，为DSC网络中个性化聚合提供了理论指导。

title: BabelSteering: Multilingual Safety Alignment via English Steering Vectors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are deployed globally in high-stakes settings, yet most safety research and alignment efforts remain concentrated on English. Thus, users interacting with LLMs in other languages may encounter weaker safeguards despite relying on the same systems for similarly sensitive tasks. In this work, we investigate whether safety signals learned from a high-resource language, like English, can improve multilingual safety. We propose BabelSteering, an activation steering method that acts as a lightweight inference- time intervention, using refusal directions derived from English safety supervision to generalize across languages. Our evaluation includes eight languages and jointly measures refusal of harmful requests, over-refusal, and general task utility. The results show that BabelSteering increases the refusal of harmful requests across languages, with only a marginal to no reduction in task utility but with some increase in refusal of pseudo-harmful prompts. For example, for Gemma 7B, we see an average increase in the refusal of harmful prompts across languages of 11 percentage points (pp), with individual languages like Bengali seeing an increase of 17 pp, with no loss of utility on Global MMLU, while pseudo-harmful refusals increase by 13 pp on average. We also introduce a multilingual translation-and-evaluation pipeline to facilitate future work on cross-lingual safety interventions. Overall, our findings suggest that activation steering may provide a practical, low- cost mechanism for extending English-derived safety signals to other languages. Warning: this paper contains examples with unsafe content

AI.tldr: 本文提出BabelSteering方法，利用从英语中学习到的拒绝方向（activation steering）来提升多语言环境下的LLM安全性，在八种语言上评估显示能有效提高有害请求的拒绝率，同时几乎不影响任务效用，并提供了多语言翻译与评估流程。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM的多数安全研究和对齐工作集中英语，但在非英语语言中用户可能面临较弱的安全防护，尽管他们在同样敏感的任务上依赖相同的系统。因此需要研究如何将高资源语言（如英语）的安全信号迁移到其他语言，以改善多语言安全。
AI.method: 提出BabelSteering，一种基于激活引导（activation steering）的轻量级推理时干预方法，利用从英语安全监督中提取的拒绝对抗方向（refusal directions）来泛化到其他语言。同时引入一个多语言翻译与评估流水线，在八种语言中联合评估有害请求拒绝率、过度拒绝率和通用任务效用。
AI.result: BabelSteering在多种语言上提升了有害请求的拒绝率，任务效用几乎不损失，但伪有害请求（pseudo-harmful prompts）的拒绝率有所增加。例如Gemma 7B上，有害提示拒绝率平均提升11个百分点（如孟加拉语提升17pp），Global MMLU效用无损失，伪有害拒绝率平均增加13pp。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导（activation steering）提供了一种实用且低成本的方式，将英语衍生的安全信号扩展到其他语言，为跨语言安全干预提供了可行的研究方向。

title: CBX-Bench: A Human-Aligned MLLM Council for Benchmarking Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are designed to make visual classification interpretable by expressing predictions through human-understandable concepts. Although interpretability is the central motivation for CBMs, they are still largely evaluated as predictive models by downstream classification accuracy, supplemented by isolated qualitative examples. This highlights a pressing need for quantitative measures, a challenge complicated by the infeasibility of ground-truth concept annotation at scale and the open nature of concept lists due to a lack of consensus. To fill this gap, we develop a multimodal large language model (MLLM) council that, given an image and its CBM explanation, produces an explanation quality score. To ground and validate the council, we first conduct a human study to establish a ground-truth reference for CBM explanation quality: for an image, annotators compare explanations from two of LF-CBM, VLG-CBM, and CBM-Suite and choose the more useful one, or mark them as equally good or equally bad, yielding 2700 judgments over 900 image-comparison items on CUB-200, ImageNet-100, and Places365. Against this human reference, our five-model council, consisting of open-weight MLLMs, recovers over 70% of strict human preference rankings, rising to 83% on items where human annotators unanimously agree. Building on this validated council, we introduce CBX-Bench, a public benchmark and leaderboard: authors of new CBMs can submit their model's explanations, and CBX-Bench scores them with the council and maintains dataset-level rankings of explanation quality. CBX-Bench thus provides a human-aligned, scalable evaluation of CBM explanations beyond accuracy and isolated qualitative examples. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/meric-karadag/cbx-bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CBX-Bench，一个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评审团的基准测试，用于量化评估概念瓶颈模型（CBM）的解释质量。通过人工研究建立解释质量的基准参考，验证了五模型MLLM评审团能够恢复超过70%的人工偏好排序，并公开了基准和排行榜供研究者提交模型解释进行评分。
AI.motivation: CBM旨在通过人类可理解的概念使视觉分类更具可解释性，但现有评估仍主要依赖下游分类准确率和零散的定性示例，缺乏量化指标。主要难点在于：大规模真值概念标注不可行，以及概念列表因缺乏共识而具有开放性。因此急需一种可扩展、与人类对齐的解释质量量化评估方法。
AI.method: 1) 开发一个由五个开源权重MLLM组成的评审团，给定图像和CBM解释，输出解释质量评分；2) 进行人工研究，让标注者比较LF-CBM、VLG-CBM和CBM-Suite的解释，选择更优或标记同等好坏，在CUB-200、ImageNet-100和Places365上收集2700个判断（900个图像比较项）；3) 基于验证后的评审团构建CBX-Bench公共基准和排行榜，接受新CBM的解释提交并评分。
AI.result: 五模型MLLM评审团恢复了超过70%的严格人工偏好排序，在人工标注一致同意的项目上提升至83%。CBX-Bench提供了人类对齐的、可扩展的CBM解释质量评估。
AI.conclusion: CBX-Bench填补了CBM解释质量量化评估的空白，提供了一种超越准确率和孤立定性示例的人类对齐、可扩展的评估方式，并通过公共基准和排行榜推动CBM领域的标准化评估。

title: FAST-DeepONet: Factor-Augmented Branch Representations for High-Dimensional PDE Inputs in the Small-Sample Regime
summary: Deep operator networks can become statistically unstable when partial differential equation inputs are observed at thousands of strongly correlated sensors but only a small number of operator samples is available. We introduce FAST-DeepONet, a branch representation combining a fixed spectral path with a regularized projection of the orthogonal residual, in which the directional penalty acts on the effective residual map after each of its rows is normalized. On Navier--Stokes flow a plain DeepONet degrades from $0.0394$ to $0.1556$ mean relative $L_2$ error as the branch grows from $129$ to $8193$ coordinates, while FAST-DeepONet stays near $0.04$, so the sensor grid can be refined without a statistical penalty. Across independent test sets for Navier--Stokes flow, Darcy flow, and signed terminal wavefield prediction it lowers mean relative $L_2$ error by $4.7\%$ to $37.0\%$ with three to seven times fewer trainable parameters. A spectral-only branch sharing the same basis separates the two paths: the fixed spectral path carries the improvement on Navier--Stokes and Darcy, while terminal wave prediction requires the residual path together with its directional penalty. FAST-DeepONet targets coordinate-query architectures and trains on solution values alone.

AI.tldr: 提出FAST-DeepONet，通过结合固定谱路径与残差的正则化投影（逐行归一化后施加方向惩罚）来稳定深度算子网络，解决高维相关传感器观测下的统计不稳定性问题。
AI.motivation: 当PDE输入在数千个强相关传感器上观测、但仅有少量算子样本时，深度算子网络会变得统计不稳定，导致误差随分支坐标增加而显著恶化。
AI.method: FAST-DeepONet的分支表示包含一个固定谱路径和一个正则化投影的正交残差路径；方向惩罚作用于有效残差映射的每一行归一化之后。
AI.result: 在Navier-Stokes流上，普通DeepONet误差从0.0394恶化到0.1556（分支从129增至8193坐标），而FAST-DeepONet保持约0.04。在多个测试集上均方相对L2误差降低4.7%至37.0%，且可训练参数减少3至7倍。
AI.conclusion: 固定谱路径在Navier-Stokes和Darcy流上带来改进，而终端波预测需要残差路径及其方向惩罚；FAST-DeepONet面向坐标查询架构，仅用解值即可训练，传感器网格可精化而无统计惩罚。

title: VibeWorlding: Can Multimodal Agents Construct 3D Open Worlds End-to-End?
summary: Constructing an interactive 3D open world from a user query is important. However, existing methods are primarily evaluated on idealized, simple queries, making it difficult to systematically analyze and compare how multimodal agents understand user intent, use 3D tools, and reason over textual and visual 3D world information. To this end, we propose VibeWorlding, a unified framework for benchmarking and training vibe worlding agents: a multimodal agent that can autonomously infer user intent, plan scene layout, invoke 3D tools, and reflect on the multimodal feedback in a multi-turn agent-environment interaction process. To achieve this, we first build VWE-BENCH, a benchmark of 2,616 high-quality 3D assets, 323 human-annotated seed 3D worlds, and 6,828 reverse-synthesized multimodal user queries, split into verified queries with ground-truth and unverified queries with carefully designed rubrics. Moreover, we develop VibeWorlding-Gym, a joint multimodal RL post-training framework that integrates (1) a sandbox environment unifying asset retrieval, editing, and image rendering as MCP tools, and (2) a rubric-based verifier that combines physical feasibility and intent fulfillment verification, supporting both fair model evaluation and scalable multimodal RL reward service. Our experiments show that current frontier MLLMs are far from solving the vibe worlding agent task, with even GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.8-Max reaching below 60% success rate, and trace the bottleneck to precise 3D world editing. We further find that RL training can ease this weakness and enable open-source MLLMs to even surpass closed-source frontiers: our VibeWorlder-8B is comparable to frontier MLLMs, while our flagship VibeWorlder-30B-A3B attains the best overall Pass@1 among all evaluated models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VibeWorlding，一个用于基准测试和训练"情境世界构建代理"（vibe worlding agent）的统一框架，包含VWE-BENCH基准（2,616个3D资产、323个人工标注的种子3D世界、6,828个逆向合成的多模态用户查询）和VibeWorlding-Gym（联合多模态RL后训练框架，集成沙盒环境与基于规则的验证器）。实验表明当前前沿MLLM在该任务上成功率低于60%，但RL训练可使开源模型超越闭源模型（VibeWorlder-8B可达前沿水平，旗舰版VibeWorlder-30B-A3B取得最佳Pass@1）。
AI.motivation: 现有3D开放世界构建方法的评估基于理想化、简单的查询，难以系统分析和比较多模态代理在理解用户意图、使用3D工具、以及推理文本和视觉3D世界信息方面的能力。需要一个统一的框架来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 构建VWE-BENCH基准：包含高质量3D资产、人工标注种子世界和逆向合成的多模态查询，区分带ground-truth的验证查询和基于精心设计rubrics的未验证查询。2) 开发VibeWorlding-Gym：联合多模态RL后训练框架，集成沙盒环境（将资产检索、编辑、图像渲染统一为MCP工具）和基于规则的验证器（结合物理可行性和意图满足验证），支持公平模型评估和可扩展的多模态RL奖励服务。
AI.result: 当前前沿MLLM（包括GPT-5.5和Qwen3.8-Max）在vibe worlding代理任务上成功率低于60%，瓶颈在于精确的3D世界编辑。RL训练能缓解这一弱点，使开源模型超越闭源模型：VibeWorlder-8B达到前沿水平，旗舰版VibeWorlder-30B-A3B在所有被评估模型中取得最佳Pass@1。
AI.conclusion: VibeWorlding展示了标准化的基准+RL训练框架能有效推动多模态代理在交互式3D世界构建任务上的进步，开源模型通过RL训练可超越闭源前沿模型，为3D开放式世界构建领域提供了系统的评估与训练基础设施。

title: Palmyra x6 Technical Report: An Agentic, Tool-Use Model Post-Trained via Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Palmyra x6 is a large language model optimized for use with enterprise-oriented agentic tasks. The model was built by post-training a Mixture-of-Experts base model with Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning on a compact corpus of verified, synthetic tool-use trajectories, optimized with a Muon + Adam hybrid. The recipe is deliberately conservative and deliberately controlled: 626 trajectories, a single epoch, a low learning rate, and a KL anchor to the frozen base. The model shows substantial gains over the previous default model for Writer Agent, and compares favorably with several recent models on public benchmarks, scoring the highest on BFCL Core at $0.785$ and posts the highest six-benchmark mean of the cohort. Furthermore, the model has shown itself to be competitive or leading relative to comparators in our bias and safety evaluations.

AI.tldr: Palmyra x6是一个针对企业智能体任务优化的LLM，通过对MoE基础模型进行锚定监督微调（仅626条合成工具使用轨迹、单轮训练、低学习率、KL锚定）并使用Muon+Adam混合优化器训练而成。该模型在Writer Agent上大幅优于先前模型，在BFCL Core上达到0.785的最高分，并在六个公开基准的平均分和偏差/安全评估中表现领先。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在为大型语言模型在企业智能体（agentic）任务中的性能优化提供一个刻意保守、可控且可复现的后训练方案，以应对复杂工具调用场景的需求。
AI.method: 在MoE基础模型上采用Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning（ASFT）进行后训练，使用一个紧凑的合成工具使用轨迹语料库（仅626条），设置单epoch、低学习率，并以KL散度锚定到冻结的基础模型；优化器采用Muon与Adam的混合方案。
AI.result: 该模型在Writer Agent上较之前的默认模型有显著提升；在公开基准测试中与多个近期模型相比表现优异，在BFCL Core上获得最高分0.785，并在六个基准的平均分中位居榜首；在偏差和安全评估中也展现出竞争力或领先水平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过刻意保守的后训练配置（极小规模数据、单epoch、低学习率、KL锚定），可以在企业智能体任务上实现显著的性能提升，同时保持良好的安全性，为LLM智能体微调提供了高效且有原则的路径。

title: ArtLang: Structured Language-to-Kinematics Grounding for Articulated 3D Actuation
summary: Articulated-object reconstructions recover explicit geometry and kinematics, but their parts often remain semantically anonymous and must be controlled through part indices and numerical joint parameters. We present ArtLang, a framework for open-vocabulary language control of persistent reconstructed articulated assets. ArtLang represents an asset as a semantic-kinematic articulation graph and augments its surface with language features and graph-constrained motion. Open-vocabulary proposals are bound to reconstructed parts while allowing uncertain parts to remain unnamed. A typed parser converts a command into a directive graph containing referring expressions, actions, magnitudes, reference frames, and relations. We then solve a global graph-to-graph grounding problem that jointly reasons about semantic, spatial, relational, and kinematic compatibility, with support for null assignments and abstention under ambiguity. Accepted directives are converted into continuous joint targets within the observed motion range and executed through forward kinematics. Experiments on synthetic reconstructions, mesh-based assets, and real captures demonstrate reliable language grounding and continuous articulated control across repeated parts, spatial references, relational commands, and ambiguous instructions.

AI.tldr: ArtLang是一个用于开放词汇语言控制持久化重建铰接资产的框架。它通过语义-运动学铰接图表示资产，将语言指令解析为指令图，并解决全局图到图的匹配问题，实现语义、空间、关系和运动学兼容性的联合推理，支持模糊情况下的空分配和弃权。
AI.motivation: 现有铰接物体重建虽然能恢复显式几何和运动学信息，但其部件在语义上是匿名的，只能通过部件索引和数值关节参数来控制，缺乏直观的自然语言控制能力。
AI.method: ArtLang采用语义-运动学铰接图表示资产，用语言特征和图约束运动增强表面；使用类型化解析器将命令转换为包含指称表达、动作、幅度、参考系和关系的指令图；通过全局图到图匹配问题联合推理语义、空间、关系和运动学兼容性，支持不确定部件的匿名处理、空分配和模糊情况下的弃权；接受的指令转换为连续关节目标并通过正运动学执行。
AI.result: 在合成重建、网格资产和真实捕获上的实验表明，该方法在重复部件、空间指称、关系命令和模糊指令下表现出可靠的语言接地和连续铰接控制能力。
AI.conclusion: ArtLang首次实现了对重建铰接资产的开放词汇自然语言控制，通过图匹配框架统一处理语义、空间和运动学约束，为重建资产的语言驱动交互提供了可行的解决方案。

title: $D^{2}R^{2}$: Discrete Diffusion with Regulation Reinforcement for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
summary: Predicting single-cell transcriptomic responses to genetic perturbations is central to functional genomics and virtual-cell modeling. Existing approaches, however, typically predict an entire expression profile as a whole, leaving the order in which individual gene responses are generated unmodeled. To address this problem, we introduce \textbf{$D^{2}R^{2}$} (\textbf{D}iscrete \textbf{D}iffusion with \textbf{R}egulation \textbf{R}einforcement), which reformulates perturbation prediction as regulation-guided gene-wise progressive generation. A Masked Discrete Diffusion Model represents expression as ordinal tokens and reconstructs a fully masked profile step by step, allowing generated gene responses to condition those that remain masked. A Regulatory Policy Module initializes the generation policy from a gene regulatory network inferred from control cells and adapts it to the perturbation and current partially generated state. Then, group-relative policy optimization refines only the ordering policy using final perturbation-effect agreement as reward. Across Norman19 and VCC-H1, $D^{2}R^{2}$ achieves the best performance on all five metrics on Norman19 and remains competitive on H1. Controlled ablations holding the generator and generation budget fixed show that biological-prior ordering improves over random ordering and is more reliable than uncertainty-based heuristics, whereas reversing the biological-prior ordering degrades every metric. Biological analyses further show that the refined policy prioritizes regulatory genes early while promoting perturbation-specific transcription factors and responsive genes. These results establish gene generation order as an effective, controllable, and biologically interpretable dimension of single-cell perturbation prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D²R²（离散扩散与调控强化）框架，将单细胞转录组扰动预测重新定义为调控引导的基因逐步生成过程，通过掩码离散扩散模型逐步重建表达谱，并结合基因调控网络初始化生成策略，利用组相对策略优化进行精调，在多个数据集上取得最优或领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有单细胞扰动预测方法通常将整个表达谱作为一个整体进行预测，忽略了基因响应生成的先后顺序这一关键维度。作者认为基因响应的生成顺序蕴含重要的生物学信息，值得建模和优化，但目前缺乏在这一维度上的探索。
AI.method: D²R²包含三个核心组件：(1) 掩码离散扩散模型（Masked Discrete Diffusion Model）将表达量表示为序数token，从完全掩码的表达谱逐步重建，使已生成的基因响应条件化影响未生成的基因；(2) 调控策略模块（Regulatory Policy Module）从对照细胞推断的基因调控网络初始化生成策略，并适应扰动状态和当前部分生成状态；(3) 组相对策略优化（Group-relative Policy Optimization）仅优化排序策略，以最终扰动效应一致性作为奖励。
AI.result: 在Norman19数据集上D²R²在全部五个指标上取得最佳性能，在VCC-H1数据集上保持竞争力。消融实验表明生物先验排序优于随机排序且比基于不确定性的启发式方法更可靠，反转生物先验排序会导致所有指标下降。生物分析显示优化后的策略优先生成调控基因，同时促进扰动特异性转录因子和响应基因的生成。
AI.conclusion: 基因生成顺序是单细胞扰动预测中一个有效、可控且具有生物学可解释性的新维度，D²R²通过将调控先验与强化学习结合，在该维度上取得了显著改进。

title: When Do Explanations Help In-Context Learning? A Comparative Study of Natural Language Explanation Types and Faithfulness
summary: Natural language explanations (NLEs) are increasingly used as inputs, for example, as few-shot rationales that influence model behavior in in-context learning (ICL). However, it remains unclear how different types of NLEs compare in their effects on downstream model performance in explanation-augmented prompting. Therefore, we provide a comparative evaluation across six benchmarks and four instruction-tuned models, studying how NLE source (human-written when available, self-generated explanations, generated by an external LLM) and NLE selection (random vs faithfulness-based filtering) affect downstream utility of NLEs when used in ICL settings. Our extensive evaluation shows that, on classification-style benchmarks, adding NLEs to few-shot prompts often improves accuracy over few-shot prompting without explanations; among NLE sources, externally generated LLM-NLEs often provide strong downstream utility and remain competitive with human rationales where both are available, whereas self-NLEs are more sensitive to the selection strategy. On math reasoning, the effects are more model- and source-dependent. We further show that faithfulness-based selection of self-NLEs yields small average gains overall, but can improve or reduce performance depending on the metric, task, and model. Different faithfulness metrics can disagree substantially, affecting which self-NLE examples are selected and their downstream predictive utility. Robustness tests with randomly swapped and out-of-distribution rationales indicate partial robustness, suggesting that semantic alignment contributes to performance gains. Overall, our results provide insights for selecting and reporting explanations that influence model behavior in practical prompting pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了自然语言解释（NLEs）在上下文学习（ICL）场景中作为提示输入时的不同来源（人类撰写、自生成、外部LLM生成）和选择策略（随机vs基于忠实度过滤）对下游任务性能的影响，跨越6个基准和4个指令微调模型，发现外部LLM生成的解释通常具有较强效用，而自生成解释对选择策略更敏感。
AI.motivation: 虽然自然语言解释（NLEs）越来越多地被用作上下文学习中的少样本推理输入，但不同类型NLEs对下游模型性能的影响尚不清楚，缺乏系统的比较研究。
AI.method: 在6个基准和4个指令微调模型上进行跨基准、跨模型的比较评估，研究NLE来源（人类撰写、自生成、外部LLM生成）和NLE选择策略（随机vs基于忠实度过滤）对ICL设置中NLE下游效用的影响。同时进行了随机替换和分布外推理的鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: 分类基准上，添加NLEs通常能提升少样本提示的准确率；外部LLM生成的NLEs往往提供强下游效用，并与人类rationales竞争力相当；自生成NLEs对选择策略更敏感。数学推理上效果更依赖模型和来源。基于忠实度的选择总体上只有小幅平均增益，且不同忠实度指标可能产生分歧。
AI.conclusion: 研究为实际提示管道中选择和报告影响模型行为的解释提供了见解，指出NLE来源和选择策略需要根据具体任务、模型和度量指标谨慎权衡。

title: HistReNeRF: Historic Image Relocalisation within Contemporary Neural Radiance Field Reconstructions
summary: Relocalising archival photographs within a contemporary scene model is challenging because historic and modern views can differ in photographic appearance, visible objects, and spatial layout. Therefore, we present HistReNeRF, a framework that estimates the 6-DoF pose of a historic photograph by matching adapted DINOv2 patch features to candidate rays sampled from a contemporary Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) reconstruction. The continuous representation of a NeRF provides a queryable scene interface from which candidate rays can be sampled and matched, enabling domain adaptation between historic photography and contemporary images directly in the feature representation used for localisation. We evaluate embedding-space-based domain adaptation against pixel-space methods on a new cross-temporal dataset comprising 10,545 contemporary street-level images and 230 archival photographs from three European landmarks. Embedding-space adaptation reduces translation and rotation errors by an average of 11% and 16%, respectively, across the three scenes. These results show that neural scene relocalisation provides a natural interface for feature-space adaptation, reducing cross-temporal appearance shift without modifying the query image. Code and dataset at https://github.com/ARTUROLab/HistReNeRF.

AI.tldr: HistReNeRF 是一个通过将 DINOv2 补丁特征与从当代 NeRF 重建中采样的候选射线匹配，来估计历史照片 6-DoF 位姿的框架。
AI.motivation: 历史档案照片与当代场景模型之间的视觉外观、可见物体和空间布局差异巨大，使得重定位极具挑战性。
AI.method: 利用 NeRF 的连续表示作为可查询的场景接口采样候选射线，将适配后的 DINOv2 补丁特征与候选射线进行匹配，并在特征表示空间中进行跨时间域的域自适应。
AI.result: 在包含 3 个欧洲地标的 10,545 张当代街景图像和 230 张档案照片的新数据集上，嵌入空间域自适应相比像素空间方法将平移和旋转误差分别平均降低 11% 和 16%。
AI.conclusion: 神经场景重定位为特征空间自适应提供了天然接口，无需修改查询图像即可减少跨时间外观偏移。

title: ReasonCast: Agentic Demand Forecasting with Selective Semantic Reasoning
summary:
Demand forecasting increasingly requires combining two complementary sources of information: historical sales reveal recurring numerical dynamics, while future promotions, holidays, price changes, and platform interventions provide forward-looking knowledge. Existing text-enhanced forecasting methods often encode such context into generic representations and fuse it uniformly with time-series features, without explicitly distinguishing which semantic effects are forecast-relevant or how they should modify future dynamics.
  We introduce ReasonCast, a structured semantic intervention framework that translates event knowledge into forecast-specific operations. An agent examines the event context, the no-text forecast, and its uncertainty to determine whether textual reasoning is needed. Rather than injecting free-form text, ReasonCast represents event knowledge through structured fields describing event relevance, demand direction, temporal shape, amplitude, and peak intensity. These fields interact selectively with temporal components of a time-series foundation model. An additive path corrects local trends and temporal shapes, while a multiplicative path captures event-driven level shifts.
  ReasonCast introduces a forecast-grounded post-training curriculum. Schema SFT establishes semantic fields; semantic-field RL calibrates direction, shape, amplitude, and peak judgments; and forecast-utility RL evaluates semantic interventions through a frozen forecaster, aligning reasoning outputs with marginal forecast improvement. ReasonCast lowers WMAPE by 3.29, 1.25, and 0.47 percentage points on holiday-sensitive categories, mega-sale-sensitive categories, and M5 event windows, respectively. On stable-sales periods, indiscriminate semantic intervention increases WMAPE by 1.68 percentage points, whereas suppressing unnecessary intervention preserves the numerical backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReasonCast，一个结构化语义干预框架，将事件知识（如促销、节假日）转化为预测特定的操作。它通过神经代理判断是否需要文本推理，将事件知识表示为结构化字段（相关性、方向、形状、幅度、峰值强度），并分别通过加性路径和多乘性路径与时间序列基础模型交互。通过三层后训练课程（Schema SFT、语义字段RL、预测效用RL）校准，在多个数据集上显著降低WMAPE，同时通过在稳定期抑制不必要干预保护数值主干。
AI.motivation: 现有文本增强预测方法将事件上下文编码为通用表示并与时间序列特征均匀融合，无法明确区分哪些语义效应对预测相关，也无法明确这些效应应如何修改未来动态。这导致了预测效果不理想，尤其是在需要区分相关与非相关事件信息的场景下。
AI.method: ReasonCast包含三大核心组件：(1) 神经agent判断是否需要语义推理，实现选择性干预；(2) 事件知识通过结构化字段（相关性、需求方向、时间形状、幅度、峰值强度）表示，而非自由文本；(3) 双路径交互：加性路径修正局部趋势与时间形状，多乘性路径捕捉事件驱动的水平偏移。训练采用三层后训练课程：Schema SFT建立语义字段，语义字段RL校准方向/形状/幅度/峰值判断，预测效用RL通过冻结预测器评估语义干预，对齐推理输出与边际预测改善。
AI.result: ReasonCast在假日敏感类别、大型促销敏感类别和M5事件窗口上分别将WMAPE降低3.29、1.25和0.47个百分点。在稳定销售期，无差别的语义干预会使WMAPE增加1.68个百分点，而抑制不必要干预则能保持数值主干性能。
AI.conclusion: ReasonCast证明了将事件知识转化为预测特定的结构化操作（而非通用文本嵌入）能显著提升需求预测质量。其核心价值在于"选择性干预"——只在语义信息真正有价值时进行干预，避免对稳定期的噪声注入。这为文本增强的时间序列预测提供了更精细、更可解释的新范式。

title: Toward Better Assessment of LLMs' Performance in Clinical Error Detection
comment: Accepted at Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC) 2026; to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR), Vol. 340
summary: Automated detection of errors in clinical documentation is a promising application of large language models (LLMs), yet decisions to deploy such models rest on benchmarks that evaluate each clinical note in isolation. Error-detection benchmarks are typically constructed by injecting errors into notes, such that each erroneous note has a natural counterpart. Aggregate discriminative metrics (e.g., balanced accuracy or F1) do not exploit this structure. We show that this omission is consequential. In particular, evaluating 15 diverse LLMs on 4 standardized clinical error-detection test sets across 3 languages, we find that 13 of 15 models fall below the level of random pairwise discrimination, even while achieving F1 scores that standard practice would read as moderate. We also observe that the underlying bias patterns differ across languages: the same model can default to "no error" on one language and over-flag errors on another. To diagnose where discrimination breaks down, we further introduce a procedure to score the evidence models cite in their outputs. We find that while models consistently locate error-relevant content, they fail to produce the corresponding correct verdict on the clean counterpart. Finally, we show that F1 and pairwise accuracy are driven in opposite directions by the same underlying bias, so that ranking models by F1 may systematically promote the weakest discriminators. For safety-critical clinical NLP applications, we advocate for supplementing aggregate metrics with paired evaluations in benchmark reporting. Code and analysis scripts are available at https://github.com/healthylaife/paired-clinical-eval.

AI.tldr: 本文指出临床文档错误检测基准测试中，聚合判别指标（如F1、平衡准确率）未利用"错误注记-干净对应注记"的配对结构，导致评估结果失真。实验表明，在4个标准化测试集、3种语言、15个LLM中，13个模型的成对判别能力低于随机水平，尽管其F1分数看起来尚可。论文还发现模型的语言间偏差模式不同，并提出证据评分程序来诊断判别失效位置，最终主张基准报告应补充配对评估。
AI.motivation: 现有临床错误检测基准将所有注记孤立评估，忽略了每个错误注记都有自然对应的干净版本这一配对结构。聚合指标无法反映模型能否正确区分"有错/无错"这对注记，导致部署决策可能基于误导性指标。
AI.method: 对15个不同LLM在4个标准化临床错误检测测试集（跨越3种语言）上进行评估；引入成对判别（pairwise discrimination）指标对比F1；提出证据评分程序，分别检查模型定位错误相关内容的能力与输出正确判定的能力。
AI.result: 13/15的模型成对判别能力低于随机水平，尽管F1显示中等水平；同一模型在不同语言上呈现相反的偏差模式（某语言默认"无错误"，另一语言过度标记）；模型能定位错误相关内容，但在干净对应注记上无法给出正确判定；F1与成对准确率受同一偏差驱动但方向相反，按F1排名会系统性地将最弱的判别器排到前面。
AI.conclusion: 对于安全关键的临床NLP应用，应在基准报告中补充配对评估，而不是仅依赖聚合指标，否则可能高估或系统性误判模型的实际判别能力。

title: NumerosityVLM: A Cognitively Inspired Benchmark for Interpreting Numerosity Representations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on high-level multimodal tasks, yet numerosity perception, a cognitive ability that emerges in human infants before language acquisition, remains poorly understood in current models, as existing counting benchmarks entangle numerosity with correlated visual factors. We introduce a cognitively inspired diagnostic benchmark, NumerosityVLM, comprising 10,800 synthetic images across six controlled conditions. The benchmark orthogonally manipulates object size, spatial arrangement, and numerosity, while progressively ablating texture, shape, and color. Evaluating seven VLMs in a zero-shot setting, multi-factor analysis reveals that model architecture explains the largest proportion of performance variance (partial $ω^{2}=0.325$), far exceeding visual conditions. Layer-wise probing further shows that linearly separable numerosity signals consistently emerge at early stages of the vision encoder, while performance differences across evaluated models are primarily associated with the language model component. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/fuy3/NumerosityVLM-Benchmark, and https://huggingface.co/datasets/fuy3/NumerosityVLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NumerosityVLM基准，包含10,800张合成图像、六个受控条件，正交操控物体大小、空间排列和数量，并渐进消融纹理、形状和颜色，用于诊断VLM的数值感知能力。评估七个VLM发现模型架构主导性能差异，层探针显示数值信号在视觉编码器早期出现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLMs在高层次多模态任务上表现优秀，但数量感知这一人类婴儿在语言习得前就具备的认知能力在现有模型中缺乏理解。现有计数基准将数量与其他相关视觉因素纠缠在一起，难以直接评估模型的真实数量感知能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个认知启发的诊断基准NumerosityVLM，包含10,800张合成图像、六个受控条件，正交操控物体大小、空间排列与数量，同时渐进消融纹理、形状和颜色。在零样本设置下评估七个VLM，采用多因素分析量化各因素对性能方差的贡献，并通过逐层探针（layer-wise probing）分析数值信号的涌现位置。
AI.result: 模型架构解释了最大的性能方差比例（partial ω²=0.325），远超视觉条件的影响。逐层分析表明线性可分的数值信号在视觉编码器早期阶段一致涌现，而不同模型的性能差异主要与语言模型组件相关。
AI.conclusion: 数值感知能力在VLM中受模型架构主导而非视觉输入条件，且核心数值信号在早期视觉编码阶段就已形成，后续语言模型组件对性能差异起关键作用。该发现为理解VLM中数量感知的神经机制提供了认知视角的证据。

title: Detecting Money Laundering in Rwandan Mobile Money: A Machine Learning Framework
summary: Mobile money has widened financial access across Sub-Saharan Africa and enlarged the surface for money-laundering and terrorism-financing (ML/TF) activity in ecosystems dominated by high-volume, low-value transactions. Rwanda is a case in point: several million active mobile-money users, telecom-led wallets on the MTN and Airtel networks, and a Financial Intelligence Centre (FIC) supervising transaction streams whose scale exceeds static rule-based monitoring. This paper develops and evaluates a transaction-monitoring framework aligned to the Rwandan AML/CFT regime under (i) extreme class imbalance (~0.1% prevalence), (ii) scarce and delayed labels, and (iii) bounded investigator capacity. Using SAML-D, a synthetic dataset of 9,504,852 transactions with 17 laundering typologies, we engineer account-centric behavioural features (rolling velocity, net-flow directionality, counterparty diversity, burstiness) and benchmark supervised classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, LightGBM), unsupervised anomaly detectors (Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor), a dense autoencoder, and a late-fusion meta-learner. Evaluation is operational: PR-AUC, recall at a calibrated ~90%-precision point, recall at top-K%, and alerts per 10,000. On the chronologically held-out test period, LightGBM attains PR-AUC = 0.0469, capturing 64 laundering cases at precision ~0.89 with 0.51 alerts per 10,000; the fusion stacker reaches PR-AUC = 0.0477 at precision ~0.91 and 0.46 alerts per 10,000, recovering 59 true positives. We map score bands to Rwanda-relevant analyst workflows and STR/SAR escalation, and outline a staged path from synthetic prototyping to real-data validation with the National Bank of Rwanda and FIC. The contribution is operational: a governance-aware pipeline and evaluation protocol calibrated to the constraints of an African mobile-money regulator, not a new algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文针对卢旺达移动支付生态中反洗钱/反恐融资（AML/CFT）监管的严峻挑战，开发并评估了一个面向交易监控的框架。该框架在极端类别不平衡（~0.1%）、标签稀缺且延迟、调查员能力有限三大约束下运作，使用包含950万笔交易和17种洗钱类型的SAML-D合成数据集，构建账户中心行为特征，并基准测试了监督分类器、无监督异常检测器、密集自编码器及后期融合元学习器。在时序留出测试集上，LightGBM达到PR-AUC=0.0469、召回64个案例（精确率~0.89），融合堆叠器达到PR-AUC=0.0477（精确率~0.91、每万笔0.46条警报）。该贡献是操作性的：一套治理感知的流程和评估协议，而非新算法。
AI.motivation: 移动支付在撒哈拉以南非洲扩大了金融普惠，但也放大了洗钱与恐怖融资活动表面。卢旺达拥有数百万活跃移动支付用户，电信主导的MTN和Airtel钱包交易量巨大，远超静态规则监控能力。然而，监管面临极端类别不平衡、标签稀缺延迟、调查员能力有限三重约束，亟需一个对齐AML/CFT制度、适合非洲移动支付监管者现实约束的交易监控框架。
AI.method: 使用SAML-D合成数据集（9,504,852笔交易、17种洗钱类型），工程化账户中心行为特征（滚动速率、净流向方向性、对手方多样性、突发性），并基准测试五类方法：监督分类器（Logistic Regression、Random Forest、LightGBM）、无监督异常检测器（Isolation Forest、Local Outlier Factor）、密集自编码器，以及后期融合元学习器。采用操作性评估指标：PR-AUC、约90%精确率点的召回率、top-K%召回率、每万笔警报数，并按时间序列划分留出验证集。
AI.result: 在时序留出测试集上，LightGBM达到PR-AUC=0.0469，以约0.89精确率捕获64个洗钱案例，每万笔仅0.51条警报；融合堆叠器达到PR-AUC=0.0477，精确率约0.91，每万笔0.46条警报，恢复59个真阳性。方法将得分区间映射到卢旺达分析师工作流及STR/SAR升级流程，并规划了从合成原型验证到与卢旺达国家银行和FIC进行真实数据验证的分阶段路径。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献是操作性的而非算法创新：提供了一个治理感知的流程和评估协议，校准到非洲移动支付监管者的约束条件。研究证明即使在极端类别不平衡下，基于合成数据的监督与融合方法也能以低误报率捕获洗钱案例，为从合成环境向真实部署的过渡提供了可行路径。

title: Divergent-Convergent Reasoning: Scaling Test-Time Compute through Structured Solution Synthesis
summary: Test-time compute can substantially improve Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning performance, yet how and when additional compute helps remains poorly understood. We study Divergent-Convergent Reasoning (DCR), a simple two-phase primitive consisting of an exploration phase that generates multiple candidate solutions followed by a convergent reconciliation phase. We present three core results. First, we show that even a single reconciliation step can reliably amplify correct minority reports: across datasets, DCR often recovers the correct answer when correct exploration outputs are in the minority, a regime where majority voting fails. Second, we introduce recursive DCR, an autoregressive reconciliation system that iteratively analyzes disagreements and allocates additional test-time compute. Recursive DCR achieves higher accuracy than fixed-compute baselines-reaching 93.3% on AIME 2024 and 92.0% on AIME 2025-while using roughly 27% less compute on average, demonstrating that attentive resource allocation is superior to uniform scaling. Third, we analyze disagreement among exploration outputs via a simple, training-free dispersion metric. Dispersion reveals a structured relationship between disagreement and test-time gains: in regimes where DCR is effective, higher disagreement among exploration outputs is associated with larger accuracy improvements from reconciliation. Together, these results show that disagreement, often viewed as noise, can be systematically exploited to improve test-time reasoning and reveal emerging scaling laws for agentic LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分歧-收敛推理（DCR）两阶段框架：先探索生成多个候选解，再通过收敛调和步骤整合答案。核心发现包括：单次调和即可放大正确的少数派报告（优于多数投票）；递归DCR通过迭代分析分歧并分配测试时计算，在AIME 2024/2025上达到93.3%/92.0%准确率，同时节省约27%计算量；并提出无需训练的分歧度量，揭示分歧与推理增益间的结构化关系。
AI.motivation: 尽管测试时计算能显著提升LLM推理性能，但额外计算何时以及如何帮助推理仍未被充分理解。作者希望揭示测试时计算有效性的内在机制，特别是分歧信息如何被系统性地利用。
AI.method: 提出两阶段DCR框架：(1) 探索阶段生成多个候选解；(2) 收敛调和阶段整合候选解。在此基础上引入递归DCR，迭代分析分歧并自适应分配计算资源，并提出无需训练的分歧分散度量来分析探索输出间的分歧与推理增益的关系。
AI.result: 单次调和可恢复正确少数派报告；递归DCR在AIME 2024达93.3%、AIME 2025达92.0%准确率，比固定计算基线平均节省约27%计算量；分歧度量揭示了分歧与调和收益间的正相关关系。
AI.conclusion: 分歧并非噪声，而可被系统性利用来改进测试时推理。DCR展示了比均匀扩展计算更优的自适应资源分配策略，并揭示了智能体LLM系统的新兴缩放定律。

title: Every Coin Has Two Sides: On the Dual Nature of Generalization in On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, yet its generalization behavior remains poorly understood, as most studies evaluate OPD on a single domain and on benchmarks close to the training data. We present a controlled study that varies one generalization factor at a time, from in-domain distribution shifts to cross-domain transfer and the multi-teacher setting. We find that OPD transfers a teacher's reasoning behavior rather than its answers to particular problems: training difficulty barely matters, and even problems the teacher never solves are useful. Transfer depends strongly on the origin relationship between teacher and student: same-origin pairs bring the student close to the teacher across languages, reasoning horizons, and even other domains, whereas cross-origin pairs mostly fit the trained distribution. This broad reach is a double-edged sword: since routing prompts to domain experts cannot confine each teacher's influence, combining them yields a mixture-dependent seesaw among their capabilities. These results clarify when OPD generalizes and offer a useful perspective for diagnosing multi-teacher OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文对on-policy distillation (OPD)的泛化行为进行了受控研究，系统地改变单一泛化因素（从域内分布偏移到跨域迁移再到多教师设置）。发现OPD传递的是教师的推理行为而非特定问题的答案：训练难度几乎无关紧要，甚至教师未解决的问题也有用。迁移效果强烈依赖师生间源关系：同源配对能让学生在跨语言、推理深度甚至其他领域都接近教师，而跨源配对大多只是拟合训练分布。这种广泛影响力是双刃剑：由于将提示路由给领域专家无法限制每个教师的影响，组合多教师会产生能力间的混合依赖性跷跷板效应。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD研究大多在单一领域和接近训练数据的基准上评估，对其泛化行为缺乏系统理解。作者希望通过控制变量的方式，逐一考察影响OPD迁移的因素（域内偏移、跨域迁移、多教师设置），以厘清OPD何时能够泛化。
AI.method: 作者设计了受控实验研究，每次变化一个泛化因素：1) 域内分布偏移；2) 跨域迁移；3) 多教师设置。通过比较同源（same-origin）和跨源（cross-origin）的师生配对，系统地分析OTP的推理行为迁移模式。
AI.result: 1) OPD传递推理行为而非具体答案，训练难度不重要，教师未解决的问题也有用；2) 迁移效果强烈依赖师生源关系——同源配对实现广泛跨语言/推理深度/领域的迁移，跨源配对大多只拟合训练分布；3) 多教师组合中，由于提示路由无法隔离各教师影响，出现能力间的跷跷板效应。
AI.conclusion: 研究厘清了OPD的泛化条件：源关系是决定性因素。同源配对的广泛影响既是优势也是风险——在诊断多教师OPD时需要认识到无法通过路由限制各教师的影响范围，这为理解和优化多教师蒸馏提供了新视角。

title: Spatially-Grounded Flow Matching: Structured Source Distributions for Image Generation
summary: Current flow matching models learn to transport the source i.i.d. Gaussian noise into the target distribution of natural images, yet this source distribution carries no notion of spatial structure. Images however are fundamentally local since nearby pixels are strongly correlated. By sampling the noise independently, we hypothesize that models are implicitly encouraged to exploit less noisy neighbors as context during training, partially bypassing the need to properly learn the true local structure of images. The source distribution, in other words, works against the inductive bias of the image domain. To ameliorate this design discrepancy, we propose StructFlow which encodes spatial locality directly into the source by having the pixels within a small region share a common noise component. This structured source produces transport paths that are geometrically aligned with image regions - enabling properties that generic flow matching struggles to provide: fine-grained local editing that naturally respects boundaries, robust structure preservation, and smooth semantic interpolation between images. We show that these benefits also extend to large pre-trained models, demonstrating that StructFlow can even be incorporated through a lightweight post-training phase. Comprehensive experiments on multiple datasets, in unconditional, class and text-conditioned regimes, using different diffusion transformer architectures confirm that StructFlow not only offers competitive image generation quality, but also significantly improves localized controllable re-synthesis.

AI.tldr: StructFlow提出在源噪声分布中编码空间局部性（让小块区域内的像素共享噪声分量），从而改善流匹配模型在图像生成中的结构保持和局部编辑能力。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配模型使用i.i.d.高斯噪声作为源分布，不含任何空间结构信息，这与图像天生具有局部相关性（邻近像素强相关）的归纳偏置相矛盾。模型可能利用噪声较小的邻居作为上下文，从而绕过了真正学习图像局部结构的需求。
AI.method: StructFlow将空间局部性直接编码到源分布中：使小区域内的像素共享共同的噪声分量，从而产生与图像区域几何对齐的传输路径。
AI.result: 实验证明StructFlow在无条件、类别条件和文本条件下均能达到与现有方法相当的生成质量，同时在细粒度局部编辑（自然尊重边界）、结构保持和图像间平滑语义插值方面显著提升。该方法还可通过轻量级后训练阶段融入大型预训练模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过在源分布中引入空间结构化噪声，可以更好地匹配图像域的归纳偏置，从而在不牺牲生成质量的前提下获得更强的局部可控重合成能力。

title: Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off
comment: 53 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and analysis artifacts: https://github.com/Nixon-H/not-all-attention-is-equal
summary: Attention mechanisms have driven machine learning for a decade, from neural machine translation to language models that do general-purpose reasoning. This survey covers four connected threads: their formulation for sequence-to-sequence tasks, adaptation to computer vision, efficiency innovations that address the quadratic bottleneck, and advances in interpretability. We define three criteria: efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and compare twenty-one methods using an EEI scoring framework. Scores come from a single rater with an assumed +/-1-point perturbation range. A deterministic Monte Carlo analysis with 200,000 samples shows that, under this perturbation model, rank changes of more than one position occur in 67-70% of samples on average. A rank-matched null model reproduces a similar stability profile, so the results support coarse tier-level comparisons rather than fine-grained rankings. The survey traces attention from Bahdanau-Luong alignment through the Transformer and into vision architectures. It reviews fixed and learned sparse attention, linear attention, IO-aware exact algorithms including FlashAttention, and state-space alternatives including Mamba. It also covers induction heads, superposition, and the attention-SSM duality. We further provide a structured narrative review, a benchmark synthesis with cross-study caveats, a five-problem research gap analysis, and a 2015-2026 evolution timeline. We conclude by framing attention research as an expansion of the efficiency-expressiveness-interpretability frontier and identifying future directions including unified efficiency benchmarks, learned routing for hybrid architectures, length generalization, and scalable mechanistic interpretability.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文系统梳理了注意力机制从2015年到2026年的发展脉络，涵盖序列到序列任务、计算机视觉、效率创新（如FlashAttention、线性注意力）和可解释性四个方向。作者提出效率（Efficiency）、表现力（Expressiveness）和可解释性（Interpretability）三个标准，用EEI评分框架比较了21种方法，并通过蒙特卡洛敏感性分析（20万样本）发现排名变动超过一位的概率达67-70%，说明该方法仅支持粗粒度层级比较而非细粒度排名。论文还提供了结构化叙事综述、基准综合、五大研究空白分析和演进时间线。
AI.motivation: 注意力机制在过去十年推动了机器学习领域的重大突破（从神经机器翻译到通用推理语言模型），但缺乏一个系统性的综述来整合其在不同方向的发展。作者希望提供一个覆盖公式化表述、计算机视觉适配、效率创新和可解释性四个维度的全面综述，并引入一个量化评估框架（EEI评分）来比较不同注意力方法。此外，作者认识到现有排名类评估缺乏稳健性分析，因此通过蒙特卡洛模拟来检验排名稳定性，为读者提供更可信的结论。
AI.method: 本文采用多维度方法：（1）提出EEI评分框架（效率、表现力、可解释性三个维度），由单一评分者打分，假设+/-1分的扰动范围；（2）使用确定性蒙特卡洛分析（20万样本）来评估排名的稳健性，并用秩匹配的零模型进行验证；（3）从历史演进角度梳理注意力机制：Bahdanau-Luong对齐→Transformer→视觉架构，覆盖固定/学习稀疏注意力、线性注意力、IO感知精确算法（FlashAttention）以及状态空间模型（Mamba）；（4）提供结构化叙事综述、基准综合（含跨研究注意事项）、五大研究空白分析和2015-2026演进时间线。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛分析显示，在+/-1分扰动模型下，排名变动超过一位的情况平均在67-70%的样本中发生，且秩匹配的零模型再现了相似的稳定性特征，表明方法排名对评分扰动不稳健。因此，该EEI框架仅适用于粗粒度的层级比较。综述成功绘制了注意力机制从序列到序列任务到视觉再到效率创新的完整演进路径，涵盖了从Bahdanau-Luong到Transformer、FlashAttention和Mamba等关键里程碑，并识别了五大研究空白。
AI.conclusion: 本文将注意力研究框架化为效率-表现力-可解释性边界的持续扩展过程。EEI评估结果警示研究者不应过度依赖细粒度的排名比较。未来研究方向包括：统一的效率基准、混合架构的学习路由、长度泛化问题以及可扩展的机制性可解释性。这些方向将推动注意力机制在更广泛的应用场景中发挥更大价值。

title: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems
comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE Intelligent Systems, which can be accessed at https://doi.ieeecomputersociety.org/10.1109/MIS.2026.3721766. The DOI is 10.1109/MIS.2026.3721766
summary: Frontier agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs) exhibit human-like patterns of cognition. As these systems become deeply integrated across different domains, their cognitive engagement raises critical concerns for human society that remain insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we systematically analyze risks induced by expanding cognitive capabilities, following a three-level framework defined by their cognitive scope, from physical cognition to social cognition, and finally to self-referential cognition. We study their potential risks to human agency, autonomy, and control capability, corresponding to each cognitive level. We finally propose strategies to mitigate these risks and enhance the controllability of agentic AI systems, ensuring their long-term safe development.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了由大型语言模型驱动的智能体系统在认知能力扩展过程中带来的风险，提出了一个从物理认知、社会认知到自我指涉认知的三层框架，并对应分析了这些认知层面对人类能动性、自主性和控制能力的潜在威胁，最后提出了缓解风险、增强可控性的策略。
