AI.motivation: 随着LLM驱动的智能体系统展现出类人认知模式并深度融入各领域，其认知参与对人类社会的潜在风险尚未得到充分研究。作者旨在填补这一研究空白，系统性地审视认知能力扩展所带来的风险。
AI.method: 采用三层认知框架进行系统分析：第一层为物理认知（physical cognition），第二层为社会认知（social cognition），第三层为自我指涉认知（self-referential cognition）。针对每个认知层级，分别研究其对人类能动性（agency）、自主性（autonomy）和控制能力（control capability）的潜在风险，并提出相应的缓解策略。
AI.result: 提出了一个系统性的三层认知风险分析框架，将智能体的认知范围与人类核心价值（能动性、自主性、控制力）进行映射，并提供了针对各层级风险的缓解策略，以增强智能体AI系统的可控性。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性的风险分析框架和缓解策略的提出，本文为确保智能体AI系统的长期安全发展提供了理论和实践指导。

title: PCA-guided Activation Scaling for Monotonic Bidirectional Control over LLM Sycophancy
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit sycophancy, a tendency to agree with user beliefs regardless of factual accuracy. This can reinforce misconceptions, but eliminating it entirely risks over-correction against valid opinions. Effective control must therefore both reduce and increase sycophancy with predictable and gradual effect. Yet, existing methods fail to ensure a bidirectional and monotonic relationship between steering strength and behavioral outcome across models and datasets. We introduce PCA-guided Activation Scaling (PAS), an activation steering framework that decomposes residual stream activations into a PCA-identified sycophancy-honesty subspace and an orthogonal residual, then applies distinct scaling exponents to achieve monotonic, bidirectional control. Across three LLMs and three datasets, PAS achieves strong monotonicity (Spearman $ρ$ = +0.92) and an average shift of 15.4% per direction, compared with 8.7% for the baselines. Ablation studies confirm that the decomposition, asymmetric exponents, and layer selection are each essential for maintaining monotonic control. The data and code are available at https://github.com/Bellafc/PCS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCA引导的激活缩放（PAS）框架，通过将残差流激活分解为PCA识别的谄媚-诚实子空间和正交残差，应用不同的缩放指数实现对LLM谄媚行为的单调、双向控制。
AI.motivation: LLM表现出谄媚倾向（sycophancy），即无论事实准确性如何都倾向于同意用户信念。完全消除谄媚可能导致过度纠正，因此需要既能减少又能增加谄媚的可预测、渐进的调控方法。现有方法无法在多个模型和数据集上保证调控强度与行为结果之间的双向单调关系。
AI.method: PAS框架包含三个核心步骤：（1）利用PCA将残差流激活分解为谄媚-诚实子空间及正交残差；（2）对两部分应用不同的缩放指数以实现不对称调控；（3）结合分层选择来确保单调控制效果。
AI.result: 在三个LLM和三个数据集上，PAS实现了强单调性（Spearman ρ=+0.92），每方向平均偏移15.4%，而基线仅为8.7%。消融实验证实分解、不对称指数和层选择对维持单调控制均至关重要。
AI.conclusion: PAS是首个能实现双向、单调谄媚调控的激活引导框架，为LLM行为可控性提供了新方法，代码和数据已开源。

title: AlignJEPA: Predictive Vision-Language Alignment for Remote Sensing Foundation Models
summary: Remote sensing (RS) foundation models provide transferable Earth observation representations across sensors, resolutions, and geographies, yet most remain weakly aligned with natural language, limiting natural-language archive search, image-text retrieval, and question-conditioned analysis. We propose AlignJEPA, a JEPA-inspired predictive vision-language alignment framework for remote sensing foundation models. AlignJEPA uses a pretrained AnySat visual encoder and a RemoteCLIP text encoder while training only a lightweight predictive alignment network. Instead of relying on global image--text contrastive alignment alone, the framework predicts remote-sensing text embeddings from masked visual foundation-model tokens. Its mask-aware multi-scale predictive aligner aggregates visible tokens at fine, regional, and global scales, jointly models them with a cross-scale Transformer, and projects the resulting representation into the text space using learned query pooling. Training combines semantic prediction with bidirectional contrastive retrieval. We train and evaluate AlignJEPA on BigEarthNet.txt for natural-language Sentinel retrieval, evaluate cross-dataset adaptation on RSICD, and use RSVQA only as a closed-set representation probe. AlignJEPA provides a parameter-efficient route for aligning Earth observation foundation models with language.

AI.tldr: AlignJEPA是一个基于JEPA思想的预测式视觉-语言对齐框架，用于遥感基础模型。它利用预训练的AnySat视觉编码器和RemoteCLIP文本编码器，仅训练轻量级预测对齐网络，通过从掩码视觉token预测遥感文本嵌入来实现高效的语言对齐，显著提升遥感图像-文本检索能力。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础模型虽然能提供跨传感器、分辨率和地理位置的迁移性表示，但大多与自然语言对齐较弱，限制了自然语言档案搜索、图像-文本检索和基于问题的分析等应用。
AI.method: AlignJEPA采用JEPA风格的预测式对齐框架：使用预训练的AnySat视觉编码器和RemoteCLIP文本编码器，仅训练轻量级预测对齐网络。框架包含掩码感知的多尺度预测对齐器，可在细粒度、区域和全局三个尺度聚合可见token，通过跨尺度Transformer联合建模，并使用学习查询池化将表示投影到文本空间。训练结合了语义预测和双向对比检索。
AI.result: 在BigEarthNet.txt上训练和评估自然语言Sentinel检索，在RSICD上评估跨数据集适应能力，并使用RSVQA作为闭集表示探针进行验证。
AI.conclusion: AlignJEPA提供了一种参数高效的途径，使地球观测基础模型与语言对齐，在保持模型参数效率的同时实现视觉-语言对齐能力。

title: High-Dimensional Nonparametric Change-Point Detection via Low-Rank Degree-Three Density Projection
summary: Distributional changes can be invisible to means and covariances yet appear in skewness, asymmetric interactions, or other third-order structure. We develop a nonparametric change-point method that retains every degree-at-most-three coefficient of a density while avoiding direct density estimation. For observations in $[-1,1]^d$, we construct a symmetric order-three Legendre feature tensor $H_3(X)\in\Sym^3(\R^{d+1})$ such that $A(f)=\E_fH_3(X)$ is an exact isometric encoding of the degree-three density projection: $\|A(f)-A(g)\|_{\F}=\|P_3(f-g)\|_{L^2}$. Instead, fixed tensor contractions are degree-three polynomial chaoses with $ψ_{2/3}$ tails. The two terms have the characteristic order-three tensor scaling and match the powers in sharp concentration results for simple random tensors. For a coordinate-orthogonal specialization, the bound improves to $\sqrt{\log d}$ and enables a prefix-sum implementation in hundreds of dimensions. We derive the exact population tent shape and localization margin, introduce a seeded shortest-interval algorithm with a padded local recentering step, and prove exact recovery by induction: null recursive segments remain inactive, every undetected change retains a balanced isolating interval, and the shortest active seed contains exactly one change before recentering. A two-way cross-fitted scalar refinement attains $O_{\Pp}(κ^{-2})$ localization in the small-jump regime, matching a Le Cam lower bound on a pure cubic family whose degree-two projection jump is exactly zero. Reproducible experiments at $d\in\{20,50,100,200\}$ and a three-change $d=100$ sequence demonstrate the intended high-dimensional regime without materializing a $(d+1)^3$ tensor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种非参数变点检测方法，通过构造对称三阶Legendre特征张量来保留密度函数的所有三次及以下系数，无需直接估计密度。该方法实现了密度的三阶投影的等距编码，并设计了基于种子最短区间的算法，在数百维空间中实现了高精度变点定位。
AI.motivation: 均值和协方差无法捕捉分布的变化，但偏度、非对称交互作用或三阶结构中的变化可能对均值-协方差方法不可见。作者希望开发一种能够检测三阶结构变化的变点检测方法，同时避免直接进行密度估计，以应对高维场景下密度估计的挑战。
AI.method: 1) 构造对称阶三Legendre特征张量H_3(X)，使A(f)=E_f H_3(X)成为密度三阶投影的精确等距编码。2) 固定的张量收缩被证明是三阶多项式混沌，具有ψ_{2/3}尾部。3) 对坐标正交特化，界改进为√log d，支持数百维的前缀和实现。4) 推导精确的总体帐篷形状和定位边界，引入带填充局部重居中步骤的种子最短区间算法。5) 通过归纳法证明精确恢复。6) 采用两路交叉拟合标量细化在小跳跃区域达到O_P(κ^{-2})定位精度。
AI.result: 在小跳跃区域达到O_P(κ^{-2})定位精度，匹配纯三次族上Le Cam下界，该族的二阶投影跳跃恰好为零。实验在d∈{20,50,100,200}及三变点d=100序列上进行，展示了高维场景下的有效性，无需物化(d+1)^3张量。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功将变点检测扩展到三阶结构，在高维场景下无需显式构造张量即可运行，并通过理论保证（精确定位、Le Cam最优性）和实验验证了其有效性。

title: Physiological World Models for Human State Transitions
summary: Continuous multimodal sensing now allows human physiology to be observed throughout daily life rather than only during occasional clinical visits. However, most health artificial intelligence systems are designed to recognize current states, estimate risks or analyse individual biomarkers. They do not directly model how physiological states change in response to real-world events, behaviours, contexts and interventions. Here we propose the Physiological World Model (PWM), an event-conditioned framework for learning these changes at the level of the whole person. We introduce the HumanState Transition Token, a structured, quality-scored unit that connects the physiological state before an event with the event or action, relevant context and intervention information, the physiological trajectory after the event, observed outcomes and data quality. We describe four capability levels, from state representation to bounded intervention planning, together with four data acquisition and validation protocols. We also propose six benchmark tasks covering HumanState representation, forecasting across multiple timescales, individualized response prediction, simulation of alternative interventions, bounded planning and reliability under distribution shift. Together, this framework provides a practical path towards personalized health management, behavioural intervention design and clinician-supervised decision support, while clearly separating prediction from causal inference and making uncertainty, safety, governance and limits of use explicit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生理世界模型（PWM），一个事件条件化的框架，用于在整体人层面学习生理状态如何随真实世界事件、行为、情境和干预而变化。引入HumanState Transition Token作为结构化、质量评分的单元，连接事件前后的生理状态，并定义了四个能力层级、四种数据获取/验证协议及六个基准任务。
AI.motivation: 大多数健康AI系统仅识别当前状态、估计风险或分析单一生物标志物，无法直接建模生理状态如何响应真实世界事件而变化。需要一个能够预测状态转移的整体系框架。
AI.method: 提出生理世界模型（PWM），核心是HumanState Transition Token——一种将事件前生理状态、事件/动作、情境与干预信息、事件后生理轨迹、观测结果和数据质量连接起来的结构化质量评分单元。定义四个能力层级（从状态表征到有界干预规划）、四种数据获取与验证协议、六个基准任务。
AI.result: 提出了完整的框架性方案，包括PWM建模范式、四层能力体系、四种数据协议和六项基准任务，涵盖状态表征、多时间尺度预测、个体化响应预测、替代干预模拟、有界规划和分布偏移下的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为个性化健康管理、行为干预设计和临床监督决策支持提供实用路径，同时明确区分预测与因果推断，并对不确定性、安全性、治理和使用限制做出显式说明。

title: Does the LM Head Create a Harmful Gradient Bottleneck? A Causal Test
summary: The language-model head maps a hidden state of width D to a vocabulary of size V, so its transpose can return at most D independent directions to the Transformer. Godey and Artzi argue that this severe projection is a harmful optimization bottleneck. We separate the geometry from the causal claim. Our backward-only intervention keeps the ordinary logits and the exact LM-head parameter update while reducing only the rank of the gradient sent into the Transformer. Across five paired seeds on byte-level and BPE-8192 WikiText-2 models, reducing backward rank increases validation loss. An equally ranked factorized forward head, however, increases loss substantially more. At half rank in the larger model, the backward-only loss increase is 0.0586 (95% CI [0.0167, 0.1005]), while the factorized forward head increases loss by 0.1795 ([0.1547, 0.2042]). The vocabulary-space residual also contributes to the ordinary LM-head update, and removing that contribution is harmful. Additional controls show that repeated-token failures are confounded by the number of independently sampled symbols, that adding never-target output classes does not impair learning, and that projection diagnostics do not reliably predict progress in our runs. Tested auxiliary feedback routes do not beat tuned backpropagation. These results confirm strong geometric compression but do not establish that it is a harmful optimization bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"仅反向传播"干预实验，将语言模型头的几何压缩与因果瓶颈论断分离，发现降低反向传播秩确实会增加验证损失，但影响远小于等效的因子化前向头，且词汇空间残差对LM头更新有贡献，最终结论是：强几何压缩存在，但不能证明其是有害的优化瓶颈。
AI.motivation: Godey和Artzi提出语言模型头将D维隐藏状态投影到V词汇量，其转置最多返回D个独立方向，这种严重投影被认为是有害的优化瓶颈。作者希望区分这一几何事实与该因果论断，检验投影是否真的构成训练瓶颈。
AI.method: 设计仅反向传播干预：保持普通logits和精确的LM头参数更新不变，仅降低发送给Transformer的梯度的秩。在字节级和BPE-8192的WikiText-2模型上使用五对随机种子进行实验，并与等效排名的因子化前向头、词汇空间残差移除、重复token失败、额外输出类、投影诊断和辅助反馈路径等系列对照实验对比。
AI.result: 降低反向传播秩增加验证损失，但影响远小于因子化前向头（半秩下仅反向传播损失增加0.0586，因子化前向头增加0.1795）。移除词汇空间残差对LM头更新的贡献是有害的。重复token失败与独立采样符号数量混淆；添加从未作为目标出现的输出类不影响学习；投影诊断无法可靠预测训练进展；辅助反馈路径不如调优的反向传播。
AI.conclusion: 结果确认了强几何压缩的存在，但并未证实其是有害的优化瓶颈。作者将几何压缩与因果危害论断清晰分离，提供了更精细的实证证据。

title: GLaQ: Grounding Latent Queries in Visual Evidence for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially improved the problem-solving capabilities of multimodal large language models. Fine-grained visual evidence, however, remains difficult to preserve and reuse across text-based reasoning steps. To address this limitation, tool-augmented thinking-with-images methods maintain visual access externally by revisiting or manipulating the image, but require predefined tools and additional inference-time processing. As an internal alternative, continuous visual latent reasoning retains intermediate computation in hidden states. However, its prevailing autoregressive construction makes each latent state depend on its predecessors, so later states may repeat information already present in the latent sequence rather than capture complementary visual details. We introduce GLaQ, a grounded latent-query framework that replaces sequential latent rollout with a fixed set of context-conditioned queries grounded in the original visual tokens. The grounded queries are reinjected for answer generation, providing direct and coordinated access to source visual evidence. We train GLaQ with localized-view supervision followed by reinforcement learning under task-level rewards. Across five benchmarks for fine-grained visual understanding and perception, GLaQ-7B gains 5.99--9.66\% over its base model and leads all compared visual latent methods, suggesting that direct query-to-image grounding can recover localized evidence from the full image without external visual operations or autoregressive latent rollouts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GLaQ，一种基于grounded latent-query的框架，用固定数量的上下文条件查询替代自回归的连续潜在推理，这些查询直接基于原始视觉token进行grounding，并在答案生成时重新注入，从而在不需要外部视觉工具或自回归潜在展开的情况下恢复细粒度局部视觉证据。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型的链式推理虽提升了问题求解能力，但细粒度视觉证据难以在基于文本的推理步骤中保留和复用。现有方法要么依赖外部工具（增加推理开销），要么采用自回归的连续潜在推理，但后者存在信息冗余问题——后续潜状态可能重复先前状态已有信息，而非互补的视觉细节。
AI.method: GLaQ框架用固定的一组上下文条件查询（conditioned queries）替代顺序潜状态展开，查询基于原始视觉token进行grounding。训练分为两个阶段：先使用局部化视图监督（localized-view supervision），再在任务级奖励下进行强化学习。训练完成后，grounded查询会被重新注入用于答案生成。
AI.result: 在五个细粒度视觉理解和感知基准上，GLaQ-7B比其基础模型提升5.99%-9.66%，并优于所有对比的视觉潜在推理方法。
AI.conclusion: 直接查询到图像的grounding能够从完整图像中恢复局部证据，无需外部视觉操作或自回归潜在展开，验证了该方法的有效性和效率。

title: Population Structure Analysis of an Inbred Population using Quantitative Shape Phenotyping from Stereo Retinal Photographs
summary: The population structure of an inbred population of 781 people on Norfolk Island in the Pacific, 318 of which are descendants of the original Mutineers of the Bounty, is analyzed phenotypically using shape from stereo retinal fundus photographs. Three-dimensional optic nerve head (ONH) shape is reconstructed from stereo pairs by a multi-scale stereo matching algorithm. Using deep neural network, the shape of ONH, which is under genetic control, is decomposed into a set of hierarchical features through self-taught learning. Features captured at different levels are selected according to their discriminant power in identifying the two populations. The prediction accuracy is evaluated with stratified cross validation. Given the selected feature set, individuals are grouped into k hierarchical clusters and cluster membership fractions are determined for k=2,3,4,5,6,7. Population structure analysis on the basis of phenotypes through image analysis allows heritability and linkage analysis, including founder effects from English and Polynesian ancestors, potentially leading to new genetic risk factors for glaucoma and other ONH-related eye diseases.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用立体视网膜眼底照片重建视神经头（ONH）的三维形态，通过深度神经网络自学习分解为层次化特征，用于分析诺福克岛近交人群（含赏金号叛变者后裔）的群体结构，最终服务于青光眼等眼病的遗传风险因素发现。
AI.motivation: 传统的群体结构分析通常基于基因型数据，而本研究希望探索通过表型（即视神经头形态）进行群体结构分析的可能性，从而为遗传力分析和连锁分析提供新途径，并可能发现与青光眼等视神经相关眼病的新遗传风险因素。
AI.method: 1) 从立体视网膜眼底照片通过多尺度立体匹配算法重建三维视神经头形态；2) 利用深度神经网络通过自学习将ONH形态分解为层次化特征；3) 根据区分两群体的判别力选择不同层级的特征；4) 使用分层交叉验证评估预测准确率；5) 对选定特征集进行k层次聚类（k=2至7），确定聚类成员比例。
AI.result: 通过分层交叉验证评估了预测准确率，并针对k=2至7的层次聚类确定了群体成员比例，成功实现了基于表型图像的群体结构分析。
AI.conclusion: 基于表型的图像分析可以实现群体结构分析，支持遗传力和连锁分析，包括英国和波利尼西亚祖先的奠基者效应研究，有望揭示青光眼及其他视神经相关眼病的新的遗传风险因素。

title: MoE Router-Guided Clustering for Heterogeneous Federated Instruction Tuning
summary: Federated instruction fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to adapt to decentralized, privacy-sensitive data without requiring data sharing. Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs are particularly attractive for federated learning because their sparse activation reduces computation and communication while scaling model capacity. However, existing federated MoE methods primarily focus on parameter aggregation and personalization, overlooking the routing behavior of MoE models as a source of information for client collaboration. Under heterogeneous instruction distributions, indiscriminate aggregation can lead to negative transfer, highlighting the need to identify which clients should collaborate during federated optimization. We propose ClientMorpher, a routing-aware, personalized federated instruction fine-tuning framework that leverages routing signatures from pretrained MoE models to organize client collaboration prior to aggregation. We investigate two complementary clustering strategies: ClientMorpher-C, which directly clusters clients using expert activation profiles, and ClientMorpher-E, which first clusters experts based on their cross-client usage signatures and then derives client collaboration groups. We evaluate ClientMorpher for federated instruction fine-tuning on the Databricks Dolly-15K dataset, using pathological and Dirichlet-based heterogeneous client distributions across multiple instruction-following tasks. Experimental results show that routing-aware collaboration consistently improves personalized performance compared to conventional federated averaging and local training, while maintaining the same communication cost. Furthermore, our study shows that client-centric and expert-centric clustering provides an effective and scalable approach for personalized federated instruction fine-tuning of sparse MoE LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClientMorpher，一个基于路由感知的个性化联邦指令微调框架，利用预训练MoE模型的路由签名来组织客户端协作，通过两种互补的聚类策略（客户端中心和专家中心）识别应协作的客户端群体，在Dolly-15K数据集上相比传统联邦平均和本地训练取得了更好的个性化性能，且通信成本不变。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦MoE方法主要关注参数聚合和个性化，忽略了MoE模型的路由行为作为客户端协作的信息来源。在异构指令分布下，不加区分的聚合会导致负迁移，因此需要识别哪些客户端应该在联邦优化过程中协作。
AI.method: 提出ClientMorpher框架：1) ClientMorpher-C直接使用专家激活配置对客户端进行聚类；2) ClientMorpher-E先根据跨客户端使用签名对专家聚类，再推导客户端协作组。在聚合之前利用预训练MoE模型的路由签名来组织客户端协作。
AI.result: 在Databricks Dolly-15K数据集上，使用病理性和Dirichlet异构客户端分布进行实验，路由感知协作相比传统联邦平均和本地训练持续提升个性化性能，同时保持相同的通信成本。
AI.conclusion: 客户端中心和专家中心聚类为稀疏MoE LLM的个性化联邦指令微调提供了有效且可扩展的方法，证明了利用路由信息进行客户端协作组织的重要性。

title: Semantic Bandits: In-Context Exploration-Exploitation is Biased by Semantic Priors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as decision-making agents in settings that require sophisticated environmental exploration. However, existing work has raised questions about how LLMs actually balance exploration and exploitation. Unlike classical agents, LLM agents engage with tasks through natural language, exposing them to semantic information with no formal counterpart in the task structure. We introduce the semantic bandit, an extension of the multi-armed bandit setting that explicitly considers the textual labels assigned to actions, and use it to study how semantic priors --- inductive biases arising from associations between language and expected reward learned during pre-training, shape LLM exploration behaviour. We find that semantically informative action labels reduce exploration in favour of exploitation, improving performance when aligned with the reward structure and severely degrading it when misaligned. We further find that negative rewards trigger substantially more exploration than equivalent positive rewards, consistent with an expected-scale bias induced by reward conventions common in pre-training data. Overall, we argue that the use of language to define the environment and rewards introduces unavoidable biases derived from the fact that the model is trained on word co-occurence, with implications for the reliability and robustness of LLM agents in real-world decision-making settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语义老虎机"（semantic bandit）框架，扩展经典多臂老虎机设置以显式考虑动作的文本标签，研究大语言模型（LLM）在探索与利用权衡中如何受语义先验的影响。研究发现：语义信息丰富的动作标签会减少探索、促进利用（与奖励结构一致时提升性能，不一致时严重损害性能）；负奖励比等价正奖励触发更多探索，归因于预训练数据中奖励约定导致的期望尺度偏差。作者认为用语言定义环境和奖励会引入不可避免的、源于词共现训练的先验偏差，影响LLM智能体的可靠性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对LLM在探索-利用权衡中的行为提出质疑，但缺乏系统性框架来研究LLM通过自然语言与环境交互时，语义信息（预训练中形成的语言-奖励关联）如何塑造其探索行为。经典强化学习智能体无法捕捉这种语言特有的先验偏差。
AI.method: 作者设计了"语义老虎机"（semantic bandit），在多臂老虎机基础上为每个动作分配带语义信息的文本标签，通过控制标签与奖励结构是否对齐，系统测量LLM智能体的探索-利用行为差异，并单独考察正负奖励对探索行为的影响。
AI.result: （1）语义信息丰富的标签显著减少探索、偏向利用，奖励结构对齐时性能提升，错位时性能严重恶化；（2）负奖励引发的探索量显著高于等价的正面奖励，体现预训练中奖励约定造成的期望尺度偏差。
AI.conclusion: 语言定义的环境和奖励会不可避免地引入由预训练词共现结构衍生出的先验偏差，这对LLM智能体在真实世界决策场景中的可靠性与鲁棒性构成重要挑战。

title: Efficient Audio-Visual Generation via Synchrony-Aware Cross-Modal Sparse Attention
summary: Recent audio-visual generation models can synthesize synchronized video and sound in a unified diffusion process, but their inference cost remains high because long video token sequences require repeated attention computation across denoising steps.A variety of acceleration techniques have been developed for video generation models, including low-bit quantization, attention sparsification, and feature caching.However, since these methods are originally designed for video generation, directly applying them to audio-visual models overlooks the interactions between the audio and video branches and may therefore disrupt audio-video synchronization.We present a synchronization-aware acceleration framework for efficient audio-visual generation.Our key observation is that bidirectional audio-video cross-attention reveals structured interactions between the two branches, with high responses often concentrated on a few sound-related visual and temporal regions.Guided by this interaction pattern, we introduce a protected sparse attention strategy that preserves high-fidelity computation for synchronization-critical tokens while sparsifying redundant attention interactions.By explicitly accounting for cross-modal dependence during acceleration, our method improves inference efficiency while keeping video quality, audio quality, and audio-video synchronization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种同步感知的加速框架，利用音频-视频交叉注意力中结构化交互模式（高分响应集中在少数与声音相关的视觉和时间区域），通过保护性稀疏注意力策略，在保持音视频质量与同步性的同时提升生成效率。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频生成模型推理成本高昂，而现有加速技术（量化、注意力稀疏化、特征缓存）均为纯视频生成设计，直接应用于音视频模型会忽略音视频分支间的交互，可能破坏音视频同步性。
AI.method: 关键观察是双向音视频交叉注意力揭示了分支间的结构化交互——高分响应集中在少数与声音相关的视觉和时间区域。基于此交互模式，提出保护性稀疏注意力策略：对同步关键token保留高保真计算，同时对冗余注意力交互进行稀疏化处理。
AI.result: 方法在提升推理效率的同时，保持了视频质量、音频质量和音视频同步性。
AI.conclusion: 在加速过程中显式考虑跨模态依赖，能够在提高推理效率的同时不牺牲音视频生成质量与同步性。

title: Optimal Lower Bounds for Networked Information Aggregation
summary:
The problem of networked information aggregation, studied in Kearns et al. (2026), involves a group of learners situated on the vertices of a directed acyclic graph $G$, each learning a linear predictor $\widehat Y$ for a fixed random variable $Y$ given access to a local feature, as well as the predictors learnt by its parents. Learning proceeds iteratively, with learners ordered according to a topological sort of $G$. The main quantity of interest is the error incurred by the current learner, constrained to this flow of information, with respect to the best linear predictor using all the features seen so far. When the studied error is the MSE, i.e., $\mathbb{E} (\widehat Y - Y)^2$, Kearns et al. (2026) show that the error is at most $O(1/\sqrt{D})$ along a path of length $D$. They also obtain a hard instance where the MSE is lower bounded by $Ω(1/D)$, leaving the correct order open. In this work, we resolve this central open problem, and obtain a family of worst case problem instances with a MSE lower bound of $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$.
  By exploiting invariances in the structure of the learnt predictors, our analysis generalizes to all convex loss functions $\ell(\widehat Y, Y)$ satisfying regularity conditions which include strong convexity in a ball around the origin, and that the ideal predictor minimizing the population loss is positively correlated with the label. We show that networked information aggregation on a gaussian instance in our worst case family incurs an $\ell$-error lower bounded by $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$ with respect to this ideal predictor. We demonstrate that a variety of common losses satisfy these regularity conditions. In particular, the logistic loss satisfies them, and hence our analysis also closes the gap between the upper and lower bounds in Bateni et al. (2026).

AI.tldr: 本文解决了Kearns等人(2026)提出的网络信息聚合问题的开放性问题。在该问题中，学习者位于有向无环图顶点上，每个学习者基于局部特征和父节点的预测学习线性预测器。Kearns等人已证明MSE误差上界为O(1/√D)，下界为Ω(1/D)，本文通过构造最坏情况实例族，将MSE下界提升至Ω(1/√D)，从而完全解决了这一开放问题。此外，利用预测器结构的对称性，分析推广至所有满足正则条件的凸损失函数（包括强凸性和理想预测器与标签正相关），并证明了Logistic损失等常见损失满足这些条件，闭合了Bateni等人(2026)中上下界之间的差距。
AI.motivation: Kearns等人(2026)研究了有向无环图上的网络信息聚合问题，证明了MSE误差的上界为O(1/√D)，但仅获得Ω(1/D)的下界，留下上界与下界之间的开放问题（即正确阶数未知）。本文旨在解决这一核心开放问题，确定该误差的精确数量级。
AI.method: 本文通过构造一族最坏情况的问题实例，在这些实例上证明MSE误差下界为Ω(1/√D)，从而匹配已知的上界。关键技术在于利用所学预测器结构中的对称性（invariances），使分析方法能够从MSE推广到所有满足正则条件的凸损失函数。这些正则条件包括：在原点附近球内的强凸性，以及最小化总体损失的理想预测器与标签正相关。通过在高斯实例上展示该最坏情况族，证明了任意满足条件的损失函数的误差下界为Ω(1/√D)。
AI.result: 本文成功将MSE误差下界从Ω(1/D)改进到Ω(1/√D)，与已知上界O(1/√D)匹配，完全解决了该开放问题。同时，对称性分析使结果推广至一大类凸损失函数（包括Logistic损失等），证明这些损失在构造的最坏情况高斯实例族上同样具有Ω(1/√D)的误差下界，从而也闭合了Bateni等人(2026)中关于Logistic损失的上下界差距。
AI.conclusion: 本文完全解决了网络信息聚合问题中MSE误差的精确阶数问题，证明其紧界为Θ(1/√D)。更重要的是，通过对称性分析实现了对一般凸损失函数的统一处理，确立了网络信息聚合在这种信息流约束下的固有误差下界，为该领域提供了完整而深刻的理论理解。

title: Physics-informed VAE-EVT for Tail Aware Radio Map Prediction
comment: Accepted at the IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM) 2026, Macau, China
summary: Ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) requires precise identification of spatial regions where the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) falls below an outage threshold. In this context, an outage refers to instances in which SNR falls below a specified threshold, which, for URLLC, can be as stringent as the 0.1% quantile of the SNR distribution. Traditional generative radio map models tend to focus on reconstructing average signal levels, often overlooking the low SNR that is crucial for accurate outage prediction. To address this limitation, we introduce a physics- and tail-informed VAE-EVT (variational autoencoder-extreme value theory) framework that distinctly models both the bulk and tail distribution of SNR. Our approach begins with a physics-informed preprocessing stage that extracts deterministic features, including line-of-sight, shadowing, and distance, from the scene geometry. A dual-latent encoder then captures the bulk SNR using a Gaussian mixture and the tail using a generalized Pareto distribution (GPD). By employing a modified variational objective, the model is trained to jointly supervise both regimes, ensuring focused attention on extreme fading events. Evaluated on the RadioMapSeer dataset, our method achieves an SNR RMSE of 4.83 dB in the outage region defined by the low threshold of 0.1% SNR quantile. This significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art GAN-based model, which records an SNR RMSE of 21.90 dB, with the performance gap widening as the outage threshold becomes more stringent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种物理与尾部信息结合的VAE-EVT框架（变分自编码器-极值理论），用于URLLC场景下低SNR（信号噪声比）中断区域的精确预测。该框架通过物理信息预处理提取确定特征，并用双潜变量编码器分别建模SNR的主体分布（高斯混合）和尾部分布（广义帕累托分布），在RadioMapSeer数据集上实现了4.83 dB的SNR RMSE，显著优于基于GAN的最先进模型（21.90 dB）。
AI.motivation: 传统生成式无线电地图模型主要关注重建平均信号水平，忽略了对于URLLC至关重要的低SNR（即SNR分布的0.1%分位数以下的极端衰落事件），导致中断预测不准确。
AI.method: 该方法包含三个核心步骤：(1) 物理信息预处理阶段，从场景几何中提取视线（LoS）、阴影衰落和距离等确定性特征；(2) 双潜变量编码器架构，利用高斯混合模型建模主体SNR分布，利用广义帕累托分布（GPD）建模尾部极值；(3) 采用修改后的变分目标函数，联合监督主体和尾部两种分布，确保模型对极端衰落事件给予充分关注。
AI.result: 在RadioMapSeer数据集上，该方法在0.1% SNR分位数定义的极低中断阈值下实现了4.83 dB的SNR RMSE，显著优于基于GAN的最先进模型（21.90 dB），且随着中断阈值越严格，性能差距进一步扩大。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式区分并联合建模SNR的主体分布与尾部极值分布，该框架能够有效克服传统无线电地图模型对低SNR区域预测不足的缺陷，为URLLC场景提供更可靠的中断预测能力。

title: ClawGym II: Exploring Black-Box RL on Agent Harness
summary: Agent harnesses have substantially improved performance on long-horizon tasks by coordinating agent interactions with the environment. However, reinforcement learning through complex harnesses remains largely unexplored, as scaling such training to long-horizon agent tasks introduces fundamental challenges. In this work, we present a unified black-box RL framework for stable and scalable optimization of general agents through complex harnesses. Concretely, we first build a sandbox-based execution infrastructure that isolates task environments and harnesses within temporary sandboxes for large-scale concurrent rollouts. We then decouple policy optimization from opaque harness execution and place a serving proxy at the model boundary to capture model calls. To reconstruct multi-turn trajectories and improve training efficiency, we organize the captured calls into prefix trees and further adapt both critic-based PPO and critic-free GRPO to optimize over the recovered tree structure. Meanwhile, we maintain training-inference consistency throughout the optimization process. Finally, we introduce mix-harness training, allowing a single model to be jointly optimized by heterogeneous harnesses. With Qwen3-30A3B, black-box RL improves Pass@1 on ClawGym-Bench by 9.98 and 14.81 points through OpenClaw and Claude Code, respectively, while remaining stable over 200-400 optimization steps. Moreover, the framework yields consistent gains on more challenging tasks such as JobBench and OfficeQA. Overall, our framework enables effective, stable, and scalable optimization of general agents through black-box harnesses, supporting unified training across heterogeneous execution systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的黑盒强化学习框架，用于通过复杂harness稳定且可扩展地优化通用智能体。该框架构建了基于沙盒的执行基础设施，将策略优化与不透明的harness执行解耦，通过前缀树重构多轮轨迹，并同时适配PPO和GRPO算法，支持混合harness联合训练。实验表明该方法在ClawGym-Bench等基准上取得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: Agent harness（智能体外壳/工具）能显著提升长时域任务的性能，但通过复杂harness进行强化学习仍未被充分探索。将RL训练扩展到长时域agent任务面临根本性挑战，如大规模并发回滚、轨迹重构、算法适配等问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于沙盒的执行基础设施，将任务环境和harness隔离在临时沙盒中，支持大规模并发回滚；2) 将策略优化与不透明的harness执行解耦，在模型边界放置服务代理以捕获模型调用；3) 将捕获的调用组织成前缀树来重构多轮轨迹，并适配基于critic的PPO和无critic的GRPO算法来进行树结构上的优化；4) 在整个优化过程中维持训练-推理一致性；5) 引入混合harness训练，使单一模型可被异构harness联合优化。
AI.result: 使用Qwen3-30A3B模型，黑盒RL在ClawGym-Bench上通过OpenClaw和Claude Code分别将Pass@1提升了9.98和14.81个百分点，且在200-400优化步骤中保持稳定。此外，在JobBench和OfficeQA等更具挑战性的任务上也获得了一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了通过黑盒harness对通用智能体进行有效、稳定且可扩展的优化，支持跨异构执行系统的统一训练。

title: EA-LiteUNet: An Edge-Adaptive and Resource-Efficient U-Net for Boundary-Sensitive Dermoscopic Image Segmentation
summary: Accurate boundary delineation remains a persistent challenge in dermoscopic image segmentation because of blurred lesion margins, heterogeneous textures, and complex background artifacts. From a signal-processing perspective, lesion boundaries represent high-frequency components that are highly susceptible to aliasing, noise amplification, and information loss. Consequently, repeated downsampling and feature transformations in conventional convolutional architectures often lead to severely degraded boundary representations. To address these limitations, we propose EA-LiteUNet, an edge-adaptive and computationally efficient U-Net variant specifically designed for boundary-sensitive medical image segmentation. The architecture integrates three core mechanisms: (1) boundary-aware representation learning to suppress aliasing and preserve high-frequency structural details; (2) attention-guided feature modulation to selectively enhance boundary-relevant responses across multi-scale features; and (3) a resource-adaptive inference strategy to dynamically balance segmentation accuracy and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations across three public dermoscopic datasets demonstrate that EA-LiteUNet consistently achieves superior boundary precision. Specifically, on the ISIC 2018 dataset, the method significantly reduces the 95% Hausdorff Distance (HD95) to 12.89 pixels while maintaining a robust Dice score of 92.08%. Notably, this strong performance is achieved with an ultralightweight configuration of merely 0.29M parameters and 1.17 GFLOPs. Ablation studies further validate the complementary effects of these components, confirming their contribution to enhanced boundary fidelity and stable optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EA-LiteUNet，一种边沿自适应且计算高效的U-Net变体，用于皮肤镜图像分割中的精确边界描绘。该架构通过三种核心机制（边界感知表示学习、注意力引导特征调制、资源自适应推理策略）解决传统卷积架构中下采样导致的边界退化问题，在ISIC 2018等三个公开数据集上实现了卓越的边界精度（HD95降至12.89像素，Dice达92.08%），且仅需0.29M参数和1.17 GFLOPs。
AI.motivation: 皮肤镜图像分割中，病灶边界因模糊边缘、异质纹理和复杂背景伪影而难以精确描绘。从信号处理角度看，边界属于高频分量，易受混叠、噪声放大和信息丢失影响；传统卷积架构的重复下采样和特征变换会严重退化边界表示，亟需针对性的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出EA-LiteUNet架构，集成三个核心机制：(1)边界感知表示学习，抑制混叠并保留高频结构细节；(2)注意力引导特征调制，在多尺度特征中选择性增强边界相关响应；(3)资源自适应推理策略，动态平衡分割精度与计算效率。
AI.result: 在三个公开皮肤镜数据集上一致取得优越的边界精度。在ISIC 2018上，HD95显著降至12.89像素，Dice分数达92.08%，同时仅需0.29M参数和1.17 GFLOPs的超轻量配置。消融实验验证了各组件互补效果，确认它们在增强边界保真度和稳定优化方面的贡献。
AI.conclusion: EA-LiteUNet通过角度化的边界保持设计，在实现超轻量计算开销的同时显著提升了边界分割精度，验证了从信号处理视角设计边界敏感分割网络的可行性，为资源受限场景下的高精度医学图像分割提供了有效方案。

title: Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study
summary: Modern deep networks are trained through long update trajectories, yet their temporal organization remains less systematically characterized than architectures, losses, or optimizers. We study short-horizon predictability as a measure of temporal redundancy: where, when, and under which training conditions recent updates contain information about near-future parameter motion. We combine three complementary probe families, displacement-direction, subspace-residual, and predictor-based probes, with convention-aware, null-calibrated group-level readouts, and apply them to multi-pass vision training on CIFAR and public Pythia pretraining checkpoints. Across both regimes, vector-like tensors such as normalization parameters and biases (auxiliary parameters) exhibit simpler short-horizon dynamics than matrix-like feature-transforming weights (bulk parameters), whose predictable behavior concentrates in localized, time-varying pockets. Agreement within and across probe families, and with independent trajectory diagnostics, indicates that these measurements capture intrinsic trajectory structure, while probe differences distinguish complementary forms of temporal organization. Controlled CIFAR comparisons further show that architecture and training recipe systematically modulate the measured structure. A Pythia-70M case study further exposes a sequence of role-, depth-, and scale-dependent events, including bulk ESA falling below the random sign-agreement level and the emergence and redistribution of predictable qkv pockets across layers. These results position short-horizon predictability as a retrospective, parameter-resolved diagnostic of training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地研究了深度网络训练轨迹的短期可预测性（short-horizon predictability），将其作为衡量时间冗余度的指标。通过三种互补的探针（位移方向、子空间残差、基于预测器的探针），结合校准的组级读数，在CIFAR视觉训练和Pythia预训练检查点上分析近期更新包含的关于近未来参数运动的信息。发现向量型张量（归一化参数和偏置）比矩阵型特征变换权重表现出更简单的短期动力学，可预测行为集中在局部、随时间变化的"口袋"中。研究还揭示了架构和训练策略系统地调节这种结构，并在Pythia-70M案例中暴露了角色、深度和尺度依赖的训练事件序列。
AI.motivation: 现代深度网络的训练通过长时间更新轨迹进行，但相比于架构、损失函数或优化器，其时间组织性尚未被系统地表征。作者希望填补这一空白，通过短期可预测性来衡量训练轨迹中的时间冗余度，从而更深入地理解训练动力学。
AI.method: 作者设计了三种互补的探针家族（位移方向探针、子空间残差探针、基于预测器的探针），并采用惯例感知（convention-aware）、零校准（null-calibrated）的组级读数。将这些方法应用于CIFAR多轮视觉训练和公开的Pythia预训练检查点，并进行受控对比实验以检验架构和训练策略的影响。
AI.result: 向量型张量（辅助参数如归一化参数和偏置）表现出更简单的短期动力学，而矩阵型参数（批量参数如特征变换权重）的可预测行为集中在局部、随时间变化的口袋中。探针家族内部和之间的一致性以及与独立轨迹诊断的一致性表明测量捕获了内在轨迹结构。受控CIFAR比较显示架构和训练策略系统性地调节测量结构。Pythia-70M案例研究揭示了角色、深度和尺度依赖的事件序列，包括批量ESA降至随机符号一致性水平以下以及可预测qkv口袋的涌现和重新分布。
AI.conclusion: 短期可预测性可以作为一种回顾性的、参数分辨的训练动力学诊断工具。该研究提供了系统理解训练轨迹时间组织的框架，揭示了不同类型参数在训练动力学中的根本差异，为未来优化训练过程和诊断训练问题提供了新的视角。

title: The Benchmark Trap: Structures of Power and Injustice in AI Evaluations
comment: to appear in the proceedings of AIES 2026
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) benchmarks are not neutral tools of evaluation but socio-technical artefacts that shape competition, power, and research priorities within AI. Benchmarks standardise the assessment of systems and facilitate the creation of leaderboards that reward state-of-the-art performance with prestige, citations, trust, and institutional influence. As the costs of developing competitive AI systems rise, these rewards increasingly concentrate among powerful, industry-funded labs. This paper situates these concerns within Iris Marion Young's theories of oppression and structural injustice. It argues that current benchmarking practices may perpetuate systematic harms affecting various actors in AI research, aligning with four of Young's "faces of oppression". Benchmarking culture is further framed as a source of structural injustice, as these harms emerge from normalised, individually defensible practices and network effects, even without explicit wrongdoing. By reinforcing existing power structures and narrowing possible research trajectories, benchmarking may in fact prevent the field from advancing in epistemically robust and socially beneficial ways.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审视AI基准测试，认为其并非中立的评估工具，而是塑造AI领域竞争、权力与研究优先级的"社会技术人工制品"。作者运用Iris Marion Young的压迫与结构性不正义理论，论证现有基准测试实践可能系统性地损害AI研究中的多方参与者，强化既有权力结构并窄化研究路径。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统开发成本不断上升，基准测试榜单带来的声望、引用和机构影响力等奖励日益集中于少数由产业界资助的大型实验室。作者希望揭示基准测试作为看似中立的技术工具，实际上如何通过正常化的实践和网络效应，系统性强化权力不平等并造成结构性不正义。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析的方法，将AI基准测试实践置于Iris Marion Young的压迫理论框架下进行阐释。论文通过将基准测试文化与Young提出的四种"压迫面貌"（剥削、边缘化、无权、文化帝国主义）逐一对照，论证其如何产生系统性伤害；并将其进一步界定为结构性不正义的来源——即伤害源于正常化、个体层面合理的行为与网络效应，而非明确的过错行为。
AI.result: 论文论证表明，当前基准测试实践与Young的压迫理论中的四种"压迫面貌"相吻合，可能对AI研究中的各类参与者造成系统性伤害。同时，基准测试文化被定性为结构性不正义的来源，因为它通过正常化的实践和网络效应运作，即使在没有明确不当行为的情况下也会强化既有权力结构。
AI.conclusion: 通过强化现有权力结构并窄化可能的研究轨迹，基准测试可能恰恰阻碍了AI领域以认识论上稳健且对社会有益的方式向前发展。这呼吁研究者重新审视基准测试的设计与使用，将其视为承载社会影响的社会技术系统而非纯技术工具。

title: Model Hypnosis: Strong control of AI via additive subliminal effects
summary: We demonstrate that AI models are broadly susceptible to a phenomenon we call model hypnosis, in which individually weak and seemingly irrelevant cues in the prompt can be systematically combined to strongly control model behavior. Model hypnosis occurs across model families and scales, including in frontier reasoning models, and hypnotic prompts can transfer between models. Because the model is controlled by inconspicuous textual choices, such as paraphrases and typos, model hypnosis presents new challenges and avenues for AI safety, and is a major hurdle for AI interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"模型催眠"（model hypnosis）现象：AI模型中单个看似无关紧要的弱线索可以被系统性地组合起来，从而强烈控制模型行为。该现象跨越模型家族和规模，包括前沿推理模型，且催眠提示可在模型间迁移，对AI安全与可解释性构成重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 发现现有研究对模型行为的控制通常聚焦于显著的提示注入或强指令，但忽略了大量弱而分散的文本线索（如改写、拼写错误）被组合后也能产生强大的行为控制效果，这构成了新的安全与可解释性威胁。
AI.method: 系统地组合单个弱提示线索，验证其在多种模型家族和不同规模模型（包括前沿推理模型）上的效果，并测试催眠提示在不同模型间的可迁移性。
AI.result: 模型催眠现象在多种模型家族和规模上普遍存在，包括前沿推理模型；催眠提示能够在不同模型之间迁移。
AI.conclusion: 模型催眠在文本层面隐蔽且难以察觉，为AI安全带来新挑战，同时也是AI可解释性的重大障碍，需要新的防御和解释方法。

title: CrossView: Can Vision-Language Models Reason Across Cameras?
summary: Video understanding benchmarks have long centered on single-camera settings, where modern multi-modal language models achieve strong performance across image and video tasks. Yet, the real world runs on multi-camera networks: autonomous vehicles, security systems, and robots all gather data across many simultaneous views. We argue that this is not simply "more" of the single-camera problem; it is fundamentally different. Multi-camera reasoning requires handling context that scales with the number of views, resolving occlusions visible from only a subset of cameras, judging which views matter, and integrating evidence across perspectives that may overlap or diverge. Current models struggle with exactly these challenges, yet no benchmark systematically targets them. We introduce CrossView, a multi-camera video question-answering benchmark spanning autonomous driving, security surveillance, egocentric/exocentric video, and robotics. Evaluation of proprietary models, such as GPT-5.2, and open-source models, like Qwen3-VL, reveals consistently low accuracy, with open-source models trailing by a wide margin. Performance scales strongly with a model's ability to jointly process multiple viewpoints, positioning CrossView as a rigorous benchmark for multi-camera video. We open-source our code and dataset at https://utaustin-swarmlab.github.io/CrossView.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossView，一个多摄像头视频问答基准测试，涵盖自动驾驶、安防监控、自我/外部视角视频和机器人领域。评估显示专有和开源多模态模型在此任务上准确率均较低，开源模型差距更大，性能与模型联合处理多视角的能力强相关。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频理解基准大多聚焦于单摄像头设置，但现实世界（自动驾驶、安防、机器人）普遍依赖多摄像头网络。多摄像头推理在本质上有别于单摄像头问题，需要处理随视角数扩展的上下文、跨视角遮挡、视角选择与证据整合等独特挑战，而现有模型在这些方面表现挣扎，且缺乏系统性基准来测试和推动这一能力。
AI.method: 构建CrossView多摄像头视频问答基准，覆盖自动驾驶、安防监控、自我/外部视角视频和机器人四个领域，并对专有模型（如GPT-5.2）和开源模型（如Qwen3-VL）进行系统评估。
AI.result: 评估显示所有模型在CrossView上准确率普遍较低，开源模型与专有模型差距明显。模型性能与其联合处理多视角的能力呈强正相关，验证了该基准的有效性和区分度。
AI.conclusion: CrossView成为一个严格的多摄像头视频推理基准，揭示出现有模型的不足，并为推动多模态模型在多视角场景中的发展提供评测框架。代码和数据集已开源。

title: QSMP: finding representative time series subsequences through Quick Shift+Matrix Profile
comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP)
summary: Finding representative waveforms in long time series has scientific and practical value in many domains, as it enables summarization and visualization of large time series datasets, and downstream tasks like classification and forecasting. We present here QSMP, a method to find representative waveforms in long time series through a density-guided clustering of time series subsequences. Our method makes a novel connection between Quick Shift, a mode-seeking algorithm, and the Matrix Profile, a time series similarity-search data structure, to adapt Quick Shift to the clustering of subsequences in long time series, with a space complexity that is superior to the state-of-the-art method. Our experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that QSMP can be a valuable tool to summarize and visualize long time series by finding representative waveforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QSMP方法，通过将Quick Shift模式搜索算法与Matrix Profile时间序列相似性搜索数据结构相结合，实现对长时间序列子序列的密度引导聚类，以发现代表性波形，空间复杂度优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在长时间序列中寻找代表性波形具有重要的科学和实践价值，可用于数据摘要、可视化和下游任务（如分类和预测），但现有方法在效率和空间复杂度上存在不足。
AI.method: QSMP方法将Quick Shift（一种模式搜索算法）与Matrix Profile（一种时间序列相似性搜索数据结构）进行新颖结合，将Quick Shift适配到长时间序列子序列的聚类任务中，实现密度引导的聚类。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，QSMP能够有效地通过发现代表性波形来摘要和可视化长时间序列，且空间复杂度优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: QSMP作为一种密度引导的子序列聚类方法，是长时间序列摘要和可视化的有价值工具，其在空间复杂度上的优势使其适用于大规模时间序列数据。

title: A concentration result for multilayer feedforward neural networks
summary: We consider for an arbitrary fixed $ρ$ and for each positive integer $n$ a multilayer feedforward artificial neural network with $ρ$ layers, $n$ neurons in the first layer (the input layer) and only one neuron, the output neuron, in the last layer. Very roughly formulated, the main result is that if the distribution of weights of connections from a layer to the next are, for all large $n$, approximated well by a fixed continuous (but otherwise arbitrary) curve which does not depend on $n$, and if the values of the $n$ input neurons are independently and identically distributed with a continuous probability density function, then there is a number $ψ$ such that for all $\varepsilon > 0$ the probability that the value of the output neuron is in $[ψ- \varepsilon, ψ+ \varepsilon]$ tends to 1 as $n$ tends to infinity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多层前馈人工神经网络在输入维度趋于无穷时的输出收敛行为，证明了在权重分布近似于某固定连续曲线且输入独立同分布连续的条件下，输出神经元的值将以概率收敛到一个确定常数ψ。
AI.motivation: 理解大规模神经网络在层数固定但每层神经元数趋于无穷时的极限行为，为神经网络的泛化性和稳定性提供理论依据。
AI.method: 考虑具有ρ层（第一层n个输入神经元，最后一层仅1个输出神经元）的多层前馈神经网络。假设层间连接权重的分布在n充分大时可被一条固定的连续曲线良好逼近，且n个输入神经元的值独立同分布且具有连续概率密度函数。
AI.result: 存在一个数ψ，使得对任意ε>0，输出神经元的值落在[ψ-ε, ψ+ε]区间内的概率当n→∞时趋近于1，即输出值以概率收敛到常数ψ。
AI.conclusion: 在较宽松的假设条件下（权重分布可被固定连续曲线逼近、输入独立同分布连续），多层前馈网络的输出在大宽度极限下是确定性的，呈现出浓度现象。

title: Towards Computational Provenance: Carrying Causal-State Evidence in Generated Text
summary: A language model's output does not by itself provide verifiable evidence about the internal computation that produced it. We study computational provenance: whether generated text can carry detectable evidence of which causally relevant internal state occurred. We test a bounded form of this idea in two controlled architectures: a modular feed-forward neural network and a transformer-based model. Both architectures are trained on the same arithmetic task with a mandatory pathway through two discrete intermediate states, allowing different internal paths to produce the same answer. We deliberately switch between these paths, authenticate the state actually used, and let that verified state determine a subtle statistical pattern in the generated text that can later be detected. The feed-forward and transformer systems each passed all 128 matched pairs in both their public and separately sealed protected end-to-end evaluations, with the detector recovering the signal associated with the authenticated internal state. The required causal computation also reproduced across five independently trained feed-forward models and three independently trained transformers. In a separate answer-only transformer experiment, our linear probes did not recover a naturally learned intermediate state. These results provide a controlled proof of concept that information about a verified, causally relevant internal state can be preserved in generated text even when the answer is unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文研究计算来源（computational provenance）问题，即生成的文本能否携带关于内部计算状态的可验证证据。作者在两种受控架构（模块化前馈神经网络和Transformer）中训练同一算术任务，要求经过两个离散中间状态的强制路径，允许不同内部路径产生相同答案。通过切换路径、验证实际使用的状态，并让已验证状态决定生成文本中的细微统计模式，前馈和Transformer系统在128对匹配测试中全部通过，检测器成功恢复与已验证内部状态相关的信号。该因果计算在5个独立前馈模型和3个独立Transformer中可复现。在单独的仅答案Transformer实验中，线性探针无法恢复自然学习的中间状态。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的输出本身无法提供关于其内部计算的可验证证据。作者希望探究生成文本能否携带可检测的、与因果相关内部状态有关的证据，从而建立计算来源的概念，为模型可解释性和可验证性提供新途径。
AI.method: 采用两种受控架构（模块化前馈神经网络和Transformer），训练于同一算术任务，设计中强制经过两个离散中间状态。研究者主动在路径间切换，认证实际使用的内部状态，并让该状态编码为生成文本中的微妙统计模式，随后通过线性探针（detector）检测该信号以恢复内部状态信息。
AI.result: 前馈和Transformer系统在公共和密封保护的两类端到端评估中，均通过全部128对匹配测试。检测器成功恢复与认证内部状态相关的信号。因果计算在5个独立训练的前馈模型和3个独立训练的Transformer中均能复现。但在单独的仅答案Transformer实验中，线性探针未能恢复自然学习的中间状态。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了受控的概念验证：即使答案不变，已验证的、因果相关的内部状态信息也能保留在生成文本中。这为计算来源的可验证性提供了基础，但自然学习场景下的中间状态恢复仍具挑战，提示需要进一步研究。

title: RigidBench: Evaluating Rigid-Body Physics in Video Generation Models
comment: 30 pages, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/swarnim-j/RigidBench. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21649156
summary: Video models are increasingly used to predict what happens next in a scene, yet the metrics commonly used to compare their outputs say little about whether the predicted objects move correctly. Motion, geometry, identity, background stability, and visual similarity can fail independently, but whole-frame scores often mix these errors together. We introduce RigidBench, a simulator-grounded benchmark that compares a generated continuation with a reference rollout from the same initial frame and motion description. Its five rigid-body tasks vary objects, materials, viewpoints, and indoor and outdoor scenes, with per-frame masks, depth, 6-DoF trajectories, and contacts available for scoring. We evaluate eight models on the same 100 examples with ten measurements that keep these aspects separate. The resulting rankings depend strongly on what is measured: no model leads on all ten, and across model means, higher SSIM accompanies larger 3D trajectory error (r = 0.89). RigidBench also includes 5,000 training videos with exact simulator state, which we use to fine-tune and analyze Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B. Full fine-tuning reduces 3D trajectory error by about 20% with almost no change in SSIM, while teacher-forced probes and targeted interventions show that object position is represented throughout Wan's diffusion transformer and used by its denoising computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RigidBench，一个基于模拟器的刚体运动视频预测基准，将运动、几何、身份、背景稳定性和视觉相似性等评估维度分离，并利用5000个训练视频微调Wan 2.2模型，将3D轨迹误差降低约20%而SSIM几乎不变。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频预测模型评估指标通常使用整帧分数（如SSIM），这些分数将运动、几何、身份、背景稳定性等不同方面的错误混合在一起，无法独立判断预测的对象是否移动正确。这导致模型排名可能误导研究者，无法诊断模型在哪些具体方面存在缺陷。
AI.method: RiggedBench包含五个刚体任务，涵盖不同的物体、材质、视角、室内外场景，并提供逐帧掩码、深度、6-DoF轨迹和接触信息用于打分。对8个模型在100个示例上使用10种独立测量指标进行评估。此外，提供5000个带精确模拟器状态的训练视频，用于对Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B进行全参数微调，并通过教师强制探测和定向干预分析模型内部表示。
AI.result: 不同测量维度下模型排名差异显著，没有模型能在所有10项指标上领先；跨模型均值中，更高的SSIM伴随更大的3D轨迹误差（相关系数r=0.89）。全参数微调Wan 2.2可将3D轨迹误差降低约20%，且SSIM几乎无变化；分析表明物体位置信息在整个Wan的扩散Transformer中都有表示，并被去噪计算所使用。
AI.conclusion: RigidBench揭示了当前视频预测模型在刚体运动预测上的系统性缺陷，证明仅靠视觉相似性指标评估是不够的；同时展示了基于模拟器生成的精确标注数据微调能有效改善物理运动预测，而不会牺牲视觉质量。

title: PERO: Efficient Robust Post-Training Foundation Models for Encrypted Traffic Classification
summary: Encrypted traffic classification is vital for network security, yet real-world deployments are inherently sensitive to rare but high-loss errors such as misclassification of malicious traffic. The encrypted traffic foundation model, as a promising general-purpose technique, can achieve impressive overall performance. However, employing standard objectives such as empirical risk minimization often overlooks high-risk tail events, and commonly used performance metrics hardly reflect robustness limitations in risk-sensitive scenarios. Directly applying robust optimization objectives, such as conditional value-at-risk, to post-training is computationally prohibitive for large models, as identifying high-loss samples exhausts substantial computation. To this end, we propose Pre-Evaluation Robust Optimization (PERO), an efficient robust post-training framework for encrypted traffic foundation models. PERO employs a lightweight proxy to estimate sample-wise risk and selects a subset of high-risk samples to update the foundation model, decoupling risk estimation from expensive large-model optimization. Extensive experiments on typical encrypted traffic datasets show that PERO achieves competitive or superior robustness and average performance compared to outstanding robust post-training methods, while significantly reducing computational and memory costs.

AI.tldr: 提出了PERO框架，一种面向加密流量基础模型的高效鲁棒后训练方法。通过轻量级代理模型预评估样本风险并筛选高风险子集进行更新，将风险估计与昂贵的大模型优化解耦，在保证鲁棒性的同时大幅降低计算和内存成本。
AI.motivation: 加密流量分类中，罕见的恶意流量误分类等高风险错误代价极高。现有基础模型后训练采用经验风险最小化忽视尾部高风险事件，而直接应用CVaR等鲁棒优化目标在大模型上计算代价过高。
AI.method: 提出PERO框架：(1) 使用轻量级代理模型预评估每个样本的风险；(2) 基于风险估计选择高风险的样本子集；(3) 仅用该子集更新加密流量基础模型，从而解耦风险估计与大规模优化过程，避免对全部样本进行昂贵的大模型前向/反向计算。
AI.result: 在典型加密流量数据集上的大量实验表明，PERO相比优秀的鲁棒后训练方法，在鲁棒性和平均性能上达到竞争性或更优水平，同时显著降低了计算和内存开销。
AI.conclusion: PERO证明了通过轻量级预评估实现风险感知的后训练是可行的，为资源受限场景下加密流量基础模型的鲁棒性优化提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: Incoherent by Design? On the Moral Self-Consistency of LLMs
comment: 88 pages; pages 16 to 88 are the appendix
summary: LLMs are increasingly used in morally sensitive contexts, yet it is unclear whether they apply ethical principles consistently across situations. A model that can state a moral principle may still violate it when the same scenario is rephrased or reframed. This inconsistency is a problem for any system whose outputs are used to inform moral decisions. If generative systems exhibit internal inconsistency, then the epistemic integrity of AI-mediated systems becomes uncertain. To study this concern, we investigate the stability of moral reasoning in LLMs within a controlled prompting framework across three major philosophical schools of thought: deontology, utilitarianism, and virtue ethics. We construct sets of morally equivalent scenarios in which the underlying situation is held constant while the framing varies to reflect different ethical stances and stylistic perturbations. We then evaluate responses from multiple models, including GPT, Mistral, and Llama. To assess consistency, we convert model outputs into structured logical statements and identify contradictions across responses generated within the same school of thought. Our results reveal substantial inconsistency with contradiction rates reaching up to 78% across scenarios. These findings point to a broader phenomenon of epistemic instability in generative AI wherein models fail to reliably maintain coherence with respect to their own prior outputs. This kind of instability carries real consequences. As generative systems influence how people form beliefs, judge actions, and absorb values, their inconsistencies can shape human reasoning and decision-making as well. Moreover, if a system cannot consistently represent its own normative commitments, then value alignment becomes a moving target rather than a well-defined objective. Thus, we argue that demonstrating internal incoherence is a necessary precursor to AI alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM在道德推理中的稳定性问题，通过可控提示框架考察模型在道义论、功利主义和美德伦理三大哲学流派下的道德判断一致性。研究发现模型存在严重的内在矛盾，矛盾率最高达78%，表明生成式AI存在认知不稳定性，并提出证明内在不一致性是AI对齐的必要前提。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于道德敏感场景，但尚不清楚它们是否能在不同情境中一致地应用伦理原则。模型可能陈述某条道德原则，却在同一场景被改写或重新框定后违反该原则。这种不一致性会破坏AI中介系统的认识论完整性，这对任何用于指导道德决策的系统都是严重问题。
AI.method: 1) 在可控提示框架下，围绕道义论、功利主义和美德伦理学三大哲学流派进行研究；2) 构建道德等价场景集——底层情境保持不变，仅改变表述框架，以反映不同伦理立场和风格扰动；3) 评估多个模型（GPT、Mistral、Llama）；4) 将模型输出转换为结构化逻辑陈述，识别同一学派内部的矛盾。
AI.result: 研究发现模型存在显著的不一致性，矛盾率高达78%。这揭示了生成式AI中更广泛的认知不稳定现象——模型无法可靠地维持与自身先前输出的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式系统的内在不一致会通过影响人们信念形成、行动判断和价值观吸收而塑造人类推理和决策。若系统无法一致地表征自身的规范性承诺，价值对齐就会变成移动目标而非明确定义的目标。因此，证明内在不一致性是AI对齐的必要前提。

title: Catching Hallucinated Citations in Video-LLM Question Answering: A Self-Verification Pipeline and Verifier Ablation Study
summary: Video question answering systems built on vision-language models often produce timestamped claims with high confidence even when unsupported by the cited frame. This deceptive hallucination arises because timestamps imply grounding without ensuring correctness, increasing user trust but not accuracy. We introduce a pipeline that closes this loop. A retrieval-augmented language model drafts answers with per-claim timestamp citations, and each cited frame is independently re-examined before being shown to the user. We compare against a plain baseline and ablate three verification designs, evaluated on both Apple Silicon (MLX) and Google Colab (HF Transformers, CUDA). Directly asking the vision model whether a frame supports a claim fails completely (0% catch rate on 40 claims) due to sycophancy. Blind re-captioning plus a general LLM judge improves results but is unstable, oscillating between 0% and 100% flagged depending on prompt phrasing. Replacing that judge with a small natural language inference model yields a stable, interpretable verifier that catches 79% of fabricated claims on adversarial false-premise questions while leaving true claims untouched. We release the full pipeline, evaluation harness, and implementations for both Apple Silicon and Colab. Code is available at https://github.com/yogesh-iitj/grounded-video-qa.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视频问答系统中视觉语言模型产生"欺骗性幻觉"（带时间戳但缺乏依据的声明）的问题，提出了一套闭环验证流水线：检索增强语言模型生成带逐声明时间戳引用的答案，每个被引用的帧在展示给用户前被独立重新审查。实验表明直接询问视觉模型会因谄媚效应完全失败（0%捕获率），盲重新描述加通用LLM判别器不稳定（0-100%波动），而用小型自然语言推理模型替换判别器后，在对抗性错误前提问题上能稳定捕获79%的虚构声明且不误伤真实声明。系统已在Apple Silicon（MLX）和Google Colab（CUDA）上实现并开源。
AI.motivation: 视频问答系统基于视觉语言模型生成带时间戳的声明时，常以高置信度产生未被引用的帧所支持的内容。时间戳暗示了"有据可依"却无法确保正确性，从而增加了用户信任感但并未提升准确性，这种"欺骗性幻觉"需要被识别和遏制。
AI.method: 提出闭环验证流水线：(1) 检索增强语言模型生成带逐声明时间戳引用的答案；(2) 对每个被引用的帧进行独立重新审查才能展示给用户。比较了三种验证设计：a) 直接询问视觉模型该帧是否支持声明（因谄媚失败）；b) 盲重新描述+通用LLM判别器（不稳定）；c) 盲重新描述+小型自然语言推理模型（稳定可解释）。
AI.result: 直接询问视觉模型的验证方式在40条声明上捕获率为0%（谄媚效应）；盲重新描述+通用LLM判别器因提示词措辞不同在0%-100%之间振荡；用小NLI模型替代判别器后，在对抗性错误前提问题上捕获79%的虚构声明，且真实声明不受影响。系统在Apple Silicon（MLX）和Google Colab（CUDA）两种环境中均完成评估。
AI.conclusion: 验证环节不能依赖视觉模型自我确认（会因谄媚失效），也不应依赖通用LLM判别器（不稳定）。将盲重新描述与小型自然语言推理模型结合的方案提供了稳定、可解释且高捕获率的验证手段，能有效识别时间戳声明中的欺骗性幻觉，且不会误伤真实声明。完整流水线、评估框架及双平台实现均已开源。

title: UniFed-VLM: Federated Instruction Tuning for Vision-Language Models with Multiple Heterogeneity
summary:
Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in multimodal understanding and generation. However, fine-tuning of VLMs typically relies on centralized data, which raises privacy concerns in certain domains (e.g. healthcare). Federated Learning (FL) provides a natural solution by enabling model training without sharing raw data. However, applying FL to VLM instruction tuning is highly challenging. VLMs have substantial parameter scales, and in real-world scenarios, clients exhibit significant heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures.
  Existing methods mainly focus on simplified settings and are unable to handle such multi-dimensional heterogeneous scenarios. In this work, we study federated instruction tuning under joint heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures.
  We propose UniFed-VLM, a unified federated instruction tuning framework for VLMs that addresses multiple types of heterogeneity. It consists of two key components: 1) Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation (FedCSA), which performs subspace-aligned aggregation of parameter-efficient adapters with dynamic weighting and compensation to mitigate heterogeneity-induced conflicts; 2) Two-stage Collaborative Distillation (TCoD), which enables effective knowledge transfer across heterogeneous models via a Mutual Distillation Adapter (MDA) and a mixture-of-experts-based distillation strategy. We conduct experiments on multiple benchmark datasets, and the results show that UniFed-VLM achieves stronger average performance across diverse tasks compared with existing FL methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/wangpengyu2004/UniFed-VLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniFed-VLM，一个统一的联邦指令微调框架，用于解决视觉语言模型在联邦学习中面临的任务、模态和模型架构三种异构性挑战。框架包含两个核心组件：Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation (FedCSA)实现参数高效适配器的子空间对齐聚合，以及Two-stage Collaborative Distillation (TCoD)通过互蒸馏适配器和专家混合蒸馏策略实现跨异构模型的知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型微调通常依赖集中式数据，在医疗等领域存在隐私问题。联邦学习虽能解决数据隐私，但应用于VLM指令微调时面临参数规模大、客户端任务/模态/架构异构等挑战，现有方法无法处理这种多维度异构场景。
AI.method: 1) FedCSA：对参数高效适配器进行子空间对齐聚合，采用动态权重和补偿机制缓解异构性导致的冲突；2) TCoD：通过互蒸馏适配器(MDA)和基于专家混合的蒸馏策略，实现异构模型间的有效知识迁移。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，UniFed-VLM在多样化任务上的平均性能优于现有联邦学习方法。
AI.conclusion: UniFed-VLM有效解决了联邦指令微调中多维度异构性问题，为VLM的隐私保护微调提供了可行的统一框架。

title: UC-PSRO: Utility-Conditioned Policy-Space Response Oracles with a Communication-Dropout Curriculum for Game-Theoretic Course-of-Action Generation in Adversarial Swarms
summary: We study generating game-theoretically optimized Courses of Action (COAs) for a Blue UAS swarm against an adaptive Red adversary in a communication-degraded environment, motivated by (but not derived from) a public U.S. Air Force SBIR solicitation. We propose UC-PSRO (Utility-Conditioned Policy-Space Response Oracles with a Communication-Dropout Curriculum), combining three mechanisms: (i) PSRO self-play, so Blue and Red policies train as approximate best responses to each other rather than one side against a fixed scripted opponent; (ii) FiLM conditioning of the Blue policy on a Commander's-Intent weight vector, sampled from a Dirichlet distribution during training, so one trained policy is re-steerable at execution time without retraining; and (iii) a curriculum annealing communication-graph edge dropout during training, so the swarm learns decentralized, peer-to-peer fallback instead of depending on full connectivity. We evaluate on a synthetic, unclassified stand-in for the solicitation's maritime scenario, with 5 seeds at N=25 Blue agents and a scalability sweep to N=200. We find a genuine trade-off, not a uniform win: the communication-dropout curriculum alone gives the strongest, most robust mission-completion rates of any learned method, improving counter-intuitively as denial increases (35% to 62% success as dropout rises from 0 to 0.75); adding utility-conditioning and PSRO self-play substantially slows convergence within a fixed budget, and we find no reliable exploitability advantage for self-play over a fixed-opponent policy, both statistically indistinguishable from a small, near-zero gap. We report this honestly as a convergence cost not yet offset by a demonstrated robustness benefit, rather than overstating one method as dominant, and provide a fully vectorized, open environment training at N=200 agents in single-digit milliseconds per step on a single consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在通信退化环境下，针对自适应红方对手的蓝方无人机蜂群博弈优化行动方案生成问题，提出UC-PSRO方法（结合PSRO自博弈、FiLM指挥官意图条件化和通信丢包课程学习三种机制）。在N=25和N=200规模的合成场景上评估发现：通信丢包课程单独使用效果最强且鲁棒（丢包率0到0.75时成功率从35%提升到62%），而加入效用条件化和自博弈反而显著拖慢收敛，且自博弈相比固定对手策略没有可靠的利用优势。作者诚实地将这一结果报告为收敛代价未被鲁棒性收益抵消。
AI.motivation: 在通信退化环境中，蓝方无人机蜂群需要生成博弈论意义上最优的行动方案以对抗自适应红方。现有方法往往让一方对抗固定脚本对手而非互相适应，且缺乏对指挥官意图的灵活条件和通信断连的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出UC-PSRO框架，包含三个机制：(i) PSRO自博弈使蓝红双方策略互为近似最优反应；(ii) FiLM条件化使蓝方策略可在执行时通过指挥官意图权重向量重新定向，无需重训练；(iii) 通信图边丢包的课程退火训练，使蜂群学会去中心化对等回退。评估采用5个种子N=25及扩展到N=200的可扩展性测试。
AI.result: 通信丢包课程单独使用达到最强的任务完成率与鲁棒性，且随丢包增强成功率反直觉上升（35%到62%）。加入效用条件化和自博弈显著拖慢固定预算内的收敛；自博弈与固定对手策略的利用性差距统计上无显著差异（接近零）。提供全向量化的开源环境，单消费级GPU上N=200训练每步仅需数毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 作者诚实地报告这是一个收敛代价尚未被鲁棒性收益抵消的权衡结果，而非夸大某一方法的优势，强调了对博弈优化方法在通信退化场景下应持审慎态度。

title: PoseAdapter: Dual-Stream 2.5D Controllable Image Generation for Complex Multi-Object Scenes
summary: While Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved remarkable success, precise spatial and orientational control in multi-object scenes remains a persistent challenge. Existing methods either rely on computationally expensive dense 3D maps or suffer from severe attribute leakage and "cut-and-paste" artifacts. To address these limitations, we propose PoseAdapter, a lightweight framework for high-fidelity 2.5D controllable image generation. Instead of dense spatial maps, it establishes precise spatial-angular anchors using an efficient condition layout: individual object captions, 2D bounding boxes, and 3D angles. To resolve the generative trade-off between strict instance isolation and global coherence, we introduce a Context-Aware Dual-Stream Representation. By injecting local object tokens and relation-enriched scene tokens into the visual stream of modern MM-DiT architectures via parallel masked and unmasked pathways, PoseAdapter eliminates attribute leakage while preserving natural inter-object relationships and scene-level coherence. To support this paradigm, we construct OrientLayout, a high-quality dataset featuring standardized 2.5D annotations and instance-level decoupled semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PoseAdapter outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in spatial accuracy, orientational precision, and multi-object visual fidelity. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/cyf23/PoseAdapter.

AI.tldr: PoseAdapter是一个轻量级的2.5D可控图像生成框架，通过对象标题、2D边界框和3D角度的高效条件布局，结合上下文感知双流表示，在多对象场景中实现了精确的空间和方向控制，同时避免了属性泄漏和剪切粘贴伪影。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像扩散模型在多对象场景中缺乏精确的空间和方向控制能力。现有方法要么依赖计算昂贵的密集3D地图，要么遭受严重的属性泄漏和"剪切粘贴"伪影问题。
AI.method: 提出PoseAdapter轻量级框架，使用高效的2.5D条件布局（对象标题+2D边界框+3D角度）建立精确的空间-角度锚点。引入上下文感知双流表示，通过并行掩码和非掩码路径将局部对象token和关系丰富的场景token注入现代MM-DiT架构的视觉流中。同时构建了OrientLayout数据集，包含标准化的2.5D标注和实例级解耦语义。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PoseAdapter在空间精度、方向精确性和多对象视觉保真度方面均优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PoseAdapter有效解决了多对象可控生成中空间与方向控制的挑战，在严格的实例隔离与全局一致性之间取得了良好的平衡，为该领域提供了新的高效解决方案。

title: Guaranteed Adaptive Modality Acquisition: When the Policy Chooses Its Own Calibration Group
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Includes appendix with full proofs and additional experiments
summary: A multimodal system may begin inference holding only some of its inputs and may acquire the rest at a cost. With adaptive acquisition, the policy determines which inputs are ultimately observed, so we state the guarantee conditional on that terminal input pattern. Conditional calibration normally assumes the grouping map is fixed independently of the calibration sample, which policy-induced grouping does not satisfy. We characterize when pattern-conditional guarantees remain valid and give two finite-sample constructions: threshold-free routing with calibration applied at the terminal pattern, and simultaneous certification of complete policy-pattern pairs, which lets calibration data select the deployed policy. A counterexample shows that a guarantee proved for a calibration-independent grouping map need not transfer once the policy makes the terminal group calibration-dependent. We call the resulting method RouteCert. On a clinical electrocardiogram task with a staged, cost-ordered lead protocol, the certified policy answers 71.2% of held-out patients at an observed 7.4% disagreement with the cardiologist's diagnosis at 48.8% of the prespecified ordinal cost of acquiring every stage, and all three acquisition stages carry their own certificate. On masked multimodal benchmarks, certifying pointwise at each terminal pattern holds observed worst-pattern selective risk, measured against the full-information reference decision rather than the true label, at 0.034 where a pooled design reaches 0.145 against a 0.10 cap, at a comparable answered fraction (0.350 vs 0.342); under the budget-matched simultaneous comparison the answered fraction falls to 0.305.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RouteCert方法，用于多模态系统中自适应输入采集（adaptive acquisition）场景下的条件校准保证。该工作刻画了策略引发的分组（policy-induced grouping）下模式条件校准（pattern-conditional calibration）有效的条件，并提供两种有限样本构造。在临床心电图任务和掩码多模态基准上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 多模态系统推理时可能只持有部分输入，并可在推理过程中以一定代价获取其余输入。自适应采集策略决定了最终哪些输入被观测，因此保证需以最终输入模式为条件。但条件校准通常假设分组映射独立于校准样本，而策略引发的分组不满足这一假设。现有保证在策略使终端分组依赖于校准数据时不再成立，需要新的理论框架和构造方法。
AI.method: 1) 刻画了模式条件保证在策略引发分组下仍然有效的条件；2) 提出两种有限样本构造：a) 无阈值路由（threshold-free routing），在终端模式处应用校准；b) 完整策略-模式对的同步认证（simultaneous certification），允许校准数据选择部署策略；3) 通过反例证明校准无关分组映射的保证在策略使终端分组校准依赖时不必然成立，由此引出RouteCert方法。
AI.result: 在临床心电图任务中，采用分阶段、按成本排序的导联方案，认证策略在71.2%的留出患者上给出答案，观测到与心脏病学家诊断7.4%的不一致率，成本仅占获取全部阶段预设序数成本的48.8%，三个采集阶段均各自携带证书。在掩码多模态基准上，按终端模式逐点认证在观测最差模式选择性风险（对照全信息参考决策而非真实标签）达到0.034，而池化设计在0.10上限下达到0.145；回答率相当（0.350对0.342）；预算匹配的同步比较下回答率降至0.305。
AI.conclusion: RouteCert为自适应输入采集的多模态系统提供了有效且有理论保证的条件校准方法，解决了策略引发分组下传统条件校准失效的问题，并在实际临床任务和基准测试中展现了良好的性能与成本效率。

title: FedPA-LoRA: Product-Aligned Framework for Mitigating Aggregation and Initialization Errors in Heterogeneous Federated LoRA
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient federated fine-tuning of large language models, but its factorized parameterization creates a tension between accurate aggregation of local updates and continuity of locally optimized factors. Factor-wise aggregation incurs aggregation mismatch but better preserves factor continuity, whereas product-space reconstruction reduces this mismatch at the cost of greater factor-level initialization mismatch from newly reconstructed factors. We propose FedPA-LoRA, a product-aligned federated LoRA framework that jointly addresses these limitations and provably converges under both homogeneous and heterogeneous client ranks. Each client preserves its local factors across communication rounds and aligns its product toward a rank-specific global reference, maintaining local optimization continuity while promoting global consistency under data heterogeneity. The server aggregates heterogeneous-rank updates in the common product space and efficiently reconstructs a rank-constrained global adapter without forming the dense aggregate. This design supports client-specific computation and communication budgets. Experiments on natural language understanding and generation tasks show that FedPA-LoRA consistently outperforms representative baselines across varying levels of data heterogeneity and homogeneous- and heterogeneous-rank settings, with up to a $6.82$ percentage-point improvement in average GLUE accuracy under heterogeneous client ranks.

AI.tldr: FedPA-LoRA是一个产品对齐的联邦LoRA框架，通过让客户端在通信轮次间保持本地因子并在产品空间中对齐到秩特定的全局参考，同时服务器在共同产品空间中聚合异构秩更新并高效重构秩约束的全局适配器，解决了因子级聚合不匹配与产品空间重构的因子连续性损失之间的冲突，并在同构和异构客户端秩下均可证明收敛。
AI.motivation: LoRA的因子化参数化在联邦微调中产生了聚合准确性与因子连续性之间的张力：因子级聚合存在聚合不匹配但能保持因子连续性，而产品空间重构虽能减少不匹配但会引入因子级初始化不匹配。
AI.method: 每个客户端在通信轮次间保留本地因子，并将其产品向秩特定的全局参考对齐；服务器在共同产品空间中聚合异构秩更新，并在不形成稠密聚合的情况下高效重构秩约束的全局适配器，支持客户端特定的计算和通信预算。
AI.result: 在自然语言理解和生成任务上的实验表明，FedPA-LoRA在不同数据异构程度以及同构和异构秩设置下均持续优于代表性基线，在异构客户端秩下GLUE平均准确率最高提升6.82个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FedPA-LoRA通过产品空间对齐同时保持了本地优化连续性和全局一致性，能够在数据异构和多秩场景下有效提升联邦LoRA的性能。

title: AlloEgo-VLM: Disambiguating Allocentric and Egocentric Reference Frames in Vision-Language Models
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures. Project page and code available at https://github.com/CKL9001/AlloEgo-VLM
summary: This study investigates the challenge of ambiguity faced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in understanding spatial semantics. Spatial cognition, shaped by cognitive psychology, spatial science, and cultural context, often assigns directionality to objects. However, natural language descriptions of spatial relations frequently omit explicit reference frames, leading to semantic ambiguity and potentially serious errors for embodied AI robots. Existing VLMs, due to insufficient training on reference frames and object orientations, often produce inconsistent responses. To address this issue, we construct a new dataset, AlloEgo-View, comprising (image, query, view-specific answer) triplets that capture key object relations from both allocentric and egocentric perspectives. The view-specific descriptions follow a structured spatial representation that annotate detailed scene descriptions, reference and target objects, their orientations, reference frames, and view types. Building on AlloEgo-View, we develop AlloEgo-VLM, a framework to disambiguate allocentric and egocentric reference frames, even under ambiguous queries, and to be easily integrated into existing VLMs via supervised fine-tuning. Furthermore, we deploy our framework onto an embodied robotic platform within NVIDIA Isaac Sim to validate its real-world feasibility in open-ended object searching tasks. Experiments highlight the limitations of current VLMs in handling view-specific queries and demonstrate the strong disambiguation ability of AlloEgo-VLM.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉语言模型（VLMs）在理解空间语义时的歧义问题，构建了AlloEgo-View数据集（包含自我中心视角和他者中心视角的图像-查询-视图特定答案三元组），并开发了AlloEgo-VLM框架用于消除空间参考框架歧义，通过监督微调可轻松集成到现有VLMs中，并在NVIDIA Isaac Sim的具身机器人平台上验证了其实际可行性。
AI.motivation: 空间认知赋予物体方向性，但自然语言描述空间关系时经常省略明确参考框架，导致语义歧义，可能对具身AI机器人造成严重错误。现有VLMs因缺乏参考框架和物体朝向的训练，对这类查询会产生不一致的响应。
AI.method: 1) 构建AlloEgo-View数据集，包含从自我中心（egocentric）和他者中心（allocentric）视角捕捉关键物体关系的（图像、查询、视图特定答案）三元组，采用结构化空间表示标注详细场景描述、参考物和目标物、朝向、参考框架及视图类型。2) 开发AlloEgo-VLM框架，通过监督微调消除自我中心和他者中心参考框架的歧义，可轻松集成到现有VLMs中。3) 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中部署到具身机器人平台验证实际可行性。
AI.result: 实验揭示了当前VLMs在处理视图特定查询时的局限性，同时证明了AlloEgo-VLM在消除空间参考框架歧义方面的强大能力。
AI.conclusion: AlloEgo-VLM能够有效消除空间参考框架歧义，即使在歧义查询下也能准确区分自我中心和他者中心视角，并通过具身机器人验证了其在开放目标搜索任务中的实际应用价值。

title: Spectral Saliency for Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning (MU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data while preserving model utility. As the name suggests, MU can be viewed as the inverse of learning, using gradient-based updates to reduce the influence of a forget-set by counteracting the previously learned behavior. Recently, Muon, a gradient descent variant, has been introduced. Muon applies spectral magnitude normalization to encourage exploration of rare directions and demonstrates promising performance. Inspired by Muon, we adopt the spectral view for unlearning and propose Spectral Saliency Unlearning (SSU). SSU thresholds weak singular components and updates only those directions supported by a confident unlearning signal. We further provide theoretical justification for this thresholding approach from the perspective of the forgetting-retention trade-off. Experiments across image classifiers, diffusion models, and LLMs demonstrate SSU's effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于频谱显著性分析的机器遗忘方法（SSU），通过阈值化弱奇异分量并仅沿具有置信遗忘信号的方向更新，实现高效的数据遗忘，并在图像分类器、扩散模型和大语言模型上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘旨在移除特定训练数据的影响同时保持模型效用，可被视为学习的逆过程。受Muon优化器在梯度下降中利用频谱幅度归一化探索稀有方向的启发，作者希望从频谱视角重新审视遗忘问题，以更精准地识别并针对性地去除需要遗忘的数据相关的方向。
AI.method: 提出Spectral Saliency Unlearning (SSU)方法：对模型参数或梯度进行奇异值分解，阈值化弱奇异分量，仅更新那些由置信遗忘信号支持的方向；并从遗忘-保留权衡的角度提供了该阈值化方法的理论依据。
AI.result: 在图像分类器、扩散模型和大语言模型三类模型上进行了实验，验证了SSU方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SSU通过频谱显著性分析实现了对遗忘方向的精准选择，在遗忘效果与模型保留能力之间取得了良好平衡，并证明了频谱视角在机器遗忘任务中的适用性。

title: EgoGazeLite: On-Device Egocentric Gaze Prediction for Token-Efficient Multimodal LLM Video Input
comment: 16 pages. Accepted at the WearableAI Workshop, ECCV 2026 (Archival Track)
summary: The use of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for egocentric video understanding with wearable devices is constrained by the token budget. Memory and compute cost scale with the number of visual tokens, and high-resolution video quickly becomes expensive to transmit and process at scale. Prior work (GazeLLM) addresses this by cropping the video around the camera wearer's gaze. This reduces the number of visual tokens by about tenfold while maintaining or improving the quality of full-resolution descriptions. However, this compression strategy depends on dedicated eye-tracking hardware, which is unavailable on consumer smart glasses. Building a software-only substitute poses a joint constraint: the predictor must be accurate enough to preserve downstream description quality, yet light enough to run on-device, within the power and compute budget of a smartphone. We address this with EgoGazeLite, a lightweight dual-process gaze predictor for egocentric video. Across two MLLMs, three automated metrics, and two LLM judges, predicted-gaze crops show no significant difference from ground-truth-gaze crops. Equivalence is confirmed in all ten cases. EgoGazeLite achieves this at 15.7M parameters, 6.71 GFLOPs, and runs the full gaze-and-crop pipeline end-to-end in real time (21.6 ms/frame) on consumer accelerator hardware. Together, these results remove the need for eye-tracking hardware for token-efficient, gaze-conditioned egocentric video understanding with MLLMs.

AI.tldr: EgoGazeLite是一个轻量级双过程目光预测器，用于替代专用眼动追踪硬件，在智能眼镜端上实现高效的目光条件化自我中心视频理解，仅15.7M参数、6.71 GFLOPs，在消费级加速硬件上实现实时运行（21.6ms/帧），且预测目光裁剪与真实目光裁剪在十个测试案例中均无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）用于可穿戴设备上的自我中心视频理解受限于token预算，高分辨率视频处理和传输成本高。先前工作GazeLLM通过目光裁剪减少约10倍视觉token，但依赖专用眼动追踪硬件，而消费级智能眼镜不具备此硬件。构建纯软件替代品面临双重约束：预测器既要足够准确以保持下游描述质量，又要足够轻量以在智能手机的功耗和计算预算内运行。
AI.method: 提出EgoGazeLite，一个轻量级双过程（dual-process）目光预测器，用于自我中心视频。该模型通过软件方式预测用户目光位置，替代硬件眼动追踪，并将预测的目光裁剪与真实目光裁剪进行对比验证。评估涵盖两个MLLM、三个自动化指标和两个LLM评审者。
AI.result: EgoGazeLite仅15.7M参数、6.71 GFLOPs，完整目光-裁剪流水线在消费级加速硬件上端到端实时运行（21.6ms/帧）。在十个测试案例中，预测目光裁剪与真实目光裁剪在描述质量上均表现出等价性（无显著差异），所有十种情况均确认等价。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，EgoGazeLite有效消除了使用MLLM进行token高效、目光条件化自我中心视频理解时对眼动追踪硬件的依赖，为消费级智能眼镜上的实时视频理解提供了可行的软件方案。

title: Amortised Post-Hoc Explanation with Exact Preservation for Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detectors
summary: Anomaly detection in dynamic graphs underpins financial fraud analysis, intrusion detection, and platform integrity, where automated decisions require human-interpretable justifications. StrGNN, the strongest performer in recent benchmarks, produces no explanation: when an edge is flagged, the analyst receives only a score. Explanation metrics are undefined for StrGNN because no attribution vector exists. This paper closes that gap. We present X-StrGNN, a post-hoc explanation layer that wraps a trained, frozen StrGNN and emits, for every flagged edge, dual attributions: a structural attribution identifying which contextual interactions in the enclosing subgraph drove the decision, and a temporal attribution identifying which historical snapshot carried the signal. Both attributions are multiplicative masks identically one in the unexplained pass, so the layer is an exact pass-through: detection is preserved to machine precision, verified rather than asserted (Delta AUC = 0.0000, Delta AP = 0.0000, Delta P@100 = 0.0000). Attribution costs 0.66 ms per edge, making explanation of an entire alarm list feasible. We conduct the first controlled design study of attribution strategies for this architecture, comparing gradient attribution, per-instance mask optimisation, and amortised parameterisation under one protocol, one budget, and three seeds. X-StrGNN attains the highest stability (0.913) at 268x lower cost than per-instance optimisation, and its temporal attribution (1.601 against a measured random floor of 0.973) is separably better than its ablated control, while per-instance optimisation - the most expensive strategy - falls below that floor. Code, protocol, and per-seed measurements are released.

AI.tldr: X-StrGNN是一个包裹已训练StrGNN模型的后置解释层，为每个被标记的边提供结构性和时间性双重归因，在保持检测精度到机器精度(Delta AUC/AP/P@100均为0.0000)的同时，以每边0.66ms的低成本提供可解释性。与逐实例掩码优化相比，X-StrGNN实现了更高稳定性(0.913)且成本降低268倍。
AI.motivation: 动态图中的异常检测（如金融欺诈分析、入侵检测）需要人类可解释的决策依据，但现有最强者StrGNN只能输出分数而无任何解释，其解释指标甚至无法定义。这阻碍了自动化决策在现实场景中的可信部署。
AI.method: 提出X-StrGNN后置解释层：包裹冻结的StrGNN，对每个标记边输出双重乘法掩码归因（结构性归因识别子图中关键交互，时间性归因识别关键历史快照）。归因掩码在未解释时为全1，保证精确透传。首次在该架构下进行受控设计研究，对比梯度归因、逐实例掩码优化和摊销参数化三种策略。
AI.result: 检测精度完全保留(Delta AUC/AP/P@100 = 0.0000)，归因成本每边0.66ms。X-StrGNN稳定性最高(0.913)，成本比逐实例优化低268倍；其时间性归因(1.601)远超随机下限(0.973)，而逐实例优化（最昂贵策略）反而低于该下限。代码、协议和逐种子测量均已发布。
AI.conclusion: X-StrGNN成功填补了StrGNN缺乏解释性的空白，以可验证的精确透传（而非传闻）保留检测能力，在低成本下提供高稳定性双重归因，为动态图异常检测提供了实用且可靠的可解释性方案。

title: Agentic-SQL Revisited: Autonomy-Based Taxonomy and Empirical Benchmark Analysis for LLM Text-to-SQL
summary: LLM-based Text-to-SQL progress is reported across heterogeneous benchmarks, backbones, and inference protocols, making cross-system comparison fragile. We reframe the field as a leaderboard aggregation: we collect the metrics authors themselves report and organize them along an inference-autonomy axis spanning constrained, in-context, iterative, agentic, and reasoning-internalized generation, with traceable provenance for every cell. To anchor the aggregation empirically, we run a focused case study on Spider, comparing 8B open-source backbones with and without chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision against few-shot DeepSeek~V3 and GLM-4 baselines. Four patterns emerge: Spider gains transfer unevenly to BIRD and Spider~2.0; autonomy buys robustness at non-trivial cost; reasoning internalization sits between answer-only decoding and externally orchestrated agents; and CoT gains concentrate on Hard and Extra-Hard queries. We release a Python harness mirroring the autonomy axis so that future methods can be added directly to the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM-based Text-to-SQL领域重新框架为排行榜聚合问题，收集作者自报的指标并按"推理自主性"轴（约束、上下文内、迭代、智能体、推理内化）组织，每个数据点都有可追溯来源。通过在Spider上用8B开源模型（带/不带CoT监督）对比few-shot DeepSeek V3和GLM-4进行案例研究，揭示了四个关键模式，并发布了Python评测框架。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL研究成果分散在异构的基准、骨干网络和推理协议中，导致跨系统比较不可靠、难以进行公平对比。
AI.method: 提出排行榜聚合方法：收集作者自报指标，按推理自主性轴（constrained, in-context, iterative, agentic, reasoning-internalized）组织，确保每个单元格有可追溯来源；并在Spider上进行8B开源模型（带/不带CoT）与DeepSeek V3、GLM-4的聚焦案例研究。
AI.result: 发现四个模式：1) Spider的增益不均匀地迁移到BIRD和Spider 2.0；2) 自主性提升鲁棒性但有显著成本；3) 推理内化介于仅答案解码和外部编排智能体之间；4) CoT增益集中在Hard和Extra-Hard查询上。
AI.conclusion: 发布一个镜像自主性轴的Python评测框架，使未来方法可以直接添加到排行榜中，从而标准化Text-to-SQL系统比较。

title: Hierarchical Adaptive Feature Refinement Network for VHR Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS). Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/anticipate218/HAFRNet
summary: Semantic segmentation of very-high-resolution (VHR) remote sensing imagery increasingly benefits from strong pretrained hierarchical encoders, yet exploiting their multi-stage representations remains difficult. Nearby regions demand different balances between fine detail and semantic context, aggressive task-specific transformations perturb useful pretrained features, and conventional semantic supervision provides limited structural guidance. We present HAFR-Net, a progressive refinement framework that adaptively organizes and conservatively refines hierarchical representations instead of replacing them with a monolithic decoder transformation. Heterogeneity-Guided Stage-Adaptive Fusion (HG-SAF) predicts dense stage weights conditioned on local feature variation. A Frequency-Residual Adapter (FRA) then injects frequency information through a bounded, zero-initialized residual branch that keeps the fused representation as its reference. A Confusion-Aware Tri-Prior Decoder (CATP) finally regularizes the prediction with boundary, objectness, and training-derived class-relation cues. Under a matched Swin-B training and single-scale inference protocol, HAFR-Net attains 84.12%, 87.86%, 55.17%, and 67.70% mIoU on ISPRS Vaihingen, ISPRS Potsdam, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap, improving the matched UPerNet baseline by 0.55, 0.95, 1.55, and 1.84 percentage points, respectively. Controlled analyses further show consistent spatial reweighting beyond content-only routing, improved boundary and thin-structure accuracy over matched spatial and spectral alternatives, and reduced confusion on pre-declared class pairs.
