AI.tldr: 本文提出HAFR-Net，一种渐进式精炼框架，用于自适应组织和保守精炼分层编码器（如Swin-B）的多阶段表示，而非用单一的编解码器变换替换它们。通过HG-SAF、FRA和CATP三个模块，在多个VHR遥感分割基准上取得了优于匹配UPerNet基线的性能。
AI.motivation: VHR遥感影像语义分割受益于预训练的层级编码器，但利用其多阶段表示仍具挑战：不同邻近区域需要在细节与语义上下文之间取得不同平衡，激进的任务特定变换会扰动预训练特征，且传统语义监督提供的结构引导有限。
AI.method: 提出三个核心组件：(1) 异质性引导的阶段自适应融合（HG-SAF），基于局部特征变化预测密集阶段权重；(2) 频率残差适配器（FRA），通过有界、零初始化的残差分支注入频率信息，保持融合表示作为参考；(3) 混淆感知的三先验解码器（CATP），利用边界、目标性和训练得到的类间关系线索来正则化预测。
AI.result: 在匹配Swin-B训练和单尺度推理协议下，HAFR-Net在ISPRS Vaihingen、ISPRS Potsdam、LoveDA和OpenEarthMap上分别达到84.12%、87.86%、55.17%和67.70%的mIoU，相比匹配的UPerNet基线分别提升了0.55、0.95、1.55和1.84个百分点。控制实验表明：空间重加权优于纯内容路由，边界和细结构精度优于匹配的空间和光谱替代方案，且在预声明类别对上混淆减少。
AI.conclusion: HAFR-Net通过自适应组织和保守精炼分层表示，而非用单一解码器变换替换它们，有效提升了VHR遥感分割的性能，验证了渐进式精炼框架相对于激进任务特定变换的优势。

title: SchurQuant: Groupwise Discrete Optimization for Layer-Wise LLM Quantization
summary: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) enables the deployment of large language models under tight memory budgets, but accuracy often collapses at 2-3 bits. Existing backpropagation-free PTQ optimizers have two limitations: group decisions ignore the correction that the remaining continuous suffix can absorb, and discrete refinements typically keep the affine quantization grid fixed. We introduce SCHUROPT, which analytically eliminates the suffix's optimal continuous response, yielding an exact groupwise quadratic with Schur-complement curvature. It then alternates closed-form row-wise scale/zero-point refitting with coordinate descent over integer codes. With the GPTQ objective fixed, SCHUROPT improves mean zero-shot accuracy on 2-bit Qwen3-4B by 11.88 percentage points (pp). At higher precision, however, tighter reconstruction does not consistently improve end-model metrics. SCHURQUANT therefore combines SCHUROPT with quantized-prefix teacher reconstruction, reference-weight regularization, residual-add targets, and teacher-decision token weighting. Across eight Llama and Qwen models, SCHURQUANT achieves the highest mean zero-shot accuracy among the evaluated backpropagation free PTQ baselines, outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.65 pp at 2 bits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCHUROPT和SCHURQUANT两种基于解析优化的免反向传播后训练量化方法。SCHUROPT通过消除连续后缀的最优响应（Schur补曲率）进行精确分组二次优化，并交替执行行级缩放/零点重拟与整数码坐标下降；SCHURQUANT在此基础上结合量化前缀教师重建、参考权重正则化、残差加目标和教师决策token加权，在2-bit量化下显著提升零样本准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的免反向传播后训练量化优化器存在两个局限：1）分组决策忽略了剩余连续后缀可吸收的修正能力；2）离散精炼通常保持仿射量化网格固定。这导致2-3比特低比特量化下准确率严重下降。
AI.method: 1) SCHUROPT：通过解析方式消除后缀的最优连续响应，得到具有Schur补曲率的精确分组二次目标函数；然后交替进行闭式行级缩放/零点重拟与整数码坐标下降。2) SCHURQUANT：在SCHUROPT基础上融合量化前缀教师重建、参考权重正则化、残差加目标和教师决策token加权等训练策略。
AI.result: 在固定GPTQ目标下，SCHUROPT在2-bit Qwen3-4B上平均零样本准确率提升11.88个百分点；在8个Llama和Qwen模型上，SCHURQUANT在2-bit下平均零样本准确率比最强基线高出9.65个百分点，在评估的免反向传播PTQ基线中取得最高平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 低比特（2-bit）量化下更紧的重建有利于提升端模型指标，但更高精度下紧重建并不总能一致改善端模型指标，需结合端到端的训练信号（如SCHURQUANT所采用的目标加权策略）才能获得最佳效果。

title: TwinGridShield: Consequence-Aware Runtime Authorization for LLM Grid-Agent Actions
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables and accepted in North American Power Symposium 2026
summary: Large language model (LLM)-assisted energy-management tools can translate natural-language context into structured grid commands, but syntactic validity does not imply physical admissibility. This paper presents TwinGridShield, a model-independent runtime authorization layer that evaluates each proposed action in a deterministic network twin before release. The prototype checks connectivity, branch-flow, generator, and load-shedding invariants and records each decision in a hash-chained log. A controlled IEEE 14-bus study evaluates single-step switching, redispatch, and load-shedding actions using DC power flow and experimentally assigned branch ratings. In the matched-model experiment, a stochastic proposal source configured to select an unsafe action with probability p=0.84 produced 421 unsafe proposals in 500 attacked-condition trials, a realized rate of 84.2%. This value characterizes the configured surrogate and is not an empirical measurement of LLM prompt-injection susceptibility. TwinGridShield produced 0 unsafe releases in those 500 trials. Because action labeling and authorization used the same DC model, system state, branch ratings, and encoded constraints, this result verifies conformance of the implementation to its encoded authorization predicate rather than safety under model error. The principal robustness evaluation therefore introduces model mismatch. Unsafe acceptance reached 5.63% under bounded +20% and -20% per-bus load-measurement error and 30.09% when actual branch ratings were 20% below modeled ratings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TwinGridShield，一个模型无关的运行时授权层，在确定性网络孪生模型中评估LLM辅助能源管理工具生成的每个电网操作动作，确保语法有效但不一定物理合理的动作被拦截。
AI.motivation: LLM辅助能源管理工具虽能将自然语言转换为结构化电网指令，但语法有效不等同于物理可行。需要一层运行时授权机制来验证动作的物理可接受性，防止不安全动作被释放到电网中。
AI.method: TwinGridShield在动作释放前于确定性网络孪生中评估每个提议动作，检查连通性、支路潮流、发电机和减载不变量，并用哈希链日志记录每个决策。在IEEE 14节点系统上进行单步切换、再调度和减载动作的实验验证。
AI.result: 在匹配模型实验中，500次攻击条件下0次不安全释放；在模型失配下，±20%负载测量误差时不安全接受率达5.63%，当实际支路额定值比建模值低20%时达30.09%。
AI.conclusion: TwinGridShield能够有效拦截LLM生成的不安全电网操作，但模型失配会显著降低其保护效果，特别是在支路额定值错误估计时。该方法验证的是实现与授权谓词的一致性，而非模型误差下的安全性。

title: Gaussian-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for 3D Gaussian Splats
comment: Joint-embedding predictive representation learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) represents 3D content with anisotropic primitives that jointly encode geometry and appearance. Fixed-budget encoders consume sampled observations of Gaussian assets, so the same object may be observed through different primitive realizations. Existing self-supervised methods mainly reconstruct masked Gaussian attributes, tying supervision to one sampled realization and requiring an input-space decoder. Latent prediction offers an alternative, but its application to Gaussian tokens requires targets that accommodate coupled attributes and heterogeneous spatial support. We introduce Gaussian-JEPA, which predicts representations of held-out Gaussian token blocks from visible context. An online encoder processes the context, while a shared exponential-moving-average encoder supplies stop-gradient features for multi-scale targets. Complementary target projections and feature-space grounding provide latent supervision without reconstructing Gaussian attributes. We evaluate the features under Gaussian resampling, partial observations, and renderable shape completion, together with transfer to part segmentation and object classification. Compared with matched reconstruction pretraining, Gaussian-JEPA is more consistent across resampled inputs, retains more instance information under partial observations, and provides stronger frozen features for Gaussian completion. These results support latent prediction as an effective objective for reusable 3D Gaussian representations. Code is on the project page (https://amazingren.github.io/Gaussian-JEPA/).

AI.tldr: 论文提出Gaussian-JEPA，一种针对3D高斯溅射（3DGS）表示的自监督预训练方法。它通过在线编码器处理可见上下文，并利用共享的指数滑动平均（EMA）编码器为多尺度目标提供停止梯度特征，预测被掩蔽的高斯token块表示，而非重构高斯属性。实验表明，相比匹配的重构预训练，Gaussian-JEPA在重采样输入下更一致、在部分观测下保留更多实例信息、并为高斯补全提供更强的冻结特征。
AI.motivation: 3DGS用各向异性原语联合编码几何与外观，但固定预算编码器从高斯资产的采样观测中生成表征，同一物体可能通过不同的原语实现被观测。现有自监督方法主要重构掩蔽的高斯属性，将监督绑定到单一采样实现且需要输入空间解码器。潜在预测（latent prediction）是一种替代方案，但其应用于高斯token时，需要适配耦合属性和异质空间支撑的目标。为此需要一种不依赖重构属性的潜在预测自监督方法。
AI.method: 提出Gaussian-JEPA框架：在线编码器处理可见上下文token；共享的EMA编码器为多尺度目标提供停止梯度特征；采用互补目标投影和特征空间接地（feature-space grounding）提供潜在监督，避免重构高斯属性。该方法在潜在空间中预测被掩蔽的高斯token块表示，而非重建原始属性。
AI.result: 在多种任务上评估：高斯重采样、部分观测、可渲染形状补全，以及迁移到部件分割和物体分类。与匹配的重构预训练相比，Gaussian-JEPA在重采样输入下表现更一致，在部分观测下保留更多实例信息，并为高斯补全提供更强的冻结特征。
AI.conclusion: 潜在预测（latent prediction）是可复用的3D高斯表示的有效自监督目标，为3DGS的自监督预训练提供了一种不依赖输入空间重构的新范式。

title: GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix
summary:
Production paged-serving engines apply uniform paging granularity to the KV cache, even though the two regions of a multi-agent workload have opposite storage requirements: a long shared prefix demands contiguity, while the per-request suffix demands fine-grained allocation.
  We present \textbf{GraniKV}, a KV-cache layer that allocates the shared prefix in a contiguous HOT pool and the suffix in a token-level COLD pool, combined with a per-step dispatcher which selects the appropriate backend among dual backends for each regime (compute-, memory-, or communication-bound). To the best of our knowledge, GraniKV is the first system to apply asymmetric paging granularity to the KV cache of a production paged-serving engine.
  At $L_p{=}16$\,K shared tokens GraniKV reaches $\mathbf{2.16\times}$, $\mathbf{1.98\times}$, and $\mathbf{1.57\times}$ output-token throughput over the production baseline on Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1, Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2, and Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4. The gain decomposes: cascade attention integration contributes the majority at saturation; the asymmetric storage layer adds $1.05$--$1.15\times$ end-to-end while being what makes the batched-GEMM prefix backend possible at all. Under heterogeneous multi-agent serving with \emph{distinct} prompts of different lengths, the attribution inverts: GraniKV sustains $\mathbf{1.95\times}$ while batch-global cascade collapses to parity --- the storage layer alone carries the win in the regime that motivates the paper.

AI.tldr: GraniKV是一个针对多智能体工作负载的KV缓存层，对共享前缀使用连续HOT池，对每个请求的后缀使用token级COLD池，并配备按步骤调度的双后端选择器，实现了高达2.16倍的输出token吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 生产级分页服务引擎对KV缓存采用统一的分页粒度，但多智能体工作负载的两个区域具有相反的存储需求：长共享前缀需要连续性，而按请求的后缀需要细粒度分配。这种矛盾导致无法同时高效处理前缀和后缀。
AI.method: GraniKV提出非对称分页粒度的KV缓存架构：将共享前缀分配在连续HOT池中，后缀分配在token级COLD池中；同时配备按步骤调度器，根据计算、内存或通信受限场景在双后端之间选择合适后端。
AI.result: 在L_p=16K共享token下，GraniKV在Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2和Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4上分别达到生产基线2.16倍、1.98倍和1.57倍的输出token吞吐量。在异构多智能体服务中（不同提示词和长度），GraniKV保持1.95倍，而batch-global级联退化为持平。
AI.conclusion: GraniKV是首个对生产分页服务引擎的KV缓存应用非对称分页粒度的系统。在饱和场景下cascade attention集成贡献主要增益，非对称存储层贡献1.05-1.15倍端到端增益；而在异构多智能体服务中，存储层独自承担胜利。

title: Visible Reasoning and Indirect Prompt-Injection Monitorability Across English, Tamil, and Tanglish
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Code, frozen protocols, raw artifacts, and analysis are available at https://github.com/Madhumasa84/MATS-multilingual-reasoning-monitorability
summary: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a potentially useful safety signal, but its reliability across languages and behavioral settings remains uncertain. In a small case study of eight manually verified synthetic scenarios, one model, one annotator, and one deterministic generation seed, I study API-visible reasoning during indirect prompt injection in Sarvam-105B across English, Tamil, and Tanglish. A four scenario pilot found 5/12 injected attack successes without reasoning and 1/11 with reasoning. A preregistered four-scenario follow-up reversed that direction, finding 2/12 attacks without reasoning and 3/12 with reasoning. With only four scenarios per phase, this design cannot distinguish a real reasoning-mode effect from prompt-specific variation or sampling noise. Across 20 non-empty injected-thinking traces, all 17 benign-correct outputs stated an intent to ignore the injection, while all three attack successes stated an intent to follow it. These descriptive observations provide a reproducible case study of behaviorally informative visible reasoning when it is available; they do not establish that reasoning mode improves safety, that visible reasoning is mechanistically faithful, or that the findings generalize beyond this configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个小型案例研究（8个手工验证的合成场景、1个模型、1个标注者、1个确定性生成种子），考察Sarvam-105B在间接提示注入下，API可见推理在英语、泰米尔语和Tanglish三种语言中的可靠性与行为信息价值。研究发现推理模式的效果方向在预注册前后两次实验中发生了逆转，无法区分真实效应与提示特异性变异或采样噪声，但可见推理轨迹本身具有行为描述价值。
AI.motivation: 链式思维（CoT）监控被视为潜在的安全信号，但此前缺乏对其跨语言、跨行为场景可靠性的系统检验，尤其在多语言与提示注入场景下，推理可见性能否提供有效安全信号仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 采用预注册的小型案例研究设计：选取8个手工验证的合成场景，分两阶段（每阶段4个场景）进行，在Sarvam-105B上对间接提示注入进行测试，比较有无推理两种条件下的攻击成功率，并分析非空注入思考轨迹的内容特征。
AI.result: 试点阶段中无推理的攻击成功率为5/12，有推理为1/11；预注册后续阶段结果相反，无推理为2/12，有推理为3/12。在20个非空注入思考轨迹中，17个良性正确输出均表达了忽略注入的意图，3个攻击成功输出均表达了遵循注入的意图。
AI.conclusion: 可见推理在可用时能提供行为信息（意图陈述与输出行为高度一致），但研究设计（每阶段仅4个场景）无法区分推理模式的真实效应与提示特异性变异或采样噪声。可见推理既不保证提升安全性，也不代表机制层面上的忠实性，结论不能推广到该配置之外。

title: Scalable Black-Box Model Attribution for Images
summary: The rapid proliferation of generative models raises the model attribution problem: given only an image, can we determine which model produced it? Existing methods have grown as elaborate as the generators they target, on the as- sumption that a more sophisticated model demands a more sophisticated attributor. We show it does not. RPA (Raw- Patch Attribution) attributes images in the strictest black- box setting with a lightweight CNN. Despite its simplicity, it attributes more models at higher accuracy than prior work, reaching 98.0% on 25-class DRAGON and 92.9% on 27- class OpenFake; it is data-efficient and runs at a cost inde- pendent of the number of candidate models; and it stays ro- bust to the compression, blur, and resizing images undergo in the wild. Training for closed-set attribution yields a ver- satile feature extractor: the same representation recovers model lineage without supervision, flags and groups unseen generators, and admits new models through few-shot adap- tation rather than retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RPA（Raw-Patch Attribution）方法，仅用轻量级CNN在严格黑盒设置下进行生成模型归属判定，在25类DRAGON上达到98.0%准确率、27类OpenFake上达到92.9%，并具备数据效率高、计算成本与候选模型数量无关、对压缩/模糊/缩放等退化鲁棒等优点。此外，闭集训练得到的特征提取器可迁移用于无监督模型谱系恢复、未知生成器识别与分组，以及通过少样本适应而非重训练来接纳新模型。
AI.motivation: 生成模型快速普及引发了模型归属问题：仅凭一张图像能否判定其由哪个模型生成？现有方法随着目标生成器日益复杂而不断复杂化，作者质疑这一假设，认为更复杂的模型并不必然需要更复杂的归属器。
AI.method: 提出RPA（Raw-Patch Attribution）方法，采用轻量级CNN在严格黑盒设置下直接对原始图像块进行归属判定，无需依赖生成器内部信息。
AI.result: 在25类DRAGON数据集上达到98.0%准确率，在27类OpenFake数据集上达到92.9%，优于现有工作；数据高效、运行成本与候选模型数量无关，并对压缩、模糊和缩放等真实世界图像退化保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 闭集归属训练所得的特征表示具有高度通用性：无需监督即可恢复模型谱系，能标记并分组未知生成器，且新模型可通过少样本适应加入而无需重新训练。这表明简单方法足以解决模型归属问题。

title: Quantum Models with Multi-Stage Training for Compositional Concept Generalization
summary: Compositional Concept Generalization (CoCoGen), the ability to systematically recombine learned primitives in novel contexts, is a key challenge for multimodal learning. In this work, we provide a solution using a compositional model of meaning that separates nouns from relations and uses tensors and variational quantum circuits to train them on data. This model enables us to employ a multi stage training paradigm, one that first learns object representations from single-object image-caption pairs, then subsequently transfers these to the relational stage where object parameters are frozen and optimisation is only applied to relational components. This design explicitly enforces compositional factorisation at the circuit, ensuring that relations are learned as transformations over stable primitives. The training paradigm is tested on the CLEVR dataset developed specificially for CoCoGen. For text, we work with vector representations of nouns and higher order tensor representations of relations using a set of different ansatz. For images, we work with quantum encodings of image embeddings dervied from Open AI's Vision Language tool CLIP and contrast amplitude encoding, which preserves the original embedding geometry, with angle encoding, which introduces nonlinear feature transformations. Our results show that multi-staged training combined with structured encodings significantly improves out of distribution relational generalisation, while using orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters than classical baselines. We find that performance gains arise from the interaction between representation and encoding, with nonlinear quantum encodings enhancing the separability of compositional structure. These findings demonstrate that structured quantum representations and staged learning provide an effective framework for compositional generalisation in multimodal quantum machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用变分量子电路和组合语义模型来解决多模态组合概念泛化（CoCoGen）问题的方法。该方法将名词与关系分离表示，采用多阶段训练范式（先学物体表示，再冻结物体参数训练关系组件），并在CLEVR数据集上验证，相比经典基线用更少的可训练参数显著提升了分布外关系泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态学习中的组合概念泛化（CoCoGen）——即系统性地在新型上下文中重组已学原语的能力——是一个关键挑战，现有方法难以实现这种结构化泛化。
AI.method: 使用张量表示名词、高阶张量表示关系的组合语义模型，结合变分量子电路进行训练。采用多阶段训练范式：先训练单物体图像-文本对以学习物体表征，然后冻结这些参数，仅优化关系组件。图像侧使用CLIP嵌入的量子编码，对比了振幅编码（保留嵌入几何）与角度编码（引入非线性特征变换），并使用不同的ansatz架构。
AI.result: 多阶段训练结合结构化编码显著改善了分布外关系泛化，且使用的可训练参数比经典基线少数个数量级。性能提升源于表示与编码之间的交互作用，非线性量子编码能增强组合结构的可分离性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化量子表示与分阶段学习为多模态量子机器学习中的组合泛化提供了有效框架，证明量子方法在组合推理任务上具有实际价值。

title: Large Language Model Assisted Operational Monitoring for Battery Energy Storage System Integrated Power Distribution Networks
summary: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) are increasingly used in distribution networks for voltage regulation and demand response, which increases the volume and complexity of operational telemetry available to grid operators. This paper presents an AI-enabled monitoring framework that connects a large language model (LLM) interface with a structured telemetry database for BESS-integrated distribution system analysis. Operator questions are submitted in natural language and translated into validated SQL queries using predefined database schema information and approved KPI views. Retrieved measurements, including bus voltages, state of charge, active power, and reactive power, are evaluated against engineering constraints for voltage limits, BESS operation, and demand response tracking. The framework is validated using hardware-in-the-loop co-simulation data from a BESS-equipped distribution feeder operating under reactive power-based voltage control and price-driven demand response. Case studies show that the framework generates valid database queries, identifies repeated voltage violations, detects reactive power overshoot, and evaluates active-power tracking performance. The results show that LLM-assisted monitoring can connect structured grid telemetry with automated engineering assessment for BESS operation analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个AI驱动的监测框架，将大语言模型（LLM）接口与结构化遥测数据库连接，用于BESS集成配电系统分析。操作员用自然语言提交问题，框架将其转换为经过验证的SQL查询，检索电压、荷电状态、有功/无功功率等数据，并对照工程约束进行评估。通过硬件在环联合仿真数据验证，结果表明该框架能生成有效查询、识别电压违规、检测无功过冲并评估有功跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 随着BESS在配电网中广泛用于电压调节和需求响应，电网运营商面临的运行遥测数据量增大且复杂度提高，亟需高效、自动化的方式将这些结构化数据与工程分析连接起来，减轻人工查询和评估负担。
AI.method: 构建一个LLM驱动的监测框架：1）操作员以自然语言提交问题；2）利用预定义的数据库模式信息和批准的KPI视图，将自然语言转换为验证过的SQL查询；3）检索母线电压、SOC、有功和无功功率等测量数据；4）将测量值对照电压限值、BESS运行约束和需求响应跟踪等工程约束进行评估；5）在BESS配电馈线上的硬件在环联合仿真环境中进行验证。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，该框架能生成有效的数据库查询，识别重复的电压违规事件，检测无功功率过冲现象，并评估有功功率跟踪性能，证明了LLM辅助监测在连接结构化电网遥测数据与自动化工程评估方面的可行性。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅助监测框架能够有效地将结构化电网遥测数据与自动化工程评估相连接，为BESS运行分析提供了一种可行的AI驱动方案，有助于提升配电系统监测的效率和智能化水平。

title: WorldRover: A Scalable Synthetic Video Data Engine for World Exploration with Rich Annotations
summary: Learning to generate or reconstruct explorable worlds requires video paired with more than RGB: camera motion, scene geometry, temporal correspondence and, for interactive models, control signals. Real capture can provide some of these signals, but dense geometry and long-range correspondence usually rely on estimation or specialised instrumentation. Rendering provides these quantities directly, yet existing synthetic resources rarely combine them on the same frames while also supporting controlled changes of viewpoint and appearance. We introduce WorldRover, a data engine for generating richly annotated, long-range explorations of artist-built environments. At its core, WorldRover-Engine is an Unreal Engine pipeline that executes and offline-renders minute-scale routes while preserving their full trajectories and scene geometry. The same exploration can be replayed from first-person, third-person, and 360 panoramic cameras under different environmental states. Using WorldRover-Engine, we construct WorldRover-10M, whose sequences pair RGB with metric depth, camera trajectories, and trajectory-derived action signals throughout each exploration. Third-person subsets additionally provide dense optical flow, long-range 2D/3D point tracks with visibility, and a character trajectory distinct from the camera trajectory. The engine can render a traversal from first-person, third-person and 360 panoramic viewpoints, under different environmental states or with a neutral white material, while preserving the route and scene geometry. WorldRover therefore turns long-horizon world exploration into a scalable data-generation problem, providing supervision for models that must build, maintain, and revisit coherent representations of an explorable world.

AI.tldr: WorldRover 是一个数据引擎，用于生成大规模、长范围的环境探索数据。它基于 Unreal Engine 构建，可同时提供 RGB、度量深度、相机轨迹、动作信号、稠密光流、长距离 2D/3D 点跟踪等丰富标注，并支持从第一人称、第三人称和 360 全景视角重新播放同一探索路径，还能切换环境状态或使用中性白色材质。论文构建了 WorldRover-10M 数据集，将长时程世界探索转化为可扩展的数据生成问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频数据通常只包含 RGB，缺少相机运动、场景几何、时间对应关系和控制信号等关键信息。真实捕获难以获得稠密几何和长距离对应关系，而现有合成资源很少在同一帧上同时提供这些信号并支持视角和外观的受控变化。
AI.method: WorldRover-Engine 是核心的 Unreal Engine 离线渲染管线，可执行分钟级别的探索路线并保留完整轨迹和场景几何。同一探索可从第一人称、第三人称和 360 全景相机在多种环境状态下重放。RGB 与度量深度、相机轨迹和轨迹衍生的动作信号配对；第三人称子集额外提供稠密光流、长距离 2D/3D 点跟踪（含可见性）和不同于相机轨迹的角色轨迹。
AI.result: 构建了 WorldRover-10M 数据集，包含大规模、丰富标注的长范围环境探索序列，覆盖多视角、多环境状态和中性材质渲染等多种设置。
AI.conclusion: WorldRover 将长时程世界探索转化为可扩展的数据生成问题，为构建、维护和回访一致的可探索世界表征的模型提供监督信号。

title: FluxBin: Flexible LUT-based Ultra-low-bit LLM Inference by Algorithm-Kernel Synergy
summary: While binary quantization theoretically promises extreme compression and acceleration for Large Language Models (LLMs), existing research often overlooks the necessity of specialized hardware kernels, thus failing to unleash the full acceleration potential due to persistent reliance on expensive floating-point arithmetic or runtime dequantization overheads. To bridge this gap, we propose FluxBin (\textbf{F}lexible \textbf{L}UT-based \textbf{U}ltra-low-bit e\textbf{X}ecution with \textbf{Bin}ary bases), an algorithm-kernel co-design that synergizes post-training quantization with a highly optimized CUDA kernel. Algorithmically, we introduce Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition to enhance representational capacity while maintaining hardware efficiency, complemented by a Hessian-guided saliency-aware hybrid bases that preserve critical information. At the kernel level, we implement a Lookup Table Building Approach with Scale Fusion to reduce floating-point arithmetic, featuring a Virtual Columnar Mapping that transforms irregular, sparse, and salient matrices into dense execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate FluxBin achieves up to $5.92\times$ speedup and $10.19\times$ energy savings across diverse model architectures, delivering comparable accuracy to heavily fine-tuned methods. This effectively enables the deployment of 70B-scale models on one single A100 GPU with a $4\times$ memory reduction. Code is available at https://github.com/nicyyyy/FluxBin.

AI.tldr: FluxBin是一种算法-内核协同设计方法，通过解耦的行列二进制分解和查找表构建策略，结合优化的CUDA内核，实现了大语言模型的极端二进制量化加速，在保持精度的同时获得高达5.92倍速度提升和10.19倍能耗节省。
AI.motivation: 现有二元量化研究忽略了专用硬件内核的必要性，在推理时仍依赖昂贵的浮点运算或运行时反量化开销，无法充分发挥二值化的加速潜力。
AI.method: 1) 算法层面：提出解耦行列二进制分解（Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition）增强表示能力；使用Hessian引导的显著性感知混合基保留关键信息。2) 内核层面：实现基于查找表的构建方法配合尺度融合减少浮点运算；引入虚拟列映射将不规则、稀疏、显著的矩阵转化为稠密执行。
AI.result: 在多种模型架构上实现高达5.92倍加速和10.19倍能耗节省；精度与深度微调方法相当；能够在单张A100 GPU上部署70B规模模型，内存减少4倍。
AI.conclusion: FluxBin通过算法与内核的协同设计，有效弥合了二元量化理论与实际加速之间的鸿沟，证明了二值化在保持精度的同时可以实现显著的硬件加速和资源节省。

title: Implementation of a Metacognition Framework for Self-Awareness and Self-Regulation in Ensembles of LLMs
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Charles Courchaine and Ricky J. Sethi contributed equally. Demo and code: https://research.sethi.org/metacognition/
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are notorious for struggling with assessing their own uncertainty, detecting knowledge conflicts, or recognizing when problems exceed their expertise; such limitations inevitably undermine reliability and trust in LLMs. In this paper, we present the first implementation of a metacognitive framework for ensembles of LLMs that addresses these challenges through explicit monitoring and control mechanisms.
  Our system computes a Metacognitive State Vector (MSV) quantifying self-awareness for monitoring across five dimensions derived from cognitive psychology: Emotional Response, Correctness Evaluation, Experiential Match, Conflicting Information, and Problem Importance. MSV values also provide self-regulation for control, automatically switching between System 1 (fast, single- or multi-node) and System 2 (deliberative, multi-node) processing based on query complexity. For System 2 execution, graph-theoretic algorithms control the assignment of specialized roles (Domain Expert, Critic, Evaluator, Synthesizer, and Generalist) to ensemble nodes according to their MSV-quantified metacognitive states.
  Our implementation allows users to explore how different query types trigger distinct processing modes. The Proof-of-Concept (PoC) demo showcases the framework with illustrative examples showing appropriate System 1/System 2 routing and helps visualize the metacognitive process via real-time radar charts and decision indicators. This PoC implementation demonstrates the feasibility of creating a framework for metacognitive self-awareness and self-regulation in LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出并实现了一个面向LLM集成系统的元认知框架，通过计算元认知状态向量（MSV）来监控和调控LLM的自我意识，并自动在System 1（快速处理）和System 2（深思熟虑处理）之间切换，同时通过图论算法为集成节点分配专业角色。
AI.motivation: LLM在评估自身不确定性、检测知识冲突以及识别超出其专业范围的问题方面存在显著困难，这严重影响了系统的可靠性和可信度。作者希望借鉴认知心理学中的元认知概念，为LLM系统引入显式的自我监控和自我调节机制。
AI.method: 框架核心是一个五维元认知状态向量（MSV），包括情绪反应、正确性评估、经验匹配、冲突信息和问题重要性。MSV同时用于自我调节：根据查询复杂度自动在System 1（快速单节点或多节点）和System 2（深思熟虑多节点）之间切换；在System 2执行时，使用图论算法根据节点的MSV状态分配专家、评论家、评估者、综合者和通才等专业角色。
AI.result: 实现了概念验证（PoC）演示，通过示例展示了不同类型查询触发的不同处理模式，能够正确路由System 1/System 2，并通过实时雷达图和决策指示器可视化元认知过程，证明了该框架在LLM系统中实现元认知自我意识和自我调节的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该PoC验证了为LLM系统构建元认知自我意识与自我调节框架是可行的，为提升LLM系统的可靠性和可信度提供了新的方向，未来可进一步扩展和深化此框架。

title: BASeg: Boundary-Aware Remote Sensing Segmentation with Structural Penalties
summary: Semantic segmentation is a core computer vision task in the remote sensing field, accelerating advancements in ur- ban development, agriculture, ecology, water resources, and environmental monitoring. However, recent methods usually struggle to capture fine-grained object features and bound- ary details. Besides, current widely used datasets often lack city morphology diversity and segmentation on generative im- ages remains largely unexplored. To address these issues, we propose a Mahalanobis-Angle Boundary Loss (MABL) that explicitly enhances boundary and shape consistency. MABL jointly models structural importance and boundary orientation through Mahalanobis distance-based weighting and angle- aware penalty. It can be readily integrated into diverse seg- mentation architectures and consistently improves their accu- racy. Built upon MABL, we introduce BASeg, a boundary- aware remote sensing segmentation framework with Struc- tural Penalties. BASeg integrates a Global Visual State Space module (GSM) with a Cross-Feature Fusion module (CFM) to capture both long-range contextual dependencies and fine- grained local details. Additionally, we establish a global 10- city benchmark dataset (GCD-25k) to facilitate accurate build- ing and road segmentation. Extensive experiments on four remote-sensing benchmarks demonstrate that BASeg consis- tently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to a 2.8% improvement in mIoU while producing more accurate object boundary segmentation across diverse scenes. Moreover, integrating MABL into multiple existing segmentation archi- tectures consistently improves performance across datasets, demonstrating its robustness and broad applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于马氏距离-角度边界损失（MABL）的边界感知遥感分割框架BASeg，结合全局视觉状态空间模块与跨特征融合模块，并构建了覆盖10个城市的GCD-25k基准数据集，在四个遥感基准上实现最高2.8%的mIoU提升。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感语义分割方法难以捕获细粒度物体特征和边界细节；当前广泛使用的数据集缺乏城市形态多样性；生成图像上的分割研究尚属空白。
AI.method: 提出MABL损失函数，通过马氏距离加权和角度感知惩罚联合建模结构重要性与边界方向；在此基础上构建BASeg框架，包含全局视觉状态空间模块（GSM）捕获长程上下文依赖，以及跨特征融合模块（CFM）获取细粒度局部细节；同时建立全球10城市基准数据集GCD-25k。
AI.result: 在四个遥感基准数据集上，BASeg一致优于现有方法，mIoU最高提升2.8%，并在多样场景下产生更精确的物体边界分割；将MABL集成到多个现有分割架构中均能一致提升性能，验证了其鲁棒性和广泛适用性。
AI.conclusion: MABL作为一种即插即用的边界增强损失具有强泛化能力，BASeg框架有效兼顾长程依赖与局部细节，GCD-25k数据集为遥感分割提供了更具城市多样性的评估基准。

title: Benchmarking Quantum Machine Learning for Power-System Attack Detection: Evaluation Choices Decide the Outcome Before the Models Do
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables. Code, configs, and seeded pipelines: https://github.com/rzn-git/quantum_grid_attack_detection_benchmark
summary: Machine-learning detectors for power-system cyberattacks are themselves attack surfaces, and quantum machine learning has been proposed for them. We benchmark fidelity-kernel SVMs and variational classifiers against six tuned classical models on public power-system attack data (Mississippi State/ORNL), across white-box, transfer, decision-based black-box, and poisoning attacks. Our headline finding is methodological: the benchmark's answers are set by the evaluator's choices before the models. Eight choices -- six in the evaluation protocol, two in the tuning the benchmark itself runs -- each reversed or moved a conclusion at fixed models. The largest is the split: the row-level protocol scores 0.905 macro-F1 where holding whole source files out leaves 0.594, and in the capped matched-dimensionality regime the quantum arm sits within noise of chance with the classical arm 0.024 above it. A fidelity kernel looks most robust until attacked directly (retention 0.886 to 0.064); a mis-fitted surrogate manufactures a 10x asymmetry; an unseeded black-box attack moves 75% between restarts. A positive control explains the accuracy null: the labels, not the pipeline. We give the control that catches each choice and release the seeded benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文对电力系统网络攻击检测中的量子机器学习模型（保真度核SVM和变分分类器）与六种经典模型进行了系统基准测试，覆盖白盒、迁移、决策黑盒和投毒攻击场景。核心发现是方法论层面的：基准测试的结论在很大程度上由评估者的选择决定，而非模型本身。八项关键选择（六项在评估协议中，两项在调参中）每项都能翻转或改变固定模型的结论。
AI.motivation: 电力系统网络攻击检测的机器学习模型本身也是攻击面，量子机器学习被提议用于此领域。但现有基准测试的结论可能被评估协议中的主观选择所左右，缺乏对结论稳健性的系统检验。
AI.method: 在公开的电力系统攻击数据集（密西西比州立/ORNL）上，对保真度核SVM和变分分类器与六种调优后的经典模型进行对比。攻击场景包括白盒、迁移、决策黑盒和投毒攻击。系统性地改变评估协议中的八项选择（六项协议选择+两项基准自身调参选择），观察结论如何变化，并引入阳性对照来区分标签信息和管道效果。
AI.result: 最大的影响因素是数据切分方式：行级协议得macro-F1为0.905，而保留整个源文件时仅0.594。在受限匹配维度设定下，量子模型在噪声范围内接近随机性能，经典模型仅高出0.024。保真度核在直接攻击前最稳健（保留率0.886），但被攻击后骤降至0.064；误适配的替代模型可制造10倍不对称性；未设种子的黑盒攻击在重启间有75%的波动。阳性对照表明精度为零的原因是标签而非管道。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试的结论由评估者的选择决定，而非模型本身。作者提供了能捕捉每项选择影响的控制方法，并发布了带种子的基准测试，以确保结果可复现且对评估协议选择更稳健。

title: A survey of AI-generated voices and their detection
summary: The ability of artificial intelligence (AI) models to generate highly realistic human voices has advanced rapidly. These technologies power accessibility tools, virtual assistants and creative applications, but they also enable harmful uses, including impersonation, fraud and disinformation. Recent incidents of voice cloning scams targeting businesses and political leaders underscore the urgent need for robust safeguards. Unlike image and video deepfakes, the detection of synthetic voices poses unique challenges due to the complexity of phonetics, prosody and auditory perception. This survey offers a comprehensive overview of AI voice generation and detection methods, encompassing both the technical foundations and the latest state-of-the-art advances. This study also identifies key open challenges, benchmark resources and future directions to make this survey useful for future researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于AI语音生成与检测技术的综合综述，涵盖了技术基础、最先进的方法、开放挑战、基准资源和未来方向。
AI.motivation: AI语音生成技术迅速发展，带来了便利的同时也催生了冒充、欺诈和虚假信息等危害。与图像和视频深度伪造不同，合成语音的检测因语音学、韵律学和听觉感知的复杂性而面临独特挑战，亟需全面的综述以指导研究和防护工作。
AI.method: 该综述系统性梳理了AI语音生成与检测两个方向，涵盖技术基础（语音学、音韵学等相关背景）和最新的前沿进展，同时整理了基准资源，并识别开放挑战与未来研究方向。
AI.result: 提供了语音生成与检测方法的全面概览，汇总了关键开放挑战、基准资源，为未来研究者指明了方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为AI语音安全和反欺诈研究提供了系统性的知识框架和路线图，是领域内研究者可参考的重要资源。

title: Counterfactual Sensitivity Is Not Repairability: Auditing Replay Probes for Video Evidence
summary: Tool-using video agents retrieve visual evidence before answering, but the final answer is not forced to depend on what was retrieved. The natural black box test is counterfactual: destroy the semantic content of the frames the agent retrieved and check whether the answer changes, against a matched sham that re-executes the identical pipeline on those same frames. We introduce CARVE, a black-box counterfactual probe that compares answer changes under matched SHAM and DESTROY replays. Across three independent k=3 runs on a frozen VideoExplorer-style agent, DESTROY changes the answer 29.3 percentage points more often than SHAM, yielding a large and reproducible aggregate effect. Question-level scores are less stable, and increasing the replay budget from k=3 to k=10 reduces ties but weakens the original zero-threshold routing policy. At k=3, CARVE selects 538 of 1,258 LVBench questions and improves accuracy by 3.26 points, with higher fallback yield than most matched random subsets. The score shows only a weak association with annotated temporal coverage, so CARVE is best understood as a routing signal rather than a direct grounding classifier. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/CARVE.

AI.tldr: 提出CARVE，一种黑盒反事实探针，通过比对SHAM（匹配重放）与DESTROY（破坏语义帧）两种回放下答案的变化，来评估视频智能体是否真正依赖检索到的视觉证据。实验表明DESTROY比SHAM多改变29.3个百分点答案，可作为路由信号提升准确率3.26点。
AI.motivation: 现有tool-using视频智能体会在回答前检索视觉证据，但最终答案并未被强制依赖所检索的内容。需要一种黑盒测试来判断智能体是否真实利用了检索到的帧。
AI.method: 1) 引入CARVE（黑盒反事实探针）；2) 设计匹配的SHAM（重新执行相同pipeline于原帧）与DESTROY（破坏帧语义内容）两种重放对照；3) 比较两种条件下答案改变的差异；4) 在不同重放预算（k=3与k=10）下评估稳定性。
AI.result: 1) 在冻结的VideoExplorer-style智能体上，k=3独立运行下DESTROY比SHAM多改变答案29.3个百分点，聚合效应显著且可复现；2) 问题级分数稳定性较差；3) 从k=3增至k=10减少了平局但削弱了原始零阈值路由策略；4) CARVE在LVBench的1258个问题中选出538个，准确率提升3.26点，回退收益优于多数随机子集；5) 分数与注释的时间覆盖率仅弱关联。
AI.conclusion: CARVE应被理解为一种路由信号（判断哪些问题值得依赖视频证据）而非直接的接地(grounding)分类器。实现已开源。

title: In Defense of OCTA: The Reconstruction-Utility Gap in OCT-to-OCTA Synthesis
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at OMIA 2026 (13th Ophthalmic Medical Image Analysis Workshop, MICCAI 2026). This is the pre-peer-review submitted version; the camera-ready revises the characterization of the capillary failure
summary: Optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) images retinal blood flow, giving capillary-perfusion and foveal-avascular-zone biomarkers that grade diabetic-retinopathy ischemia. Because OCTA hardware is less common than structural OCT, recent work synthesizes it from OCT, reporting strong reconstruction (3D PSNR > 31 dB, SSIM > 0.9). We ask not whether the synthetic image looks similar, but whether it supports the measurements OCTA is acquired for. A frozen real-OCTA segmenter, applied as a probe to two synthesizers (XOCT, TransPro), shows downstream Dice falling with structural fineness: large vessels survive (0.862 -> 0.831) while the fine capillary network collapses (0.798 -> 0.635, five times the large-vessel loss; paired Wilcoxon p < 1e-3), TransPro worse throughout. A matched-blur control shows this detail is fabricated, not blurred. Retrained on a private Spectralis dataset, neither synthesizer reproduces the neovascular lesion (qualitative, n=3). Reconstruction fidelity is not clinical utility; we establish downstream-task fidelity as the evaluation OCT-to-OCTA synthesis needs.

AI.tldr: 本文指出OCT-to-OCTA合成方法虽然重建指标优异（3D PSNR>31dB, SSIM>0.9），但临床下游任务性能差：冻结的真实OCTA分割器应用于两个合成器（XOCT、TransPro）时，大血管Dice仅从0.862降至0.831，而精细毛细血管网络从0.798崩溃至0.635（损耗是大血管的五倍），TransPro表现更差。匹配模糊对照实验证明细节是伪造而非模糊造成的。在私有Spectralis数据集上重训练后，两种合成器均无法再现新生血管病变。结论：重建保真度不等于临床实用性，应以下游任务保真度作为OCT-to-OCTA合成的评价标准。
AI.motivation: 现有OCT-to-OCTA合成研究仅以图像相似性指标（PSNR、SSIM）评估，忽略了OCTA的核心用途是为糖尿病视网膜病变缺血提供毛细血管灌注和黄斑无血管区等生物标志物测量。作者质疑合成图像能否真正支持OCTA的临床测量用途，而非仅仅看起来相似。
AI.method: 使用冻结的真实OCTA分割器作为探针，应用于两个OCT-to-OCTA合成器（XOCT和TransPro），比较下游毛细血管分割Dice分数；设计匹配模糊对照实验区分细节是伪造还是模糊所致；在私有Spectralis数据集上重训练并定性评估新生血管病变（n=3）的再现能力。
AI.result: 大血管分割相对稳健（0.862→0.831），但精细毛细血管网络严重退化（0.798→0.635），损耗是大血管的五倍（配对Wilcoxon p<1e-3）；TransPro整体表现更差；匹配模糊对照实验表明丢失的细节是伪造而非模糊；两种合成器均无法再现新生血管病变。
AI.conclusion: 重建图像相似性不等于临床测量效用。对于OCT-to-OCTA合成，应建立以下游任务保真度（如分割性能、生物标志物测量准确性）作为评价标准，而非仅仅依赖PSNR和SSIM等重建指标。

title: Does the Proof Prove It That Way? Faithful Formalization of Elements Proofs
summary: In formal verification, both the autoformalization of statements and automated proof search have been studied extensively. While automated proof search can produce a formal proof that compiles, the generated proof does not necessarily reflect how the natural-language argument arrives at its conclusion--a property we refer to as faithfulness. With faithfully formalized proofs, one can check the reasoning behind a human- or AI-written argument, and assist mathematicians in formalizing their proof sketches. However, it is particularly challenging due to misalignment of formal proof tactics and natural language reasoning. In this work, we rigorously describe a set of five necessary conditions a faithful formal proof must satisfy, and introduce Pistis, an agentic, oracle-guided proof search that produces formal Lean proofs that satisfy them. At its core is a novel faithfulness-preserving divide-and-conquer search, which we name OrderDecompose, that tracks citation dependencies and blocks unfaithful shortcuts, paired with a refutation search, that surfaces gaps and errors in the natural language proof source. OrderDecompose completes proofs that baselines cannot close even within a 12-hour budget, and its artifacts compile over 33$\times$ as fast as prior work's. We apply Pistis on the first three books of Euclid's Elements, producing high-quality artifacts containing faithful formal proofs. Under a blinded human study and an LLM-as-a-judge protocol on rigorous rubrics, Pistis-generated proofs are favored over prior works--2.89$\times$ and 5.2$\times$ as often by human reviewers and the LLM judge, respectively. It further uncovers gaps in Euclid's proofs and their translation, and can accept or refute natural language proofs written by humans or AI, demonstrating that faithful formalization is useful as a proof-checking tool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pistis系统，一个基于智能体与oracle引导的证明搜索框架，用于生成忠实的（faithful）形式化Lean证明。其核心是OrderDecompose算法，一种保持忠实性的分治搜索策略，通过追踪引文依赖并阻断不忠实的捷径，结合反驳搜索来发现自然语言证明中的漏洞。在欧几里得《几何原本》前三卷上验证，Pistis生成的证明在人工评审和LLM评审中分别以2.89倍和5.2倍的频率优于先前工作，且能揭示原始证明中的缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有自动证明搜索虽然能生成可编译的形式化证明，但生成的证明不一定反映自然语言论证的推理过程（即不具有忠实性）。忠实的形式化证明对于验证人类或AI撰写的论证、辅助数学家形式化其证明草图至关重要，但这一目标因形式化证明策略与自然语言推理之间的错位而极具挑战性。
AI.method: （1）严格定义忠实形式化证明必须满足的五项必要条件；（2）提出Pistis系统，包含两个核心组件：OrderDecompose——一种保持忠实性的分治证明搜索算法，追踪引文依赖并阻断不忠实的捷径；以及反驳搜索，用于发现自然语言证明来源中的缺口和错误。
AI.result: OrderDecompose能在基线方法12小时预算内无法完成的证明上成功完成，且编译速度比先前工作快33倍以上。在《几何原本》前三卷上，Pistis生成的证明在人类评审和LLM评审中分别以2.89倍和5.2倍的频率获得偏好，并发现了欧几里得证明及其翻译中的缺口。
AI.conclusion: Pistis展示了忠实形式化作为证明检查工具的实用性：它既能接受也能反驳人类或AI撰写的自然语言证明，并能揭示原始证明中的缺陷，证明忠实形式化不仅在理论上重要，在实践中也具有显著价值。

title: Training-Free Long-Term Multi-Object Tracking for Sports Video Analytics
summary: Long-term multi-object tracking in sports remains challenging due to frequent occlusions, rapid camera motion, and repeated player reappearances. We introduce McByte++, a training-free tracking-by-detection framework that integrates lightweight mask propagation, conditional camera motion compensation, and online re-identification within a unified pipeline. Compared to its predecessor, McByte++ substantially improves runtime efficiency while enhancing identity preservation. On SoccerNet-tracking and SportsMOT benchmarks, McByte++ achieves up to +3.0 HOTA and +6.1 IDF1 improvements over the original McByte in the online setting, with further gains when combined with offline global association. Replacing heavy segmentation components and optimizing motion modeling yields up to an order-of-magnitude speed increase. All results are obtained without detector retraining or dataset-specific tuning. Code will be made available at https://github.com/tstanczyk95/McBytePlusPlus.

AI.tldr: McByte++是一个无需训练的跟踪-by-检测框架，通过轻量级掩码传播、条件相机运动补偿和在线重识别集成，在SoccerNet-tracking和SportsMOT基准上相比原始McByte实现了高达+3.0 HOTA和+6.1 IDF1的提升，同时运行速度提升了最多一个数量级，且无需检测器重训练或数据集特定调优。
AI.motivation: 体育场景中的长期多目标跟踪面临频繁遮挡、快速相机运动和球员反复重现等挑战，现有方法在身份保持和运行效率方面存在不足，需要在不依赖训练或数据集特定调优的前提下提升跟踪性能。
AI.method: McByte++采用无需训练的跟踪-by-检测框架，统一集成三个关键组件：轻量级掩码传播（替代重型分割组件）、条件相机运动补偿（优化运动建模）、以及在线重识别（增强身份保持），全部在统一流水线中运行。
AI.result: 在SoccerNet-tracking和SportsMOT基准上，在线设置下相比原始McByte实现高达+3.0 HOTA和+6.1 IDF1的提升；结合离线全局关联时可获得进一步增益；通过替换重型分割组件和优化运动建模，运行速度提升最多达一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: McByte++在显著提升运行效率的同时增强了身份保持能力，所有结果均无需检测器重训练或数据集特定调整，表明该框架具有较好的泛化性和实际应用价值，代码已开源。

title: Sparse Prototype Code Underlies Classification and Prediction Across Modalities
summary: Neural representations have become a central tool for studying the internal mechanisms of modern AI models, yet their complex high-dimensional structure makes them difficult to interpret. We show that classification tasks give rise to a universal representational geometry, shared across state-of-the-art models in vision, audio, and language processing. The key structure is that within-class variability is not random in representation space. Instead, its classifier-relevant component has strong and structured correlations with the class's own centroid and with the centroids of its competing classes. Building on this observation, we derive an analytical mean-field theory governed mainly by the variability along true-class and rival-class centroid coordinates, together with a global renormalization of the class radius that compensates for the non-Gaussian statistics of real representations. The theory accurately predicts classification accuracy across architectures and modalities. The relevant geometric quantities improve systematically with model scale, mirroring the observed gains in accuracy. A striking feature of the theory is its sparsity: accurate prediction requires only a small set of centroid coordinates associated with the true class and its strongest rivals - connecting our framework to sparse-feature extraction approaches such as sparse autoencoders. Together, these results provide a parsimonious predictive theory of neural representations and suggest that classification in deep networks is governed by a sparse, centroid-aligned structure embedded within the full high-dimensional representation space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现分类任务在不同模态（视觉、音频、语言）的现代AI模型中产生通用的表征几何结构。类内变异并非随机，其分类器相关成分与类别质心及竞争类别质心存在强结构相关。作者据此推导出解析平均场理论，仅需少量质心坐标即可准确预测分类精度，且该几何量随模型规模提升而系统改善。
AI.motivation: 神经表征的高维复杂结构难以解释，尽管已成为研究现代AI模型内部机制的核心工具，但目前缺乏对表征几何结构的普适性理解和解析性预测框架。
AI.method: 1) 实证发现跨模态、跨架构的分类任务存在通用表征几何，即类内变异的分类器相关成分与真实类别质心及竞争类别质心强相关；2) 基于此观察推导解析平均场理论，主要刻画真实类别与竞争类别质心坐标上的变异，并通过全局类别半径重整化补偿非高斯统计；3) 理论预测仅需少量质心坐标（真实类别及其最强竞争者），与稀疏自编码器等稀疏特征提取方法相衔接。
AI.result: 该理论能跨架构、跨模态准确预测分类精度；相关几何量随模型规模提升而系统改善，与精度提升趋势一致；理论具有显著稀疏性，少数质心坐标即可实现高精度预测。
AI.conclusion: 深度网络中的分类受嵌入在高维表征空间中的稀疏、质心对齐结构支配，该研究为神经表征提供了简洁可预测的统一理论框架，并连接了稀疏特征提取方法。

title: OTel: Building Domain-Specialized Telecom LLM Foundations for Intelligent Networks
comment: Accepted at the ACM AI Leadership Summit, Breakthrough Impact Highlights Track, 2026
summary: Frontier AI models have advanced rapidly, but they still struggle with telecom-specific tasks. We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource with derived datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, plus 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines across embedding, reranking, and language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times, and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.5% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.952 MRR@10, and language-model correctness reaches 88.2%. We release OTel as a reproducible starting point and invite the community to expand the data, improve embedding and reranking models, and build stronger context-grounded telecom LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Open Telco (OTel)，一个面向电信领域的开放AI资源，包含检索、重排序、指令微调和安全/弃权等派生数据集，以及30个全参数后训练的嵌入、重排序和语言模型基线。模型下载量超1600万次，获得157+媒体关注。后训练显著提升性能：嵌入检索NDCG@10达93.5%，重排序MRR@10达0.952，语言模型正确率达88.2%。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI模型虽然发展迅速，但在电信领域特定任务上仍表现不佳，缺乏统一的开放电信AI资源来支撑这一垂直领域的模型开发与应用。
AI.method: 构建统一的开放电信AI资源OTel，涵盖文档化数据来源、保留评估分区、派生数据集（检索、重排序、指令微调、安全/弃权），并对嵌入模型、重排序模型和语言模型三类模型族进行30个全参数后训练。
AI.result: OTel后训练在三类模型族上均提升性能：嵌入检索NDCG@10达93.5%，重排序MRR@10达0.952，语言模型正确率达88.2%。资源已获社区广泛参与，模型下载超1600万次，媒体覆盖157+次。
AI.conclusion: OTel作为可复现的电信AI起点，邀请社区扩展数据、改进嵌入与重排序模型，构建更强的上下文接地电信大语言模型。

title: Automated Fetal Brain MRI Biometry in Healthy and Pathological Cases
comment: Accepted at the PIPPI Workshop of MICCAI 2026
summary: Automated biometric analysis of fetal brain MRI enables reproducible, observer-independent quantitative assessment, yet existing methods are often restricted to few measurements or evaluated only on healthy cases. We assemble and evaluate an automated biometric analysis pipeline that localizes 22 anatomical landmarks on NeSVoR-reconstructed 3D volumes and derives 11 clinically relevant measurements spanning supratentorial, ventricular, cerebellar, and midline structures. We compare two landmark localization models, H3DE-Net and SCN, on a heterogeneous cohort of 122 acquisitions (both healthy controls and range pathologies). Localization accuracy was assessed with a linear mixed-effects model, agreement with normative growth trajectories with calibrated centile charts, and diagnostic utility with a decision tree classifying VM severity. H3DE-Net achieved significantly lower localization error than SCN across all landmarks (mean 1.36 mm vs. 3.58 mm in HC and 1.90 mm vs. 4.13 mm in PC; p < 0.001), and outperformed a GA-based regression baseline in 7 of 11 measurements. H3DE-Net measurements yielded higher classification AUC in every diagnostic group, with the clearest advantage in separating healthy controls from VM. Decision tree thresholds for ventricular width fell near the clinical 10 mm and 15 mm cut-offs used to define and grade VM.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并评估了一个自动化胎儿脑MRI生物特征分析流程，通过NeSVoR重建3D体积上定位22个解剖标志点，推导11项临床相关测量指标。比较H3DE-Net和SCN两种标志点定位模型，在122例（健康与多种病理）异质性队列中，H3DE-Net定位误差显著更低，测量结果在诊断分类上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有胎儿脑MRI自动化生物特征分析方法受限，要么测量指标有限，要么仅在健康病例上评估，缺乏在病理异质性队列中的系统性验证，无法满足临床实际需求。
AI.method: 构建自动化生物特征分析pipeline：在NeSVoR重建的3D体积上定位22个解剖标志点，推导11项涉及幕上、脑室、小脑及中线结构的临床测量。对比H3DE-Net与SCN两种定位模型，采用线性混合效应模型评估定位精度，用校准百分位图检验与正常生长轨迹的一致性，并以决策树评估脑室肥大（VM）严重程度分类的诊断效用。
AI.result: H3DE-Net在全部标志点上定位误差显著低于SCN（健康对照平均1.36mm vs 3.58mm；病理组1.90mm vs 4.13mm；p<0.001），在11项测量中7项优于基于GA的回归基线。H3DE-Net测量在所有诊断组中分类AUC更高，尤其在区分健康对照与VM时优势最明显。脑室宽度决策树阈值接近临床10mm和15mm的VM定义与分级切点。
AI.conclusion: H3DE-Net驱动的自动化pipeline在病理异质性队列中展现出更高的定位精度和更强的诊断区分能力，且决策阈值与临床标准契合，具备临床转化潜力。

title: Generalised Transportability via Causal Abstractions
summary: Transporting a causal conclusion from a source study population to a target one is a fundamental problem in causal inference. The theory of transportability provides a criterion for when this is possible: given experimental data from the source and observational data from the target, it determines whether a target query is identifiable and does so completely; i.e. if the query can be transported, the criterion finds the exact formula. However, it works one query at a time and returns an expression rather than the value itself. It is also silent in two practically important regimes: when the query is not transportable and when no target data exist at all. To tackle both, we take a model-level perspective grounded in Causal Abstraction theory. Source and target share variables, graph, and interventions, differing only at a known set of mechanisms, which makes transportability a special case of same-level abstraction. Thus, instead of asking whether one query transports, we ask whether a single map aligns the source and target across their interventional behaviour. We characterise when such a map exists in both the Markovian and semi-Markovian settings; when it does, every target query transports at once. Our main contribution lies in the approximate case. When no exact map exists, the best approximate one still yields certified query intervals, recasting abstraction error as a quantitative notion of approximate transportability. We formulate model-level transport as distributionally robust optimisation over mechanism and environment perturbations of the unseen target and derive certificates for both challenging regimes: bounds for non-transportable queries, and guarantees under target-agnostic settings. We evaluate our framework on synthetic Markovian and semi-Markovian benchmarks and a real ecological dataset, and we show that the certified intervals bracket the true interventional query.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果抽象（Causal Abstraction）理论的模型级可迁移性（model-level transportability）框架，将传统的单查询可迁移性推广到整个模型层面。当源和目标共享变量、图和干预但仅在已知机制集上不同时，该框架通过寻找一个映射来对齐源和目标的干预行为，从而一次性实现所有目标查询的可迁移。作者还提出了近似情况下的分布鲁棒优化方法，为非可迁移查询提供认证区间，并在无目标数据的场景下提供保证。
AI.motivation: 传统可迁移性理论存在三个局限：1）每次只处理一个查询，返回表达式而非具体值；2）当查询不可迁移时无法提供任何信息；3）当目标数据完全不存在时无法工作。这些局限阻碍了可迁移性理论在实践中的应用。
AI.method: 将可迁移性视为同层因果抽象的特例，设定源和目标共享变量、图和干预，仅在已知机制集上不同。通过寻找一个对齐源与目标干预行为的映射来表征马尔可夫和半马尔可夫设置中映射存在的条件。对于近似情况，将模型级可迁移公式化为分布鲁棒优化（DRO）问题，对未见目标的机制和环境扰动进行优化，从而为非可迁移查询提供认证区间，并为目标不可知场景提供保证。
AI.result: 在合成马尔可夫和半马尔可夫基准测试以及真实生态数据集上评估了该框架，结果表明认证区间能够正确包含真实的干预查询值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将可迁移性从单查询层面提升到模型层面，通过将抽象误差重新概念化为近似可迁移性的定量度量，成功解决了传统方法无法处理的非可迁移查询和无目标数据两种关键场景，为跨种群因果结论迁移提供了更全面的理论框架。

title: Measuring Reward Hacking and Reasoning-Answer Decoupling Under Position-Confounded Optimization
comment: Accepted at the AI Measurement Science Workshop, COLM 2026
summary: When a reward is correct on every training example yet consistent with more than one goal, a model can acquire an unintended one, a failure known as goal misgeneralization. Endpoint accuracy on the training distribution cannot tell the two apart, because solving the task and exploiting a surface feature can satisfy the reward equally well. We treat this as a measurement problem: what does a benchmark score measure once a model has been optimized against a correct but confounded signal? We train language models with GRPO on multiple-choice math problems where the correct answer is always option A, then evaluate on an unseen test set with unbiased answer positions. Across Qwen2.5, Llama 3.x and Gemma-3 models, biased training often drives option-A rates above 0.90 in smaller models and collapses unbiased accuracy toward chance, so accuracy stops measuring math ability and instead measures an answer-position policy. We further find reasoning-answer decoupling: capable models generate reasoning that reaches the correct numeric answer while still selecting A. We track this with numeric extraction and an LLM judge (GPT-4.1-mini; Qwen2.5-3B decoupling rate is about 0.66). The broken construct generalizes beyond the training domain: biased models inflate A-rates on out-of-domain MMLU and value-laden prompts. Continued training on unbiased data reverses the in-domain shift unevenly and only partially reverses the out-of-domain one, so a model can appear restored on its training distribution while remaining biased on unseen inputs. Reasoning-answer decoupling rate, together with answer distributions and out-of-domain behavior, separates capability loss from a learned, transferable shortcut.

AI.tldr: 本文研究目标错泛化（goal misgeneralization）问题：当训练数据中存在表面特征（如正确答案总是选项A）时，模型可能学会利用这些捷径而非真正的数学能力。研究发现偏差训练使小模型选择A的比例超过0.90，无偏准确率降至随机水平；且出现推理与答案解耦现象——模型推理正确但依然选A。该偏差可跨域迁移（如MMLU），且用无偏数据继续训练只能部分逆转。
AI.motivation: 传统端点准确率无法区分模型是真正解决了任务还是利用了表面特征。当奖励信号在训练集上正确但存在混杂因素时，基准分数衡量的可能是捷径策略而非真实能力，这是一个测量问题。
AI.method: 使用GRPO训练多语言模型（Qwen2.5、Llama 3.x、Gemma-3）于正确答案总为选项A的选择题数学题上，然后在答案位置无偏的测试集上评估。通过数值提取和LLM评判（GPT-4.1-mini）追踪推理与答案解耦，并在域内（数学）和域外（MMLU、价值负载提示）测试偏差迁移及无偏数据继续训练的逆转效果。
AI.result: 偏差训练在小模型中使A选项率超过0.90，无偏准确率崩溃至随机水平。大型模型出现推理-答案解耦（Qwen2.5-3B解耦率约0.66）。偏差扩展到域外MMLU和负载价值提示。无偏数据继续训练只能部分且不均匀地逆转偏差。
AI.conclusion: 推理-答案解耦率、答案分布和域外行为三者结合，可以区分能力丧失与习得的可迁移捷径。评估基准分数需要超越训练分布上的端点准确率，关注模型的真实泛化行为。

title: RRFC: Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning for Iterative Image-to-Image Generation
summary: Conditional image-to-image generators are single-shot: they map input features to an output in one forward pass and treat it as final, with no opportunity to improve on it. Although trained to produce the best possible result in one step, such a model leaves room for improvement if it can adaptively revise its own output over iterations. We propose Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning (RRFC), a novel feedback-conditioning framework for iterative output refinement that teaches a model to adaptively revise its output by conditioning on a new signal, namely its most recent previous prediction, which is fed back as an auxiliary set of channels alongside the original input. This preserves the generator's core architecture while modifying its conditioning interface and, depending on the model family, its training or inference procedure, so RRFC can be attached to existing generators without redesign. We evaluate RRFC across six baselines spanning adversarial, equilibrium, and diffusion-based models and three paired image-to-image translation tasks. Across 18 architecture-task settings, RRFC yields seven Holm-corrected improvements, seven degradations, and four non-significant changes. The gains concentrate on reconstruction-fidelity and identity settings, while five of the seven degradations fall on the single semantic-layout task, where every model declines. These results indicate that feedback-based refinement helps when its objective overlaps with the evaluated property, and that its gains concentrate on the tasks where that overlap holds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RRFC框架，通过将模型自身最近的预测作为辅助通道反馈回输入，实现条件图像生成器的迭代式输出精化，无需重新设计生成器架构。
AI.motivation: 条件图像生成器通常为单次前向传播设计，一次生成即视为最终结果，缺乏迭代改进的机会。作者认为即使模型被训练为一次生成最佳结果，若能在迭代中自适应修正自身输出，仍存在提升空间。
AI.method: RRFC框架将生成器最近的预测作为新的辅助通道与原始输入拼接反馈回模型，保留原有核心架构，仅修改条件输入接口及训练/推理过程。该框架可适配对抗、均衡和扩散三类生成模型。
AI.result: 在6个基线模型、3个成对图像翻译任务、18个架构-任务组合中，RRFC获得7项Holm校正后的显著提升，7项退化，4项无显著变化。提升集中在重建保真度和身份保持任务，7项退化中5项出现在语义布局任务。
AI.conclusion: 反馈式精化在目标与评估属性重叠时有效，其收益集中在任务目标与评估指标一致的场景；当评估属性与生成目标不一致时（如语义布局任务），反馈迭代反而导致退化。

title: Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization for Product Media Ranking in E-Commerce
comment: Proceedings of the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026), Rome, Italy
summary: On modern e-commerce stores, customers consume ordered slates of heterogeneous product media, such as images, videos, and 3D renders, before making purchase decisions. Existing media-ranking systems often optimize myopic engagement proxies such as clicks or dwell time, even though product media assets are cooperative informational components of the same item that together help customers find the information they need through sequential interaction. We present Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization (SMEO), a two-stage utility-guided framework for customer-oriented media sequencing. SMEO first learns a trajectory utility model from consumed media prefixes to estimate how ordered evidence helps customers reach a purchase decision, while mitigating position-bias and variable-depth imbalance in logged data. Recognizing that customer attention is a limited resource, it then trains an autoregressive ranking policy with survival-weighted reward-to-go that prioritizes the most decision-relevant information early, so customers can find what they need with less effort. By decoupling utility learning from policy optimization, SMEO enables stable offline learning from biased logs and post-hoc media attribution without explicit media-level labels. Evaluated offline on large-scale e-commerce sessions using doubly robust off-policy estimation, SMEO improves estimated conversion by 5.5% and helps customers reach a purchase decision with 15% fewer swipes than existing baselines.

AI.tldr: SMEO是一个两阶段、效用引导的框架，用于电商场景下多媒体序列排序。它先学习轨迹效用模型估计顺序证据如何帮助购买决策（同时缓解位置偏差和深度不平衡），再用生存加权奖励训练自回归排序策略，优先呈现决策相关信息，在离线评估中提升转化率5.5%，减少15%滑动手势。
AI.motivation: 现有媒体排序系统优化点击或停留时间等短期参与代理指标，忽视了产品媒体资产是同一商品的合作性信息组件，顾客通过顺序交互共同获取所需信息。需要一个面向顾客的、考虑顺序多模态证据的媒体排序方案。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 从消费过的媒体前缀学习轨迹效用模型，估计顺序证据对购买决策的帮助，同时缓解位置偏差和变深不平衡；(2) 用生存加权奖励训练自回归排序策略，优先呈现决策相关信息。效用学习与策略优化解耦，支持从有偏日志进行稳定离线学习和事后媒体归因。
AI.result: 离线使用双重鲁棒离策略评估，SMEO相比现有基线提升估算转化率5.5%，并帮助顾客减少15%的滑动手势即达成购买决策。
AI.conclusion: SMEO通过解耦效用学习与策略优化，实现了从有偏日志的稳定离线学习，在提升转化和减少顾客交互成本两方面均优于现有基线，为电商媒体序列排序提供了更符合顾客信息需求的新范式。

title: Bitstream Action Recognition is Byte Modeling
summary: Conventional action recognition typically relies on successful pixel decoding of the bitstream. However, bitstream corruption during storage or transmission may cause severe visual artifacts or even decoding failure, posing a significant challenge to reliable action recognition. Bitstream Action Recognition (BAR) aims to overcome the dependency on decoding and the vulnerability to corruption. In this paper, we propose a novel BAR framework, Bitstream Recognition via Anchoring Corrupted Embeddings (BRACE). BRACE is a dual-branch byte-modeling architecture that treats a corrupted bitstream and its intact counterpart as two byte realizations of the same action. This guides the generation of rich and stable representations for robustness to corruption through Intact-Anchored Representation Alignment (IARA). The intact representation serves as a stable anchor, and the corrupted one is aligned to it at the embedding and decision levels under Unreliable-Anchor Suppression (UAS), entirely in representation space and without repairing the bitstream. To address the scarcity of corrupted bitstreams in practice, we introduce the Real-world Bitstream Corruption Simulator (RBCS), a four-parameter simulator that reproduces bit-flip and byte-loss errors arising in transmission and storage. Building on RBCS, we construct the first large-scale BAR dataset (BAR-D), which comprises the BAR-Stanford40 and BAR-PPMI subsets and spans diverse corruption types and severity levels. Finally, we build a large benchmark on BAR-D involving 14 action recognition methods from the pixel, compressed, and bitstream domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BRACE has superior robustness to bitstream corruption than all comparison methods. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed RBCS augmentation and IARA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRACE框架，直接从损坏的比特流（不依赖像素解码）进行动作识别。通过双分支字节建模架构，将损坏比特流与完好比特流视为同一动作的两种字节实现，利用Intact-Anchored Representation Alignment对齐表征，并引入RBCS模拟器构建首个大规模BAR数据集（BAR-D），实验证明其抗损坏鲁棒性优于14种对比方法。
AI.motivation: 传统动作识别依赖比特流的像素解码，但比特流在存储或传输过程中可能损坏，导致视觉伪影甚至解码失败，严重威胁动作识别的可靠性。现有方法缺乏对损坏比特流的鲁棒性，亟需不依赖解码的直接比特流动作识别方法。
AI.method: 提出BRACE框架：（1）双分支字节建模架构，将损坏比特流与完好比特流视为同一动作的两种字节实现；（2）Intact-Anchored Representation Alignment (IARA)，以完好表征为稳定锚点，在嵌入层和决策层对齐损坏表征；（3）Unreliable-Anchor Suppression (UAS)抑制不可靠锚点；（4）Real-world Bitstream Corruption Simulator (RBCS)，四参数模拟比特翻转和字节丢失错误，构建BAR-D数据集。
AI.result: 构建了首个大规模BAR数据集（BAR-D），包含BAR-Stanford40和BAR-PPMI子集；在14种来自像素、压缩和比特流领域的动作识别方法上进行大规模基准测试；实验证明BRACE对比特流损坏的鲁棒性优于所有对比方法，消融实验验证了RBCS增强和IARA的有效性。
AI.conclusion: BRACE通过纯表征空间内的锚定对齐机制，在不修复比特流的情况下实现了对损坏比特流动作识别的强鲁棒性，为比特流域动作识别提供了新的研究范式和基准数据集。

title: SubZero+: Efficient Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Large Learning Rates
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables backpropagation-free fine-tuning of large language models, but existing ZO methods suffer from high-variance gradient estimators, making convergence unstable and highly sensitive to learning rates. We propose SubZero+, an improved SubZero framework that improves stability in three complementary ways: (i) multi-query gradient estimation within layer-specific low-rank subspaces to reduce variance without exhibiting the multi-query paradox; (ii) a subspace Adam optimizer that performs adaptive updates using in-subspace multi-query gradient statistics; and (iii) a sign correction for QR-based subspace construction to ensure Haar-distributed projection matrices, eliminating implementation-dependent orientation ambiguity. Experiments on models from 1.3B to 32B across SuperGLUE, under both full-parameter tuning and LoRA, show that SubZero+ consistently outperforms prior ZO baselines, enlarges the stable learning-rate range, and narrows the gap to first-order methods with minimal extra memory overhead.

AI.tldr: SubZero+是一种改进的零阶(ZO)优化框架，通过三种互补策略提升大语言模型微调的稳定性：(i)在层特定低秩子空间内进行多查询梯度估计以降低方差；(ii)子空间Adam优化器利用子空间内多查询梯度统计进行自适应更新；(iii)对QR子空间构建进行符号校正以确保Haar分布投影矩阵。在1.3B到32B模型上的SuperGLUE实验中，无论全参数微调还是LoRA，SubZero+均优于现有ZO基线，扩大了稳定学习率范围，并以最小额外内存开销缩小了与一阶方法的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的零阶(ZO)优化方法在微调大型语言模型时，梯度估计器方差过高，导致收敛不稳定且对学习率非常敏感。这阻碍了ZO方法作为无需反向传播的高效微调方案的实用性和可靠性。
AI.method: SubZero+通过三个互补机制改进SubZero框架：1) 在层特定低秩子空间内进行多查询梯度估计以降低方差，同时避免"多查询悖论"；2) 设计子空间Adam优化器，利用子空间内的多查询梯度统计信息进行自适应参数更新；3) 对基于QR分解的子空间构建引入符号校正，确保投影矩阵服从Haar分布，消除实现相关的方向歧义性。
AI.result: 在1.3B至32B规模模型上的SuperGLUE基准测试中，无论是全参数微调还是LoRA设置下，SubZero+都持续优于之前的ZO基线方法。该方法扩大了稳定的学习率范围，并以最小的额外内存开销显著缩小了与一阶优化方法之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: SubZero+通过降低方差、自适应优化和消除实现歧义三管齐下，有效提升了ZO优化的稳定性，使零阶方法在大模型微调中更具实用性和竞争力，同时保持了后向传播无关的低内存开销优势。

title: Dynamic Multi-Byte Prediction With Hierarchical Language Models
summary: Byte-level hierarchical language models (LMs) have recently emerged as a robust alternative to their popular counterparts that use subword tokenization. However, generating one byte at a time remains a bottleneck for inference speed. To address this, we introduce multi-byte prediction (MBP), which generates multiple bytes in parallel, speeding up inference with minimal performance impact and no additional parameters. MBP builds on the popular multi-token prediction (MTP) paradigm with two crucial innovations. First, we introduce a variable-length prediction window that aligns with the latent tokens, or segments, of a hierarchical LM. Second, we implement a novel attention-masking scheme that enables parallel byte prediction without violating causality. We show that multi-byte prediction strikes a Pareto-optimal trade-off across multiple generative tasks, instruction following, question answering, summarization, and machine translation, achieving the best trade-off between performance and inference throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多字节预测（MBP）方法，允许字节级层次语言模型并行生成多个字节，在不增加参数且性能影响极小的情况下显著提升推理速度。MBP通过可变长度预测窗口（对齐层次LM的潜在分段）和新型注意力掩码方案实现因果性下的并行字节预测，在多种生成任务上达到帕累托最优的性能-吞吐量平衡。
AI.motivation: 字节级层次语言模型是子词分词方法的稳健替代方案，但逐字节生成导致推理速度成为瓶颈，亟需加速方法。
AI.method: 提出MBP方法：(1) 引入可变长度预测窗口，与层次LM的潜在分段（token）对齐；(2) 设计新颖的注意力掩码方案，在不违反因果性的前提下实现并行字节预测。MBP基于多token预测（MTP）范式，无需额外参数。
AI.result: MBP在指令遵循、问答、摘要和机器翻译等多个生成任务上实现了性能与推理吞吐量之间的帕累托最优权衡，即最佳trade-off。
AI.conclusion: 多字节预测能够在保持字节级LM优势的同时有效解决推理速度瓶颈，是一种无需额外参数的高效加速方案。

title: Large Discovery Models: Empirically-grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search
summary: Scientific discovery often involves optimising expensive-to-evaluate objectives over vast, structured, and open-ended hypothesis spaces, such as molecules, protein sequences, and computer programs. Generative models such as large language models (LLMs) provide expressive priors over such spaces, but their likelihoods and self-assessments are unreliable proxies for the objectives and calibrated epistemic uncertainty, especially for novel candidates outside the observed data distribution. We introduce the Large Discovery Model (LDM), an empirically grounded recurrent architecture that couples a generative model with a Bayesian non-parametric reward surrogate model. The generative model proposes and refines candidate designs, while the surrogate predicts their performance and quantifies uncertainty, yielding an uncertainty-aware value that guides candidate generation, refinement, and selection. The discovery memory and the surrogate model are continually updated as each new experimental observation arrives. We evaluate LDM on three scenarios spanning different design modalities and objectives, including neural-network training, antibody design, and molecular optimisation. Compared to LLM-only reflection or traditional statistical search across these domains, LDM achieves a $2.4\times$ greater reduction in validation BPB, an $18.2\%$ relative decrease in binding energy, and more than $60\%$ relative gains in molecular multi-objective performance. These results suggests that LDM could serve as a general-purpose discovery engine for effective search over open-ended hypothesis spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大型发现模型（LDM），将生成式模型与贝叶斯非参数奖励代理模型耦合，用于在开放的假设空间（分子、蛋白质序列、程序等）中优化昂贵的评估目标。LDM通过不确定性感知的价值引导候选生成、优化和选择，并持续更新发现记忆和代理模型。在神经网络训练、抗体设计和分子优化三个场景中，LDM相比仅LLM反思或传统统计搜索，在验证BPB、结合能和分子多目标性能上分别取得2.4倍、18.2%和60%以上的相对提升。
AI.motivation: 科学发现常需在海量、结构化且开放式的假设空间（如分子、蛋白质序列、计算机程序）中优化评估成本高昂的目标函数。虽然生成模型（如LLM）能提供这些空间的表达性先验，但其似然度和自我评估作为目标函数及校准不确定性代理并不可靠，尤其对分布外的新颖候选而言。现有方法缺乏将生成能力与可靠不确定性量化相结合的有效框架。
AI.method: LDM是一个基于经验构建的循环架构，核心包含两个耦合组件：(1) 生成模型负责提出和精炼候选设计；(2) 贝叶斯非参数奖励代理模型预测候选性能并量化不确定性，产生不确定性感知的价值来指导候选的生成、精炼和选择。发现记忆与代理模型在每次新的实验观测到达时持续更新，形成闭环的迭代发现循环。
AI.result: 在三个不同设计模态与目标场景（神经网络训练、抗体设计、分子优化）中评估LDM。相比LLM-only反思或传统统计搜索：验证BPB降低幅度提升2.4倍；结合能相对降低18.2%；分子多目标性能相对提升超过60%。
AI.conclusion: LDM作为通用发现引擎，能有效在开放式假设空间中进行高效搜索，将生成模型的表达能力与贝叶斯代理模型的不确定性量化优势有机结合，超越仅依赖LLM反思或传统统计方法的表现。

title: A Network-driven Framework for Public Event Forecasting via Dynamic Interaction Network Evolution
summary: Effective public event forecasting is essential for intelligent service systems, enabling proactive risk management, adaptive resource allocation, and timely decision-making. In many real-world scenarios, the evolution of public events is driven by dynamic interactions among participants. Motivated by this observation, this paper proposes auto-ibDLM, a network-driven deep learning framework that represents events as dynamic interaction networks and predicts public event evolution through participant growth forecasting. The proposed framework adopts a hybrid representation learning strategy that first represents network evolution using network science-informed structural metrics and subsequently transforms the resulting structural feature vectors into compact and robust latent representations through an auto-learning layer. A GRU-based temporal forecasting module is then employed to capture temporal dependencies and predict future participant growth. Extensive experiments on 13 real-world public event datasets and two publicly available dynamic network datasets demonstrate that auto-ibDLM consistently outperforms representative state-of-the-art methods in both forecasting accuracy and generalization capability, achieving over 97% accuracy in public event forecasting. Comprehensive experimental analyses further validate the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid representation learning strategy and demonstrate its representation-level interpretability. These results indicate that auto-ibDLM provides an effective and practical solution for intelligent public event forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出auto-ibDLM，一种基于网络驱动的深度学习框架，将公共事件建模为动态交互网络，通过参与者增长预测来实现事件演化预测。框架采用混合表示学习策略（网络科学结构指标+自学习层降维）和GRU时序预测模块，在13个真实公共事件数据集和2个公开动态网络数据集上达到97%以上的预测准确率。
AI.motivation: 公共事件预测对于智能服务系统至关重要，但现有方法未能充分利用事件演化中参与者之间的动态交互信息。真实世界中公共事件演化由参与者间的动态交互驱动，因此需要一种能够捕捉这种交互网络演化规律的预测框架。
AI.method: 1) 将公共事件表示为动态交互网络；2) 采用混合表示学习策略：先用网络科学启发的结构指标表示网络演化，再通过自动学习层将结构特征向量转换为紧凑鲁棒的潜在表示；3) 使用基于GRU的时序预测模块捕捉时间依赖关系并预测未来参与者增长。
AI.result: 在13个真实公共事件数据集和2个公开动态网络数据集上进行大量实验，auto-ibDLM在预测准确率和泛化能力上均优于代表性最先进方法，公共事件预测准确率超过97%。消融实验验证了混合表示学习策略的有效性和表示层面的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: auto-ibDLM为智能公共事件预测提供了有效且实用的解决方案，验证了将网络科学与深度学习相结合用于事件演化建模的可行性，同时具备良好的泛化能力和可解释性。

title: PixelControl: Fine-Grained Condition Fidelity in Text-to-Image Diffusion
comment: The project homepage can be found: https://linxin0.github.io/pixelcontrol_homepage/pixelcontrol-site/
summary: Controllable text-to-image diffusion models can often follow the global layout of spatial conditions, yet still violate fine-grained structures such as object boundaries, thin contours, and medium/small conditioned regions. This limitation is especially problematic for VAE-based latent diffusion, where spatial compression can weaken high-frequency and low-area condition signals. We propose PixelControl, a pixel-space controllable diffusion framework for fine-grained condition fidelity. Built on a PixelDiT-style backbone, PixelControl avoids the latent bottleneck and introduces two complementary designs. First, Structure-Aware Control Injection derives a condition structure map and uses it to strengthen injected control residuals around spatially sensitive regions. Second, Multi-Scale Pyramid Cycle Loss verifies generated images against condition-derived structures across multiple resolutions, balancing global layout consistency with local boundary and detail accuracy. PixelControl supports depth, segmentation, edge, and their combinations through modality-specific control branches with lightweight gated fusion. Experiments across depth, segmentation, and edge control show that PixelControl improves structural fidelity and visual quality over existing controllable generation methods, with especially strong gains on boundaries and medium/small conditioned regions. The project page can be found at: https://linxin0.github.io/pixelcontrol_homepage/pixelcontrol-site/

AI.tldr: PixelControl是一个基于像素空间的可控扩散框架，旨在解决VAE潜在扩散中因空间压缩导致的高频和低面积条件信号弱化问题，通过结构感知控制注入和多尺度金字塔循环损失，实现对物体边界、细轮廓和中/小条件区域的高保真控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的可控文生图扩散模型虽能遵循全局布局，但在物体边界、细轮廓和中/小条件区域等细粒度结构上仍存在违规。尤其对于基于VAE的潜扩散模型，空间压缩会削弱高频和低面积的条件信号，这是细粒度条件保真度不足的根本原因。
AI.method: （1）构建在PixelDiT风格骨干上，避免潜在瓶颈；（2）结构感知控制注入：推导条件结构图，用于增强空间敏感区域附近的控制残差；（3）多尺度金字塔循环损失：在多个分辨率下将生成图像与条件推导结构进行对比验证，平衡全局布局一致性与局部边界/细节精度；（4）通过模态特定控制分支和轻量级门控融合支持深度、分割、边缘及其组合条件。
AI.result: 在深度、分割和边缘控制实验中，PixelControl相比现有可控生成方法在结构保真度和视觉质量上均有提升，尤其在边界和中/小条件区域上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: PixelControl通过避免VAE潜在瓶颈并叠加结构感知注入与多尺度循环损失，有效解决了细粒度条件保真问题，在边界和中/小区域上取得显著优势。

title: PL-Guard: Probabilistic Logic Reasoning for LLM Guardrails
comment: Preliminary version of this paper was presented at the IJCAI 2026 Workshop on Logical and Symbolic Reasoning of Large Language Models
summary: Large language model guardrails can be viewed as policy-consistency problems: a system must determine which policy-relevant facts hold in a prompt-response pair and what those facts imply under a given policy. Common approaches, including policy prompting and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, often overlap the tasks of semantic grounding and policy reasoning: the model both interprets the prompt-response pair and reasons about whether a policy has been violated. This can lead to unsafe compliance with harmful prompts, or refusals to assist benign ones. To separate grounding and reasoning roles, we propose PL-Guard, a neurosymbolic guardrail architecture. Using a symbolic policy interface consisting of predicates and ProbLog rules, a local LLM grounds prompt-response pairs into predicate probabilities using renormalized True/False token scores, while ProbLog performs explicit probabilistic rule inference over the symbolic policy. On the XSTest benchmark, an offline Qwen-based evaluator finds that PL-Guard with a hand-curated policy reduces unsafe compliance from 22.0% for the base model to 0.5%, and below the 6.0% rate of an LLM-as-a-judge baseline. This comes at the cost of higher over-refusal than the LLM-as-a-judge baseline, 14.4% versus 5.2%. These results suggest that separating neural grounding from probabilistic symbolic reasoning can expose the safety-helpfulness tradeoff while making the guardrail's intermediate reasoning steps explicit and auditable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PL-Guard，一种神经符号护栏架构，通过将LLM的语义锚定与ProbLog的概率符号推理分离，解决大语言模型安全护栏中的政策一致性问题，在XSTest基准上显著降低不安全合规率，代价是更高的过度拒绝率。
AI.motivation: 现有护栏方法（如政策提示和LLM-as-a-judge流水线）将语义锚定和政策推理两个任务混在一起，导致模型可能不安全地顺从有害提示，或拒绝有益提示。作者希望分离这两个角色以改善护栏性能。
AI.method: PL-Guard使用符号政策接口（包括谓词和ProbLog规则），本地LLM通过重归一化的True/False token分数将提示-响应对锚定为谓词概率，然后ProbLog在符号政策上执行显式概率规则推理。
AI.result: 在XSTest基准上，PL-Guard将不安全合规率从基础模型的22.0%降至0.5%，低于LLM-as-a-judge基线的6.0%；但过度拒绝率更高，为14.4%（基线为5.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 分离神经锚定与概率符号推理可以揭示安全-有用性权衡，同时使护栏的中间推理步骤显式和可审计。

title: EcoVLA: Energy-Efficient Device-Edge Co-Inference for Vision-Language-Action Models under Real-Time Constraints
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising foundation for Embodied AI, but their high inference cost poses significant challenges for deployment in robotic systems. In practice, on-device inference is constrained by limited compute capacity and energy budgets, struggling to simultaneously satisfy real-time control and energy efficiency requirements. Alternatively, offloading the inference workload to an edge server is susceptible to fluctuations in system conditions, introducing unpredictable latency risks. Device-edge co-inference offers a promising solution, but systematic research tailored to VLA models remains scarce, particularly a unified co-inference framework that jointly addresses real-time constraints and system-level energy efficiency. Thus, we propose EcoVLA, an adaptive device-edge co-inference framework for VLA models that maximizes system energy efficiency under real-time constraints. EcoVLA first introduces a unified stage-level abstraction over different VLA paradigms, establishing an architecture-agnostic co-inference design space. It then formulates a joint device-edge-network latency and energy prediction model to enable rapid runtime evaluation of candidate co-inference schemes. Building on this, EcoVLA continuously selects the energy-optimal scheme satisfying real-time constraints with millisecond-level overhead, adapting to runtime variations in network and system states. Furthermore, EcoVLA incorporates a lightweight transmission mechanism for inter-stage intermediate tensors to reduce the communication overhead incurred by cross-device collaboration. Experimental results across VLA models show that EcoVLA improves system energy efficiency by up to 236% over existing co-inference approaches under a 20 Hz action output frequency constraint, while consistently maintaining SLO satisfaction under dynamic network and edge workload conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EcoVLA，一个自适应的设备-边缘协同推理框架，用于VLA（Vision-Language-Action）模型，在实时约束下最大化系统能效。该框架通过统一的阶段级抽象建立架构无关的协同推理设计空间，构建联合设备-边缘-网络延迟与能耗预测模型，并持续选择满足实时约束的能效最优方案，同时引入轻量级中间张量传输机制降低通信开销。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在具身智能中具有巨大潜力，但其高推理成本给机器人系统部署带来挑战。设备端推理受限于计算能力和能耗预算，难以同时满足实时控制和能效要求；边缘服务器卸载又受系统条件波动影响，引入不可预测的延迟风险。设备-边缘协同推理是解决方案，但针对VLA模型的系统性研究匮乏，缺乏统一的协同推理框架来同时解决实时约束和系统级能效问题。
AI.method: EcoVLA包含三个核心组件：(1) 统一的阶段级抽象，覆盖不同VLA范式，建立架构无关的协同推理设计空间；(2) 联合设备-边缘-网络延迟与能耗预测模型，支持候选协同方案的快速运行时评估；(3) 自适应方案选择机制，以毫秒级开销持续选择满足实时约束的能效最优方案，并适配网络和系统状态的动态变化。此外，引入轻量级中间张量传输机制以降低跨设备协作的通信开销。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在20 Hz动作输出频率约束下，EcoVLA相比现有协同推理方法将系统能效提升高达236%，并在动态网络和边缘工作负载条件下持续满足SLO（服务水平目标）要求。
AI.conclusion: EcoVLA证明了通过架构无关的协同推理设计空间、准确的延迟能耗预测以及自适应方案选择，设备-边缘协同推理可以有效解决VLA模型部署中的实时性与能效双重挑战，为具身智能系统的边缘推理提供了可行方案。

title: What You Ask is What You Ground: Bridging Question Intent to Temporal Evidence for Grounded VideoQA
comment: Accepted at ECCV2026. Code: https://github.com/jinhseo/GroundFormer. Project page: https://jinhseo.github.io/groundformer/groundformer.html
summary: We study a critical yet overlooked failure mode in Grounded Video Question Answering: question-invariant grounding, where models predict nearly identical temporal segments for different questions about the same video. We trace this behavior to two structural limitations in prior common designs: (i) modality isolation that fixes video representations before they receive question semantics, and (ii) weak question injection inside the grounding module. To address this, we propose GroundFormer, which conditions video features on question intent before localization via learnable communication tokens that mediate directed visuo-lingual interaction. On top of the question-conditioned features, a factorized MIL cross-attention couples answer selection with temporal evidence under candidate-level supervision, while Gaussian smoothing converts peaked attention into temporally coherent segments. We further introduce a hierarchical multi-modal contrastive loss that aligns video, question, and answer embeddings across a two-pass training pipeline. GroundFormer achieves state-of-the-art grounded VideoQA performance on NExT-GQA and STAR, substantially improving question-discriminative temporal grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Grounded VideoQA中一个被忽视的失败模式：问题不变式grounding（不同问题预测几乎相同的时间段），并提出GroundFormer框架，通过可学习的通信token在定位前将问题语义注入视频特征，结合分解MIL交叉注意力、高斯平滑和层级多模态对比损失，在NExT-GQA和STAR上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Grounded VideoQA模型存在一个关键缺陷：对于同一视频的不同问题，模型会预测几乎相同的时间段（问题不变式grounding）。作者将这一行为归因于两个结构性限制：(i)模态隔离——视频表示在接收问题语义之前就被固定了；(ii)grounding模块内部的问题注入过于薄弱。
AI.method: 提出GroundFormer，核心设计包括：(1)通过可学习的通信token在定位之前将视频特征条件化于问题意图，实现有向的视觉-语言交互；(2)在问题条件化特征之上，采用分解的MIL交叉注意力，在候选级监督下将答案选择与时间证据耦合；(3)高斯平滑将峰值注意力转化为时间上连贯的片段；(4)引入层级多模态对比损失，在两步训练流程中对齐视频、问题和答案嵌入。
AI.result: GroundFormer在NExT-GQA和STAR基准上取得了SOTA的Grounded VideoQA性能，显著提升了问题判别性的时间grounding能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过在定位前实现问题条件化的视频特征表示，并配合多层次的训练监督，可以有效克服问题不变式grounding的失败模式，为Grounded VideoQA提供了新的解决方案。

title: Learning Auditable Classifier Models: Source-Disjoint Tree Ensembles
summary: Predictive models in clinical and regulated settings must be accurate and fully auditable. Tree ensembles deliver strong accuracy on tabular data, but their sequential boosting couples structure discovery with coefficient estimation, making compact per-prediction auditing difficult. Interpretable alternatives impose structural constraints that limit expressiveness: generalized additive models typically restrict interactions to pairwise terms and post-hoc rule extractors produce overlapping rules that hinder compact interpretation. We introduce Residual Pattern Tree Ensemble (RPTE), a three-stage learning approach, that is built on three key principles: bounded feature budget, source disjointness, and separate coefficient estimation. Stage~1 builds a supervised symbolic feature vocabulary. Stage~2 grows shallow trees under a source-disjointness constraint, where each raw variable is allocated to at most one tree, and retains only the discovered tree structures. Stage~3 solves a single $\ell_1$-regularized logistic regression over leaf-region indicators, yielding jointly optimal sparse coefficients. This learning approach ensures that every prediction decomposes into an algebraic sum of named, non-overlapping rule contributions, enabling full auditability by design. Empirical evaluation on twelve clinical-domain binary classification benchmarks using repeated stratified 5-fold cross-validation shows that RPTE performs competitively against tuned opaque ensembles and interpretable baselines. RPTE reduces model inspection units by 9$\times$ to 87$\times$ relative to XGBoost and maintains lower audit complexity than EBM on all 12 datasets. RuleFit requires comparable or fewer inspection units on three datasets where its rule count is small, but without source-disjointness guarantees. The source code is available at \href{https://github.com/srikumar2050/hugiml-core}{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RPTE（残差模式树集成），一个三阶段可审计的机器学习方法，通过有界特征预算、源不相交和独立系数估计三个原则，使每个预测可分解为命名、非重叠规则的代数求和，实现完全可审计性。在12个临床二分类基准上表现与黑盒集成和可解释基线相当，模型检查单元比XGBoost减少9-87倍，审计复杂度低于EBM。
AI.motivation: 临床和监管场景需要既准确又完全可审计的预测模型。树集成虽在表格数据上准确，但顺序提升将结构发现与系数估计耦合，难以进行紧凑的逐预测审计。可解释替代方案（如GAM限于成对交互、后验规则提取器产生重叠规则）在表达力或紧凑性上受限。
AI.method: RPTE采用三阶段学习：(1) 构建有监督符号特征词表；(2) 在源不相交约束下生长浅层树（每个原始变量最多分配到一个树），仅保留发现的树结构；(3) 对叶区域指示器求解单一L1正则化逻辑回归，获得联合最优稀疏系数。确保每个预测可分解为命名、非重叠规则贡献的代数求和。
AI.result: 在12个临床二分类基准上使用重复分层5折交叉验证，RPTE与调优的黑盒集成和可解释基线表现相当。模型检查单元比XGBoost减少9-87倍，在全部12个数据集上审计复杂度低于EBM。RuleFit在三个数据集上检查单元更少但不具备源不相交保证。
AI.conclusion: RPTE通过解耦结构发现与系数估计，在保持竞争性预测性能的同时实现了设计层面的完全可审计性，为临床和监管场景提供了兼具准确性与可解释性的模型方案。

title: Who Leads Now? Token-Level Modality Arbitration for Chart-to-Code Generation
summary: Chart-to-code generation requires a model to read the fine-grained visual details of a chart and write executable code that reproduces it.
