Existing chart-to-code methods either train visual and coding abilities separately, or fine-tune on chart-to-code data with the two abilities entangled. Neither strategy accounts for the distinct nature of the two abilities or the interference that arises when they are optimized together. We propose MoCA (Mixture of Cross-modal Arbitration), which separates the two abilities rather than blending them. MoCA is built on Cross-modal Arbitration Block (CAB), which maintains a visual branch and a code branch as two distinct pathways, and a lightweight arbiter that arbitrates their relative contributions at every layer and generated token. We train MoCA in two stages: a supervised warm-up on self-distilled reasoning trajectories that decomposes visual understanding into explicit steps, followed by reinforcement learning with rewards on both the reasoning process and the final code. Analysis shows that the arbiter learns structured rather than arbitrary allocations, with expert contributions varying systematically across tokens, layers, and instances. Across three benchmarks, MoCA delivers competitive performance against general-domain and chart-specialized models. Ablation results show that the gains cannot be attributed to a larger model size alone, but instead arise from the joint contributions of complementary visual and code branch initialization and input-conditioned arbitration through CAB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoCA（Mixture of Cross-modal Arbitration），一种新的图表到代码生成方法。与现有方法将视觉和编码能力混合或分别训练不同，MoCA通过交叉模态仲裁块（CAB）将两种能力分离为独立的视觉分支和代码分支，并由轻量级仲裁器在每个层级和生成的token上动态分配它们各自的贡献。训练采用两阶段策略：基于自蒸馏推理轨迹的监督预热，以及结合推理过程和最终代码奖励的强化学习。实验表明仲裁器学习到的是结构化而非任意的分配模式，在三个基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图表到代码生成方法存在两个问题：一是分别训练视觉和编码能力，忽略了二者在生成过程中的协同需求；二是在图表到代码数据上联合微调，导致两种能力纠缠在一起，优化时相互干扰。这两种策略都没有考虑到两种能力本质上的差异性，需要一种能够分离并动态协调这两种能力的方法。
AI.method: MoCA基于交叉模态仲裁块（CAB）构建：维护视觉分支和代码分支作为两条独立通路，并通过轻量级仲裁器在每个层和每个生成的token上仲裁它们各自的贡献。训练分为两个阶段：首先在自蒸馏推理轨迹上进行监督预热，将视觉理解分解为显式步骤；随后使用强化学习，同时奖励推理过程和最终代码的正确性。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上与通用领域模型和图表专用模型相比，MoCA取得了有竞争力的性能。消融实验表明性能提升不能仅归因于更大的模型规模，而是来源于视觉分支和代码分支互补初始化的联合贡献以及通过CAB实现的输入条件化仲裁。分析显示仲裁器学习到的是结构化分配而非任意分配，专家贡献随token、层和实例系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: MoCA通过显式分离视觉理解和代码生成两种能力，并用仲裁机制动态协调二者，有效解决了图表到代码生成中多能力协同训练的干扰问题，为该任务提供了一种新的范式。

title: Beyond Single Object: Learning 3D Relations with Large Language Models
summary: We address a fundamental gap in 3D-LLMs: existing models focus on single-object/scene description, struggling with detailed, inter-object comparison. We propose a framework for detailed object-level reasoning across multiple objects with three components: (1) MO3D (Multi-Object in 3D), an instruction dataset requiring fine-grained multi-object comparison; (2) Multi-3DLLM, using a minimal Patch-Interaction Transformer (PIT) that models inter-/intra-object relationships while preserving local geometry; (3) Mini-apps, two application-driven benchmarks (Shape Mating, Change Captioning) that probe geometric understanding for practical use. Recent 3D-LLMs and 2D-VLMs perform poorly on these tasks, lacking both comparison-centric design and geometric awareness. In contrast, Multi-3DLLM trained on our mixture data learns geometric reasoning, surpasses all baselines on MO3D, and provides positive transfer to single-object classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向多物体3D推理的框架，包含MO3D指令数据集、Multi-3DLLM模型（采用Patch-Interaction Transformer建模物体间/物体内关系）以及两个应用驱动基准（Shape Mating和Change Captioning），填补了3D-LLM在细粒度物体间对比推理方面的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-LLM主要聚焦于单物体/单场景描述，无法处理需要细粒度的多物体间对比和关系推理任务，这是一个根本性的能力缺口。
AI.method: 提出三部分框架：(1) MO3D指令数据集，需要细粒度多物体对比；(2) Multi-3DLLM，采用极简的Patch-Interaction Transformer (PIT)同时建模物体间与物体内关系并保持局部几何信息；(3) Mini-apps，包含Shape Mating和Change Captioning两个应用导向的基准测试。
AI.result: 现有3D-LLM和2D-VLM在这些任务上表现不佳，缺乏对比中心设计和几何感知能力。Multi-3DLLM在MO3D上超越所有基线，并对单物体分类任务产生正向迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过混合数据训练的Multi-3DLLM能够学习几何推理能力，不仅在多物体对比任务上表现优异，还能正向迁移到单物体任务，验证了多物体对比训练的价值。

title: FirstDiff: One-Step Diffusion-Based Anomaly Detection for Multivariate Time Series via Initial Noise Prediction
summary:
Diffusion models have recently shown strong potential for multivariate time-series anomaly detection by learning the distribution of normal data through iterative denoising. Existing diffusion-based approaches, however, typically perform anomaly detection after completing the reverse diffusion process, relying primarily on the final reconstructed signal and overlooking informative representations produced during denoising. This design incurs substantial computational cost and limits the use of intermediate diffusion information for anomaly detection.
  In this paper, we propose FirstDiff, a diffusion-based anomaly detection framework based on the observation that the predicted diffusion noise at the initial reverse-diffusion evaluation already contains sufficient information for accurate anomaly detection. FirstDiff models the statistical distribution of predicted diffusion noise under normal behavior using validation data, enabling anomaly inference from a single denoising-network evaluation rather than completing the reverse diffusion trajectory.
  To model complex temporal and inter-sensor dependencies, FirstDiff employs a Diffusion Transformer as the denoising backbone. Extensive experiments on five public benchmark datasets demonstrate that FirstDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing diffusion inference from the full reverse trajectory to a single denoising-network evaluation.

AI.tldr: FirstDiff提出了一种基于扩散模型的多变量时间序列异常检测框架，核心观察是扩散模型在逆向扩散过程初始阶段的预测噪声就已包含足够的异常检测信息，因此只需单次去噪网络评估即可完成异常检测，无需完整执行逆向扩散轨迹，大幅降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的异常检测方法通常需要完成完整的逆向扩散过程，仅依赖最终重建信号进行异常判断，忽视了去噪过程中产生的中间表征，导致计算成本高昂且信息利用不充分。
AI.method: FirstDiff基于"初始逆向扩散评估时的预测噪声已包含足够异常检测信息"这一观察，利用验证数据建模正常行为下预测扩散噪声的统计分布，从而仅需单次去噪网络评估即可推断异常；同时采用Diffusion Transformer作为去噪骨干网络，以建模复杂的时间依赖和传感器间依赖关系。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FirstDiff实现了最先进的性能，同时将扩散推断从完整的逆向轨迹缩减为单次去噪网络评估。
AI.conclusion: FirstDiff证明了扩散模型中间信息（特别是初始预测噪声）的高效利用价值，在保持甚至提升异常检测性能的同时显著降低了计算开销，为基于扩散模型的时间序列异常检测提供了更高效的范式。

title: From Contexts to Values: Context-Dependent Defeat in Abstract Argumentation
comment: Accepted to SAFA workshop at COMMA 2026
summary: In value-based argumentation, an audience's ordering of values decides which attacks succeed as defeats. In many settings the deciding factor is not the audience but the circumstances: the same attack may succeed at one procedural stage, or under one regulation, and fail at another. Context-dependent argumentation frameworks (CDAFs), a model we recently introduced, capture this directly: one set of arguments, one attack relation, and a defeat function that switches each attack on or off per context, so every context induces an ordinary Dung framework. This raises a reduction question: is context genuinely new, or can one value assignment with per-context orderings reproduce the defeat function, collapsing the CDAF into a VAF? We present a polynomial-time decision procedure for this question and map the harder neighbouring problems, with upper bounds from NP to $Σ^p_3$. We also present a validated reference implementation and a measurement: representability is rare and falls fast with the number of contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究情境依赖论证框架（CDAFs）能否被价值论证框架（VAFs）所替代的约简问题，提出了多项式时间判定算法，并给出从NP到Σ^p_3的复杂性上界，同时通过参考实现验证了可表示性在实践中很罕见且随情境数量快速下降。
AI.motivation: 在价值论证中，受众的价值排序决定攻击是否成功；然而在许多实际场景中，起决定作用的是情境（如程序阶段、法规）而非受众。作者此前提出了CDAF模型来直接捕捉这一现象，但需要回答一个根本问题：情境机制是否真正新颖，还是可以被VAF中按情境调整的价值排序所模拟？
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为：是否存在一个价值分配及每情境的价值排序，使得VAF产生的击败函数与CDAF的击败函数一致。针对该可表示性判定问题，作者设计了一个多项式时间的决策过程，并对相邻的更困难变形问题进行了复杂性映射，给出从NP到Σ^p_3的上界。同时实现了参考代码并进行了实验测量。
AI.result: 提供了可表示性问题的多项式时间判定算法；刻画了相邻难题的复杂性（NP至Σ^p_3上界）；通过验证的参考实现和实验测量发现，CDAF可被VAF表示的情况很罕见，且可表示性的比例随情境数量增加而迅速下降。
AI.conclusion: 情境机制相对于价值排序是真正新颖的：在绝大多数情况下，CDAF无法被VAF约简，因此CDAF作为独立模型具有理论价值。该判定程序为实际应用中鉴别CDAF是否可简化提供了有效工具。

title: YOLO26-RD: An End-to-End Road Damage Detection Network With Learnable Contrast Enhancement and Edge-Guided Downsampling
summary: Automated pavement-distress detection is commonly framed as a small-object problem, motivating high-resolution P2/4 detection heads and lossless downsampling. We present YOLO26-RD, an end-to-end (NMS-free) detector built on YOLO26 with two lightweight novel modules (LearnableContrast, a 494-parameter differentiable analogue of CLAHE that adapts contrast per tile inside the network, and EdgeSPD, a Sobel-gated space-to-depth downsampler adding only 2 parameters over SPD-Conv), and we subject the design to a data-first audit on a 7,618-image road-survey dataset (alligator crack, linear crack, patching). The audit falsifies the small-object premise: 92% of instances are COCO-large, and linear cracks are extreme-aspect structures (median 10:1) whose difficulty is sensitivity, not localization. Guided by this analysis, we remove the P2 detection level while retaining P2 features in the fusion path, which improves mAP50 by 2.8 points over the full YOLO26-RD model and reduces epoch time by 8%. Trained from scratch at 640x640, our best screening configuration reaches 0.787 mAP50 on the validation split versus a 0.771 project baseline (a stock YOLO26-s of uncontrolled recipe), with the largest per-class gain on the rarest class (patching, 2.6 points over baseline; 9.4 over the unmodified YOLO26-RD control under an identical recipe). A failure-mode decomposition further attributes the residual error of the bottleneck class (crack, approximately 0.74 across all architectures tested) to train/validation distribution shift on crack orientation and length, sub-pixel crack width at 640x640, and label incompleteness, factors no architecture change can address. We argue that for pavement imagery, measurement-driven subtraction outperforms module accretion, and we release our audit protocol alongside the model.

AI.tldr: YOLO26-RD是一个基于YOLO26的无NMS端到端路面病害检测器，引入两个轻量级模块（LearnableContrast和EdgeSPD）。通过对7,618张道路图像的数据优先审计，论文否定了"小目标"前提（92%实例为COCO-large），基于此移除P2检测层但保留P2特征融合，mAP50提升2.8点并节省8%训练时间。最佳配置达到0.787 mAP50，并通过失败模式分解将瓶颈类误差归因于分布偏移、亚像素宽度和标签不完整等架构不可解因素。
AI.motivation: 路面病害检测通常被框架为小目标问题，促使研究者采用高分辨率P2/4检测头和无损下采样。作者质疑这一前提，主张通过数据优先的审计来验证设计假设，并强调"测量驱动的减法优于模块堆砌"（measurement-driven subtraction outperforms module accretion）。
AI.method: 在YOLO26基础上构建无NMS的端到端检测器YOLO26-RD，引入两个轻量级模块：LearnableContrast（494参数的可微分CLAHE类比模块，在网络内逐tile自适应对比度）和EdgeSPD（Sobel门控的space-to-depth下采样器，仅比SPD-Conv多2个参数）。在7,618图像数据集上进行数据优先审计，基于审计结论移除P2检测层而保留P2特征于融合路径中，并从零开始以640x640训练。
AI.result: 审计显示92%实例为COCO-large，线性裂缝为极端长宽比结构（中位数10:1），其难点是灵敏度而非定位。移除P2检测层使mAP50提升2.8点（相对完整YOLO26-RD），epoch时间减少8%。最佳筛选配置在验证集达0.787 mAP50，优于0.771项目基线，最稀有类别patching提升最大（较基线+2.6点，较未修改的YOLO26-RD对照+9.4点）。
AI.conclusion: 瓶颈类（crack，约0.74）的残留误差归因于训练/验证分布的裂缝方向和长度偏移、640x640下裂缝宽度为亚像素级别、以及标签不完整——这些因素任何架构改动都无法解决。作者主张路面图像领域应使用测量驱动的减法而非模块堆砌，并发布审计协议和模型。

title: TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity
comment: 38 pages, 6 figures, 17 tables. Code and weights: https://github.com/raws-labs/tinycast
summary: We introduce TinyCast, an attention-free zero-shot forecaster that emits a predictive distribution from 146,505 parameters, on the premise that at this size the periodic structure of a context is worth computing rather than learning. A zero-parameter spectral detector supplies the dominant periods, the context is folded on their phase, and a dilated convolutional encoder and a block-autoregressive quantile decoder model the rest. It is smaller than every zero-shot entry on the GIFT-Eval board whose parameter count can be established. On probabilistic accuracy it defines the size-accuracy frontier. Among zero-shot entries declaring no test-data leakage it is the only one below 1.4M parameters that emits a predictive distribution, and every entry scoring better carries at least that budget. On Chronos-ZS and fev-bench every neural model ahead of it carries at least 28 times its parameters. Because the mixing path is convolutions and matrix multiplications only, it exports to static INT8 and forecasts end to end on an embedded device without per-signal fitting.

AI.tldr: TinyCast是一个仅含146,505参数的免注意力零样本预测器，利用零参数频谱检测器识别主导周期并用卷积编码器和分块自回归分位数解码器生成预测分布，在GIFT-Eval等基准上以极小参数量定义了大小-精度前沿。
AI.motivation: 在极小的模型规模下，时间序列的周期性结构值得直接计算而非通过学习获得，从而可以在保持零样本预测能力的同时大幅降低参数量，使模型能够在资源受限的嵌入式设备上运行。
AI.method: 采用零参数频谱检测器提取主导周期，将上下文按相位折叠，使用膨胀卷积编码器和分块自回归分位数解码器建模残差部分。整个模型仅使用卷积和矩阵乘法运算，可导出为静态INT8格式。
AI.result: TinyCast是GIFT-Eval榜单上参数最少的零样本模型，在概率精度上定义了大小-精度前沿。在不泄露测试数据的零样本模型中，它是唯一低于1.4M参数却能输出预测分布的模型；在Chronos-ZS和fev-bench上，超越它的神经模型参数量都至少是其28倍。
AI.conclusion: 极小规模模型通过显式计算周期性结构可以实现与大规模模型竞争的概率预测精度，且无需逐信号拟合即可在嵌入式设备上端到端部署，展示了"计算优于学习"这一设计理念在小规模时间序列预测中的可行性。

title: Anatomical and Physical Supervision for CT-less PET Attenuation Correction: BIC-MAC 2026 Challenge
comment: 6 pages, 1 table. Technical report for the BIC-MAC 2026 Challenge
summary: This report describes our submission to the Big Cross-Modal Attenuation Correction (BIC-MAC) 2026 Challenge for CT-less PET attenuation correction through multimodal pseudo-CT synthesis. We build upon a standard nnU-Net architecture and combine anatomical and physical supervision to improve both pseudo-CT quality and downstream PET reconstruction. Anatomical supervision is introduced through a frozen TotalSegmentator feature extractor, anatomy-guided structural constraints and patch sampling, while physical supervision is achieved using a differentiable attenuation correction factor projection loss based on multi-angle attenuation projections. Furthermore, the network is initialized with pretrained weights obtained from training on the SynthRAD Challenge MR-to-CT dataset. Minimal architectural modifications are applied, while performance improvements are pursued across the nnU-Net pipeline, including preprocessing, plans, and supervision design, among other components. Our final submission demonstrates the effectiveness of combining anatomical supervision, attenuation physics, and efficient nnU-Net scaling for CT-less PET attenuation correction.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了BIC-MAC 2026挑战赛的提交方案，基于nnU-Net架构，结合解剖监督（TotalSegmentator特征提取器）和物理监督（可微衰减校正因子投影损失），并使用SynthRAD数据集预训练权重，实现CT-free PET衰减校正的伪CT合成。
AI.motivation: CT-less PET衰减校正是临床上重要的挑战，因为PET/CT扫描中CT提供的衰减信息可能缺失或质量受限。作者希望通过结合解剖和物理监督来提升伪CT合成质量及下游PET重建性能，而不对标准nnU-Net架构做大幅修改。
AI.method: 1）基于标准nnU-Net架构，进行最小化架构修改；2）解剖监督：使用冻结的TotalSegmentator特征提取器、解剖引导的结构约束和补丁采样策略；3）物理监督：采用可微的衰减校正因子投影损失（多角度衰减投影）；4）使用SynthRAD Challenge MR-to-CT数据集训练得到的预训练权重初始化网络；5）对nnU-Net流程中的预处理、plans和监督设计等组件进行优化。
AI.result: 最终提交方案展示了结合解剖监督、衰减物理和高效nnU-Net扩展在CT-less PET衰减校正中的有效性，同时提升了伪CT质量和下游PET重建性能。
AI.conclusion: 结合解剖先验知识（TotalSegmentator）和物理约束（衰减投影损失）可以显著提升CT-less PET衰减校正的效果，且这种改进可在保持标准nnU-Net架构的基础上通过流程优化的方式实现。

title: Temporal Graph Prototype-conditioned Conformal Prediction for Fraud Detection
summary: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free coverage guarantees and has emerged as a principled tool for uncertainty quantification. In edge-level fraud detection on temporal interaction graphs, where false positives and false negatives both carry substantial cost, such coverage guarantees are particularly appealing for risk-aware decision making. However, directly applying existing graph conformal predictors yields inefficient prediction sets due to two recurring properties of fraud data. Fraudulent interactions are often embedded in benign-dominated neighborhoods that dilute calibration signals, while extreme class imbalance leaves scarce labeled-fraud support in the calibration split and leads to overly conservative class-conditional thresholds. To address these issues, we propose ProtoCP, a conformal prediction framework for edge-level fraud detection on temporal graphs. ProtoCP improves calibration efficiency by focusing calibration on fraud-relevant subgraph context and producing more stable nonconformity scores under class imbalance and temporal drift. Specifically, it leverages learned prototypes to suppress benign-dominated noise in the calibration context and introduces a neighborhood-relative scoring mechanism with temporal score diffusion for stable class-conditional calibration. Experiments on four fraud benchmarks (YelpChi, S-FFSD, FTFD, and BankSim) show that ProtoCP achieves the target coverage with consistently smaller prediction sets than state-of-the-art baselines. Our codes are available at https://github.com/Picard1701ent/ProtoCP.git

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProtoCP，一种用于时间交互图上边级欺诈检测的共形预测框架，通过聚焦欺诈相关子图上下文、利用学习原型抑制良性主导噪声，并引入邻域相对评分机制和时间分数扩散，解决了传统图共形预测器在欺诈数据上因类别不平衡和邻域噪声导致的预测集效率低下问题。
AI.motivation: 边级欺诈检测中，直接应用现有图共形预测器会产生低效的预测集，原因有二：（1）欺诈交互常嵌入良性主导的邻域中，稀释校准信号；（2）极端类别不平衡导致校准集中标记欺诈样本稀缺，产生过度保守的类别条件阈值。这在误报和漏报都代价高昂的场景中严重影响了风险感知决策的质量。
AI.method: ProtoCP框架包含三个关键组件：（1）利用学习原型（learned prototypes）抑制校准上下文中良性主导的噪声；（2）引入邻域相对评分机制（neighborhood-relative scoring），在类别不平衡和时序漂移下产生更稳定的非一致性分数；（3）采用时间分数扩散（temporal score diffusion）实现稳定的类别条件校准。
AI.result: 在四个欺诈基准数据集（YelpChi、S-FFSD、FTFD和BankSim）上的实验表明，ProtoCP在达到目标覆盖率的同时，预测集显著小于现有最优基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ProtoCP通过针对欺诈数据的特性进行定制化校准设计，有效提升了时间图边级欺诈检测中共形预测的效率，为风险感知的欺诈决策提供了更可靠的覆盖保证。

title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
comment: Code and data are available at \url{https://github.com/junbolian/AdmitOR}
summary: Experience-learning agents for optimization modeling improve by storing verified skills, but existing learners admit knowledge by checking against known answers, which real ticket streams do not provide. The natural label-free alternatives are unreliable: on a 300-problem label-blind stream, admitting every executable model poisons roughly one admission in four, while single-instance agreement accepts models that match at one value but differ elsewhere. We propose AdmitOR, an admission gate built on calibrated external behavioral evidence. Candidates from three model families, prompting strategies, and solver stacks are run on instances resampled from an extracted parameter domain; agreement across the resulting value-function traces is summarized by a cross-family clique, and a calibrated threshold returns accept, abstain, or escalate. The preregistered false-discovery criterion holds on calibration data but not on the wild stream. We report this negative result in full and trace most failures to benchmark texts that do not faithfully encode their labeled instances. Comparing four admission judges on one collection of logs inside a state-of-the-art skill learner, AdmitOR raises admission precision to 0.927, against 0.871 for majority vote and 0.726 for execution success, yielding 3.1x and 8.0x fewer poisoned admissions. Its library is the smallest and attains the highest macro accuracy across five public benchmarks, 58.4 against 54.8 for majority vote and 53.9 for the ground-truth-labeled library. The 3.5-point gain over majority vote is supported by a paired bootstrap and survives correction for a host-side anomaly. To our knowledge, AdmitOR is the first label-free admission mechanism designed around an explicitly calibrated false-discovery target. The transfer failure identifies a necessary condition for extending it to wild streams.

AI.tldr: AdmitOR 是一种基于校准外部行为证据的无标签技能准入机制，用于经验学习代理的优化建模。它通过跨模型族派的种值函数轨迹一致性（交叉族派团）和校准阈值来判定接受、弃权或升级。在预注册的校准数据上满足错误发现标准，但在野生流上失效（负面结果已完整报告）。在技能学习器内部对比中，AdmitOR 将准入精度提升至0.927，比多数投票(0.871)和执行成功(0.726)分别减少3.1倍和8.0倍的毒化准入。
AI.motivation: 现有经验学习代理需要通过已知答案来验证技能，但真实的票据流不提供这种标签。自然无标签替代方案不可靠：在所有可执行模型均被接受时约四分之一准入被毒化；单实例一致性接受可能只在一值匹配但其他处不同的模型。因此亟需一种可靠的无标签准入机制。
AI.method: AdmitOR 从提取的参数域重新采样实例，将来自三个模型家族、提示策略和求解器栈的候选模型运行在这些实例上；用交叉族派团汇总所得种值函数轨迹的一致性，并通过校准阈值输出接受、弃权或升级三元判断。
AI.result: 预注册的错误发现标准在校准数据上成立但在野生流上失败（负面结果已报告，主要归因于基准文本未能忠实编码其标注实例）。在四种准入判定器对比中，AdmitOR 将准入精度提升到0.927，优于多数投票(0.871)和执行成功(0.726)，分别减少3.1倍和8.0倍毒化准入；其技能库最小且宏平均准确率最高（58.4 vs 多数投票54.8 vs 真实标签库53.9），3.5分优势经配对bootstrap和宿主侧异常校正后仍显著。
AI.conclusion: AdmitOR 是首个围绕显式校准错误发现目标设计的无标签准入机制，在受控数据上显著优于现有方法。但其转移失败揭示了一个必要条件：要将该方法扩展到野生流，基准文本必须忠实编码其标注实例，这一发现为未来工作指明了方向。

title: Identifying Confusion Trends in Concept-based XAI for Multi-Label Classification
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) deployed in high-risk domains, such as healthcare and autonomous driving, must be not only accurate but also understandable to ensure user trust. In real-world computer vision tasks, these models often operate on complex images containing background noise and are heavily annotated. To make such models explainable, Concept-based Explainable AI (CXAI) methods need to be assessed for their applicability and problem-solving capacity. In this work, we explore CXAI use cases in multi-label classification by training two DNNs, VGG16 and ResNet50, on the 20 most annotated labels in the MS-COCO dataset (Microsoft Common Objects in Context). We apply two CXAI methods, CRP (Concept Relevance Propagation) and CRAFT (Concept Recursive Activation FacTorization), to generate concept-level explanations and investigate the overall evaluations. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) CXAI highlights learning weaknesses in DNNs, (2) higher concept distinctiveness reduces label and concept confusion, and (3) environmental concepts expose dataset-induced biases. Our results demonstrate the potential of CXAI to enhance the understanding of model generalizability and to diagnose bias instigated by the dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文在MS-COCO数据集上使用VGG16和ResNet50进行多标签分类，应用CRP和CRAFT两种概念级可解释AI方法生成概念级解释，发现三个关键结论：概念级可解释AI能揭示深度神经网络的学习弱点、更高的概念区分度能减少标签和概念混淆、环境概念暴露数据集引发的偏见。
AI.motivation: 高风险领域（如医疗、自动驾驶）中部署的深度神经网络不仅需要准确，还需要可理解性以建立用户信任。真实世界视觉任务常涉及含背景噪声的复杂图像，需要评估概念级可解释AI（CXAI）方法在多标签分类中的适用性和问题解决能力。
AI.method: 在MS-COCO数据集的20个最常用标注标签上训练两个深度神经网络（VGG16和ResNet50）进行多标签分类，并应用两种CXAI方法——CRP（概念相关性传播）和CRAFT（概念递归激活因子分解）——来生成概念级解释并评估其整体表现。
AI.result: 分析揭示了三个关键发现：（1）CXAI能够突出DNN的学习弱点；（2）更高的概念区分度可以降低标签和概念的混淆；（3）环境概念暴露了由数据集引发的偏见。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，CXAI有潜力增强对模型泛化能力的理解，并有助于诊断由数据集引发的偏见。

title: Learning Stock Trading Policies via Barycenter-Based Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Designing effective trading strategies using reinforcement learning remains challenging due to delayed and noisy rewards, poor exploration, and the difficulty of enforcing explicit risk constraints. In this work, we propose BRaG, a barycenter-based adversarial inverse reinforcement learning framework for stock trading that learns trading behavior from multiple heterogeneous expert strategies. BRaG aggregates expert demonstrations using a performance-weighted Wasserstein barycenter, yielding a stable pseudo-expert representation that captures shared structure across diverse trading styles. This representation is used to pretrain a trading policy via adversarial imitation learning, which alleviates unstable exploration during reinforcement learning. The pretrained policy is subsequently refined using reinforcement learning with true market rewards. To ensure risk-aware decision-making, BRaG incorporates control barrier functions that constrain action execution and regularize policy learning to satisfy drawdown limits. We evaluate the proposed approach on four major global equity markets, including the US, UK, Indian, and Taiwanese indices. Across all the markets, the proposed approach achieves stronger performance than both classical trading rules and recent deep reinforcement learning methods, while exhibiting more stable risk characteristics.

AI.tldr: 提出BRaG框架，一种基于重心（barycenter）的对抗逆强化学习方法，用于股票交易策略学习。它通过性能加权的Wasserstein重心聚合多个异构专家策略，形成稳定的伪专家表示来预训练交易策略，再通过强化学习精调，并引入控制屏障函数确保风险约束。
AI.motivation: 强化学习设计交易策略面临三大挑战：奖励延迟且噪声大、探索效率低、难以实施显式风险约束。现有方法难以从多样化的专家策略中有效学习，且缺乏稳定的预训练机制来缓解强化学习的不稳定探索问题。
AI.method: 1) 使用性能加权的Wasserstein重心聚合多个异构专家演示，生成稳定的伪专家表示；2) 通过对抗模仿学习（adversarial imitation learning）预训练交易策略；3) 使用真实市场奖励进行强化学习精调；4) 引入控制屏障函数（CBF）约束动作执行，并正则化策略学习以满足回撤限制。
AI.result: 在四大全球股票市场（美国、英国、印度、台湾）指数上评估，BRaG在性能上优于经典交易规则和近期深度强化学习方法，同时展现出更稳定的风险特征。
AI.conclusion: BRaG通过重心化聚合多个专家策略、预训练+精调的两阶段学习范式，以及控制屏障函数的风险约束，有效解决了强化学习交易中的关键难题，在多个市场中取得了更优且更稳健的表现。

title: From Generalist to Specialist: A Context-Fusion Framework for Endoscopic Polyp Reporting with a Frozen VLM
summary: Reliable endoscopic polyp reporting requires integrating quantitative lesion sizing, standardized Paris classification, and clinically meaningful morphological description within a single record. General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) offer a unified interface for image understanding and report generation. Existing specialization strategies, however, typically rely on task-specific models or model-weight adaptation, leaving unresolved how to introduce reliable specialist knowledge while preserving both this unified interface and the VLM's pretrained capabilities. We introduce a context-fusion framework that specializes a frozen general-purpose VLM through both implicit instruction context and explicit transduction context without modifying its pretrained weights. Specifically, a self-supervised polyp encoder retrieves related image-report pairs as explicit, query-specific evidence, while learned continuous specialist tokens provide implicit instruction context shared across cases. Experiments were conducted on 2,056 expert-annotated public endoscopic images. We compared the framework with general-purpose VLMs, task-specific predictors, and weight-adaptation methods to assess specialist performance, unified reporting, and adaptation efficiency. Across numerical, categorical, and report-generation metrics, the proposed framework substantially improved direct frozen-VLM inference and achieved the strongest overall performance among the evaluated methods. It added trainable parameters equal to only 0.006% of the frozen VLM's parameter count. When the top-1 retrieved case carried the correct target category, our framework corrected 70.5% of the errors made by a weight-adaptation baseline. These findings support the context-fusion framework as a lightweight and effective strategy for specialist adaptation of a frozen VLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种上下文融合框架，通过隐式指令上下文（可学习的专业连续标记）和显式转导上下文（自监督息肉编码器检索的图文对）来特化冻结的通用视觉语言模型（VLM），无需修改预训练权重即可实现专业化的内镜息肉报告生成。
AI.motivation: 可靠的内镜息肉报告需要整合定量病灶测量、标准化巴黎分类和临床形态描述。通用VLM提供统一接口，但现有特化策略依赖任务特定模型或权重适配，难以在保持统一接口和预训练能力的同时引入专业领域知识。
AI.method: 提出上下文融合框架：1）自监督息肉编码器检索相关图文对作为显式的查询特定证据；2）可学习的连续专业标记提供跨病例共享的隐式指令上下文。整个过程不修改冻结VLM的预训练权重。
AI.result: 在2,056张专家标注的公开内镜图像上，该框架在数值、分类和报告生成指标上均显著优于直接冻结VLM推理，整体性能最强。新增可训练参数仅为冻结VLM参数量的0.006%。在检索到正确目标类别时，可纠正70.5%的权重适配基线错误。
AI.conclusion: 上下文融合框架是一种轻量且有效的冻结VLM专业特化策略，能够在不牺牲统一接口和预训练能力的前提下实现可靠的内镜息肉报告生成。

title: ES3D: Embedding Semantics into 3D Space for Component-Aware Editing
summary:
Existing 3D editing methods have made notable progress in controllability, yet they remain limited in several important ways. Most approaches rely on text-driven editing, which struggles to express fine-grained visual changes intended by the user. Moreover, many methods require manually supplied 3D masks or introduce unintended changes to regions that should remain untouched. These limitations largely arise from the absence of fine-grained semantic understanding, making it difficult for existing models to retrieve or modify specific 3D components.
  We introduce ES3D, a framework that embeds semantics directly into 3D space, enabling component-aware retrieval and editing of a 3D asset conditioned on multiple local reference images and optional text queries. We first construct a 3D semantic embedding by projecting multi-view semantic features into the voxelized space of the asset. We then perform 3D component retrieval by computing feature similarity between the 3D semantic embedding and the semantic embeddings of image or text queries. For editing, we employ a pretrained 3D generative model with an inpainting mechanism to modify the retrieved components guided by user-provided images while preserving the rest of the asset. Overall, ES3D is a 3D editing framework that retrieves editable regions based on semantic cues and uses multiple images as conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ES3D produces geometrically consistent and semantically coherent edits, enabling robust image-based and text-assisted control for 3D editing.

AI.tldr: ES3D是一个将语义直接嵌入3D空间的编辑框架，通过多视角语义特征投影到体素空间构建3D语义嵌入，实现基于多个局部参考图像和文本查询的组件感知检索与编辑，利用预训练3D生成模型和inpainting机制进行编辑，在保持几何一致性和语义连贯性的同时实现精确的组件级3D编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有3D编辑方法主要依赖文本驱动，难以表达用户细粒度的视觉变化意图；同时许多方法需要手动提供3D掩码，或会对不应修改的区域产生意外改变。这些局限的根源在于缺乏细粒度的语义理解，导致模型难以检索或修改特定的3D组件。
AI.method: ES3D框架包含两个关键步骤：(1) 通过将多视角语义特征投影到资产的体素化空间构建3D语义嵌入；(2) 通过计算3D语义嵌入与图像或文本查询的语义嵌入之间的特征相似度进行3D组件检索。编辑阶段使用预训练3D生成模型结合inpainting机制，在保留资产其余部分的同时修改检索到的组件。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ES3D能产生几何一致且语义连贯的编辑结果，实现了鲁棒的基于图像和文本辅助的3D编辑控制。
AI.conclusion: ES3D是首个基于语义线索检索可编辑区域并结合多图像条件进行3D编辑的框架，克服了文本驱动编辑在细粒度表达上的局限，并避免了手动掩码的需求和意外区域修改的问题。

title: Routing Divergence Is Not Evidence of Behavioral Influence in Same-Weight MoE Self-Distillation
summary: Two Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) forward passes can share every weight yet route the same token through different experts. This creates a possible blind spot in same-weight self-distillation, where a demonstration-conditioned teacher supervises a query-only student. We study this mismatch in its single-step form, with frozen weights rather than as a proxy for a full training trajectory. An exact blockwise decomposition separates a routing term, which changes gates at fixed content, from a dense-like content term. Across seven open-weight checkpoints and two domains, the routing term spans only $1.6\times$ as a fraction of block output, while its residual-stream exposure spans $3.2\times$. Exposure is ordered by the routed block's share of the residual. Scaling the always-on backbone in two confirmatory models moves exposure monotonically; common-mode controls support a mass-and-coherence mechanism rather than denominator dilution alone. Preregistered PubMedQA patches on three models show that the full routing term moves outputs by less than half the natural context effect and is largely reproduced by matched-norm noise, whereas the content term is strongly direction-specific. Scale and merged-expert probes show that the narrow block-level range is not universal, although exposure remains small at the tested boundaries. Router movement alone is therefore not evidence of behavioral influence: measure exposure first, and use a behavioral intervention when the decision matters.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨混合专家（MoE）模型在前向传播中，相同权重下不同路由选择的影响。通过精确的分块分解，将路由项（固定内容改变门控）与类稠密内容项分离，发现路由项在块输出中仅占1.6倍，而在残差流中占3.2倍。研究表明路由移动本身不能作为行为影响的证据，应先测量暴露度，再做行为干预。
AI.motivation: 在MoE模型的同权重自蒸馏中，教师和学生模型虽然共享权重，但同一token可能被路由到不同的专家，造成同权重自蒸馏的盲区。作者希望通过单步形式（冻结权重）研究这种不匹配，澄清路由差异是否真正影响模型行为，而非作为完整训练轨迹的代理。
AI.method: 采用精确的逐块分解方法，将路由变化（在固定内容下改变门控）与类稠密内容项分离。在七个开源检查点和两个领域上进行分析，并通过扩大常开骨干网络、共模对照、预注册PubMedQA补丁测试、缩放与合并专家探针等实验进行验证。
AI.result: 路由项在块输出中仅跨越1.6倍，在残差流中跨越3.2倍，且暴露度由路由块在残差中的占比决定。扩大骨干网络使暴露度单调变化，共模对照支持"质量与一致性"机制。PubMedQA测试显示完整路由项的移动不到自然上下文效应的一半，且主要由匹配范数的噪声复现，而内容项具有强烈的方向特异性。在测试边界上，块级范围的狭窄性并非普遍适用，但暴露度仍然很小。
AI.conclusion: 路由（router）移动本身不能作为行为影响的证据。研究者应先测量暴露度（exposure），当决策重要时使用行为干预方法。这一结论对于理解MoE模型的自蒸馏、知识蒸馏和模型行为分析具有重要指导意义。

title: Agent Gym: A Framework for Continuous Evaluation and Evolution of LLM Agents Through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents deployed in production environments face a fundamental tension: the agent's behavior is frozen at deployment time, while the business rules and edge cases it must handle continue to evolve. Existing approaches address agent construction and one-time evaluation but provide no structured mechanism for continuous post-deployment behavioral correction without modifying the agent's source code. Most of the approaches offered in the market, require intense collection of logs and traces, and re-examining the agent design by the engineering team, a process which is heavy, long and negates the economical value of agentic transformation. We introduce Agent Gym, a modular, domain-agnostic framework that wraps any existing LLM-based agent in a continuous evaluation-and-evolution loop. The framework provides six composable capabilities --- Act, Evaluate, Investigate, Correct, Learn, and Observe --- organized across three architectural zones: a constitution layer that codifies domain knowledge in configuration artifacts, a runtime inference pipeline that chains acting, investigation, and adaptive correction, and a learning loop that enables subject matter experts to discover and validate new correction rules through natural language interaction. The key technical contributions include a hybrid deterministic-LLM correction engine with 21 condition operators and three-tier actions, a three-layer investigation architecture for ground-truth-free compliance validation, and a programmatic safety loop that guarantees rule correctness before human approval. We further introduce the Spec-to-Note Gap, an autoencoder-inspired view of agentic system transparency. An open-source reference implementation for invoice processing demonstrates that the framework is fully operational and ready for adoption.

AI.tldr: Agent Gym 是一个模块化、领域无关的框架，通过在现有 LLM 智能体外包裹一个持续评估-进化循环，解决生产环境中智能体行为冻结与业务规则持续演化的矛盾。框架提供六种可组合能力（Act、Evaluate、Investigate、Correct、Learn、Observe），分布在宪法层、运行时推理管道和学习循环三个架构区域，核心贡献包括混合确定性-LLM 修正引擎、三层调查架构和程序化安全循环。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的 LLM 智能体面临根本性矛盾：部署时行为被冻结，而业务规则和边缘情况持续演化。现有方法仅关注智能体构建和一次性评估，缺乏无需修改源代码的持续部署后行为修正机制。市场上的方案需要大量日志追踪收集和工程团队重新审查，过程沉重漫长，削弱了智能体转型的经济价值。
AI.method: Agent Gym 框架包含三大架构区域：(1) 宪法层：将领域知识编码为配置工件；(2) 运行时推理管道：链式执行行动、调查和自适应修正；(3) 学习循环：领域专家通过自然语言交互发现和验证新的修正规则。关键技术贡献包括：混合确定性-LLM 修正引擎（21 个条件操作符和三层动作）、三层调查架构（实现无真值合规验证）、程序化安全循环（在人审批准前保证规则正确性），以及 Spec-to-Note Gap（类自动编码器的智能体系统透明度视角）。
AI.result: 论文提供了发票处理的开源参考实现，证明框架完全可操作并已准备好被采纳。不过摘要未提供定量实验结果或与基线方法的对比数据。
AI.conclusion: Agent Gym 为生产环境 LLM 智能体的持续行为修正提供了结构化机制，弥合了部署后行为冻结与业务规则演化之间的鸿沟，使领域专家无需修改源代码即可通过自然语言持续改进智能体行为。

title: Propaganda Forensics: Recovering the Generation Pipeline of an AI-Driven Influence Campaign
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 10th Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms (WOAH), EMNLP 2026
summary: We present a forensic analysis of the generation pipeline behind a recent AI-driven influence campaign. We introduce PROPAGIA, a corpus of 2,646 propagandist French articles from the Storm-1516/CopyCop campaign disclosed by VIGINUM and INSIKT GROUP in 2025. For comparison, we rely on SIPA, a corpus of human-written French mainstream press from the same period. Using topic modeling, vagueness and sentiment analysis, we first isolate persuasion techniques characteristic of propaganda, with PROPAGIA far exceeding SIPA in vagueness, subjectivity and negativity, and citing fewer sources. We then find prompt instruction leaks on 50 of the 84 PROPAGIA websites, including a verbatim ten-point editorial specification accounting for several of these differences, together with high cross-article redundancy. Finally, we show that rewriting-based detection supports INSIKT GROUP's attribution to the Llama 3 family, but also suggests the involvement of Mistral-family models.

AI.tldr: 本文对Storm-1516/CopyCop AI驱动影响力传播活动进行取证分析，引入PROPAGIA语料库（2,646篇法语宣传文章）与SIPA人类写作主流媒体语料对比，通过主题建模、模糊性/情感分析隔离说服技巧，发现84个网站中50个存在提示词泄露（包括逐字十条编辑规范），并通过重写检测支持Llama 3归因且暗示Mistral家族模型参与。
AI.motivation: AI驱动的虚假信息/影响力传播已成为新兴威胁，需要系统性的取证方法来分析生成管线、识别宣传特征并归因所使用的AI模型，以辅助防御与溯源。
AI.method: 构建PROPAGIA语料库与SIPA对照语料库，运用主题建模、模糊性分析与情感分析；检测网站中泄露的提示指令；使用重写检测技术进行模型归因分析。
AI.result: PROPAGIA在模糊性、主观性和负面性上远高于SIPA，引用来源更少；84个PROPAGIA网站中50个存在提示指令泄露，含逐字十点编辑规范；重写检测支持Llama 3家族归因，同时暗示Mistral家族模型参与。
AI.conclusion: AI驱动的影响力宣传活动具有可量化的语言特征差异，提示词泄露可提供管线内幕，重写检测可实现大语言模型归因，为检测和防御AI虚假信息提供取证框架。

title: Beyond Independence: Learning Correlated Views for Variational Incomplete Multi-View Clustering
summary: Incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) aims to uncover shared cluster structures from data with partially observed views. Although recent imputation-free methods based on variational inference demonstrate robustness to missing views, they commonly rely on a conditional independence assumption across views in the posterior aggregation stage, which fails to capture the inherently structured and potentially correlated nature of multi-view data. In this paper, we propose a variational framework that explicitly goes beyond this assumption by introducing a learnable cross-view correlation structure. Specifically, we explicitly model and learn correlations between views by utilizing the covariance structure of posterior estimation errors during aggregation. To facilitate robust and efficient learning, the correlation matrix is parameterized through a normalized Cholesky decomposition, ensuring positive definiteness and enabling the entire model to be trained jointly through a unified variational objective. Extensive experiments on multiple IMVC benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse missing-view settings while introducing only a negligible number of learnable parameters. These results highlight the effectiveness of adaptive correlation modeling in variational IMVC, demonstrating the need to go beyond the independence assumption in IMVC. The code is available at https://github.com/zmxu196/ACOVA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为ACOVA的变分不完全多视图聚类框架，通过显式建模视图间的跨视图相关结构（利用后验估计误差的协方差），突破传统方法中视图间条件独立的假设，在多种缺失视图设置下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于变分推断的免补全不完全多视图聚类方法在后验聚合阶段普遍依赖视图间条件独立的假设，但多视图数据本质上具有结构化和相关性，该假设无法捕捉视图间的关联信息，限制了聚类性能。
AI.method: 提出可学习的跨视图相关结构：在后验聚合时利用后验估计误差的协方差来显式建模和习视图间的相关性；相关矩阵通过归一化Cholesky分解参数化，保证正定性；整个模型通过统一的变分目标联合训练。
AI.result: 在多个IMVC基准数据集上，该方法在多种缺失视图设置下一致超越最先进方法，且仅引入极少量可学习参数。
AI.conclusion: 自适应相关建模在变分IMVC中具有显著有效性，证明了超越独立性假设的必要性；代码已开源。

title: CrevasseSeg: A Label-Efficient UAV Crevasse Segmentation Framework
summary: Crevasse mapping from uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery matters for glaciological research and for field safety in glaciated terrain. Yet, pixel-level annotation of glacier surfaces is costly and requires domain experts. We introduce CrevasseSeg, a framework for binary segmentation over the terminus of Borebreen, Svalbard, comprising 1,938 unlabelled UAV orthomosaic tiles for self-supervised/unsupervised fine-tuning, 24 labelled tiles for validation and 176 labelled tiles for testing. Using CrevasseSeg, we benchmark five self-supervised objectives -- BYOL, a Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) objective, Barlow-Twins, VICReg, and a combined BYOL-JSD objective -- across three architectures: O-Net, O-Net++, and a DINOv3-initialised O-Net. Each configuration is evaluated under two frozen-feature readouts that differ only in the form of their decision boundary: a linear probe and a non-linear XGBoost classifier fit only on the 24 labelled validation images. Our central finding is a consistent inversion between the two readouts: DINOv3 features are the weakest under linear probing but the strongest under a non-linear readout. A UMAP analysis of the learned feature space shows that DINOv3 fragments pixels into many small clusters in which the classes are locally interleaved, whereas the convolutional architectures (O-Net and O-Net++) embed them onto a single class-sorted manifold. Satellite-pretrained DINOv3 improves over natural-image initialisation across objectives, and our label-efficient DINOv3-ViT-L-Sat-O-Net-BYOL-JSD pipeline reaches 75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU, outperforming standard machine learning baselines fit on the same 24 labelled images with the RGB pixel values used as features. We release CrevasseSeg to support label-efficient segmentation research in remote sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrevasseSeg框架，用于斯瓦尔巴Borebreen冰川末端的裂缝二元分割。框架包含1,938张未标注UAV正射影像用于自监督微调，24张标注图用于验证，176张标注图用于测试。作者在三种架构（O-Net、O-Net++、DINOv3初始化的O-Net）上对比了五种自监督目标（BYOL、JSD、Barlow-Twins、VICReg、BYOL-JSD），并在两种冻结特征读取器（线性探针和XGBoost非线性分类器）下评估。核心发现是两种读取器结果存在反转：DINOv3特征在线性探针下最弱但在非线性读取器下最强。最佳管道DINOv3-ViT-L-Sat-O-Net-BYOL-JSD达到75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU。
AI.motivation: 冰川裂缝测绘对冰川研究和野外安全至关重要，但像素级标注成本高昂且需要领域专家。现有方法依赖大量标注数据，缺乏标签高效的自监督分割方案。作者希望利用大量未标注的UAV影像通过自监督学习来降低标注依赖。
AI.method: 构建CrevasseSeg数据集框架，采用三种网络架构（O-Net、O-Net++、DINOv3初始化的O-Net），对比五种自监督目标（BYOL、JSD、Barlow-Twins、VICReg、BYOL-JSD组合）。使用24张标注图训练线性探针和XGBoost分类器作为冻结特征读取器，并进行UMAP特征空间分析和卫星预训练DINOv3与自然图像预训练的对比。
AI.result: 核心发现是线性探针与非线性读取器之间的结果反转：DINOv3在线性探针下最弱但在XGBoost下最强。UMAP显示DINOv3将像素分散为许多小型交错聚类，而卷积架构嵌入到单一类排序流形上。卫星预训练优于自然图像初始化。最佳管道达到75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU，优于基于RGB像素的机器学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果强调了读取器选择对自监督特征评估的影响，表明非线性的XGBoost读取器更能释放DINOv3等视觉Transformer自监督特征的潜能。卫星预训练对遥感分割任务具有显著优势。作者发布CrevasseSeg以支持遥感领域的标签高效分割研究。

title: When Entropy Is Not Enough: Reclaiming Lost Semantics in LLM Output Length Prediction
summary: Efficient LLM serving is often bottlenecked by the need to pad sequences to a fixed maximum length, and this wastes compute and degrades throughput. Predicting output lengths in advance makes it possible to adopt length-aware scheduling, and this reduces the overhead. This advantage is especially pronounced in long-context reasoning and reinforcement learning applications. Existing approaches, such as entropy-guided token pooling, use token-wise entropy as their primary signal, but they tend to ignore differences in semantic content across tokens. So, important tokens are often underweighted, and tokens carrying little information receive disproportionate emphasis. This hurts the reliability of length prediction. We introduce ESTP (Entropy-and-Semantic Token Pooling), a lightweight framework that addresses this issue by combining entropy with attention-based importance scores. These scores are derived directly from the self-attention weights computed during the LLM prefill phase, and this allows ESTP to capture both uncertainty and semantic importance with minimal additional computation. Since the framework reuses prefill activations, it adds almost no extra memory overhead and introduces only minimal latency. On the ForeLen benchmark, ESTP outperforms baseline methods, achieves better prediction accuracy and lower error rates in most scenarios. When integrated with a length-aware scheduler in end-to-end system tests, it further helps improve overall throughput and reduce the padding ratio. Our results offer a practical and effective building block for length-aware LLM serving systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了ESTP（熵与语义令牌池化）框架，结合熵和基于注意力的重要性分数来预测LLM输出长度，通过复用预填充阶段的激活值，以极小的额外计算和内存开销实现更准确的长度预测，从而优化长度感知调度，提升吞吐量并降低填充开销。
AI.motivation: LLM服务效率常受限于序列填充到固定最大长度的开销，浪费计算并降低吞吐量。预先预测输出长度可实现长度感知调度来减少开销，但现有方法（如基于熵的令牌池化）仅使用令牌级熵作为信号，忽略了令牌间语义内容的差异，导致重要令牌被低估、低信息令牌被过度强调，损害长度预测可靠性。
AI.method: 提出ESTP框架，将熵与基于注意力机制的重要性分数相结合。重要性分数直接取自LLM预填充阶段计算的自注意力权重，从而同时捕捉不确定性和语义重要性。由于复用预填充激活值，几乎不增加额外内存开销，仅引入极小延迟。
AI.result: 在ForeLen基准测试上，ESTP在大多数场景下优于基线方法，取得更高的预测准确率和更低的错误率。与长度感知调度器集成进行端到端系统测试时，进一步帮助提升整体吞吐量并降低填充比率。
AI.conclusion: ESTP为长度感知的LLM服务系统提供了一个实用且有效的构建模块，在最小化额外开销的同时提升了长度预测的可靠性，从而改善了整体服务效率。

title: RoofGS: Roofline-Guided End-to-End Acceleration of 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel-view synthesis but remains limited on GPUs at high resolutions. Through a stage-wise Roofline characterization, we identify two distinct hardware bottlenecks: global memory traffic dominates the front end, whereas instruction throughput limits rasterization. Guided by this analysis, we develop RoofGS, a rendering framework that applies bottleneck-specific optimizations rather than generic kernel acceleration. For the memory-bound front end, we design a resolution-adaptive quantized depth sorting key that compresses each key to 32 bits. For the compute-bound rasterizer, we introduce a range-aware bit-level fast exponential approximation tailored to the bounded exponent range after opacity culling, with a derived per-pixel error bound. These two core techniques are complemented by additional optimizations (kernel fusion, compact attribute storage, culling, dual-pixel evaluation) that additionally reduce memory traffic and improve instruction-level parallelism. Experiments show that RoofGS achieves a 10.1$\times$ end-to-end speedup over 3DGS at 4K on an RTX 4090, increasing throughput from 61 to 616 FPS, with only a 0.028 dB PSNR loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoofGS，一个基于Roofline模型瓶颈分析的3D高斯泼溅渲染框架。通过识别前端受显存带宽限制、光栅化受指令吞吐量限制的不同瓶颈，分别设计32位量化深度排序键（用于内存受限前端）和范围感知的快速指数近似（用于计算受限光栅化器），在RTX 4090上实现4K分辨率10.1倍的端到端加速，从61 FPS提升至616 FPS，仅损失0.028 dB PSNR。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽然能实现实时新视角合成，但在GPU高分辨率下表现受限。现有优化方法多为通用的内核加速，缺乏针对不同硬件瓶颈的差异化优化策略。
AI.method: 通过分阶段的Roofline特性分析，识别出前端是显存带宽瓶颈、光栅化是指令吞吐量瓶颈。针对内存受限的前端，设计分辨率自适应的量化深度排序键，压缩至32位；针对计算受限的光栅化器，提出范围感知的位级快速指数近似，利用不透明度剔除后的有界指数范围并推导逐像素误差界。辅以内核融合、紧凑属性存储、裁剪和双像素评估等优化。
AI.result: 在RTX 4090上，4K分辨率下相对3DGS实现10.1倍端到端加速，吞吐量从61 FPS提升至616 FPS，PSNR仅损失0.028 dB。
AI.conclusion: 瓶颈感知的针对性优化比通用内核加速更有效，通过分别解决内存和计算瓶颈，可以在保持高质量渲染的同时大幅提升高分辨率下的3DGS性能。

title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception
summary: Language models are compared by their held-out per-token cross-entropy risk---the quantity scaling laws are fitted to. We show that it cannot be consistently estimated. Consistency, or convergence to the estimand, is defined relative to a \emph{possible state of the world}: a pair consisting of a data-generating distribution and a model we turn out to train. Quantifying over models as well as data-generating mechanisms is essential, because what decides whether a model's risk is estimable is a tail property of the distribution its weights induce, which no sample reveals. The per-token cross-entropy risk is hard to estimate because of a topological fact: among the possible states, finite risk and infinite risk each lie arbitrarily close to every instance of the other. Consequently no estimator---not merely the holdout average---is consistent at every state at which the risk is defined. Worse, inconsistent estimation persists under both bounding the expected sequence length and restricting to full-support models; and in that restricted setting the states at which inconsistency occurs are even dense. Two interesting ways out are identified, and neither is free. Way out 1: using a bounded context window, we can floor a model's next-token probabilities, making its risk finite exactly when the data-generating distribution has finite expected sequence length---a new, statistical rationale for a choice that was made on computational grounds, though the assumption it substitutes is itself beyond the reach of any test. Way out 2: reporting the risk only when it falls below a threshold fixed in advance restores consistency, at no cost to what model selection actually requires---but we need to recognize that the goal of estimation is revised.

AI.tldr: 本文证明语言模型的逐词元交叉熵风险（衡量困惑度的指标，也是缩放定律所拟合的量）无法被一致估计。作者从拓扑学角度论证，在有限风险与无限风险任意接近的状态空间中，没有任何估计器能在所有风险有定义的状态下保持一致性，即使限制期望序列长度有界或限制为全支持模型也无法避免。文章提出两条出路：有界上下文窗口加概率下限，以及预置阈值报告风险，但两者皆有代价。
AI.motivation: 语言模型通常通过逐词元交叉熵风险进行比较，这是缩放定律所拟合的量。然而作者揭示了这一核心评估指标存在无法被一致估计的根本性缺陷，这动摇了语言模型评估的统计学基础，亟需理论层面的审视与应对。
AI.method: 作者采用一致性（consistency）的定义框架，将其相对于"可能的世界状态"（数据生成分布+训练所得模型的组合）来刻画。通过拓扑分析构建状态空间，证明有限风险与无限风险在所有状态下互为稠密，从而说明任何估计器（不仅仅是留出集平均）都无法在所有风险有定义的状态下保持一致。随后在限制性场景（有界期望序列长度、全支持模型）下检验该结论的持久性，并提出两条出口路径。
AI.result: 证明了逐词元交叉熵风险无法被一致估计，且不一致性在有界期望序列长度和全支持模型限制下依然存在，该场景下不一致状态甚至稠密。提出两条解决路径：有界上下文窗口加概率下限使风险有限性等价于数据分布有有限期望序列长度；以及仅在风险低于预置阈值时报告，可恢复一致性但改变了估计目标。
AI.conclusion: 逐词元交叉熵风险作为语言模型比较的核心指标，在统计可估计性上存在根本性缺陷。虽然有两种可能的修正路径，但都要求额外假设或重新定义估计目标，提示研究者需要重新审视语言模型评估的统计基础。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Aware Reasoning for Multi-Turn Adversarial Conversation Evaluation
summary: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks have emerged as a critical safety threat to LLMs, as harmful objectives are decomposed across a sequence of apparently benign turns to bypass guardrails. Existing defenses lack the reasoning capacity to identify evolving manipulation patterns, often trading helpfulness for safety by over-refusing benign requests related to sensitive topics. We introduce Trace, a multi-turn defense with trajectory-aware structured reasoning. Before generating each response, the model identifies manipulation cues from the trajectory, evaluates both the benign and adversarial interpretations of user intent, assigns a jailbreak score, and commits to an action: Allow, Caution, or Decline. We curate 4k multi-turn adversarial conversations from five attack frameworks, pair them with 2.4k benign dialogs, and 600 sensitive-but-benign conversations. We train Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with SFT and GRPO under a multi-component reward that jointly optimizes helpfulness on benign prompts and robustness against jailbreak attempts. Across seven multi-turn attack benchmarks, Trace attains an average attack success rate (ASR) of 14.5% against 31.4% for the strongest baseline and 74.9% for the undefended target, while significantly raising the attacker effort required per successful jailbreak. Trace also balances usability and safety, achieving a 93.3% average compliance on over-refusal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Trace，一种针对多轮越狱攻击的防御方法，通过轨迹感知的结构化推理来识别操作模式，在保持可用性的同时提升安全性。在七个多轮攻击基准上ASR降至14.5%，同时在过度拒绝基准上保持93.3%的合规率。
AI.motivation: 多轮越狱攻击将有害目标分解到一系列看似良性的对话轮次中，绕过现有防护。现有防御缺乏推理能力来识别不断演变的操纵模式，往往以过度拒绝良性请求为代价换取安全性，导致可用性下降。
AI.method: Trace在每次响应前执行结构化推理流程：从对话轨迹中识别操纵线索，评估用户意图的良性及对抗性解释，分配越狱评分，并做出Allow、Caution或Decline三类动作决策。数据集包含4k多轮对抗对话（来自五种攻击框架）、2.4k良性对话和600个敏感但良性对话。使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct进行SFT和GRPO训练，采用多组件奖励函数同时优化良性提示的 helpfulness 和对越狱尝试的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在七个多轮攻击基准上，Trace的平均攻击成功率(ASR)为14.5%，强于最强基线的31.4%和未防御目标的74.9%，同时显著提高了每次成功越狱所需的攻击者工作量。在过度拒绝基准上达到93.3%的平均合规率，实现了可用性与安全性的平衡。
AI.conclusion: Trace通过轨迹感知的结构化推理有效解决了多轮越狱防御中的安全-可用性平衡问题，证明了将推理过程显式建模为操纵检测、意图评估和动作决策的流水线，能够在显著降低攻击成功率的同时不牺牲对良性请求的响应质量。

title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving
summary: KV-cache eviction caps the memory cost of long reasoning traces but is inherently lossy because the model decodes from a partial view of its history. Under aggressive budgets, this not only lowers accuracy but can also cause runaway degeneration, where the model produces incoherent or repetitive tokens until reaching the length limit. We characterize much of this loss as an information gapf caused by missing context, rather than a capability gap caused by limited model capacity. An evicted 7B model and a full-context 1.5B model make complementary errors, and an oracle choice between their answers recovers 79% of the accuracy gap to the full-KV 7B model. Based on this observation, we propose KV-Rescue, a training-free inference framework that bridges the information gap introduced by KV eviction using a lightweight full-context helper. KV-Rescue interleaves reasoning steps from the two models into a shared trajectory. An online detector uses entropy and compressibility to terminate the generation of incoherent or repetitive base-model candidates early. Across five math benchmarks with Qwen2.5-Math 7B and 72B, KV-Rescue recovers an average of 87% of the accuracy lost to eviction at eviction budget B=64. A decode-cost analysis further shows that preventing runaway degeneration cuts base-model token generation by 43% on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KV-Rescue，一种无需训练的推理框架，通过引入轻量级全上下文辅助模型来弥合KV缓存驱逐造成的信息差距，恢复因驱逐损失的大部分精度，并防止模型退化。
AI.motivation: KV缓存驱逐虽然能限制长推理轨迹的内存成本，但本质上是有损的，因为模型只能从部分历史视角解码。在激进的预算下，这不仅降低精度，还会导致失控退化（产生不连贯或重复的token）。作者将这种损失归因于信息差距（缺少上下文）而非能力差距（模型容量限制），并据此提出解决方案。
AI.method: KV-Rescue是一个训练无关的推理框架，核心思路是：(1) 使用轻量级全上下文辅助模型（如1.5B）来弥补被驱逐模型的上下文缺失；(2) 将两个模型的推理步骤交错到共享轨迹中；(3) 在线检测器利用熵和可压缩性来提前终止基础模型产生的不连贯或重复token生成。
AI.result: 在五个数学基准测试上，使用Qwen2.5-Math 7B和72B模型，KV-Rescue在驱逐预算B=64时平均恢复了87%因驱逐损失的精度。解码成本分析显示，防止失控退化使基础模型的token生成平均减少43%。
AI.conclusion: KV-Rescue通过信息差距视角重新理解了KV驱逐的损失来源，证明用轻量级辅助模型弥合信息差距是高效且有效的方案，在恢复精度的同时还能大幅减少token生成成本。

title: ChainSpace: A Chained-Reasoning Paradigm for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence requires foundation models to maintain coherent spatial state across interactions with the physical world. However, existing data-centric approaches typically treat spatial reasoning as independent question-answer instances, enabling shortcut-based answering and providing limited supervision for persistent spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce ChainSpace, a chained-reasoning paradigm that structures spatial reasoning as a state-preserving multi-round process. In this paradigm, spatial questions are organized into logically constrained and jointly consistent chains, where later questions depend on spatial constraints established in earlier rounds. Following this principle, we instantiate ChainSpace-Bench, a manually annotated real-world multi-round benchmark with a Chain-Aware Metric, and ChainSpace-Pipeline, a simulator-based chain-structured supervision generation framework for spatial intelligence training. Experiments show that ChainSpace-Bench exposes chain-level failures that are not captured by isolated question accuracy. Additionally, with a relatively small amount of simulator-generated chained data, models trained by ChainSpace-Pipeline achieve the best performance among open-source models on ChainSpace-Bench and transfer competitively to multiple external spatial intelligence benchmarks. These results establish ChainSpace as an effective paradigm for more faithful evaluation and more data-efficient learning of spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChainSpace，一种链式推理范式，将空间推理组织为状态保持的多轮过程，后续问题依赖前面建立的空间约束。包含ChainSpace-Bench（人工标注的多轮基准+链感知指标）和ChainSpace-Pipeline（基于模拟器的链式监督生成框架）。实验证明该范式能暴露孤立问题准确率无法捕捉的链级失败，且仅需少量模拟器生成的链式数据即可在多个空间智能基准上达到开源模型最优。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动方法将空间推理视为独立的问答实例，导致两个问题：(1) 模型可通过捷径回答（shortcut-based answering），而非真正理解空间状态；(2) 缺乏对持续性空间理解（persistent spatial understanding）的监督信号。空间智能本质上要求模型在与物理世界交互中保持连贯的空间状态，因此需要新的范式。
AI.method: 提出链式推理范式ChainSpace：(1) 将空间问题组织为逻辑约束且联合一致的链条，后续问题依赖先前回合建立的空间约束；(2) 构建ChainSpace-Bench，人工标注的真实世界多轮基准，配以Chain-Aware Metric评价链级一致性；(3) 构建ChainSpace-Pipeline，基于模拟器生成链式结构监督数据用于训练。
AI.result: (1) ChainSpace-Bench能揭露链级失败，而这些失败无法被孤立问题的准确率指标捕捉；(2) 仅用少量模拟器生成的链式数据训练，ChainSpace-Pipeline训练的模型在ChainSpace-Bench上取得开源模型最优性能，并能在多个外部空间智能基准上实现有竞争力的迁移表现。
AI.conclusion: ChainSpace证明链式推理是更忠实评估空间智能和数据高效学习的有效范式，为空间基础模型提供了新的训练与评测方向。

title: A Pre-Specified Construction-Confirmation Test of Operation-Level Causal Transfer Across Finite Isomorphic Symbolic Domains
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, and 4 ancillary CSV files
summary: Behavioral accuracy, linear decodability, and successful activation interventions do not by themselves show that a model carries an operation-level structure from one symbolic domain to another. We ask a narrower question in finite isomorphic state spaces: if the hidden-state difference between two operations is estimated separately for each source input, does adding that difference to a mapped recipient input move the model toward the corresponding recipient answer? The design compares this input-specific intervention with wrong-operation, norm-matched random, and no-op controls, and separates candidate construction from an independently isolated confirmation split. On a frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model at layers 20--21, one route--domain--operation candidate from a family pre-specified and frozen before confirmation access, transparent | integer_mod16--letters16 | successor->predecessor, passed both PyVene splits; its confirmation intersection--union p-value was 0.000198 and its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.006943. A subsequent NNsight 0.7.0 experiment, pre-specified and frozen before its confirmation access, tested only this selected prompt route, without candidate or layer reselection. It reproduced all 12 confirmation effect estimates, confidence intervals, and exact sign-flip p-values numerically; its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.007141. The result is therefore limited to one prompt route and one candidate, replicated across two intervention implementations on one model revision and one layer interval. It does not establish cross-model generalization, full-family backend independence, domain-general transfer, or algebraic invariance.

AI.tldr: 本文在有限同构状态空间中，通过输入特定的隐藏状态差异干预，检验模型是否携带从符号域到另一符号域的操作级结构。在冻结的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型第20-21层，成功复现了一个预指定的候选操作（整数模16→字母16，后继→前驱），并通过两种独立的干预实现（PyVene和NNsight）获得一致且统计显著的结果。
AI.motivation: 以往研究仅凭行为准确率、线性可解码性和成功的激活干预来推断模型是否具有跨符号域的操作级结构，但这些证据不够充分。作者提出更严格的问题：对每个源输入分别估计两个操作的隐藏状态差异，将其加到映射后的目标输入上，是否能推动模型朝对应目标答案移动。
AI.method: 采用输入特定的干预设计，将候选操作与错误操作、范数匹配随机、无操作对照进行比较；将候选构建与独立隔离的确认分割分开；在预指定的候选族中选择一个透明候选（integer_mod16→letters16，后继→前驱），先在PyVene框架下通过双重分割验证，再用NNsight 0.7.0独立复现，预指定提示路径且不重新选择候选或层。
AI.result: PyVene确认的交集-并集p值为0.000198，36族Holm调整p值为0.006943；NNsight复现实验中所有12个确认效应估计、置信区间和精确符号翻转p值数值一致，36族Holm调整p值为0.007141。结果仅限一个提示路径和一个候选，但在两种干预实现中稳定复现。
AI.conclusion: 该结果局限于单一提示路径和单一候选，在一种模型版本和一个层区间上的两种干预实现中复现。作者明确强调这不建立跨模型泛化、全族后端独立性、领域泛化迁移或代数不变性，仅表明在特定条件下，输入特定的操作差干预确实能引导模型朝目标答案移动。

title: VARM-Bench: Benchmarking Verifiable Structured Reasoning in Chinese Abusive Speech Moderation
summary: The widespread circulation of abusive online content has increased the need for reliable moderation of Chinese social-media text. Existing Chinese benchmarks support label classification, fine-grained toxicity categorization, and target-aware extraction, but do not provide a unified representation for deterministically verifying the stated basis of a moderation decision. We introduce VARM-Bench, a benchmark for field-anchored chain-of-thought rationales in Chinese abusive-speech moderation. Each instance contains a concise natural-language rationale with explicit anchors for six decisions: target, target type, target explicitness, author stance, harmfulness label, and fine-grained category. Our deterministic protocol evaluates field correctness, target alignment, output validity, complete-record agreement, and hidden record errors conditioned on correct final decisions, without relying on an LLM judge. Under a common structured-output protocol, we evaluate language models across multiple model families using zero-shot prompting, taxonomy guidance, and structured CoT supervision, and analyze lexical-cue sensitivity and field-level errors. Results show that strong label-level performance can conceal substantial errors in complete moderation records. VARM-Bench provides an auditable and reproducible benchmark for evaluating verifiable moderation rationales in Chinese abusive-speech moderation.

AI.tldr: VARM-Bench是一个用于中文辱骂性言论审核的基准测试，提供了基于字段锚定的链式思维（Chain-of-Thought）推理基准，包含六个决策锚点（目标、目标类型、目标明确性、作者立场、危害标签、细粒度类别），并通过确定性协议评估模型而不依赖LLM裁判。
AI.motivation: 现有的中文审核基准支持标签分类、细粒度毒性分类和目标感知提取，但缺乏统一的表示来确定性验证审核决策的陈述依据，因此需要一个可审计且可复现的基准来评估可验证的审核推理。
AI.method: 构建VARM-Bench基准，每个实例包含带有六个决策显式锚点的简明自然语言推理。采用确定性评估协议，涵盖字段正确性、目标对齐、输出有效性、完整记录一致性和隐藏记录错误。在通用结构化输出协议下，跨多个模型家族使用零样本提示、分类法引导和结构化CoT监督进行评估。
AI.result: 强标签级性能可能掩盖完整审核记录中的重大错误；不同模型家族在字段级错误和词汇线索敏感性上表现存在差异，VARM-Bench成功揭示了标签级评估无法暴露的深层问题。
AI.conclusion: VARM-Bench为中文辱骂性言论审核提供了可审计、可复现的基准，弥补了现有基准在确定性验证审核决策依据方面的空白，有助于推动更可靠的审核推理评估。

title: Schema-Agnostic Graph Reasoning Agent for Hybrid Knowledge Graphs
summary: Tool-calling LLM agents navigate unfamiliar codebases with a handful of generic primitives for listing, reading and searching files (ls, cat, grep). A knowledge graph admits the same interface: listing neighbours, reading node content and searching descriptions are the same operations on a different substrate. Building on this correspondence, we present GRA, a Graph Reasoning Agent that explores hybrid knowledge graphs, whose nodes are either textual concepts or relational tables, with seven generic tools, discovering everything domain-specific at run time. On UFK-M (Unified Factory Knowledge Model), an industrial benchmark of 258 analytical questions whose gold answers are produced by executing validated SQL programs, GRA beats a full-context agent by 5.1 pp (88.4% vs. 83.3%), while reading under a third of its input tokens. A graph-free control shows the gain comes chiefly from selective agentic access rather than graph topology, and that the effect depends on a model able to drive tools reliably. Seeing less, the agent answers better: selective navigation over a structured substrate beats exhaustive context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRA（Graph Reasoning Agent），一种利用知识图谱作为推理底座的工具调用型LLM智能体。GRA通过将代码库探索的通用原语（ls、cat、grep）映射到知识图谱操作（列举邻居、读取节点内容、搜索描述）上，仅用七个通用工具驱动混合知识图谱（包含文本概念节点和关系表节点）进行推理。在工业基准UFK-M（258个分析问题）上，GRA以88.4%的准确率超越全上下文智能体（83.3%）5.1个百分点，同时仅读取其三分之一的输入token。对照实验表明性能提升主要来自选择性智能体访问而非图拓扑本身，且依赖于模型驱动工具的能力。
AI.motivation: 工具调用的LLM智能体通常需要在大型代码库或文档集中进行导航，但将它们放入完整上下文中成本高昂且效率低下。作者观察到知识图谱与代码库在接口层面存在类比性——列举、读取和搜索是相同的操作，只是底层媒介不同。这一观察促使作者探索能否用知识图谱作为结构化推理基底，让智能体通过选择性访问而非穷举上下文来更高效地回答问题。
AI.method: 作者构建了GRA（Graph Reasoning Agent），它通过七个通用的图谱导航工具（列举邻居、读取节点内容、搜索描述等）在混合知识图谱上进行推理。该图谱的节点类型包括文本概念和关系表。所有领域特定的知识均在运行时由智能体自行探索发现，无需预先编码。作者在UFK-M（统一工厂知识模型）基准上评估，这是一个包含258个分析问题的工业基准，金标准答案由已验证的SQL程序执行产生。
AI.result: GRA在UFK-M基准上达到88.4%的准确率，比全上下文智能体（83.3%）高出5.1个百分点，同时输入token消耗不到后者的三分之一。消融实验表明：（1）移除图谱结构（图无关对照）后性能下降，说明增益主要来自选择性智能体访问而非图拓扑本身；（2）该效果依赖于模型驱动工具的能力。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出"看得更少，答得更好"的核心结论：在结构化基底上进行选择性导航优于穷举式上下文注入。知识图谱提供的选择性访问机制让智能体以更低的计算成本获得更高的推理准确率，这一范式为工业知识库问答提供了高效路径。

title: Emergent 3D Instance Segmentation from Self-Supervised Point Transformers
summary: Unsupervised 3D instance segmentation of outdoor LiDAR scans has traditionally relied on handcrafted geometric priors such as density-based clustering, motion cues, or projected 2D detections. In this work, we investigate whether a frozen, self-supervised point transformer already contains the structural information required to isolate object instances without any handcrafted geometric prior. Using this transformer purely as a feature extractor, we probe its internal representations across the SemanticKITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Perception datasets. Our analysis yields four core insights: (1) the instance signal concentrates in the attention queries and keys rather than in the values or final output features; (2) output features semantically collapse, merging adjacent same-class objects that the queries and keys keep distinct; (3) this instance signal is bimodal in depth, strongest at the shallowest and deepest encoder stages; and (4) this signal is driven predominantly by the rotary position encoding (RoPE), whose removal collapses its advantage. We put these findings into our method TokenGraph3D, a training-free segmenter that groups points via connected components on a key-similarity graph, using neither density-based clustering nor proximity priors. Under identical prior-free conditions, we substantially outperform output-feature baselines, making the emergent 3D instance structure visible.

AI.tldr: 本文发现冻结的自监督点云Transformer内部表示已包含3D实例分割所需的结构信息，无需手工几何先验。通过跨三个数据集的分析，识别出实例信号集中在注意力查询/键中、在深度上呈双峰分布且主要由旋转位置编码驱动。基于此提出TokenGraph3D，一种无需训练、不依赖密度聚类或邻近先验的分割器，在无条件约束下显著优于输出特征基线。
AI.motivation: 传统无监督3D实例分割依赖手工几何先验（如密度聚类、运动线索、2D检测投影），作者希望探索是否冻结的自监督点Transformer已内含实例分割所需的结构信息，从而摆脱对手工先验的依赖。
AI.method: 将冻结的自监督点Transformer仅作为特征提取器，跨SemanticKITTI、nuScenes和Waymo三个数据集探测内部表示，分析注意力查询/键/值及输出特征中的实例信号。基于四个核心洞察，提出TokenGraph3D：通过键相似性图上的连通分量对点进行分组，不使用密度聚类和邻近先验。
AI.result: 在相同无先验条件下，TokenGraph3D大幅优于基于输出特征的基线方法，证明了从Transformer内部表示中浮现的3D实例结构是可见且可利用的。
AI.conclusion: 自监督点Transformer的中间表示（特别是查询和键）天然蕴含实例级结构信息，旋转位置编码在其中起关键作用，可据此构建无需手工几何先验的有效无监督3D实例分割方法。

title: KOALA: Koopman Operator Learning for WiFi-Based Anticipatory Hum
summary: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has emerged as a privacy-preserving alternative to cameras for human pose estimation. However, existing approaches treat pose inference as an instantaneous regression problem and do not model temporal dynamics, making future motion prediction infeasible. Naively applying vision-based prediction methods compounds the estimation noise already present in CSI-derived poses, as autoregressive rollouts amplify errors at every step. We propose KOALA, the framework for human motion prediction directly from WiFi CSI, by lifting noisy CSI-derived pose sequences into a learned Koopman latent space where nonlinear dynamics become linear, enabling multi-horizon prediction via simple matrix-vector products without autoregressive iteration or error accumulation. A residual CSI-conditioned operator resolves the identity attractor problem inherent from Koopman formulations, and an anchor-delta prediction head eliminates the degenerate shortcut of copying the current pose across all horizons. To regularise the lifting and operator jointly, we introduce a Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL) loss that operates in the temporal-encoder feature space, enforcing dynamical consistency across prediction horizons without requiring contrastive, spectral, or auxiliary losses. Experiments on MM-Fi and WiPose show that KOALA achieves robust, consistent performance across both short- and long-term prediction horizons, outperforming all baselines by a substantial margin.

AI.tldr: KOALA 是一个直接从 WiFi CSI 信号进行人体运动预测的框架，通过将含噪的 CSI 姿态序列提升到可学习的 Koopman 潜空间，将非线性动力学转化为线性，从而无需自回归迭代即可实现多时域预测，避免误差累积。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 WiFi CSI 的人体姿态估计算法仅做瞬时回归，未建模时间动态，无法进行未来运动预测。而直接套用基于视觉的预测方法会放大 CSI 姿态中已有的估计噪声，因为自回归展开会在每一步累积误差。
AI.method: 1) 将含噪 CSI 姿态序列提升到可学习的 Koopman 潜空间，使非线性动力学线性化，通过简单的矩阵-向量乘积实现多时域预测。2) 引入残差 CSI 条件化算子解决 Koopman 公式固有的恒等吸引子问题。3) 设计 anchor-delta 预测头消除跨时域复制当前姿态的退化捷径。4) 提出 Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL) 损失，在时间编码器特征空间联合正则化提升与算子，保证预测时域的动力学一致性，无需对比、谱或辅助损失。
AI.result: 在 MM-Fi 和 WiPose 数据集上的实验表明，KOALA 在短期和长期预测时域均表现稳健且一致，大幅优于所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: KOALA 证明了将 Koopman 算子理论应用于 WiFi CSI 人体运动预测的有效性，通过潜空间线性化从根本上避免了自回归误差累积问题，为基于无线信号的人体运动预测提供了新的范式。

title: Bias-Corrected Ceilings of Emotion Predictability from Human Label Variation Based on Instance-Level Fano Bounds
summary: Emotion recognition from text keeps improving on benchmarks, yet whether an accuracy ceiling has been reached is seldom asked with discipline. Our aim is not to pin this ceiling to a single number, but to quantify how far it depends on finite annotation, estimator choice, annotation noise, and the evaluation protocol, and thereby to discipline how confidently saturation can be claimed. We propose Bias-corrected Affective Ceiling Estimation (BACE), an analysis framework that estimates a bias-corrected ceiling, separates irreducible from reducible error, and disciplines the resulting claims. An anchored Dirichlet-mixture empirical Bayes estimator, bracketed between plug-in and NSB, recovers the human-consensus distribution; an annotator split, a noise deconvolution, and a fixed claim gate then attribute error without circularity. Methodologically, unconstrained point estimates place reachability anywhere from 0.38 to 1.03, so saturation cannot be decided by any single estimator. Substantively, the only assertion passing the claim gate is that at least about 33% of a representative classifier's error on GoEmotions is irreducible, with the same pattern recurring on offensiveness and irony.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BACE框架，用于量化文本情感识别准确率天花板对标注有限性、估计器选择、标注噪声和评估协议的依赖程度，并规范地判断饱和性声明是否可成立。
AI.motivation: 文本情感识别在基准上持续进步，但很少严谨地追问是否已达到准确率天花板。作者希望不仅给出单一数值，而是量化天花板在多大程度上依赖于有限标注、估计器选择、标注噪声和评估协议，从而规范地裁定饱和性声明的可信度。
AI.method: 提出BACE（偏差校正情感天花板估计）分析框架：采用锚定Dirichlet混合经验贝叶斯估计器（介于plug-in与NSB之间）恢复人类共识分布；通过标注者划分、噪声反卷积和固定声明门控来无循环地归因误差。该框架区分不可约误差与可约误差。
AI.result: 方法上，无约束点估计给出的可达到性范围从0.38到1.03，表明靠单一估计器无法判定饱和。实质性发现：唯一通过声明门控的结论是，GoEmotions上代表性分类器至少有约33%的误差是不可约的，该模式在冒犯性和讽刺性任务中同样出现。
AI.conclusion: 情感识别饱和性的声明必须经过严谨的偏差校正和门控检验；目前能确认的是分类器存在不可忽略比例的不可约误差，而非整体饱和已达到。

title: PWLR: Pairwise Witness Local Rejection for Boundary-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging for image classifiers, especially when near-OOD samples lie close to in-distribution (ID) class boundaries. Recent vision-language detectors improve OOD detection through class semantics, local prompting, or LLM-generated outlier concepts, but seldom use language as explicit boundary evidence between confusing ID classes. We propose Pairwise Witness Local Rejection (PWLR), which uses an MLLM offline to describe visible local cues that favor one ID class over a specific rival class. These cue phrases are then screened with ID-only data under a frozen vision-language backbone, so that only reliable local verifiers are kept. At inference, PWLR first retains a small set of globally plausible classes, then checks whether any of them is locally supported against its most relevant rivals, and finally combines this pairwise local evidence with the global class score through calibration. Experiments on ImageNet-100 far-OOD, cleaner/challenging OOD and near-OOD benchmarks show that PWLR consistently improves strong vision-language baselines across multiple backbones. Source code will be released.

AI.tldr: PWLR是一种利用多模态大语言模型离线生成成对本地视觉线索，并通过冻结的视觉-语言骨干网络筛选可靠验证器，从而在推理时结合全局分数与成对本地证据进行校准，提升OOD检测性能的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的OOD检测方法在处理接近ID类别边界的近OOD样本时表现不佳，虽然已有的视觉-语言检测器利用类别语义、局部提示或LLM生成的概念，但很少将语言作为混淆ID类别之间的显式边界证据。
AI.method: 1) 使用MLLM离线生成描述有利于某一ID类别胜过特定竞争类别的可见局部线索短语；2) 在冻结的视觉-语言骨干网络上仅用ID数据筛选这些线索，保留可靠的局部验证器；3) 推理时先保留少量全局可能的类别，检查它们是否在局部被最相关的竞争对手支持，最后通过校准将成对本地证据与全局类别分数结合。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-100远OOD、更干净/更具挑战性的OOD以及近OOD基准上的实验表明，PWLR在多个骨干网络上持续改进了强视觉-语言基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PWLR通过引入成对局部证据作为类别间的显式边界信息，有效提升了视觉-语言模型在OOD检测中的性能，特别是对近OOD场景。

title: Second-Moment Memory in Coordinatewise Adam
summary: Adam retains a moving average of past squared gradients in its denominator, but the optimization cost of this memory is not well understood. We show that second-moment memory can itself suppress progress toward the optimum even under finite-variance stochastic gradients. For a simple two-point oracle, the expected positive normalized update is $O(M_2^{-1/2})$ after an initialization transient, where $M_2=(1-β_2)^{-1}$ is the second-moment memory length. We convert this directional bound, under the stated memory and stepsize scaling, into an average-stationarity lower bound of the same order on a smooth convex problem with normalized gap, smoothness, and variance. Long second-moment memory can slow optimization even when the gradient noise has finite variance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Adam优化器中二阶矩记忆（second-moment memory）对优化收敛速度的负面影响。作者证明，即使在有限方差的随机梯度条件下，二阶矩的长期记忆本身也会抑制算法向最优解的进展。通过一个简单的两点查询模型，他们展示了在初始化瞬态之后，期望的归一化正更新量以O(M₂^{-1/2})的速率衰减（其中M₂=(1-β₂)^{-1}为二阶矩记忆长度），并将此方向性界限转化为平滑凸问题上的平均平稳性下界。结论是：即使梯度噪声方差有限，过长的二阶矩记忆也会显著减缓优化速度。
AI.motivation: Adam优化器在现代深度学习中被广泛使用，其分母中保留了历史平方梯度的移动平均（二阶矩记忆）。然而，这种记忆机制对优化代价（即收敛速度）的影响此前未被充分理解。作者旨在从理论上揭示二阶矩记忆本身可能带来的优化瓶颈，即使在梯度噪声具有有限方差的理想条件下也是如此。
AI.method: 作者首先构建了一个简单的两点查询模型（two-point oracle）来分析Adam的更新行为。在此模型下，他们推导出期望的归一化正更新量在初始化瞬态之后遵循O(M₂^{-1/2})的衰减率，其中M₂=(1-β₂)^{-1}表示二阶矩记忆长度。随后，作者将此方向性上界转换，在指定的记忆长度和步长缩放条件下，推导出平滑凸问题上的平均平稳性下界（average-stationarity lower bound），该下界具有相同的量级，并考虑了归一化间隔、光滑性和方差等因素。
AI.result: 本文的核心结果是一个明确的负面理论结果：在有限方差随机梯度条件下，Adam中过长的二阶矩记忆（即大的M₂值）会导致优化进展被抑制。具体而言，归一化正更新量的期望以O(M₂^{-1/2})的速度衰减，并在平滑凸问题上转化为同阶的平均平稳性下界。这意味着二阶矩记忆长度越长的配置（对应更小的β₂），优化收敛速度越慢。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了Adam优化器中二阶矩记忆的潜在代价：即使梯度噪声方差有限，长期记忆也会显著拖慢优化进程。这一发现对Adam及其变体（如AdamW等）中β₂超参数的选择具有重要指导意义，表明需要在记忆长度与优化速度之间做出权衡。

title: Rotation-Invariant Multi-IMU Activity Recognition under Independent Per-Location Orientation Shifts
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. ACM International Symposium on Wearable Computing (ISWC) 2026
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) with self-administered wearables, such as at-home rehabilitation and exercise monitoring, often requires reattaching inertial measurement units (IMUs) across sessions. In multi-IMU settings, this can induce independent orientation offsets across body locations, a deployment shift that conventional scalar HAR models do not structurally handle. Existing remedies rely on rotation augmentation, whose robustness depends on sampled transformations, or calibration and orientationnormalization pipelines requiring additional reference-frame assumptions or explicit procedures. We present Truly Rotation-Invariant HAR (TRI-HAR), a rotation-invariant framework that makes robustness to independent per-location IMU orientation offsets a structural model property. TRI-HAR reshapes accelerometer and gyroscope streams into triaxial vectors, applies a shared SO(3)-equivariant backbone and invariant projection to each IMU location, and fuses the resulting invariant features for activity classification. Across four multi-IMU benchmarks, TRI-HAR preserves macro-F1 under fixed independent per-location SO(3) rotations and outperforms rotation-augmented baselines under this target shift without requiring rotational augmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出TRI-HAR框架，通过SO(3)等变骨干网络和不变投影，使多IMU人体活动识别对每个位置的独立方向偏移具备结构性旋转不变性，无需旋转增强或校准。
AI.motivation: 多IMU场景中，每次会话重新佩戴传感器会引入各身体位置间独立的方向偏移，而传统标量HAR模型无法在结构上处理这种部署偏移；现有方法依赖旋转增强或校准归一化，其鲁棒性受限于采样变换或需要额外的参考框架假设。
AI.method: 将加速度计和陀螺仪数据重塑为三轴向量，对每个IMU位置应用共享的SO(3)等变骨干网络和不变投影，再将各位置的不变特征融合用于活动分类。
AI.result: 在四个多IMU基准上，TRI-HAR在固定独立的位置级SO(3)旋转下保持宏F1分数，并且在不使用旋转增强的情况下优于旋转增强基线。
AI.conclusion: 将旋转不变性构建为模型的结构属性，可有效解决多IMU可穿戴设备中因重新佩戴引起的方向偏移问题，无需依赖增强或校准流程。

title: From Generation to Matching: A Development Report on Personalized Chinese Handwriting
summary: This paper documents a frozen engineering project on personalized Chinese handwriting. The project started from approximately 200 real handwriting images from one user, covering 197 unique Chinese characters, and was initially formulated as few-shot generation of unseen characters. A sequence of canonical-centered personalization routes repeatedly exposed the same conflict: increasing structural pressure made outputs more canonical, while increasing personalization could damage identity-defining strokes. The project was therefore reset around real-human character equivalence classes. A multi-writer CASIA candidate pool showed that a USER-compatible realization often already existed among valid human samples. The task consequently changed from synthesis to character-wise matching, followed by cross-writer composition into a virtual writer. The frozen system uses real-ink features, character-specific human population percentiles, top-20 candidate pruning, and greedy hardest-first whole-row selection. On the covered target set, all 197 USER characters had real-human candidates, and the 100-character evaluation subset was covered 100/100. Knowncharacter held-out comparisons included a row judged visually almost indistinguishable from genuine USER handwriting. A 60- episode stability audit placed every episode in a predefined A-like machine-proxy region, but these were not independent human A-level judgments. The final evidence supports stable practical B-level quality, with many outputs approaching A-level under the USER-defined criterion. The report records why generation became unnecessary for this case without claiming unrestricted or universal handwriting synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了一个冻结的个性化中文手写工程。该项目从约200张真人手写图像（覆盖197个独特汉字）出发，最初被设定为少样本生成未见过汉字。一系列以规范字形为中心的个人化路线反复暴露出同一矛盾：增加结构约束使输出更规范，而增强个性化则可能破坏身份特征笔画。项目因此重置为基于真人字符等价类，从多人CASIA候选池中发现用户兼容的现成实现往往已存在，任务从合成转变为逐字匹配及跨书写者组合成虚拟书写者。
AI.motivation: 个性化中文手写生成面临的内在矛盾：结构保真与个性化特征保持之间的冲突。传统的从规范字形出发进行少样本生成的方法反复失败，促使作者反思任务本身是否应当被重新定义。
AI.method: 采用真实墨水特征、字符级人类群体百分位数、Top-20候选剪枝、贪婪最难点优先的全行选择策略。系统通过多书写者CASIA候选池匹配现成人手写样本，再跨书写者组合构建虚拟书写者。
AI.result: 覆盖目标集上所有197个用户字符均有真人候选，100字符评估子集覆盖率为100/100。已知字符留出比较中有一行被判定与真实用户手写几乎无法区分。60轮稳定性审计中每轮均落在预定义的类A机器代理区域内，但非独立人类A级评判。
AI.conclusion: 最终证据支持稳定的实用B级质量，许多输出在用户自定义标准下接近A级。报告记录了为何在该案例下生成变得不必要，且不声称该方法适用于无限制或通用的手写合成。

title: Self-Supervised Auxiliary Task Discovery for Stable Reinforcement Learning in Stock Trading
summary: Reinforcement learning has gained increasing attention as a data-driven approach for stock trading. However, learning a policy that is both profitable and stable remains challenging due to non-stationary market behaviour and noisy reward signals. Auxiliary tasks are often used to improve representation learning and stabilize training, yet they are usually designed manually and depend heavily on prior assumptions about targets and prediction horizons. Such fixed designs may not remain suitable across changing market regimes. In this work, we propose a self-supervised framework that automatically discovers auxiliary tasks to support reinforcement learning for stock trading. The auxiliary tasks are formulated as General Value Functions so that their predictions enrich the learned state representation and assist policy optimization. The framework consists of two networks. The main network learns the trading policy along with the auxiliary predictions, while the secondary network generates the definitions of auxiliary tasks through learned cumulants and discount factors. These tasks are updated using a meta gradient mechanism that accounts for their long-term impact on trading performance and improves training stability. We evaluate the proposed approach across four major equity indices: DJI, FTSE, Sensex, and TAIEX. The empirical results demonstrate that automatically discovered auxiliary tasks lead to more robust learning and improved trading performance compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自监督框架，自动发现辅助任务（以General Value Functions形式）来支持股票交易的强化学习，通过元梯度机制更新任务定义，在四个主要股指上验证了更稳健的学习和更好的交易表现。
AI.motivation: 股票交易的强化学习面临非平稳市场行为和噪声奖励信号的挑战，难以学到既盈利又稳定的策略。现有的辅助任务通常人工设计，依赖对目标和预测视界的先验假设，在变化的市场环境中可能不再适用。
AI.method: 提出双网络自监督框架：主网络学习交易策略和辅助预测，辅助网络通过学习累积量（cumulants）和折扣因子（discount factors）自动生成辅助任务定义（General Value Functions）。辅助任务通过元梯度机制更新，考虑其对交易表现的长期影响并提升训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在DJI、FTSE、Sensex和TAIEX四个主要股票指数上进行了评估，实验结果表明自动发现的辅助任务相比现有基线方法带来更稳健的学习过程和更优的交易表现。
AI.conclusion: 自动发现辅助任务是提升股票交易强化学习性能的有效途径，无需人工设计任务目标，能够适应不同市场环境。

title: Argumentation for Common Ground: Finding Zones of Possible Agreement between Individuals in Conflict
summary: How can common ground between societies in conflict be identified when citizens' acceptability of peace agreements is shaped by contested narratives? Such acceptability is mediated not only by the clauses that agreements include or exclude, but crucially by citizens' subjective reasoning concerning agreements' clauses. In this paper, we leverage computational argumentation to introduce a novel approach to identifying mutually acceptable agreements among individuals in conflict, i.e. a Zone of Possible Agreement (ZOPA). First, we introduce a quantitative bipolar argumentation framework tailored to represent each side's reasoning about peace agreements. We then show how merging these frameworks can enable negotiators to identify peace agreements that are mutually acceptable. To evaluate our approach under conditions of real-world relevance, we focus on the Palestinian-Israeli conflict, where long-standing policy, practitioner and public interest underscores the demand for methods capable of analysing polarised public reasoning. We show how our framework identifies a ZOPA through theoretical analysis and preliminary experiments using survey data from both existing work and retrieved by a large language model. The results illustrate how argumentation can empower negotiators and conflict-resolution teams in mapping feasible ZOPAs grounded in citizens' reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于计算论证的新方法，用于识别冲突社会中公民可接受的和平协议区域（ZOPA）。作者引入量化双极论证框架来表示冲突各方的推理，通过合并这些框架帮助谈判者识别相互可接受的协议，并在巴以冲突中进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 冲突社会中的公民对和平协议的接受度受争议叙事影响，不仅取决于协议条款本身，还取决于公民对条款的主观推理。现有方法缺乏能够分析极化公众推理的系统性手段，因此需要新方法来识别双方可共同接受协议的"可能协议区"（ZOPA）。
AI.method: 首先引入一种量化双极论证框架（quantitative bipolar argumentation framework），用于表示冲突各方关于和平协议的推理；随后展示如何通过合并这些框架，使谈判者能够识别双方相互可接受的协议。评估聚焦于巴以冲突，结合理论分析和初步实验，使用已有调查数据和大型语言模型检索的数据。
AI.result: 该框架能够通过理论分析和基于调查数据及LLM数据的初步实验，成功识别出基于公民推理的ZOPA，验证了论证方法在映射可行和平协议区域方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 计算论证方法能够赋能谈判者和冲突解决团队，在基于公民推理的基础上绘制可行的ZOPA，为分析极化公众推理和促进和平协议谈判提供了新工具。

title: FlowDance: Music-Driven Dance Video Generation with Parallel Pose and RGB Streams
summary: Music-driven dance video synthesis aims to animate a reference person according to a given music clip. The task is challenging because it requires a model to jointly learn music-to-motion correspondence, identity-preserving human animation, temporal coherence, and visually realistic video generation. We present FlowDance, a music-driven dance video generation framework that integrates explicit motion modeling with reference-preserving visual synthesis through parallel pose and RGB streams. We further introduce timestep-aware pose injection to adapt structural guidance across denoising steps and persistent identity injection to preserve the reference appearance over long video. To support this task, we further build a popularity-curated, high-resolution in-the-wild dance video dataset with synchronized music, RGB videos, 3D body motion, camera parameters, and projected 2D pose annotations.
