AI.result: 在352,333次实时准入调用中风险界全面成立；预注册的确认实验中精确回退率从0.30降至0.14（风险匹配）；三层审计分别测得算子范数查询包络距紧界1.5倍、椭圆体替代无增益（0.89倍）、门控工作点差距约700倍，从而定位了1064倍差距全部源于工作点；可交换外推的校准风险为0.41对比二元共形预测的0.51。
AI.conclusion: 本文交付的最终产物是"账本"：可花费的风险、可从法则中读取的差距、以及能在未见过的请求上存活的界。通过形式化验证和实证裁决（拒绝路由认证的替代方案），构建了一个有定价保证的运行时压缩认证框架。

title: TR-GS: High-Fidelity Sparse-View CT Volumetric Rendering via t-Distribution Gaussian Splatting and Ray-Confidence Modeling
summary: High-fidelity 3D medical visualization supports applications such as clinical assessment and surgical planning. Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) can reduce projection requirements and associated radiation exposure, but limited observations may introduce structural artifacts and reconstruction uncertainty. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient explicit representation for volumetric rendering, existing CT methods based on standard Gaussian primitives may be sensitive to unreliable observations under sparse-view acquisition. We present TR-GS, a Gaussian-splatting framework for sparse view CT volumetric rendering. TR-GS replaces standard Gaussian primitives with projectable Student's t-distribution primitives and introduces a ray-confidence model that regulates their degrees of freedom according to local ray observability. Confidence-guided 3D wavelet regularization is further used to balance high-frequency detail preservation and noise suppression. This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that TR-GS improves over representative baselines in most evaluated settings and remains competitive in the remaining cases. The resulting volumetric representations may support downstream medical multimedia applications, including XR-based visualization and interactive clinical rendering.

AI.tldr: TR-GS是一个用于稀疏视角CT体渲染的高斯溅射框架，通过用可投影的学生t分布基元替换标准高斯基元，并引入射线置信度模型与置信度引导的3D小波正则化，在合成和真实数据集上优于多数基线方法。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角CT虽能减少投影需求和辐射暴露，但有限观测会引入结构伪影和重建不确定性。现有基于标准高斯基元的3DGS方法在稀疏视角采集下对不可靠观测敏感，亟需更稳健的表示方法。
AI.method: TR-GS采用三个关键创新：(1) 用可投影的学生t分布基元替代标准高斯基元；(2) 引入射线置信度模型，根据局部射线可观测性调控基元的自由度；(3) 采用置信度引导的3D小波正则化，平衡高频细节保留与噪声抑制。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，TR-GS在大多数评估设置中优于代表性基线方法，在其余情况下也具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TR-GS生成的体积表示可支持下游医学多媒体应用，包括XR可视化与交互式临床渲染，为稀疏视角CT高质量重建提供了有效方案。

title: Toward Optimal Second-Order Path-Length Guarantee for Adversarial Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We study second-order path-length regret in adversarial $K$-armed bandits against oblivious loss sequences. Bubeck et al. [2019] designed an algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K+\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,1}})$ regret, where $Q_{\infty,1}$ is the first-order path length, and left open whether $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\text{poly}(K)\sqrt{1+Q_{\infty,2}})$ regret is achievable under bandit feedback, where $Q_{\infty,2}$ is the second-order path length. Somewhat surprisingly, we resolve this question positively by showing that with a more involved analysis, the exact same algorithm of Bubeck et al. [2019] achieves $\mathcal{O}\left(K\log(KT)+\sqrt{K\log(KT)\bigl(1+Q_{\infty,2}\bigr)}\right)$ expected regret when $Q_{\infty,2}$ is known, where $T$ is the horizon. This matches the $Ω(\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,2}})$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors and additive terms. We further remove the knowledge of $Q_{\infty,2}$ using an adaptive restart scheme whose path-length estimator has uniformly bounded increments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了对抗性K臂老虎机中二阶路径长度遗憾问题。令人惊讶的是，作者证明了Bubeck等人[2019]的原始算法（仅需更深入的分析）即可达到𝒪(K log(KT) + √(K log(KT)(1+Q_{∞,2})))的期望遗憾，解决了其遗留的开放问题，并匹配了Ω(√(KQ_{∞,2}))下界（至多差对数因子）。此外，作者通过自适应重启方案去除了对Q_{∞,2}的依赖。
AI.motivation: Bubeck等人[2019]设计了在对抗性K臂老虎机中达到Ō(K+√(KQ_{∞,1}))遗憾的算法（其中Q_{∞,1}为第一阶路径长度），并遗留了在bandit反馈下是否能达到Ō(poly(K)√(1+Q_{∞,2}))遗憾（涉及第二阶路径长度Q_{∞,2}）的开放问题。本文旨在解决这一开放问题。
AI.method: 作者采用两种技术：(1) 对Bubeck等人[2019]的原始算法进行更精细的分析，证明其无需修改即可达到第二阶路径长度遗憾界；(2) 设计自适应重启方案，通过具有均匀有界增量的路径长度估计器来消除对Q_{∞,2}已知性的依赖。
AI.result: 在Q_{∞,2}已知时达到𝒪(K log(KT) + √(K log(KT)(1+Q_{∞,2)}))期望遗憾，匹配Ω(√(KQ_{∞,2}))下界（除对数因子和加性项外）。在Q_{∞,2}未知时，通过自适应重启方案同样达到类似保证。
AI.conclusion: 这解决了Bubeck等人[2019]遗留的开放问题，表明原始的简单算法就足以实现二阶路径长度遗憾界，无需设计更复杂的算法，且匹配了理论下界。

title: RLCascadeRouter: Quality-Estimator-Free Cascade Routing via Reinforcement Learning
summary: The growing ecosystem of large language models (LLMs) offers huge potential to optimize performance-cost trade-offs. However, their heterogeneous capabilities and inference costs make efficiently routing queries a significant challenge. Existing paradigms are inflexible: one-shot routers commit before observing responses, whereas conventional cascades stop adaptively but follow a fixed model order. Cascade routing removes both restrictions by reconsidering whether to stop or invoke another model after each response. Current methods use a predict-then-optimize pipeline estimating response quality and future model utility. However, prediction loss for quality or utility is not equivalent to routing-decision loss. A lower prediction error does not necessarily yield a better action; a small boundary-crossing error can reverse a ``stop'' or model-selection decision. Therefore, we propose RLCascadeRouter, a quality-estimator-free framework that formulates cascade routing as a Markov decision process with actions comprising ``stop'' and model selection. It uses trajectory returns and advantages to directly optimize the performance-cost objective. Its Cascade Policy Network models candidate complementarity for model selection and remaining-action value for stopping, eliminating independent post-hoc response-quality estimators. Evaluated across ten LLMRouterBench benchmarks with thirteen LLMs, RLCascadeRouter outperforms strong baselines and achieves superior performance-cost trade-offs. It incorporates unseen models without retraining, and ablation studies validate both policy components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLCascadeRouter，一个无需质量估计器的级联路由框架，将级联路由建模为马尔可夫决策过程，直接优化性能-成本目标，在十个基准测试上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM路由方法存在局限：一次性路由器在观察响应前就做决策，而传统级联方法虽能自适应停止但遵循固定模型顺序。现有方法采用预测-然后-优化的流程估计响应质量和未来模型效用，但预测损失不等于路由决策损失，较小的边界错误就可能反转停止或模型选择决策。
AI.method: 将级联路由形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，动作包括"停止"和模型选择；使用轨迹回报和优势函数直接优化性能-成本目标；设计级联策略网络，建模候选模型互补性用于模型选择，建模剩余动作价值用于停止决策，消除了独立的响应后质量估计器。
AI.result: 在十个LLMRouterBench基准测试中使用十三个LLM进行评估，RLCascadeRouter优于强基线方法，实现了更优的性能-成本权衡；能够在不重新训练的情况下纳入未见过的模型；消融研究验证了两个策略组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对齐路由决策损失而非预测损失，RLCascadeRouter提供了更灵活有效的级联路由方案，并具有良好的泛化能力。

title: SafeGesture: Evaluating Fine-Grained Hand Gesture Understanding in Vision-Language Models through Scenario-Conditioned Safety Interpretation
comment: 14 pages, 22 tables, 2 figures. Code and benchmark resources available at https://github.com/The-Responsible-AI-Initiative/SafeGesture
summary: Open-weight and frontier vision-language models (VLMs) perform well on general image understanding, but their ability to interpret fine-grained hand gestures in safety-critical operational contexts remains largely unexamined. We introduce SafeGesture, a benchmark that evaluates whether a model can infer scenario-appropriate safety actions from hand gestures. It pairs six HaGRID gestures with eight operational scenarios for 4,800 items and evaluates Qwen2.5-VL-7B, LLaVA-NeXT-7B, InternVL2-8B, Phi-3.5-Vision, and GPT-4o. Results reveal a perception-reasoning decoupling: GPT-4o achieves 98.4% gesture accuracy but 53.3% safety accuracy, while Qwen2.5-VL reaches 84.9% and 39.5%, yielding gaps of 45.0 and 45.4 percentage points. Four of five models rarely or never use the uncertainty label, and failure directions differ substantially across models. Accuracy also obscures label bias: a scenario-majority policy with no visual input reaches 58.3%, above every evaluated model, while only GPT-4o exceeds this prior under macro-F1. Visual input improves safety accuracy by 11.2 to 30.2 percentage points, but providing the ground-truth gesture as text improves performance by only 0.4 to 3.2 points, and no model exceeds 56.2%. These results indicate that the main bottleneck is scenario-conditioned safety reasoning rather than gesture recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeGesture基准，评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在手势理解与安全场景推理方面的能力。实验发现模型存在"感知-推理解耦"现象：GPT-4o手势识别准确率达98.4%但安全推理仅53.3%，所有模型在安全推理上表现欠佳，且多数模型未利用不确定性标签，表明瓶颈在于场景条件化的安全推理而非手势识别。
AI.motivation: 开放权重和前沿视觉语言模型在通用图像理解上表现良好，但其在安全关键操作场景中解读细粒度手势的能力尚未被充分检验，因此需要专门的基准来评估这一能力。
AI.method: 构建SafeGesture基准，将6种HaGRID手势与8种操作场景配对形成4,800个测试项，评估Qwen2.5-VL-7B、LLaVA-NeXT-7B、InternVL2-8B、Phi-3.5-Vision和GPT-4o五个模型的手势识别与安全推理能力，并设置无视觉输入基线对照。
AI.result: GPT-4o手势准确率98.4%但安全准确率仅53.3%，Qwen2.5-VL分别为84.9%和39.5%，感知-推理差距达45.0和45.4个百分点。5个模型中4个几乎不使用不确定性标签；无视觉输入的场景多数策略可达58.3%准确率，超过所有评估模型（仅GPT-4o在宏F1上超过该先验）；提供真实手势文本仅提升0.4-3.2个百分点，所有模型安全准确率均未超过56.2%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型的主要瓶颈在于场景条件化的安全推理而非手势识别。简单的手势识别能力无法转化为可靠的安全决策，模型在安全关键场景中的推理能力亟需改进。

title: Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast for Molecule-Text Alignment
summary: This paper studies the problem of molecule-text alignment, which aims to project molecules and their textual descriptions into a joint latent space for downstream tasks including molecule search and molecular property prediction. Previous approaches typically combine graph structure mining with contrastive learning to enhance joint representation learning. However, they typically neglect fine-grained semantic relationships between substructures and texts, leading to suboptimal performance on downstream tasks. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast (RISEN) for molecule-text alignment. The core idea of RISEN is to construct a latent twin molecule for each substructure with cross-modal retrieval for semantic enhancement. In particular, for each substructure query, we retrieve relevant textual descriptions and sample several molecules that share similar descriptions of substructures. Then, we aggregate their representations via attention pooling for a twin latent representation, which would be further fused with the original substructure for representation enrichment. In addition, we measure the similarity across substructures and texts, which would further guide cross-modal contrastive learning with soft thresholding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate the superiority of the proposed RISEN in comparison with existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RISEN方法用于分子-文本对齐任务，通过为每个子结构构建"孪生潜在分子"实现跨模态检索增强，并结合相似度感知对比学习，在分子搜索和分子性质预测等下游任务上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有分子-文本对齐方法通常结合图结构挖掘与对比学习，但忽略子结构与文本之间的细粒度语义关系，导致下游任务性能次优。
AI.method: RISEN的核心是为每个子结构构建潜在孪生分子：首先以子结构为查询检索相关文本描述并采样共享相似子结构描述的分子，然后通过注意力池化聚合其表示得到孪生潜在表示，再与原始子结构融合进行表征增强；此外，计算子结构与文本间的相似度，以软阈值方式引导跨模态对比学习。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RISEN在分子搜索和分子性质预测等下游任务上优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨模态检索增强和相似度感知对比学习，RISEN有效捕获了子结构与文本间的细粒度语义关系，验证了其在分子-文本对齐任务上的优越性。

title: The Authority Resolution Framework: A Five-Domain Ontology for Governing Who and What Decides, at Scale
summary:
As AI systems become increasingly capable of autonomous action, determining whether an agent is technically capable of performing an action is insufficient: the system must also determine whether the action is authorised in its context.
  This paper introduces the Authority Resolution Framework (ARF), a five-domain ontology for representing and resolving authority across organisational roles and informal influence, business concepts, codified processes, machine-readable permissions and executable systems, and external real-world context. ARF defines the Authority Relation (AR) as a cross-domain primitive binding an actor, action, object, bounded context, justification chain, and a calibration measure termed the DNA-Coefficient, which captures divergence between documented authority structures and authority as practiced.
  The framework provides a machine-interpretable representation of authority provenance and scope, with JSON-LD representations and knowledge-graph query patterns for authority resolution. ARF is designed to support AI agents in determining the provenance, scope and contextual validity of authority before executing consequential actions. The framework positions authority resolution as a knowledge-representation and reasoning problem at the intersection of ontology engineering, semantic AI, agentic AI and AI governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出权威解析框架（ARF），一个五域本体，用于表示和解析AI智能体在组织环境中执行行动前的权威来源、范围和上下文有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统自主行动能力增强，仅判断智能体"技术上能否"执行行动已不够，还必须判断该行动在其上下文中是否"被授权"。现有研究缺乏对权威表示与解析的系统性框架。
AI.method: ARF构建了一个五域本体（组织角色与非正式影响力、业务概念、编码化流程、机器可读权限与可执行系统、外部现实世界上下文），定义权威关系（AR）作为跨域原语，包含参与者、行动、对象、受限上下文、证明链，以及衡量权威记录与实践之间差异的DNA系数。框架提供JSON-LD表示和知识图谱查询模式。
AI.result: ARF提供了一种机器可解释的权威溯源和范围表示方法，支持AI智能体在执行关键行动前确定权威的来源、范围及上下文有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将权威解析定位为本体工程、语义AI、智能体AI与AI治理交叉领域的知识表示与推理问题，为自主AI系统的安全治理提供了理论基础。

title: Representation Is Not Enough: Body-Localized Thermal Evidence for Contactless Stress and Craving Sensing in Opioid Use Disorder
summary: Removing wearables from physiological monitoring also removes their supervision: the signal indicating where and when a stress response occurred. Contactless stress sensing therefore becomes a weakly supervised evidence-localization problem, where a clip-level label must be traced to the body regions and moments that produced it. We address this with FABLE-Therm, a weakly supervised architecture that preserves localized evidence across body regions, time, and encoder-specific representations until the final decision. FABLE-Therm fuses frozen foundation-model encoders at the embedding level, with theory explaining why localized fusion can outperform feature concatenation and prediction averaging. We study this problem in opioid use disorder (OUD), where stress is a major relapse trigger and sustained wearable use can be difficult during early recovery. Using fixed thermal video, FABLE-Therm achieves 0.938 AUROC on held-out participants, and its learned representation transfers to self-reported craving, providing, to our knowledge, the first evidence that craving can be recovered from contactless thermal video. Localized evidence also enables participant-level analysis of deployment failure. We find that improving representation alone is insufficient for equitable deployment: additional data from the underserved group would recover only about half of the cohort gap, while the remainder reflects person-to-person heterogeneity. This modality-agnostic decomposition applies to models with identifiable subpopulations. Together with the first cohort-structured contactless thermal OUD benchmark, our results show that preserving localized evidence supports both accurate sensing and principled analysis of who a model fails and why.

AI.tldr: FABLE-Therm是一种弱监督架构，用于非接触式热视频应激检测，在阿片类药物使用障碍人群中达到0.938 AUROC，并首次证明可从非接触热视频恢复渴求感信号，同时支持参与者级别的部署失败分析。
AI.motivation: 去除可穿戴设备后，生理监测失去了监督信号——即压力反应发生的位置和时间。非接触式压力感知因此成为弱监督的证据定位问题（clip级标签需追溯到产生它的身体区域和时刻）。此外，在阿片类药物使用障碍人群中，压力是复发的主要诱因，而早期恢复期间持续佩戴可穿戴设备困难，需要非接触替代方案。
AI.method: 提出FABLE-Therm弱监督架构，在嵌入层面融合冻结的基础模型编码器，跨身体区域、时间和编码器特定表示保留局部化证据直至最终决策，并有理论解释为何局部化融合优于特征拼接和预测平均。
AI.result: 在固定热视频上对未参与训练的被试达到0.938 AUROC；学习到的表示可迁移到自我报告的渴求感，首次证明可从非接触热视频恢复渴求信号。局部化证据支持参与者级部署失败分析：仅改进表示不足以实现公平部署，从服务不足群体额外采集数据只能恢复约一半的群体差距，其余反映个体间异质性。
AI.conclusion: 保留局部化证据同时支持准确感知和关于模型失败对象及原因的原则性分析。该方法具有模态无关性，适用于具有可识别子群体的模型，并提供了首个队列结构化的非接触热视频OUD基准。

title: Breaking the Compression Barrier: Cross-Architecture Compression Boundary Learning via Reverse Regrowth
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE
summary: Model compression is critical for deploying networks on resource-constrained edge devices. While pruning-based methods can significantly reduce model size, they often suffer from abrupt performance collapse beyond a sparsity thresh-old, making it difficult to identify the feasible compression limit of the model. To address this challenge, we propose a boundary-Learning reverse regrowth framework, BRIDGE, that reformulates compression as a constructive boundary-search problem. Unlike forward pruning, our method first drives the model to an extremely sparse state to expose the collapse region, and then selectively regenerates the critical structure to restore performance. The proposed framework employs a hierarchical regeneration strategy, including coarse-grained layer selection and fine-grained regeneration parameter selection, to accurately identify which parameters require recovery. Experiments show that our method can recover models from the brink of collapse on both CNNs and Transformer architectures, demonstrating its architecture in-dependence. BRIDGE achieves a performance improvement of up to 1.49% in unstructured pruning and up to 4.77% in structured pruning. These results demonstrate that reverse regeneration can effectively extend the compression limit while maintaining stable performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRIDGE框架，将模型压缩重新定义为边界搜索问题，采用逆向生长策略：先将模型压缩至极稀疏状态以暴露崩溃区域，再选择性再生关键结构来恢复性能，在CNN和Transformer上均能有效扩展压缩极限。
AI.motivation: 传统剪枝方法在超过稀疏度阈值后会出现性能急剧崩溃，难以确定模型可行的压缩极限。现有方法缺乏对压缩边界区域的系统探索能力。
AI.method: 提出逆向再生长框架BRIDGE：(1) 先将模型推向极稀疏状态暴露崩溃区域；(2) 采用分层再生策略——粗粒度层选择与细粒度再生参数选择——精确识别需要恢复的参数并选择性重建关键结构。
AI.result: 在CNN和Transformer架构上均能从崩溃边缘恢复模型，非结构化剪枝性能提升最高1.49%，结构化剪枝最高提升4.77%，展示出架构无关性。
AI.conclusion: 逆向再生长方法能够有效扩展模型压缩极限，同时保持稳定性能，为模型压缩提供了新的研究方向。

title: TISC: A Text-Driven Image Semantic Communication System for Faithful Reconstruction
summary: Generative image semantic communication converts an image into a text description and then performs text-to-image reconstruction at the receiver via diffusion-based generative models. This paradigm has attracted broad attention due to its extremely low bandwidth cost. However, existing methods still face two critical bottlenecks across image-to-text (I2T) semantic extraction at the transmitter and text-to-image (T2I) semantic reconstruction at the receiver: (i) semantic loss and distortion in I2T, where holistic image descriptions may omit fine-grained object attributes and spatial-position information, causing the generated text to deviate from the original image semantics; and (ii) insufficient semantic faithfulness in T2I, where even with the same semantically faithful text description, different initial noise settings may lead diffusion-based reconstruction to produce images with different levels of semantic consistency with the original image. These issues jointly limit the semantic faithfulness of image reconstruction. To address them, we propose TISC, a text-driven image semantic communication framework tailored for faithful reconstruction. TISC incorporates two key designs: (1) Tree-Structured Attribute Semantic Extraction (TSASE), which decomposes semantic extraction into global scene, background, and object-level attribute descriptions, covering spatial position, shape/pose, color, material, and other physical attributes for each detected object; and (2) an Initial Noise Optimization (INO) mechanism, which selects an initial noise seed at the transmitter according to a comprehensive similarity score that jointly considers visual and semantic consistency. Experiments on multiple datasets show that TSASE improves object-position recovery and semantic description faithfulness, while the INO parameter study supports the adopted configuration for noise selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TISC框架，一种面向忠实重建的文本驱动图像语义通信框架，通过树状结构属性语义提取（TSASE）和初始噪声优化（INO）两个核心设计，分别解决图像到文本语义提取中的细粒度信息丢失问题，以及文本到图像重建中初始噪声设置影响语义一致性的问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像语义通信虽具有极低带宽优势，但面临两大瓶颈：一是图像到文本（I2T）语义提取中，整体性描述会遗漏细粒度物体属性与空间位置信息，导致文本偏离原始图像语义；二是文本到图像（T2I）重建中，即使语义文本相同，不同初始噪声设置也会导致重建图像的语义一致性层次不齐，两者共同限制了重建的语义忠实度。
AI.method: TISC框架包含两个核心设计：(1) TSASE（树状结构属性语义提取）：将语义提取分解为全局场景、背景和物体级别的属性描述，对每个检测到的物体覆盖空间位置、形状/姿态、颜色、材质等物理属性；(2) INO（初始噪声优化）：在发射端根据综合考虑视觉和语义一致性的相似度评分来选择初始噪声种子。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，TSASE改善了物体位置恢复和语义描述忠实度，INO参数研究支持了所采用的噪声选择配置方案。
AI.conclusion: TISC通过结构化的细粒度语义提取和优化的初始噪声选择，有效提升了生成式图像语义通信中图像重建的语义忠实度，为该领域提供了新的解决思路。

title: RagGAD: Rationale-Aware Conditional Gaussian Mixture Normalizing Flow for Unsupervised Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph anomaly detection aims to identify nodes that deviate from normal behavioral patterns within graphs. However, existing methods largely rely on the homophily assumption, which makes it difficult to distinguish spurious affinities and to capture the diverse behaviors of normal nodes,limiting their robustness in complex real-world scenarios. To address this problem, we propose RagGAD, an unsupervised graph anomaly detection framework based on rationale-aware conditional Gaussian mixture normalizing flow. RagGAD introduces an adaptive rationale disentangler to disentangle stable rationales from spurious correlations within node interrelationships, and further decomposes stable rationales into robust and fragile components. The learned rationales capture underlying interaction patterns that characterize normal behaviors under varying conditions, while anomalies emerge as deviations associated with unstable or spurious correlations. To model the intricate distributions of normal and abnormal nodes, RagGAD integrates rationale-non-rationale Gaussian mixture modeling with a robust-fragile rationale mixture learning strategy. By mitigating spurious homophilic correlations and embracing the heterogeneity of normal patterns, RagGAD identifies anomalies as low-density regions within a structure-aware distribution space. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that RagGAD outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RagGAD，一个基于理性感知的条件高斯混合归一化流的无监督图异常检测框架。它通过自适应理性解缠器将节点间关系中的稳定理性与虚假相关性分离，并将理性分解为鲁棒和脆弱两部分，结合高斯混合建模识别低密度区域中的异常节点，在多个基准数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图异常检测方法过度依赖同质性假设，难以区分虚假亲和关系，也无法捕捉正常节点的多样化行为，导致在复杂真实场景中鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出RagGAD框架：(1) 自适应理性解缠器（adaptive rationale disentangler）将节点间关系中的稳定理性与虚假相关性分离，并进一步分解为鲁棒和脆弱两部分；(2) 结合理性-非理性高斯混合建模与鲁棒-脆弱理性混合学习策略，建模正常与异常节点的复杂分布；(3) 通过缓解虚假同质相关性并拥抱正常模式的异质性，在结构感知分布空间中将异常识别为低密度区域。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RagGAD在性能上优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解缠稳定理性与虚假相关性，并建模正常行为的多样模式，RagGAD有效克服了同质性假设的局限，为无监督图异常检测提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: RAGas: Retrieval-Augmented Gas Optimization for Smart Contracts with Continuous Knowledge Integration
summary: Ethereum is now integral to mission-critical sectors, including finance, healthcare, and supply chain management. Execution fees, commonly referred to as Gas, scale with the computational complexity of their functions. Smart contracts on Ethereum incur execution fees, known as Gas, which increase with computational complexity. Thus, optimizing Gas-intensive code while preserving functional equivalence significantly lowers deployment costs. No existing system continuously exploits evolving Gas usage patterns. We systematically analyze syntactic and semantic constructs that drive excessive Gas use. This yields six high-level categories covering twelve fine-grained antipatterns underpinning a curated knowledge base. We operationalize these insights with RAGas, a three-stage retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a large language model to pinpoint and automatically fix Gas inefficiencies. Experiments on deployed contracts demonstrate that RAGas reduces Gas usage by up to 11% and achieves high precision and recall in detecting code snippets exhibiting Gas wastage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAGas，一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的三阶段框架，利用大语言模型自动检测并修复以太坊智能合约中的Gas低效问题，实验表明最高可降低11%的Gas消耗。
AI.motivation: 以太坊智能合约的Gas费用随计算复杂度增加而上升，优化Gas密集型代码可显著降低部署成本。现有系统未能持续利用不断演变的Gas使用模式，缺乏系统性方法来自动检测和修复Gas低效问题。
AI.method: 作者系统分析了导致过度Gas使用的句法和语义构造，归纳出六个高层类别涵盖十二个细粒度反模式，构建了精选知识库。基于此，提出RAGas框架，采用三阶段检索增强生成方法，利用大语言模型精准定位并自动修复Gas低效问题。
AI.result: 在已部署合约上的实验表明，RAGas可将Gas使用量减少最高11%，且在检测展示Gas浪费的代码片段方面实现了高精确率和召回率。
AI.conclusion: RAGas通过结合系统化的反模式知识库与检索增强生成技术，能够有效自动优化智能合约的Gas效率，为持续利用演进中的Gas使用模式提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Beyond Similarity Matching: Structured Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Referring Segmentation in 3DGS
summary: Open-vocabulary referring segmentation in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) requires a neural model to select Gaussian primitives according to free-form language expressions. Existing 3DGS-based methods usually rely on global text-region similarity, which is weak for queries involving attributes, reference objects, spatial relations, and fine-grained parts. This often causes target-reference confusion, granularity mismatch, part-whole leakage, and relation violations. We propose QAGaussian, a query-adaptive neural reasoning framework for language-guided Gaussian primitive selection. QAGaussian first learns query-conditioned multi-scale Gaussian slots as differentiable candidates whose receptive fields are shaped by the input expression. It then builds a relation-aware slot graph with language-conditioned edge weighting to propagate target-reference, attribute, part-whole, and contextual evidence. A granularity-adaptive router softly combines region-level, object-level, part-level, attribute-aware, and relation-aware mask branches, followed by relation-constrained refinement for spatial, part-whole, attribute, and geometric consistency. QAGaussian is pretrained only on Mosaic3D-5.6M for Gaussian-text alignment and evaluated on independent benchmarks without target-dataset fine-tuning. It achieves 47.2 Avg. mIoU and 63.2 Avg. F1, outperforming the strongest 3DGS referring baseline by 2.7 mIoU points and 2.9 F1 points. It also improves Part-mIoU from 38.6 to 43.4, Rel-mIoU from 44.4 to 50.8, and reduces target-reference confusion from 10.8 to 7.4. These results demonstrate that query-conditioned slot learning, relation-aware graph reasoning, and adaptive routing provide an effective neural modeling strategy for open-vocabulary referring segmentation in 3DGS. The code is available at https://github.com/zqeslwyz/QAGaussian.

AI.tldr: 提出了QAGaussian，一个查询自适应的神经推理框架，用于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）中的开放词汇指代分割。通过查询条件化的多尺度高斯槽、关系感知槽图和粒度自适应路由器，解决了现有方法在属性、空间关系、细粒度部件等查询上的不足。仅在Mosaic3D-5.6M上预训练即可在独立基准上超越最强基线2.7 mIoU和2.9 F1。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS指代分割方法依赖全局文本-区域相似性，在处理涉及属性、参照对象、空间关系和细粒度部件的查询时表现脆弱，导致目标参照混淆、粒度不匹配、部分-整体泄漏和关系违反等问题。
AI.method: 1) 学习查询条件化的多尺度高斯槽作为可区分的候选；2) 构建语言条件边加权的关系感知槽图以传播目标-参照、属性、部分-整体和上下文证据；3) 粒度自适应路由器软性组合区域级、对象级、部分级、属性感知和关系感知的掩码分支；4) 关系约束细化保证空间、部分-整体、属性和几何一致性。
AI.result: 达到47.2 Avg. mIoU和63.2 Avg. F1，超越最强3DGS指代基线2.7 mIoU和2.9 F1。Part-mIoU从38.6提升至43.4，Rel-mIoU从44.4提升至50.8，目标参照混淆从10.8降至7.4。
AI.conclusion: 查询条件化槽学习、关系感知图推理和自适应路由为3DGS开放词汇指代分割提供了有效的神经建模策略，且无需目标数据集微调。

title: Group ICA 2.0: Closing the Gap Between Subjects and Group Latent Decomposition with Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA)
summary: Group Independent Component Analysis (gICA) is widely used to decompose high-dimensional functional MRI data into interpretable brain networks. However, conventional gICA primarily identifies components shared across subjects. This group-level assumption can limit the recovery of networks present only in individuals or subject subsets, reducing sensitivity to intersubject heterogeneity in clinical neuroimaging datasets. We introduce Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA), an algorithm in the Group ICA 2.0 framework that jointly estimates template-linked, cohort-only, and subject-only brain networks within a unified model. CoLiG-ICA combines ICA-based spatial decomposition, copula-based dependence modeling, and deep learning optimization to preserve the consistency and interpretability of template-constrained ICA while enabling free components beyond the reference networks. By linking subject decompositions to shared templates and jointly estimating cohort-only and subject-only sources, CoLiG-ICA represents individual variability not captured by conventional group priors. We evaluate CoLiG-ICA using resting-state fMRI data from the UCLA-CNP dataset and compare it with conventional constrained ICA in estimating template-linked components, discovering additional free components, improving component independence, and capturing subject-level variability beyond the shared group prior. Compared with MOO-ICAR, CoLiG-ICA showed significantly lower intercomponent spatial dependence, indicating improved subject-level component independence, and significantly reduced motion-related variance in the template-linked components. Additionally, in a schizophrenia-only group analysis, CoLiG-ICA identified three additional resting-state networks beyond the 53 template-linked NeuroMark components: one sensorimotor and two visual networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoLiG-ICA算法，属于Group ICA 2.0框架，通过结合ICA空间分解、copula依赖建模和深度学习优化，在统一模型中联合估计模板关联网络、队列特有网络和个体特有网络，以捕捉传统gICA忽略的个体间异质性。在UCLA-CNP静息态fMRI数据上验证，相比MOO-ICAR和传统约束ICA，CoLiG-ICA在组件独立性、运动相关方差控制和发现额外网络方面表现更优。
AI.motivation: 传统组级ICA主要识别受试者间共享的组件，这种组级假设限制了仅存在于个体或亚群中的网络恢复，降低了对临床神经影像数据中受试者异质性的敏感性。
AI.method: CoLiG-ICA在Group ICA 2.0框架下结合三种技术：(1) ICA空间分解用于提取脑网络；(2) copula依赖建模用于捕捉组件间非线性依赖；(3) 深度学习优化用于联合估计。该方法将受试者分解与共享模板关联，同时联合估计队列特有和个体特有的自由组件，超越参考网络的限制。
AI.result: 在UCLA-CNP静息态fMRI数据上：(1) 相比MOO-ICAR，CoLiG-ICA的组件间空间依赖性显著更低，表明个体级组件独立性更好；(2) 模板关联组件中与运动相关的方差显著减少；(3) 在精神分裂症患者组分析中，除53个模板关联的NeuroMark组件外，还识别出3个额外静息态网络（1个感觉运动网络和2个视觉网络）。
AI.conclusion: CoLiG-ICA能够有效捕获传统组级先验未能表征的个体变异性，提高组件独立性，并发现队列/个体特有的脑网络，为临床神经影像中受试者异质性分析提供了更全面的工具。

title: Nexus: Structured Synergy for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation using Rectified Flow Model
summary: Diffusion and flow matching models have made significant progress in text-to-image generation, yet high computation, quadratic complexity, and large memory footprint hinder high-resolution synthesis and edge deployment. We propose Nexus, which integrates sparse architecture, linear complexity, and low-bit quantization. It combines MoE feed-forward layers, gated DeltaNet attention, and per-expert low-bit training to reduce computation and memory. Their joint optimization allows Nexus to achieve generation quality comparable to mainstream models such as SDXL and SD3 while delivering markedly higher inference efficiency. Experiments on COCO and LAION validate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: Nexus是一个集成了稀疏架构、线性复杂度和低比特量化的文本到图像生成模型，通过MoE前馈层、门控DeltaNet注意力和逐专家低比特训练，在保持与SDXL和SD3相当生成质量的同时大幅提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型和流匹配模型在文本到图像生成中取得显著进展，但高计算量、二次复杂度和大的内存占用阻碍了高分辨率合成和边缘部署。
AI.method: Nexus集成了三种关键技术：MoE前馈层（稀疏架构）、门控DeltaNet注意力（线性复杂度）、以及逐专家低比特训练（低比特量化），通过联合优化减少计算和内存开销。
AI.result: 在COCO和LAION数据集上的实验表明，Nexus在生成质量上与SDXL和SD3等主流模型相当，同时实现了明显更高的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: Nexus通过稀疏架构、线性注意力和低比特量化的联合优化，成功在生成质量与推理效率之间取得了良好平衡，为高分辨率合成和边缘部署提供了可行的解决方案。

title: AdROD: HyperNetwork-based Adversarially Robust Object Detection for Autonomous Driving
summary: Camera-based object detectors are vulnerable to physical adversarial attacks designed to suppress detections. While adversarial training and input purification offer some protection, they often overfit to specific attack distributions and fail on adaptive adversaries. This paper presents AdROD, an embedded, stochastic ensemble defense software designed for autonomous driving. AdROD employs {\em low-rank HyperNetworks}, which require only 1.6\% of the parameter footprint of standard HyperNetworks, to generate diverse detectors at a per-frame rate, making it impractical for attackers to obtain the deployed detectors in time. To further improve adversarial robustness, AdROD incorporates a novel \emph{functional diversity} mechanism, which couples stochastic weight updates with unique input-space transformations. We design two serving modes of AdROD that strike different trade-offs between robustness and runtime overhead: AdROD-I, a continuous protection mode for maximum resilience that leverages inter-detector disagreement to recover compromised detections, and AdROD-II, an on-demand mode triggered by kinematic discontinuities in object tracking. Through comprehensive evaluation with synthetic benchmarks, physically deployed adversarial patches, and end-to-end safety tests in the OpenCDA co-simulator, AdROD outperforms five baseline defenses and exhibits superior generalizability compared with the evaluated adversarial-training baselines, while maintaining real-time performance for safely stopping the vehicle at a stop sign instrumented with adversarial patches.

AI.tldr: AdROD是一种面向自动驾驶的嵌入式随机集成防御软件，利用低秩HyperNetworks（仅需标准1.6%参数）生成多样化检测器，通过功能多样性机制和两种服务模式（AdROD-I连续保护与AdROD-II按需触发）来抵御物理对抗攻击，在合成基准、物理补丁攻击和OpenCDA协同仿真中均优于五种基线防御。
AI.motivation: 基于摄像头的目标检测器容易受到物理对抗攻击（如对抗补丁）的抑制。现有的对抗训练和输入净化方法往往过拟合到特定攻击分布，无法有效应对自适应攻击者。
AI.method: AdROD采用低秩HyperNetworks生成每帧更新的多样化检测器（参数仅占标准1.6%），使攻击者难以实时获取部署的检测器；引入功能多样性机制，将随机权重更新与独特的输入空间变换相结合；提供两种服务模式：AdROD-I（持续保护，利用检测器间分歧恢复被攻击的检测结果）和AdROD-II（按需模式，由目标跟踪中的运动学不连续触发）。
AI.result: 在合成基准、物理部署的对抗补丁以及OpenCDA协同仿真器的端到端安全测试中，AdROD优于五种基线防御，相比对抗训练基线展现出更优的泛化能力，同时在配备对抗补丁的停车标志场景中保持实时性能以安全停车。
AI.conclusion: AdROD通过嵌入式随机集成和低秩HyperNetwork设计，在鲁棒性与运行时开销之间取得了有效平衡，为自动驾驶系统提供了实用且可泛化的对抗防御方案。

title: Dear Algo: A Precision-First Agentic Intent Layer for Unified Search and Recommendation
summary:
Search and recommendation serve a shared discovery objective but encode intent differently. We study this boundary through Dear Algo on Threads, a deployed product where open-ended requests such as \emph{more NBA news} or \emph{less politics} steer subsequent feed recommendations rather than return a one-shot result list. Its agentic intent layer compiles explicit, inferred, negative, and compound intent into a grounded executable plan, then invokes conventional retrieval and optional semantic or multimodal reranking. The layer shares an intent-to-retrieval contract without requiring one model or serving path across search-like and recommendation-like modes.
  We evaluate Dear Algo under a precision-first objective. In a blinded audit of 300 public request-item pairs (296 evaluable), a strict categorical LLM-as-a-judge gate achieved 94.4\% exact-Relevant precision [88.8\%, 98.9\%]. Across 72 normalized request clusters, the full configuration produced 7.73 judge-qualified candidates per 20 slots versus 6.61 for an LLM-derived-query baseline, a gain of 1.11 [0.12, 2.12]. In a candidate-randomized serving-path study restricted to the reranker path's first 72 eligible hours, the user-weighted judge-Irrelevant share among judged admissions was 2.80\% versus 4.78\% off (-1.97 points [-3.02, -0.94]), while Exact-Relevant share was 2.24 points higher [0.08, 4.41].
  Together, these studies show how explicit natural-language intent can be carried into feed recommendation under a precision-first evaluation framework

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Threads上的Dear Algo产品，它通过代理意图层将开放式的自然语言请求（如"更多NBA新闻"或"减少政治"）编译为可执行的检索计划，从而在搜索与推荐之间架起桥梁。在精度优先的评估框架下，该系统的严格分类LLM评判门控实现了94.4%的精确相关精度，并在多个研究中显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 搜索和推荐虽有共同的目标（发现内容），但对意图的编码方式不同。作者希望研究这一边界，探索如何将显式的自然语言意图引入推荐系统，而非仅仅返回一次性结果列表。
AI.method: 提出了Dear Algo——Threads上已部署的产品。其代理意图层将显式、推断、负面和复合意图编译为可执行的计划，然后调用传统检索和可选的语义或多模态重排序。该层使用意图到检索的契约，无需在搜索式和推荐式模式间共享单一模型或服务路径。评估采用精度优先目标，结合盲审、LLM评判门控和服务路径随机化研究。
AI.result: 在300个公开请求-条目对的盲审中（296个可评估），严格分类LLM评判门控达到94.4%精确相关精度。在72个规范化请求簇中，完整配置产生7.73个合格候选（对比基线6.61个）。在随机化服务路径研究中，重排序路径的用户加权不相关条目占比为2.80%（对比4.78%），精确相关占比高出2.24个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 这些研究共同展示了如何在精度优先的评估框架下，将显式的自然语言意图有效地引入信息流推荐中，弥合了搜索式与推荐式意图表达之间的鸿沟。

title: SUGFW+: An Uncertainty-guided Feature Weighting Framework for Cold Start Active Adaptation of SAM in Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Cold Start Active Learning (CSAL) is important in improving the performance of a medical image segmentation model with low annotation budget by querying a small subset for annotation from an unlabeled training set. Existing CSAL methods typically rely on inefficient dataset-specific Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) to map the unlabeled images into a feature space for sample selection. Recently, the advent of foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) offer a promising alternative as the pre-trained model can provide strong generalizable feature embeddings, and allow high performance in downstream tasks after fine-tuning (adaptation). However, how to systematically exploit SAM's inherent embeddings for cold-start sample selection during adaptation with low annotation budget remains underexplored. To address this, we propose an extended SAM-based Uncertainty-guided Feature Weighting (SUGFW+) framework for CSAL and adaptation of SAM. Specifically, it leverages the SAM for Patch-level Feature and Uncertainty Calculation (PFUC), and introduces a Patch-based Global Distinct Representation (PGDR) module that aggregates patch-level embeddings into highly discriminative, uncertainty-aware image-level features. These features are then utilized by a Greedy Selection with Cluster and Uncertainty (GSCU) strategy to combine diversity and uncertainty during sample selection. Unlike prior CSAL methods that decouple sample selection from model training, SUGFW+ tightly integrates these two stages via an Uncertainty-Prompted Fine-Tuning (UPFT) process of SAM in model training. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that SUGFW+ achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing CSAL methods. Code is available at https://github.com/HiLab-git/SUGFW-plus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SUGFW+框架，利用SAM基础模型的预训练嵌入进行冷启动主动学习（CSAL）和自适应微调，通过补丁级特征与不确定性计算、全局判别表示聚合、以及贪婪选择策略（结合聚类与不确定性）进行样本选择，并通过不确定性提示微调过程将样本选择与模型训练紧密集成，在四个公开数据集上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CSAL方法依赖数据集特定的自监督学习（SSL）将未标注图像映射到特征空间进行样本选择，效率低下且泛化性差。SAM等基础模型虽能提供强泛化性特征嵌入，但如何系统地利用SAM固有嵌入进行低标注预算下的冷启动样本选择与适配仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: SUGFW+框架包含三个核心模块：(1) 基于SAM的补丁级特征与不确定性计算（PFUC）；(2) 补丁级全局判别表示模块（PGDR），将补丁级嵌入聚合为高判别性、不确定性感知的图像级特征；(3) 贪婪选择与聚类和不确定性策略（GSCU），结合多样性和不确定性进行样本选择；此外通过不确定性提示微调（UPFT）过程将样本选择与模型训练紧密集成，而不是像以往方法那样解耦。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，SUGFW+相比现有CSAL方法取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用SAM基础模型的特征嵌入并结合不确定性引导的特征加权与选择策略，SUGFW+显著提升了低标注预算下医学图像分割的冷启动主动学习性能，且代码已开源。

title: NICE: Scale-Stable Perturbations for Graph Neural Network Explanations via Noise Corruption
summary: Post-hoc Graph Neural Network (GNN) explainers commonly follow a Perturb-Query paradigm, inferring the importance of graph elements based on queried predictions to perturbed inputs. However, such perturbations often introduce substantial distribution shift, undermining the reliability of the queried predictions used to derive explanations. While existing efforts mainly improve perturbed graphs or stabilize model predictions on them, we revisit the perturbation mechanism itself. We show that the widely used Element-wise Masking(EM) suppresses edge-induced messages toward zero, causing deterministic scale contraction that accumulates across message-passing layers, a phenomenon we term Scale Drift. Consequently, prediction changes under EM may conflate information corruption with deviations in propagation scale. As a scale-stable alternative to EM, we introduce Noise Corruption (NC), which perturbs each message through matched-norm random-direction corruption while preserving the expected squared message norm. Building on NC, we propose NICE, a Noise Corruption-based explanation framework, which learns a Stochastic Restoration Boundary (SRB) under NC-induced uncertainty, balancing target-prediction restoration against compactness. Furthermore, Boundary-Integrated Gradient (BIG) converts this boundary into edge attributions by accumulating each edge's contribution to reducing restoration risk along the restoration path. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate stronger explanation performance and model faithfulness while confirming that NC substantially reduces the Scale Drift induced by masking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NICE框架，针对图神经网络后置解释器中Perturb-Query范式的缺陷，指出元素掩码(EM)会导致"尺度漂移"(Scale Drift)问题，即干扰预测可靠性的尺度收缩现象。作为替代，提出噪声破坏(NC)机制，并构建基于随机修复边界的解释框架NICE，通过边界积分梯度(BIG)生成边属性，在多个基准上取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 后置GNN解释器普遍采用Perturb-Query范式，但扰动会引入显著的分布偏移，破坏用于生成解释的预测可靠性。现有工作主要改进扰动图或稳定模型预测，却未审视扰动机制本身。作者发现广泛使用的元素掩码(EM)会抑制边消息至零，产生跨消息传递层累积的确定性尺度收缩（尺度漂移），导致预测变化混淆了信息破坏与传播尺度偏移。
AI.method: 1) 提出噪声破坏(NC)替代元素掩码(EM)：通过匹配范数的随机方向破坏每个消息，同时保持期望平方消息范数不变，实现尺度稳定扰动。2) 构建NICE解释框架：基于NC引入的不确定性，学习随机修复边界(SRB)，在目标预测修复与紧凑性之间取得平衡。3) 提出边界积分梯度(BIG)方法：沿修复路径累积每条边对降低修复风险的贡献，将边界转化为边属性得分。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，NICE取得了更强的解释性能和模型忠实度，同时证实NC能显著减少掩码引起的尺度漂移问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过重新审视扰动机制本身而非仅修补其副作用，揭示了EM的尺度漂移问题，并提供了尺度稳定的NC替代方案及完整的NICE解释框架，为后置GNN解释器提供了更可靠的基础。

title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/xmuruaga/bounded-agents
summary: LLM-based agents can act on behalf of a user to access cloud services, call tools, or invoke agents. At session start, the agent's permissions are set but remain static, and each request is evaluated independently, without considering prior actions. Within its permissions, an agent may act contrary to the delegated task, combine individually permitted actions into a prohibited outcome, or delegate authority to a sub-agent without limiting it. A prompt injection poses a risk only if the agent has authority to perform such actions; this is therefore a problem of authorization architecture, not just the model. The Agentic Principal Chain (APC) tracks delegated authority from one principal to the next. APC evaluates each request against the accumulated session state using six authorization checks. APC carries forward and restricts delegated scope and budgets. Using composition closure, APC checks requests against prior actions to prevent prohibited combinations and enforces the decision outside the model. We prove Blast Radius Monotonicity and Composition Soundness for APC implementations; Composition Soundness is limited to prohibited combinations under a complete restriction set and serialized admission. We evaluated 3,154 instances including InjecAgent, AgentDojo, and ASB. Our compromised-model evaluation tests APC independently of model behavior by inserting the ground-truth attack call after the first legitimate tool call. AgentDojo exfiltration fell from 75-100% to 0% across all four domains; APC blocked all 544 InjecAgent data-stealing cases. Intent binding reduced destruction from 38.6% to 4.0% and manipulation from 90.5% to 12.1%. Authorization latency was 0.24 ms at the 99th percentile on an idle host; across 949 AgentDojo task-injection pairs, utility was 8.6 and 13.9 percentage points lower in the two settings. Implementation, evaluation tools, and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Principal Chain (APC)框架，用于解决LLM智能体在授权架构中的安全漏洞。APC通过追踪委托授权链，在每次请求时结合会话状态执行六项授权检查，防止智能体通过组合个体允许的操作实现禁止后果。实验证明APC将AgentDojo数据外泄从75-100%降至0%，并显著降低破坏和操纵行为。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的权限在会话开始时设置后保持静态，每个请求被独立评估，不考虑先前的操作。这导致智能体可能违反委托任务、组合个体允许的操作产生禁止结果、或无限制地将权限委托给子智能体。提示注入的风险取决于智能体的授权架构，而不仅仅是模型本身，因此需要更完善的授权架构解决方案。
AI.method: APC追踪从一个主体到下一个主体的委托授权链，评估每次请求与累积会话状态的关系，执行六项授权检查。APC继承并限制委托范围和预算，使用组合闭包检查请求与先前操作的组合以防止禁止组合，并将决策强制在模型外部执行。作者还证明了Blast Radius Monotonicity和Composition Soundness性质，其中组合健全性在完整限制集和序列化准入下有效。
AI.result: 在3,154个实例上评估，包括InjecAgent、AgentDojo和ASB。受损模型评估在首个合法工具调用后插入真实攻击调用以独立测试APC。AgentDojo四个域的数据外泄从75-100%降至0%；APC阻止了全部544个InjecAgent数据窃取案例。意图绑定将破坏率从38.6%降至4.0%，操纵从90.5%降至12.1%。授权延迟在99百分位仅0.24ms。在949个AgentDojo任务-注入对中，两个设置的效用分别降低8.6和13.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: APC通过架构层面的授权控制有效解决了LLM智能体的安全问题，不仅在模型外强制执行决策以防止提示注入攻击，还能阻止禁止操作组合，且引入的延迟开销极低。该框架实现了强安全保证（组合健全性），同时保持了可接受的效用，为LLM智能体授权架构提供了实用解决方案。

title: TokenSTFormer: A Tokenized Spatial-temporal Attention Model for Holistic Motion Analysis in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis Screening
summary: Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS) is a prevalent spinal deformity in adolescents that, if left untreated, can result in severe health outcomes. Traditional screening methods are limited by subjective interpretation, reliance on professional expertise and low scalability. To address these challenges, we present ScoliGait dataset, which comprises 1,516 gait video clips paired with corresponding X-ray records. We also introduce TokenSTFormer, a novel model that tokenizes spatial and temporal semantics to enhance feature representation and convergence. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing vanilla Vision Transformer encoder across key metrics, including accuracy of 0.79. This study highlights the potential of leveraging holistic motion features derived from gait video and attention-based models for scalable, cost-effective AIS screening, paving the way for future clinical applications in scoliosis detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScoliGait数据集（1,516个步态视频片段配X光记录）及TokenSTFormer模型，通过将空间和时间语义进行token化来增强特征表示和收敛性，在AIS（青少年特发性脊柱侧弯）筛查中达到0.79的准确率，超越vanilla Vision Transformer，展示了基于步态视频的注意力模型在可扩展、低成本的脊柱侧弯筛查中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 传统AIS筛查方法依赖主观判断和专家经验，可扩展性差；现有步态分析方法在特征表示和模型收敛方面存在局限，缺乏大规模配对数据集。
AI.method: 构建ScoliGait数据集（1,516个步态视频+对应X光记录）；提出TokenSTFormer模型，将空间与时间语义进行token化以增强特征表示与收敛性能。
AI.result: TokenSTFormer在关键指标上达到最先进水平，准确率为0.79，超越vanilla Vision Transformer编码器。
AI.conclusion: 基于步态视频的整体运动特征与注意力模型可有效用于大规模、低成本的AIS筛查，为未来脊柱侧弯检测的临床应用奠定了基础。

title: OceanLight: Efficient Global Ocean Forecasting via Geometry-Adaptive Unstructured Mesh Representation
summary: Reliable global ocean forecasting is critical for climate monitoring, marine navigation, and extreme event early warning. Physics-based ocean forecasting models impose prohibitive computational costs, while existing deep learning approaches predominantly rely on structured-grid architectures, incurring unnecessary computation on masked land cells and enforcing uniform resolution across dynamically heterogeneous ocean regions regardless of local flow complexity. Here we present OceanLight, an efficient global ocean forecasting framework innovatively combining geometry-adaptive unstructured mesh tokenization with a graph neural network (GNN) backbone. OceanLight achieves pointwise forecast accuracy and kinetic energy spectral fidelity exceeding both operational numerical analyses and state-of-the-art AI-based models, while surpassing all AI-based ocean models in geostrophic balance consistency. Furthermore, OceanLight demonstrates reliable mesoscale eddy representation, capturing coherent ocean structures beyond pointwise statistical optimization. These capabilities are delivered with a 62% reduction in GPU memory consumption and 70\% reduction in FLOPs relative to structured-grid baselines. Our unstructured mesh representation establishes a generalizable paradigm for scalable data-driven oceanography.

AI.tldr: OceanLight是一个结合几何自适应非结构化网格tokenization与图神经网络（GNN）的高效全球海洋预报框架，在点级预报精度、动能谱保真度和地转平衡一致性上超越现有数值分析和AI模型，同时降低62%的GPU内存消耗和70%的FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 基于物理的海洋预报模型计算成本过高，而现有深度学习方法依赖结构化网格架构，在掩膜陆地单元上产生不必要的计算，且对所有海洋区域强制施加均匀分辨率，无法适应不同区域的局部流动复杂性。
AI.method: 提出OceanLight框架，创新性地将几何自适应的非结构化网格tokenization与图神经网络骨干相结合，通过非结构化网格表示实现计算资源的动态分配，对局部流动复杂区域给予更高分辨率。
AI.result: OceanLight在点级预报精度和动能谱保真度上超过操作化数值分析和最先进的AI模型，在所有AI海洋模型中地转平衡一致性表现最佳，并能可靠表示中尺度涡旋结构。同时相比结构化网格基线，GPU内存消耗降低62%，FLOPs降低70%。
AI.conclusion: 非结构化网格表示为可扩展的数据驱动海洋学建立了通用范式，为高效、高精度的全球海洋预报提供了新的可行路径。

title: Breaking and Defending LLM-Powered Social Media Bot Detection Systems
comment: Accepted at ACISP 2026 (Australasian Conference on Information Security and Privacy). Also accepted as a poster at IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P) 2026. Published in Pragmatic Cybersecurity 2026, 1(2), 10, https://doi.org/10.53941/pc.2026.100010. 19 pages, 11 figures
summary: The rise of social media bots poses a persistent threat, enabling misinformation, opinion manipulation, and the erosion of trust in online platforms. To combat this, machine learning systems have been developed to detect and limit bot activity, but attackers continuously adapt through techniques such as adversarial learning and behavior imitation, fueling an ongoing arms race between bots and detection tools. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved bot detection by enabling deeper semantic and contextual analysis of accounts and their content. However, this shift also introduces new attack surfaces, allowing adversaries to craft exploits that directly target the reasoning and generation mechanisms of LLM-based classifiers. Industry tools such as Anthropic's Claude Code Security similarly leverage LLMs for security-critical decisions, further motivating a careful study of their attack surfaces. In this work, we investigate both the offensive and defensive aspects of LLM-powered, threat-specific cybersecurity applications. While centered on the challenge of social media bot detection, our methodology and insights generalize to a broad class of LLM-powered cybersecurity systems, including phishing detection, email classification, and fraud analysis. We introduce two novel adversarial attack strategies that systematically exploit the semantic and contextual weaknesses of LLM-based classifiers, degrading their detection accuracy by up to 48%. To counter these threats, we propose a robust multi-LLM defense architecture designed to preserve detection reliability under adaptive adversarial conditions. Our solution, LSABRE (LLM-powered Social Adversarial Bot Recognition Ensemble), is a multi-LLM framework that substantially improves robustness across a range of attacks, maintaining 86% detection accuracy even under strong, adaptive adversarial pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM驱动的社交机器人检测系统中的攻防两面性。作者提出了两种新型对抗攻击策略，可降低LLM分类器检测准确率高达48%；同时提出了多LLM防御架构LSABRE，即使在强自适应对抗压力下仍能保持86%的检测准确率。
AI.motivation: 社交机器人对在线平台构成持续威胁，虽然LLM提升了机器人检测能力，但也引入了新的攻击面——对手可以直接针对LLM分类器的推理和生成机制进行攻击。此外，行业工具（如Claude Code Security）也在利用LLM做安全关键决策，因此迫切需要研究此类系统的攻击面和防御方法，而这一研究范式可推广到钓鱼检测、邮件分类、欺诈分析等广泛领域。
AI.method: 1) 提出两种新型对抗攻击策略，系统性地利用LLM分类器在语义和上下文层面的弱点；2) 提出LSABRE（LLM驱动的社交对抗机器人识别集成）多LLM防御架构，通过多模型集成的鲁棒设计在自适应对抗条件下保持检测可靠性。
AI.result: 两种新型攻击可将LLM检测准确率降低多达48%；LSABRE框架在强自适应对抗压力下仍能维持86%的检测准确率，显著提升了对多种攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 研究同时揭示了LLM驱动的网络安全应用（尤其是社交机器人检测）中漏洞的存在与可防御性，其方法论与见解可泛化至更广泛的LLM驱动网络安全系统（包括钓鱼检测、邮件分类、欺诈分析等），为安全关键型LLM应用提供了攻防研究框架。

title: Graph Neural Assisted Actor-Critic for Latency-Efficient Edge Vision System
summary: UAV on-board vision systems are widely used for different activities, including monitoring in no-fly zones. In this case, the vision-equipped UAV streams a video to a ground server where an operator assists its activities. The latency of video transmission has a profound impact on the effectiveness of the operator assistance. However, most techniques available for video transmission still incur significant latency costs. In this paper, we propose a graph convolutional neural network-assisted (GCN-Assisted A2C) deep reinforcement learning (DRL) system model to find the optimal pixel-correlated area of a suspicious object. We combine the Lagrangian dual form with gradient descent to prevent lack of convergence and over- and under-penalization constraint violation during latency optimization. The proposed system model sends a sub-group pixel-correlated area of the frame from the UAV to the server rather than the transmission of the whole video frame. The proposed framework utilizes the GCN model to explore hidden representations of feature-correlated groups of pixels. Moreover, the GCN supervises the A2C model, which selects a subgroup to enhance transmission latency, thus supervising the training of UAV actions in A2C. Experimental results show that GCN-assisted A2C reduces video frame transmission latency together with false detection rate in UAV vision systems over other DRL and state-of-the-art models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种图卷积神经网络辅助的深度强化学习（GCN-Assisted A2C）系统模型，用于无人机视觉系统中的视频传输延迟优化。该方法不传输完整的视频帧，而是仅传输可疑目标的像素相关子区域，并结合拉格朗日对偶形式和梯度下降防止收敛问题和约束违规，实验结果表明该方法在降低传输延迟和误检率方面优于其他DRL和先进模型。
AI.motivation: 无人机视觉系统在禁飞区监测等场景中需要将视频流传输到地面服务器供操作员协助，但现有视频传输技术存在显著的延迟成本，严重影响操作员协助的有效性。
AI.method: 1) 提出GCN-Assisted A2C深度强化学习系统模型，寻找可疑目标的最优像素相关区域；2) 结合拉格朗日对偶形式与梯度下降，防止优化过程中缺乏收敛以及过惩罚和欠惩罚的约束违规；3) 通过GCN模型探索特征相关像素组的隐藏表示，并监督A2C模型选择子组以增强传输延迟性能；4) 仅传输帧的子组像素相关区域而非完整视频帧。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GCN辅助的A2C模型在无人机视觉系统中相比其他DRL和先进模型，显著降低了视频帧传输延迟和误检率。
AI.conclusion: 通过只传输可疑目标的像素相关子区域并结合GCN监督的A2C强化学习模型，可以有效降低无人机视频传输延迟和误检率，为无人机视觉系统的实时监控应用提供了更高效的解决方案。

title: Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) with group-relative advantages has become the de facto standard for post-training language model reasoners. However, when optimizing multiple reward objectives, existing methods typically scalarize the reward vector with a fixed weighted sum before group-wise standardization. We show that this design leads to two fundamental problems: rollouts with distinct reward profiles can receive identical advantages, and all objectives are optimized with fixed relative weights regardless of their current level of saturation. As a result, training continues to allocate gradient budget to already-solved objectives instead of focusing on those with greater remaining headroom. We introduce \textbf{Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization} (SA-MRPO), which standardizes each reward objective independently and adaptively discounts its contribution according to a batch-level estimate of objective saturation. This dynamically reallocates optimization effort toward under-optimized objectives while empirically maintaining performance on those that are already well satisfied. We further show that saturation-aware reweighting can reverse the sign of an update, rather than merely rescale its magnitude. Across mathematical reasoning with two- and three-objective reward combinations, SA-MRPO improves the harder correctness objective over GDPO in 12 of 15 benchmark comparisons, with gains of up to $5\%$ on AIME24. On adaptive reasoning it improves accuracy on all five benchmarks, by $3.8\%$ on average and up to $9.2 \%$ on AMC23, and on coding benchmarks it improves pass rate by up to $2.3\%$, while in all settings maintaining the easier objectives near their already satisfied levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SA-MRPO方法，用于多奖励策略优化。与现有方法使用固定加权和标量化奖励不同，SA-MRPO独立标准化每个奖励目标，并根据批次级别的目标饱和度自适应地折扣其贡献，从而动态地将优化努力重新分配到尚未充分优化的目标上。
AI.motivation: 现有组相对优势RL方法在多奖励优化时存在两个根本问题：1) 不同奖励配置的rollout可能获得相同的优势值；2) 所有目标以固定相对权重优化，不考虑当前的饱和程度。这导致训练继续将梯度预算分配给已解决的目标，而不是关注具有更大提升空间的目标。
AI.method: SA-MRPO独立标准化每个奖励目标，并根据批次级别的目标饱和度估计自适应地折扣其贡献。该方法能动态重新分配优化努力到欠优化目标，同时保持已满足目标的性能，甚至能逆转更新的符号而不仅仅是调整幅度。
AI.result: 在数学推理中，两目标和三目标奖励组合下，SA-MRPO在15个基准比较中12个优于GDPO，在AIME24上提升高达5%；在自适应推理中，五个基准全部提升，平均提升3.8%，AMC23上最高提升9.2%；在编程基准上，通过率提升最高达2.3%，同时保持较容易目标的已满足水平。
AI.conclusion: SA-MRPO通过饱和度感知的重加权机制，有效解决了多奖励策略优化中固定权重标量化带来的问题，在多个任务领域均取得了显著且一致的改进，验证了自适应奖励权重分配的有效性。

title: Unified Pedestrian Path Prediction Using Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Pedestrian path prediction is crucial for enhancing the safety of autonomous vehicles and advanced driver-assistance systems. Previous studies explored different learning-task formulations for pedestrian path prediction and compared these formulations using shallow neural networks, but did not extend this analysis to more complex deep-learning models. This paper adapts the Spatial-Temporal Graph Attention Network (STGAT) to a unified pedestrian path prediction framework and introduces state and action definitions specific to STGAT. The resulting formulations support deterministic and stochastic policies, one-time and sequential decision-making, and reinforcement-learning algorithms including REINFORCE and proximal policy optimization. The proposed learning-task formulations improve prediction performance across the selected benchmark datasets compared with the standard supervised-learning formulation. These results demonstrate that reformulating the decision process and training objective can improve an advanced pedestrian trajectory prediction architecture and may provide a path toward improving other graph-based prediction models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的行人路径预测框架，将STGAT（空间-时间图注意力网络）适配到该框架中，并通过重新定义状态和动作来支持多种学习任务形式（如强化学习和顺序决策），在基准数据集上相比标准监督学习显著提升了预测性能。
AI.motivation: 此前行人路径预测研究虽然探索了不同的学习任务形式，但仅使用浅层神经网络进行比较，未将分析扩展到复杂的深度学习模型。本文旨在验证学习任务重新定义对复杂深度模型的改进效果。
AI.method: 将STGAT适配到一个统一的行人路径预测框架中，定义了特定于STGAT的状态和动作；支持确定性和随机策略、一次性与顺序决策，以及包括REINFORCE和PPO在内的强化学习算法。
AI.result: 所提出的学习任务形式在多个基准数据集上相比标准监督学习形式提升了预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 重新制定决策过程和训练目标可以改进先进的行人轨迹预测架构，并可能为改进其他基于图的预测模型提供路径。

title: The Right Prior for the Right Deformation: Rethinking Continuous Deformable Image Registration
summary: Deformable image registration models implicitly encode deformation priors through their parametrization and optimization. In this work, we conduct a validation study on continuous registration methods to examine how these implicit priors affect performance across different registration tasks. Classic B-Spline transformations impose locality, smoothness, and scale through their control-point structure, whereas recent INR-based methods impose different priors through neural parameterization and optimization. We compare INR-Dense (IDIR), which directly models a dense displacement field using a SIREN-based INR; INR-BSCP (SINR), which predicts B-Spline control points with an INR; D-BSCP, which directly optimizes single-scale B-Spline control points; and MR-D-BSCP, which adds a multiresolution coarse-to-fine scheme. Experiments on inter-subject brain MR registration (OASIS) and intra-subject exhale-to-inhale lung CT registration (DIR-LAB 4DCT) reveal different behavior across deformation regimes. On OASIS, where deformations are moderate but locally complex, D-BSCP matches or slightly outperforms INR-BSCP, suggesting that the B-Spline parameterization accounts for much of INR-BSCP's effectiveness. On DIR-LAB 4DCT, where respiratory motion is larger and more coherent, single-scale B-Spline methods (D-BSCP and INR-BSCP) are less suitable, while INR-Dense and MR-D-BSCP are more effective. Across both tasks, MR-D-BSCP achieves the best performance among the tested continuous parameterizations. These findings highlight that registration accuracy depends strongly on matching the induced deformation prior to the target motion pattern, and support prior-deformation matching as a practical design principle for medical image registration. Our code will be available at https://github.com/HengjieLiu/RightPriorDIR.

AI.tldr: 本文对连续图像配准方法进行验证研究，比较了几种隐式编码变形先验的方法（B-Spline和INR-based），发现在不同配准任务中，将变形先验与目标运动模式匹配是提升配准精度的关键设计原则。
AI.motivation: 可变形图像配准模型通过参数化和优化隐式编码变形先验，但这些隐式先验如何影响不同配准任务的性能尚未被系统验证。作者希望厘清不同连续参数化方法（经典B-Spline与近期INR-based方法）在不同变形场景下的表现差异。
AI.method: 对比四种连续配准方法：IDIR（SIREN-based INR直接建模稠密位移场）、SINR（INR预测B-Spline控制点）、D-BSCP（直接优化单尺度B-Spline控制点）、MR-D-BSCP（多分辨率粗到细B-Spline方案）。在两个任务上验证：OASIS（脑部MR，中等但局部复杂的变形）和DIR-LAB 4DCT（肺部CT，较大且更连贯的呼吸运动）。
AI.result: 在OASIS上，D-BSCP与INR-BSCP相当或略优，表明B-Spline参数化本身就贡献了大部分性能。在DIR-LAB上，单尺度B-Spline方法表现不佳，而INR-Dense和MR-D-BSCP更有效。MR-D-BSCP在两个任务中均取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 配准精度强烈依赖于诱导变形先验与目标运动模式的匹配程度。先验-变形匹配应作为医学图像配准的实用设计原则，多分辨率B-Spline参数化（MR-D-BSCP）在不同任务中展现出最好的泛化能力。

title: DeepOHeat-v2: Self-Improving Operator Learning for Fast and Trustworthy Thermal Optimization in 3D-IC Design
summary: Thermal-aware optimization of multi-die 3D integrated circuits evaluates many designs, each a costly heat-equation solve. Operator-learning surrogates replace this solve with a fast forward pass, ideally trained from physics alone, without labeled data. DeepOHeat-v1 made such surrogates fast and trustworthy, but only on low-contrast geometries. High-contrast multi-die stacks break it in two ways: discontinuous conductivities make the continuous physics loss ill-defined at material interfaces, and ill-conditioning ($κ_2(A_h) \approx 6 \times 10^4$) puts the discretized strong-form loss beyond first-order optimization. We propose DeepOHeat-v2 to overcome both. First, we train on a discretized physics loss that handles the discontinuities natively; its energy form reduces the prediction-space loss-Hessian conditioning from $κ^2$ to $κ$, and a matrix-preconditioned optimizer cuts the mean peak temperature error from over 30 K to 0.55 K. Second, because optimization leaves the training distribution, we propose a self-improving framework: a hotspot trust gate sends flagged placements to a reference solver, and the surrogate incrementally retrains on the refined solutions, keeping an update only when it improves held-out validation error. On a multi-die benchmark, the surrogate-true peak gap on the returned design falls from 1.12 K to 0.11 K, matching a solve-at-every-step optimizer while running $56\times$ faster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepOHeat-v2，一种用于多裸片3D集成电路热感知优化的无标签算子学习代理模型。它通过离散物理损失处理材料界面不连续性，利用能量形式与矩阵预条件优化器将平均峰值温度误差从30K以上降至0.55K，并引入热点信任门控的自改进框架，使代理-真值峰值温差从1.12K降至0.11K，同时比逐步求解优化器快56倍。
AI.motivation: 传统热感知的多裸片3D IC优化需要对每个设计进行代价高昂的热方程求解。DeepOHeat-v1虽然实现了快速且可信的无标签代理模型，但仅限于低对比度几何体。高对比度多裸片堆叠会让连续物理损失在材料界面处定义失效，且离散强形式损失的病态条件数（约6×10^4）使一阶优化无法收敛，亟需同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: DeepOHeat-v2提出两个关键改进：(1) 在离散物理损失上训练以原生处理不连续性，利用能量形式将预测空间损失-黑森条件数从κ²降至κ，并通过矩阵预条件优化器大幅提升收敛性能；(2) 提出自改进框架：热点信任门控将标记的布局发送至参考求解器，代理模型在精化解上增量重训，仅在改进验证误差时才保留更新。
AI.result: 在多裸片基准测试中，平均峰值温度误差从超过30K降至0.55K；代理-真值峰值温差从1.12K降至0.11K，与逐步求解优化器精度相当，但运行速度快56倍。
AI.conclusion: DeepOHeat-v2通过离散物理损失与自改进框架，成功将算子学习代理模型扩展到高对比度多裸片3D IC场景，在保持物理可信性的同时实现了显著的加速，为该类高维热优化问题提供了高效可靠的解决方案。

title: UI-Mate: Advancing Open-Weight Foundation GUI Agents with In-Context Demonstrations
comment: UI-Mate Technical Report. Project page: https://ui-mate.github.io
summary: Foundation GUI agents can automate complex digital tasks, but deployment is hindered by scarce and biased training data, ambiguous prompts, and unreliable execution. Routine workflows rely on user-specific tools and tacit conventions, so unstated instructions can produce arbitrary variations across runs. We present UI-Mate, a foundation GUI agent that integrates an environment-grounded training stack with in-context demonstration learning. UI-Mate makes three contributions: A Scalable Environment-Grounded Training Stack: A closed-loop data engine automates task generation, environment construction, rollout, filtering, capability balancing, SFT, and online RL across massively parallel environments via unified task-verifier bundles. In-Context Demonstration Learning: A mechanism that transforms multimodal demonstrations into flexible subtask-level workflows, follows relevant demonstrated steps, and re-plans from the live interface. OSWorkerBench Benchmark and Insights: A benchmark of 100 long-horizon office tasks across 41 applications that supports instruction-only and demonstration-guided evaluation. Its demonstration resources separate a 33-task self-demo setting, built from successful strong-agent rollouts of the same targets, from a 45-task variant-demo setting, built from human recordings of related but non-identical tasks. Experiments show that UI-Mate-27B sets a new open-weight state of the art on general computer-use benchmarks, scoring 77.0% on OSWorld-Verified and 66.2% on WindowsAgentArena. On OSWorkerBench, it reaches 41.0% strict success and 76.9% progress, outperforming its Qwen3.6-27B base by 17.7 and 24.5 points. On the 33-task self-demo subset, one demonstration raises strict success from 17.2% to 35.4% and progress from 67.9% to 81.1%, substantially improving long-horizon reliability. Project page: https://ui-mate.github.io.

AI.tldr: UI-Mate是一个基础GUI智能体，通过环境接地训练栈与上下文演示学习相结合，解决了基础GUI代理在训练数据稀缺、提示模糊和执行不可靠方面的部署难题。它提出了可扩展的环境接地训练栈、上下文演示学习机制和OSWorkerBench基准，在多个基准上取得了SOTA成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有的基础GUI智能体在实际部署中面临三大挑战：训练数据稀缺且有偏差、用户提示往往模糊不清、执行过程不可靠。日常工作中用户特定工具和隐式惯例的存在，使得未阐明的指令在不同运行中会产生任意变化，严重阻碍了GUI代理的实际应用。
AI.method: UI-Mate包含三个核心贡献：(1) 可扩展的环境接地训练栈：通过闭环数据引擎在超并行环境中自动化任务生成、环境构建、回滚、过滤、能力平衡、SFT和在线RL，并使用统一的任务验证器捆绑包；(2) 上下文演示学习机制：将多模态演示转化为灵活的子树级工作流，遵循相关演示步骤并基于实时界面重新规划；(3) OSWorkerBench基准：包含100个跨41个应用的长时程办公任务，支持仅指令和演示引导两种评估模式。
AI.result: UI-Mate-27B在通用计算机使用基准上刷新了开放权重SOTA，OSWorld-Verified得分77.0%，WindowsAgentArena得分66.2%。在OSWorkerBench上达到41.0%严格成功率和76.9%进度，比其Qwen3.6-27B基础模型分别高出17.7和24.5个百分点。在33任务自演示子集中，一个演示将严格成功率从17.2%提升至35.4%，进度从67.9%提升至81.1%。
AI.conclusion: UI-Mate通过环境接地训练栈和上下文演示学习的结合，显著提升了基础GUI智能体的长时程任务可靠性，验证了演示引导学习在解决模糊提示和隐式惯例问题上的有效性，为GUI代理的实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Towards Reasonable Molecular Structure Elucidation from Infrared Spectroscopy with Chemical Feedback
summary: Infrared (IR) spectra provide characteristic signals of molecular structure, which are often interpreted by experts via functional-group identification or library matching, making the process time-consuming and ambiguous. Recent machine learning methods have made progress in molecular structure elucidation using molecular formulas and IR spectra. However, these models often infer unreasonable candidate molecular structures, including top-ranked predictions. More specifically, the molecular formula implied by a candidate structure often fails to match the input molecular formula, and the candidate's theoretical IR spectrum is often inconsistent with the observed IR spectrum. To address these issues, we propose Formula- and IR-Matched Preference Optimization (FIRMPO), a general and plug-and-play chemical feedback-driven preference optimization framework for molecular structure elucidation. FIRMPO incorporates chemical feedback as preference signals based on exact molecular formula matching and IR spectral consistency to guide reasonable structure predictions. Unlike generic preference optimization methods, FIRMPO is tailored to molecular structure elucidation while remaining model-agnostic, enabling it to be readily integrated with different structure prediction models in this class. This encourages models to prioritize structures that satisfy the chemical feedback, leading to a substantial improvement in the accuracy of top-ranked predictions. Extensive experiments on three widely used IR datasets show that FIRMPO significantly improves molecular structure elucidation accuracy over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FIRMPO，一个基于化学反馈的偏好优化框架，通过精确分子式匹配和IR光谱一致性作为偏好信号，引导机器学习模型生成合理且准确的分子结构，在三类IR数据集上显著提升结构解析精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于机器学习的方法利用分子式和红外光谱进行结构解析时，即使排名最高的预测也常产生不合理的候选分子结构，具体表现为候选结构隐含的分子式与输入分子式不匹配，且候选的理论IR光谱与观测IR光谱不一致。这些问题严重制约了模型的实际可用性。
AI.method: 提出公式与IR匹配的偏好优化（FIRMPO）框架，将化学反馈（精确分子式匹配与IR光谱一致性）作为偏好信号融入偏好优化过程，指导模型优先预测满足化学约束的合理结构。该框架是即插即用且模型无关的，可与不同的结构预测模型灵活集成。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的IR数据集上进行的大量实验表明，FIRMPO相较于现有基线方法显著提升了分子结构解析的准确率，特别是在top-ranked预测的准确性方面提升明显。
AI.conclusion: FIRMPO通过将化学反馈作为偏好信号来约束结构预测，有效解决了现有模型生成不合理候选结构的核心问题，为分子结构解析提供了通用且可扩展的优化范式。

title: Augmenting Text to Increase Translation Difficulty
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. William Kalikman and Šimon Sukup contributed equally. Published in EAMT 2026. Code: https://github.com/BreakingMT/ATO. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/wskal/ATO-datasets
summary: As state-of-the-art machine translation models saturate standard benchmarks, the field needs more challenging evaluations to distinguish between models of varying quality. We propose augmenting existing benchmarks to increase translation difficulty by combining adversarial optimization with a differentiable translation difficulty estimator. Our Adversarial Translation Optimization (ATO) uses gradients from a combined difficulty and fluency objective to iteratively replace tokens. Because each step branches over candidate substitutions at every position, optimization becomes a tree search problem, which we address with Beam Search. ATO offers a gradient-based alternative to LLM-based dataset creation without LLM prompting, expensive human curation, or task-specific model training. Our ATO-modified benchmark lowers average translation quality (xCOMET) from 0.93 to 0.82, compared to 0.88 for paraphrasing and 0.86 for a zero-shot baseline. Human evaluation shows the modified texts are somewhat less natural than the baselines but remain reasonably grammatical and plausible while being substantially harder to translate. We release two datasets of 350 English texts each, generated by our methods, as well as the code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对抗性翻译优化（ATO）方法，通过可微分的翻译难度估计器结合对抗优化，对现有基准测试中的源文本进行迭代式替换，从而生成更具挑战性的翻译评估集。ATO采用束搜索处理分支搜索问题，无需LLM提示、人工标注或任务特定训练，能将平均翻译质量（xCOMET）从0.93降至0.82，显著高于基线的0.88和0.86，同时保持文本的语法合理性和可读性。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的机器翻译模型在标准基准测试上已趋于饱和，得分差异很小，难以区分不同质量模型之间的优劣。领域需要更具挑战性的评估方法来有效区分模型的性能差异。
AI.method: ATO方法将对抗优化与可微分的翻译难度估计器结合，利用组合的难度和流畅度目标的梯度迭代替换源文本中的词汇。由于每一步都在每个位置分支多个候选替换，优化过程成为树搜索问题，采用束搜索来解决。该方法不需要LLM提示、人工筛选或任务特定模型训练。
AI.result: ATO修改后的基准将平均翻译质量（xCOMET）从0.93降至0.82，对比基线：改写方法为0.88，零样本方法为0.86。人工评估表明修改后的文本虽然自然度略低于基线，但仍保持合理的语法性和可读性，且翻译难度显著提高。
AI.conclusion: ATO提供了一种基于梯度的替代方案来生成更具挑战性的翻译评估数据集，无需LLM提示、昂贵的人工筛选或任务特定模型训练，为机器翻译评估提供了区分模型质量的有效工具。作者发布了两个各含350条英文文本的数据集及代码。

title: Beyond Clear Skies: Synthetic Seasonal and Weather Variations for Real-World Drone Detection
summary: Reliable drone detection under real-world deployment conditions requires training data that spans the full operational design domain, including adverse weather and seasonal appearance variation. However, acquiring and annotating such data at scale remains highly resource-intensive, as adverse-weather conditions are inherently difficult to control, reproduce, and sample systematically. Existing datasets therefore typically provide only limited coverage of such conditions. Conversely, synthetic data offers a scalable alternative: environmental variation becomes controllable, while modern game-engine-based pipelines provide realistic rendering and automatic annotations. Leveraging this potential, we introduce SynDroneVision-Weather (SDV-W), an systematic extension of SynDroneVision (SDV) targeting adverse-weather and seasonal domain shifts in urban drone detection. SDV-W comprises 55,187 annotated high-resolution images from three urban environments, rendered across three seasonal configurations and diverse weather conditions, including rain, snow, and fog at multiple severity levels. By preserving SDV's scene and trajectory configuration, SDV-W enables matched clean-adverse comparisons and quantification of condition-specific detector degradation. Across representative YOLO models and real-world datasets, we show that SDV-W improves detector reliability under adverse appearance shifts, reduces missed detections and false alarms, and is most effective as a complement to general-purpose synthetic drone-detection data. SDV-W will be publicly released upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SynDroneVision-Weather (SDV-W)，一个系统化的合成无人机检测数据集扩展，覆盖恶劣天气（雨、雪、雾）和季节变化，包含55,187张高分辨率标注图像，用于提升无人机检测器在真实部署条件下的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 真实世界无人机检测需要覆盖全操作设计域的训练数据，但恶劣天气和季节变化的数据难以大规模获取和标注，现有数据集对此覆盖有限。合成数据提供可控且可扩展的替代方案。
AI.method: 基于SynDroneVision (SDV)进行系统化扩展，保持原有场景和轨迹配置，渲染三个城市环境在三种季节配置和多种恶劣天气（雨、雪、雾及不同严重等级）下的图像，实现匹配的干净-恶劣对比。
AI.result: 在代表性YOLO模型和真实世界数据集上，SDV-W改善了检测器在恶劣外观变化下的可靠性，减少了漏检和误报，且作为通用合成无人机检测数据的补充最为有效。
AI.conclusion: SDV-W证明了合成恶劣天气数据能有效提升无人机检测的鲁棒性，数据集将在论文被接收后公开发布。

title: Behaviour Is an Incomplete Measure of Reasoning Development: Cross-surface pre-arrival accessibility and the limits of developmental inference in a recurrent-depth reasoner
summary: Capability development is routinely inferred from behavioural thresholds, from final checkpoints, or from what a decoder can read out of a hidden state. These quantities need not identify the same event. We study a 30M-parameter recurrent-depth relational reasoner in a closed, oracle-defined world, using dense behavioural trajectories, two training surfaces, preregistered pre-arrival hidden-state probes, prospectively checked evaluability, and explicit untrained and negative controls, holding the training-time and inference-time axes separate throughout. Behaviour first: under one frozen acquisition criterion, three-hop competence cost 70 logical epochs on the symbolic surface and 13,055 on the verbal surface, a 186.5-fold contrast, after which verbal four-hop competence cleared in 8 logical epochs. Across the 13,055-epoch grind, four-hop held-out behaviour never exceeded 3/40 and ended at 0/40. Internal measurement next: on the verbal surface a linear probe recovered future-answer identity before behavioural arrival at 0.056159 against uniform chance 0.025, an untrained control of 0.024758 and a population frequency baseline of 0.048309 (p = 0.012987; 16/40 answer classes contributing). Analogous pre-arrival accessibility survived the surface change, reaching 0.1020 against a zero-step control of 0.0460 (p = 0.000999) at the upstream structural position and 0.0618 at the readout comparator (p = 0.004), with 21/40 classes contributing. Finally, the natural attempt to track that accessibility across training was not cleanly evaluable: probe eligibility is defined by behavioural arrival, so the measured population changes with the measurand. Behavioural competence, internal accessibility, and training-time development are distinct observables, and neither behaviour nor decoder accessibility identifies the computation training acquired; causal intervention is the necessary next step.

AI.tldr: 本研究在30M参数递归深度关系推理器中，分离了行为阈值、隐状态可读性和训练时间发展这三个不同观测指标。发现三者并不指向同一事件：符号表面3跳能力需要70个逻辑epochs，而语言表面需要13,055个epochs（186.5倍差异）；语言表面在线性探针能在行为到达前恢复未来答案身份（0.056 vs 随机0.025），该预先可达性跨越表面变化仍存（0.102 vs 对照0.046）。研究指出行为能力、内部可达性和训练时间发展是不同的可观测变量，因果干预是必要下一步。
AI.motivation: 传统上，能力发展通常从行为阈值、最终检查点或解码器从隐状态读出的内容来推断，但这些量未必指向同一认知事件。作者希望厘清行为能力、内部信息可达性与训练时间发展之间的关系，避免用单一指标误导对训练动态的理解。
AI.method: 采用30M参数的递归深度关系推理器，在封闭、神谕定义的世界中，使用密集行为轨迹、两种训练表面（符号与语言）、预先注册的隐状态探针、前瞻性可评估性检查，以及明确的未训练和阴性对照。严格分离训练时间轴与推理时间轴。
AI.result: 符号表面3跳能力需70 epochs，语言表面需13,055 epochs（186.5倍差异），随后语言表面4跳在8 epochs内获得。在13,055 epochs的漫长训练中，4跳留出行为从未超过3/40且最终为0/40。语言表面线性探针在行为到达前恢复未来答案身份（0.056 vs 均匀随机0.025，p=0.013），未训练对照为0.025，群体频率基线为0.048。跨表面变化的预先可达性仍存（0.102 vs 零步对照0.046，p=0.001）。但追踪该可达性的自然尝试不可清晰评估——探针资格由行为到达定义，测量群体随被测量对象变化。
AI.conclusion: 行为能力、内部可达性与训练时间发展是截然不同的可观测变量。行为和解码器可达性都不能唯一标识训练获得的计算。因果干预是必要下一步。

title: Navigation-Informed Embeddings: Dense-Retriever Adaptation from Agent Search Traces
summary: Agentic retrieval workflows produce query, retrieval, and stopping traces as a byproduct of answering questions. We study how these traces can adapt a deployed dense retriever to changing workflow distributions without new relevance labels, synthetic queries, or LLM judgments. We introduce Navigation-Informed Embeddings (NIE), a family of trace-derived objectives. NIE-Stop turns the stopping document into a soft positive; NIE-Path additionally uses preceding path documents as hard comparisons and imposes ordinal constraints with geometric decay. A BGE encoder adapted from retained source trajectories improves support Recall@20 on an independent target benchmark from 72.2 to 78.0 overall. NIE-Stop reaches 76.9 overall and 52.3 on long paths; NIE-Path raises long-path performance to 55.4, compared with 46.7 for the unadapted encoder. A shuffled-order control under the full path objective loses 3.2 points. Without public-benchmark training, the same adapter also improves nDCG@10 by 1.9 points on standard BEIR HotpotQA. NIE therefore provides a lightweight adaptation channel for settings where trajectories are already retained, with zero incremental labeling cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出导航信息嵌入（NIE），利用智能体检索工作流产生的查询、检索和停止轨迹来适应部署中的稠密检索器，无需新标注、合成查询或LLM判断。NIE-Stop将停止文档作为软正例，NIE-Path利用路径文档施加有序约束，在目标基准上将support Recall@20从72.2提升到78.0，并显著提升长路径性能，零增量标注成本。
AI.motivation: 部署中的稠密检索器需要适应不断变化的工作流分布，但传统适应方法依赖新的相关性标注、合成查询或LLM判断，成本高昂。作者观察到智能体检索工作流在回答问题过程中本身产生了丰富的查询、检索和停止轨迹，这些轨迹可作为免费的适应信号。
AI.method: 提出NIE（Navigation-Informed Embeddings）系列轨迹衍生目标函数。NIE-Stop将停止文档视为软正例；NIE-Path额外利用路径中的前序文档作为硬对比样本，并以几何衰减施加有序约束，使得BGE编码器从保留的源轨迹中自适应学习。
AI.result: 在独立目标基准上，NIE将support Recall@20从72.2提升至78.0；NIE-Stop达到76.9（长路径52.3），NIE-Path将长路径性能提升至55.4（未适应编码器为46.7）。打乱顺序控制实验损失3.2点。在标准BEIR HotpotQA上nDCG@10提升1.9点，且未使用公共基准训练。
AI.conclusion: NIE为已保留轨迹的场景提供了一条轻量级适应通道，零增量标注成本即可显著提升检索器性能和泛化能力，验证了工作流轨迹作为无监督适应信号的有效性。

title: Picking the Right Image to Classify: Reliable-Input Selection in Teledermatology
summary: Dermatology models face distribution shifts in teledermatology settings, where submitted images differ from the training data in lighting, angle, distance, focus, and framing. These test-time images are ordinary clinical photographs, but some fall outside the model's training conditions, leading the model to often misclassify them due to shifts in acquisition between training and deployment. When multiple images of the same case exist (several photos of one patient or lesion), a natural way to improve accuracy is therefore to select the image the model is most likely to classify correctly. We call this task reliable-input selection. An oracle that, for each case, selects a correctly classified image when one exists raises weighted F1 by about 20 percentage points on average across six dermatology datasets and nine frozen backbones. This oracle is an upper bound that sees the labels, whereas a selector must choose blindly. Capturing this gain in practice is hard. A selector that needs no pretraining data applies to any frozen model, including those whose data is not public. It must judge reliability from quantities the model exposes at inference: its embeddings, their norms, and its confidence. We benchmark four such training-data-free selectors: the embedding norm, the neighborhood consensus among a case's images, the stability of the prediction under small perturbations, and the model's own confidence. No training-data-free selector substantially narrows this oracle gap. The best of them is the model's own confidence, but it recovers only a small part of the gap on the clinical datasets. A small labeled reference set does not help either: the best selector overall, a fusion of confidence and Mahalanobis distance, still leaves most of the gap. To our knowledge, this is the first study to introduce and benchmark reliable input selection, a clinically important, unsolved task.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出并系统评估了"可靠输入选择"任务：在远程皮肤科场景中，当同一病例存在多张临床照片且模型因分布偏移可能误分类时，如何在不依赖训练数据的情况下，从这些图像中选出模型最可能正确分类的那一张。研究发现，虽然理想选择器（oracle）可使加权F1提升约20个百分点，但所有无需训练数据的选择器（嵌入范数、邻域一致性、预测稳定性、模型置信度）以及有少量标签参考集的选择器均无法大幅缩小这一差距，该任务目前仍未被解决。
AI.motivation: 远程皮肤科诊断中，图像在光照、角度、距离、焦距和构图等方面与训练数据存在分布偏移，导致模型对部分测试图像误分类。当同一病例有多张图像时，选择模型最可能正确分类的图像是提升准确率的自然思路，但这一"可靠输入选择"任务此前未被正式研究和评估。
AI.method: 定义一个"可靠输入选择"任务：在每病例多图中选择模型最可能正确分类的图像（oracle为上限基准，基于标签选择）。提出了四类无需训练数据的选择器：嵌入范数、病例图像间邻域一致性、预测对小扰动的稳定性、模型自身置信度；此外还评估了带少量标签参考集的方法（融合置信度与Mahalanobis距离）。在六个皮肤科数据集和九个冻结骨干网络上进行基准测试。
AI.result: Oracle选择器（看到标签的上界）平均可将加权F1提升约20个百分点。但所有无需训练数据的选择器均无法大幅缩小与oracle的差距，其中模型自身置信度表现最佳，仅能挽回临床数据集上的一小部分差距。即便引入小规模标注参考集，最佳选择器（置信度与Mahalanobis距离融合）仍留下大部分差距。
AI.conclusion: 可靠输入选择是一个临床上重要但尚未解决的任务。目前无论是否有标签参考数据，所有基准选择器都无法有效实现oracle所展现的巨大性能提升潜力，该问题仍亟待进一步研究。

title: Unifying Graph Neural Networks Through a Common Layer Equation
comment: 133 pages, including appendix; includes figures and tables
summary:
Graph neural networks are commonly described through family-specific equations whose notation obscures shared computations and structural differences. We introduce a common layer equation that represents covered architectures through seven components: an update domain, channel set, propagation bank, per-channel message maps, channel-fusion operator, ego/residual map, and update map. The central factorization separates where information moves, encoded by the propagation bank, from what moves, encoded by the message maps. Function-valued fillings extend the same equation across local message passing, attention, spectral filtering, global communication, relation-specific channels, higher-order domains, and geometric messages.
  We make this unification explicit and checkable through worked reductions of canonical layers and component assignments spanning seven nonexclusive architectural families. A fixed slot discipline assigns operations by computational role and defines the framework's coverage boundary. The decomposition also yields component-level theoretical insights: under endpoint-local messages and node-local updates, operator support bounds one-layer dependencies, and one-layer global mixing requires a full effective operator row under the stated hypotheses.
  The resulting framework organizes more than 200 architectures in a common design space, enables component-wise comparison and generation of structurally consistent architectures, and connects propagation choices to oversmoothing, oversquashing, heterophily, and expressivity. It further exposes the empirical inverse problem of mapping measurable graph and task properties to validated component choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的图神经网络层方程，通过七个组件（更新域、通道集、传播库、每通道消息映射、通道融合算子、自我/残差映射、更新映射）来表征超过200种GNN架构，并将信息传递分解为"信息去向"（传播库）和"信息内容"（消息映射）两个核心维度。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络通常通过各家族特有的方程描述，这些方程在符号层面掩盖了共享的计算逻辑和结构差异，导致不同架构之间难以进行系统性比较和组件级分析。
