AI.method: 提出一个统一的层方程框架，由七个组件构成，通过函数值填充将同一方程扩展到局部消息传递、注意力、谱过滤、全局通信、关系特定通道、高阶域和几何消息等七类架构家族。采用固定的插槽规范（slot discipline）按计算角色分配操作，并定义框架的覆盖边界。
AI.result: 该框架组织了超过200种架构，实现了组件级比较和结构化一致架构的生成，将传播选择与过平滑、过挤压、异质性、表达力等概念联系起来，并揭示了从可测量的图和任务属性到经验验证的组件选择的映射这一实证逆问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一框架和组件级分解，论文为GNN架构提供了系统的设计空间和理论洞见，确立了覆盖边界并指出了未来研究方向（实证逆问题）。

title: PCT-Prompt: A Prompt-Guided Transformer Framework for Dense Prediction Tasks in Point Clouds
summary: Standard Transformers have proven effective in point cloud object classification, but their performance in dense prediction tasks within complex scenes is often hindered by weak prior assumptions. To address this challenge, we propose PCT-Prompt, a novel framework that enhances standard Transformers by introducing a prompt-guided feature branch to improve performance in dense prediction tasks. The standard Transformer branch leverages pre-trained models for global feature extraction from point cloud data, serving as the backbone for processing high-level features. Meanwhile, the prompt-guided feature branch consists of two key components: a fine-grained feature extraction block that captures multi-scale geometric features using geometry-sensitive abstraction layer, along with the PnP-3D layer to integrate local context with global regularization. The second component, the prompt-refined feature learning block generates prompt tokens, which are subsequently refined through cross-attention mechanisms. Additionally, we introduce a prompt drop mechanism that progressively removes prompt information across Transformer layers, balancing local details and global consistency. Experimental results on the ShapeNetPart, S3DIS, and DALES datasets demonstrate that PCT-Prompt significantly improves the adaptability of standard Transformers to dense prediction tasks, achieving strong performance in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: PCT-Prompt是一种通过引入提示引导特征分支来增强标准Transformer在点云密集预测任务中性能的框架。它结合了预训练Transformer分支进行全局特征提取，并设计了一个包含细粒度特征提取块（使用几何敏感抽象层和PnP-3D层）和提示精炼特征学习块（通过交叉注意力生成和精炼提示令牌）的提示引导分支。同时引入提示丢弃机制来平衡局部细节和全局一致性，在ShapeNetPart、S3DIS和DALES数据集上取得了显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer在点云物体分类任务中表现优异，但在复杂场景下的密集预测任务中，由于缺乏较强的先验假设，其性能往往受到限制。作者旨在解决这一挑战，提升标准Transformer在密集预测任务中的适应能力。
AI.method: 提出PCT-Prompt框架，包含两个分支：1) 标准Transformer分支，利用预训练模型进行全局特征提取作为骨干网络；2) 提示引导特征分支，由细粒度特征提取块（采用几何敏感抽象层捕获多尺度几何特征，结合PnP-3D层整合局部上下文与全局正则化）和提示精炼特征学习块（生成提示令牌并通过交叉注意力机制精炼）组成。此外引入提示丢弃机制，在Transformer层间逐步移除提示信息以平衡局部细节与全局一致性。
AI.result: 在ShapeNetPart、S3DIS和DALES三个数据集上的实验表明，PCT-Prompt显著提升了标准Transformer在密集预测任务中的适应性，在真实场景中取得了强性能表现。
AI.conclusion: PCT-Prompt通过提示引导机制有效增强了标准Transformer在点云密集预测任务中的能力，证明了引入提示分支和丢弃策略能够有效平衡局部几何细节与全局语义一致性。

title: AsyTO: Asymmetric Temporal Operator for Parameter-Efficient Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate time-series forecasting faces a structural dilemma: sharing one temporal predictor across variables is parameter-efficient but forces heterogeneous variables through an identical history-to-future map, whereas learning an independent predictor per variable restores flexibility at a cost that grows with the product of variable count, context length, and horizon. We argue that this dilemma dissolves once the object being compressed is the forecasting operator rather than the observed series. Auditing per-variable linear history-to-future maps across standard benchmarks, we find that a phase-locked seasonal component paired with a compact residual operator outperforms a dense phase-blind reference in most audited settings. The residual transport is also directional: lag-invariant alternatives consistently underperform asymmetric history-to-future maps. Guided by this structure, we propose AsyTO, an Asymmetric Temporal Operator that factorizes the tensor of per-variable operators into shared but distinct history-reading and future-writing temporal modes with per-variable mode-wise gains, complemented by a low-rank periodic prototype and a cycle-separable factorization of the temporal modes. Each forecast reads only its own variable's history, so parameters and compute grow linearly in the number of variables. Across eleven benchmarks and multiple forecast horizons, AsyTO attains the best lightweight error in 30 of 44 dataset-horizon settings, locating at the accuracy-compute Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AsyTO（不对称时序算子），通过压缩预测算子而非观测序列来解决多变量时间序列预测中的结构困境。AsyTO将逐变量的线性预测算子分解为共享但不同的历史读取和未来写入时序模式，辅以低秩周期原型和周期可分离分解，使参数和计算量随变量数线性增长，在11个基准、44个数据集-预测范围设置中30个达到最佳轻量级误差。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列预测面临结构性两难：跨变量共享单一预测器参数高效但强制异构变量经历相同的历史到未来映射；每个变量独立预测器虽灵活却成本随变量数、上下文长度和预测范围的乘积增长。作者论证当压缩对象是预测算子而非观测序列时，这一困境得以化解。
AI.method: 通过审计基准数据集上的逐变量线性历史到未来映射，发现相位锁定季节性分量配紧凑残差算子优于密集相位盲参考；残差传输具有方向性（非对称优于滞后不变）。基于此提出AsyTO：将逐变量算子张量分解为共享但不同的历史读取与未来写入时序模式，附逐变量模式增益、低秩周期原型及周期可分离分解。每个预测只读取自身变量历史，参数和计算随变量数线性增长。
AI.result: 在11个基准数据集的多个预测范围上，AsyTO在44个数据集-预测范围组合中的30个达到最佳轻量级误差，位于准确率-计算量的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 压缩预测算子而非观测序列是更优的建模思路；时序映射的不对称结构（历史读取与未来写入分离）和相位锁定的周期分量是提升多变量预测性能的关键设计原则。

title: ALPS: Measuring Valid Creativity in Large Language Models with Mathematical Construction
summary: Large language models produce outputs presented as discoveries - new proofs, conjectures, or molecules. Whether such an output that appears creative is truly original and effective is hard to establish: open-ended outputs require subjective judgment, the output may replicate something seen in training, or the task may be too simple to need creativity. We present ALPS (Austin-Law Proof-Synthesis), a benchmark that designs a task to measure valid creativity: producing a solution that is original and can be proven correct. Each instance is a single equational law, certified to require either the construction of an infinite mathematical structure satisfying the law, or a proof that no such structure exists. Submissions are verified by automated proof checking with no human involvement, and a public generator produces new instances without limit, so LLMs are never evaluated on problems they may have seen. A portfolio of eight configurations of leading automated provers resolves 2.2% of the 4,141-law evaluation pool, and a twentyfold budget increase adds 0.6%: the obstacle is not compute, but the absence of any method that produces the tailored structure each law requires. Under a fixed protocol, the strongest reasoning model we test succeeds in 14% of instances on the proof side, but none on the construction side. The remaining 97.2% of the pool is unresolved at every configuration and budget we test. We release ALPS in full: the corpus, the generator, and the automated judge.

AI.tldr: ALPS是一个用于衡量大语言模型真正创造力（原创且可证明正确的解决方案）的基准测试，基于等式定律自动生成无限实例，通过自动化证明检查进行验证，测试结果显示即使是领先的推理模型和自动定理证明器也只能解决极小比例的问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型会产生看似具有发现性的输出（新证明、猜想或分子），但很难判断这些输出是否真正原创且有效：开放式输出需要主观判断、输出可能只是复现训练数据、或者任务本身过于简单。需要一个能够客观衡量"有效创造力"（原创且可证明正确）的基准。
AI.method: ALPS基准的每个实例是一个等式定律，要求要么构造满足该定律的无限数学结构，要么证明不存在这样的结构。提交通过自动化证明检查验证（无需人工参与），公共生成器可无限产生新实例以防模型见过训练数据。使用八个配置的领先自动证明器组合以及最强的推理模型进行评估。
AI.result: 八个自动证明器配置仅解决4,141条定律评估池的2.2%，预算增加二十倍仅提升0.6%（瓶颈是方法而非计算）；最强的推理模型在证明侧成功率为14%，但构造侧为0%；剩下97.2%的实例在所有配置和预算下都未解决。
AI.conclusion: 当前无论是自动定理证明器还是最强的大语言模型推理模型，都缺乏为每条定律量身定制数学结构的创造力。ALPS揭示了现有方法在需要真正原创性构造的任务上的根本性局限，为未来的创造力评估提供了客观、可扩展的基准。

title: GaussianDWM++: Language-Grounded 3D Gaussian Driving World Model for Unified Scene Understanding, Editing, and Multi-Modal Generation
summary: Driving World Models (DWMs) have recently advanced rapidly with generative models, yet most existing methods mainly focus on conditional scene generation and lack explicit 3D scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, and controllable 4D editing capabilities. Moreover, commonly used point cloud, occupancy, or BEV representations make it difficult to achieve fine-grained alignment between textual information and the underlying 3D scene structure. To address these limitations, we propose a foundation-feature Gaussian driving world model that unifies scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, controllable 4D editing, and multi-modal generation within a single framework. Specifically, we introduce a foundation-feature Gaussian tokenizer that directly distills Qwen/SigLIP visual-language features into 3D Gaussian primitives, building a compact open-vocabulary Gaussian semantic field. We further design a geometry-aware Gaussian adapter that combines importance-aware hierarchical selection with text-conditioned Perceiver-style cross-attention to aggregate dense Gaussian primitives into compact world tokens. To improve representation compatibility, we introduce a KL-based Gaussian--image distribution alignment objective that aligns Gaussian world tokens with foundation image tokens. Based on the aligned Gaussian representation, our framework further supports instruction-controllable scene editing, including weather-conditioned generation and dynamic vehicle manipulation. Extensive experiments on broader driving benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across scene understanding, visual grounding, planning-oriented reasoning, and controllable 4D generation tasks. We will release the code and datasets publicly on Github.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基础特征高斯驾驶世界模型（Foundation-feature Gaussian Driving World Model），该模型将Qwen/SigLIP视觉语言特征蒸馏到3D高斯基元中，构建了开放词汇高斯语义场，并通过几何感知高斯适配器聚合紧密的高斯基元为世界令牌，实现了场景理解、语言接地推理、可控4D编辑和多模态生成的统一框架。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型主要关注条件场景生成，缺乏显式3D场景理解、语言接地推理和可控4D编辑能力；同时常用的点云、占用网格或BEV表示难以实现文本信息与底层3D场景结构的细粒度对齐。
AI.method: 1）提出基础特征高斯分词器，将Qwen/SigLIP视觉语言特征直接蒸馏到3D高斯基元中，构建紧密的开放词汇高斯语义场；2）设计几何感知高斯适配器，结合重要性感知的层次选择与文本条件Perceiver式交叉注意力，将密集高斯基元聚合并紧凑世界令牌；3）引入基于KL的高斯-图像分布对齐目标，使高斯世界令牌与基础图像令牌对齐；4）基于对齐的高斯表示，支持指令控制的场景编辑，包括天气条件生成和动态车辆操控。
AI.result: 在多个驾驶基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在场景理解、视觉接地、规划导向推理和可控4D生成任务上均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了将基础视觉语言特征与大3D高斯表示相结合，能够在单一框架内统一驾驶场景的多项关键能力（理解、推理、编辑、生成），为驾驶世界模型的发展提供了新方向。代码和数据集将公开。

title: RetroMPA: A Molecular Property-Aware Auxiliary Framework for Enhancing Retrosynthesis Prediction
comment: Accepted for publication in Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
summary:
Retrosynthesis is a cornerstone of drug discovery and organic synthesis. While data-driven deep learning models have shown remarkable progress, they autonomously learn reaction patterns from extensive datasets with limited integration of established chemical knowledge as priors.
  To address this limitation, we introduce RetroMPA, a molecular property-aware, post-hoc enhancement module that injects chemical knowledge into the retrosynthesis pipeline. Rather than functioning as an independent SMILES sequence generator, RetroMPA is a broadly applicable, model-agnostic chemical filter designed to recalibrate and optimize the predictive pathways of existing algorithms.
  This plug-and-play framework integrates seamlessly with a range of data-driven retrosynthesis methods, enhancing outputs without modifying model architecture or requiring resource-intensive retraining. By leveraging a property-aware latent embedding space, RetroMPA consistently improves top-1 accuracy across eight representative retrosynthesis models by an average of 5.50% on USPTO-50K.
  Furthermore, we validate its scalability on the large-scale USPTO-Full dataset, achieving an average improvement of about 2.03% across both template-based and template-free architectures.
  Wet-lab experiments provide preliminary support for the practical utility of the framework. These syntheses confirmed viable, previously unreported substrate combinations for classic reaction paradigms---specifically, Suzuki-Miyaura coupling, Bucherer reaction, and Friedel-Crafts acylation---suggesting that RetroMPA can operate beyond mere data fitting. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/MengzhouLu/RetroMPA.

AI.tldr: RetroMPA 是一个模型无关的后处理增强模块，通过注入化学知识（属性感知的潜在嵌入空间）来重新校准和优化现有逆合成预测模型的输出，无需修改模型架构或重训练。在USPTO-50K上平均提升8个模型的top-1准确率5.50%，在USPTO-Full上平均提升约2.03%，并通过湿实验验证了其实用价值。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据驱动逆合成深度学习模型虽然取得了显著进展，但缺乏对已有化学知识的整合作为先验。作者希望将化学知识注入逆合成流程，以弥补纯数据驱动方法的不足。
AI.method: RetroMPA是一种化学过滤器，基于属性感知的潜在嵌入空间，对现有逆合成算法的预测路径进行重新校准和优化。它是一个即插即用的模块化框架，无需修改模型架构或重新训练，可无缝集成到多种数据驱动的逆合成方法中。
AI.result: 在USPTO-50K数据集上，RetroMPA对八个代表性逆合成模型平均提升top-1准确率5.50%；在USPTO-Full大规模数据集上，对模板基和模板自由两种架构平均提升约2.03%。湿实验证实了其能发现可行且此前未报道的底物组合（Suzuki-Miyaura偶联、Bucherer反应、Friedel-Crafts酰化）。
AI.conclusion: RetroMPA证明了一种轻量级、模型无关的后处理增强方法可以有效整合化学知识并提升逆合成预测性能，且其价值超越了单纯的数据拟合，能够在实际实验室合成中发挥实用作用。

title: MUPA$^{2}$E: Multimodal Unified Perception with Asymmetric Attention for Emotion Assessment
summary: Automatic emotion assessment can benefit from combining neural and behavioral signals, but many multimodal approaches rely on separate, modality-specific feature-extraction pipelines before fusion. This paper presents MUPA\textsuperscript{2}E, a unified perception framework that processes facial video and electroencephalography (EEG) through a single shared asymmetric-attention backbone. Facial video is represented through axis-folded frame tokens, while EEG is processed either as a raw multichannel waveform or projected into the spatial domain for multimodal fusion. The framework is evaluated on the DMER dataset under a stratified subject-independent protocol, comparing unimodal video, unimodal EEG, and fused video--EEG configurations with per-channel and merged EEG projections. Using the original recordings, with shorter trials zero-padded to match the longest duration, merged fusion at stride~$30$ achieves the highest validation performance and a test accuracy of $70.07\%$. Further analysis revealed that recording duration is unevenly distributed across the affective classes, making the padding pattern a potential classification cue. Controlling for this factor by cropping all recordings to a common duration of $20$ seconds yielded a test accuracy of $62.71\%$, providing a stricter duration-controlled assessment of the framework in which differences in recording length are removed as a potential classification cue. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of processing structurally different neural and visual signals within a compact unified architecture while highlighting the importance of controlling duration-related cues in affective datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MUPA²E，一个统一的感知框架，通过单一共享的异步注意力主干同时处理面部视频和脑电（EEG）信号进行情感识别。在DMER数据集上采用分层独立被试协议评估，融合配置在原始记录（步长30）下达到70.07%的测试准确率；控制时长差异后为62.71%。研究发现录制时长在情感类别间分布不均，可能成为分类线索，因此提供了时长受控的更严格评估。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感识别中，现有方法通常依赖分离的、模态特定的特征提取管道再进行融合，缺乏统一的处理架构，且忽略了数据集中录制时长分布不均可能充当分类线索的问题。
AI.method: 提出MUPA²E统一感知框架：用单一共享异步注意力骨干同时处理面部视频和EEG。面部视频通过轴折叠帧令牌表示，EEG可处理为原始多通道波形或投影到空间域进行多模态融合。在DMER数据集上采用分层独立被试协议评估，对比单模态视频、单模态EEG及融合配置（逐通道和合并EEG投影）。
AI.result: 原始记录下，步长30的合并融合取得最高验证性能和70.07%测试准确率。时长受控实验（所有记录裁剪至20秒）测试准确率为62.71%。
AI.conclusion: 证明了在紧凑统一架构中处理结构不同的神经和视觉信号的可行性，同时强调了在情感数据集中控制时长相关线索的重要性。

title: Convolution-Free Holistic Multivariance Decomposition Layer for Efficient Hyperspectral Image Classification Tensor Networks
summary: Feature extraction for hyperspectral image classification is conventionally addressed using rigid tensor decompositions that fail to capture complex spatio-spectral interdependencies, or heavily parameterized convolutional neural networks that are computationally expensive. To overcome these limitations, this work introduces the Holistic Multivariance Decomposition (HMD) framework as a novel, end-to-end differentiable neural network layer. By explicitly separating independent single mode variations from cooperative higher dimensional interactions via learnable, matrix valued supports, the proposed HMD-0, HMD-1 and HMD-2 approximants are optimized jointly with a downstream classifier via backpropagation. Comprehensive evaluations across three benchmark HS datasets demonstrate that the higher level HMD layers achieve superior classification accuracy compared to classical learnable tensor baselines, including Tucker, Canonical Polyadic, and Tensor Train decompositions. Furthermore, HMD-1 and HMD-2 achieve a generalization capacity and training stability comparable to standard 2D and 3D-CNNs while requiring significantly fewer feature extractor parameters. These results demonstrate that the HMD framework provides a structurally robust substitute for traditional convolution in multidimensional HS image classification, offering high parameter efficiency and stability throughout the optimization process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端可微分的神经网络层——Holistic Multivariance Decomposition (HMD) 框架，用于高光谱图像分类中的特征提取。它将独立的单模态变化与协作的高维交互显式分离，并通过矩阵值支持（learnable matrix supports）实现。HMD-0、HMD-1、HMD-2三种近似级别与下游分类器联合通过反向传播优化，在三个基准HS数据集上，高级别HMD层在分类精度上优于Tucker、CP、Tensor Train等经典可学习张量基线，同时以更少的参数达到与2D/3D-CNN相当的性能和训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统的高光谱图像分类特征提取方法存在两大局限：一是刚性张量分解无法捕捉复杂的空间-光谱相互依赖关系；二是参数量庞大的卷积神经网络计算成本过高。因此需要一个既能刻画复杂时空光谱交互、又具备参数效率的方法。
AI.method: 提出HMD框架，将其设计为一种新颖的、端到端可区分的神经网络层。核心思想是显式地将独立的单模态变化与协作的高维交互分离，利用可学习的矩阵值支持（learnable matrix-valued supports）实现。提供HMD-0、HMD-1、HMD-2三种层次的近似，通过反向传播与下游分类器联合优化。
AI.result: 在三个高光谱基准数据集上的综合评估显示：高级别HMD层（HMD-1、HMD-2）的分类精度优于Tucker、Canonical Polyadic和Tensor Train等经典可学习张量基线；同时其泛化能力和训练稳定性与标准2D/3D-CNN相当，但特征提取器参数显著更少。
AI.conclusion: HMD框架可以作为传统卷积在多维高光谱图像分类中的结构稳健替代方案，兼具高参数效率和训练过程的稳定性。

title: Multi-Feature Riemannian Hypergraph for Online Test-Time Adaptation of Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interface
summary: In clinical motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) decoding, cross-day transferability and online operation remain two critical challenges. Hypergraphs can improve transferability by capturing higher-order sample relationships, yet existing hypergraph-based methods for online emotion recognition neglect the cross-day benefits of Riemannian geometry widely adopted in EEG transfer learning. To bridge this gap, we propose the Multi-feature Riemannian Hypergraph (MRieHy), a framework tailored for online test-time adaptation in MI-BCI decoding that leverages Riemannian geometry to strengthen cross-day transferability. MRieHy first computes Riemannian means of covariance matrices from cross-day training data to align multi-day distributions. It then constructs a hypergraph over covariance matrices using Riemannian distance, complemented by a second hypergraph over deep features built with cosine similarity. The two hypergraphs are fused via adaptively learned combination weights, jointly optimized with the label projection matrices. During online testing, MRieHy maintains a first-in-first-out buffer of recent samples, performs Riemannian alignment on the buffered data, and decodes with the learned hypergraph. Extensive experiments on a private four-class ECoG dataset and two public four-class EEG datasets validate that MRieHy achieves notable performance gains over state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MRieHy框架，结合黎曼几何与双超图结构，专门用于运动想象脑机接口（MI-BCI）的在线测试时自适应解码，有效解决了跨日迁移性和在线操作两大挑战，在私有ECoG数据集和两个公开EEG数据集上均超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: MI-BCI解码面临两个关键挑战：跨日数据分布漂移导致的可迁移性问题，以及实际应用所需的在线操作能力。现有超图方法虽能通过高阶样本关系提升迁移性，但主要用于在线情绪识别，未利用黎曼几何在EEG迁移学习中的跨日优势。
AI.method: MRieHy框架包含：（1）利用黎曼均值对跨日训练数据的协方差矩阵进行多日分布对齐；（2）基于黎曼距离在协方差矩阵上构建第一个超图，基于余弦相似度在深度特征上构建第二个超图；（3）通过自适应学习的组合权重融合两个超图，并与标签投影矩阵联合优化；（4）在线测试时使用先进先出缓冲区保存近期样本，对缓冲数据进行黎曼对齐后用学习到的超图进行解码。
AI.result: 在私有四类ECoG数据集和两个公开四类EEG数据集上的大量实验表明，MRieHy相较于最先进的基线方法取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: MRieHy通过黎曼几何与双超图融合的策略，成功弥合了跨日迁移性与在线自适应的差距，为MI-BCI的实用化部署提供了有效方案。

title: SCOUT: Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-Vocabulary Editing of face Recognition Templates
summary: Face recognition templates are compact identity representations, yet they also encode rich semantic information about facial appearance. Prior work has shown that templates can be inverted to images or indirectly manipulated through image-editing pipelines, but direct semantic editing in template space remains largely unexplored. Existing interpretability methods for face recognition often rely on manual neuron inspection or predefined attribute labels, limiting scalability and semantic flexibility. To address this gap, we propose SCOUT (Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-VocabUlary Editing of Face Recognition Templates), an end-to-end framework for discovering and directly manipulating semantic concepts in face recognition templates using mechanistic interpretability. SCOUT learns sparse template representations, generates semantic hypotheses for latent features from natural-language descriptions, and validates their stability. The resulting features act as controllable semantic directions for direct editing, avoiding costly edit--re-encode pipelines. Experiments with face recognition models using CNN, ViT, and Swin backbones show that SCOUT discovers interpretable concepts beyond standard attribute labels and enables controllable, identity-aware template manipulation with negligible impact on identity matching. We further show that edited templates can subsequently be decoded with independent inversion models for visualization and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOUT框架，利用机械可解释性在面部识别模板空间中直接发现和操控语义概念，无需通过图像编辑-重新编码的间接流程。该方法学习稀疏模板表示、生成语义假设并验证稳定性，实验表明能在CNN、ViT和Swin骨干网络上发现超越标准属性标签的可解释概念，并实现可控的、保持身份一致性的模板编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有面部识别模板虽包含丰富的语义信息，但直接在模板空间进行语义编辑的研究几乎空白。已有的可解释性方法依赖手动神经元检查或预定义属性标签，扩展性和语义灵活性受限。
AI.method: SCOUT包含三个核心步骤：(1) 学习稀疏模板表示；(2) 从自然语言描述中为潜在特征生成语义假设；(3) 验证特征的稳定性。由此得到的特征作为可控的语义方向，可直接在模板空间进行编辑，无需昂贵的编辑-重新编码流程。
AI.result: 在CNN、ViT和Swin骨干网络上验证，SCOUT能发现超越标准属性标签的可解释概念，支持可控的、身份感知的模板操作，且对身份匹配影响极小。编辑后的模板还可通过独立的逆向模型解码用于可视化和评估。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT首次实现面部识别模板空间的开放词汇语义编辑，为面部识别模型的可解释性和可控编辑提供了新范式，兼具可扩展性与语义灵活性。

title: Governance at the Boundary: How Agent Decomposition Degrades Policy Compliance
summary: Existing agent benchmarks ask whether the agent finished the task. We ask whether it finished it within policy. We introduce Fiducia-bench, a benchmark for the governability of financial agents---whether they escalate when obligated, abstain when required, and leave an auditable trail---and use it to study a question no prior benchmark addresses: does decomposing an agent into components degrade its governance? It does, and the mechanism is specific. Policy-relevant facts discovered by one component are attenuated at the handoff boundary before reaching the component that must act on them. In a 626-episode experiment across 100 KYC/AML task variants, two models, and three architectures, a 32B open-weights model attenuated 0% of discovered facts under a single-loop baseline, 56% under a fixed pipeline, and 85% under an orchestrator-subagent architecture (all at constraint distance 2). A stronger model (gpt-4.1-mini) attenuated 3-6% under the same conditions, suggesting the governance cost of decomposition is partly a function of model capability. Critically, the same mechanism produces both under-escalation and over-escalation, depending on whether the dropped fact was a risk signal or an exculpating one. The benchmark, all tasks, and the verification harness are open-source

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fiducia-bench基准，用于评估金融智能体的"可治理性"（governability），并首次系统研究了一个新问题：将智能体分解为多个组件是否会损害其治理能力。研究发现分解确实导致治理退化，机制是策略相关事实在组件交接边界被衰减（attenuation），且该机制同时导致过度升级和升级不足。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准只关注"任务是否完成"，而忽略了"是否在政策范围内完成任务"。在金融领域（如KYC/AML），智能体需要遵守合规义务（升级、回避、审计追踪），但现有基准无法评估这些治理属性，也没有研究多组件分解架构对治理能力的影响。
AI.method: 构建Fiducia-bench基准，包含100个KYC/AML任务变体和626次实验。对比三种架构：单循环基线（single-loop）、固定流水线（fixed pipeline）、编排者-子智能体架构（orchestrator-subagent），使用两个模型（32B开源模型和gpt-4.1-mini），测量策略相关事实在组件交接边界的衰减率。
AI.result: 32B模型在单循环基线下衰减0%已发现事实，固定流水线下衰减56%，编排者-子智能体架构下衰减85%（约束距离2）。更强模型gpt-4.1-mini在同条件下仅衰减3-6%，表明分解的治理成本部分取决于模型能力。且该机制同时导致升级不足（丢弃风险信号）和过度升级（丢弃开脱性事实）。
AI.conclusion: 组件分解会系统性损害金融智能体的可治理性，其根本机制是信息在交接边界发生衰减。这一治理成本与模型能力相关，且会双向导致政策违规。该基准、任务和验证工具已开源，为后续研究提供了评估智能体治理能力的新框架。

title: Defake-o3: From Speculative Rationales to Verifiable Evidence for Explainable AIGI Detection
summary: The rapid progress of image generation models calls for AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors that are not only accurate but also explainable and reliable. While MLLM-based detectors can provide natural language explanations, existing methods often generate speculative rationales: they rely on vague or hallucinated artifacts, miss subtle localized flaws from the latest generators, and fail to provide evidence that can be visually verified. We present Defake-o3, an explainable AIGI detector that moves from speculative rationales to verifiable evidence. It combines interactive visual search with verifier-guided evidence alignment: the model iteratively zooms into suspicious regions to inspect fine-grained details, while an Evidence Verifier, trained from human verification annotations, provides reinforcement learning rewards that favor grounded evidence and penalize baseless claims. To support this objective, we construct GroundFake, a dataset designed for grounded explainable detection, with localized bounding-box evidence, human verification based on visual grounding and artifact specificity, corrected reasoning trajectories, and valid/invalid evidence supervision. We further introduce FakeFrontier, an out-of-distribution benchmark built from real images and outputs of 10 recent generators, together with an MLLM-based protocol for evaluating evidence quality and persuasiveness. Experiments on GroundFake, FakeFrontier, and additional out-of-distribution benchmarks show that Defake-o3 improves both detection accuracy and explanation quality, producing more localized, verifiable, and persuasive evidence.

AI.tldr: Defake-o3是一个可解释的AI生成图像检测器，通过交互式视觉搜索和验证器引导的证据对齐，将推测性解释转变为可验证的证据，并在新构建的GroundFake数据集和FakeFrontier基准上同时提升了检测准确性和解释质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的AIGI检测器虽然能提供自然语言解释，但往往生成推测性的理由，依赖模糊或幻觉的伪影，无法捕捉最新生成器中微妙的局部缺陷，且缺乏可视觉验证的证据。
AI.method: Defake-o3结合交互式视觉搜索（迭代放大可疑区域以检查细粒度细节）与验证器引导的证据对齐（Evidence Verifier基于人类验证标注，通过强化学习奖励奖励有根据的证据、惩罚无根据的声明）。同时构建GroundFake数据集（包含局部边界框证据、人类视觉验证标注、修正推理轨迹和有效/无效证据监督）以及FakeFrontier基准（基于10个最新生成器的输出和MLLM评估协议）。
AI.result: 在GroundFake、FakeFrontier及其他分布外基准上的实验表明，Defake-o3同时提高了检测准确性和解释质量，生成了更局部化、可验证且有说服力的证据。
AI.conclusion: 通过从推测性理由转向可验证的证据，并将人类验证知识注入强化学习过程，Defake-o3实现了更可靠、可解释的AIGI检测。

title: A Tree-Structured Approach for Phishing Template and Attacker Attribution Analysis
comment: Paper accepted and presented @ eCrime 2026 conference
summary: Phishing remains a persistent and evolving cybersecurity threat, with attack volumes reaching record levels. This growth is driven by the industrialization of phishing through widely available phishing kits and reusable templates, which enable cybercriminals to rapidly generate and deploy large numbers of fraudulent webpages. Although surface-level attributes may differ across these websites, their underlying structures often exhibit significant similarities. However, most existing defenses rely on reactive blocklists or supervised classification models that focus on individual phishing instances, limiting their ability to identify structural reuse and detect coordinated phishing campaigns. To address this limitation, this study investigates whether HTML structure can serve as a robust fingerprint for identifying phishing template reuse. We model webpages as Document Object Model (DOM) trees and extract structural features, optionally enriched with HTML tag-based content information. These representations are then clustered using unsupervised learning methods to group structurally similar webpages. Three clustering algorithms are evaluated and compared, while also analyzing how the depth of the extracted DOM-tree affects cluster formation and overall clustering performance. Finally, cluster quality is also evaluated both quantitatively and qualitatively, including a novel level-wise Jaccard Distance Score and manual inspection supported by visualization tools. Results demonstrate that structural representations of webpages can effectively reveal hidden similarities across phishing sites, enabling the detection of emerging and zero-day templates and supporting the analysis of coordinated phishing threats

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用HTML结构（DOM树）作为指纹来识别钓鱼网站的模板复用。通过提取DOM树结构特征并进行无监督聚类，能够发现表面上不同但结构相似的钓鱼网页，从而检测新兴和零日模板以及协同钓鱼攻击。
AI.motivation: 钓鱼攻击工业化导致攻击量激增，但现有防御依赖被动黑名单或监督分类模型，仅关注单个钓鱼实例，无法识别结构复用和检测协同钓鱼活动。
AI.method: 将网页建模为DOM树，提取结构特征（可选增强HTML标签内容信息），使用三种无监督聚类算法对结构相似的网页进行分组，分析DOM树深度对聚类效果的影响，并引入层级Jaccard距离分数进行定量和定性评估。
AI.result: 实验证明网页结构表示能有效揭示钓鱼网站间的隐藏相似性，支持检测新兴和零日模板，并有助于分析协同钓鱼威胁。
AI.conclusion: HTML结构可以作为钓鱼模板复用的稳健指纹，通过无监督聚类实现对新出现的钓鱼模板的检测，弥补传统基于单实例防御方法的不足。

title: Eigenanalysis framework for autoregressive neural emulators of multi-scale chaotic dynamics
summary: Neural autoregressive models have rapidly emerged as powerful emulators of high-dimensional chaotic systems, yet their long-term instability and error growth remain poorly understood, leading to ad-hoc solutions. Here, we develop an eigenanalysis framework that reveals the dynamical origin of this error growth. By analyzing the Jacobian of the learned one-step update map with respect to the state, we show how inference-time error growth, and thus model stability, is governed by its spectral radius. Direct-step architectures (models that predict the next state from the previous one) generically admit unstable eigenvalues with magnitudes exceeding one, explaining the rapid divergence of these widely used models. In contrast, integration-constrained models (where the time derivative is estimated and integrated with a higher-order integrator) collapse their eigenspectrum onto the unit circle, yielding neutral stability and a universal linear error-scaling law. The largest eigenvalue of this Jacobian provides an architecture-agnostic, a priori diagnostic of short-term skill, long-term stability, and spectral bias, without requiring an expensive rollout. Leveraging this theory, we introduce a stability-promoting loss that explicitly regularizes Jacobian-driven error amplification, improving both forecast accuracy and dynamical robustness. Demonstrated across $29$ models spanning two architectures, several explicit and implicit integrators, and multiple loss functions on the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky system, our results establish a theoretical foundation for the design and evaluation of neural emulators of chaotic multi-scale dynamics. More broadly, our framework is a step toward the kind of a priori stability analysis that numerical analysis provides for discretizations of differential equations and that scientific machine learning currently lacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个特征值分析框架，揭示了神经自回归模型作为混沌系统仿真器时误差增长的动力学根源。通过分析学习到的一步更新映射的Jacobian矩阵谱半径，解释了直接步进架构因不稳定特征值而快速发散，而积分约束模型将特征谱收敛到单位圆上实现中性稳定和线性误差缩放定律。基于该理论，作者提出了一种稳定性促进损失函数，在Kuramoto-Sivashinsky系统上的29个模型中验证了其提升预测精度和动力学鲁棒性的效果。
AI.motivation: 神经自回归模型已成为高维混沌系统的强大仿真器，但其长期不稳定性和误差增长机制尚未被充分理解，导致解决方案往往依赖于临时性的（ad-hoc）手段，缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 1) 提出特征值分析框架，分析学习得到的一步更新映射关于状态的Jacobian矩阵及其谱半径；2) 对比直接步进架构（direct-step）与积分约束模型（integration-constrained）的谱特性；3) 引入稳定性促进损失函数，显式正则化Jacobian驱动的误差放大；4) 在Kuramoto-Sivashinsky系统上对29个模型进行系统验证。
AI.result: 直接步进架构普遍存在模超过1的不稳定特征值导致快速发散；积分约束模型将特征谱坍缩到单位圆上，实现中性稳定和通用线性误差缩放定律。最大特征值可作为架构无关的先验诊断指标，用于预测短期技能、长期稳定性和谱偏差。稳定性促进损失显著提升了预测精度和动力学鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文为神经混沌仿真器的设计和评估建立了理论基础，为科学机器学习提供了类似数值分析中微分方程离散化那样的先验稳定性分析能力，是该领域向更严格理论框架迈出的重要一步。

title: Seeing Before Answering: Training-Free Visual Layer Profiling for Vision-Language Models
summary: LLaVA-style Vision-Language Models (VLMs) pass visual tokens from a fixed late layer of the vision backbone, typically the penultimate one, to the language model. We first show that this hidden convention is fragile: across 2 VLMs and 7 image and video benchmarks, the default layer is sub-optimal in 13 of 14 model-task pairs, and the best layer shifts with both task and visual backbone. Finding that layer by exhaustive layer-wise inference is prohibitively expensive, and no better fixed default exists. We therefore ask whether layer usefulness can instead be predicted from representation geometry. We study matrix-based entropy, introduced for unimodal layer analysis, which we compute over sample-level visual embeddings as Visual Dataset Entropy (VDE); and Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distance, introduced for encoder-level VLM model selection, which we repurpose as a layer-wise visual--language alignment signal. Transferring these to LLaVA-based models is not obvious a priori: the vision tower is frozen while the multimodal projector is trained, so we profile both sides of the projector. We find that VDE transfers, and GW does not. Computed from 100 unlabeled task samples without downstream inference, pre-projector VDE tracks layer-wise accuracy and its top-ranked layers cover the oracle best layer on every task for the SigLIP-based LLaVA-Video, while giving region-level guidance for the CLIP-based Video-LLaVA. Post-projector profiles show that the projector reshapes visual geometry but does not erase the performance-relevant trend, leaving $\mathrm{VDE}_{\mathrm{pre}}$ the stronger signal. GW instead flattens after projection and is best read as an alignment diagnostic rather than a selector. VDE thus offers an interpretable, training-free policy that narrows the visual-layer search to a handful of candidates for limited downstream verification.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLaVA-style视觉语言模型中"固定使用倒数第二层视觉特征"的默认惯例在大多数任务-模型组合下是次优的。作者提出使用基于矩阵熵的视觉数据集熵（VDE）和Gromov-Wasserstein距离来预测哪一层视觉特征最适合下游任务，其中VDE在投影器前计算能有效追踪逐层准确率并锁定最优层，而GW距离则在投影后趋于平坦，仅适合作为对齐诊断工具而非层选择器。
AI.motivation: LLaVA-style VLM通常从视觉骨干网络的固定晚期层（通常是倒数第二层）传递视觉token给语言模型，但这一默认选择是否最优从未被严格检验。作者发现默认层在14个模型-任务组合中的13个都是次优的，且最优层随任务和视觉骨干变化。穷举逐层推理代价过高，且不存在更好的固定默认层，因此需要一种无需下游推理即可预测层有效性的方法。
AI.method: 作者将两种原本用于不同场景的几何信号迁移到LLaVA模型中：(1) 基于矩阵熵的VDE（视觉数据集熵），在100个无标签任务样本上计算样本级视觉嵌入的熵；(2) Gromov-Wasserstein距离，用于衡量视觉-语言对齐。由于视觉塔冻结而多模态投影器被训练，作者对投影器的两侧（pre-projector和post-projector）都进行profile分析。
AI.result: VDE在投影器前计算时能有效追踪逐层准确率，其排名最高的层在SigLIP-based LLaVA-Video的每个任务上都能覆盖oracle最优层，在CLIP-based Video-LLaVA上提供区域级指导。GW距离在投影后趋于平坦，不能作为层选择器。后投影器的profile显示投影器重塑了视觉几何但未消除与性能相关的趋势。
AI.conclusion: VDE提供了一种可解释、免训练的层选择策略，可将视觉层搜索从全量推理缩小到少量候选层进行有限验证，是一种实用的替代穷举搜索的方案。

title: Demystifying Oversmoothing in Sheaf Neural Networks: An Index-Theoretic Criterion
summary: To combat oversmoothing in Graph Convolutional Networks, Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs) were proposed as a generalization by equipping the graph with a sheaf structure and replacing the graph Laplacian with a sheaf Laplacian $\mathcal{L}$. Existing analyses connect sheaf diffusion to oversmoothing via the harmonic space ($\ker\mathcal{L}$), taking its absolute dimension as an indicator of anti-oversmoothing capacity. However, absolute dimension alone is not a reliable measure: certain sheaf configurations inflate $\dim \ker \mathcal{L}$ while their harmonic sections remain entirely constant, without enriching discriminative capacity. We instead introduce the first relative, geometric approach, yielding a precise characterisation of anti-oversmoothing capacity. Under natural conditions on stalk transportation and global sheaf structure, we establish an index-theoretic comparison criterion showing that one sheaf's harmonic space genuinely contains another's beyond trivial inflation. We illustrate this with a concrete instance and further introduce \textit{GyroSheaf}, a sheaf with curved gyrovector-space stalks, extending the criterion to the non-linear setting via local tangent-space linearization. Experiments across ten models confirm the theoretical criterion: sheaf models violating the criterion collapse despite possessing index jumps, while compliant models maintain depth-stable representations.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出相对几何方法精确刻画Sheaf神经网络(SNNs)的抗过平滑能力，指出仅用调和空间绝对维度作为指标不可靠，并建立指标理论比较准则；同时提出GyroSheaf（具有弯曲陀螺向量空间stalks的sheaf），通过局部切空间线性化将准则扩展到非线性场景。实验在十个模型上验证了理论准则。
AI.motivation: 现有SNNs的过平滑分析基于调和空间$\ker\mathcal{L}$的绝对维度来指示抗过平滑能力，但绝对维度不可靠——某些sheaf配置会虚增$\dim\ker\mathcal{L}$的维度，而其调和截面完全恒定，未增强判别能力。需要一个更精确的相对几何方法来刻画抗过平滑能力。
AI.method: 1) 引入首个相对几何方法，在stalks传输和全局sheaf结构的自然条件下，建立指标理论比较准则，证明一个sheaf的调和空间真正包含另一个sheaf的调和空间（超越平凡膨胀）。2) 提出GyroSheaf，使用弯曲陀螺向量空间作为stalks，通过局部切空间线性化将准则扩展到非线性场景。
AI.result: 跨十个模型实验验证了理论准则：违反准则的sheaf模型即使有指标跳跃也会崩溃，而符合准则的模型保持深度稳定的表示。
AI.conclusion: 绝对维度不足以衡量sheaf的抗过平滑能力，需要相对几何比较；指标理论准则为设计深度稳定的sheaf模型提供了理论指导，GyroSheaf展示了非线性扩展的可能性。

title: Protein Structure Prediction: From Evolutionary Constraints to Generative Modeling
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier
summary: Accurate protein structure prediction is fundamental to structural biology because protein structure underlies molecular function and provides a basis for mechanistic interpretation. Recent advances in deep learning have transformed the field from multiple sequence alignment (MSA)-driven monomer folding into broader frameworks capable of modeling protein complexes and increasingly heterogeneous molecular systems. Existing reviews have summarized this progress from the perspectives of representative models, application domains, and protein design. Building on these efforts, this review focuses on the methodological evolution of the field itself. It examines recent developments through three closely related dimensions: representations and data, architectures and learning strategies, and confidence and evaluation. Within this perspective, the field is organized into four methodological phases and three cross-cutting transitions: from explicit evolutionary coupling features and early contact prediction to learned sequence representations in AlphaFold2, RoseTTAFold, and ESMFold; from protein-only monomer folding to increasingly integrated modeling of heterogeneous molecular systems in AlphaFold-Multimer, RoseTTAFoldNA, and AlphaFold3; and, more recently, from prediction-oriented structure inference to design-oriented generative modeling in RFdiffusion and related frameworks. This framework provides a clearer understanding of how methodological shifts have shaped the capabilities, limitations, and practical roles of recent models.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述从方法论演化的角度审视蛋白质结构预测领域的发展，通过表征与数据、架构与学习策略、置信度与评估三个维度，将领域划分为四个方法论阶段和三个跨阶段转变，梳理了从早期接触预测到AlphaFold系列、再到生成式设计模型的演进脉络。
AI.motivation: 已有综述多从代表性模型、应用领域或蛋白质设计等角度总结进展，但缺乏从方法论本身演化视角的系统梳理。这篇综述旨在弥补这一空白，通过方法论维度帮助读者理解领域内模型的演进逻辑。
AI.method: 采用综述框架，从三个维度（表征与数据、架构与学习策略、置信度与评估）审视最近的发展，并将领域组织为四个方法论阶段，识别出三个跨阶段转变：从显式进化耦合特征到学习式序列表征（AlphaFold2等）、从蛋白单体折叠到异质分子系统集成建模（AlphaFold-Multimer等）、从预测导向到设计导向的生成式建模（RFdiffusion等）。
AI.result: 提出了一个将领域划分为四个方法论阶段和三个核心转变的组织框架，涵盖了从AlphaFold2、RoseTTAFold、ESMFold到AlphaFold-Multimer、RoseTTAFoldNA、AlphaFold3及RFdiffusion等关键模型的演化路径。
AI.conclusion: 该方法论框架有助于更清晰地理解方法转变如何塑造了近期模型的能力、局限性和实际作用，为蛋白质结构预测领域的研究者和实践者提供了系统化的认知工具。

title: CoM$^3$eT: A foundation model for medical image analysis through federated, multidimensional context integration
summary: Medical foundation models improve generalization when training AI models with limited labeled data, but remain confined to a single specialty, such as pathology or radiology, and to either sparse or dense outputs, such as classification or segmentation. Here, we present CoM$^3$eT (Co-representation Multidimensional Multitask Medical Transformer), a medical vision foundation model that unifies pathology and radiology, sparse and dense predictions, and two- and higher-dimensional inputs by modeling multidimensional context with attention. CoM$^3$eT outperformed other medical foundation models in an open competition spanning five tomographic, four whole-specimen, and three two-dimensional datasets, covering sparse and dense prediction tasks as well as report generation. When adapted across diverse clinical applications, training fewer than 2.5% of parameters achieved performance comparable to full fine-tuning, enabling research without access to high-performance GPU clusters. Applied to federated learning across hospitals, this approach achieved performance comparable to pooled-data training over internet connections and with consumer-grade hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoM$^3$eT，一个统一病理与放射学、稀疏与稠密预测、二维与高维输入的医学视觉基础模型，通过注意力机制建模多维上下文，在多个数据集上超越其他医学基础模型，并支持参数高效微调和联邦学习部署。
AI.motivation: 现有医学基础模型局限于单一专科（如病理或放射学）、单一输出类型（分类或分割），缺乏能够同时处理多模态、多任务、多维度输入的通用模型。
AI.method: 提出CoM$^3$eT（Co-representation Multidimensional Multitask Medical Transformer），通过注意力机制建模多维上下文，统一处理病理和放射学影像、稀疏和稠密预测任务、二维及更高维度输入。
AI.result: 在涵盖5个断层扫描、4个全标本、3个二维数据集的公开竞赛中优于其他医学基础模型；适应多种临床任务时仅需训练不到2.5%的参数即可达到全量微调的性能；在联邦学习场景下，通过互联网连接和消费级硬件即可获得与集中式数据训练相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: CoM$^3$eT展示了跨专科、跨任务、跨维度的统一医学基础模型可行性，其参数高效微调与联邦学习能力显著降低了研究门槛，无需高性能GPU集群即可实现广泛的临床应用。

title: Understanding and Stabilizing Deep Q-Learning via Controlled Bootstrapping and Regulated Value Dynamics
summary: Deep Q-learning (DQL) has achieved remarkable empirical success in reinforcement learning, yet its training process remains notoriously unstable. Existing studies often attribute instability to isolated factors such as overestimation bias or representation learning issues, lacking a unified understanding of how different sources of instability interact during recursive value estimation. In this work, we provide a systematic analysis of instability in deep Q-learning from three complementary perspectives: operator-level bias in Bellman bootstrapping, estimator-level sensitivity of greedy action selection to regression noise, and parameter-dynamics imbalance under aggressive data reuse. We identify a reward-triggered self-reinforcing trap and characteristic parameter spike dynamics, then derive stabilization principles for controlled bootstrapping, ensemble quantile estimation, and spike-based parameter regulation. Experiments on Atari-100K and Procgen demonstrate competitive performance and improved training stability.

AI.tldr: 本文对深度Q-learning的不稳定性进行了系统分析，从算子级（贝尔曼自举偏差）、估计器级（贪心动作选择对回归噪声的敏感性）和参数动力学级（激进数据重用下的不平衡）三个互补视角出发，识别出奖励触发的自我强化陷阱和特征参数尖峰动力学，提出了可控自举、集成分位数估计和基于尖峰的参数调节等稳定性原则。
AI.motivation: 深度Q-learning虽然在强化学习中取得了显著的实证成功，但其训练过程以不稳定著称。现有研究往往将不稳定性归因于过估计偏差或表征学习问题等孤立因素，缺乏对不同不稳定性来源在递归值估计过程中如何相互作用的统一理解。
AI.method: 从三个互补视角进行系统性分析：(1) 算子级：贝尔曼自举中的偏差；(2) 估计器级：贪心动作选择对回归噪声的敏感性；(3) 参数动力学级：激进数据重用下的不平衡。基于分析结果提出三种稳定性原则：可控自举（controlled bootstrapping）、集成分位数估计（ensemble quantile estimation）和基于尖峰的参数调节（spike-based parameter regulation）。
AI.result: 在Atari-100K和Procgen基准上取得了具有竞争力的性能，并显著改善了训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个统一的框架来理解深度Q-learning中不同不稳定性来源之间的交互作用，识别出关键的不稳定机制（奖励触发的自我强化陷阱和参数尖峰动力学），并提出有效的稳定性原则，在保持性能的同时显著提升训练稳定性。

title: Assessing LLMs' mathematical abilities requires understanding the various mechanisms of mathematical creativity
summary: How should we assess whether large language models can perform mathematical invention? I argue that this question is currently underspecified: mathematical creativity is not one capacity but several mechanistically distinct modes of meaning-making - reflexive introspection on mathematical practice, analogical import from the sciences, problem-driven construction, and the bridging of distant domains - together with a further, cross-cutting distinction between meaning pursued because a pattern was observed and meaning pursued because it is strategically wanted, a distinction I develop through the case of conjecture-formation. These mechanisms are likely non-substitutable, so that competence in one does not transfer to the others. Grounding each in a historical case study and in an architecture-level account of current transformer-based systems, I suggest that today's models concentrate their competence in modes shaped by recombination and search over existing building blocks; if that description holds, the remaining modes are out of reach in principle, not just slower - though whether it holds is itself the open, empirical part. Because proof is getting cheaper as AI improves at generating it - a shift the field's own leading voices are now diagnosing - mathematical value is migrating toward the modes current systems cannot yet perform, and evaluations of AI mathematical ability should be organized around this taxonomy rather than around aggregate benchmarks that conflate it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出评估大语言模型数学创造力的框架，认为数学创造力并非单一能力，而是包含四种机制上不同的意义建构模式（对数学实践的反思性内省、从科学中的类比导入、问题驱动的建构、跨越遥远领域的桥接），以及一个横切区分：因观察到模式而追求意义与因战略需要而追求意义。这些机制可能不可替代，当前模型的能力集中在重组与搜索现有构件上，其余模式在原则上无法触及，数学价值正朝当前系统无法执行的方向迁移，评估应围绕这一分类而非聚合基准。
AI.motivation: 当前关于大语言模型能否进行数学创造的评估问题缺乏明确界定——数学创造力并非单一能力，而是多种机制上截然不同的意义建构模式，需要更精细的框架来理解与评估。
AI.method: 通过历史案例研究奠定每种机制的经验基础，并结合当前基于Transformer系统的架构层面分析，提出四种意义建构模式及模式驱动与战略驱动之间的区分，以猜想形成为例进行阐述。
AI.result: 认为当前模型的能力集中于由重组和搜索现有构件所塑造的模式；若此描述成立，其余模式在原则上不可达（而非仅速度较慢），但这一判断本身是否成立仍是开放的经验问题。
AI.conclusion: 随着AI生成证明能力提升使证明变便宜，数学价值正向当前系统无法执行的模式迁移。对AI数学能力的评估应围绕这一分类学组织，而非混淆各类能力的聚合基准。

title: TransAnyText: Translating Arbitrary Text in E-commerce Images via Structured Visual Generation
summary: Cross-border e-commerce image translation is essential for global retail, where product images, banners, and detail pages need to be produced in different languages. Existing methods struggle to achieve accurate translation, faithful visual identity preservation, and easy-to-edit outputs, simultaneously. To address these challenges, we introduce TransAnyText, a structured visual code framework that reformulates image text translation as generating renderable HTML patches from source images and target languages. Our framework decouples semantic generation from pixel rendering: a vision-language model (VLM) handles visual understanding, cross-lingual translation, and structured visual generation, while a diffusion model performs background inpainting and pixel-level refinement, followed by deterministic rendering to synthesize the final image. Based on this formulation, we develop a three-stage post-training framework, where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) establishes the image-to-code mapping, privilege-gap weighted self-distillation (PWSD) improves the learning of style and layout tokens, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) further optimizes task-level performance. We further introduce TransAnyDataset and TransAnyBench, a multilingual dataset and benchmark for e-commerce image translation. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance against cascaded pipelines, open-source end-to-end models, and closed-source image editing systems, providing an effective, controllable, and editable solution for cross-border e-commerce image translation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TransAnyText，一种结构化视觉代码框架，将跨境电商图像文本翻译重构为从源图像和目标语言生成可渲染的HTML补丁。该框架通过VLM负责语义理解、跨语言翻译和结构化视觉生成，扩散模型负责背景修复和像素级精化，最终确定性渲染合成图像。配合三阶段后训练（SFT、PWSD、RLVR）和专门构建的多语言数据集与基准，实现了准确翻译、视觉一致性保持和可编辑输出的统一。
AI.motivation: 现有跨境电子商务图像翻译方法难以同时满足三个要求：准确的翻译、忠实的视觉身份保持以及易于编辑的输出。级联流水线和端到端模型在这些目标之间存在权衡，亟需一种能同时解决这些挑战的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 将图像文本翻译重构为生成可渲染HTML补丁的结构化视觉代码问题；2) 解耦语义生成（VLM负责）与像素渲染（扩散模型负责背景修复和精化，确定性渲染合成最终图像）；3) 三阶段后训练框架：SFT建立图像到代码映射，PWSD改进风格和布局token学习，RLVR优化任务级性能；4) 构建TransAnyDataset和TransAnyBench多语言数据集与基准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TransAnyText在与级联流水线、开源端到端模型和闭源图像编辑系统的对比中均展现出竞争性性能，提供了有效、可控且可编辑的跨境电商图像翻译解决方案。
AI.conclusion: TransAnyText通过结构化可视代码框架有效解决了跨境电商图像翻译中翻译准确性、视觉一致性保持和可编辑性三者兼顾的难题，为该领域提供了新范式。

title: Multi-Granularity Sentiment Integration for LLM-Based Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict sentiment polarity and intensity from heterogeneous inputs such as text, audio, and vision. While large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic priors for MSA, effectively incorporating audio and visual signals effectively remains challenging. A key challenge is that audio and visual sentiment cues evolve over different temporal scales, yet many LLM-based methods compress these signals through shallow projection or coarse pooling before fusing them with text, which can weaken cross-modal alignment and erase fine-grained affective information. We propose MGSI, a multi-granularity sentiment integration framework for LLM-based MSA. MGSI first encodes audio and visual streams at short-, medium-, and long-range temporal scales, preserving both local variations and global affective trends. It then refines non-text features through text-guided alignment, and applies polarity- and intensity-aware enhancement to better handle ambiguous and near-neutral samples. The resulting multimodal representation is finally compressed into a small set of pseudo-tokens for efficient conditioning of a frozen LLM. Experiments on four public benchmarks show that MGSI substantially outperforms frozen-LLM baselines and remains competitive with strong multimodal methods. Further ablation and sensitivity analyses support the effectiveness of multi-granularity temporal modeling, text-guided refinement, and adaptive sentiment calibration.

AI.tldr: 提出MGSI框架，通过多粒度时间建模（短/中/长范围）编码音频和视觉信号，辅以文本引导对齐和极性/强度感知增强，将多模态表示压缩为伪token以高效适配冻结的LLM，在多模态情感分析任务中超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-based多模态情感分析方法通常通过浅层投影或粗略池化压缩音频和视觉信号，忽略了这些信号在不同时间尺度上演化的特性，导致跨模态对齐被削弱、细粒度情感信息丢失。
AI.method: 1) 在短、中、长三种时间尺度上编码音频和视觉流，保留局部变化和全局情感趋势；2) 通过文本引导对齐细化非文本特征；3) 应用极性和强度感知增强以处理模糊和近中性样本；4) 将多模态表示压缩为少量伪token来条件化冻结的LLM。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准上，MGSI大幅超越冻结LLM基线，并与强多模态方法保持竞争力；消融和敏感性分析验证了多粒度时间建模、文本引导细化和自适应情感校准的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多粒度时间建模、文本引导对齐和情感感知校准是提升LLM在多模态情感分析中性能的关键要素，MGSI为高效利用冻结LLM处理异构多模态情感信号提供了有效方案。

title: When Single-Dataset Conclusions Fail: A 45-Task Study of Threshold Tuning and Resampling for Imbalanced Classification
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and per-run metrics released
summary:
Class-imbalance handling is routinely evaluated on a single benchmark dataset, and the resulting conclusions are reported as if they were properties of the method. We show this practice is unsafe. On the public Kaggle credit-card fraud dataset, under a leakage-free nested cross-validation protocol in which the decision threshold is selected on a held-out inner validation fold, a plain Random Forest at the default 0.5 threshold attains F1 = 0.861 +/- 0.021, and threshold tuning yields it no benefit (delta-F1 = -0.002). Read alone, this supports an appealing conclusion: for a well-calibrated ensemble, imbalance handling is unnecessary.
  We then apply the identical protocol to 45 binary tasks spanning imbalance ratios from 1:1.5 to 1:178 (2,025 model fits, four model families). The conclusion reverses. Random Forest benefits most from threshold tuning across the suite (delta-F1 = +0.101 +/- 0.134), not least, while three other families replicate their fraud-dataset behaviour almost exactly. SMOTE likewise harms the fraud dataset but helps across the suite (mean delta-F1 = +0.076; 138 wins, 39 losses; Wilcoxon p = 2.7e-17).
  Two further results. Threshold-tuning benefit is non-monotonic in the imbalance ratio: near zero below 1:5, peaking at +0.120 in the 1:15-1:40 band, declining to +0.045 beyond 1:100 - explaining why the fraud dataset, at 1:577, is an unrepresentative place to study the question. And we reject an intuitive heuristic: validation-set calibration error does not predict tuning benefit (expected calibration error r = -0.087; Brier r = +0.137), so calibration diagnostics cannot tell a practitioner whether tuning is worthwhile. We release the protocol, the 45-task harness, and all per-run metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文指出在单一基准数据集上评估类别不平衡处理方法是不安全的。在Kaggle信用卡欺诈数据集上，随机森林在默认阈值下表现良好且阈值调优无益；但在45个跨不平衡比率的二分类任务（2,025次模型拟合）上结论完全逆转——随机森林从阈值调优中获益最大，SMOTE在欺诈数据上有害但在整个套件中有益。阈值调优的收益随不平衡比率呈非单调变化，且校准误差无法预测调优收益。
AI.motivation: 当前类别不平衡处理方法通常只在单一基准数据集上评估，并将结果泛化为方法的固有属性。作者质疑这一做法的安全性，因为单一数据集可能不具代表性，导致错误结论。以Kaggle信用卡欺诈数据集（不平衡比1:577）为例，证明这种评估实践可能产生误导性结论。
AI.method: 采用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证协议，在持出的内部验证折上选择决策阈值。先在Kaggle信用卡欺诈数据集上测试随机森林（默认阈值0.5与阈值调优对比），再将该协议应用到45个二分类任务（不平衡比率从1:1.5到1:178），涵盖四种模型族，共2,025次模型拟合。同时评估SMOTE效果及校准诊断（期望校准误差、Brier分数）与调优收益的关系。
AI.result: 欺诈数据集上随机森林默认阈值F1=0.861±0.021，阈值调优无益（delta-F1=-0.002）；但45任务套件上随机森林从阈值调优获益最大（delta-F1=+0.101±0.134）。SMOTE在欺诈数据上有害但在套件中有益（平均delta-F1=+0.076，138胜39负，Wilcoxon p=2.7e-17）。调优收益随不平衡比率非单调变化：低于1:5接近零，1:15-1:40达峰值+0.120，超过1:100降至+0.045。校准误差不能预测调优收益。
AI.conclusion: 在单一数据集上评估类别不平衡方法得出的结论不可靠，可能完全逆转。欺诈数据集（1:577）恰好处于调优收益递减区间，是不具代表性的评估场所。研究发布完整协议、45任务测试框架及所有运行指标，倡导多数据集系统评估。

title: Audio-Visual Segmentation via Depth-Guided Collaborative Modeling
summary: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) is a fundamental task in multimodal perception that performs pixel-level segmentation of sounding objects in videos by leveraging both visual and audio cues. It has broad applications in video understanding, human-computer interaction, and autonomous driving. However, most existing AVS methods do not explicitly model geometric cues such as relative distance and occlusion, thereby limiting the robustness of cross-modal alignment. In human perception, spatial structure is naturally integrated with audio-visual evidence to accurately localize sounding objects. Motivated by this, we incorporate estimated depth as a spatial structural cue for AVS and propose DGCM-AVS, a tri-modal framework that jointly models audio, visual, and depth information. Specifically, we design a Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator to improve the separation of adjacent objects while preserving intra-object feature consistency. Furthermore, we propose Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion, which uses depth as an intermediate bridge to progressively align audio cues with visual features. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, DGCM-AVS achieves relative improvements of 10.2 percent in M_J and 8.7 percent in M_F on the AVSS dataset. We believe our study highlights depth as a promising yet underexplored modality for AVS and may encourage further research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DGCM-AVS，一种将深度信息作为空间结构线索引入音频-视觉分割（AVS）任务的三模态框架，通过深度感知动态调制器和深度引导渐进融合模块，在AVSS数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有AVS方法大多未显式建模几何线索（如相对距离和遮挡），限制了跨模态对齐的鲁棒性。人类感知中空间结构与音视频证据自然结合，因此作者希望引入深度信息作为空间结构线索来提升AVS性能。
AI.method: 提出DGCM-AVS三模态框架（音频、视觉、深度）：1）Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator（深度感知动态调制器）用于改善相邻物体分离并保持物体内部特征一致性；2）Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion（深度引导渐进融合）以深度为中间桥梁，渐进地对齐音频线索与视觉特征。
AI.result: 与最先进方法相比，DGCM-AVS在AVSS数据集上取得了M_J提升10.2%、M_F提升8.7%的相对改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了深度是AVS中一个有前景但尚未充分探索的模态，有望推动该方向的进一步研究。

title: Conditional Evaluation of Language Models with Cheap Auxiliary Signals
summary: Aggregate accuracy hides where models succeed and fail. Estimating conditional performance profiles from gold labels alone is expensive, while cheap auxiliary signals such as LLM-judge scores, pairwise comparisons, confidence scores, and judge-disagreement features can be collected for every benchmark item but are often biased or miscalibrated. We propose LACE (Local Augmented Control-Variate Evaluation), a semi-supervised estimator for conditional LLM evaluation. The key step is local centering: after subtracting the conditional mean of a cheap signal within the target profile region, any linear augmentation has zero conditional mean and therefore cannot change the estimand. The augmentation coefficient is used only for efficiency, and a local ridge control variate combines a gold-label residual mean from the labeled subset with a cheap-signal mean from the full item pool. We prove calibration-free identification, unbiasedness for grouped profiles, local oracle optimality within centered linear augmentations, and first-order adaptivity to the estimated coefficient. The resulting gain formula is governed by a population local $R^2$, which characterizes how the efficiency attainable from the cheap signals varies across profile values. We also derive corresponding estimators for direct paired model gaps and deployment-weighted scores. We empirically evaluate the primary performance-profile estimator on MATH-500, ScienceQA, MMLU, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, GSM8K, and ARC.

AI.tldr: 提出LACE（局部增广控制变量评估）框架，一种半监督条件LLM评估估计器。通过"局部中心化"技术，利用廉价信号（如LLM裁判分数、成对比较、置信度分数等）提升条件性能估计效率，同时保证无偏性和校准无关性。
AI.motivation: 传统的聚合准确率无法揭示模型在具体子群体上的表现差异。获取带金标签的条件性能剖面成本高昂，而廉价辅助信号（LLM裁判分数、成对比较、置信度等）虽然易获取但存在偏差或校准问题，难以直接使用。
AI.method: 核心步骤是"局部中心化"：在目标剖面区域内减去廉价信号的条件均值后，任何线性增广的条件均值变为零，因此不会改变估计量目标。局部岭控制变量结合来自标注子集的金标签残差均值和来自完整样本池的廉价信号均值。理论证明包括校准无关识别、分组剖面的无偏性、中心化线性增广内的局部Oracle最优性以及对估计系数的一阶自适应性。
AI.result: 增益公式由群体局部R²决定，该量刻画廉价信号在不同剖面值下可获得效率的变化。推导了直接配对模型差距和部署加权分数的对应估计器，并在MATH-500、ScienceQA、MMLU、WinoGrande、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA、GSM8K和ARC八个基准上进行了实证评估。
AI.conclusion: LACE通过局部中心化技巧，使得有偏的廉价信号也能安全用于方差缩减而不引入偏差，实现了条件性能评估的效率提升，同时提供了完整的理论保证。

title: FeatureHospital: A Skill-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Algorithm Customization in Multi-View Multi-Label Feature Selection
summary: Multi-view multi-label feature selection aims to identify a compact and informative feature subset from heterogeneous views while preserving discriminative information for multiple labels. Existing methods are generally developed from specific modeling perspectives and incorporate mechanisms tailored to particular data characteristics. Designing suitable feature selection algorithms across datasets with diverse and heterogeneous characteristics still relies heavily on expert knowledge and substantial manual effort, imposing considerable time and labor costs that severely hinder the practical adoption of feature selection. To address this problem, we propose FeatureHospital, a Skill-driven multi-agent framework for automated multi-view multi-label feature selection algorithm design. FeatureHospital first diagnoses the target dataset to identify its feature selection issues. Based on the diagnosis, specialist agents equipped with domain Skills then prescribe corresponding optimization strategies and Loss terms for different issues. After that, the resulting prescriptions are reconciled to remove overlaps and resolve conflicts before being integrated into a compact dataset-specific objective. Finally, the constructed objective is optimized to select the final feature subset. Experimental results demonstrate that FeatureHospital can construct effective feature selection algorithms for different datasets based on their individual characteristics.

AI.tldr: 提出了FeatureHospital，一个基于技能驱动的多智能体框架，用于自动化设计多视图多标签特征选择算法。该框架通过诊断目标数据集、让专家智能体开具优化策略与损失函数处方、整合处方为紧凑目标函数并优化选择特征子集，从而实现针对不同数据集特性自动构建有效特征选择算法。
AI.motivation: 现有多种多视图多标签特征选择方法通常基于特定建模视角开发，并针对特定数据特征设计机制。跨不同异构特征的数据集设计合适的特征选择算法仍高度依赖专家知识和大量人工努力，造成巨大的时间和人力成本，严重阻碍特征选择的实际应用。
AI.method: 1) 首先诊断目标数据集，识别其特征选择问题；2) 基于诊断结果，配备领域技能（Skills）的专家智能体为不同问题开出相应的优化策略和损失函数处方；3) 协调这些处方，去除重叠并解决冲突，整合为紧凑的数据集特定目标函数；4) 优化构建的目标函数以选择最终特征子集。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FeatureHospital能够针对不同数据集基于其个体特征构建有效的特征选择算法。
AI.conclusion: FeatureHospital证明了基于技能驱动的多智能体框架能够自动化实现多视图多标签特征选择算法设计，减少对专家知识和人工劳动的依赖，提升特征选择的实用性。

title: PosterText: Towards Unified Visual Text Generation and Editing for E-commerce Poster
summary: Automated e-commerce poster design requires both high-quality poster generation and flexible editing of existing designs. However, most existing methods either target end-to-end poster generation or follow multi-stage design pipelines, with limited capability for flexible and precise editing of existing posters. To enable unified generation and editing of e-commerce posters, we introduce Text Patch Generation and Editing, a unified task formulation that treats text patches as atomic units and covers four operations: poster generation, patch addition, patch deletion, and patch modification, with optional reference-guided style control. Based on this, we propose PosterText, a unified model trained with a four-stage curriculum, including text rendering pretraining, instruction-following training, reinforcement learning for preference alignment, and spatial guidance self-distillation for execution refinement. We further construct a large-scale dataset with patch-level annotations and a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PosterText achieves competitive performance against existing generation and editing approaches, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PosterText，一个统一的电商海报生成与编辑模型。该模型将文本补丁作为原子单元，提出"文本补丁生成与编辑"(TPGE)任务框架，涵盖海报生成、补丁添加、补丁删除和补丁修改四种操作，并支持可选的参考风格控制。通过四阶段课程训练（文本渲染预训练、指令跟随训练、强化学习偏好对齐、空间引导自蒸馏），配合大规模标注数据集和基准测试，实现了超越现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有电商海报生成方法要么只做端到端生成，要么采用多阶段设计流程，缺乏对已有海报进行灵活精确编辑的能力，无法满足电商设计中生成与编辑统一的需求。
AI.method: 1) 提出TPGE统一任务框架，将文本补丁作为原子单元，覆盖生成、添加、删除、修改四种操作；2) 构建PosterText统一模型，采用四阶段课程训练：文本渲染预训练、指令跟随训练、强化学习偏好对齐、空间引导自蒸馏；3) 构建大规模补丁级标注数据集和综合基准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PosterText在生成和编辑任务上均取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PosterText通过统一的TPGE任务表述和四阶段课程训练，成功弥合了电商海报生成与编辑之间的鸿沟，为自动化工商业海报设计提供了统一解决方案。

title: Quantifying the Gap Between Laboratory Battery Test Patterns and Field Duty Profiles
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to ECCE Europe 2026
summary: Laboratory battery tests provide the main empirical basis for battery performance and degradation studies, but their operating patterns do not directly represent field duty profiles. This paper quantifies the gap by comparing six accessible evidence sources covering controlled cycling, drive-cycle testing, dynamic cycling, NMC811 laboratory ageing, a real electric-vehicle charging trace, and fleet-scale electric-vehicle state-of-health (SOH) data. The analysis combines usage frequency, usage intensity, usage C-rate, and a duty-structure index (DSI) based on normalized current dispersion and ramping. The representative single-segment DSI ranges from 0.630 for the field source trace and 0.699 for NASA to 2.936 for Oxford and 2.855 for Imperial, while usage C-rate ranges from 0.14-0.40 for Imperial, NASA, Stanford, and Hyundai to 2.00 for Oxford. Long-term ageing also differs: the 80 percent retention region occurs near 351 NASA cycles, 6292 Oxford checkpoints, and 1019 Stanford cycles. In chemistry-aligned NMC/NCM evidence, Imperial retains 0.813 under standard cycling and 0.865 under drive-cycle ageing, while the field source has median SOH 0.889 with visible dispersion. Field operation further shows a median use intensity of 137.2 km/day and 56.9 percent of charges ending at or above 95 percent SOC. These results show that battery performance metrics are conditional on the duty pattern that generated them; application-oriented studies should report explicit duty-profile descriptors together with chemistry, capacity, and ageing metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比六种证据来源（受控循环、驾驶循环测试、动态循环、NMC811实验室老化、真实电动汽车充电轨迹、车队级SOH数据），量化了实验室电池测试与真实场域工况之间的差距，并提出了基于使用频率、强度、C-rate和负载结构指数（DSI）的分析框架。
AI.motivation: 实验室电池测试是电池性能和退化研究的主要经验基础，但其运行模式不能直接代表真实场域的负载分布谱。这种差距导致实验室得出的电池性能指标可能与实际应用场景严重不符，需要定量化理解这一差距。
AI.method: 整合六种证据来源的数据，从使用频率、使用强度、使用C-rate和基于归一化电流离散度与斜坡的负载结构指数（DSI）四个维度进行分析，横跨不同测试模式和真实场域数据。
AI.result: 发现代表性单段DSI在0.630（场域源）到2.936（牛津）之间变化；使用C-rate在0.14-0.40（Imperial、NASA、Stanford、Hyundai）到2.00（牛津）之间；长期老化差异显著（80%容量保持率出现在351 NASA循环、6292牛津检查点、1019 Stanford循环）；场域数据中值SOC为0.889，中位使用强度137.2 km/天，56.9%充电在≥95% SOC结束。
AI.conclusion: 电池性能指标高度依赖于生成它们的负载模式；面向应用的研究应同时报告明确的负载特征描述符以及化学体系、容量和老化指标。

title: TRCA: Transition-wise Rubric Credit Assignment for Long-horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents are typically optimized with sparse terminal outcomes, making fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step interactions difficult. Existing approaches either rely on process evaluators, which incur annotation and inference costs, or derive step-level credit from successful trajectories. However, successful trajectories are extremely scarce during early-stage reinforcement learning, substantially weakening anchor-based methods. We propose Transition-wise Rubric Credit Assignment (TRCA), which derives step-level supervision directly from action-induced transitions without learned evaluators or successful anchors. TRCA evaluates each transition using Evidence, Execution, and Invalidity rubrics to capture task-relevant information acquisition, valid task execution, and invalid or regressive behavior. From these judgments, Foundational Rubric Reward measures local transition quality, while Breakthrough Rubric Reward tracks newly covered Evidence and Execution conditions to reward incremental task progress. Combined with terminal outcomes, these signals produce fine-grained step-level advantages for policy optimization. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and seven search-augmented question-answering benchmarks show consistent improvements over the evaluated baselines. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, TRCA improves the WebShop score by 6.0%-12.6%; with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, it improves the average SearchQA score by 1.9%-18.3%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of transition-wise rubric credit assignment for long-horizon tasks with sparse successful anchors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRCA（Transition-wise Rubric Credit Assignment）方法，通过直接基于动作诱导的状态转换（transition）来推导步骤级监督信号，无需学习型评估器或成功轨迹锚点，解决长周期LLM智能体在多步骤交互中的细粒度信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 长周期LLM智能体通常仅用稀疏的终端结果优化，导致多步交互中的细粒度信用分配困难。现有方法要么依赖过程评估器（带来标注和推理成本），要么从成功轨迹中推导步骤级信用（但早期强化学习中成功轨迹极其稀缺，严重削弱了基于锚点的方法）。
AI.method: TRCA使用三个评分标准（Evidence、Execution、Invalidity）评估每个状态转换，分别捕捉任务相关信息获取、有效任务执行以及无效或倒退行为。由此衍生出两种奖励信号：Foundational Rubric Reward衡量局部转换质量，Breakthrough Rubric Reward追踪新覆盖的Evidence和Execution条件以奖励增量任务进展。这些信号与终端结果结合，产生细粒度的步骤级优势用于策略优化。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和七个检索增强问答基准上的实验显示一致优于基线。使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct时，WebShop分数提升6.0%-12.6%；使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct时，平均SearchQA分数提升1.9%-18.3%。
AI.conclusion: 转换级评分式信用分配（TRCA）在成功锚点稀疏的长周期任务中显著有效，证明了无需成功轨迹也能实现细粒度信用分配的可能性。

title: Cross-View Urban Sensing: Mapping Subjective Streetscape Perception via AlphaEarth Embeddings and Urban Context
summary: Residents' perception of the urban streetscape is an important factor in public health, active mobility, and social wellbeing. Street view imagery (SVI) has emerged as a widely used data source for assessing these perceptual qualities, yet its uneven coverage and irregular updating limit large-scale measurement. Here, we present CVLNet, a Cross-View Learning Network that predicts street-level perception from AlphaEarth embeddings and multi-source urban contextual data without requiring SVI at inference. CVLNet applies per-task adaptive gating to jointly model five perceptual dimensions, using labels from the pretrained SVI-Percept model as ground truth. The proposed method is evaluated across four Southeast Asian cities: Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta, and Manila. CVLNet achieves a median road-segment-level Adjusted $R^{2}$ of 0.76 and consistently outperforms the baseline models, with gains ranging from 5.9--11.3% across the five perceptual dimensions. Ablation experiments show that AlphaEarth features and urban contextual features contribute complementary information. We further produce citywide road-level streetscape perception maps for five subjective perceptual dimensions across all four cities, extending perception estimation from the 13--31% of the road network directly covered by available SVI to the complete road network of each city. Integrating these maps with WorldPop gridded population data, we quantify exposure inequality across population-density, demographic, and land-use groups using the Deficit Palma Ratio. These results demonstrate that remote sensing can serve as a scalable alternative to SVI for citywide streetscape perception mapping, enabling a more comprehensive assessment of urban environmental inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CVLNet，一种跨视角学习网络，利用AlphaEarth嵌入和多源城市上下文数据预测街道级感知质量，无需推理时的街道影像（SVI）。在东南亚四个城市评估，中位道路段Adjusted R²为0.76，优于基线模型5.9-11.3%，并生成了覆盖完整路网的感知地图，结合人口数据量化了暴露不平等。
AI.motivation: 街道景观感知对公共健康、主动出行和社会福祉至关重要，但现有SVI数据覆盖不均、更新不规律，难以支持大规模测量。需要一种无需SVI即可进行城市尺度街道感知评估的替代方法。
AI.method: 提出CVLNet（Cross-View Learning Network），从AlphaEarth嵌入和多源城市上下文数据预测五个感知维度。采用逐任务自适应门控联合建模，使用预训练SVI-Percept模型的标签作为真实值进行训练。
AI.result: 在四个东南亚城市评估中，中位道路段Adjusted R²为0.76，五个感知维度上优于基线模型5.9-11.3%。消融实验表明AlphaEarth特征和城市上下文特征互补。感知估计覆盖范围从SVI直接覆盖的13-31%扩展至完整路网。结合WorldPop数据量化了不同人口密度、人口统计和土地利用群体间的暴露不平等。
AI.conclusion: 遥感可作为SVI的可扩展替代方案用于城市街道景观感知制图，实现更全面的城市环境不平等评估，支持大规模城市街道感知测量。

title: Beyond Peak Backlog: Conditional Energy and Temporal Geometry in Capacity-Constrained Delayed Bandit Optimization
summary: What is the right delay complexity when a learner can track only $C$ pending feedback items and discarded feedback is permanently lost? Existing one-point bandit convex optimization guarantees in this model pay $\sqrt{Tσ_{\max}}$, where $σ_{\max}$ is the peak backlog, although unlimited tracking admits the sharper $\sqrt{d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ dependence on total delay. We introduce a scheduler-side conditional-energy interface that separates rate adaptation from the one-point perturbation filtration and handles the dependent importance weights created by randomized admission. Under the same semi-clairvoyant oracle and pathwise hard-capacity contract, this yields an untuned learner whose delay term scales as $O(\sqrt{E_C d_{\mathrm{tot}}})$, with only an explicit restart factor $E_C$; a public constant-factor peak bound removes this factor while $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ remains unknown. Under strong convexity, the same interface yields the temporal cost $H_A(d)=\sum_t σ_t/(A+t)$. Two delay vectors with identical delay multisets, $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$, $σ_{\max}$, and capacity can nevertheless have polynomially different minimax regret, showing that timing matters under curvature even when aggregate delay summaries agree. Finally, a continuous hard family converts tracking capacity into a zeroth-order query budget and gives a complementary capacity-starvation lower endpoint. The upper bounds require $C\ge \ln T+1$ and do not constitute a complete capacity minimax characterization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究学习者只能跟踪C个待处理反馈项且丢弃反馈永久丢失情况下的延迟复杂度问题。现有单点bandit凸优化保证给出O(√(T·σ_max))的界，而无限制跟踪可达到更优的√d_tot依赖。作者引入调度器侧条件能量接口，分离率自适应与单点扰动过滤，处理随机准入产生的依赖重要性权重，实现延迟项为O(√(E_C·d_tot))的无调参学习器。
AI.motivation: 现有单点bandit凸优化在有限反馈跟踪容量C下只能保证√(T·σ_max)的复杂度，其中σ_max是峰值积压，而无限制跟踪可获得更优的√d_tot（总延迟）。需要弥合这一差距，并理解延迟时序在强凸下的影响。
AI.method: 引入调度器侧条件能量接口（conditional-energy interface），将率自适应与单点扰动过滤分离，并通过该接口处理随机准入产生的依赖重要性权重。对强凸情形，提出时间成本函数H_A(d)=Σ_t σ_t/(A+t)。还构造连续硬族将跟踪容量转化为零阶查询预算。
AI.result: 在半透视预言机和路径硬容量契约下，无调参学习器的延迟项达到O(√(E_C·d_tot))，仅含显式重启因子E_C；公共常数因子峰值界可消除该因子且d_tot仍未知。两个延迟向量即使具有相同延迟多重集、d_tot、σ_max和容量，其minimax遗憾也可能多项式不同，表明曲率下时序信息重要。上界需要C≥ln T+1。
AI.conclusion: 本文在有限反馈跟踪容量下首次将延迟复杂度从√(T·σ_max)改进到√(E_C·d_tot)，揭示了强凸下延迟时序对遗憾的显著影响，并给出容量饥饿下界端点，但尚未构成完整的容量minimax特征刻画。

title: Trajectory-Level Automatic Curriculum Learning for Legged Locomotion on Unstructured Terrain
summary: Training locomotion policies for complex unstructured terrain requires a curriculum to avoid early exploration failures. However, since unstructured terrain lacks explicit difficulty ordering for curriculum design, existing methods resort to heuristic curricula over parameterized terrains. This abstraction limits generalization, as policies can overadapt to near-fixed perceptual patterns. To address this, we propose \textbf{\ourname{}}, an \textbf{T}rajectory-level \textbf{A}utomatic \textbf{C}urriculum \textbf{L}earning framework that generates training tasks directly from unstructured terrain maps. At each curriculum update, the evaluator learns a difficulty function for the current policy that maps a given trajectory task to a difficulty score. The sampler then proposes new trajectories guided by the learned evaluator as the curriculum for the next policy update. This forms a closed loop in which the curriculum is iteratively matched to the evolving policy. Quantitative and qualitative experiments show that \ourname{} continuously provides effective curricula on unstructured terrain, improving trajectory success rate by \(56.3\%\) over direct training without curriculum. Compared with handcrafted curriculum learning, our method improves success rate by \(18.5\%\) on the hardest terrain tasks and by up to \(39.74\%\) when evaluating traversal from diverse approach directions on the same obstacle type.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TACL框架，一种面向非结构化地形的轨迹级自动课程学习方法，通过评估器学习难度函数、采样器生成新轨迹，形成闭环课程学习，显著提升轨迹成功率。
AI.motivation: 非结构化地形缺乏显式的难度排序，现有方法依赖参数化地形的启发式课程，导致策略过适应于近似固定的感知模式，泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 提出TACL框架：1）评估器学习当前策略的难度函数，将轨迹任务映射为难度分数；2）采样器基于评估器指导生成新轨迹作为下一轮策略更新的课程；3）形成闭环，课程随策略演化迭代匹配。
AI.result: 相比无课程直接训练，轨迹成功率提升56.3%；相比手工设计课程，在最难地形任务上成功率提升18.5%，在多种接近方向评估中最高提升39.74%。
AI.conclusion: TACL能够在不依赖人工难度排序的情况下，直接从非结构化地形地图生成有效课程，持续为策略提供适配的渐进式训练任务，改善泛化性能。

title: A Privacy Study of Sparse Collaborative Inference
summary: Collaborative inference (CI) splits a model between an edge device and a server, whereby the client computes an intermediate activation, transmits it, and the server completes the computation. This raises two concerns, the communication cost of the transmission and the risk that it reveals private information about the input. Recent work reduces this cost by sparsifying activations and entropy-coding the result. Sparsity has also been argued to improve privacy, on the intuition that transmitting fewer values reveals less about the input. We test this claim by decomposing the sparse activation into the retained values and the set of positions they occupy, and by reconstructing inputs from each component in isolation. We find that sparsification reduces the leakage far less than it reduces the transmission cost, and that the remaining risk shifts to the positions, which prior analyses treat as side information for decoding. Across natural-image and face datasets, the positions alone constitute a serious privacy risk, enabling high-fidelity reconstructions and re-identification of individuals. The leakage from the positions persists even when both the transmission cost and the task utility are low. We conclude that the positions of sparse activations should be treated as sensitive transmitted data and audited carefully in the context of collaborative inference. Code is available at https://github.com/an7123/Privacy-Study-Sparse-CI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了协作推理（CI）中稀疏激活的隐私风险，发现稀疏化虽然大幅降低了通信成本，但对隐私的保护远低于预期。通过将稀疏激活分解为保留值和位置信息，作者发现位置信息本身构成严重的隐私泄露风险，即使传输成本和任务效用都很低时依然如此。因此，位置信息应被视为敏感传输数据并需谨慎审计。
AI.motivation: 协作推理中，现有工作通过稀疏化激活并熵编码来降低通信成本，同时直觉上认为稀疏化（传输更少的数值）也能提升隐私保护。作者旨在验证这一直觉性假设是否成立，评估稀疏化是否真的能有效降低输入私有信息的泄露。
AI.method: 作者将稀疏激活分解为两个组成部分：保留的数值（values）和它们所在的位置集合（positions），然后分别从每个组成部分独立地重建输入。在自然图像和人脸数据集上进行实验，评估两个组成部分各自带来的隐私泄露程度。
AI.result: 研究发现稀疏化减少隐私泄露的程度远小于其减少传输成本的程度，剩余风险主要转移到了位置信息上。仅凭位置信息就能实现高保真的输入重建和个体重新识别，构成严重的隐私风险。该泄露在传输成本和任务效用都较低时依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏激活中的位置信息应被视为敏感的传输数据，在协作推理的背景下需要被仔细审计和对待，不能简单地将稀疏化视为隐私保护的机制。

title: Baseline-Relative Counterfactual Refinement for Bit-Aware Visual Token Communication
summary: Generative visual-token communication reduces transmission load by sending only selected discrete tokens and reconstructing missing content at the receiver. However, existing token-selection criteria based on local uncertainty, importance, or diversity do not directly determine whether changing the current selection improves the final reconstruction under the same packet budget. To address this problem, we propose Gated Counterfactual Refinement for Communication (GCR-C), a rollout-style correction layer over Local-MDL. GCR-C constructs a compact diversified candidate set, evaluates each candidate through matched full-budget Local-MDL continuation, and replaces the baseline action only when a positive baseline-relative reconstruction gain is obtained. Experiments on CIFAR-10, STL-10, a coded 5G-LDPC link, and a limited high-resolution Kodak transfer show that GCR-C consistently improves reconstruction quality at active low- and medium-rate operating points without increasing the realized packet rate, while remaining effective across changes in dataset, channel condition, resolution, token grid, and tokenizer. The results also reveal a clear quality--computation tradeoff due to the additional encoder-side counterfactual evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出GCR-C（门控反事实精炼通信），一种基于rollout式修正层的生成式视觉token通信框架。它构建紧凑多样的候选集，通过匹配全预算的Local-MDL继续生成来评估每个候选，仅当相对于基线产生正向重建增益时才替换动作。在CIFAR-10、STL-10、5G-LDPC链路及高分辨率Kodak上均稳定提升重建质量，不增加实际包速率，但存在质量-计算权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于局部不确定性、重要性或多样性的token选择准则，无法直接判断在相同包预算下改变当前选择是否能改善最终重建质量。缺乏以最终重建为导向的选择优化机制。
AI.method: GCR-C作为Local-MDL之上的rollout式修正层：1) 构建紧凑多样化候选集；2) 对每个候选执行匹配全预算的Local-MDL续生成；3) 采用门控机制，仅在候选产生正向基线相对重建增益时才替换基线动作。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、STL-10、编码5G-LDPC链路及有限高分辨率Kodak传输实验中，GCR-C在低速率和中速率工作点上一致提升重建质量，不增加实际包速率，且对数据集、信道条件、分辨率、token网格和tokenizer的变换保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 反事实评估方法是提升token选择质量的有效途径，但编码端额外的反事实评估带来了清晰的质量-计算权衡，这为未来研究提供了优化方向。

title: StreamOPD: A Post-Training Recipe with Spatio-Temporal Cue Gating for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding demands direct responses from the causally observed prefix of an unfolding video. Existing systems add inference-time memory, retrieval, and compression, yet a training-free sliding-window baseline already matches them. We therefore fix a memory-free recent-window protocol and ask how far post-training alone can go. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards fits this regime poorly, encouraging long ``think-then-answer'' generations, while on-policy distillation (OPD) supplies dense token-level teacher supervision on student trajectories but is stable only when both models train in thinking mode. These observations lead to \textsc{StreamOPD}, a recipe combining verifiable streaming-video data, thinking-mode OPD, and instruct-mode deployment. It raises StreamingBench from $77.9\%$ to $83.9\%$---within $0.3$ points of the 9B teacher---and improves OVO-Bench excluding its hallucination-detection subtask (HLD) by $9.1$ points under unchanged inference. As a teacher-privilege extension, \emph{Spatio-Temporal CueGate (ST-CueGate)} aggregates cue-versus-no-cue teacher likelihood ratios into a group-relative response score that reweights OPD. It reaches $71.9\%$ on OVO-Bench (excluding HLD) and $64.9\%$ on Video-MME, and is the only variant that stays above the base model on all four benchmarks. Replacing the teacher with a frozen copy of the student's initial policy---on-policy self-distillation---retains most of these gains and lifts HLD to $57.0\%$, above both the untrained student and the 9B teacher, so abstention loss is not intrinsic to the recipe. We provide a transparent and reproducible reference for open-source streaming-video research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StreamOPD，一个结合可验证流式视频数据、思考模式下的同策略蒸馏（OPD）和指令模式部署的训练方案，仅通过后训练将StreamingBench从77.9%提升到83.9%（接近9B教师水平），并在OVO-Bench（排除HLD）上提升9.1分。进一步的教师特权扩展ST-CueGate利用线索/无线索似然比加权OPD，在所有四个基准上保持高于基线的表现。用学生初始策略的冻结副本替代教师（同策略自蒸馏）保留了大部分收益并提升HLD到57.0%。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需要在因果观察前缀上直接响应。现有系统依赖推理时内存、检索和压缩，但无训练滑动窗口基线已能匹配这些方法。作者因此固定无记忆最近窗口协议，探索仅靠后训练能走多远，并发现RLVR不适配该场景（鼓励长思考-回答生成），而OPD虽提供稠密token级监督但仅在双方都处于思考模式时才稳定。
AI.method: StreamOPD：结合可验证流式视频数据、思考模式OPD训练、推理时切换为指令模式部署。ST-CueGate作为教师特权扩展，聚合线索/无线索教师似然比形成组相对响应分数来重新加权OPD。还探索了用学生初始策略的冻结副本作为教师（自蒸馏）的变体。
AI.result: StreamOPD在StreamingBench上从77.9%提升到83.9%（距9B教师仅0.3分），OVO-Bench（排除HLD）提升9.1分且推理不变。ST-CueGate在OVO-Bench（排除HLD）达71.9%，Video-MME达64.9%，是唯一在全部四个基准上保持在基线上的变体。自蒸馏保留大部分收益且将HLD提升至57.0%，超过未训练学生和9B教师。
AI.conclusion: 训练/推理模式不匹配（思考模式训练+指令模式部署）是流式视频后训练成功的关键；OPD比RLVR更适合此场景；HLD的降低并非配方固有缺陷（自蒸馏可超越教师）；提供了透明可复现的开源流式视频研究参考。

title: Optimizing Multi-Market Participation of Battery and Electrolyser Systems Based on Field Performance
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Power and Energy Society General Meeting (PESGM)
summary: The increasing share of renewable energy in power systems creates a need for fast-response and flexible resources to maintain system stability. With the expansion of electricity markets and ancillary service products, opportunities arise to stack revenues across multiple services. Long-term Power-to-X (PTX) electrolysers and short-term battery energy storage systems (BESS) are prevalent flexible resources, yet most studies neglect real hardware behavior, such as ramp limits, efficiency, and setpoint-tracking accuracy. This work presents experimental and modeling results for a 55 kW/79 kWh BESS and an electrolyser comprising three 2.4 kW units. Key characteristics are identified through measurements and embedded into a price-driven optimization framework for participation in the Danish electricity and ancillary service markets, utilizing real market data from 2022 to 2025. The optimized daily profits for multi-market participation are 1,749.27 DKK and 289.46 DKK for the BESS and electrolyser, respectively. With the demonstrated business cases for BESS and PTX systems, this work highlights the importance of incorporating experimental performance when evaluating participation across multiple markets and years.

AI.tldr: 本文对55kW/79kWh电池储能系统（BESS）和由三个2.4kW单元组成的电解器进行了实验测试与建模，将真实硬件特性（爬坡限制、效率、设定点跟踪精度）嵌入价格驱动优化框架，利用2022-2025年真实市场数据评估其在丹麦电力和辅助服务市场的多市场参与收益。结果显示BESS和电解器的最优日利润分别为1,749.27丹麦克朗和289.46丹麦克朗，强调了在评估多市场参与时纳入实验性能的重要性。
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源占比增加，电力系统需要快速响应和灵活资源来维持稳定性。电力市场和辅助服务产品扩张创造了跨服务叠加收入的机会，但大多数研究忽视了实际硬件行为（如爬坡限制、效率和设定点跟踪精度），导致对BESS和电解器这类灵活资源的经济潜力评估可能不准确。
