AI.method: 对55 kW/79 kWh BESS和含三个2.4 kW单元的电解器进行实验测试，识别关键硬件特性；将这些特性嵌入面向价格驱动的优化框架中；利用2022至2025年的真实市场数据，评估系统参与丹麦电力和辅助服务市场的多市场协同收益。
AI.result: 多市场参与下，BESS和电解器的最优日利润分别为1,749.27丹麦克朗和289.46丹麦克朗，证明了两种灵活资源的商业可行性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作强调了在评估多市场、多年份参与时，将实验性能数据纳入优化模型的重要性，为BESS和PTX系统的实际市场投资决策提供了更可靠的依据。

title: Beyond Asking: A Pipeline for Personalized Game Generation that Reads Players from Behavior
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Includes technical appendix
summary: Personalized game generation requires inferring a player's abilities and behavioral style from how they play. Large language models have made this inference more attainable than ever: an LLM can read a raw gameplay transcript and produce a fluent, plausible profile of the player. Plausible, however, is not verified, and verification is precisely what the field lacks: latent traits are unobservable; questionnaires provide noisy proxies and become circular when self-reports are used to validate behavior-based inference; and behavior itself is ambiguous without context -- a player who never collects an item may not want it, or may never have had the chance. We address both problems. First, we construct a synthetic player population whose traits are ground truth by construction: each trait is an explicit bot parameter, accepted only after controlled manipulation produces consistent, trait-specific behavioral change. Unlike prior parameter-recovery work that inverts a known decision model, our benchmark evaluates policy-agnostic inference from behavioral transcripts alone. Second, we introduce an opportunity-aware decision-moment representation that disentangles preference from the chance to express it; ablating it selectively degrades opportunity-dependent traits. On this benchmark, few-shot LLM inference outperforms embedding- and rule-based baselines on most traits, though feature-based supervised regressors remain stronger overall. Finally, we close the loop: inferred profiles drive difficulty adaptation, evaluated against ground-truth references and mismatched-profile controls, and an exploratory human study examines whether these findings transfer to real players.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个以合成玩家群体为基准的个性化游戏生成评估框架，通过将bot参数作为特质真值，引入机会感知的决策时刻表示来区分偏好与表达机会，并验证了LLM推断玩家特质的能力及其驱动的难度自适应效果。
AI.motivation: 个性化游戏生成需要从玩家行为中推断其能力与行为风格，但现有验证方法存在根本缺陷：潜在特质不可观测、问卷是噪声代理且存在循环验证问题、行为本身具有歧义性（不收集道具可能是不想要也可能没机会）。
AI.method: 1) 构建合成玩家群体，每个特质作为显式bot参数，通过受控操纵产生一致的特质特定行为变化来验证；2) 引入机会感知的决策时刻表示，将偏好与表达机会分离；3) 评估少样本LLM推断、嵌入方法、规则基线和特征监督回归等方法的性能；4) 将推断结果用于难度自适应，并与ground-truth参照和错配档案对照比较。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，少样本LLM推断在大多数特质上优于嵌入与规则基线，但特征监督回归器整体更强。消融实验显示机会感知表示会选择性地退化机会依赖型特质的性能。难度自适应实验和探索性人类研究验证了结果向真实玩家的迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了行为推断验证缺失的空白，提供了一个具备ground truth特质的合成基准，并证明了机会感知表示和LLM推断在个性化游戏生成中的有效性，同时指出监督回归方法仍有优势。

title: LaGSplat: Inferring Physics-Governed Interactive Simulation from Monocular Video Using Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting
comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Project page with interactive demo: https://louenpottier.github.io/lagsplat.html
summary: We present LaGSplat (Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting), a framework that infers interactive, physics-governed dynamics from one or a few monocular videos. At inference it lets a user push on the filmed object, rigid or deformable, with an external force that was never measured, annotated, or seen during training. This is possible because a low-dimensional latent state $\mathbf{q} \in \mathbb{R}^d$ plays two roles at once: it is the generalised coordinate of a learned dissipative Lagrangian and the conditioning variable of a Gaussian Splatting decoder. The inductive bias of this decoder, whose primitives are explicit points $μ_i(\mathbf{q})$ that move with the object, is what lets a force $f$ applied in the image pull back into a latent generalised force $J(\mathbf{q})^\top f$ and enter the equations of motion, which pixel-space (CNN) or neural-field (NeRF) decoders cannot do. We validate LaGSplat on test cases of increasing difficulty, from rigid to deformable and from autonomous to forced real systems, combining monocular video and sensor measurements. We further demonstrate interactive use: forces of arbitrary magnitude and direction can be applied to the reconstructed object at any time, its response rendered in real time, in 2D or 3D. Assuming a dissipative Euler-Lagrange equation over a few generalised coordinates trades generality for a bounded, plausible response to unseen forces, where an unconstrained predictor diverges.

AI.tldr: LaGSplat提出了一种从单目视频中推断具有物理规律动力学的方法，用户可以在推理时对刚体或可变形物体施加训练中从未见过的外力，系统能实时渲染出符合物理规律的响应。其关键在于将低维潜变量同时用作耗散拉格朗日方程的运动学坐标和高斯溅射解码器的条件变量。
AI.motivation: 现有的动力学学习方法要么只能处理无外力干预的自发运动，要么无法对未见过的新外力产生合理响应。需要一种既能从少量单目视频中学习物体动力学、又能在推理时支持用户交互式施加任意力的框架。像素空间CNN或神经场NeRF解码器无法将图像空间中的力反推入运动方程。
AI.method: 利用低维潜状态q同时充当两个角色：既是学习到的耗散拉格朗日方程中的广义坐标，又是高斯溅射解码器的条件变量。该解码器的高斯基元为随物体运动的显式点μ_i(q)，使图像中施加的力f能通过雅可比J(q)^T反推为潜空间中的广义力并进入运动方程。假设耗散欧拉-拉格朗日方程，在少量广义坐标上以通用性换取对有界、合理的未知力响应。
AI.result: 在从刚体到可变形体、从自主运动到受迫真实系统的递进难度测试用例上验证了有效性，结合了单目视频与传感器数据。展示了交互式使用：任意大小和方向的外力可在任意时刻施加，物体的响应可实时以2D或3D渲染。
AI.conclusion: 通过将物理归纳偏置（耗散拉格朗日方程）与显式点基元的渲染解码器（高斯溅射）相结合，LaGSplat实现了对未见外力可控且符合物理的响应，而无约束的预测器则会发散。这种以少部分广义坐标为代价的建模方式，在通用性与可解释物理响应之间取得了有价值的权衡。

title: The Trade-off Between Covariate Dependence and Latent Structure in Representation Learning
summary: Disentangled representation learning seeks latent representations whose indicidual dimensions each align with a distinct covariate. Unsupervised approaches typically target latent dimension independence, yet this gives no guarantee that the resulting dimensions align with semantically meaningful covariates. Supervised approaches structure the latent space using observed covariates, but under correlated covariates they cannot simultaneously control one-to-one latent-covariate alignment and latent independence. We introduce a unified, supervised framework that couples latent dimension-covariate dependence with constraints on the latent structure. Within this framework, we show an inherent trade-off, where enforcing latent independence or exclusive one-to-one latent-covariate dependence comes at a provable cost in latent-covariate alignment. We prove that the resulting disentanglement regimes are ordered by the strength of that alignment. Each regime admits a closed-form transformation of the latent space. We apply these transformations post-hoc to realign the representations of pretrained models such as CLIP, DINOv2, and ViT, and we fold them into the inference of informed factor analysis (iFA), a probabilistic model with covariate-informed factors. On simulated and real multi-omics data, we show that both post-hoc alignment and iFA enable controllability of structured latent representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的有监督解缠表示学习框架，将潜在维度与协变量的依赖关系同潜在结构约束耦合，并证明了潜在独立性或一对一潜在-协变量排他依赖与潜在-协变量对齐之间存在固有的权衡。每个解缠区域对应一个闭式潜在空间变换，可后验应用于预训练模型（如CLIP、DINOv2、ViT），也可融入iFA概率模型。
AI.motivation: 无监督解缠学习仅追求潜在维度独立性，无法保证维度与语义上有意义的协变量对齐；有监督方法虽利用观测协变量结构化潜在空间，但在协变量相关时无法同时控制一对一潜在-协变量对齐与潜在独立性。需要一个统一框架来处理这一矛盾。
AI.method: 提出统一的有监督框架，将潜在维度-协变量依赖与潜在结构约束耦合；证明在强制潜在独立性或排他一对一依赖时，潜在-协变量对齐会付出可证的代价；不同解缠区域按对齐强度排序，每个区域对应一个闭式潜在空间变换；变换可后验应用于预训练模型，也可纳入iFA（协变量信息因子分析）的推理中。
AI.result: 在模拟数据和真实多组学数据上，后验对齐和iFA方法均能实现对结构化潜在表征的可控性。
AI.conclusion: 解缠表征学习中存在潜在结构与潜在-协变量对齐之间的固有权衡，但通过闭式变换可以在不同解缠区域间灵活切换，实现对预训练和概率模型的潜在表征的可控对齐。

title: Competing at Every Price Point with Agentic Evolution over a Menu of LLMs
summary: Consider a firm that surveys its competition for a particular agentic task and seeks to offer superior accuracy at every competitor price point. A firm that Pareto-dominated its competitors would leave no rational customer a reason to buy elsewhere. This paper shows a path to this kind of capability via agentic evolution over a menu of LLMs, from training pools of at most 100 examples. Given a priced menu of nine LLM endpoints; brief documentation of the task, objective, and API; a simple seed agent; and an operator-chosen per-problem cost target - usually set at an incumbent's own price - RoboPhD, an evolutionary meta-agent, evolves complete agent programs that attack the public frontiers of two semantically dissimilar tasks point by point: DS-1000 (execution-checked code generation) and PaperFindingBench (LLM-judged scientific document retrieval). Our officially scored submissions hold every Pareto-frontier slot but one on the two tasks' leaderboards, including Pareto domination of both the top-scoring and the lowest-cost competing points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboPhD，一个进化式元智能体，能从最多100个示例的训练池中，在九个LLM端点的价格菜单上进化出完整的智能体程序，在DS-1000和PaperFindingBench两个任务上实现帕累托支配竞争对手，几乎占据所有帕累托前沿位置。
AI.motivation: 企业希望在所有价格点上提供优于竞争对手的准确性，即帕累托支配竞争对手，使理性客户没有理由购买别家的服务。本文旨在展示实现这种能力的一条路径。
AI.method: 采用进化式元智能体框架RoboPhD：输入为有定价的九个LLM端点菜单、简短的任务文档（目标与API）、简单种子智能体以及操作者选择的每个问题的成本目标（通常设定为竞争对手的价格）。RoboPhD通过进化方式演化出完整的智能体程序，逐点攻击两个语义不同任务的公共前沿。
AI.result: 官方评分提交在两个任务的排行榜上几乎占据所有帕累托前沿位置（仅漏掉一个），包括帕累托支配了得分最高和成本最低的竞争方案。
AI.conclusion: 仅用少量训练示例（最多100个），通过智能体进化的方法，可以在多个成本点位上实现对竞争对手的帕累托支配，展示了小样本进化方法在构建成本-精度前沿优势方面的可行性。

title: GRNEdit: Efficient General Video Editing from a New Binary-Evidence Perspective in Generative Refinement Networks
summary: Instruction-based general video editing seeks to unify diverse editing operations within a single, intuitive interface. Existing approaches often rely on resource-intensive conditioning, using either heavyweight branches or costly source concatenation. Is there any efficient way to model editing intent? Thus, we introduce GRNEdit, a lightweight two-stage framework. GRN inspires our approach by encoding visual semantics through combinations of bits. Through task-specific fine-tuning, we take this representation further and recast editing semantics as local retain-or-flip decisions over individual bits. Source information is consequently modeled as coordinate-wise evidence supporting the observed binary states, while the GRN backbone remains responsible for resolving their global composition into coherent generative semantics. In Stage I, a compact encoder translates discrete source codes into continuous evidence signals, which GRN assimilates throughout binary refinement. Inspired by null-prompt training for classifier-free guidance, we further assign the null condition an editing-specific meaning: an empty instruction denotes no edit and is supervised through source reconstruction. This identity pathway not only implicitly strengthens evidence utilization and content preservation in Stage I, but also produces a source-preserving state in the same representation space as the edited state. Stage II can therefore directly compare each edited state with its source-preserving counterpart and use their discrepancy to revise unresolved target-bit decisions. Trained on only 0.6M pairs with less than 3\% conditioning parameters, GRNEdit-2B and GRNEdit-8B achieve scores of 4.03 and 4.18 on OpenVE-Bench. The 2B model outperforms multiple 14B open-source editors, while the 8B model performs on par with leading open-source editors.

AI.tldr: GRNEdit是一个轻量级两阶段视频编辑框架，通过将编辑语义建模为GRN（binary）表示上的局部保留或翻转决策，仅用不到3%的条件参数和0.6M训练对，就在OpenVE-Bench上达到4.03（2B）和4.18（8B）的分数，性能超越多个14B开源编辑器。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于指令的通用视频编辑方法通常依赖资源密集型的条件建模方式（如重型分支或昂贵的源视频拼接），缺乏高效建模编辑意图的方法。作者希望探索一种更轻量的方式来编码编辑语义。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架GRNEdit。核心思想是将编辑语义映射为GRN（binary code）上的局部保留或翻转决策：Stage I用紧凑编码器将离散源编码翻译为连续证据信号，由GRN骨干在二值精化过程中吸收；同时引入"空指令=无编辑"的身份路径（受null-prompt训练启发），通过源重建监督来强化证据利用和内容保持；Stage II直接将每个编辑状态与源保持状态对比，用两者差异修正未解决的目标比特决策。
AI.result: 仅用0.6M训练对和少于3%的条件参数，GRNEdit-2B和GRNEdit-8B在OpenVE-Bench上分别取得4.03和4.18分。2B模型超越多个14B开源编辑器，8B模型与领先开源编辑器持平。
AI.conclusion: 通过将编辑意图转化为二值表示上的局部比特决策，GRNEdit证明了一种高效且可扩展的视频编辑条件建模方式，在显著降低计算开销的同时达到甚至超越大规模模型的效果。

title: SAUL: Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning in Large Language Models (LLMs) faces a critical trade-off between erasing target knowledge and preserving general utility. We propose SAUL (Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning), which formulates unlearning as a constrained minimization problem following the principle of "forget enough, but no more than necessary." At its core, SAUL formulates forgetting as an explicit constraint with a prescribed satisfaction criterion, whereas prior unlearning methods typically specify the desired level of forgetting implicitly through optimization objectives. An augmented Lagrangian controller adaptively adjusts forget-side pressure according to constraint violation and can eventually deactivate the forget-side update as the prescribed criterion remains satisfied. Sharpness-aware updates on both retain and forget objectives, together with a dual-optimizer design that maintains role-separated states, further stabilize the resulting unlearning dynamics. We evaluate SAUL on the TOFU, WMDP, and MUSE benchmarks, demonstrating favorable forgetting-utility trade-offs over representative sharpness- and perturbation-based baselines under benchmark-specific forgetting criteria. Beyond the complete SAUL framework, we further show on TOFU that applying the augmented-Lagrangian controller as a drop-in modifier to representative baselines improves their post-forgetting utility, demonstrating the practical value of explicit forgetting control.

AI.tldr: 提出SAUL框架，将大语言模型机器遗忘建模为有约束的最小化问题，通过增广拉格朗日控制器显式控制遗忘程度，并结合锐度感知更新与双优化器设计，在TOFU、WMDP和MUSE基准上取得了更优的遗忘-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM机器遗忘面临目标知识擦除与通用能力保留之间的关键权衡，现有方法通常通过优化目标隐式设定遗忘水平，缺乏显式、可控的遗忘标准。
AI.method: 将遗忘建模为带预设满足准则的显式约束，使用增广拉格朗日控制器根据约束违反程度自适应调整遗忘侧压力（达标后可停用遗忘更新）；对保留和遗忘目标均采用锐度感知更新，并通过双优化器设计维持角色分离状态以稳定训练动态。
AI.result: 在TOFU、WMDP和MUSE基准上，SAUL在遗忘-效用权衡上优于代表性锐度与扰动基线；将增广拉格朗日控制器作为即插即用修改器应用于基线方法，可提升其遗忘后的效用。
AI.conclusion: 显式的遗忘约束控制具有实用价值，SAUL的增广拉格朗日控制器不仅能独立工作，还能作为通用模块增强现有遗忘方法的性能。

title: BaT: Towards Self-Evolving Medical Research Agent with Stage Rubrics
summary: Long-horizon agents are beginning to automate complete workflows that produce code, reports, and research artifacts. Medical imaging workflows are multi-stage and data-sensitive, while expert trajectories remain scarce and difficult to share. Structured benchmarks can localize failures through stage-level rubrics, but standard post-training discards these diagnostics before the next training round. We present Benchmark-as-Teacher (BaT), a recursive self-improvement system for agent post-training. BaT contains two linked components: the asynchronous Stage Bank data pipeline and BiCuRL (Bilevel Curriculum Reinforcement Learning), its self-improving post-training method. Stage Bank synthesizes content-isolated training states outside the policy-update loop. BiCuRL uses a fixed held-out evaluation to select the next stage curriculum, verifies rollouts with task rubrics, updates the policy with GRPO, and returns the candidate checkpoint to evaluation. On AutoMedBench-Lite, BaT-4B and BaT-9B more than double the Overall scores of their Qwen Instruct baselines. BaT-9B Agent reaches 79.6 Overall, exceeding Claude Opus 4.6 with Claude Code at 77.5.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Benchmark-as-Teacher (BaT)系统，通过异步Stage Bank数据管道和BiCuRL（双层课程强化学习）方法实现医疗影像智能体的递归自我改进后训练。在AutoMedBench-Lite上，BaT-4B和BaT-9B的Overall分数较基线翻倍以上，BaT-9B达到79.6分，超越Claude Opus 4.6搭配Claude Code的77.5分。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体开始自动化完整工作流，但医疗影像工作流是多阶段且数据敏感的，专家轨迹稀缺难以共享。虽然结构化基准可通过阶段级评分定位失败，但标准后训练在下轮训练前丢弃了这些诊断信息，造成资源浪费。
AI.method: BaT系统包含两个组件：1) 异步Stage Bank数据管道，在策略更新循环之外合成内容隔离的训练状态；2) BiCuRL（Bilevel Curriculum Reinforcement Learning）自改进后训练方法，利用固定留出评估选择下一阶段课程，通过任务评分验证rollout，用GRPO更新策略，并将候选检查点返回评估。
AI.result: 在AutoMedBench-Lite基准上，BaT-4B和BaT-9B的Overall分数比Qwen Instruct基线翻倍以上。BaT-9B Agent达到79.6 Overall，超过Claude Opus 4.6搭配Claude Code的77.5分。
AI.conclusion: BaT证明了将基准诊断信息引入后训练循环可以显著提升医疗影像长时程智能体的性能，并且较小规模的开源模型通过递归自改进能够超越更大规模的商业模型。

title: Unlocking Motion in Expressions: Temporal Calibration for Referring Video Object Segmentation
summary: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to segment referred objects at the pixel level in video sequences based on natural language descriptions. Existing methods typically introduce motion information within a unified cross-modal temporal modeling framework, where language cues are used for target localization and segmentation. However, the dependency of expressions on motion semantics is not explicitly modeled, making it difficult to adaptively adjust the use of motion information according to different semantic requirements. To address these issues, we propose an Expression-driven Motion Calibration (EMC) framework for RVOS that explicitly unlocks and leverages the motion semantics within expressions. The proposed method extracts interpretable motion control signals from expressions via a Motion Signal Processing (MSP) module, and employs a Motion Influence Calibration (MIC) module to adjust the contribution of motion cues during temporal decision making. In addition, a Semantic Temporal Stage Construction (STSC) module is introduced to build expression-relevant temporal stages, providing a compact temporal candidate space for motion calibration. Through extensive evaluation on six standard benchmarks, including Ref-YouTubeVOS, Ref-DAVIS17, MeViS (valid/valid$^u$), A2D-Sentences, and JHMDB-Sentences, the superiority of our method is validated. We will release the code on https://github.com/Jeven7/EMC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为EMC（Expression-driven Motion Calibration）的框架，用于解决指代视频物体分割（RVOS）问题。该框架通过显式挖掘语言表达中的运动语义，利用运动信号处理（MSP）模块提取可解释的运动控制信号，并通过运动影响校准（MIC）模块动态调整运动信息在时间决策中的贡献，同时引入语义时间阶段构建（STSC）模块以提供紧凑的时间候选空间。在六个标准基准上的广泛实验验证了方法的优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有RVOS方法通常在一个统一的跨模态时间建模框架中引入运动信息，依赖语言线索进行目标定位和分割，但未显式建模表达对运动语义的依赖关系，难以根据不同的语义需求自适应地调整运动信息的使用。
AI.method: 提出EMC框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) MSP模块从表达式中提取可解释的运动控制信号；(2) MIC模块用于校准运动线索在时间决策过程中的贡献；(3) STSC模块构建与表达相关的时间阶段，为运动校准提供紧凑的时间候选空间。
AI.result: 在Ref-YouTubeVOS、Ref-DAVIS17、MeViS（valid/valid^u）、A2D-Sentences和JHMDB-Sentences六个标准基准上的广泛评估验证了方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解锁和利用表达中的运动语义，EMC框架能够更有效地根据不同语义需求自适应调整运动信息的利用，从而提升指代视频物体分割的性能。

title: Efficient Coreset Selection via K-Nearest Neighbor Graphs
summary: Coreset selection reduces the cost of model training by replacing a large training set with a small representative subset. Existing gradient-approximation coreset methods such as CRAIG and cluster-based variants can preserve model accuracy. Still, their selection stages often rely on dense pairwise distances or large item-cluster bound matrices, leading to high time and memory costs on large datasets. This paper proposes KNNG-CS, a lightweight coreset selection method based on a $K$-nearest neighbor graph. KNNG-CS exploits local neighborhood structures to estimate the importance of each data item and greedily selects representative nodes without maintaining a quadratic distance matrix. The method requires only linear storage in the number of edges. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that KNNG-CS achieves accuracy comparable to representative gradient-approximation coreset methods, while reducing selection time by $2.3\times$-$41.2\times$ and peak memory to $0.3\%$-$7.5\%$ of the baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KNNG-CS，一种基于K近邻图的轻量级coreset选择方法，通过利用局部邻域结构估计数据项重要性并贪心选择代表节点，避免维护二次距离矩阵，仅需线性存储。在四个真实数据集上，该方法在保持与现有梯度近似coreset方法相当精度的同时，将选择时间降低2.3倍到41.2倍，峰值内存仅为基础方法的0.3%到7.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度近似coreset方法（如CRAIG及其聚类变体）虽然能保持模型精度，但其选择阶段往往依赖密集的成对距离计算或大规模item-cluster边界矩阵，在大型数据集上导致高昂的时间和内存成本。作者旨在解决coreset选择在大规模数据场景下的效率瓶颈。
AI.method: KNNG-CS基于K近邻图构建coreset选择方法。核心思路是利用K近邻图的局部邻域结构来估计每个数据项的重要性，并通过贪心策略选择代表性节点。该方法不需要维护二次距离矩阵，存储复杂度仅与边的数量成线性关系，从而显著降低时间和内存开销。
AI.result: 在四个真实数据集上的实验表明，KNNG-CS能够达到与代表性梯度近似coreset方法相当的模型精度，同时将选择时间降低2.3倍到41.2倍，峰值内存使用仅为基础方法的0.3%到7.5%。
AI.conclusion: KNNG-CS证明了利用K近邻图的局部结构可以高效实现coreset选择，在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算资源和内存开销，为大规模数据集下的coreset选择提供了实用的轻量级解决方案。

title: Process-Constituted Intelligence: A Shared Criterion for Humans and Machines
summary: Intelligence is constituted by \textit{process} (iterative activity through which output emerges), not in the output itself. Generative AI (GenAI) is trained on \textit{traces} (textual and visual residues of human cognitive processes), reproducing samples from a distribution of those traces. Its outputs resemble reasoning, problem-solving, and creativity, yet the activity that produces such outputs in humans remains largely absent. Current GenAI is, therefore, weakly equivalent to the cognition it imitates, matching outputs while process stays absent or opaque. The cognitive sciences have long distinguished between weak and strong equivalence. Here, we define \textit{strong} equivalence across seven process features, assessable against human and machine cognition. Our process-based account addresses a symmetric risk: GenAI tools that outsource a person's generative processes may leave critical capacities unbuilt. We specify design principles for GenAI that instantiate more process and preserve rather than erode human judgment and creativity, and outline process audits that make strong equivalence testable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出智能的本质在于过程而非输出，认为当前生成式AI（GenAI）仅对认知痕迹的分布进行采样，因此与人类认知仅具备弱等价性。作者定义了涵盖七项过程特征的强等价框架，并提出设计原则与过程审计，使强等价可测试，以防范GenAI侵蚀人类判断与创造力。
AI.motivation: 当前GenAI输出看似具备推理、解决问题和创造力，但其产出背后缺乏人类认知中产生这些输出所需的活动过程。作者担忧GenAI外包人类生成过程会削弱关键能力，因此需要一个基于过程的框架来区分弱等价与强等价，并指导AI设计。
AI.method: 作者从认知科学中弱等价与强等价的经典区分出发，定义了强等价所需的七项过程特征，并据此在人类与机器认知之间进行评估；同时提出可实例化更多过程的GenAI设计原则，以及使强等价可检验的过程审计方法。
AI.result: 论文提出了一个基于过程的强等价定义框架（七项特征），并给出了相应的设计原则与过程审计方案，使得GenAI与人类认知之间的强等价关系可以被具体评估和测试。
AI.conclusion: 智能应被视为过程而非输出；为了让GenAI不侵蚀人类判断力与创造力，应通过设计原则和过程审计推动GenAI朝强等价方向演进，而非停留在仅模仿输出痕迹的弱等价层面。

title: SIGMA-Lane: Scale-pyramId Gated MAmba for Temporally Consistent Video Lane Detection
summary: Video lane detection requires predictions that remain stable across frames, yet severe vehicle occlusions can break temporal cues. In streaming recurrent models, corrupted observations may enter the hidden state and produce errors that persist into later frames. Existing occlusion-aware refinements usually provide obstacle masks as auxiliary inputs, so the state-update path is only indirectly protected. We propose SIGMA-Lane, which treats this failure mode as state contamination in State Space Model (SSM)-based temporal modeling. SIGMA-Lane places occlusion-aware gates on the SSM write and residual-fusion paths, controlling how current observations enter temporal memory and are fused back after temporal propagation. After coordinate-consistent affine alignment, the model combines two complementary paths: SSM-consistent dual-gating for temporal filtering and Structural Spatial Retrieval (SSR) for recovering missing lane structure from aligned historical priors. Experiments on VIL-100 and OpenLane-V show improved temporal stability under heavy occlusion, with competitive F1 and mIoU scores.

AI.tldr: 提出SIGMA-Lane，一个基于状态空间模型（SSM）的视频车道线检测方法，通过遮挡感知门控机制防止被遮挡的帧污染时间记忆，结合结构空间检索恢复缺失的车道结构，在VIL-100和OpenLane-V数据集上实现更好的时间稳定性。
AI.motivation: 视频车道线检测中，严重车辆遮挡会破坏时间线索。在流式循环模型中，被遮挡的观测可能进入隐状态并产生持续的错误。现有遮挡感知方法仅将障碍物掩码作为辅助输入，状态更新路径未被直接保护，导致状态污染问题。
AI.method: SIGMA-Lane将车道检测中的失败模式视为SSM中的状态污染问题。具体方法包括：1) 在SSM的写入路径和残差融合路径上放置遮挡感知门控，控制当前观测如何进入时间记忆以及时间传播后如何融合回来；2) 通过坐标一致的仿射对齐；3) 结合两条互补路径：SSM一致的双门控时间滤波和结构空间检索（SSR），从对齐的历史先验中恢复缺失的车道结构。
AI.result: 在VIL-100和OpenLane-V数据集上的实验表明，SIGMA-Lane在重遮挡下具有更好的时间稳定性，并在F1和mIoU指标上取得有竞争力的成绩。
AI.conclusion: SIGMA-Lane通过直接在SSM状态更新路径上施加遮挡感知门控，有效解决了视频车道检测中的状态污染问题，验证了从SSM角度处理时间域遮挡鲁棒性的有效性。

title: Foresight-England: Development of a National-Scale Generative AI Model of Electronic Health Records for Medical Event Prediction across the COVID-19 Pandemic
comment: Methodology and evaluation framework for Foresight-England. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are not currently available. On behalf of the CVD-COVID-UK/COVID-IMPACT Consortium
summary: Foresight-England (Foresight-E) is the first national-scale generative foundation model of electronic health records (EHRs), developed as a research pilot strictly for COVID-19 research. We evaluated its ability to model the direct and indirect effects of the pandemic. Trained from scratch entirely within the NHS England Secure Data Environment, Foresight-E is a 243-million-parameter transformer decoder. It was trained and evaluated on de-identified, longitudinal EHRs of approximately 61 million individuals, integrating primary/secondary care, death registrations, and COVID-19 data. Training and validation used a 90% subset (54.9 million) spanning November 2018 to December 2022; the remaining 10% (6.1 million) was held out for evaluation. Foresight-E models patient timelines autoregressively, predicting the next medical event given their prior history. At inference, it operates zero-shot, predicting any concept in its ~40,000-code vocabulary without task-specific training. Our tokenisation scheme retains the clinical granularity of ICD-10, OPCS-4, and SNOMED CT codes, jointly representing absolute and relative timing. We designed an evaluation framework for 30-day COVID-19 hospitalisation and mortality, including subgroup analyses by demographic factors and vaccination status. To assess generalisation to unseen future data and the pandemic's indirect effects, we tested the model on medical events from 2023 (beyond its training period), benchmarking against logistic regression and XGBoost. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are currently unavailable. Instead, we share our strategy for tokenisation, architecture, training, inference, and evaluation as a methodological template and case study in the challenges of building population-scale EHR foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Foresight-England（Foresight-E），这是首个国家级规模的电子健康记录（EHR）生成式基础模型，专为COVID-19研究开发。该模型是一个2.43亿参数的Transformer解码器，在NHS England安全数据环境中从头训练，使用了约6100万人的纵向去标识化EHR数据（覆盖初级/二级医疗、死亡登记和COVID-19数据）。模型以自回归方式建模患者时间线，零样本预测未来医疗事件。由于NHS England已暂停数据访问，定量结果不可用，本文以方法论模板和案例研究的形式分享了其标记化、架构、训练、推理和评估策略。
AI.motivation: 在大流行期间及之后，需要更好地理解COVID-19对人群健康产生的直接和间接影响。现有的疾病建模方法通常针对特定任务设计，缺乏通用性和规模性。作者旨在构建一个国家级规模的EHR基础模型，能够在零样本条件下建模患者时间线，同时覆盖COVID-19的直接和间接效应，以应对大规模公共卫生挑战。
AI.method: Foresight-E采用2.43亿参数的Transformer解码器架构，在NHS英格兰安全数据环境中从头训练。使用约6100万人的去标识化纵向EHR数据，其中90%（5490万）用于训练/验证（2018年11月至2022年12月），10%（610万）保留用于评估。模型以自回归方式预测患者下一个医疗事件。标记化方案保留ICD-10、OPCS-4和SNOMED CT代码的临床粒度，并联合表示绝对和相对时间。推理时零样本操作，覆盖约4万代码词汇表。评估框架针对30天COVID-19住院和死亡率设计，包括按人口统计因素和疫苗接种状态的分组分析，并使用2023年数据（超出训练期）测试泛化能力，与逻辑回归和XGBoost进行基准对比。
AI.result: 由于NHS England已暂停对Foresight-E项目的数据访问，定量结果目前不可用。作者转而分享了其方法策略——包括标记化、架构、训练、推理和评估框架——作为方法论模板，以及构建人口规模EHR基础模型所面临挑战的案例研究。
AI.conclusion: Foresight-E作为第一个国家级规模的EHR生成式基础模型，展示了在安全数据环境中构建此类模型的可行性框架。尽管数据访问暂停导致定量结果缺失，但其方法学贡献为未来人口规模EHR基础模型的研究提供了重要模板，特别是在处理临床代码粒度、时间建模、零样本推理和评估框架设计方面。

title: AeroCopilotBench: A Two-Tier Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents as Aviation Copilots in an Interactive Virtual Cockpit Environment
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents may assist flight crews with complex decisions and task execution, but existing aviation evaluations centered on static knowledge do not support systematic testing of procedural execution and safety compliance in interactive environments. This paper presents the AeroCopilot Operational Environment (ACOE), a reproducible interactive virtual-cockpit test environment, and AeroCopilotBench, a two-tier aviation agent evaluation benchmark. Tier-1 evaluates aviation knowledge using 1,200 multiple-choice questions, while Tier-2 comprises 73 emergency and abnormal tasks derived from the manufacturers' Pilot's Operating Handbooks (POHs) and instantiated in ACOE. ACOE converts natural-language procedures into executable state transitions, final-state goal conditions, and hard safety constraints, enabling models to interpret cockpit state, diagnose faults, and operate aircraft systems through standardized tool interfaces. We establish a safety-gated evaluation framework in which a trajectory succeeds only when all task goals are achieved without violating any hard safety constraint, while safe goal progress and trajectory safety are measured separately. Across 12 models, the highest Tier-2 success rate is 72.6%, while static knowledge performance does not consistently translate into procedural execution. Analysis of 451 failed episodes from 3 representative models identifies recurring failures in procedural completeness, use of state feedback, and long-horizon execution management. These findings motivate state-aware agent orchestration, joint assessment of task completion and trajectory safety, and repeated regression testing. ACOE and AeroCopilotBench provide a reproducible foundation for testing knowledge application, interactive execution, and operational safety in aviation agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AeroCopilot Operational Environment (ACOE)，一个可复现的交互式虚拟座舱测试环境，以及AeroCopilotBench，一个双层航空智能体评估基准。Tier-1测试1,200道航空知识选择题，Tier-2包含73个源自飞机制造商POH手册的紧急和异常任务。在12个模型中最高Tier-2成功率为72.6%，并分析了451个失败片段，识别出程序完整性、状态反馈利用和长时程执行管理方面的反复失败。
AI.motivation: 现有航空评估主要基于静态知识测试，无法支持在交互环境中系统性地测试程序执行和安全合规性。LLM智能体有望协助飞行机组进行复杂决策和任务执行，但缺乏能够评估其交互式程序执行能力的测试环境。
AI.method: 构建ACOE可复现的交互式虚拟座舱环境，将自然语言程序转换为可执行状态转换、最终状态目标条件和硬性安全约束。提出AeroCopilotBench双层基准：Tier-1含1,200道多选题评估静态知识，Tier-2含73个POH衍生任务。采用安全门控评估框架，轨迹仅在达成所有目标且不违反任何硬性安全约束时才算成功。
AI.result: 12个模型中Tier-2最高成功率为72.6%；静态知识表现不能一致地转化为程序执行能力。对3个代表性模型的451个失败片段分析发现程序完整性、状态反馈利用和长时程执行管理方面的反复失败。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现促使需要状态感知的智能体编排、任务完成与轨迹安全的联合评估以及重复回归测试。ACOE和AeroCopilotBench为航空智能体的知识应用、交互执行和运行安全测试提供了可复现的基础。

title: Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection for Natural Scenes
summary: To date, all natural scene skeleton detection follows the paradigm of taking RGB images as the sole input; despite notable progress, methods under this paradigm suffer significant performance degradation on complex-content images. We observe that depth images are inherently insensitive to color and texture, and can provide clear regional contours and inter-region spatial relationships, which naturally alleviates the difficulty of skeleton detection in complex scenarios. Motivated by this observation, this paper proposes for the first time a novel skeleton detection paradigm where depth images serve as the dominant modality and RGB images act as the auxiliary, and accordingly presents a model DDSkel (short for Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection) under this paradigm. DDSkel employs an asymmetric encoder design to fuse RGB information into depth features, with the RGB modality branch having only 12% the parameters of the depth modality branch. DDSkel has a simple structure without intricate designs. Nevertheless, with only 36% of the trainable parameters of the current best method, DDSkel outperforms all state-of-the-art approaches on SymPASCAL, the most challenging dataset with a large volume of complex images.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出以深度图为主导模态、RGB图像为辅助模态的骨架检测新范式，并设计了DDSkel模型。该模型采用非对称编码器将RGB信息融合到深度特征中，RGB分支参数仅为深度分支的12%。尽管结构简单且训练参数仅为当前最优方法的36%，DDSkel在最具挑战性的SymPASCAL数据集上超越了所有现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自然场景骨架检测均以RGB图像为唯一输入，该方法在处理复杂内容图像时性能显著下降。作者观察到深度图像对颜色和纹理不敏感，能提供清晰的区域轮廓和区域间空间关系，可自然缓解复杂场景下骨架检测的困难，因此提出以深度为主模态的新范式。
AI.method: 提出DDSkel模型，采用非对称编码器设计，将RGB信息融合到深度特征中。RGB模态分支参数仅为深度模态分支的12%，整体结构简单，无复杂设计。
AI.result: DDSkel在SymPASCAL数据集（最具挑战性、包含大量复杂图像的基准）上，仅用当前最优方法36%的可训练参数，超越了所有现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 深度图像作为主导模态的骨架检测新范式是可行且有效的，证明了在复杂场景下深度信息相比RGB信息具有更强的鲁棒性，以极低的参数成本即可取得最优性能。

title: SCALE: State-Calibrated Latent Embeddings for JEPA Planning in the Right Geometry
summary: Joint-embedding predictive world models plan by scoring predicted terminal embeddings against a goal embedding using a cost defined on the representation itself. Two prominent strategies for obtaining non-collapsed representations are to inherit a pretrained feature space, as in DINO-WM, and to learn an embedding end to end with anti-collapse regularization, as in LeWorldModel (LeWM) with SIGReg. These strategies show complementary strengths across tasks. Although task-relevant state is decodable from the full embeddings of both models, DINO-WM's leading principal components usually retain substantially more state information than LeWM's. Because Euclidean planning costs are dominated by high-variance directions, this difference affects how strongly state can influence candidate selection. We propose SCALE (State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings) to give the end-to-end LeWM representation the favorable geometric property observed in DINO-WM. SCALE induces this property by correlating sampled pairwise latent distances with distances in a standardized task-relevant state space, without replacing LeWM's learned encoder. Across five tasks, three planning solvers, and five compute budgets, SCALE improves every task--solver average over LeWM. A latent-to-state regression control matches or exceeds SCALE's full-embedding decodability yet leaves latent--state distance alignment essentially unchanged and yields less consistent planning gains. SCALE adds a single lightweight training-time regularizer and no planning-time overhead. These results show that planning depends not only on whether task-relevant information is present, but also on whether it shapes the geometry consumed by the planner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCALE（State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings）方法，通过将端到端学习的潜在表示（LeWM）的成对距离与标准化任务相关状态空间的距离进行对齐，使其获得类似DINO-WM的有利几何性质，从而提升联合嵌入预测世界模型（JEPA）的规划性能。
AI.motivation: JEPA世界模型通过评分预测终端嵌入与目标嵌入的表示空间距离来进行规划。现有两种防止表示坍塌的策略各有优劣：继承预训练特征空间（DINO-WM）和端到端学习加抗坍塌正则化（LeWM）。DINO-WM的主成分保留更多状态信息，而欧几里得规划成本受高方差方向主导，这导致表示几何结构对规划效果有显著影响。作者希望让LeWM获得DINO-WM的有利几何性质以提升规划性能。
AI.method: SCALE通过将采样的成对潜在距离与标准化任务相关状态空间中的距离进行相关性对齐，从而在不替换LeWM已学习的编码器的情况下，为其表示引入有利的几何性质。该方法仅需在训练时添加一个轻量级正则化项，规划时无额外开销。
AI.result: 在五个任务、三个规划求解器和五个计算预算的设置下，SCALE在每个任务-求解器平均值上均优于LeWM。与仅使用潜在状态回归控制的方案相比，SCALE在完整嵌入可解码性上相当或更优，同时显著改善了潜在-状态距离对齐并带来更一致的规划增益。
AI.conclusion: 规划性能不仅取决于任务相关信息是否存在于表示中，还取决于这些信息是否塑造了规划器所消费的几何结构。SCALE证明了通过校准表示几何可以有效提升JEPA世界模型的规划能力，且代价极低。

title: DriveCache: Action-Aware Caching for Driving World Model Inference
summary: Driving video generation models support autonomous-driving development by predicting controllable future scenes for simulation, planning evaluation, and offline data generation. Diffusion-based driving generators repeatedly evaluate large backbones across denoising steps, which limits generation throughput. Existing diffusion acceleration methods reduce this cost, but general-purpose designs omit driving signals available before generation, such as ego speed and planned trajectories. Experiments across driving motions show that cache tolerance varies with ego translation and rotation, denoising progress, and consecutive reuse length. We propose DriveCache, a training-free, action-aware controller that uses planned motion to allocate reuse across scenes and dynamic programming to place it across denoising steps under a calibrated response budget. A causal drift check refreshes features and replans the remaining schedule when generation departs from calibration. Across three generator configurations, DriveCache improves the overall fidelity-efficiency trade-off over evaluated cache methods. Our code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: DriveCache是一种训练无关、动作感知的缓存控制器，利用计划轨迹（如自我车速和规划路径）来优化扩散驾驶视频生成中的特征复用分配，通过动态规划在去噪步骤间分配缓存并配合因果漂移检查刷新特征，在不牺牲生成保真度的前提下显著提升生成吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 扩散驾驶视频生成模型因需在多个去噪步骤中反复评估大型骨干网络，导致生成吞吐量受限。现有扩散加速方法为通用设计，未能利用生成前可获得的驾驶信号（如自我车速和规划轨迹）来优化缓存策略，效率提升有限。
AI.method: DriveCache包含三个核心组件：1) 动作感知控制器，利用计划运动在不同场景间分配特征缓存复用；2) 动态规划，在去噪步骤间最优分配缓存，满足校准的响应预算；3) 因果漂移检查，当生成偏离校准时刷新特征并重新规划剩余调度方案。
AI.result: 在三种生成器配置下，DriveCache相比评估的其他缓存方法均提升了整体保真度-效率权衡，验证了动作感知缓存策略对驾驶视频生成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用驾驶场景中特有的运动规划信号，DriveCache在保持生成质量的同时有效突破了扩散驾驶视频生成的吞吐量瓶颈，展示了将领域特定先验融入加速方法的显著优势。代码将公开以促进后续研究。

title: Adaptive Post-Processing Drives Instance-Level Detection in Stroke Lesion Segmentation
summary: Instance-level lesion detection has been an increasingly larger focal point in medical image segmentation besides the more standard voxel-level overlap. Still, most pipelines are trained and post-processed for voxel overlap alone. In particular, the mismatch is most pronounced for small lesions, where a near-miss prediction---substantial overlap that falls just short of the instance-matching threshold---scores the same as a complete miss. In our ISLES'26 submission, we found that closing this gap mattered far more in post-processing than in architecture design. Our Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP) scheme adjusts component-size thresholds to each case's predicted lesion burden, improving Lesion-F1 by 0.032 (unbiased cross-fold estimate)---approximately 6 times larger than any architectural change we tested. A resolution-aware attention architecture (Viola2Plus), designed for small-lesion segmentation, shows why the distinction matters: it left small-lesion Dice unchanged but raised small-lesion detection rate by 3.7\%, a real effect voxel-overlap metrics alone would have missed. Under 5-fold cross-validation on the 1,453-case training set, our post-processed two-architecture ensemble achieves Dice 0.651 and Lesion-F1 0.614, versus 0.644 and 0.573 for the unprocessed single-model baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于病例预测病变负荷的自适应后处理方案（VCAP），通过调整组件大小阈值来缩小体素重叠与实例级病灶检测之间的差距，在ISLES'26中显著提升Lesion-F1（提升0.032，约为任何架构改进的6倍）。同时引入分辨率感知注意力架构Viola2Plus，实验表明后处理比架构设计对实例级检测影响更大。
AI.motivation: 大多数医学图像分割流水线仅针对体素级重叠进行训练和后处理，导致实例级病灶检测与体素重叠指标之间存在不匹配。尤其对小病灶而言，接近命中（接近匹配阈值但未达标准）的预测与完全漏检得分相同，这种不匹配最严重。作者旨在缩小这一差距，并探究后处理与架构设计各自的贡献。
AI.method: 提出Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP)方案，根据每个病例的预测病变负荷自适应调整组件大小阈值。同时设计分辨率感知注意力架构Viola2Plus用于小病灶分割，并在1,453例训练集上进行5折交叉验证，将两种架构与后处理结合为集成系统。
AI.result: VCAP改善Lesion-F1达0.032（无偏交叉验证估计），约为任何架构改动效果的6倍。Viola2Plus虽未改变小病灶Dice，但将小病灶检测率提升3.7%。后处理两架构集成达到Dice 0.651和Lesion-F1 0.614，优于未处理单模型基线的0.644和0.573。
AI.conclusion: 在实例级病灶检测中，后处理策略远比架构设计更为关键。单纯依赖体素重叠指标会忽略小病灶检测率的真实改进，设计目标应同时关注实例级指标。自适应后处理是有效提升病灶检测性能的优先手段。

title: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
summary:
This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $α$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the community has not converged on a reliable, reproducible way to compare different methods on these tasks. Our $α$-release, RelArena-$α$, provides a unified framework for running and comparing baselines on RelBench v1 by standardizing data loading, evaluation protocols, tuning regimes, and support for systems with custom tuning, inspired by established tabular benchmarks such as TabArena. We plan to work with the research community to further develop RelArena-$α$ into a catalyst for progress in the relational learning community. We release the initial version of TabPFN-Rel, a purpose-built relational harness for TabPFN-3. Currently ranked first among models on RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel makes key improvements upon RDBLearn. Beyond its ranking, TabPFN-Rel serves as a strong baseline, adding to the growing evidence that flattening a relational database into a single table remains competitive with specialized relational architectures on real-world tasks.
  To facilitate adoption of relational learning methods in research and industry, we release an initial $α$-version of our Relational Predictive Interface, RPI, an open-source, model-agnostic interface that enables early adopters to easily define problems on new databases and apply any model implemented in RelArena-$α$, including TabPFN-Rel, to these problems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Prior Labs在关系学习领域的三项开源软件α版本发布：RelArena-α（统一基准测试框架）、TabPFN-Rel（关系学习模型）和RPI（关系预测接口），旨在推动关系学习研究的可复现性和实际应用。
AI.motivation: 关系学习领域缺乏统一、可复现的方法比较标准，社区虽涌现了大量数据集和任务，但尚未形成可靠的基准测试协议，这阻碍了研究的进展和实际落地。
AI.method: 1) RelArena-α：基于RelBench v1的统一比较框架，标准化数据加载、评估协议、调参机制，并支持自定义调参系统（借鉴TabArena）；2) TabPFN-Rel：专为TabPFN-3设计的关系学习工具，当前在RelArena-α上排名第一；3) RPI：开源、模型无关的关系预测接口，便于早期采用者在新的数据库上定义问题和应用任何RelArena-α中的模型。
AI.result: TabPFN-Rel在RelArena-α上排名第一，超越了RDBLearn，并进一步证明了将关系数据库展平为单表在真实世界任务上仍能与专门的关系架构相竞争。
AI.conclusion: 作者通过开放科学的方式发布三项工具，期望与社区合作推动开发，将RelArena-α发展成为关系学习社区进步的关键催化剂，并促进关系学习方法在研究与产业中的采用。

title: What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? Interaction Costs Unrevealed by Task-Completion Metrics
summary:
Task completion is the standard metric for evaluating context compression, yet it is incomplete: compression can increase an agent's interaction cost by forcing it to reacquire dropped state while leaving completion statistically unchanged.
  We introduce a controlled runtime measurement protocol for reacquisition cost in a bounded-horizon tool-using agent. The agent acts in a deterministic planning environment under a fixed 24-turn horizon. We vary compression severity, compare a dropping operator with a fact-preserving operator, restore dropped state through controlled oracle interventions, and decompose tool calls into retrieval and execution. We evaluate three models across two task regimes.
  Retrieval calls increase in all six model-regime comparisons and account for almost all added interaction; five of six remain significant after Holm correction. At the prespecified 5x comparison point, completion changes are not significant in any cell. DeepSeek shows a significant completion drop only at 10x compression. GPT-5.5 is the clearest case: completion changes from 80% to 85% (p = 1.0) while retrieval increases from 21.0 to 63.9 calls (p = .002).
  Retention interventions further separate state quantity, state type, and content validity. Random selection is comparable to an offline hindsight oracle, while replacing retained D-state with semantically irrelevant content increases retrieval by 57% (p < .001) without a significant completion change. In a second environment, ALFWorld, sliding compression produces no retrieval surge, showing that the reacquisition signature is environment-dependent rather than intrinsic to shortening context.
  Overall, compression can impose hidden interaction costs when execution-relevant state becomes absent and must be reacquired, while completion alone may not expose those costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受控运行时测量协议，用于评估上下文压缩对工具使用智能体造成的"重新获取成本"。研究发现，压缩虽不改变任务完成率，但会显著增加检索调用次数（六项对比中六项均增加），且这种成本具有环境依赖性而非压缩本身的固有属性。
AI.motivation: 任务完成率是评估上下文压缩的标准指标，但该指标不完整——压缩可能通过迫使智能体重新获取已丢弃的状态信息而增加交互成本，即使完成率统计上没有变化。现有方法无法捕捉这种隐藏成本。
AI.method: 在固定24回合的有界时域确定性规划环境中，对三种模型（含GPT-5.5、DeepSeek）进行受控实验：变化压缩强度、对比丢弃型操作符与事实保留型操作符、通过受控oracle干预恢复丢弃状态、将工具调用分解为检索和执行两部分。在两个任务环境（确定性规划环境和ALFWorld）中，结合保留干预来分离状态数量、状态类型和内容有效性。
AI.result: 检索调用在全部六项模型-任务对比中均增加且几乎占所有新增交互；五项经Holm校正后仍显著。在预定的5倍压缩比较点，完成率无显著变化。DeepSeek仅在10倍压缩时完成率显著下降；GPT-5.5完成率从80%到85%（p=1.0）但检索从21.0增至63.9次（p=.002）。随机选择与离线oracle相当；用语义无关内容替换保留的D状态使检索增加57%（p<.001）而完成率无显著变化。ALFWorld环境中滑动压缩未产生检索激增，表明重获取特征是环境依赖的。
AI.conclusion: 压缩在执行相关状态缺失且需要重新获取时会产生隐藏的交互成本，而仅依赖完成率指标无法暴露这些成本。评估上下文压缩时应同时考虑完成率与交互效率（如检索调用量）等多维度指标。

title: Synthetic Data Augmentation for Satellite-Based Analysis of Battle-Damaged Agricultural Fields in Ukraine
summary: Monitoring war-induced damage to agricultural land in Ukraine is important for understanding threats to food security, environmental stability, and post-war recovery. However, the development of computer-vision systems for satellite-based damage analysis is limited by the scarcity of labeled imagery, especially for damaged agricultural fields. This work investigates synthetic data augmentation as a method for improving classification under limited and imbalanced training data. We train class-conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) architectures on real satellite images and use them to generate additional bombed and not-bombed agricultural-field samples. The generated images are used only for training augmentation, while all downstream evaluation is performed on an exclusively real test set. A Vision Transformer classifier is trained under multiple real and synthetic data configurations to measure the practical utility of each generative approach. The best configuration, based on balanced DDPM augmentation, improves accuracy from 84\% to 88\%, balanced accuracy from 67\% to 81\%, macro F1 from 65\% to 78\%, and recall for the underrepresented not-bombed class from 41\% to 69\%. These results demonstrate the potential of synthetic satellite imagery for data-scarce geospatial applications in war-affected regions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用合成数据增强（GAN和DDPM）来改善卫星图像中农业用地受损分类的性能，在数据稀缺且类别不平衡的情况下，通过生成合成轰炸/未轰炸农田样本进行训练增强，最佳配置（平衡DDPM增强）将准确率从84%提升至88%，平衡准确率从67%提升至81%，宏F1从65%提升至78%，少数类召回率从41%提升至69%。
AI.motivation: 乌克兰战争导致农业用地受损，监测这种损害对粮食安全、环境稳定性和战后重建至关重要。然而，基于卫星图像的计算机视觉系统开发受限于标注数据稀缺，特别是受损农田的数据严重不足，限制了分类模型的性能。
AI.method: 作者训练了类别条件生成对抗网络（GAN）和去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）两种生成架构，在真实卫星图像上训练后生成额外的轰炸和未轰炸农田样本。生成图像仅用于训练数据增强，所有评估均在真实测试集上进行。使用Vision Transformer分类器在多种真实+合成数据配置下训练，以衡量各生成方法的实际效用。
AI.result: 最佳配置采用平衡DDPM增强，将准确率从84%提升至88%，平衡准确率从67%提升至81%，宏F1从65%提升至78%，少数类（未轰炸）召回率从41%提升至69%，显著改善了数据稀缺和不平衡条件下的分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 合成卫星图像在数据稀缺的地缘空间应用中具有显著潜力，特别是在战争影响区域，生成式数据增强可有效缓解标注数据不足的问题，为灾难监测和战后恢复提供技术支持。

title: Transfer Learning of Keystroke Dynamics for Cross-Device User Authentication
summary: Keystroke dynamics (typing patterns) can be used as a behavioural biometric modality for user authentication, with applications such as fraud prevention. While the modality has been shown to work well for single device authentication, its application to cross-device scenarios is more challenging. Dynamics learned on one device (eg., phone) may not be directly applicable to authentication on a secondary device with a different form factor (eg., tablet) due to changes in typing patterns that can lead to distribution drifts. To address this, we propose a cross-device user authentication system based on inductive transfer learning, where keystroke dynamics learned on one device are adapted to a secondary device. The adapted data is then combined with necessarily limited training data for the secondary device, which is used to robustly train a binary classifier. Furthermore, an extended set of keystroke features is used to better capture discriminative dynamics. Experiments on the BBMAS dataset show that proposed system achieves an equal error rate of 14.2% for the cross-device scenario, surpassing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备用户认证系统，利用键盘动力学（击键模式）作为行为生物特征，将一种设备上学到的动态特征迁移到另一种形态要素不同的设备上，并结合有限的辅助训练数据训练二分类器，在BBMAS数据集上实现了14.2%的等错误率，超越了现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 键盘动力学作为行为生物特征在单设备认证中表现良好，但跨设备场景面临挑战——不同设备（如手机和平板）的键盘形态差异会导致打字模式改变，引发分布漂移，使得在一个设备上学习的动态特征无法直接用于另一设备的认证。
AI.method: 1) 采用归纳迁移学习，将一个设备上学习到的键盘动力学特征适配到辅助设备；2) 将迁移后的数据与辅助设备上有限的训练数据结合，用于稳健地训练二分类器；3) 使用扩展的击键特征集，以更好地捕捉判别性动态特征。
AI.result: 在BBMAS数据集上的跨设备场景实验中，提出的系统实现了14.2%的等错误率（EER），超越了现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过归纳迁移学习结合有限的辅助设备数据，能够有效解决跨设备键盘动力学认证中的分布漂移问题，提升跨设备用户认证性能。

title: AstronOS: A Unified Execution Model and Runtime for Long-Horizon Agentic Systems
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Zhenhang Nie and Gui Zheng contributed equally; Gui Zheng and Bin Zhang are corresponding authors
summary: Agentic systems often organize execution and state around a single conversation, model invocation, or agent instance, even when real work spans many calls and stages. We introduce a unified execution model that maintains a work item's persistent identity and versioned authoritative state across calls. Each step receives input scoped to a specific state version and new material; a result advances state only after validation and recording. We implement selected paths of this model in AstronOS using Cases, Tasks, and Scenario Packs across central and local execution. We compare five complete strategies for carrying an established software-version update plan into a fresh model session: rereading original materials, replaying full history, deterministic text summary, deterministic JSON, and the AstronOS runtime-mediated handoff. Ten controlled tasks are run under all five strategies with three repetitions, yielding 150 included executions. On the single-stage reference family, strategies perform similarly. In the primary three-stage A-C batch, AstronOS passes the frozen scorer in 14 of 15 executions, compared with 0 of 15 for rereading and 2 of 15 for full-history replay; later non-interleaved summary and JSON batches each pass 0 of 15. AstronOS has lower attempt-accounted model-token cost per passing execution, while requiring more execution-window time per attempt. These results associate the complete AstronOS condition with higher end-to-end pass rates across fresh sessions in this benchmark, at a measurable time cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一执行模型，通过维护工作项的持久身份和版本化权威状态来支持跨多次调用的智能体系统。作者在AstronOS系统中实现了该模型的选定路径（Cases、Tasks、Scenario Packs），并对比了五种将既有软件更新计划带入新模型会话的策略。在10个受控任务（150次执行）的基准测试中，AstronOS在三阶段A-C批次中14/15次通过冻结评分器，远优于重读原文（0/15）和历史回放（2/15），每次通过的执行在模型token成本上更低，但需要更多执行窗口时间。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体系统通常将执行和状态组织在单一对话、模型调用或智能体实例中，但实际工作往往跨越多次调用和多个阶段。这种不一致导致跨会话传递工作状态效率低下，需要更统一、更具权威性的执行模型来维护工作项的持久身份和版本化状态。
AI.method: 提出统一执行模型，为每个工作项维护持久身份和版本化权威状态。每步接收限定于特定状态版本和新材料的输入，结果仅在验证和记录后才推进状态。在AstronOS中实现该模型的选定路径，并对比五种策略：重读原始材料、完整历史回放、确定性文本摘要、确定性JSON摘要、以及AstronOS运行时中介交接。
AI.result: 在单阶段参考族中五种策略表现相似。主要三阶段A-C批次中，AstronOS在15次执行中14次通过冻结评分器，而重读和完整历史回放分别为0/15和2/15；后续非交错摘要和JSON批次均为0/15。AstronOS每次通过执行拥有更低的token成本（按尝试次数计算），但每次尝试需要更多执行窗口时间。
AI.conclusion: 完整AstronOS条件在该基准测试中与更高的端到端跨新会话通过率相关联，代价是可测量的时间开销。这表明运行时中介的状态交接机制比传统的文本摘要或历史回放策略在跨会话任务延续中更具优势。

title: Self-Routed Tensor Adapters for Parameter-Efficient Universal Visual Adaptation
summary: Universal visual representations require adaptation mechanisms that adapt across heterogeneous domains without fragmenting knowledge into domain-specific modules. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts frozen visual foundation models efficiently, but standard low-rank adapters use a fixed subspace for all inputs, which can be restrictive when domains differ in style, background, and semantic context. MoE-based adapters improve specialization through multiple expert pathways, but often rely on external routers and large expert banks, adding parameters and separating routing from adaptation. We propose \textbf{Self-Routed Tensor Adapters}, a compact framework for multi-domain visual adaptation. SRTA projects each input into a low-rank space, computes routing weights from this representation using a learnable domain matrix, and uses these weights to blend slices of a shared Tucker core. This produces a sample-specific adaptation matrix without an external gating network, allowing shared visual factors to be reused while supporting domain-aware specialization. To strengthen pathway learning, we introduce a progressive depth-weighted routing objective that supervises routing decisions across adapter layers. Across five heterogeneous multi-domain visual classification benchmarks, SRTA achieves competitive or slightly stronger average accuracy than MoE-style PEFT baselines while using substantially fewer trainable parameters. At rank 64, SRTA uses 2.77M parameters in the 4-domain setting compared with 9.52M for MoLoRA, and 3.00M in the 6-domain setting compared with 14.31M. Overall, SRTA offers an effective accuracy-parameter trade-off for adapting visual foundation models toward universal multi-domain representations. \href{https://github.com/surajyadav-research/SRTA}{GitHub}

AI.tldr: 本文提出Self-Routed Tensor Adapters (SRTA)，一种紧凑的自路由张量适配器框架，用于视觉基础模型的多领域自适应。SRTA将输入投影到低维空间，通过可学习的领域矩阵计算路由权重，并用这些权重混合共享Tucker核心的切片，生成样本特定的适配矩阵，无需外部门控网络。在五个多领域视觉分类基准上，SRTA以显著更少的可训练参数（如rank=64时4-domain设置仅2.77M参数 vs MoLoRA的9.52M）达到与MoE风格PEFT基线相当或略优的平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 标准低秩适配器对所有输入使用固定子空间，在多领域场景下受限（域在风格、背景和语义上下文上存在差异）；MoE适配器虽然通过多专家路径提升特化能力，但依赖外部路由器和大型专家库，增加参数并导致路由与适配分离。作者希望设计一种既紧凑又能实现领域感知特化的适配方法。
AI.method: SRTA将输入投影到低秩空间，从该表示中用可学习领域矩阵计算路由权重，再用这些权重混合共享Tucker核心的切片，生成样本特定的适配矩阵。整个过程无需外部门控网络，共享视觉因子可复用且支持领域感知特化。此外，引入渐进式深度加权路由目标，在适配器层间监督路由决策以强化路径学习。
AI.result: 在五个异质多领域视觉分类基准上，SRTA达到与MoE风格PEFT基线相当或略优的平均准确率，同时大幅减少可训练参数。rank=64时，SRTA在4-domain设置使用2.77M参数（对比MoLoRA的9.52M），在6-domain设置使用3.00M参数（对比MoLoRA的14.31M），展现了优异的准确率-参数权衡。
AI.conclusion: SRTA提供了一种有效的准确率-参数权衡方案，通过将路由与适配合并在紧凑的张量框架内，实现通用视觉基础模型向通用多领域表示的适配，验证了无需外部路由网络即可实现高效领域特化的可行性。

title: Task-Anchored Representation Shaping for Pre-Trained Model-Based Continual Learning
summary: Pre-trained models (PTMs) provide a strong foundation for continual learning by offering stable representations that facilitate lightweight adaptation to new tasks. However, adapting well to each task does not ensure reliable inference over all learned tasks. Since task boundaries are often artificial and semantically entangled, an input from an unknown task can remain ambiguous even with strong PTM features, making cross-task prediction a key bottleneck. We propose Task-Anchored Inference Latent Shaping (TAILS), a lightweight post-PTM module that can be integrated into diverse continual learners and optimized through a decoupled step. TAILS uses fixed task anchors as persistent references to accumulated knowledge. It interprets each sample's feature representation relative to these references, then composes relevant evidence across tasks into latent recall. Rather than selecting a task-specific path or adjusting classifier outputs, TAILS uses latent recall to directly correct the feature representation before prediction. It therefore resolves cross-task ambiguity at the representation level, while leaving the original PTM, method-specific modules, and classifier unchanged. Extensive experiments across multiple PTM-based continual learning paradigms show that TAILS can improve classification and task-inference performance with modest parameter overhead and negligible inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAILS（Task-Anchored Inference Latent Shaping），一种轻量级的后预训练模型模块，通过固定任务锚点作为持久参考，在表示层面直接修正特征，解决持续学习中跨任务预测的模糊性问题，可集成到多种持续学习器中且开销极小。
AI.motivation: 预训练模型为持续学习提供了稳定表示，但适应单个任务并不能保证对所有已学任务的可靠推理。由于任务边界往往是人为且语义纠缠的，即使有强大的PTM特征，未知任务的输入仍可能存在歧义，跨任务预测成为关键瓶颈。
AI.method: TAILS是一种轻量级后PTM模块，通过解耦步骤优化，可集成到多种持续学习器中。它使用固定任务锚点作为累积知识的持久参考，将每个样本的特征表示相对于这些锚点进行解释，然后跨任务组合相关证据形成潜在召回（latent recall）。不同于选择任务特定路径或调整分类器输出，TAILS在预测前直接修正特征表示，在表示层面解决跨任务歧义，同时保持原始PTM、方法特定模块和分类器不变。
AI.result: 在多种基于PTM的持续学习范式上进行的大量实验表明，TAILS能够以适度的参数开销和可忽略的推理成本提升分类性能和任务推断性能。
AI.conclusion: TAILS通过在表示层面直接修正特征来解决跨任务预测的歧义问题，是一种通用且高效的持续学习增强模块，既保持了原有模型的完整性，又显著改善了跨任务推断能力。

title: Joint Flow Matching Enables Continuous Dose-Conditioned Cell Morphing
summary: Generative modeling has shown increasing promise for predicting cellular perturbation effects under chemical compound treatments. Existing approaches either model perturbation as a distribution-to-distribution mapping without explicit concentration handling, or treat concentration as a discrete class label, precluding continuous dose control. We introduce a joint flow matching approach that simultaneously models cell latents and drug concentration via a dual-timestep formulation, enabling dose-conditioned single-cell morphing through the invertibility of flow matching. The joint formulation induces a monotonic dose-response geometry in latent space and additionally supports concentration estimation from cell morphology. As proof of concept, we further demonstrate generalization to an unseen dose held out during training. Empirically, our method achieves competitive or improved per-concentration metrics on two compounds compared with representative baselines, while enabling capabilities structurally unavailable to discrete-class methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种联合流匹配方法，通过双时间步长公式同时建模细胞潜变量和药物浓度，实现连续剂量控制下的单细胞形态变换，并支持从细胞形态估计浓度及泛化到未见剂量。
AI.motivation: 现有预测化合物处理下细胞扰动效应的方法中，要么将扰动建模为分布到分布的映射而缺乏显式浓度处理，要么将浓度当作离散类别标签，无法实现连续剂量控制。这限制了模型对药物剂量-反应关系的精细刻画能力。
AI.method: 提出联合流匹配（joint flow matching）方法，采用双时间步长公式同时建模细胞潜变量和药物浓度。利用流匹配的可逆性实现剂量条件下的单细胞形态变换，联合公式在潜空间中诱导出单调的剂量-反应几何结构，并支持从细胞形态估计浓度。
AI.result: 在两种化合物上，与代表性基线相比，各浓度指标达到有竞争力或更优的结果；同时验证了对训练中未见剂量的泛化能力，并实现了离散类别方法在结构上无法支持的功能。
AI.conclusion: 联合流匹配方法为细胞扰动预测提供了连续的浓度控制能力，不仅在指标上不逊于甚至优于已有基线，还开辟了离散方法无法实现的新能力，如未见剂量泛化和浓度估计。

title: OceanDepths: A Global Dataset of Paired Subsurface and Surface Ocean Observations
summary: Despite comprising over 70\% of its surface, the world's oceans are critically underobserved compared to the land surface or the atmosphere.Understanding the global ocean requires jointly observing its surface and subsurface structure, yet no standardized, high-resolution dataset couples satellite surface fields to co-located \emph{in situ} depth profiles in an AI-ready format.Existing resources either consist of model-reconstructed gridded products rather than observations, cover only a single variable or basin, or operate at resolutions too coarse for mesoscale dynamics.We introduce \textsc{OceanDepths}, the first open, global, regridded AI-ready dataset that pairs satellite-derived sea surface temperature (SST), sea surface salinity (SSS), and sea surface height (SSH) L4 products with co-located EN4 subsurface temperature and salinity profiles, complemented by matched GLORYS12 ocean reanalysis data to support comparisons or multi-stage learning.The dataset spans 2000--2024 at \SI{0.1}{\degree}$\times$\SI{0.1}{\degree} spatial resolution and at weekly temporal resolution, covering the entire globe's sea surface and with over 9.5 million paired profiles interpolated to 50 standardized depth levels.We provide a configurable system to split the globe in equally sized spatial patches.The 4D multivariate structure, high resolution, long temporal extent, and extreme sparsity of subsurface observations (${\sim}$0.01\% per depth level) make \textsc{OceanDepths}a challenging testbed for novel AI methods.We demonstrate subsurface state reconstruction as an example task with simple baseline models, but also envision \textsc{OceanDepths}to support the development of observation-based forecast methods and other related tasks.\added{Available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ESA-philab/OceanDepths.}

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了OceanDepths——首个开放的、全球范围的、AI-ready再栅格化数据集，将卫星衍生的海表温度(SST)、海表盐度(SSS)和海表高度(SSH)与EN4次表层温度和盐度剖面配对，并补充了GLORYS12再分析数据。数据集覆盖2000-2024年，空间分辨率0.1°×0.1°，时间分辨率为周，包含超过950万条配对剖面，插值到50个标准化深度层。该数据集为海洋次表层状态重建、观测驱动的预测方法等AI任务提供了挑战性测试平台。
AI.motivation: 全球海洋占地球表面70%以上，但观测严重不足。目前缺乏一个标准化的、高分辨率的、AI-ready的数据集来联合海洋表层和次表层结构，现有资源要么是模型重建的网格化产品而非观测数据，要么只覆盖单一变量或单一海盆，要么分辨率过粗无法解析中尺度动力学。
AI.method: 构建OceanDepths数据集：(1) 将卫星衍生的SST、SSS、SSH L4产品与EN4次表层温度/盐度剖面进行空间匹配；(2) 补充GLORYS12海洋再分析数据以支持对比或多阶段学习；(3) 覆盖2000-2024年，0.1°×0.1°空间分辨率，周时间分辨率；(4) 将剖面插值到50个标准化深度层；(5) 提供可配置系统将全球划分为等大小的空间块。
AI.result: 生成了包含超过950万条配对剖面的全球数据集，具有4D多元结构、高分辨率、长时间跨度和极稀疏的次表层观测（每深度层约0.01%覆盖率）。作者用简单基线模型演示了次表层状态重建任务。
AI.conclusion: OceanDepths是首个将观测为基础的卫星表层数据与原位次表层剖面耦合的全球AI-ready数据集，为次表层状态重建、观测驱动的预测方法和相关任务提供了具有挑战性的测试平台。数据集公开可用。

title: A Policy Algebra for Trust-Preserving Agentic AI Execution
summary: Large language model-based agentic frameworks primarily optimize capability: whether an agent can reason, retrieve information, call tools, delegate work, and complete a goal. Enterprise execution requires a stronger property. A successful result is not reliable if it was produced through unauthorized data access, widened delegated authority, unapproved side effects, unrecoverable budget consumption, or incomplete evidence. This paper defines reliable capability as a path property: an agent is reliably capable only when it completes a task through action events that remain admissible under identity, profile, tool, data, memory, budget, artifact, approval, and audit constraints. We propose a policy algebra that defines the reliability envelope within which agent capability may be exercised. Security profiles and runtime obligations compose through joins, intersections, budget narrowing, approval inheritance, and evidence accumulation; the resulting composition is both trust-preserving and the least restrictive state satisfying all governing inputs. The algebra also propagates restrictions across multi-agent calls and introduces cost-aware artifact materialization, which redirects open-ended execution toward a recoverable outcome as budget exposure grows. The evaluation is interpreted as a reliability-capability trade-off rather than a capability benchmark: the policy-algebra runtime intervenes on 94.8% of policy-violating events while retaining an 86.9% task-completion rate, eliminates the observed profile-monotonicity and zero-artifact-exhaustion violations, and increases audit completeness to 98.6%. The method provides researchers and practitioners with formal correctness conditions, executable decision semantics, and trace evidence for building agents that are not only capable, but reliably capable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种策略代数（policy algebra），为基于大语言模型的智能体框架定义了"可靠能力"（reliable capability）的形式化框架。与仅优化智能体能力的传统方法不同，本文强调在执行任务时，智能体的所有行为必须满足身份、配置、工具、数据、记忆、预算、工件、审批和审计等九类约束。策略代数通过连接、交集、预算收窄、审批继承和证据累积等操作组合安全配置和运行时义务，构成可信任保持且最不限制的可靠包络。实验显示该方法拦截了94.8%的违规事件，保留86.9%的任务完成率，并将审计完整性提升至98.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体框架主要关注能力优化（推理、检索、工具调用、委派和任务完成），但企业执行还需要更强的属性：可靠性。一个成功的结果若源自未授权数据访问、扩大的委派权限、未经批准的副作用、不可恢复的预算消耗或不完整的证据，就不可靠。因此需要形式化的方法定义并保证智能体的可靠能力。
AI.method: 本文提出策略代数（policy algebra），定义智能体能力可被行使的"可靠包络"（reliability envelope）。具体包括：安全配置文件和运行时义务通过连接（joins）、交集（intersections）、预算收窄（budget narrowing）、审批继承（approval inheritance）和证据累积（evidence accumulation）进行组合，组合结果既保持信任又是最不限制的状态；代数还能跨多智能体调用传播限制；引入成本感知的工件具体化（cost-aware artifact materialization），在预算暴露增加时将开放式执行转向可恢复的结果。
AI.result: 策略代数运行时拦截了94.8%的策略违规事件，同时保留86.9%的任务完成率；消除了观察到的配置单调性违规和零工件耗尽违规；审计完整性提升至98.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为构建"不仅有能力而且可靠地有能力"的智能体提供了形式化的正确性条件、可执行的决策语义和可追踪的证据，为研究人员和实践者提供了在可靠性与能力之间进行权衡的系统化框架。

title: Contrastive Energy Fields for Inference-Time Procedure Planning in Instructional Videos
comment: To appear at GCPR 2026 (oral paper). Project page: https://visinf.github.io/cefito
summary: Procedure planning seeks to estimate a sequence of actions to transition from an observed initial state to a given goal state. Current procedure planning approaches directly predict action sequences from latent representations using feed-forward neural networks or diffusion-based inference. These paradigms treat every action as plausible, lacking the ability to enforce task-specific logical constraints that render certain actions irrelevant or not plausible. We propose CEFITO, a procedure planning approach that learns a predictor to express an action-conditioned representation space. Based on this representation space, we formulate procedure planning as a task-constrained optimization problem. Unlike prior methods, CEFITO explicitly reasons over the action space by omitting irrelevant actions during inference-time planning. This reformulation enables effective procedure planning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on two established procedure planning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CEFITO将程序规划重构为任务约束优化问题，通过学习动作条件表示空间并在推理时排除不相关动作，从而实现更有效的程序规划，在两个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有程序规划方法（如前馈神经网络或扩散模型）将所有动作视为同等可能，缺乏执行任务特定逻辑约束的能力，无法排除不相关或不合理的动作，导致规划精度受限。
AI.method: CEFITO学习一个预测器来表达动作条件表示空间，将程序规划形式化为任务约束优化问题。与先前方法不同，CEFITO在推理时显式推理动作空间，忽略不相关动作，从而在规划过程中施加任务逻辑约束。
AI.result: 在两个成熟的程序规划基准数据集上取得了最先进的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将程序规划重新定义为约束优化问题并在推理时显式排除不相关动作，CEFITO验证了动作空间推理对提升程序规划性能的有效性。

title: Coverage-Maximizing Multinomial Subset Routing under Operational Constraints
summary:
We introduce Multinomial Subset Routing (MSR), a new online routing framework over $K$ experts in which the learner keeps a multinomial routing policy instead of a deterministic subset of experts. At each round, the learner samples $M$ experts i.i.d. from the multinomial policy, and the resulting set of distinct sampled experts forms the routed subset.
  The reward depends only on the best-performing expert(s) in the routed subset. This reward structure arises naturally in routing across specialized models but is not captured by standard combinatorial bandits or subset-selection methods, which optimize deterministic subsets and typically assume additive rewards. We require the selection to satisfy several long-term, two-sided operational constraints under bandit feedback, observing only the winner's reward each round. We propose OMD-Approachability, combining online mirror descent with Blackwell's Approachability, and prove it achieves $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ regret in both reward and constraint violation. We ground the framework in practical application domains and validate it empirically on a real-world crowdsourcing dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态子集路由（MSR）框架，学习者维护一个K个专家的多模态路由策略，每轮从中采样M个专家形成路由子集，奖励仅取决于子集中表现最好的专家。该框架在带反馈下同时考虑长期双向操作约束，提出的OMD-Approachability方法结合在线镜像下降与Blackwell可逼近性，实现了奖励与约束违反的O(1/√T)遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 现有的组合老虎机或子集选择方法优化确定性子集且通常假设加性奖励，无法捕捉路由到专门模型中"仅由最优专家决定奖励"这一自然奖励结构，需要一种新的在线路由框架来处理此类问题并满足长期双向操作约束。
AI.method: 提出MSR框架：每轮从多模态策略中i.i.d.采样M个专家形成路由子集；提出OMD-Approachability算法，将在线镜像下降（OMD）与Blackwell可逼近性（Blackwell's Approachability）相结合，在带反馈下同时处理奖励优化和长期双向约束满足问题。
AI.result: 理论上证明OMD-Approachability在奖励和约束违反两方面均达到O(1/√T)的遗憾界；在真实众包数据集上进行实证验证，证实了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MSR框架为仅依赖最优专家的子集路由问题提供了新的理论框架和实用算法，在理论上保证了遗憾界，并在实际数据集中得到了验证，适用于跨专门模型路由等实际应用场景。

title: Reasoning-supported Robustness Validation of Automotive E/E Components
comment: Published in: 2017 IEEE 11th International Conference on Semantic Computing (ICSC)
summary: This paper presents an ontology-supported approach to tackle the complexity of the Robustness Validation (RV) process of automotive electrical/electronic (E/E) components. The approach uses formalized knowledge from the RV process and stress, operating, and load profiles, so-called Mission Profiles (MPs). In contrast to the error-prone industrially established manual procedure, we show how component characteristics are formalized in OWL in order to form the foundation of an efficient automated analysis selection and decision support during the RV process. The proposed approach is based on the idea of mapping MPs to an OWL representation so to allow to perform semantic queries against MP data to improve their integration into the RV process. The resulting ontology-supported application framework has been applied to an industrial use-case from automotive power electronics. We present experimental results showing that the RV process can be significantly improved in terms of reduced design time and increased exhaustiveness by automating the analyses selection step and the provisioning of all the relevant data to be used.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于本体（ontology）的方法来应对汽车电子/电气（E/E）部件稳健性验证（RV）过程的复杂性。该方法利用OWL形式化RV过程及任务剖面（Mission Profiles, MPs）中的知识，通过语义查询实现自动化分析选择和决策支持，取代易出错的手动流程。实验表明该方法能显著缩短设计时间并提高验证的全面性。
AI.motivation: 汽车E/E部件的稳健性验证（RV）过程目前依赖工业中容易出错的手动流程，面对复杂的压力、运行和负载剖面（Mission Profiles），难以高效且全面地进行分析选择和数据集成，亟需形式化和自动化手段来改善该过程。
AI.method: 1) 将RV过程及组件特征形式化为OWL本体表示；2) 将Mission Profiles（MPs）映射到OWL表示，以便对MP数据进行语义查询；3) 基于本体构建应用框架，实现自动化分析选择及决策支持；4) 在汽车电力电子工业用例中进行验证。
AI.result: 在汽车电力电子的工业应用中，实验结果显示该本体支持的方法能够显著缩短设计时间，并通过自动化分析选择步骤和提供相关数据来提高RV过程的全面性（exhaustiveness）。
AI.conclusion: 基于本体的方法能够有效改进汽车E/E部件的RV过程，通过形式化知识和语义查询实现自动化，提升效率与覆盖度，为工业稳健性验证提供更可靠的支持。

title: Shared-Structure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation for Sparse-View Spectral CT Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view spectral computed tomography (CT) reconstructs energy-resolved attenuation volumes from limited projection views, requiring simultaneous handling of angular undersampling and spectral coupling. We propose a SharedStructure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation (4D-SG) that learns shared Gaussian geometry from full spectrum structural projections and uses a Gaussian-wise Spectral Density Curve Network (GSC-Net) to predict Gaussian raw density transformations. This factorization separates shared spatial structure from spectral attenuation variation, avoids independent channel geometry optimization, and establishes a continuous 4D-SG representation from discrete spectral measurements for unobserved spectral channel queries. Experiments on six synthesized, simulated projection, and real projection datasets with 50 views demonstrate the best average performance. Compared with the strongest Gaussian baseline, 4D-SG improves PSNR from 35.56 dB to 36.61 dB, increases SSIM from 0.909 to 0.914, and reduces LPIPS from 0.208 to 0.194, demonstrating its effectiveness for sparse-view spectral CT reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种共享结构4D光谱高斯表示（4D-SG）方法，用于稀疏视角光谱CT重建。通过共享几何结构因子分解与光谱密度曲线网络（GSC-Net），在50个视角下相比最强高斯基线，PSNR从35.56dB提升至36.61dB，SSIM从0.909提升至0.914，LPIPS从0.208降至0.194。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角光谱CT需要同时处理角度欠采样和光谱耦合问题，现有方法往往对每个光谱通道独立优化几何结构，导致参数冗余且重建质量受限。
AI.method: 1）从全光谱结构投影中学习共享高斯几何；2）使用高斯级光谱密度曲线网络（GSC-Net）预测高斯原始密度变换；3）将共享空间结构与光谱衰减变化因子分解，建立从离散谱测量到连续4D表示的映射。
AI.result: 在六个合成、模拟投影和真实投影数据集（50个视角）上取得最佳平均性能。相比最强高斯基线，PSNR从35.56dB提升至36.61dB，SSIM从0.909增至0.914，LPIPS从0.208降至0.194。
AI.conclusion: 4D-SG通过共享几何与光谱密度预测的因子分解策略，有效避免了独立通道几何优化，实现了稀疏视角光谱CT的高质量重建，验证了连续4D表示方法的有效性。

title: FETERS: Few-Shot Early Time-Series Classification via Effective Ratio Selection
summary: Early time-series classification (ETSC) aims to make accurate predictions from partially observed time series as early as possible. Although various stopping mechanisms and feature learning strategies have been developed for ETSC, most existing methods assume access to sufficient labeled training data, which may be unrealistic in applications with limited annotation. Under limited supervision, learning an additional sample-level stopping module and extracting effective classification features can both become challenging. In this paper, we propose FETERS, a few-shot ETSC framework that selects a dataset-level stopping ratio through class-wise leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation on the support set and uses a penalty-based reward function to manage the accuracy-earliness trade-off, thereby avoiding the need to train an additional stopping module. FETERS further combines Rocket-based features with frozen Chronos representations for classification. Extensive experiments on 69 public datasets spanning 14 domains show that FETERS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the 5-shot setting, with the highest average harmonic mean (HM) and the best HM on 38 datasets, while outperforming the current SOTA method on 44 datasets. FETERS also remains competitive in the full-shot setting, demonstrating its effectiveness in managing the accuracy-earliness trade-off.

AI.tldr: FETERS是一个少样本早期时间序列分类（ETSC）框架，通过数据集级别的停止比例选择（基于支持集的类别留一法评估）和基于惩罚的奖励函数来管理准确率-及时性权衡，无需训练额外的停止模块。它结合Rocket特征与冻结的Chronos表征进行分类，在69个公开数据集（覆盖14个领域）上的5-shot设置中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有ETSC方法大多假设有足够的标注训练数据，但在实际应用中标注可能非常有限。在少样本条件下，训练样本级别的停止模块和提取有效的分类特征都变得困难，因此需要专门设计适用于少样本场景的ETSC框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出数据集级别的停止比例选择机制，通过支持集上的类别留一法（LOO）评估来确定停止比例，避免训练额外的停止模块；2) 使用基于惩罚的奖励函数来平衡准确率与及时性之间的权衡；3) 结合Rocket特征和冻结的Chronos表征进行少样本分类。
AI.result: 在69个公开数据集（覆盖14个领域）上的广泛实验中，FETERS在5-shot设置下取得SOTA性能：最高平均HM值，在38个数据集上取得最佳HM，并在44个数据集上优于当前SOTA方法。在full-shot设置下也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FETERS有效解决了少样本条件下的早期时间序列分类问题，展示了其在准确率-及时性权衡管理方面的有效性，在少样本和全样本设置下均表现出竞争力。

title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence
comment: Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ScottZhang812/ParaTempo
summary: Parallel reasoning improves the accuracy and robustness of large reasoning models by exploring multiple solution paths, but its computational cost grows with reasoning depth and branch count. Existing methods for managing these parallel paths typically rely on final-answer consensus, local token confidence, or isolated intermediate probes. However, these signals are often delayed, weakly tied to actual reasoning progress, or too noisy for dynamic, branch-level control. To address these limitations, we introduce ParaTempo, a training-free asynchronous parallel reasoning framework. ParaTempo is driven by temporal confidence, a branch-local measure of answer-space convergence. Each branch is periodically probed for a tentative answer probability distribution, and temporal confidence quantifies how sharply the recent intermediate probes concentrate on a dominant answer. Once sufficient evidence has accumulated, ParaTempo drives its entire control process from this single signal: low-confidence branches are pruned, branches that persistently commit to their dominant answer are retired early, freed computation is reallocated by forking new branches, and generation stops globally once the confidence-weighted vote concentrates. Without requiring synchronization among reasoning trajectories, ParaTempo adaptively allocates computation based on branch-level convergence. Experiments on challenging mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks show that ParaTempo reduces average latency by 21.8-32.2% and total token usage by 18.1-30.3% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Moreover, temporal confidence exhibits stronger temporal stability and predictive power for future branch convergence than token-level and instantaneous signals.

AI.tldr: ParaTempo是一个无需训练的异步并行推理框架，通过"时间置信度"（temporal confidence）这一分支级别的答案空间收敛度量来动态管理并行推理分支。它利用周期性探测的候选答案概率分布，量化近期中间探针在主导答案上的集中程度，从而驱动剪枝、提前退出、计算重分配和全局停止等全部控制决策，在保持竞争力的同时降低21.8-32.2%的延迟和18.1-30.3%的token消耗。
AI.motivation: 并行推理虽能提升大推理模型的准确性和鲁棒性，但其计算成本随推理深度和分支数量增长。现有管理方法依赖最终答案共识、局部token置信度或孤立的中间探针，这些信号要么延迟过高、要么与实际推理进展关联弱、要么对动态分支级控制过于嘈杂，缺乏一个可靠且及时的信号来指导分支级别的计算分配。
AI.method: ParaTempo核心是一种称为"时间置信度"的分支局部度量，用于衡量答案空间的收敛程度。每个分支周期性地被探测以获得候选答案概率分布，时间置信度量化近期探针在主导答案上的集中程度。基于该单一信号驱动全部控制流程：低置信度分支被剪枝、持续承诺主导答案的分支提前退出、释放的计算资源用于分叉新分支、全局置信度加权投票集中时停止生成。整个过程无需分支间同步。
AI.result: 在数学和科学推理基准上，ParaTempo将平均延迟降低21.8-32.2%，总token使用量减少18.1-30.3%，同时保持有竞争力的准确性。时间置信度在时间稳定性和对未来分支收敛的预测能力上优于token级和瞬时信号。
AI.conclusion: 时间置信度作为一种时间维度的分支收敛信号，比现有信号更稳定且更具预测力，为并行推理的资源管理提供了一种统一、训练免费且高效的解决方案，在降低计算成本的同时维持推理质量。

title: Sterilizable Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
summary: Scene graph generation from surgical video enables a holistic and structured understanding of surgical scenes by modeling objects and their semantic relationships. Despite recent advances, state-of-the-art approaches rely on large, parameter-heavy deep learning models that are impractical for deployment in the operating room (OR) due to hardware footprint, hygiene constraints, latency, and data privacy concerns. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first scene graph generation method built on NCAs and the first NCA framework capable of learning structured representations. We introduce SG-NCA, a lightweight scene graph generation framework based on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), designed for inference in fanless devices critical for OR hygiene protocols. SG-NCA is the first scene graph generation combining NCA-based multiclass segmentation for efficient object detection and feature extraction with a lightweight relation predictor. We evaluate SG-NCA on videos of cataract surgery and cholecystectomy, demonstrating performance comparable to established baselines while requiring 55x fewer parameters. We showcase deployment on fanless edge devices better suited for the OR and demonstrate downstream applications such as surgical video captioning, highlighting SG-NCA's potential for affordable, privacy-preserving, and OR-ready intraoperative scene understanding.

AI.tldr: SG-NCA是一个基于神经细胞自动机（NCA）的轻量级手术视频场景图生成框架，专为手术室无风扇边缘设备部署而设计。与现有依赖大规模深度模型的方法不同，SG-NCA首次将NCA用于场景图生成，通过NCA多类别分割实现目标检测与特征提取，并结合轻量级关系预测器，在白内障手术和胆囊切除术视频上达到与现有基线相当的性能，同时参数数量减少55倍。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的手术场景图生成方法依赖大规模、高参数量的深度学习模型，这些模型因硬件占用、卫生约束、延迟和数据隐私问题难以在手术室实际部署。作者希望开发一种轻量级、可在无风扇设备（符合OR卫生协议）上运行的场景图生成方案。
AI.method: 提出SG-NCA框架：(1) 首次将NCA（神经细胞自动机）应用于场景图生成；(2) 利用NCA多类别分割实现高效目标检测和特征提取；(3) 配合轻量级关系预测器生成对象间的语义关系；(4) 在白内障手术和胆囊切除术视频上训练和评估。
AI.result: 在白内障手术和胆囊切除术视频数据集上，SG-NCA达到与现有基线相当的性能，同时参数数量减少55倍；成功部署在无风扇边缘设备上，并展示了手术视频字幕生成等下游应用。
AI.conclusion: SG-NCA证明了NCA架构在结构化场景理解任务上的可行性，为手术室提供了经济高效、保护隐私且符合手术室部署条件的术中场景理解方案，是该领域首个基于NCA的场景图生成方法。

title: SoftModel: A Neural Model That Grows Its Own Topology -- Governed Structural Growth for Continual In-Service Learning
summary: Today, a neural system is almost always used in two phases -- trained, then deployed -- and in that regime it freezes twice: training ends, and the topology itself was never a degree of freedom. We take the opposite premise as an axiom -- total plasticity: no part of a model, including its structure, is ever frozen -- and derive the governance a lifelong learner then requires. The design's target regime is continual, in-service learning: a long-lived model on a non-stationary stream, whose stability comes from governance rather than immobility and whose capacity follows demand. The result is a growable soft model: an algebra of structural operators (width, hierarchy, composition, input interface, grown cycles, attention heads), each exact at application, budgeted, and audited, with adoption decided solely by a held-out reality gate that treats parametric and structural change uniformly. A complete from-scratch system realizes the whole account; its factory surface is operated end-to-end by a production LLM. Two conclusions follow from the axiom by construction: stability under lifelong change becomes an audit property of the lifecycle, and structure that follows demand removes the silent cap a fixed topology places on later capability where the capacity floor binds. A third is measured: in the worlds where this was measured, the marginal value of new capacity was unobservable before adoption, so workable growth governance took its ex-post form. The same governance extends to evaluative signals, and the core method is evaluated on standard continual-learning benchmarks, where governed growth preserves the ability to keep learning along long task sequences. A pre-registered experimental program adjudicates the mechanism and value claims on the tested problems and reports its failures at full prominence; the map -- positive and negative -- is the contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"完全可塑性"原则：模型的任何部分（包括结构）都不应冻结。为此设计了一个可增长的软模型系统，通过结构算子（宽度、层级、组合、输入接口、增长循环、注意力头）结合"现实门控"（held-out reality gate）统一决策参数化与结构化变更，实现终身持续学习。系统由生产级LLM端到端操作，并通过预注册实验在标准持续学习基准上评估，正面与负面结果一并公开。
AI.motivation: 传统神经系统的两阶段范式（先训练后部署）存在双重冻结：训练结束时冻结权重，且拓扑结构本身从未成为可调节的自由度。这导致固定拓扑对后期能力形成隐性上限。作者以"完全可塑性"为公理，探讨终身学习者所需的治理机制，旨在使稳定性源于治理而非静止，容量紧跟需求。
AI.method: 提出可增长软模型（growable soft model）：构建结构算子代数（宽度、层级、组合、输入接口、增长循环、注意力头），每个算子精确可应用、有预算、可审计。所有变更（参数化与结构化）统一由held-out现实门控决定是否采纳。系统从零完整实现，并由生产级LLM端到端操作工厂表面。治理机制同样扩展至评估信号。
AI.result: 在标准持续学习基准上评估，治理增长保留了沿长任务序列持续学习的能力。关键测量发现：在测试环境中，新容量的边际价值在采纳前不可观察，因此可行的增长治理采取事后（ex-post）形式。预注册实验程序对机制和价值声明进行裁决，并充分报告失败。
AI.conclusion: 由公理构造推导出两个结论：终身变更下的稳定性成为生命周期的审计属性；随需求增长的结构消除了固定拓扑对后期能力的静默上限。第三个结论通过测量得出：在可观察容量边际价值之前，增长治理须采用事后形式。该研究的贡献在于正负结果全貌（map）而非单一正向发现。

title: RISE: Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding across 3D Tracking and Structured Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: We present RISE (Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding and Evaluation), a framework spanning metric 3D tracking and structured vision-language reasoning in roadside sequences. For metric tracking, our image-only method combines SAM3 video identities with calibration-guided mask agreement for multi-view identity association, recovering persistent 3D tracks without LiDAR or task-specific 3D training. Its calibration-conditioned geometry allows the procedure to be instantiated at different calibrated multi-camera intersections without layout-specific retraining. On 20 human-reviewed clips from six intersections, the generated tracks achieve 66.9 MOTA within the defined multi-view evaluation scope. For structured vision-language reasoning, a human-reviewed MLLM pipeline mines high-value clips and uses a constrained full-context Oracle to construct bbox-grounded predictive QA without exposing future evidence to evaluated models. The resulting RISE-VQA dataset contains 33,910 QA pairs from 557 clips across 16 intersections and 61 roadside views. Its intersection-held-out RISE-Bench evaluates semantic choices, coordinates, future boxes, and interaction sets with deterministic task-specific metrics. Experiments show consistent benefits from domain adaptation and generally from temporal context, while revealing persistent challenges in spatial grounding, future localization, and interaction reasoning.
