AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法通过设计复杂的遗忘函数U来实现精确遗忘，但在大规模训练数据下计算成本高昂，复杂结构成为瓶颈，即使对参数较少的模型也是如此。
AI.method: 受Learning to Optimize启发，L2UL将"手工设计U"转变为"从分布视角学习遗忘行为"，通过机器学习方式获得一个简单高效的遗忘函数U，是首个基于学习的模型无关方法。
AI.result: 实验表明L2UL在精度上与重训练方法相当，同时在数据密集型场景下展现出令人印象深刻的效率优势，并在更大的ResNet模型上验证了性能与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 通过"学习遗忘"而非"设计遗忘"，L2UL有效解决了现有方法在大规模数据下的计算瓶颈问题，为机器遗忘提供了新的高效范式。

title: Hypergraph-based Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Incremental Refinement
comment: Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
summary: Modern Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (M-RAG) systems are fundamentally limited by the binary connectivity paradigm of traditional simple graphs, which fails to capture the intricate, high-order correlations among heterogeneous entities, such as the N-ary relationships between a visual chart, its scattered textual descriptions, and underlying numerical data. Furthermore, existing refinement strategies often rely on exhaustive, full-page reconstruction to align cross-modal information, leading to prohibitive computational redundancy and the introduction of contextual noise in long-form document processing. In this paper, we propose Hyper-M2RAG, a novel framework that redefines multimodal document retrieval through High-order Hypergraph Representation Learning. We first formalize the document structure as a Multimodal Hypergraph, utilizing hyperedges as unified semantic containers to encapsulate multi-way associations across text, images, and tables, thereby transcending point-to-point modeling. To mitigate semantic fragmentation caused by physical pagination, we introduce an Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement mechanism. Rather than performing a global sweep, our approach identifies boundary-crossing anchor nodes and reconstructs their local hyper-topology using one-hop neighborhood contexts. This targeted refinement effectively bridges cross-page knowledge gaps with minimal computational footprints. Extensive evaluations on multimodal benchmarking datasets demonstrate that Hyper-M2RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both retrieval precision and generation coherence. Our code is available at https://github.com/ShenAoChen2001/MMHRAG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hyper-M2RAG框架，利用高阶超图表示学习重新定义多模态文档检索。将文档结构形式化为多模态超图，用超边封装文本、图像、表格间的多元关联；并引入锚点驱动的增量细化机制，通过重建跨页锚节点的局部超拓扑来弥补跨页知识鸿沟，在检索精度和生成连贯性上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有M-RAG系统受限于传统简单图的二元连接范式，无法捕捉异构实体间的高阶关联（如图表、文本描述和数值数据间的N元关系）。此外，现有的细化策略依赖全页面重建来对齐跨模态信息，导致计算冗余和上下文噪声。
AI.method: 1. 多模态超图构建：将文档形式化为Multimodal Hypergraph，用超边作为统一语义容器封装文本、图像、表格的多向关联，超越点对点建模。2. 锚点驱动增量细化机制：识别跨页边界锚节点，利用一跳邻域上下文重建其局部超拓扑，以最小计算开销弥合跨页知识鸿沟。
AI.result: 在多模态基准数据集上的大量评估表明，Hyper-M2RAG在检索精度和生成连贯性两方面都显著优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: Hyper-M2RAG通过高阶超图表示学习和锚点驱动的局部增量细化，有效解决了多模态文档检索中高阶关联建模和跨页语义碎片化问题，实现了高效的跨模态知识整合。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Assessing Calibration of Geospatial Foundation Models and Their Sensitivity to Distribution Shifts
summary: Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) are most commonly ranked and selected by accuracy on standard benchmark conditions via averaged ranks. We show that this protocol is too narrow: the promised deployment in critical EO tasks requires further angles of analysis, mainly calibration, the agreement between a model's confidence and its correctness. Across 16 frozen encoders, four classification and five segmentation datasets, and two orthogonal stress axes, every encoder degrades as corruption intensifies, and the ranking changes as well. Across the four classification benchmarks, EO-pretrained and ImageNet-pretrained encoders are indistinguishable on clean accuracy and clean calibration, and EO pretraining provides no more stability under shift than ImageNet pretraining. Under shift the GeoFMs drift further into overconfidence than the ImageNet-pretrained encoders, at every grade and in every corruption family. A centered kernel alignment (CKA) analysis ties this to representational rigidity: EO-pretrained embeddings move less under corruption while losing just as much task information and remaining overconfident. We apply three commonly explored uncertainty quantification methods and find that temperature scaling and deep ensembles cannot counteract the degradation, while a Gaussian-process probe roughly halves ECE under severe cloud only by tripling it on clean data. In selective prediction experiments, we find that confidence-based abstention cannot defer around confidently wrong predictions, and advocate that benchmark rankings and evaluations should therefore operate across a multitude of conditions and metrics to more holistically evaluate model development progress and close the gap to real world deployment scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了地理空间基础模型（GeoFMs）在标准基准排名之外的可靠性表现，发现所有编码器在数据损坏下性能退化且排名改变。EO预训练与ImageNet预训练在干净准确率和校准上无显著差异，但在分布偏移下EO预训练模型表现更过度自信。通过CKA分析、不确定性量化方法和选择性预测实验，揭示了现有评估协议的局限性，倡导更全面的多指标评估。
AI.motivation: 传统GeoFMs评估仅依赖标准基准条件下的平均排名准确率，但实际地球观测（EO）关键任务部署需要考察模型校准能力（置信度与正确率的一致性）。现有评估协议过于狭窄，无法反映模型在真实世界分布偏移下的表现，亟需多角度分析来弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 在16个冻结编码器、4个分类数据集和5个分割数据集上，沿两个正交应力轴进行系统评估。采用CKA（centered kernel alignment）分析表征表示的刚性；应用三种不确定性量化方法（温度缩放、深度集成和高斯过程探针）；进行选择性预测实验验证基于置信度的弃权机制有效性。
AI.result: 所有编码器随损坏强度增强性能退化且排名变化；EO预训练与ImageNet预训练在干净准确率和校准上无差异，但EO预训练在分布偏移下更过度自信；CKA显示EO预训练嵌入移动较少但丢失同样多的任务信息并保持过度自信；高斯过程探针在严重云条件下将ECE减半但在干净数据上增三倍；置信度弃权无法规避自信的错误预测。
AI.conclusion: 单一基准排名无法全面反映GeoFMs在真实部署中的表现，需要跨多种条件和指标进行评估，以更全面地衡量模型发展进展并缩小与真实世界部署场景之间的差距。

title: The Ethical Decision Head: Operationalizing Normative Ethics in Autonomous Vehicles via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
summary: As autonomous vehicles (AVs) approach Level 4 and Level 5 operational capability [SAE International, 2018], their on- board decision systems must handle not only safety-critical locomotion but also their subsequent moral weight. This paper details the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep re- inforcement learning (RL) framework that encodes ethical reasoning as a differentiable reward signal, enabling a pol- icy gradient agent to learn morally-aligned driving behavior in scenarios whose state representation is aligned with the CARLA simulation environment [Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]. Two normative frameworks are instantiated and evaluated: a Utilitarian framework minimizing total casualties and a Kan- tian framework enforcing course maintenance as a categori- cal imperative. The EDH is trained via Proximal Policy Op- timization (PPO) [Schulman et al., 2017] against a Bradley- Terry reward model [Bradley and Terry, 1952] learned from pairwise human preference annotations over 200 collision- imminent scenarios. Results reveal an asymmetry in the learnability of normative ethical frameworks under human su- pervision. The Kantian condition, which reduces to a con- stant prediction task under the codebook, serves as a pipeline control: it confirms training stability and rules out infrastruc- ture failure as an explanation for the utilitarian result. The Utilitarian agent learned something more unsettling: human raters rewarded self-sacrifice over casualty minimization, and the model learned that preference faithfully. This divergence between what humans prescribe in theory and what they re- ward in practice suggests that RLHF does not learn ethics as philosophers define it, but as humans live it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出伦理决策头（EDH）框架，将伦理推理编码为可微分的奖励信号，让深度强化学习智能体在CARLA仿真环境中学习道德一致的驾驶行为。论文实例化了功利主义（最小化总伤亡）和康德主义（维持行驶路线作为绝对命令）两种规范框架，通过PPO算法和基于成对人类偏好标注的Bradley-Terry奖励模型进行训练。结果显示人类评估者实际奖励了自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化，揭示了理论伦理与人类实际奖励之间的分歧。
AI.motivation: 随着自动驾驶车辆接近L4/L5级别，其决策系统不仅需要处理安全关键的行驶操作，还必须面对后续的道德权重问题。现有系统缺乏将伦理推理整合进决策过程的框架，需要一种能够编码伦理准则并让智能体学习道德一致行为的方法。
AI.method: 提出EDH框架：将伦理推理编码为可微分奖励信号的深度强化学习框架。采用PPO算法训练策略梯度智能体，使用Bradley-Terry奖励模型学习成对人类偏好标注（覆盖200个碰撞迫近场景）。实例化并评估了功利主义和康德主义两种规范伦理框架，场景状态表示与CARLA仿真环境对齐。
AI.result: 伦理框架的可学习性存在不对称性：康德主义条件退化为恒定预测任务，作为管线控制验证了训练稳定性；功利主义智能体则学到一个更令人不安的结果——人类评估者奖励自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化，模型忠实地学习了这一偏好。
AI.conclusion: 人类在理论上规定的伦理与在实践中实际奖励的伦理之间存在分歧。RLHF学习的不是哲学家定义的伦理，而是人类实际生活的伦理，这对自动驾驶道德决策系统的设计具有重大启示。

title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning
summary: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. Experiments on the NL-pddlgym test set containing 106 problems across 4 held-out domains show that PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6\% of tested planning problems. This improves upon our adaptations of previous PDDL generation methods, which achieved up to 45.3\%, and outperforms direct LLM planning approaches, which reached up to 74.5\% on the same test set. Our work demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic PDDL generation for planning and establishes a reproducible benchmark for future research on LLM-assisted symbolic planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDDLCoder，一个用于从自然语言生成PDDL规划规格的智能体（agentic）框架，能够迭代地生成、分析和细化规划规格；同时引入NL-pddlgym基准数据集，包含23个领域的711个规划问题及可执行的gym环境用于自动化验证。实验表明PDDLCoder在106个测试问题上实现了89.6%的可执行规划生成率，大幅优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在长时域规划任务上不可靠，常生成逻辑不一致或不可执行的计划。现有混合方法存在以下问题：依赖僵硬的生成流程、使用部分PDDL定义、需要人工反馈，且缺乏标准化基准和自动化验证手段。
AI.method: 提出PDDLCoder智能体框架，采用迭代的"生成-分析-细化"流程将自然语言转换为PDDL；同时构建NL-pddlgym基准数据集，包含23个领域的711个规划问题，配备可执行的gym环境用于自动化验证计划可应用性。
AI.result: 在包含106个问题、4个留出领域的NL-pddlgym测试集上，PDDLCoder对89.6%的规划问题生成了可应用计划，远超改编的现有PDDL生成方法（最高45.3%）和直接LLM规划方法（最高74.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 证明了智能体式PDDL生成在规划任务中的有效性，并为未来LLM辅助符号规划研究建立了可复现的基准。

title: HarmTrace: Anchor-Calibrated Decoupled Optimization for Fine-Grained Target Identification in Harmful Memes
summary: Multimodal harmful meme detection is typically formulated as image--text harmfulness classification. A model may correctly predict harmfulness while misidentifying the attacked target or its supporting evidence. We therefore extend harmful meme detection with fine-grained target identification, asking what type of target is attacked, who is targeted, and where the target appears in the meme. The model predicts harmfulness for every meme and, for harmful memes, outputs the target category, target entity, textual mention, and visual region. To support this task, we introduce Meme3W, which unifies multiple public harmful meme datasets and provides human-verified annotations for harmful instances. We further introduce Joint Record Accuracy (JRA), a strict record-level metric requiring the harmfulness label and all target-identification fields to be jointly correct. Experiments with representative multimodal large language models reveal a substantial gap between harmfulness accuracy and JRA. To narrow this gap, we propose HarmTrace, an anchor-calibrated decoupled optimization framework. HarmTrace strengthens target-entity supervision through entity-aware supervised fine-tuning. It then applies Conditional Target-identification Policy Optimization (CTPO) to decouple harmfulness and target-identification advantages, restricting target-identification optimization to label-correct responses for harmful examples. CTPO uses a Virtual Positive Anchor (VPA) as a fully correct reference for target-identification advantage normalization. HarmTrace improves both JRA and harmfulness accuracy across the evaluated backbones, with JRA on the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone increasing from 17.58\% to 52.51\%. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llly1234/HarmTrace-for-Harmful-Memes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了细粒度的多模态有害梗图检测任务，在原有危害性分类基础上增加了目标类别、目标实体、文本提及和视觉区域四个细粒度识别维度。为此引入统一数据集Meme3W和严格指标JRA，并提出HarmTrace框架（含CTPO和VPA机制）来弥合危害性分类与细粒度目标识别之间的巨大差距，在Qwen3-VL-8B上JRA从17.58%提升至52.51%。
AI.motivation: 现有有害梗图检测仅关注危害性二分类，但模型可能正确预测有害性却错误识别攻击目标或支持证据。这种粗粒度检测不足难以支撑实际安全应用，需要细粒度的目标识别来提供更可解释和可操作的检测结果。
AI.method: 1) 构建Meme3W统一多源有害梗图数据集，提供人工验证的细粒度标注；2) 提出JRA严格记录级评估指标，要求危害性标签与所有目标识别字段同时正确；3) 提出HarmTrace框架：先通过实体感知SFT强化目标实体监督，再使用CTPO将危害性与目标识别优势解耦，仅对有害示例的标签正确响应进行优化，并引入VPA作为目标识别优势归一化的完全正确参考。
AI.result: HarmTrace在评估的多个多模态大语言模型骨干上同时提升了JRA和危害性准确率，其中Qwen3-VL-8B骨干上JRA从17.58%提升至52.51%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将危害性检测与细粒度目标识别解耦优化，可以有效缩小危害性分类与联合记录准确率之间的差距，表明细粒度目标识别是可行的且能提升整体检测性能。

title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms for Large Language Models (LLMs) are largely distinguished by their variance reduction strategy. Group-relative methods like GRPO reduce gradient variance by sampling multiple rollouts per prompt, but provide only sequence-level credit. Training is also blocked by straggler rollouts, reducing throughput and increasing off-policyness. Learned value functions theoretically address both problems, providing token-level advantages without requiring large groups. However, additional infrastructure engineering challenges combined with the practical success of critic-free methods have made it difficult to justify their inclusion in RL pipelines. We propose two complementary strategies to improve the performance of value function RL: 1) Privileged Value Functions (PVF) which provide an elegant mechanism to inject additional task-relevant token-level signal without biasing the policy objective; 2) TETHER, a baseline that adaptively interpolates between group-relative and value baselines depending on the value function accuracy. Across several reasoning tasks, both strategies consistently improve over the standard value function baseline, and are competitive with or outperform mean-baseline GRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种互补策略来提升LLM强化学习中价值函数RL的性能：1)特权价值函数(PVF)在无偏策略目标的前提下注入额外的任务相关token级信号；2)TETHER基线根据价值函数准确性自适应地在组相对基线和价值基线之间插值。实验表明两种策略在推理任务上均优于标准价值函数基线，与均值基线GRPO相当或更优。
AI.motivation: LLM的强化学习算法主要区别在于方差缩减策略。GRPO等组相对方法通过多次采样降低梯度方差，但仅提供序列级信用分配，且受慢速rollout阻塞。学习价值函数理论上能同时解决这两个问题（提供token级优势且无需较大组规模），但由于工程基础设施挑战和critic-free方法的实际成功，难以证明其在RL管线中的必要性。本文旨在改进价值函数RL的性能。
AI.method: 提出两个互补策略：1)特权价值函数(PVF)——通过优雅机制注入额外的任务相关token级信号而不使策略目标产生偏差；2)TETHER——一种自适应基线的基线方法，根据价值函数的准确性在组相对基线和价值基线之间动态插值。
AI.result: 在多个推理任务上，两种策略都一致地优于标准价值函数基线，并且与均值基线GRPO相比具有竞争力或表现更优。
AI.conclusion: PVF和TETHER两种策略有效解决了价值函数RL在实际应用中的不足，使其能够与主流的critic-free方法（如GRPO）相竞争甚至超越，为价值函数RL在LLM训练中的可行性提供了有力支持。

title: DRAFE: Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion of Heterogeneous Detection Transformers for Cross-City Fine-Grained Traffic Object Detection
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code available at: https://github.com/dyagbobli/VisionOps-Trainer
summary: Deep learning-based object detectors are fundamental to intelligent transportation systems, enabling traffic monitoring, vehicle analytics, and infrastructure management. However, achieving both fine-grained vehicle recognition and robust cross-city domain generalization remains challenging. We present the Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion Ensemble (DRAFE), which combines independently trained LW-DETR and RF-DETR detectors for cross-city fine-grained traffic object detection. DRAFE employs a two-stage training strategy that first pretrains complementary detectors on diverse public traffic datasets using pseudo-label expansion and human-in-the-loop annotation refinement, producing a curated corpus of 6,049 images and 203,619 annotations, before challenge-compliant fine-tuning on the Project Hafnia Track 6 dataset. At inference, DRAFE applies anchor-conditioned class-consistent matching, reliability-weighted coordinate fusion, agreement-aware confidence recalibration, and complementary hypothesis recovery. On AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6, DRAFE achieves 0.4022 mAP, ranks sixth among 25 participating teams, and improves by 0.0553 mAP over a preliminary ensemble evaluated under identical benchmark conditions.

AI.tldr: DRAFE是一个结合LW-DETR和RF-DETR两个独立检测器的集成框架，用于跨城市细粒度交通目标检测。通过两阶段训练策略（先在多样化公共数据集上预训练并人工校对，再在竞赛数据上微调），以及推理时的锚定条件类一致匹配、可靠性加权坐标融合、置信度重校准和互补假设恢复等策略，在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6上达到0.4022 mAP，排名第六。
AI.motivation: 智能交通系统需要既具备细粒度车辆识别能力又具备跨城市域泛化能力的目标检测器，但这两方面同时实现仍然极具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出域鲁棒非对称融合集成（DRAFE）：1) 两阶段训练策略，先在多样化公共交通数据集上预训练互补的LW-DETR和RF-DETR检测器，使用伪标签扩展和人在回路标注精炼，构建了6,049张图像和203,619个标注的精选语料库，再在Project Hafnia Track 6数据集上按竞赛要求微调；2) 推理时采用锚定条件类一致匹配、可靠性加权坐标融合、一致性感知置信度重校准和互补假设恢复策略。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6上达到0.4022 mAP，在25支参赛队伍中排名第六，比在相同基准条件下评估的初步集成提升了0.0553 mAP。
AI.conclusion: 通过非对称架构的检测器集成结合精细的数据工程和推理融合策略，DRAFE有效平衡了细粒度识别与跨城市域泛化的需求，验证了集成方法在跨域交通目标检测中的有效性。

title: Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments
summary: Many areas of AI research, such as language model interpretability and chain of thought faithfulness, seek to explain model behaviors. But what constitutes a "good" explanation? In this work, we evaluate explanations through the lens of counterfactual simulatability-whether the explanation is useful for predicting model behaviors on related counterfactual inputs. To this end, we introduce CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), a novel agentic pipeline that identifies unexpected model behaviors in the wild and investigates them with counterfactual prompt edits. This yields thousands of high-quality explanations for naturally-occurring model behaviors along with supporting counterfactual evidence. We apply CHIVE in two ways. First, we evaluate whether common LLM interpretability techniques improve an agent's ability to predict counterfactual model behaviors. Surprisingly, we find no uplift from any of the interpretability techniques studied. Second, we use CHIVE to generate training data. We find that training models to predict outcomes of CHIVE-generated counterfactual experiments generalizes to various out-of-distribution settings. Overall, CHIVE automatically discovers explanations of naturally-occurring LLM behaviors, enabling us to evaluate and improve methods for explaining LLM behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CHIVE，一个智能体流水线，通过反事实提示编辑来识别和调查自然发生的大语言模型行为，生成高质量解释及反事实证据。研究发现在预测反事实行为时，常见的可解释性技术没有带来提升，但用CHIVE生成的数据训练模型可以泛化到多种分布外场景。
AI.motivation: AI研究（如语言模型可解释性和思维链忠实度）致力于解释模型行为，但缺乏对"好解释"的统一定义和评估标准。作者提出以反事实可模拟性（counterfactual simulatability）作为评估解释的标准，即解释能否帮助预测模型在反事实输入上的行为。
AI.method: 提出CHIVE（Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits），一个智能体流水线：1) 在自然场景中发现意外的模型行为；2) 通过反事实提示编辑进行调查；3) 生成大量带反事实证据的高质量解释。CHIVE用于两个方向：评估常见LLM可解释性技术是否提升预测能力，以及生成训练数据训练模型预测反事实实验结果。
AI.result: 1) 所有测试的常见可解释性技术（interpretability techniques）在提升反事实行为预测能力方面均无提升；2) 用CHIVE生成的数据训练模型预测反事实实验结果，能泛化到多种分布外设置。
AI.conclusion: CHIVE能够自动发现自然发生的LLM行为的解释，为评估和改进解释方法提供了新的框架。同时，反事实可模拟性可作为评估解释质量的有效标准，而生成的反事实数据可用于训练更善于预测模型行为的模型。

title: Chronocooked: A Benchmark for Implicit Interval Timing in Reinforcement Learning Agents
summary: This paper presents Chronocooked, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark suite for studying implicit interval timing in RL agents. Inspired by Overcooked, the suite comprises cooking scenarios that require temporal decision making. The tasks and reward functions are designed such that temporal information is unobserved yet critical for optimal performance. The environment is intentionally kept simple to enable controlled experiments and support biologically plausible models. Evaluation metrics are designed to expose limitations in timing abilities of RL agents, and we report baselines using a non-recurrent, a recurrent, and a biologically plausible model. This work ultimately aims to underscore the need to incorporate time perception and temporal processing in artificial agents designed for human robot interaction and deployment in time dependent human societies.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Chronocooked，一个用于研究强化学习（RL）智能体隐式间隔计时能力的基准测试套件。该套件基于Overcooked场景设计烹饪任务，其中时间信息未被直接观测但对最优表现至关重要。环境保持简单以支持受控实验和生物合理模型，并设计了专门暴露RL智能体计时局限的评估指标。
AI.motivation: 当前RL智能体在需要时间感知和间隔计时的任务上表现不佳，但在人机交互和时间依赖的社会场景中，时间感知至关重要。现有基准缺乏专门针对隐式间隔计时的系统性评估工具，因此需要构建一个能揭示RL智能体计时能力局限的基准测试套件。
AI.method: 基于Overcooked游戏设计烹饪场景，构建时间决策任务；任务与奖励函数设计确保时间信息不可直接观测但为最优策略所需；环境刻意保持简单以支持受控实验和生物合理模型；设计能暴露计时局限的评估指标；使用非循环、循环和生物合理三种模型作为基线。
AI.result: 报告了使用非循环、循环和生物合理模型作为基线的实验结果，评估指标能够有效暴露这三种RL智能体在计时能力上的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作强调在人工智能体中融入时间感知和时间处理的重要性，特别是在人机交互和部署于时间依赖的人类社会场景中。Chronocooked为研究隐式间隔计时提供了标准化的测试平台，有助于推动具备时间感知能力的RL智能体研究。

title: Training-Free Reconstruction-Based AI-Generated Image Detectors Are Inherently Vulnerable to Adversarial Examples
comment: Accepted at AI4MFDD (AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection) Workshop, ECCV 2026
summary: The impressive visual quality and ubiquity of AI-generated images call for reliable and robust detection methods. Reconstruction-based detectors have emerged as a promising direction for transparent and training-free identification of synthetic images. However, due to their fundamentally different mode of operation (compared to standard, classifier-based methods), little is known about their adversarial robustness. In this work, we propose two novel attack methods targeted at detectors that leverage autoencoder reconstruction error. We find that by constructing imperceptible adversarial examples, the distance between original and reconstruction can be artificially increased, causing fake images to be wrongly classified as real. Our evaluation including images from three state-of-the-art generators and three detectors demonstrates that detection performance is significantly decreased, even if attacked images additionally undergo real-world degradations. Critically, our adversarial examples naturally transfer across detectors, as they all share the same principle, pointing towards an inherent vulnerability of reconstruction-based detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种针对基于自编码器重建误差的AI生成图像检测器的对抗攻击方法，通过构造不可感知的对抗样本，人为增大原始图像与重建图像之间的距离，使伪造图像被错误分类为真实图像。实验表明攻击能显著降低检测性能，且对抗样本可跨检测器迁移。
AI.motivation: 重建式检测器作为透明且无需训练的AI图像检测方法虽有前景，但其对抗鲁棒性尚未被充分研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出两种针对基于自编码器重建误差检测器的攻击方法，通过构造不可感知的对抗样本来人为增大原始图像与重建图像之间的距离。
AI.result: 在三个最先进生成器和三个检测器上的评估表明，检测性能显著下降，即使攻击图像经过真实世界退化处理仍然有效；对抗样本可跨检测器自然迁移。
AI.conclusion: 重建式检测器存在固有脆弱性，因为其共享相同的工作原理，攻击可自然迁移，这指向了一个普遍的安全隐患。

title: On the Principles Behind Neural Network Optimizers
summary: Reliable optimization is central to neural network (NN) training, yet Adam, the default optimizer for modern LLMs, rests on a fragile foundation. This thesis develops a principled grounding for Adam and motivates new designs. First, we revisit Adam's divergence--convergence debate and show the existence of a problem-dependent phase transition: with properly chosen, batch-size-dependent hyperparameters, Adam converges, whereas under small-$β_2$ regimes it can diverge. Second, we investigate why Adam substantially outperforms SGD on Transformers through Hessian structure. We find that the Hessian evolves toward a near-block-diagonal form along training, accompanied by strong block heterogeneity. We prove that this structure makes Adam's diagonal preconditioner effective. We further show that this special Hessian structure originates from consecutive multiplications of large matrix variables, and we provide a rigorous analysis based on random matrix theory. Finally, these insights motivate Adam-mini, a new optimizer that reduces Adam's memory footprint by 50\% while preserving its performance. Our results also have broader implications beyond Adam: they reveal new local structures in matrix-based nonconvex problems, and also help understand and improve recent NN optimizers, such as Muon.

AI.tldr: 本论文为Adam优化器建立了理论基础，揭示了其在Transformer上的收敛性与黑森矩阵结构的关系，并提出了内存占用减半的Adam-mini优化器。
AI.motivation: Adam是现代LLM训练中的默认优化器，但其理论基础薄弱。论文旨在为Adam建立原则性理论基础，解释其与SGD相比在Transformer上的显著优势，并据此设计新的优化器。
AI.method: 1) 通过问题相关的相变理论重新审视Adam的收敛与发散争论，发现批次大小相关的超参数选择决定收敛性；2) 通过黑森矩阵结构分析，证明训练中黑森矩阵演化为近块对角结构，并利用随机矩阵理论证明Adam对角预条件器的有效性；3) 基于这些洞见设计Adam-mini优化器。
AI.result: 证明了Adam在适当超参数下收敛、小β₂下可能发散；证明了Transformer黑森矩阵的近块对角结构使Adam有效；提出的Adam-mini在保持性能的同时将内存占用减少50%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究不仅为Adam提供了理论基础，还揭示了矩阵型非凸问题中的新的局部结构，并对理解改进Muon等新型优化器具有更广泛的启示意义。

title: FabriMAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) integrate visual perception, language instruction, and action generation into end-to-end policies across heterogeneous architectures. However, enabling VLAs to self-evaluate their action generation reliability without external supervision remains a major challenge. Existing methods either rely on expert annotations or estimate uncertainty only from output statistics, largely ignoring internal signals. In this work, we observe that internal visual modality entropy exhibits consistent distinctions between successful and failed tasks across heterogeneous VLAs. Although VLAs' architectures differ in their action generation, we show that they share a common latent action generation abstraction evolving under visual perception, language instruction, and state input, which we formulate as a Conditional Generative Markov Chain. Based on this formulation, we propose MAE (Markov Attention Entropy), a self-evaluation framework that directly converts internal attention signals into architecture-aware reliability scores, and introduce LIBERO-Reflect, a 4,000-episode benchmark combining 2,000 standard episodes and 2,000 challenging episodes across four subsets. Extensive experiments across heterogeneous VLA architectures and diverse scenarios show that MAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on AUPR, AUROC, and FPR@95. We further instantiate FabriMAE for verifier-free test-time action selection, showing that MAE-guided multiple sampling improves PI-family robustness on LIBERO-Plus with small observed runtime overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAE（马尔可夫注意力熵）框架，利用VLA模型内部的注意力信号来评估动作生成的可靠性，并引入LIBERO-Reflect基准数据集，在异构VLA架构上显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型（视觉-语言-动作模型）虽然集成了视觉、语言和动作生成，但缺乏无需外部监督的自评估能力。已有方法要么依赖专家标注，要么仅从输出统计估计不确定性，忽略了模型内部信号，难以可靠地评估动作生成的成功与否。
AI.method: 论文首先观察到内部视觉模态熵在成功和失败任务间存在一致差异，提出VLA共享一种条件生成马尔可夫链的潜在动作生成抽象。基于此，提出MAE（Markov Attention Entropy）框架，将内部注意力信号直接转化为架构感知的可靠性评分，并构建LIBERO-Reflect基准（4000个回合，含2000个标准和2000个具有挑战性的回合）。还提出了FabriMAE用于无验证器的测试时动作选择。
AI.result: 在异构VLA架构和多样化场景中，MAE在AUPR、AUROC和FPR@95指标上一致优于最先进的基线方法。MAE引导的多重采样在LIBERO-Plus上提升了PI系列模型的鲁棒性，且运行时开销很小。
AI.conclusion: MAE框架通过利用模型内部注意力信号实现可靠的VLA自评估，为无外部监督的动作生成可靠性评估提供了新的有效范式，并展示了其在测试时动作选择中的实际应用价值。

title: X$^2$Localizer: Cross-grained Alignment for Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization
comment: Accepted to The 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Cross-view Video Geo-localization (CVG) aims to localize ground-view videos by retrieving their corresponding geo-tagged aerial images. However, CVG approaches rely on fixed-length inputs and post-hoc refinement, hindering online-oriented localization under partial or dynamic observations. In this work, we formulate Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization (PCVG) as a deployment-oriented extension and evaluation protocol of CVG, enabling localization under varying temporal budgets, prefix-based inference, random-start evaluation, and long-range localization with interruptions. To explore PCVG, we introduce X$^2$Localizer, a cross-grained alignment framework that jointly supervises global prefix-to-aerial retrieval and token-aggregated frame--aerial-tile matching with a budget-dependent asymmetric objective. Furthermore, we introduce a Sliding-Window Re-Localization (SWRL) strategy that dynamically refreshes candidate regions for failure recovery and long-range deployment without full-sequence reprocessing. Extensive experiments show that X$^2$Localizer preserves conventional full-video performance, with marginal gains of +0.1 Recall@1 and +0.3 Recall@10, while substantially improving early localization. In the challenging single-frame setting, X$^2$Localizer improves coarse retrieval by +4.7 Recall@1 and +11.5 Recall@10 over the previous state-of-the-art method. With SWRL, our approach further enables robust progressive localization under random-start and long-distance scenarios, narrowing the gap between benchmark evaluation and real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出渐进式跨视角视频地理定位（PCVG）协议及其解决方案X$^2$Localizer，通过跨粒度对齐框架和滑动窗口重定位策略，实现在可变时间预算、前缀推理和随机起点等真实部署场景下的高效定位，同时保持甚至小幅提升传统全视频定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角视频地理定位（CVG）方法依赖固定长度输入和事后精炼，无法适应在线场景下部分或动态观测的需求，即无法在视频尚未完整播放时进行快速定位，且在长距离、随机起始等真实部署条件下表现不佳，阻碍了从基准评估到实际部署的转化。
AI.method: 1）形式化PCVG作为CVG的部署导向扩展协议，涵盖可变时间预算、前缀推理、随机起点评估和带中断的长距离定位。2）提出X$^2$Localizer跨粒度对齐框架，联合监督全局前缀-航拍检索和基于token聚合的帧-航拍瓦片匹配，采用预算依赖的不对称目标函数。3）引入滑动窗口重定位（SWRL）策略，动态刷新候选区域实现失败恢复和长距离部署，无需全序列重新处理。
AI.result: X$^2$Localizer在保持传统全视频性能基础上（Recall@1提升+0.1，Recall@10提升+0.3），大幅提升早期定位能力。在单帧挑战场景下，粗粒度检索Recall@1提升+4.7，Recall@10提升+11.5，优于先前最先进方法。结合SWRL策略，在随机起点和长距离场景下实现稳健的渐进式定位。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过PCVG协议和X$^2$Localizer框架，有效弥合了跨视角视频地理定位在基准评估与真实部署之间的差距，验证了渐进式、可中断的在线定位范式在保持原有性能的同时显著增强早期定位能力与鲁棒性。

title: Beyond $L_2$: Generalizing Abductive Latent Explanations to Diverse Prototype-Based Architectures
summary: Prototype-based neural networks are hailed as interpretable-by-design architectures. Recently, Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE) were introduced to provide formal, mathematically guaranteed explanations that leverage the intrinsic structure of these networks to ensure both predictive safety and human readability. ALEs rely on computing tight bounds on latent space distances to produce formal explanations. However, existing ALE formulations are rigidly confined to Euclidean latent spaces. This leaves a critical gap: modern state-of-the-art architectures increasingly rely on non-Euclidean representations - such as spherical metrics, Gaussian densities, and dimensional projections - rendering current formal explanation methods incompatible. In this work, we generalize the ALE framework to support non-Euclidean prototype architectures. For each geometric variant, we systematically derive how to either map the architecture to existing bounds or construct novel, architecture-specific bounding algorithms. We validate our theoretical constructions by computing subset-minimal formal explanations on fully trained image classifiers. By unifying these diverse models under a single formal framework, we enable the first rigorous, cross-architecture comparison of their interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种泛化的框架，将Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE)从欧几里得潜空间扩展到非欧几里得原型网络架构（如球面度量、高斯密度和维度投影），通过为每种几何变体设计架构特定的边界算法，实现了首个跨架构的形式化可解释性比较。
AI.motivation: 现有的ALE形式化解释方法仅适用于欧几里得潜空间，而现代最先进的架构越来越多地采用非欧几里得表示（如球面度量、高斯密度和维度投影），导致当前的形式化解释方法无法与之兼容，存在关键的研究空白。
AI.method: 作者将ALE框架泛化以支持非欧几里得原型架构。对于每种几何变体，系统地推导出如何将架构映射到现有边界，或构建新颖的、架构特定的边界算法。最终通过计算子集最小形式化解释来验证理论构建。
AI.result: 通过在训练完成的图像分类器上计算子集最小形式化解释，验证了理论构建的有效性，并首次实现了不同架构间的可解释性严格对比。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多种非欧几里得模型统一到单一形式化框架下，该工作实现了首个严格的跨架构可解释性比较，填补了非欧几里得原型网络形式化解释的研究空白。

title: LAVA: Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation Framework for Large-Scale Financial Document Auditing
summary: Financial document validation in production, such as payroll auditing, tax compliance, and loan underwriting, demands exceptional accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility under strict enterprise constraints. In practice, documents arrive with heterogeneous layouts and formats, semantically rich and context-dependent content, and embedded business rules that current pipelines struggle to process reliably. We introduce LAVA (Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation), a modular, backbone-agnostic pipeline built on multimodal large language models, that integrates a four-stage design: document-rule retrieval, layout-preserving information extraction, auxiliary metadata enrichment, and auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification. LAVA supports robust rule grounding, fine-grained error attribution, and consistent, traceable end-to-end execution, capabilities essential for high-stakes deployment. Evaluated on a large real-world benchmark with diverse financial documents and dozens of expert-curated validation rules, LAVA outperforms baselines in hallucination control and edge-case handling while maintaining efficient token usage, demonstrating practicality for high-volume, time-critical validation.

AI.tldr: LAVA是一个基于多模态大语言模型构建的模块化、骨干无关的金融文档验证流水线，通过四阶段设计（文档规则检索、布局保持信息提取、辅助元数据增强、可审计符号/算术验证）实现高准确率、一致性和可复现性的文档验证，在真实基准上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 金融文档验证（如工资审计、税务合规、贷款承销）在生产环境中要求极高的准确性、一致性和可复现性，但实际文档存在异构布局与格式、语义丰富且上下文相关的内容，以及嵌入式业务规则，现有流水线难以可靠处理这些挑战。
AI.method: LAVA采用四阶段设计：1）文档-规则检索（document-rule retrieval），实现稳健的规则接地；2）布局保持信息提取（layout-preserving information extraction）；3）辅助元数据增强（auxiliary metadata enrichment）；4）可审计的符号/算术验证（auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification）。整个流水线是多模态大语言模型驱动的模块化、骨干无关架构。
AI.result: 在包含多样化金融文档和数十条专家策展验证规则的大规模真实世界基准上，LAVA在幻觉控制和边缘情况处理方面优于基线方法，同时保持高效的token使用，展现了高吞吐、时间关键验证场景下的实用性。
AI.conclusion: LAVA证明了模块化、可审计的LLM流水线能够满足高风险金融文档验证场景对稳健规则接地、细粒度错误归因和一致可追溯端到端执行的要求，为生产级部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Turning spectra into images improves plant trait retrieval with 2D-CNNs
comment: 38 pages, 14 figures, 11 tables. Supplementary material appended after the references. v2: adds a per-image vs global scaling ablation, expands the methods, and corrects several figures and captions
summary: Hyperspectral reflectance spectroscopy enables non-destructive estimation of plant functional traits, yet current deep learning approaches process spectra as one-dimensional sequences, which limits how they capture long-range inter-band dependencies. We asked whether transforming 1D spectra into 2D image representations improves multi-trait prediction with convolutional neural networks (CNN). We compared nine transformations using EfficientNet-B0 on the GreenHyperSpectra dataset (7,897 labeled spectra, eight traits, 400-2450 nm), benchmarked against published 1D CNN results on the same split. Trained from scratch, the simplest transformation, a direct Reshape of the spectrum into a 2D grid, performed best ($R^2 = 0.684 \pm 0.001$) and improved on the state-of-the-art 1D baseline ($R^2 = 0.587$, $+0.097$). We then pretrained a 2D masked autoencoder (MAE-2D) on 139,000 unlabeled spectral images. Linear probing, which freezes the encoder and trains only a multilayer perceptron head, reached $R^2 = 0.646$ and exceeded every 1D self-supervised counterpart, including the fine-tuned MAE-1D ($R^2 = 0.641$). Under cross-dataset evaluation all models lost most of their accuracy and none beat the 1D baseline significantly. To identify which wavelengths drive each prediction, we applied Integrated Gradients and Grad-CAM and unfolded band importance back to the spectral axis. Protein ($r = 0.45$) and leaf water ($r = 0.33$) agreed with sensitivities simulated by the PROSAIL radiative-transfer model, while carotenoids ($r = 0.06$) and leaf area index ($r = -0.11$) did not, showing that the model reads established leaf chemistry for traits with sharp absorption features. The representational advantage of 2D spectral images, rather than architectural complexity or ImageNet pretraining, drives the gain over 1D approaches.

AI.tldr: 该研究将高光谱反射光谱从一维序列转换为二维图像表示，使用EfficientNet-B0 CNN进行多性状预测。简单Reshape变换在GreenHyperSpectra数据集上表现最佳（R²=0.684），比一维基线提升0.097。2D掩码自编码器预训练优于所有一维自监督方法，但跨数据集泛化仍存在挑战。可解释性分析显示模型对蛋白质和水分等具尖锐吸收特征的性状读取了既定叶片化学信号。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习处理高光谱数据时将光谱视为一维序列，限制了模型捕获波段间长程依赖关系的能力。作者质疑将一维光谱转换为二维图像表示是否能改善CNN的多性状预测性能，并希望探索这种表示转换是否带来超越架构复杂度的收益。
AI.method: 比较九种光谱到二维图像的变换方法，使用EfficientNet-B0在GreenHyperSpectra数据集（7,897个标签光谱，8个性状，400-2450nm）上从零训练，并与已发表的一维CNN结果对比。随后在139,000个未标记光谱图像上预训练2D掩码自编码器（MAE-2D），采用线性探测评估。使用Integrated Gradients和Grad-CAM进行可解释性分析，与PROSAIL辐射传输模型模拟的敏感性对比。
AI.result: 最简单直接的Reshape变换表现最佳（R²=0.684±0.001），较一维基线R²=0.587提升0.097。线性探测的MAE-2D达到R²=0.646，超过所有一维自监督方法包括微调后的MAE-1D（R²=0.641）。跨数据集评估中所有模型精度大幅下降。可解释性显示蛋白质（r=0.45）和水分（r=0.33）与PROSAIL模型一致，类胡萝卜素和叶面积指数不一致。
AI.conclusion: 二维光谱图像的表征优势（而非架构复杂度或ImageNet预训练）是超越一维方法的关键驱动力。简单Reshape变换足以捕获光谱波段间的空间关系，但模型的跨数据集泛化能力仍有待提升。

title: GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises
summary: High-capacity encoders in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can let the query dominate the latent state, leaving retrieved evidence functionally irrelevant. We call this failure mode query dominance. To address it, we introduce \textbf{GRIP} (Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises), which imposes capacity asymmetry: the decoder keeps full-dimensional access to the query, while retrieved evidence passes through a severe stochastic bottleneck. This forces the evidence channel to encode only the residual information unavailable from the query. Across five reasoning benchmarks, GRIP outperforms strong iterative baselines, cuts a query--latent mutual-information diagnostic by roughly 30$\times$ (14.8 $\to$ 0.47 bits), and reduces hallucination by 73\%. Residual-alignment analysis further shows that the bottleneck output occupies subspaces less aligned with the query than baseline representations.

AI.tldr: GRIP通过信息受限前提（信息瓶颈）解决RAG中查询主导隐状态导致检索证据失效的"查询主导"问题，强制证据通道仅编码查询无法提供的残差信息，在五个推理基准上超越强基线，互信息诊断降低约30倍，幻觉减少73%。
AI.motivation: 在高容量编码器的RAG系统中，查询信息会主导潜在状态，导致检索到的证据在生成过程中功能上无关紧要，这种"查询主导"（query dominance）失效模式严重削弱了检索增强的效果。
AI.method: GRIP引入容量不对称设计：解码器保留对查询的全维度访问，而检索证据通过一个严格的随机瓶颈（stochastic bottleneck）。这种设计迫使证据通道只编码查询中不存在残差信息，从而避免查询主导问题。
AI.result: 在五个推理基准上GRIP优于强迭代基线；查询与隐状态的互信息诊断从14.8比特降至0.47比特（约30倍缩减）；幻觉减少73%；残差对齐分析表明瓶颈输出占据与查询对齐度更低的子空间。
AI.conclusion: 通过信息瓶颈实现能力不对称是一种有效的机制，能确保检索证据在RAG中真正发挥功能作用，而非被查询信息淹没，从而提升推理可靠性与事实性。

title: Concept-based explanation of gene expression prediction from H&E images
summary: Recent advances in pathology foundation models have enabled accurate prediction of spatial transcriptomics (ST) from routine H&E images. However, existing explainability methods for vision transformer (ViT)-based models are largely limited to local heatmaps and do not reveal how morphological concepts contribute to ST predictions. Here, we introduce an explainable framework that combines relevance propagation and concept discovery to link transcriptional programs to tissue morphology. We developed a ViT-based framework for virtual ST from H&E images that combines ViT-aware layer-wise relevance propagation with relaxed archetypal TopK sparse autoencoder-based concept discovery. This approach provides both local explanations and global insights into the morphological patterns associated with transcriptional programs. We applied the framework to colorectal cancer ST data from the HEST-1k cohort and evaluated its generalizability in TCGA COAD. Our architecture accurately predicts clinically relevant ST signatures and accompanying molecular phenotypes. Measured and predicted gene expression profiles reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity of the colorectal cancer subtypes iCMS2 and iCMS3 across a large number of samples. Spatially resolved and aggregated iCMS classification achieve weighted F1 scores of 0.872 and 0.819 (0.770 in TCGA COAD), respectively, and both stratify patient outcome. Beyond prediction, our framework establishes a relevance-based concept atlas linking molecular phenotypes to histopathological representations. Comparison of activation- with relevance-derived concepts demonstrates that relevances provide a more direct link between tissue morphology and downstream predictions. We establish a general strategy for concept-based explanation of spatial prediction, and our framework is readily applicable to a broad range of ViT-based pathology models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释框架，将相关性传播与概念发现相结合，用于从H&E图像预测空间转录组学（ST）。该框架基于ViT架构，结合ViT感知的逐层相关性传播（LRP）与松弛原型TopK稀疏自编码器进行概念发现，同时提供局部热图解释和全局形态学概念洞察。在结直肠癌HEST-1k队列和TCGA COAD数据上验证，iCMS亚型分类的加权F1分数分别达到0.872和0.819（TCGA COAD中0.770），并建立了连接分子表型与组织病理学表征的相关性概念图谱。
AI.motivation: 现有的病理基础模型可解释性方法大多局限于局部热图，无法揭示形态学概念如何贡献于空间转录组学预测，缺乏对预测背后生物学机制的深入理解。
AI.method: 提出结合ViT感知的逐层相关性传播（LRP）与松弛原型TopK稀疏自编码器（relaxed archetypal TopK SAE）的概念发现方法，在ViT架构上进行虚拟空间转录组学预测，同时提供局部解释和全局形态学-转录程序的关联洞察。
AI.result: 在结直肠癌数据上，iCMS2和iCMS3亚型的空间分辨和聚合分类加权F1分数分别达0.872和0.819（TCGA COAD中0.770），均能对患者预后进行分层；相关性派生的概念相比激活派生的概念更能直接连接组织形态与下游预测。
AI.conclusion: 该框架建立了基于概念解释空间预测的通用策略，可广泛适用于各类基于ViT的病理模型，为揭示转录程序与组织形态之间的关联提供了更直接的可解释性途径。

title: CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?
summary: Video world models approximate the stochastic distribution of physical outcomes through generative sampling, but existing benchmarks score individual generations or compare distributions coarsely over a whole dataset, leaving the fine-grained aleatoric uncertainty of specific phenomena untested. We introduce CaliBench, which scores outcomes in a physically interpretable discrete space - a bin index, a die face, a suit, a colour - rather than a learned feature space such as in FID, so the distance from a known reference distribution is measured directly. We curate outcome spaces whose reference is known in closed form (binomial Galton boards, Bernoulli forks, uniform dice/cards/lottery, a skewed European-roulette colour), enabling an exact calibration test. We decompose performance into two orthogonal axes that a single accuracy metric conflates: scorability, the fraction of generations yielding a scoreable outcome, and calibration, the total variation distance from the reference on that sample. A chi-squared test assesses significance; as calibration is its null hypothesis it can evidence only miscalibration, and at N=32 per cell detects only large deviations. We apply it to nine scenes and six image-to-video models (WAN-2.7, SeeDance-2.0, HappyHorse-1.0, Veo 3.1, Runway Gen-4.5, Cosmos3-Super), 32 generations each. Models consistently concentrate probability mass on a few outcomes rather than reproducing the reference. Most scene-model combinations are significantly miscalibrated, in the extreme collapsing to one outcome, as Veo 3.1 does on dice. On roulette, generations often leave the ball ambiguously placed, giving several models low scorability. Performance varies by scene: no model dominates all nine. We release the protocol and a metric (mean normalised total variation, mnTV) for comparing new models against our results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CaliBench，一个用于评估视频世界模型细粒度随机不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）校准的基准。它在物理可解释的离散结果空间（如箱位、骰面、花色）上直接比较生成分布与已知参考分布，并通过"可评分性"（scorability）和"校准度"（总变差距离）两个正交轴分解性能，使用卡方检验进行显著性检验。作者对九个场景和六个视频生成模型进行了评估，发现大多数模型显著未校准，且在极端情况下坍缩为单一结果。论文还发布了协议和 mnTV 指标。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准要么对单个生成结果打分（如FID），要么在整个数据集上粗略比较分布，无法测试特定现象的细粒度随机不确定性。作者希望构建一个能在物理可解释空间中直接、精确衡量模型对随机结果概率分布校准程度的基准。
AI.method: CaliBench 在物理可解释的离散结果空间（箱位、骰面、花色、颜色等）中评估模型输出，其参考分布在闭式下已知（二项分布的 Galton 板、伯努利分叉、均匀骰子/纸牌/彩票、偏斜的欧式轮盘颜色），从而可以进行精确校准测试。性能分解为两个正交轴：可评分性（生成结果可评分的比例）和校准度（与参考分布的总变差距离）。采用卡方检验（以校准为零假设）评估显著性，每格 N=32 的样本量。此外，引入 mnTV（平均归一化总变差）指标用于比较新模型。
AI.result: 对六个模型（WAN-2.7、SeeDance-2.0、HappyHorse-1.0、Veo 3.1、Runway Gen-4.5、Cosmos3-Super）在九个场景上各生成32次进行评估，发现模型普遍将概率质量集中在少数结果上而非复现参考分布。大多数场景-模型组合显著未校准，极端情况下收敛为单一结果（如 Veo 3.1 在骰子场景）。在轮盘场景中，生成结果常使球位置模糊，导致多个模型可评分性低。性能因场景而异，没有模型在所有九个场景中占据主导。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频世界模型在细粒度随机结果校准方面存在系统性缺陷，倾向于概率坍缩而非忠实复现真实分布的随机性。CaliBench 提供了一种可解释、可精确检验的校准评估框架，并发布协议和 mnTV 指标供社区比较。卡方检验以校准为零假设，只能证明未校准，且 N=32 的样本量仅能检测较大偏差。

title: How Sampling Strategy Affects Imbalance Mitigation in LiDAR Segmentation: A Study of Structured vs. Random Point-Based Architectures
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2026
summary: Class imbalance in LiDAR point clouds poses challenges for semantic segmentation in autonomous navigation and urban mapping. While 2D vision has numerous mitigation techniques, their effectiveness in 3D remains unclear. We benchmark six reweighting schemes and five imbalance-aware losses across three datasets (DALES, S3DIS, STPLS3D) using two architectures (KPConv, RandLA-Net). Inverse-frequency weighting degrades performance by up to 12% compared to uniform weighting, with catastrophic failures in minority classes. Uniform weighting performs within 2% of complex losses for structured sampling (KPConv) but benefits less for random sampling (RandLA-Net, up to 4.6% gap). Loss landscape analysis reveals a complex interplay: for structured sampling, imbalance ratio determines landscape geometry on real LiDAR data but decouples from it on synthetic data; for random sampling, landscapes show high sensitivity to dataset geometry regardless of imbalance ratio. For the two evaluated point-based architectures, these results suggest that the interaction between sampling strategy (structured vs. random), imbalance severity, and data acquisition characteristics shapes which mitigation approaches are effective.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了六种重加权方案和五种不平衡感知损失在LiDAR点云语义分割中的表现，覆盖三个数据集（DALES、S3DIS、STPLS3D）和两种架构（KPConv、RandLA-Net）。关键发现：逆频率加权会使性能下降最多12%，均匀加权在结构化采样（KPConv）下与复杂损失仅差2%，但在随机采样（RandLA-Net）下差距达4.6%。损失景观分析揭示采样策略、不平衡程度和数据采集特性之间的复杂交互决定了缓解方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: LiDAR点云语义分割中类别不平衡问题严重，虽然2D视觉领域已有大量缓解技术，但这些方法在3D点云中的有效性尚不明确。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统评估现有方法在3D场景下的表现，并深入理解其失效或有效的机制。
AI.method: 采用基准测试与损失景观分析相结合的方法：(1) 在三个数据集上系统比较六种重加权方案和五种不平衡感知损失；(2) 使用两种代表性架构（KPConv结构化采样、RandLA-Net随机采样）；(3) 通过损失景观分析探究不平衡比、采样策略与数据获取特性之间的交互关系。
AI.result: (1) 逆频率加权性能比均匀加权差最多12%，少数类出现灾难性失败；(2) 均匀加权在结构化采样下与复杂损失差距仅2%，但在随机采样下差距达4.6%；(3) 损失景观在结构化采样中，真实LiDAR数据上由不平衡比决定几何形态，合成数据上则与之解耦；(4) 随机采样的损失景观对数据集几何高度敏感，与不平衡比无关。
AI.conclusion: 采样策略（结构化vs随机）、不平衡严重程度和数据采集特性三者的交互决定了哪种缓解方法有效，不存在一刀切的解决方案。这提示研究者需要根据具体架构和数据类型选择合适的不平衡处理策略。

title: Time-Aware Validation of Machine Learning Fuel Consumption Models: Evidence from 1\,Hz Operational Data, CCGS \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier}
summary: Ship fuel consumption (SFC) prediction supports vessel operation optimisation, emissions estimation, and decision support systems (DSS) for sustainable maritime transportation. Numerous data-driven fuel models have been developed over the past two decades, but a critical and often overlooked limitation lies in their validation practices: most studies evaluate performance using random train--test splits, which, applied to high-frequency records, admit temporal leakage and yield optimistic results that do not reflect deployment conditions. This paper examines that gap using time-aware evaluation, specifically Time Series Cross-Validation (TSCV) and Blocked TSCV (BTSCV). Using the Canadian Coast Guard Ship (CCGS) \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier} as a case study, six regression models and a physics baseline are tuned under three time-aware schemes and three feature configurations, then evaluated on a common chronological hold-out set drawn from approximately 3.88 million steady-state 1\,Hz records.

AI.tldr: 本文指出船舶燃油消耗预测研究中普遍存在的验证缺陷——随机训练测试划分导致时间泄漏和乐观偏差，并提出采用时间感知评估方法（时间序列交叉验证和分块时间序列交叉验证）来真实反映部署条件下的模型性能。以加拿大海岸警卫队一艘船舶约388万条稳态1Hz数据为案例，比较六种回归模型和一个物理基线模型在不同时间感知方案和特征配置下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有大量数据驱动的船舶燃油消耗预测模型虽然在文献中报告了良好的性能，但多数研究采用随机训练测试划分进行评估，对高频时间序列数据而言这会造成时间泄漏（前后时间的数据被同时用于训练和测试），产生过于乐观的结果，无法真实反映模型在实际部署中的表现。作者旨在通过时间感知评估框架来揭示和弥补这一验证实践中的关键缺口。
AI.method: 采用时间序列交叉验证（TSCV）和分块时间序列交叉验证（BTSCV）作为时间感知的评估方案，与随机划分进行对比。以加拿大海岸警卫队Sir Wilfrid Laurier号船舶作为案例，在三种时间感知方案和三种特征配置下对六种回归模型及一个物理基线模型进行调参，最终在一个共同的时间顺序留出集上进行评估，数据来自约388万条稳态1Hz记录。
AI.result: 论文通过时间感知评估方法系统比较了各模型在真实部署条件下的性能，揭示了随机划分评估导致的乐观偏差，展示了不同时间感知方案和特征配置对模型表现的影响。
AI.conclusion: 随机训练测试划分在船舶燃油消耗预测评估中会产生时间泄漏和误导性结果，应采用时间序列交叉验证等时间感知评估方法，才能获得反映实际部署条件的可靠模型性能估计。

title: Cross-Sign Language Transfer Learning Using Domain Adaptation with Multi-scale Temporal Alignment
summary: Sign language serves as a vital means of communication for individuals with hearing impairments, yet recognition resources for the over 100 distinct sign languages are severely lacking. In response, we present our work on sign language recognition using transfer learning and the domain adaptation method TA3N, which utilizes the Temporal Relational Network (TRN) module for aligning multi-scale temporal relations. Our findings highlight the superior performance of Domain Adaptation to neural network-based transfer learning, particularly in improving recognition of American Sign Language (ASL). Our research also identifies the effectiveness of aligning shorter-term temporal features between source and target domains. In addition to using RGB, we conducted experiments using Optical Flow mode for the sign language samples, ultimately determining that RGB outperforms Optical Flow in the majority of cases. Our work aims to improve accessibility and communication for individuals who rely on sign language as their primary mode of communication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用迁移学习和领域自适应方法TA3N（结合时间关系网络TRN模块对齐多尺度时间关系）进行手语识别，实验表明领域自适应优于基于神经网络的迁移学习，且在ASL识别中效果显著。研究发现对齐短期时间特征更有效，RGB输入在大多数情况下优于光流模式。
AI.motivation: 手语是听障人士的重要交流方式，但全球超过100种不同的手语中，识别资源严重匮乏。现有的识别方法难以有效跨领域泛化，亟需探索更高效的手语识别技术来改善听障人士的可访问性和沟通体验。
AI.method: 采用迁移学习和领域自适应方法TA3N进行手语识别。TA3N利用时间关系网络（TRN）模块来对齐源域和目标域之间的多尺度时间关系。实验中使用RGB和光流两种输入模式进行对比，探索不同时间尺度特征对齐的有效性。
AI.result: 领域自适应方法在性能上优于基于神经网络的迁移学习，特别是在美国手语（ASL）识别上表现突出。研究还发现对齐短期时间特征最为有效，且RGB输入在大多数情况下优于光流输入。
AI.conclusion: 工作证实了领域自适应结合时间关系对齐在手语识别中的有效性，为资源稀缺的手语识别任务提供了可行方案，旨在改善依赖手语作为主要交流方式人群的可访问性和沟通效率。

title: Bridging the Gap between Labeled and Unlabeled Data via Unified Flow with Feature Memory Bank
summary: Although semi-supervised semantic segmentation ($\text{S}^4$) utilizes abundant unlabeled data to reduce manual labeling burdens, independent training of labeled and unlabeled data causes the former to dominate, which severely degrades pseudo-label quality. To address this challenges, we propose a novel remote sensing (RS) $\text{S}^4$ method via unified flow with feature memory bank (UFFM). Specifically, UFFM comprises two key innovations: unified flow (UF) and feature memory bank (FMB). The UF is a new training flow that generates less biased pseudo-labels by combining an external visual foundation model (VFM) with an RS domain teacher, and jointly optimizes labeled and pseudo-labeled data under a unified training objective. The FMB is a novel memory module for $\text{S}^4$ that dynamically updates class-specific features during training and reduces the feature discrepancy between labeled and unlabeled data through class-feature alignment. To verify the effectiveness of our model, we conduct extensive experiments on RS datasets. The experimental results show the superiority of our method over SOTA $\text{S}^4$ methods. Moreover, the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our contributions in bridging the optimization and feature representation gap between labeled and unlabeled data. Our code is released at \href{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向遥感图像半监督语义分割（S⁴）的新方法UFFM，通过统一流程（UF）和特征记忆库（FMB）解决标注/未标注数据独立训练导致的伪标签质量退化问题，在遥感数据集上优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有半监督语义分割方法对标注和未标注数据独立训练，导致标注数据在训练中占据主导地位，严重降低伪标签质量。这一优化与特征表示上的差距问题亟需解决。
AI.method: UFFM包含两大创新：1) 统一流程（UF）：将外部视觉基础模型（VFM）与遥感领域教师模型结合生成偏差更小的伪标签，并在统一训练目标下联合优化标注与伪标注数据；2) 特征记忆库（FMB）：动态更新训练过程中的类别特定特征，通过类别特征对齐缩小标注与未标注数据之间的特征差异。
AI.result: 在遥感数据集上的大量实验表明，UFFM优于现有SOTA半监督语义分割方法，并验证了其在弥合标注和未标注数据之间的优化与特征表示差距方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: UFFM通过统一训练流程和特征记忆库机制，有效解决了标注/未标注数据间的优化和特征分布差距问题，提升了遥感图像半监督语义分割的伪标签质量与整体性能，代码已开源。

title: Quipu: A Governed Bitemporal Knowledge Graph Store
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Subtitle: "Start strict: rethinking knowledge-graph defaults for agent-written knowledge". Source and the benchmark/census/ artifacts behind every reported number are archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21878428 (concept DOI, resolves to newest release). Development repository: github.com/scbrown/quipu
summary: Agents now write knowledge graphs, but knowledge-graph stores still carry defaults set when humans curated them: accept writes now and clean later, keep one time axis or none, treat every writer's facts as equally trustworthy, and leave governance to dashboards and middleware. These four defaults are individually convenient and jointly untenable under agent workloads. We present Quipu, an embeddable store that inverts all four: no fact enters except through a gate whose predicates evaluate the pending post-state; data, trust labels, verdicts, and the rules themselves are bitemporal; named graphs are the unit of authority and trust, composed under a lattice whose one invariant is that composition never widens; and the governance specification $Σ$, the trace, and signed verdicts are facts in the store they govern, making the audit $T \models Σ$ a query. We evaluate with Census, a deterministic multi-writer lifecycle whose single seeded run scores every research question against planted ground truth: the gated store ends with 0 of 6 planted defects versus 6 of 6 ungated; all 7 composition probes uphold the lattice contract; 50 of 50 satisfied verdicts re-derive faithfully as of their instant while all 50 would be misreported under a latest-only rule set; and the SARC reference checker agrees with the in-store audit verdict-for-verdict, differing only on coverage semantics. A recorded trace from a governed writer surfaces a live enforcement gap the audit names with its remediation. On DEMM-Bench, an external decision-evidence sufficiency benchmark, a content-only reading of the exported records answers all 512 property-level governance questions correctly with zero overclaim under all eight degradation conditions, while container-presence baselines overclaim on up to 87.5% of them -- and the run surfaced, and led us to close, a gap in what a denial's verdict attests.

AI.tldr: Quipu 是一个可嵌入的知识图谱存储系统，它颠覆了传统知识图谱存储的四大默认设置：门控写入（无事实可通过未经评估的谓词检查）、全比特emporal（数据、信任标签、判定和规则本身都带有时间维度）、命名图作为权威与信任单位（由格结构组合且组合绝不扩大权限）、治理规范本身作为存储中的事实（审计变成查询）。评估显示该系统在确定性多写者生命周期基准上完全消除缺陷，在时间版本化、组合契约和外部治理基准上均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 传统知识图谱存储的四大默认设计——先写后清理、单一时间轴或无时间轴、所有写者事实同等可信、治理交由仪表盘和中间件——在智能体（agent）工作负载下变得不可持续。智能体自动写入的知识图谱需要更强的门控、时间追踪、信任管理和内嵌治理机制。
AI.method: Quipu 设计了一种反转为四层设计：(1) 写入门控——所有事实必须通过谓词评估"待提交后状态"才能进入；(2) 双时间维度——数据、信任标签、判定及规则本身均为bitemporal；(3) 命名图为信任与权威单位，在格（lattice）结构下组合，不变量为组合永不扩大权限；(4) 治理规范Σ、轨迹和签名判定都是存储中的事实，使审计 T ⊨ Σ 成为一次查询。
AI.result: 在 Census 基准上：门控存储以 0/6 的缺陷率结束（对比无门控的 6/6）；全部 7 个组合探针满足格契约；50/50 的满意判定在其时间点均能忠实重推导（而最新规则集下 50 个全部误报）。SARC 参考检查器与存储内审计在判定级上逐条一致。在 DEMM-Bench 外部基准上，内容阅读回答 512 个属性级治理问题全部正确，零过度声明（而容器存在性基线在最多 87.5% 的问题上过度声明）。同时发现了并修复了一个关于"拒绝判定所证明内容"的语义缺口。
AI.conclusion: Quipu 证明了将治理内嵌到知识图谱存储本身——而非外包给外部系统——是可行且有效的。通过将审计视为查询、将规则视为存储中的事实、将信任视为组合结构的一部分，可以在智能体工作负载下实现严格的门控、完整的时间追溯和可验证的审计能力。

title: AnchorScore: A CLIP-Based Diagnostic of MLLM Annotation Difficulty
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for automated annotation, yet their per-class accuracy varies widely (e.g., 12%-98% across the 13 classes of three classroom sub-datasets) and is expensive to measure: evaluating one 27B MLLM on 5,416 validation images takes roughly 14 hours, whereas a frozen-CLIP pass over the same images completes in about 3 minutes. A low-cost signal for ranking classes by expected MLLM annotation difficulty a priori remains underexplored. Building on the AnchorProxy construct (per-class zero-shot CLIP accuracy) introduced in the companion study, this paper systematically evaluates its full-frame formulation, termed AnchorScore here, as an a priori diagnostic that flags the classes MLLMs are least likely to annotate reliably.
  On classroom behavior data (SCB5, 13 classes, 6 MLLMs), AnchorScore correlates with per-class MLLM accuracy (Spearman rho = 0.769, p = 0.002, n = 13). None of the alternative difficulty predictors (DINOv2, ResNet-50, SigLIP, or MLLM self-verbalized uncertainty) showed a significant class-level correlation at n = 13. A cross-model consensus control suggests AnchorScore primarily captures a shared class-difficulty factor rather than a CLIP-specific signal. An independent replication on Stanford40 Actions yields a nearly identical effect (rho = 0.817, p < 0.001); the association is strongest on activity-recognition data and attenuates on medical and satellite imagery.
  Three practical applications follow: a deployable hybrid CLIP/MLLM routing strategy (predicted-class routing: up to +23 pp over CLIP-only at roughly 44% MLLM cost savings), prompt disambiguation on hard classes (exploratory), and review-priority prediction for human verification. AnchorScore does not estimate exact MLLM accuracy; it provides a low-cost ranking signal that directs expensive MLLM evaluation to the classes where it is most informative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnchorScore（基于每类零样本CLIP准确率的先验诊断指标），用于低成本预测MLLM在各类别上的标注难度排序。在SCB5数据上，AnchorScore与6个MLLM的每类准确率显著相关（rho=0.769），并在Stanford40上得到复现（rho=0.817）。该方法支持混合CLIP/MLLM路由策略（节省44%成本），但不估计精确准确率，仅提供排序信号。
AI.motivation: MLLM被广泛用于自动标注，但其每类准确率差异巨大（12%-98%），且评估成本高昂（27B模型在5416张图上需14小时，而CLIP仅需3分钟）。现有方法缺乏低成本信号来先验预测哪些类别MLLM标注不可靠，因此需要一种a priori诊断工具。
AI.method: 基于AnchorProxy（每类零样本CLIP准确率）构造AnchorScore，将其作为MLLM每类标注难度的先验排序指标。通过Spearman相关分析验证与6个MLLM的每类准确率的关联，并与DINOv2、ResNet-50、SigLIP和MLLM自述不确定性等替代预测器对比，同时进行跨模型一致性控制和独立数据集（Stanford40）复现。
AI.result: AnchorScore在SCB5上与每类MLLM准确率显著相关（rho=0.769, p=0.002），替代预测器均不显著；Stanford40复现rho=0.817；在活动识别数据上关联最强，医学和卫星图像上减弱。实际应用包括：混合CLIP/MLLM路由（较纯CLIP提升最高23个百分点，节省44%成本）、困难类别提示消歧、人工审核优先级预测。
AI.conclusion: AnchorScore是一个低成本、有效且可推广的MLLM类别难度先验排序信号，能引导昂贵的MLLM评估资源集中于最需要关注的类别。它不是精确准确率估计器，而是帮助优化标注评估效率的实用诊断工具。

title: Data-Efficient and Interpretable Classification of Circulating Tumor Cell Phenotypes in Microfluidic Devices via Deep Learning
summary:
Accurate classification of circulating tumor cell (CTC) phenotypes can provide valuable information for assessing metastatic potential. Label free microfluidic devices provide a hydrodynamic obstacle course that transforms subtle biophysical characteristics of CTCs, including size and deformability, into distinct kinematic trajectories. However, the highly nonlinear fluid structure interactions governing these trajectories make the inverse problem of inferring cellular phenotype from trajectory data analytically intractable. While deep neural networks (DNNs) have emerged as a powerful approach for addressing this inverse problem, their effectiveness is constrained by the limited availability of trajectory data and the lack of physical interpretability.
  To address these challenges, we propose an interpretable and data efficient DNN framework for trajectory based CTC classification. To mitigate the scarcity of data, we develop Subsequence (SubSeq), a targeted augmentation strategy that randomly extracts informative local trajectory segments during training to promote learning from localized patterns. We further apply Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping to identify the trajectory features and physical regions of the microfluidic device that drive model predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that SubSeq improves classification accuracy over the evaluated baseline and augmentation methods. Furthermore, interpretability analysis suggests that localized trajectory segments contain substantial biophysical information relevant to accurate classification. This provides justification for SubSeq and also highlights the redundancy of full-length trajectories. More broadly, the proposed framework views microfluidic geometries as physical encoders of cellular mechanical properties, providing mechanistic insights that may inform the future design of diagnostic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释且数据高效的深度神经网络框架，用于基于轨迹的循环肿瘤细胞（CTC）表型分类。通过子序列（SubSeq）数据增强策略缓解轨迹数据稀缺问题，并结合梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）提升物理可解释性。
AI.motivation: CTC表型分类对评估转移潜能具有重要意义。虽然无标记微流控装置能通过流体动力学将细胞生物物理特性转化为运动轨迹，但逆问题（从轨迹推断表型）因高度非线性的流固耦合而难以解析求解。深度神经网络虽可用于此逆问题，但受限于有限的轨迹数据和缺乏物理可解释性。
AI.method: 提出可解释且数据高效的DNN框架：1）开发SubSeq定向增强策略，在训练中随机提取信息丰富的局部轨迹片段以促进局部模式学习，缓解数据稀缺；2）应用梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）识别驱动模型预测的轨迹特征和微流控装置的物理区域。
AI.result: 实验结果表明SubSeq在分类准确率上优于基线和其他增强方法；可解释性分析显示局部轨迹段包含大量与准确分类相关的生物物理信息，同时揭示了全长轨迹的冗余性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将微流控几何结构视为细胞力学特性的物理编码器，提供机制性见解，可为未来诊断设备的设计提供指导。

title: MIRROR: Multimodal Intelligent Radiology Reasoning and Observation Reporter
summary: A radiologist reading a model's output faces two problems. The model returns a number and no reason, and any system that turns that number into readable prose can quietly add claims the model never made. MIRROR is a research prototype built to separate those failures. It chains a multi-label classifier, a Grad-CAM localizer that turns each positive finding into a named anatomical region, and a report writer that receives the labels, probabilities, and regions but never the image. Because the language layer cannot see pixels, it cannot assert a finding the classifier did not make. We are precise about what that buys: a MIRROR report's findings are auditable against the probability vector, while the sentences framing them are ordinary generated text, and we show one stating a cardiothoracic ratio the system never measured. One registry holds the taxonomy, anatomy, and phrasing for chest X-ray, brain MRI, and head CT, so adding a modality is a data change; all three are routed and tested, one is trained. On ChestMNIST that classifier reaches macro AUROC 0.729 and ranks better than chance on all 14 labels, at 1.6 to 6.8 times the precision a random ranker would get. Yet at the default 0.5 threshold it emits no positive prediction at all for 11 of them, and its excellent-looking Brier score of 0.045 sits beside the 0.047 earned by a predictor that ignores the image. The discrimination is real; the decisions are not. Under the class imbalance normal in radiology, aggregate metrics flatter models that do nothing, and should be reported against that floor.

AI.tldr: MIRROR是一个研究原型，通过链式架构（多标签分类器→Grad-CAM定位器→报告生成器）将影像诊断与自然语言生成解耦，确保语言层无法看到像素、不能声称分类器未做出的发现，使报告结果可审计。实验显示分类器在ChestMNIST上判别力真实但决策不可用，并揭示在类别不平衡下聚合指标会掩盖"什么都不做"的模型。
AI.motivation: 放射科医生阅读模型输出时面临两个问题：模型只返回数字而不提供理由；将数字转成可读文本的系统可能悄悄添加模型从未作出的声明。作者旨在分离这两类失败，并澄清可审计性真正买到了什么。
AI.method: MIRROR采用链式架构：多标签分类器输出标签与概率，Grad-CAM将每个阳性发现定位为命名的解剖区域，报告写入器只接收标签、概率和区域而不接收图像。因为语言层看不到像素，它无法断言分类器未做的发现。一个注册表统一管理胸部X光、脑MRI和头CT的分类学、解剖与措辞，添加模态只是数据变更。
AI.result: 分类器在ChestMNIST上达到宏AUROC 0.729，14个标签全部优于随机，精度为随机排名器的1.6-6.8倍。但在默认0.5阈值下对11个标签无阳性预测。Brier分数0.045与忽略图像的预测器0.047几乎相同。所有三种模态已路由和测试，一种已训练。
AI.conclusion: 判别力是真实的，但决策并不可用。在放射学常见的类别不平衡下，聚合指标会美化"什么都不做"的模型，应将其与不依赖图像的基线地板进行比较报告。

title: An Analytical-Prior Framework for Data-Efficient Prediction of Sound-Reduction Frequencies in Rectangular Side-Branch Helmholtz Resonators
summary: High-fidelity finite-element simulations can provide accurate numerical predictions for side-branch resonators, but large simulation datasets are expensive to generate and purely data-driven surrogates may become unreliable when simulation-labelled data are scarce. This study develops an analytical-prior learning framework that reuses a low-cost analytical model to improve data efficiency under limited high-fidelity simulation budgets. Two complementary routes are considered. When the analytical model remains available at inference, it is retained as an explicit baseline and the simulation data are used to learn only the analytical-to-simulation discrepancy. When a self-contained predictor is required, the analytical mapping is first distilled from abundant low-cost evaluations into a learned prior and then calibrated with the limited simulation data. The framework is evaluated on rectangular side-branch Helmholtz resonators using 86 simulation-labelled geometries and 8,998 non-overlapping analytical-only geometries. The analytical model achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.333 Hz. Direct support vector regression (SVR) achieved 3.375 Hz, while residual SVR reduced the MAE to 0.426 Hz. A direct multilayer perceptron (MLP) achieved 1.109 Hz, whereas analytical-prior pretraining reduced the error to 0.556 Hz with frozen-prior residual adaptation and 0.371 Hz with full-model fine-tuning. Across training budgets of 20 to 70 simulation-labelled cases, both analytical correction and analytical-prior pretraining consistently improved data efficiency relative to direct learning. These results show that analytical prior information can substantially improve high-fidelity prediction when simulation data are scarce, with explicit correction and prior distillation serving complementary deployment needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于解析先验的学习框架，通过复用低成本解析模型来提高有限仿真数据下的预测精度。框架包含两条路径：显式残差校正和解析先验蒸馏后微调，在矩形侧支亥姆霍兹谐振器上验证了显著的数据效率提升。
AI.motivation: 高保真有限元仿真准确但昂贵，大型仿真数据集生成成本高；纯数据驱动的替代模型在仿真标注数据稀缺时可能不可靠。因此需要一种方法在有限高保真仿真预算下提高预测精度。
AI.method: 提出解析先验学习框架，包含两条互补路径：(1) 残差学习——保留解析模型作为显式基线，仅用仿真数据学习解析到仿真的差异；(2) 解析先验蒸馏——先从大量低成本解析评估中蒸馏出学习先验，再使用有限仿真数据微调。采用SVR和MLP两种模型验证。
AI.result: 在86个仿真标注几何和8,998个解析几何上：解析模型MAE为1.333 Hz；直接SVR为3.375 Hz，残差SVR降至0.426 Hz；直接MLP为1.109 Hz，解析先验预训练微调后降至0.371 Hz。在20-70个训练样本预算下，两条路径均显著提升数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 解析先验信息在仿真数据稀缺时能大幅提升高保真预测精度，显式校正和先验蒸馏分别服务于不同的部署需求，两者互为补充。

title: What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models
summary: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule leaves detection accuracy unchanged for every guard and activation probe we test, including a policy-conditioned guard that correctly cites the governing clause yet barely changes its verdict when that clause is swapped for its permissive counterpart. A purpose-built benchmark crossing two rules with two scenarios, so that neither alone predicts the label, confirms the failure under a design no prior benchmark rules out, and shows that step by step reasoning, not any fast detector we test, is what escapes it. Auditing at scale requires a retraining-free detector, so we introduce the Internal Compliance Score (ICS): a training-free activation readout calibrated from ten labelled pairs and scored by a single projection. We hold ICS to the same scrutiny as the guards it audits: a pre-registered criterion for beating trivial baselines is not met, and a bag-of-words model matches its pooled generalisation exactly. It remains useful because it is inexpensive, letting us audit four deployed guard models, an 8B zero-shot judge, and thirteen benchmarks, and it raises the mechanically verified pass rate when used to rank candidate responses, though an adaptive white-box attack removes this gain. We release the counterfactual protocol and crossed-rule benchmark so rule blindness can be tested in future probe and guard claims.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示当前合规检测器普遍存在"规则盲视"问题——检测器的判定依赖于场景表面特征而非所陈述的规则。作者构建交叉规则基准验证了这一失败，并提出了无需训练的激活检测器ICS，但该检测器未能超越简单基线，且易受自适应白盒攻击。尽管如此，ICS因成本低廉仍可用于大规模审计多个部署的防护模型。
AI.motivation: 法规合规监控被广泛用作部署语言模型的审计控制手段，但其有效性前提是检测器的判定必须依赖于所陈述的规则而非场景表面特征。作者发现当前所有合规检测器均不满足这一条件，这种"规则盲视"使合规监控失去意义，需要系统性验证与解决方案。
AI.method: 作者设计了交叉两条规则与两个场景的基准（使单独任一因素都无法预测标签），测试了所有防护模型和激活探针。提出Internal Compliance Score (ICS)：一个无需训练的激活读取方法，仅用十个标注样本校准，通过单次投影打分。作者还采用预注册标准对ICS进行严格评判，并评估其在实际审计中的效用。
AI.result: 发现删除、置换或替换规则不改变任何检测器的准确率，包括能正确引用规则子句的策略条件防护模型。ICS未能通过预注册的胜过朴素基线的标准，袋装词模型与其池化泛化性能完全一致。但ICS成本低廉，可审计四个部署防护模型、一个8B零样本裁判及十三个基准，用于候选响应排序时能提升机械验证通过率，但自适应白盒攻击可消除这一收益。
AI.conclusion: 合规检测器的规则盲视是普遍且严重的缺陷，逐步推理而非任何快速检测器才能克服。作者发布反事实协议和交叉规则基准，供未来检测器验证规则感知能力。ICS虽作为检测器存在局限，但作为低成本大规模审计工具仍有实用价值。

title: PersonaShot: Benchmarking Person-Centric Narrative Continuity in Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot clips to multi-shot narratives, where the human character serves as the core narrative anchor. However, existing benchmarks mainly assess character appearance or individual-shot quality, without measuring whether physical and emotional states remain coherent across cuts. They also rarely provide criterion-specific evaluation methods, although physical continuity, facial dynamics, and cinematic relations require different visual, temporal, and relational evidence. To address these limitations, we introduce PersonaShot, the first person-centric benchmark for narrative continuity in multi-shot video generation. PersonaShot contains approximately 1,000 multi-shot segments and 16 metrics spanning physical continuity, affective dynamics, and cinematic grammar. \textbf{\textit{1)} Narrative Continuity Benchmark:} We evaluate character coherence across three temporal levels: within-shot states, cross-shot transitions, and sequence-level trajectories. \textbf{\textit{2)} Human-Aligned Specialist Evaluators:} We distill reasoning from a large multimodal teacher into lightweight criterion-specific evaluators, each grounded in the visual, temporal, or relational evidence required by its metric, and align them with expert human judgments. \textbf{\textit{3)} Systematic Evaluation and Insights:} Our evaluation reveals distinct capability profiles across state-of-the-art models and a clear gap between perceptual quality and cross-shot narrative continuity. Even visually compelling videos frequently exhibit physical-state resets, abrupt affective shifts, and broken cinematic relations across shots. Human studies further demonstrate strong agreement between our evaluators and expert judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PersonaShot，这是首个以人物为中心的多镜头视频生成叙事连贯性基准，包含约1000个多镜头片段和16个指标，覆盖物理连贯性、情感动态和电影语法三个维度，并提供了与专家人类判断对齐的轻量级标准专用评估器。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成基准主要评估角色外观或单镜头质量，无法衡量物理和情感状态在镜头切换间是否保持一致；同时缺乏针对不同标准（物理连贯性、面部动态、电影关系）的特定评估方法。这些限制阻碍了对多镜头叙事视频生成的全面评估。
AI.method: 1)构建包含约1000个多镜头片段和16个指标的人物中心叙事连贯性基准，从镜头内状态、跨镜头转换和序列级轨迹三个时间层面评估角色连贯性；2)从大型多模态教师模型中蒸馏推理能力，训练轻量级标准专用评估器，每个评估器基于其指标所需的视觉、时间或关系证据，并与专家人类判断对齐；3)进行系统评估并提取洞察。
AI.result: 评估揭示了各先进模型的能力画像差异，以及感知质量与跨镜头叙事连贯性之间的明显差距。即使是视觉上吸引人的视频也频繁出现物理状态重置、情感突变和电影关系断裂。人类研究表明评估器与专家判断具有高度一致性。
AI.conclusion: PersonaShot填补了多镜头视频生成中人物中心叙事连贯性评估的空白，证明现有模型在视觉质量与叙事连贯性之间存在显著鸿沟，为后续提升视频生成模型的跨镜头连贯性提供了系统化的评估工具和方向指引。

title: Q-based Variational Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: The development of safe and beneficial AI requires that systems can learn and act in accordance with human preferences. However, explicitly specifying these preferences by hand is often infeasible. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) addresses this challenge by inferring preferences, represented as reward functions, from expert behaviour. We introduce Q-based Variational IRL (QVIRL), a novel Bayesian IRL method that recovers a posterior distribution over rewards from expert demonstrations via primarily learning a variational distribution over optimal Q-values. Unlike previous approaches, QVIRL combines scalability with uncertainty quantification, important for safety-critical applications as well as active learning. We demonstrate QVIRL's strong performance in apprenticeship learning across various tasks, including gridworlds, Lunar Lander, the Highway Environment, and two ATARI games both with static expert data and with active learning. It is the first method for Bayesian IRL that demonstrates training from raw pixel observations.

AI.tldr: QVIRL是一种新颖的贝叶斯逆强化学习方法，通过变分分布学习最优Q值来恢复奖励的后验分布，兼具可扩展性与不确定性量化能力，首次实现从原始像素观测的贝叶斯IRL训练。
AI.motivation: 安全有益的AI需要系统学习并遵守人类偏好，但手工指定偏好常常不可行。IRL从专家行为中推断奖励函数，然而现有方法难以同时兼顾可扩展性与不确定性量化，这对安全关键应用和主动学习至关重要。
AI.method: QVIRL通过主要学习最优Q值上的变分分布来恢复奖励的后验分布。它是一种新颖的贝叶斯IRL方法，与以往方法不同，它结合了可扩展性与不确定性量化。
AI.result: 在多个任务中展示了强性能，包括gridworlds、Lunar Lander、Highway Environment和两个ATARI游戏，同时适用于静态专家数据和主动学习场景。它是首个展示从原始像素观测进行训练的贝叶斯IRL方法。
AI.conclusion: QVIRL将可扩展性与不确定性量化成功结合，为安全关键应用和主动学习提供了有力支持，是贝叶斯IRL领域的重要进展。

title: A Temporal Reasoning Benchmarking Framework for LRMs via Difficulty-controlled and Dynamic Test Generation
comment: Accepted to ISSTA 2026. 23 pages including references, 3 figures
summary:
Defining the reasoning boundaries and ensuring the reliability of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) remains a critical challenge. Current benchmarks primarily rely on static datasets susceptible to data contamination or synthetic tasks lacking fine-grained difficulty control. Furthermore, standard outcome-based evaluations often conceal reasoning flaws by neglecting the reasoning process.
  To address these limitations, we introduce TRACE, a testing framework that models temporal reasoning as constraint satisfaction problems via Allen's Interval Algebra. This approach enables precise regulation of logical complexity and incorporates a Trace-Based Verification Oracle to validate reasoning faithfulness. Using this framework, we construct TRACEBench, an extensive benchmark comprising 1,200 synthesized test instances across graded difficulty levels. We employ TRACE to evaluate eight widely used LRMs on TRACEBench. The results confirm a strong negative correlation between model performance and our difficulty metric (Pearson's r approximately -0.96), validating the effectiveness of our difficulty control mechanism. Moreover, our trace-based analysis exposes significant discrepancies between reasoning validity and final answers, revealing a high spurious guessing rate of approximately 28% in mid-sized models. In addition, we diagnose scale-dependent failure modes, ranging from Degenerative Loops in small models to Reasoning Explosion in advanced architectures. TRACE thus provides a robust, automated platform for benchmarking the true temporal reasoning capabilities of LRMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE框架，利用Allen区间代数将时间推理建模为约束满足问题，构建TRACEBench基准（含1200个不同难度级别的测试实例），并引入基于轨迹的验证预言机来检验推理忠实性。评估8个主流大型推理模型，发现模型性能与难度指标强负相关（r≈-0.96），揭示了约28%的虚假猜测率，并诊断出从退化循环到推理爆炸等规模相关的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有基准要么依赖易受数据污染的静态数据集，要么使用缺乏精细难度控制的合成任务；且基于结果的评估常忽视推理过程，无法揭示推理缺陷。
AI.method: 通过Allen区间代数将时间推理建模为约束满足问题，实现逻辑复杂度的精确调控；融入基于轨迹的验证预言机以验证推理忠实性；构建包含1200个分级难度测试实例的TRACEBench基准。
AI.result: 在8个主流LRM上验证：模型性能与难度指标强负相关（r≈-0.96），证实难度控制机制有效；轨迹分析暴露推理有效性与最终答案之间的显著差异，中型模型虚假猜测率约28%；诊断出从小型模型的退化循环到先进架构的推理爆炸等规模相关失败模式。
AI.conclusion: TRACE提供了一个稳健、自动化的平台，用于基准测试LRM的真实时间推理能力，能有效控制难度、验证推理过程并诊断多样化的失败模式。

title: CytoFormer: A Molecularly Supervised Cell Foundation Model for Histopathology Cell Classification
summary: Identifying cell types directly from routine haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histology would enable single-cell analysis at scale, but training such models has relied on manual pathologist annotations, which are slow, expensive and unreliable for many cell types. We instead supervise morphology with molecules. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics profiles individual cells in situ on a section that can afterwards be stained with H&E, so that molecular identity and morphology are observed for the same physical cell. We assembled 81 such paired Xenium sections spanning 16 organs, derived per-cell labels by clustering, marker-gene annotation, organ-wise human review and quality control, and mapped them onto the cell types commonly reported in each organ. This yielded 15.4 million cells, each with a paired H&E image patch and one of 23 cell types, on which we trained CytoFormer, a cell foundation model with a multi-task, per-organ classification head. On spatially held-out tissue CytoFormer reached an accuracy of 0.85 and a macro-F1 of 0.78 across all 16 organs, and its predictions reproduced the tissue architecture of an entire held-out section. The representation also transfers: with the encoder frozen, a linear head on CytoFormer features performed better than six pathology foundation models on four expert-annotated benchmarks, including on organs and cell types that were not part of pretraining. Finally, in an interactive active-learning setting, CytoFormer's embeddings are markedly more label-efficient than existing pathology foundation models, detecting normal epithelium amid look-alike tumour with an F1 of 0.82 from only a few annotations and leading the strongest baseline by 0.13 in F1. CytoFormer turns paired H&E and spatial transcriptomics into a reusable, label-efficient representation for cell-level analysis of routine histology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CytoFormer，一个基于H&E图像切片的细胞基础模型。通过将成像空间转录组学（Xenium）与H&E染色配对，在81个切片、16个器官、1540万个细胞上训练，实现了无需人工病理标注的细胞类型鉴定，并展示了强大的泛化能力和标签效率。
AI.motivation: 传统上从H&E组织学切片识别细胞类型依赖病理学家手工标注，该方法缓慢、昂贵且对许多细胞类型不可靠。作者希望用分子数据（空间转录组学）替代人工标注来监督形态学，从而实现大规模的细胞水平单细胞分析。
AI.method: 1) 收集81对Xenium空间转录组与H&E染色切片，覆盖16个器官；2) 通过聚类、标记基因注释、器官人工审核和质量控制获得每个细胞的分子身份标签，映射到23种常见细胞类型；3) 训练CytoFormer——一个带有跨器官多任务分类头（per-organ classification head）的细胞基础模型。
AI.result: 在空间保留的组织的测试中，CytoFormer在16个器官上达到0.85的准确率和0.78的宏F1分数，能重现整个保留切片的组织结构。其冻结编码器特征在4个专家标注基准上优于6个病理基础模型（包括预训练中未见的器官和细胞类型）。在交互式主动学习场景中，CytoFormer的嵌入比现有病理基础模型显著更标签高效，仅用少量标注即可在类似肿瘤的背景下以0.82的F1检测正常上皮，比最强基线高0.13。
AI.conclusion: CytoFormer通过将配对的H&E和空间转录组数据转化为可复用、标签高效的表示，为常规组织学的细胞水平分析提供了新路径，证明了用分子监督取代人工标注来训练形态学模型的可行性。

title: GenRouter: Unified Workflow Routing for Agentic Image Generation
summary: The rapid evolution of text-to-image (T2I) generation models has effectively solved the foundational challenge of raw pixel synthesis, shifting the community's focus toward fulfilling increasingly intricate user requests. While recent agentic image generation workflows enhance static inference with advanced capabilities like external knowledge retrieval and iterative reasoning, they mostly operate in isolated silos with fixed ``one-size-fits-all" topologies. This inevitably leads to severe compute-mismatch, where simple queries are forced through computationally heavy pipelines. To bridge this gap, we present GenRouter, the first unified workflow routing framework for agentic image generation. We first formulate GenCanvas, standardizing diverse agentic pipelines into a universal set of foundational primitives and executable templates. Operating over this unified space, GenRouter adaptively routes heterogeneous prompts to their optimal workflows via (i) demand profiling, (ii) experience matching, and (iii) Pareto filtering. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GenRouter achieves superior visual alignment while reducing execution costs by over 95% and latency by 65% compared to heavyweight static pipelines. Furthermore, the system continuously self-evolves via accumulated experience, enabling robust zero-shot generalization that boosts performance and halves computational overhead.

AI.tldr: GenRouter是首个面向智能体图像生成的统一工作流路由框架，通过将多样化的智能体管线标准化为通用原语和可执行模板，并采用需求画像、经验匹配和Pareto过滤来自适应地将异构提示路由到最优工作流，实现了卓越的视觉对齐效果，同时相比重型静态管线降低超95%的执行成本和65%的延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体图像生成工作流虽然增强了静态推理的能力（如外部知识检索和迭代推理），但大多在孤立的架构中运行，采用固定的"一刀切"拓扑结构，导致严重的计算不匹配——简单查询被迫通过计算密集型管线处理，造成资源浪费。
AI.method: GenRouter包含两个核心组件：(1) GenCanvas——将多样化的智能体管线标准化为一组通用的基础原语和可执行模板；(2) 自适应路由机制——通过需求画像（demand profiling）、经验匹配（experience matching）和Pareto过滤（Pareto filtering）三个步骤，将异构提示路由到最优工作流。系统还能通过累积经验持续自我进化。
AI.result: 在多种基准上的大量实验表明，GenRouter在实现更优视觉对齐的同时，相比重型静态管线降低了超过95%的执行成本和65%的延迟；此外，系统通过经验累积实现自我进化，具备稳健的零样本泛化能力，能在提升性能的同时将计算开销减半。
AI.conclusion: GenRouter通过统一的工作流路由框架解决了智能体图像生成中的计算不匹配问题，证明了按需路由多样化提示到最优工作流的方法既能提升性能又能大幅降低计算成本，且系统具备持续自我进化的能力。

title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Image Dataset Quality Assurance in Multi-Center Breast MRI
summary:
Corrupted, inconsistent, or anomalous data silently threatens the safety and reliability of medical AI. Despite growing regulatory recognition of dataset quality assurance (QA) for high-risk medical AI, scalable automated detection remains underdeveloped. We employ unsupervised anomaly detection (AD) and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection as an automated dataset QA mechanism for multi-center dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI.
  We build a controlled AD benchmark of 17 realistic QA-relevant anomaly types from six public datasets (protocol violations, processing errors, incorrect anatomical regions) and propose a taxonomy of radiological image anomalies based on human visual perception, enabling fine-grained analysis of AD failure modes. The benchmark includes near-, medium-far-, far-OOD samples, as well as in-distribution and external normal data. Four methods are evaluated: a projection-based method extended with a domain-specific feature extractor and a novel positional encoding, a reconstruction-based approach extended to full 3D volumes with an augmented training objective, and two unmodified hybrid OOD detection methods.
